## 3. ИИ

Коротко, где мы:

**Статус работы**
- Все 9 техник (A1–A4, B1–B4, N5) реализованы и были зелёные в тестах (1326/1326 full-security). N5 — последнее крупное: ISA переменной длины + смешанный порядок байт, запакован в зип.
- Потом ты скинул новый `output.lua` и попросил **статик-ревью**: найти оставшиеся уязвимости и придумать ещё техники (только статик). Я прогнал анализ атакующего и нашёл главное:
  - **W2** — бутстрап-заголовок полностью в плейнтексте, одним eval достаётся вся карта билтинов (`string.char`, `bit32.bxor/bor/band`, `table.concat`, `math.floor`, `debug.info`).
  - **W6** — ~2433 «MBA»-выражений над **литеральными константами** → сворачиваются одним проходом парциального вычислителя.
  - **W1 (закрыто)** — A1–A4 реально работают: 268 уникальных фингерпринтов из 271 хендлера.
  - Этот конкретный билд — **не** directVM (нет base85-блоба), а сериализованный inline-путь: ~116K числовых литералов в плейнтексте, но операнды/опкоды rot-зашифрованы.

**А вот почему у тебя сейчас падает:**
```
lua: output.lua:1: malformed number near '0X46_58'
```
Это баг генератора — в вывод попал hex с подчёркиванием `0X46_58`. Стандартный Lua **не** принимает `_` в числовых литералах (это валидно только в Luau/некоторых диалектах). То есть текущий `output.lua` вообще не запускается.

Это, скорее всего, побочка от MBA/noise-эмиттера, который где-то вставил разделитель `_` в числовой литерал.

Что делаем дальше — скажи:
1. чинить баг `0X46_58` (найти в генераторе, где эмитится `_` в числах, и убрать) — это блокер, без него ничего не крутится;
2. или сначала дописать статик-отчёт с новыми предлагаемыми техниками, а баг потом.

cd /data/prism/fixtures

BASE="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/terrorlua/obfuscator-samples/main"

grab() {

  done
}

## 40. ИИ · шаг

Cataloging lexical edge-cases in fixtures
bash
cd /data/prism/fixtures/samples
python3 - <<'PY'
import re, glob, collections
files=sorted(glob.glob('*.lua'))
print(f"{len(files)} fixtures\n")
# edge-case catalog
agg=collections.Counter()
examples={}
pats={
 'hex_underscore': r'0[xX][0-9a-fA-F_]*_[0-9a-fA-F_]+',
 'bin_literal':    r'0[bB][01_]+',
 'hex_float':      r'0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]+\.[0-9a-fA-F]+',
 'num_underscore': r'(?<![\w.])\d[\d_]*_[\d_]+',
 'esc_x':          r'\\x[0-9a-fA-F]{2}',
 'esc_dec':        r'\\\d{1,3}',
 'esc_z':          r'\\z',
 'esc_u':          r'\\u\{[0-9a-fA-F]+\}',
 'longstr':        r'\[(=*)\[',
 'dup_param':      r'function\(([A-Za-z_]\w*),\s*\1\b',
 'goto':           r'\bgoto\b',
 'continue':       r'\bcontinue\b',
 'typecolon':      r'\)\s*:\s*[A-Za-z_][\w.<>]*\s*(?:\n|$|then|do)',
 'strinterp':      r'`[^`]*\{',
 'compound_assign':r'[-+*/%^]=|\.\.=',
}
for f in files:
    s=open(f,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read()
    for name,p in pats.items():
        m=re.findall(p,s)
        if m:
            agg[name]+=len(m)
            if name not in examples:
                mm=re.search(p,s)
                examples[name]=s[mm.start():mm.start()+40].replace('\n','\\n')
for name in pats:
    c=agg.get(name,0)
    ex=examples.get(name,'')
    print(f"{name:18} {c:8}   {ex[:50]}")
PY

## 41. ИИ

The fixtures reveal the **critical ground truth**: these are **Luau**, not Lua 5.1. They use `0X1__2` (underscore hex), `0B...` (binary), `function(J,J,...)` (duplicate params), `continue`, `+=`/`..=`, backtick interpolation. That's exactly why your `output.lua` threw `malformed number near '0X46_58'` in stock Lua — underscores in numerics are a Luau feature. So the engine's lexer must be a real **Luau** lexer.

Now I'll set up the monorepo and start the install. Architecture:
- **`packages/core`** — zero-dependency TS engine (runs in browser + Node + MCP): Luau lexer → parser → AST, constant/MBA folder, string decoder, junk remover, VM/bytecode detector, disassembler, call graph, family fingerprinting.
- **`apps/web`** — Vite + React, purple-neon glass UI, Monaco, copy-everywhere.
- **`apps/mcp`** — MCP server exposing every engine tool to an AI.

Let me scaffold and install.

- **Handler CFG-shape hashing** — свернуть 200 хендлеров в ~30 семантических классов.
- **Pattern-matching по известным VM** (Luraph/IronBrew/MoonSec форки).

# PRISM — Static Luau Reverse Engine: technique catalog

Only static analysis (no execution) for now. Distilled from real deobfuscation work.

## Detection / fingerprinting
- Family fingerprint: header comment, dispatcher shape, key-derivation names, literal styles.
- Luau lexical tells: `0X1__2` (underscore hex), `0B...` (binary), dup params `function(J,J)`,
  `continue`, compound assigns `+= ..=`, backtick string interpolation, `\u{..}`, `\z`.

## Cleanup passes (AST → AST)
1. Constant folding incl. **MBA identities**: `a+b = bor(a,b)+band(a,b)`,
   `a-b`, `a^b` via bit32; fold when all args are literals.
2. String decoding: `string.char(...)`, `\ddd`/`\xHH`/`\u{..}` escapes, concat chains,
   base85/base64 blob decoders, long-string `[[...]]`.
3. Junk/opaque-predicate removal: `if <const> then` pruning, dead branches, no-op math.
4. Identifier renaming: stable semantic names from role inference.
5. Proxy/alias inlining: `local x = bit32.bxor` → inline `x`.

## VM / CFF analysis (the hard part)
- Dispatcher classes:
  - classic table VM: `handlers[opcode](...)` → opcode table.
  - **CFF**: nested `if PC<X then ... elseif PC<Y`, transitions via `state = <next>`.
- Reconstruct CFG from PC/state transitions → basic blocks.
- **Backward slice** from an entry PC: drop unreachable blocks.
- **Symbolic execution / const-fold** per block to collapse the state machine to linear code.
- **Crypto-lifting**: locate decrypt fn (XOR/add over key stream), evaluate symbolically.

## Opcode recovery (custom VM)
- Bytecode histogram: #distinct bytes ≈ #opcodes; byte 0/1 usually NOP/MOVE/RETURN.
- Operand structure via high-nibble clustering → `[op:4][arg:4]` style.
- Handler length analysis: short = simple (MOVE/LOADK), long = CALL/GETTABLE/arith.
- **Handler CFG-shape hashing**: same hash = same semantic class → 200 handlers → ~30 classes.
- Pattern-match handlers against known VM templates (Luraph/IronBrew/MoonSec fork inheritance).

## Outputs the site must produce
- Cleaned source, string table, constant table, bytecode disasm, CFG + call graph,
  opcode map (editable), family report, and copy-everything.
MD

## 55. ИИ · шаг

Writing the universal Luau lexer
bash
cd /data/prism && cat > packages/core/src/lexer.ts <<'TS'
// PRISM Luau lexer — universal, spec-accurate, tolerant.
// Handles Luau extensions seen across all obfuscator families:
//   underscore digit groups (0X1__2, 1_000), binary 0B..,
//   escapes \z \xHH \ddd \u{...}, long strings [[ ]] / [==[ ]==],
//   string interpolation `...{expr}...`, compound assignments += -= .. etc.

export enum T {
  Name, Number, String, InterpString,
  Keyword, Punct, Eof,
}

export interface Token {
  type: T;
  value: string;      // raw lexeme (source text)
  // decoded value for strings/numbers when applicable:
  cooked?: string;    // decoded string contents
  num?: number;       // numeric value
  start: number;      // byte offset in source
  end: number;
  line: number;
  col: number;
  // interpolation: segments of a backtick string (strings + embedded expr source)
  parts?: Array<{ kind: 'str' | 'expr'; value: string }>;
  nl?: boolean;       // preceded by a newline (for ASI-like heuristics)
}

export const KEYWORDS = new Set([
  'and','break','do','else','elseif','end','false','for','function','goto','if','in',
  'local','nil','not','or','repeat','return','then','true','until','while',
  // Luau contextual keywords are treated as names by the parser, except `continue`
  // which we surface as a keyword for convenience; parser also accepts it as a name.
  'continue',
]);

// Multi-char punctuation, longest first.
const PUNCT3 = ['...', '//=', '..='];
const PUNCT2 = ['==','~=','<=','>=','..','::','->','+=','-=','*=','/=','%=','^=','//','<<','>>'];
const PUNCT1 = '+-*/%^#&~|<>=(){}[];:,.?';

export interface LexError { message: string; start: number; line: number; col: number; }

export interface LexResult { tokens: Token[]; errors: LexError[]; }

export function lex(src: string): LexResult {
  const tokens: Token[] = [];
  const errors: LexError[] = [];
  let i = 0;
  let line = 1;
  let lineStart = 0;
  const n = src.length;
  let pendingNL = false;

  const col = () => i - lineStart + 1;
  const push = (t: Omit<Token, 'nl'>) => { tokens.push({ ...t, nl: pendingNL }); pendingNL = false; };
  const err = (message: string, start = i) =>
    errors.push({ message, start, line, col: start - lineStart + 1 });

  const isDigit = (c: string) => c >= '0' && c <= '9';
  const isHex = (c: string) => isDigit(c) || (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F');
  const isNameStart = (c: string) => c === '_' || (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z') || (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') || c.charCodeAt(0) > 127;
  const isNameCont = (c: string) => isNameStart(c) || isDigit(c);

  function newline(c: string) {
    // handle \r\n and \n\r as one line break
    const next = src[i + 1];
    if ((c === '\r' && next === '\n') || (c === '\n' && next === '\r')) i++;
    i++;
    line++;
    lineStart = i;
    pendingNL = true;
  }

  // Long bracket: returns level if src[pos] starts [=*[ , else -1
  function longBracketLevel(pos: number): number {
    if (src[pos] !== '[') return -1;
    let p = pos + 1, eq = 0;
    while (src[p] === '=') { eq++; p++; }
    return src[p] === '[' ? eq : -1;
  }

  function readLongString(level: number): string {
    // assumes i points at opening '['
    i += 2 + level; // skip [==[
    // Luau: a newline immediately after the opening bracket is skipped
    if (src[i] === '\r' || src[i] === '\n') { const c = src[i]; newline(c); }
    const close = ']' + '='.repeat(level) + ']';
    const startContent = i;
    const idx = src.indexOf(close, i);
    if (idx === -1) {
      err('unterminated long string');
      const rest = src.slice(startContent);
      i = n;
      return rest;
    }
    const content = src.slice(startContent, idx);
    // advance line counter across the content
    for (let k = startContent; k < idx; k++) {
      if (src[k] === '\n') { line++; lineStart = k + 1; }
    }
    i = idx + close.length;
    return content;
  }

  function readNumber() {
    const start = i;
    let isFloat = false;
    if (src[i] === '0' && (src[i + 1] === 'x' || src[i + 1] === 'X')) {
      i += 2;
      while (i < n && (isHex(src[i]) || src[i] === '_')) i++;
      if (src[i] === '.') { isFloat = true; i++; while (i < n && (isHex(src[i]) || src[i] === '_')) i++; }
      if (src[i] === 'p' || src[i] === 'P') { isFloat = true; i++; if (src[i] === '+' || src[i] === '-') i++; while (i < n && (isDigit(src[i]) || src[i] === '_')) i++; }
    } else if (src[i] === '0' && (src[i + 1] === 'b' || src[i + 1] === 'B')) {
      i += 2;
      while (i < n && (src[i] === '0' || src[i] === '1' || src[i] === '_')) i++;
    } else {
      while (i < n && (isDigit(src[i]) || src[i] === '_')) i++;
      if (src[i] === '.') { isFloat = true; i++; while (i < n && (isDigit(src[i]) || src[i] === '_')) i++; }
      if (src[i] === 'e' || src[i] === 'E') { isFloat = true; i++; if (src[i] === '+' || src[i] === '-') i++; while (i < n && (isDigit(src[i]) || src[i] === '_')) i++; }
    }
    const raw = src.slice(start, i);
    const num = decodeNumber(raw);
    push({ type: T.Number, value: raw, num, start, end: i, line, col: start - lineStart + 1 });
  }

  function readQuoted(q: string) {
    const start = i;
    i++; // opening quote
    let out = '';
    while (i < n) {
      const c = src[i];
      if (c === q) { i++; break; }
      if (c === '\n' || c === '\r') { err('unterminated string'); break; }
      if (c === '\\') { out += readEscape(); continue; }
      out += c; i++;
    }
    push({ type: T.String, value: src.slice(start, i), cooked: out, start, end: i, line, col: start - lineStart + 1 });
  }

  function readEscape(): string {
    // src[i] === '\\'
    i++;
    const c = src[i];
    switch (c) {
      case 'n': i++; return '\n';
      case 't': i++; return '\t';
      case 'r': i++; return '\r';
      case 'a': i++; return '\x07';
      case 'b': i++; return '\b';
      case 'f': i++; return '\f';
      case 'v': i++; return '\v';
      case '\\': i++; return '\\';
      case '"': i++; return '"';
      case "'": i++; return "'";
      case '`': i++; return '`';
      case '\n': case '\r': newline(c); return '\n';
      case 'x': {
        i++; let h = '';
        for (let k = 0; k < 2 && isHex(src[i]); k++) { h += src[i]; i++; }
        return h ? String.fromCharCode(parseInt(h, 16)) : 'x';
      }
      case 'z': {
        i++;
        while (i < n && /\s/.test(src[i])) { if (src[i] === '\n' || src[i] === '\r') newline(src[i]); else i++; }
        return '';
      }
      case 'u': {
        i++;
        if (src[i] === '{') {
          i++; let h = '';
          while (i < n && src[i] !== '}') { h += src[i]; i++; }
          if (src[i] === '}') i++;
          try { return String.fromCodePoint(parseInt(h, 16) || 0); } catch { return ''; }
        }
        return 'u';
      }
      default:
        if (isDigit(c)) {
          let d = '';
          for (let k = 0; k < 3 && isDigit(src[i]); k++) { d += src[i]; i++; }
          return String.fromCharCode(parseInt(d, 10) & 0xff);
        }
        i++; return c ?? '';
    }
  }

  function readInterp() {
    // backtick string with {expr} segments
    const start = i;
    i++; // opening `
    const parts: Array<{ kind: 'str' | 'expr'; value: string }> = [];
    let cur = '';
    while (i < n) {
      const c = src[i];
      if (c === '`') { i++; break; }
      if (c === '\\') { cur += readEscape(); continue; }
      if (c === '{') {
        parts.push({ kind: 'str', value: cur }); cur = '';
        i++; // skip {
        let depth = 1; const estart = i;
        while (i < n && depth > 0) {
          const d = src[i];
          if (d === '{') depth++;
          else if (d === '}') { depth--; if (depth === 0) break; }
          else if (d === '"' || d === "'") { skipQuotedRaw(d); continue; }
          i++;
        }
        parts.push({ kind: 'expr', value: src.slice(estart, i) });
        if (src[i] === '}') i++;
        continue;
      }
      if (c === '\n' || c === '\r') { err('unterminated interpolated string'); break; }
      cur += c; i++;
    }
    parts.push({ kind: 'str', value: cur });
    push({ type: T.InterpString, value: src.slice(start, i), parts, start, end: i, line, col: start - lineStart + 1 });
  }

  function skipQuotedRaw(q: string) {
    i++; // opening
    while (i < n) {
      const c = src[i];
      if (c === '\\') { i += 2; continue; }
      if (c === q) { i++; break; }
      if (c === '\n') break;
      i++;
    }
  }

  while (i < n) {
    const c = src[i];
    // whitespace
    if (c === '\n' || c === '\r') { newline(c); continue; }
    if (c === ' ' || c === '\t' || c === '\f' || c === '\v') { i++; continue; }
    // comments
    if (c === '-' && src[i + 1] === '-') {
      i += 2;
      const lvl = longBracketLevel(i);
      if (lvl >= 0) { readLongString(lvl); continue; }
      while (i < n && src[i] !== '\n' && src[i] !== '\r') i++;
      continue;
    }
    // long string
    const lvl = longBracketLevel(i);
    if (lvl >= 0) {
      const startL = i, lc = i - lineStart + 1, ln = line;
      const content = readLongString(lvl);
      push({ type: T.String, value: src.slice(startL, i), cooked: content, start: startL, end: i, line: ln, col: lc });
      continue;
    }
    // strings
    if (c === '"' || c === "'") { readQuoted(c); continue; }
    if (c === '`') { readInterp(); continue; }
    // numbers
    if (isDigit(c) || (c === '.' && isDigit(src[i + 1]))) { readNumber(); continue; }
    // names / keywords
    if (isNameStart(c)) {
      const start = i;
      i++;
      while (i < n && isNameCont(src[i])) i++;
      const value = src.slice(start, i);
      push({ type: KEYWORDS.has(value) ? T.Keyword : T.Name, value, start, end: i, line, col: start - lineStart + 1 });
      continue;
    }
    // punctuation (longest match)
    const three = src.substr(i, 3);
    if (PUNCT3.includes(three)) { const s = i; i += 3; push({ type: T.Punct, value: three, start: s, end: i, line, col: s - lineStart + 1 }); continue; }
    const two = src.substr(i, 2);
    if (PUNCT2.includes(two)) { const s = i; i += 2; push({ type: T.Punct, value: two, start: s, end: i, line, col: s - lineStart + 1 }); continue; }
    if (PUNCT1.includes(c)) { const s = i; i += 1; push({ type: T.Punct, value: c, start: s, end: i, line, col: s - lineStart + 1 }); continue; }

    err(`unexpected character ${JSON.stringify(c)}`);
    i++;
  }
  push({ type: T.Eof, value: '', start: i, end: i, line, col: col() });
  return { tokens, errors };
}

// Decode a Luau numeric literal (strips underscores, supports hex/bin/float/exp).
export function decodeNumber(raw: string): number {
  const s = raw.replace(/_/g, '');
  if (/^0[xX]/.test(s)) {
    if (/[.pP]/.test(s)) return parseHexFloat(s);
    return parseInt(s.slice(2), 16);
  }
  if (/^0[bB]/.test(s)) return parseInt(s.slice(2), 2) >>> 0;
  return parseFloat(s);
}

function parseHexFloat(s: string): number {
  // 0x<mantissa>[.<frac>][pP<exp>]
  const m = /^0[xX]([0-9a-fA-F]*)(?:\.([0-9a-fA-F]*))?(?:[pP]([+-]?\d+))?$/.exec(s);
  if (!m) return NaN;
  const [, int = '', frac = '', exp = '0'] = m;
  let val = parseInt(int || '0', 16);
  if (frac) {
    let scale = 1;
    for (const ch of frac) { scale /= 16; val += parseInt(ch, 16) * scale; }
  }
  return val * Math.pow(2, parseInt(exp, 10));
}
TS
echo "lexer.ts written: $(wc -l < packages/core/src/lexer.ts) lines"

// PRISM AST — a compact, complete Luau AST.
export type Node =
  | Chunk | Block
  // statements
  | LocalStat | AssignStat | CallStat | DoStat | WhileStat | RepeatStat
  | IfStat | NumericForStat | GenericForStat | FunctionStat | LocalFunctionStat
  | ReturnStat | BreakStat | ContinueStat | GotoStat | LabelStat
  // expressions
  | NilLit | TrueLit | FalseLit | NumberLit | StringLit | VarargLit
  | NameExpr | IndexExpr | MemberExpr | CallExpr | MethodCallExpr
  | FunctionExpr | TableExpr | BinExpr | UnExpr | ParenExpr | InterpExpr;

export interface Pos { start: number; end: number; line: number; }

interface Base { type: string; loc?: Pos; }

export interface Chunk extends Base { type: 'Chunk'; body: Stat[]; }
export interface Block extends Base { type: 'Block'; body: Stat[]; }

export type Stat =
  | LocalStat | AssignStat | CallStat | DoStat | WhileStat | RepeatStat
  | IfStat | NumericForStat | GenericForStat | FunctionStat | LocalFunctionStat
  | ReturnStat | BreakStat | ContinueStat | GotoStat | LabelStat;

export type Expr =
  | NilLit | TrueLit | FalseLit | NumberLit | StringLit | VarargLit
  | NameExpr | IndexExpr | MemberExpr | CallExpr | MethodCallExpr
  | FunctionExpr | TableExpr | BinExpr | UnExpr | ParenExpr | InterpExpr;

export interface LocalStat extends Base { type: 'LocalStat'; names: string[]; attribs?: (string|null)[]; init: Expr[]; }
export interface AssignStat extends Base { type: 'AssignStat'; targets: Expr[]; values: Expr[]; op?: string; } // op for compound (+=, ..=)
export interface CallStat extends Base { type: 'CallStat'; expr: CallExpr | MethodCallExpr; }
export interface DoStat extends Base { type: 'DoStat'; body: Stat[]; }
export interface WhileStat extends Base { type: 'WhileStat'; cond: Expr; body: Stat[]; }
export interface RepeatStat extends Base { type: 'RepeatStat'; body: Stat[]; cond: Expr; }
export interface IfClause { cond: Expr; body: Stat[]; }
export interface IfStat extends Base { type: 'IfStat'; clauses: IfClause[]; elseBody?: Stat[]; }
export interface NumericForStat extends Base { type: 'NumericForStat'; var: string; from: Expr; to: Expr; step?: Expr; body: Stat[]; }
export interface GenericForStat extends Base { type: 'GenericForStat'; names: string[]; iters: Expr[]; body: Stat[]; }
export interface FunctionStat extends Base { type: 'FunctionStat'; target: Expr; isMethod: boolean; func: FunctionExpr; }
export interface LocalFunctionStat extends Base { type: 'LocalFunctionStat'; name: string; func: FunctionExpr; }
export interface ReturnStat extends Base { type: 'ReturnStat'; args: Expr[]; }
export interface BreakStat extends Base { type: 'BreakStat'; }
export interface ContinueStat extends Base { type: 'ContinueStat'; }
export interface GotoStat extends Base { type: 'GotoStat'; label: string; }
export interface LabelStat extends Base { type: 'LabelStat'; name: string; }

export interface NilLit extends Base { type: 'NilLit'; }
export interface TrueLit extends Base { type: 'TrueLit'; }
export interface FalseLit extends Base { type: 'FalseLit'; }
export interface NumberLit extends Base { type: 'NumberLit'; value: number; raw: string; }
export interface StringLit extends Base { type: 'StringLit'; value: string; raw: string; long?: boolean; }
export interface VarargLit extends Base { type: 'VarargLit'; }
export interface NameExpr extends Base { type: 'NameExpr'; name: string; }
export interface IndexExpr extends Base { type: 'IndexExpr'; obj: Expr; index: Expr; }
export interface MemberExpr extends Base { type: 'MemberExpr'; obj: Expr; name: string; }
export interface CallExpr extends Base { type: 'CallExpr'; callee: Expr; args: Expr[]; }
export interface MethodCallExpr extends Base { type: 'MethodCallExpr'; obj: Expr; method: string; args: Expr[]; }
export interface FunctionExpr extends Base { type: 'FunctionExpr'; params: string[]; vararg: boolean; body: Stat[]; }
export interface TableField { kind: 'item' | 'named' | 'keyed'; key?: Expr; name?: string; value: Expr; }
export interface TableExpr extends Base { type: 'TableExpr'; fields: TableField[]; }
export interface BinExpr extends Base { type: 'BinExpr'; op: string; left: Expr; right: Expr; }
export interface UnExpr extends Base { type: 'UnExpr'; op: string; expr: Expr; }
export interface ParenExpr extends Base { type: 'ParenExpr'; expr: Expr; }
export interface InterpExpr extends Base { type: 'InterpExpr'; parts: Array<{ kind: 'str'; value: string } | { kind: 'expr'; expr: Expr }>; }

// Generic visitor: calls fn on every node; children discovered structurally.
export function walk(node: any, fn: (n: any, parent: any, key: string | null) => void, parent: any = null, key: string | null = null) {
  if (!node || typeof node !== 'object') return;
  if (typeof node.type === 'string') fn(node, parent, key);
  for (const k of Object.keys(node)) {
    if (k === 'loc' || k === 'type') continue;
    const v = (node as any)[k];
    if (Array.isArray(v)) { for (const el of v) walk(el, fn, node, k); }
    else if (v && typeof v === 'object') walk(v, fn, node, k);
  }
}

## 59. ИИ · шаг

Writing the universal Luau parser
bash
cd /data/prism && cat > packages/core/src/parser.ts <<'TS'
// PRISM Luau parser — recursive descent + Pratt expressions.
// Tolerant: records errors but keeps going so obfuscated inputs still yield a usable AST.
import { lex, T, Token } from './lexer.js';
import type * as A from './ast.js';

export interface ParseError { message: string; start: number; line: number; }
export interface ParseResult { chunk: A.Chunk; errors: ParseError[]; }

// Binary operator precedence (left, right) — Lua 5.1/Luau semantics.
const BINPRI: Record<string, [number, number]> = {
  'or': [1, 1], 'and': [2, 2],
  '<': [3, 3], '>': [3, 3], '<=': [3, 3], '>=': [3, 3], '~=': [3, 3], '==': [3, 3],
  '|': [4, 4], '~': [5, 5], '&': [6, 6], '<<': [7, 7], '>>': [7, 7],
  '..': [9, 8], // right assoc
  '+': [10, 10], '-': [10, 10],
  '*': [11, 11], '/': [11, 11], '//': [11, 11], '%': [11, 11],
  '^': [14, 13], // right assoc
};
const UNARY_PRI = 12;
const UNARY = new Set(['not', '-', '#', '~']);

export function parse(src: string): ParseResult {
  const { tokens } = lex(src);
  const errors: ParseError[] = [];
  let p = 0;

  const peek = (o = 0) => tokens[Math.min(p + o, tokens.length - 1)];
  const next = () => tokens[p++];
  const atEof = () => peek().type === T.Eof;
  const loc = (t: Token): A.Pos => ({ start: t.start, end: t.end, line: t.line });

  function err(message: string) {
    const t = peek();
    errors.push({ message, start: t.start, line: t.line });
  }
  function isPunct(v: string, o = 0) { const t = peek(o); return t.type === T.Punct && t.value === v; }
  function isKw(v: string, o = 0) { const t = peek(o); return t.type === T.Keyword && t.value === v; }
  function expectPunct(v: string) { if (isPunct(v)) return next(); err(`expected '${v}'`); return peek(); }
  function expectName(): string {
    const t = peek();
    if (t.type === T.Name || (t.type === T.Keyword && t.value === 'continue')) { next(); return t.value; }
    err('expected name'); return '';
  }

  function parseChunk(): A.Chunk {
    const start = peek();
    const body = parseBlock();
    return { type: 'Chunk', body, loc: loc(start) };
  }

  const BLOCK_END = new Set(['end', 'else', 'elseif', 'until']);
  function blockEnds(): boolean {
    const t = peek();
    if (t.type === T.Eof) return true;
    if (t.type === T.Keyword && BLOCK_END.has(t.value)) return true;
    return false;
  }

  function parseBlock(): A.Stat[] {
    const out: A.Stat[] = [];
    while (!blockEnds()) {
      if (isKw('return')) { out.push(parseReturn()); break; }
      const s = parseStatement();
      if (s) out.push(s);
      else if (!blockEnds()) { // avoid infinite loop
        next();
      }
    }
    return out;
  }

  function parseStatement(): A.Stat | null {
    const t = peek();
    if (isPunct(';')) { next(); return null; }
    if (isPunct('::')) return parseLabel();
    if (t.type === T.Keyword) {
      switch (t.value) {
        case 'local': return parseLocal();
        case 'do': { next(); const body = parseBlock(); expectKw('end'); return { type: 'DoStat', body, loc: loc(t) }; }
        case 'while': return parseWhile();
        case 'repeat': return parseRepeat();
        case 'if': return parseIf();
        case 'for': return parseFor();
        case 'function': return parseFunctionStat();
        case 'break': next(); return { type: 'BreakStat', loc: loc(t) };
        case 'continue': next(); return { type: 'ContinueStat', loc: loc(t) };
        case 'goto': { next(); const label = expectName(); return { type: 'GotoStat', label, loc: loc(t) }; }
      }
    }
    return parseExprStatement();
  }

  function expectKw(v: string) { if (isKw(v)) { next(); return; } err(`expected '${v}'`); }

  function parseLabel(): A.LabelStat {
    const t = next(); // ::
    const name = expectName();
    expectPunct('::');
    return { type: 'LabelStat', name, loc: loc(t) };
  }

  function parseLocal(): A.Stat {
    const t = next(); // local
    if (isKw('function')) {
      next();
      const name = expectName();
      const func = parseFuncBody();
      return { type: 'LocalFunctionStat', name, func, loc: loc(t) };
    }
    const names: string[] = [];
    const attribs: (string | null)[] = [];
    do {
      names.push(expectName());
      if (isPunct('<')) { next(); attribs.push(expectName()); expectPunct('>'); }
      else attribs.push(null);
    } while (isPunct(',') && next());
    let init: A.Expr[] = [];
    if (isPunct('=')) { next(); init = parseExprList(); }
    return { type: 'LocalStat', names, attribs, init, loc: loc(t) };
  }

  function parseWhile(): A.Stat {
    const t = next();
    const cond = parseExpr();
    expectKw('do');
    const body = parseBlock();
    expectKw('end');
    return { type: 'WhileStat', cond, body, loc: loc(t) };
  }
  function parseRepeat(): A.Stat {
    const t = next();
    const body = parseBlock();
    expectKw('until');
    const cond = parseExpr();
    return { type: 'RepeatStat', body, cond, loc: loc(t) };
  }
  function parseIf(): A.Stat {
    const t = next();
    const clauses: A.IfClause[] = [];
    const cond = parseExpr(); expectKw('then');
    clauses.push({ cond, body: parseBlock() });
    while (isKw('elseif')) { next(); const c = parseExpr(); expectKw('then'); clauses.push({ cond: c, body: parseBlock() }); }
    let elseBody: A.Stat[] | undefined;
    if (isKw('else')) { next(); elseBody = parseBlock(); }
    expectKw('end');
    return { type: 'IfStat', clauses, elseBody, loc: loc(t) };
  }
  function parseFor(): A.Stat {
    const t = next();
    const first = expectName();
    if (isPunct('=')) {
      next();
      const from = parseExpr(); expectPunct(',');
      const to = parseExpr();
      let step: A.Expr | undefined;
      if (isPunct(',')) { next(); step = parseExpr(); }
      expectKw('do'); const body = parseBlock(); expectKw('end');
      return { type: 'NumericForStat', var: first, from, to, step, body, loc: loc(t) };
    }
    const names = [first];
    while (isPunct(',')) { next(); names.push(expectName()); }
    expectKw('in');
    const iters = parseExprList();
    expectKw('do'); const body = parseBlock(); expectKw('end');
    return { type: 'GenericForStat', names, iters, body, loc: loc(t) };
  }
  function parseFunctionStat(): A.Stat {
    const t = next();
    let target: A.Expr = { type: 'NameExpr', name: expectName(), loc: loc(peek()) };
    let isMethod = false;
    while (isPunct('.') || isPunct(':')) {
      const method = isPunct(':');
      next();
      const name = expectName();
      target = { type: 'MemberExpr', obj: target, name, loc: loc(t) };
      if (method) { isMethod = true; break; }
    }
    const func = parseFuncBody(isMethod);
    return { type: 'FunctionStat', target, isMethod, func, loc: loc(t) };
  }

  function parseReturn(): A.Stat {
    const t = next();
    let args: A.Expr[] = [];
    if (!blockEnds() && !isPunct(';')) args = parseExprList();
    if (isPunct(';')) next();
    return { type: 'ReturnStat', args, loc: loc(t) };
  }

  const COMPOUND = new Set(['+=', '-=', '*=', '/=', '%=', '^=', '//=', '..=']);
  function parseExprStatement(): A.Stat {
    const t = peek();
    const first = parseSuffixedExpr();
    if (isPunct('=') || [...COMPOUND].some(o => isPunct(o))) {
      const targets = [first];
      // only '=' allows multiple targets
      const opTok = peek();
      if (opTok.value === '=') {
        while (isPunct(',')) { next(); targets.push(parseSuffixedExpr()); }
        expectPunct('=');
        const values = parseExprList();
        return { type: 'AssignStat', targets, values, loc: loc(t) };
      } else {
        next(); // compound op
        const values = parseExprList();
        return { type: 'AssignStat', targets, values, op: opTok.value, loc: loc(t) };
      }
    }
    if (first.type === 'CallExpr' || first.type === 'MethodCallExpr') {
      return { type: 'CallStat', expr: first, loc: loc(t) };
    }
    err('unexpected expression statement');
    return { type: 'CallStat', expr: first as any, loc: loc(t) };
  }

  // ---- expressions ----
  function parseExprList(): A.Expr[] {
    const out = [parseExpr()];
    while (isPunct(',')) { next(); out.push(parseExpr()); }
    return out;
  }

  function parseExpr(limit = 0): A.Expr {
    let left: A.Expr;
    const t = peek();
    if ((t.type === T.Keyword && t.value === 'not') || (t.type === T.Punct && UNARY.has(t.value))) {
      next();
      const expr = parseExpr(UNARY_PRI);
      left = { type: 'UnExpr', op: t.value, expr, loc: loc(t) };
    } else {
      left = parseSimpleExpr();
    }
    for (;;) {
      const op = peek();
      const key = op.type === T.Keyword ? op.value : op.type === T.Punct ? op.value : '';
      const pri = BINPRI[key];
      if (!pri || pri[0] <= limit) break;
      next();
      const right = parseExpr(pri[1]);
      left = { type: 'BinExpr', op: key, left, right, loc: loc(t) };
    }
    return left;
  }

  function parseSimpleExpr(): A.Expr {
    const t = peek();
    switch (t.type) {
      case T.Number: next(); return { type: 'NumberLit', value: t.num ?? 0, raw: t.value, loc: loc(t) };
      case T.String: next(); return { type: 'StringLit', value: t.cooked ?? '', raw: t.value, long: t.value.startsWith('['), loc: loc(t) };
      case T.InterpString: {
        next();
        const parts = (t.parts ?? []).map(part =>
          part.kind === 'str'
            ? { kind: 'str' as const, value: part.value }
            : { kind: 'expr' as const, expr: parse(part.value || 'nil').chunk.body[0] && exprOf(part.value) });
        return { type: 'InterpExpr', parts: parts as any, loc: loc(t) };
      }
      case T.Keyword:
        if (t.value === 'nil') { next(); return { type: 'NilLit', loc: loc(t) }; }
        if (t.value === 'true') { next(); return { type: 'TrueLit', loc: loc(t) }; }
        if (t.value === 'false') { next(); return { type: 'FalseLit', loc: loc(t) }; }
        if (t.value === 'function') { next(); return parseFuncBody(); }
        break;
      case T.Punct:
        if (t.value === '...') { next(); return { type: 'VarargLit', loc: loc(t) }; }
        if (t.value === '{') return parseTable();
        break;
    }
    return parseSuffixedExpr();
  }

  function exprOf(srcPart: string): A.Expr {
    // parse an embedded interpolation expression fragment
    const r = parse('return (' + srcPart + ')');
    const ret = r.chunk.body[0] as A.ReturnStat | undefined;
    return (ret && ret.args[0]) || { type: 'NilLit' };
  }

  function parsePrimaryExpr(): A.Expr {
    const t = peek();
    if (isPunct('(')) {
      next();
      const e = parseExpr();
      expectPunct(')');
      return { type: 'ParenExpr', expr: e, loc: loc(t) };
    }
    if (t.type === T.Name || (t.type === T.Keyword && t.value === 'continue')) {
      next();
      return { type: 'NameExpr', name: t.value, loc: loc(t) };
    }
    err('unexpected token in expression');
    next();
    return { type: 'NilLit', loc: loc(t) };
  }

  function parseSuffixedExpr(): A.Expr {
    let e = parsePrimaryExpr();
    for (;;) {
      const t = peek();
      if (isPunct('.')) { next(); const name = expectName(); e = { type: 'MemberExpr', obj: e, name, loc: loc(t) }; }
      else if (isPunct('[')) { next(); const index = parseExpr(); expectPunct(']'); e = { type: 'IndexExpr', obj: e, index, loc: loc(t) }; }
      else if (isPunct(':')) { next(); const method = expectName(); const args = parseCallArgs(); e = { type: 'MethodCallExpr', obj: e, method, args, loc: loc(t) }; }
      else if (isPunct('(') || isPunct('{') || t.type === T.String || t.type === T.InterpString) {
        const args = parseCallArgs();
        e = { type: 'CallExpr', callee: e, args, loc: loc(t) };
      } else break;
    }
    return e;
  }

  function parseCallArgs(): A.Expr[] {
    const t = peek();
    if (t.type === T.String) { next(); return [{ type: 'StringLit', value: t.cooked ?? '', raw: t.value, loc: loc(t) }]; }
    if (t.type === T.InterpString) { const e = parseSimpleExpr(); return [e]; }
    if (isPunct('{')) return [parseTable()];
    expectPunct('(');
    if (isPunct(')')) { next(); return []; }
    const args = parseExprList();
    expectPunct(')');
    return args;
  }

  function parseTable(): A.Expr {
    const t = expectPunct('{');
    const fields: A.TableField[] = [];
    while (!isPunct('}') && !atEof()) {
      if (isPunct('[')) {
        next(); const key = parseExpr(); expectPunct(']'); expectPunct('=');
        fields.push({ kind: 'keyed', key, value: parseExpr() });
      } else if ((peek().type === T.Name) && isPunct('=', 1)) {
        const name = expectName(); next(); // =
        fields.push({ kind: 'named', name, value: parseExpr() });
      } else {
        fields.push({ kind: 'item', value: parseExpr() });
      }
      if (isPunct(',') || isPunct(';')) next(); else break;
    }
    expectPunct('}');
    return { type: 'TableExpr', fields, loc: loc(t) };
  }

  function parseFuncBody(isMethod = false): A.FunctionExpr {
    const t = peek();
    expectPunct('(');
    const params: string[] = [];
    let vararg = false;
    if (isMethod) params.push('self');
    if (!isPunct(')')) {
      do {
        if (isPunct('...')) { next(); vararg = true; break; }
        params.push(expectName());
        // optional Luau type annotation: name: Type
        if (isPunct(':')) { next(); skipTypeAnnotation(); }
      } while (isPunct(',') && next());
    }
    expectPunct(')');
    if (isPunct(':')) { next(); skipTypeAnnotation(); } // return type
    const body = parseBlock();
    expectKw('end');
    return { type: 'FunctionExpr', params, vararg, body, loc: loc(t) };
  }

  // Minimal Luau type-annotation skipper (so handlers with types still parse).
  function skipTypeAnnotation() {
    let depth = 0;
    for (;;) {
      const t = peek();
      if (t.type === T.Eof) return;
      if (isPunct('(') || isPunct('{') || isPunct('<')) { depth++; next(); continue; }
      if (isPunct(')') || isPunct('}') || isPunct('>')) { if (depth === 0) return; depth--; next(); continue; }
      if (depth === 0 && (isPunct(',') || isPunct('=') || isPunct(')') || isKw('end') || isPunct(';'))) return;
      if (depth === 0 && (t.type === T.Name || t.type === T.Keyword) && (isPunct('=', 1) || isPunct(',', 1) || isPunct(')', 1))) {
        // likely start of next param
        if (!isPunct('.', 1) && !isPunct('<', 1)) return;
      }
      next();
    }
  }

  const chunk = parseChunk();
  return { chunk, errors };
}

bash
cd /data/prism && cat > packages/core/test/lexparse.ts <<'TS'
import { lex, T } from '../src/lexer.js';
import { parse } from '../src/parser.js';
import { walk } from '../src/ast.js';
import { readdirSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';

const dir = join(process.cwd(), 'fixtures/samples');
const files = readdirSync(dir).filter(f => f.endsWith('.lua')).sort();
let totalTok = 0, totalNodes = 0, totalErr = 0, ok = 0;
console.log(`Testing lexer+parser on ${files.length} real fixtures:\n`);
for (const f of files) {
  const src = readFileSync(join(dir, f), 'utf8');
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const lr = lex(src);
  const t1 = Date.now();
  const pr = parse(src);
  const t2 = Date.now();
  let nodes = 0; walk(pr.chunk, () => nodes++);
  totalTok += lr.tokens.length; totalNodes += nodes; totalErr += pr.errors.length;
  const errRatio = pr.errors.length / Math.max(1, nodes);
  const good = errRatio < 0.01;
  if (good) ok++;
  const firstErr = pr.errors[0] ? ` | 1st: "${pr.errors[0].message}" @L${pr.errors[0].line}` : '';
  console.log(
    `${good ? 'OK ' : 'ERR'} ${f.padEnd(26)} ${(src.length/1024|0)+'KB'}`.padEnd(44) +
    `tok=${lr.tokens.length.toString().padStart(7)} nodes=${nodes.toString().padStart(7)} ` +
    `perr=${pr.errors.length.toString().padStart(4)} lex=${(t1-t0)}ms parse=${(t2-t1)}ms${firstErr}`
  );
}
console.log(`\n${ok}/${files.length} parsed clean (<1% error ratio). tokens=${totalTok} nodes=${totalNodes} parseErrors=${totalErr}`);
TS

import { lex, T } from './packages/core/src/lexer.js';
import { parse } from './packages/core/src/parser.js';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
for (const f of ['luraph_v14.8.lua','moonsec_v2_2.lua','ironbrew2_2.lua','luaobf_vm_1.lua','hercules_max_1.lua']) {
  const src = readFileSync('fixtures/samples/'+f,'utf8');
  const { tokens } = lex(src);
  const pr = parse(src);
  console.log(`\n===== ${f} :: ${pr.errors.length} errors =====`);
  for (const e of pr.errors.slice(0,3)) {
    // find token index near error offset
    let idx = tokens.findIndex(t => t.start >= e.start);
    if (idx < 0) idx = 0;
    const win = tokens.slice(Math.max(0,idx-6), idx+6)
      .map((t,k)=>`${(k=== 6?'>> ':'   ')}${T[t.type]}:${JSON.stringify(t.value).slice(0,22)}`).join('  ');
    console.log(`  L${e.line} "${e.message}"  @${e.start}`);
    console.log(`    ctx: ${win}`);
    console.log(`    src: ${JSON.stringify(src.slice(e.start-30, e.start+40))}`);
  }
}

## 76. ИИ

Found the root-cause bug: in `parseBlock`, an empty statement (`;`) returns `null` after consuming the `;`, but then the recovery path force-skips **another** token — eating the next real statement (e.g. the `n` in `n[60]=...`). That one bug cascades through every VM-family file. Fix: only force-advance when the parser is genuinely stuck (position unchanged).

cd /data/prism && cat > packages/core/src/printer.ts <<'TS'
// PRISM printer — AST -> readable Luau source. Deterministic, stable indentation.
import type * as A from './ast.js';

const KW_TARGET = new Set([
  'and','break','do','else','elseif','end','false','for','function','goto','if','in',
  'local','nil','not','or','repeat','return','then','true','until','while',
]);

export interface PrintOptions { indent?: string; }

export function print(node: A.Chunk | A.Stat | A.Expr, opts: PrintOptions = {}): string {
  const IND = opts.indent ?? '  ';
  const out: string[] = [];
  const push = (s: string) => out.push(s);

  function block(body: A.Stat[], depth: number) {
    for (const s of body) { push(IND.repeat(depth)); stat(s, depth); push('\n'); }
  }

  function stat(s: A.Stat, d: number) {
    switch (s.type) {
      case 'LocalStat': {
        push('local ' + s.names.join(', '));
        if (s.init.length) { push(' = '); push(s.init.map(e => expr(e)).join(', ')); }
        push(';'); break;
      }
      case 'AssignStat': {
        push(s.targets.map(e => expr(e)).join(', '));
        push(' ' + (s.op ?? '=') + ' ');
        push(s.values.map(e => expr(e)).join(', ')); push(';'); break;
      }
      case 'CallStat': push(expr(s.expr) + ';'); break;
      case 'DoStat': push('do\n'); block(s.body, d + 1); push(IND.repeat(d) + 'end'); break;
      case 'WhileStat': push('while ' + expr(s.cond) + ' do\n'); block(s.body, d + 1); push(IND.repeat(d) + 'end'); break;
      case 'RepeatStat': push('repeat\n'); block(s.body, d + 1); push(IND.repeat(d) + 'until ' + expr(s.cond)); break;
      case 'IfStat': {
        s.clauses.forEach((c, i) => {
          push((i === 0 ? 'if ' : IND.repeat(d) + 'elseif ') + expr(c.cond) + ' then\n');
          block(c.body, d + 1);
        });
        if (s.elseBody) { push(IND.repeat(d) + 'else\n'); block(s.elseBody, d + 1); }
        push(IND.repeat(d) + 'end'); break;
      }
      case 'NumericForStat': {
        push('for ' + s.var + ' = ' + expr(s.from) + ', ' + expr(s.to) + (s.step ? ', ' + expr(s.step) : '') + ' do\n');
        block(s.body, d + 1); push(IND.repeat(d) + 'end'); break;
      }
      case 'GenericForStat': {
        push('for ' + s.names.join(', ') + ' in ' + s.iters.map(e => expr(e)).join(', ') + ' do\n');
        block(s.body, d + 1); push(IND.repeat(d) + 'end'); break;
      }
      case 'FunctionStat': {
        push('function ' + expr(s.target) + funcTail(s.func, d, s.isMethod)); break;
      }
      case 'LocalFunctionStat': push('local function ' + s.name + funcTail(s.func, d)); break;
      case 'ReturnStat': push('return' + (s.args.length ? ' ' + s.args.map(e => expr(e)).join(', ') : '') + ';'); break;
      case 'BreakStat': push('break;'); break;
      case 'ContinueStat': push('continue;'); break;
      case 'GotoStat': push('goto ' + s.label + ';'); break;
      case 'LabelStat': push('::' + s.name + '::'); break;
      default: push('--[[?]]');
    }
  }

  function funcTail(f: A.FunctionExpr, d: number, isMethod = false): string {
    const params = isMethod ? f.params.slice(1) : f.params;
    const p = params.concat(f.vararg ? ['...'] : []).join(', ');
    const inner: string[] = [];
    const saved = out.splice(0, out.length); // capture nested
    block(f.body, d + 1);
    const body = out.join(''); out.length = 0; out.push(...saved);
    return '(' + p + ')\n' + body + IND.repeat(d) + 'end';
  }

  function expr(e: A.Expr): string {
    switch (e.type) {
      case 'NilLit': return 'nil';
      case 'TrueLit': return 'true';
      case 'FalseLit': return 'false';
      case 'VarargLit': return '...';
      case 'NumberLit': return numStr(e.value, e.raw);
      case 'StringLit': return strLit(e.value);
      case 'NameExpr': return e.name;
      case 'MemberExpr': return expr(e.obj) + '.' + e.name;
      case 'IndexExpr': return expr(e.obj) + '[' + expr(e.index) + ']';
      case 'CallExpr': return callee(e.callee) + '(' + e.args.map(a => expr(a)).join(', ') + ')';
      case 'MethodCallExpr': return callee(e.obj) + ':' + e.method + '(' + e.args.map(a => expr(a)).join(', ') + ')';
      case 'ParenExpr': return '(' + expr(e.expr) + ')';
      case 'UnExpr': return (e.op === 'not' ? 'not ' : e.op) + wrapBin(e.expr);
      case 'BinExpr': return wrapBin(e.left) + ' ' + e.op + ' ' + wrapBin(e.right);
      case 'FunctionExpr': { return 'function' + funcTailExpr(e); }
      case 'TableExpr': return table(e);
      case 'InterpExpr': return '`' + e.parts.map(p => p.kind === 'str' ? p.value : '{' + expr(p.expr) + '}').join('') + '`';
      default: return '--[[?expr]]';
    }
  }

  function funcTailExpr(f: A.FunctionExpr): string {
    const p = f.params.concat(f.vararg ? ['...'] : []).join(', ');
    const saved = out.splice(0, out.length);
    block(f.body, 1);
    const body = out.join(''); out.length = 0; out.push(...saved);
    return '(' + p + ')\n' + body + 'end';
  }

  function callee(e: A.Expr): string {
    // wrap calls on non-trivial callees
    if (e.type === 'NameExpr' || e.type === 'MemberExpr' || e.type === 'IndexExpr' || e.type === 'CallExpr' || e.type === 'MethodCallExpr' || e.type === 'ParenExpr') return expr(e);
    return '(' + expr(e) + ')';
  }

  function wrapBin(e: A.Expr): string {
    if (e.type === 'BinExpr' || e.type === 'UnExpr') return '(' + expr(e) + ')';
    return expr(e);
  }

  function table(t: A.TableExpr): string {
    if (!t.fields.length) return '{}';
    const parts = t.fields.map(f => {
      if (f.kind === 'item') return expr(f.value);
      if (f.kind === 'named') return f.name + ' = ' + expr(f.value);
      return '[' + expr(f.key!) + '] = ' + expr(f.value);
    });
    return '{ ' + parts.join(', ') + ' }';
  }

  if ((node as A.Chunk).type === 'Chunk') { block((node as A.Chunk).body, 0); return out.join(''); }
  if ('type' in node && isStat(node as A.Stat)) { stat(node as A.Stat, 0); return out.join(''); }
  return exprOnly(node as A.Expr);

  function exprOnly(e: A.Expr) { return expr(e); }
}

function isStat(n: any): boolean { return typeof n.type === 'string' && n.type.endsWith('Stat'); }

export function numStr(v: number, raw?: string): string {
  if (Number.isInteger(v) && Math.abs(v) < 1e15) return String(v);
  if (!Number.isFinite(v)) return v > 0 ? '(1/0)' : (v < 0 ? '(-1/0)' : '(0/0)');
  return String(v);
}

export function strLit(s: string): string {
  // choose quote with fewer escapes
  let needEsc = false;
  for (const ch of s) { const c = ch.charCodeAt(0); if (c < 32 || c === 127) { needEsc = true; break; } }
  const dq = s.includes('"'), sq = s.includes("'");
  const q = dq && !sq ? "'" : '"';
  let out = q;
  for (const ch of s) {
    const c = ch.charCodeAt(0);
    if (ch === q) out += '\\' + q;
    else if (ch === '\\') out += '\\\\';
    else if (ch === '\n') out += '\\n';
    else if (ch === '\t') out += '\\t';
    else if (ch === '\r') out += '\\r';
    else if (c < 32 || c === 127) out += '\\' + c;
    else out += ch;
  }
  return out + q;
}
TS

## 82. ИИ

Now the **constant/MBA folding pass** — one of the most impactful cleanup tools. It evaluates literal arithmetic, bit32 operations, and the MBA identities (`a+b = bor(a,b)+band(a,b)`, etc.) that every obfuscator uses. This directly collapses the `0X46_58`-style noise.

## 83. ИИ · шаг

Writing the constant/MBA folding pass
bash
cd /data/prism && cat > packages/core/src/passes/fold.ts <<'TS'
// PRISM constant + MBA folding pass.
// Evaluates literal arithmetic, comparisons, string concat, and bit32/bitops
// (including Luau's native operators and the common MBA identities obfuscators emit).
import type * as A from '../ast.js';

export interface FoldStats { folded: number; mbaFolded: number; }

const U32 = 0x100000000;
const toU32 = (n: number) => ((n % U32) + U32) % U32 >>> 0;
const toI32 = (n: number) => (toU32(n) | 0);

// Map of known bit32.* builtins -> operation (populated from alias analysis later; here the literal names).
function bitFn(name: string): ((a: number, b: number) => number) | null {
  switch (name) {
    case 'bxor': return (a, b) => toU32(toU32(a) ^ toU32(b));
    case 'band': return (a, b) => toU32(toU32(a) & toU32(b));
    case 'bor': return (a, b) => toU32(toU32(a) | toU32(b));
    default: return null;
  }
}

function lit(n: A.Expr | undefined): number | string | boolean | null | undefined {
  if (!n) return undefined;
  if (n.type === 'NumberLit') return n.value;
  if (n.type === 'StringLit') return n.value;
  if (n.type === 'TrueLit') return true;
  if (n.type === 'FalseLit') return false;
  if (n.type === 'NilLit') return null;
  return undefined;
}
const isNum = (v: any): v is number => typeof v === 'number';

function mkNum(value: number, loc?: A.Pos): A.NumberLit { return { type: 'NumberLit', value, raw: String(value), loc }; }
function mkStr(value: string, loc?: A.Pos): A.StringLit { return { type: 'StringLit', value, raw: JSON.stringify(value), loc }; }
function mkBool(v: boolean, loc?: A.Pos): A.Expr { return v ? { type: 'TrueLit', loc } : { type: 'FalseLit', loc }; }

// Recognize bit32.op(a,b) or alias via a resolver (name -> canonical bit op).
function asBitCall(e: A.Expr, resolve: (name: string) => string | null): { op: string; a: A.Expr; b: A.Expr } | null {
  if (e.type !== 'CallExpr') return null;
  let name: string | null = null;
  if (e.callee.type === 'MemberExpr' && e.callee.obj.type === 'NameExpr' && e.callee.obj.name === 'bit32') name = e.callee.name;
  else if (e.callee.type === 'NameExpr') name = resolve(e.callee.name);
  if (!name) return null;
  if (!['bxor', 'band', 'bor'].includes(name)) return null;
  if (e.args.length !== 2) return null;
  return { op: name, a: e.args[0], b: e.args[1] };
}

export interface FoldOptions {
  // resolver maps a local alias name to a canonical bit op ('bxor'|'band'|'bor') if known
  resolveBitAlias?: (name: string) => string | null;
  maxStringConcat?: number;
}

export function fold(node: any, opts: FoldOptions = {}): FoldStats {
  const stats: FoldStats = { folded: 0, mbaFolded: 0 };
  const resolve = opts.resolveBitAlias ?? (() => null);

  function evalExpr(e: A.Expr): A.Expr {
    switch (e.type) {
      case 'ParenExpr': {
        e.expr = evalExpr(e.expr);
        // collapse parens around a literal
        if (isLiteral(e.expr)) { stats.folded++; return e.expr; }
        return e;
      }
      case 'UnExpr': {
        e.expr = evalExpr(e.expr);
        const v = lit(e.expr);
        if (e.op === '-' && isNum(v)) { stats.folded++; return mkNum(-v, e.loc); }
        if (e.op === 'not' && v !== undefined) { stats.folded++; return mkBool(!(v !== false && v !== null), e.loc); }
        if (e.op === '#' && typeof v === 'string') { stats.folded++; return mkNum(v.length, e.loc); }
        if (e.op === '~' && isNum(v)) { stats.folded++; return mkNum(toI32(~toU32(v)), e.loc); }
        return e;
      }
      case 'BinExpr': {
        e.left = evalExpr(e.left);
        e.right = evalExpr(e.right);
        const folded = foldBin(e);
        if (folded) { stats.folded++; return folded; }
        const mba = foldMBA(e);
        if (mba) { stats.mbaFolded++; stats.folded++; return mba; }
        return e;
      }
      case 'CallExpr': {
        e.callee = evalExpr(e.callee);
        e.args = e.args.map(evalExpr);
        // fold bit32.op(litA, litB)
        const bc = asBitCall(e, resolve);
        if (bc) {
          const a = lit(bc.a), b = lit(bc.b);
          if (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) {
            const fn = bitFn(bc.op)!;
            stats.folded++;
            return mkNum(toI32(fn(a, b)), e.loc);
          }
        }
        return e;
      }
      case 'MethodCallExpr': { e.obj = evalExpr(e.obj); e.args = e.args.map(evalExpr); return e; }
      case 'IndexExpr': { e.obj = evalExpr(e.obj); e.index = evalExpr(e.index); return e; }
      case 'MemberExpr': { e.obj = evalExpr(e.obj); return e; }
      case 'TableExpr': { for (const f of e.fields) { if (f.key) f.key = evalExpr(f.key); f.value = evalExpr(f.value); } return e; }
      case 'FunctionExpr': { walkStats(e.body); return e; }
      case 'InterpExpr': { for (const p of e.parts) if (p.kind === 'expr') p.expr = evalExpr(p.expr); return e; }
      default: return e;
    }
  }

  function foldBin(e: A.BinExpr): A.Expr | null {
    const a = lit(e.left), b = lit(e.right);
    // string concat
    if (e.op === '..' && (typeof a === 'string' || isNum(a)) && (typeof b === 'string' || isNum(b))) {
      return mkStr(String(a) + String(b), e.loc);
    }
    if (!isNum(a) || !isNum(b)) {
      // boolean logic with literals
      if (e.op === 'and') { if (a === false || a === null) return e.left; if (a !== undefined) return e.right; }
      if (e.op === 'or') { if (a !== undefined && a !== false && a !== null) return e.left; if (a === false || a === null) return e.right; }
      return null;
    }
    switch (e.op) {
      case '+': return mkNum(a + b, e.loc);
      case '-': return mkNum(a - b, e.loc);
      case '*': return mkNum(a * b, e.loc);
      case '/': return mkNum(a / b, e.loc);
      case '%': return mkNum(a - Math.floor(a / b) * b, e.loc);
      case '^': return mkNum(Math.pow(a, b), e.loc);
      case '//': return mkNum(Math.floor(a / b), e.loc);
      case '==': return mkBool(a === b, e.loc);
      case '~=': return mkBool(a !== b, e.loc);
      case '<': return mkBool(a < b, e.loc);
      case '>': return mkBool(a > b, e.loc);
      case '<=': return mkBool(a <= b, e.loc);
      case '>=': return mkBool(a >= b, e.loc);
      case '&': return mkNum(toI32(toU32(a) & toU32(b)), e.loc);
      case '|': return mkNum(toI32(toU32(a) | toU32(b)), e.loc);
      case '~': return mkNum(toI32(toU32(a) ^ toU32(b)), e.loc);
      case '<<': return mkNum(toI32(toU32(a) << (b & 31)), e.loc);
      case '>>': return mkNum(toI32(toU32(a) >>> (b & 31)), e.loc);
      default: return null;
    }
  }

  // MBA identities over literals: bor(a,b)+band(a,b) == a+b ; bxor(a,b)+2*band(a,b) == a+b ; etc.
  function foldMBA(e: A.BinExpr): A.Expr | null {
    if (e.op !== '+' && e.op !== '-') return null;
    const L = asBitCall(e.left, resolve);
    const R = asBitCall(e.right, resolve);
    if (!L || !R) return null;
    const la = lit(L.a), lb = lit(L.b), ra = lit(R.a), rb = lit(R.b);
    if (!(isNum(la) && isNum(lb) && isNum(ra) && isNum(rb))) return null;
    // same operand pair?
    const samePair = (la === ra && lb === rb) || (la === rb && lb === ra);
    if (!samePair) return null;
    const ops = new Set([L.op, R.op]);
    // a+b = bor+band
    if (e.op === '+' && ops.has('bor') && ops.has('band')) return mkNum(toI32(la + lb), e.loc);
    // a+b = bxor + 2*band -> appears as (bxor) + (band) when band counted twice; handle simple bor/band only here
    // a^b style handled by literal bit fold already
    return null;
  }

  function isLiteral(e: A.Expr): boolean {
    return e.type === 'NumberLit' || e.type === 'StringLit' || e.type === 'TrueLit' || e.type === 'FalseLit' || e.type === 'NilLit';
  }

  function walkStats(body: A.Stat[]) {
    for (const s of body) walkStat(s);
  }
  function walkStat(s: A.Stat) {
    switch (s.type) {
      case 'LocalStat': s.init = s.init.map(evalExpr); break;
      case 'AssignStat': s.targets = s.targets.map(evalExpr); s.values = s.values.map(evalExpr); break;
      case 'CallStat': s.expr = evalExpr(s.expr) as any; break;
      case 'DoStat': walkStats(s.body); break;
      case 'WhileStat': s.cond = evalExpr(s.cond); walkStats(s.body); break;
      case 'RepeatStat': walkStats(s.body); s.cond = evalExpr(s.cond); break;
      case 'IfStat': for (const c of s.clauses) { c.cond = evalExpr(c.cond); walkStats(c.body); } if (s.elseBody) walkStats(s.elseBody); break;
      case 'NumericForStat': s.from = evalExpr(s.from); s.to = evalExpr(s.to); if (s.step) s.step = evalExpr(s.step); walkStats(s.body); break;
      case 'GenericForStat': s.iters = s.iters.map(evalExpr); walkStats(s.body); break;
      case 'FunctionStat': s.target = evalExpr(s.target); walkStats(s.func.body); break;
      case 'LocalFunctionStat': walkStats(s.func.body); break;
      case 'ReturnStat': s.args = s.args.map(evalExpr); break;
    }
  }

  if (node.type === 'Chunk') walkStats(node.body);
  else if (node.type && node.type.endsWith('Stat')) walkStat(node);
  else evalExpr(node);
  return stats;
}

## 85. ИИ · шаг

Writing string recovery and alias passes
bash
cd /data/prism && cat > packages/core/src/passes/strings.ts <<'TS'
// PRISM string-recovery pass.
// Folds string.char(a,b,...) and alias(...) chains, and {string.byte-style} decoders,
// plus collects a string table for reporting. Escapes are already decoded by the lexer.
import type * as A from '../ast.js';

export interface StringStats { charCalls: number; concatChains: number; }

export interface StringOptions {
  // resolve a name to 'string.char' / 'string.byte' / 'table.concat' if it's an alias
  resolveStrAlias?: (name: string) => string | null;
}

function mkStr(value: string, loc?: A.Pos): A.StringLit { return { type: 'StringLit', value, raw: JSON.stringify(value), loc }; }

export function recoverStrings(node: any, opts: StringOptions = {}): StringStats {
  const stats: StringStats = { charCalls: 0, concatChains: 0 };
  const resolve = opts.resolveStrAlias ?? (() => null);

  function nameOf(e: A.Expr): string | null {
    if (e.type === 'MemberExpr' && e.obj.type === 'NameExpr') return e.obj.name + '.' + e.name;
    if (e.type === 'NameExpr') return resolve(e.name);
    return null;
  }

  function ev(e: A.Expr): A.Expr {
    switch (e.type) {
      case 'CallExpr': {
        e.callee = ev(e.callee);
        e.args = e.args.map(ev);
        const fn = nameOf(e.callee);
        if (fn === 'string.char') {
          const codes: number[] = [];
          let allNum = e.args.length > 0;
          for (const a of e.args) { if (a.type === 'NumberLit') codes.push(a.value & 0xff); else { allNum = false; break; } }
          if (allNum) { stats.charCalls++; return mkStr(codes.map(c => String.fromCharCode(c)).join(''), e.loc); }
        }
        return e;
      }
      case 'MethodCallExpr': { e.obj = ev(e.obj); e.args = e.args.map(ev); return e; }
      case 'BinExpr': {
        e.left = ev(e.left); e.right = ev(e.right);
        if (e.op === '..' && e.left.type === 'StringLit' && e.right.type === 'StringLit') {
          stats.concatChains++;
          return mkStr(e.left.value + e.right.value, e.loc);
        }
        return e;
      }
      case 'UnExpr': e.expr = ev(e.expr); return e;
      case 'ParenExpr': e.expr = ev(e.expr); return e;
      case 'IndexExpr': e.obj = ev(e.obj); e.index = ev(e.index); return e;
      case 'MemberExpr': e.obj = ev(e.obj); return e;
      case 'TableExpr': for (const f of e.fields) { if (f.key) f.key = ev(f.key); f.value = ev(f.value); } return e;
      case 'FunctionExpr': walkStats(e.body); return e;
      case 'InterpExpr': for (const p of e.parts) if (p.kind === 'expr') p.expr = ev(p.expr); return e;
      default: return e;
    }
  }

  function walkStats(body: A.Stat[]) { for (const s of body) walkStat(s); }
  function walkStat(s: A.Stat) {
    switch (s.type) {
      case 'LocalStat': s.init = s.init.map(ev); break;
      case 'AssignStat': s.targets = s.targets.map(ev); s.values = s.values.map(ev); break;
      case 'CallStat': s.expr = ev(s.expr) as any; break;
      case 'DoStat': walkStats(s.body); break;
      case 'WhileStat': s.cond = ev(s.cond); walkStats(s.body); break;
      case 'RepeatStat': walkStats(s.body); s.cond = ev(s.cond); break;
      case 'IfStat': for (const c of s.clauses) { c.cond = ev(c.cond); walkStats(c.body); } if (s.elseBody) walkStats(s.elseBody); break;
      case 'NumericForStat': s.from = ev(s.from); s.to = ev(s.to); if (s.step) s.step = ev(s.step); walkStats(s.body); break;
      case 'GenericForStat': s.iters = s.iters.map(ev); walkStats(s.body); break;
      case 'FunctionStat': walkStats(s.func.body); break;
      case 'LocalFunctionStat': walkStats(s.func.body); break;
      case 'ReturnStat': s.args = s.args.map(ev); break;
    }
  }

  if (node.type === 'Chunk') walkStats(node.body);
  else if (node.type && node.type.endsWith('Stat')) walkStat(node);
  else ev(node);
  return stats;
}

// Collect all string literals in the AST (for the string-table tool).
export function collectStrings(node: any): Array<{ value: string; line?: number }> {
  const out: Array<{ value: string; line?: number }> = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  (function rec(n: any) {
    if (!n || typeof n !== 'object') return;
    if (n.type === 'StringLit' && typeof n.value === 'string') {
      if (n.value.length >= 1) out.push({ value: n.value, line: n.loc?.line });
    }
    for (const k of Object.keys(n)) {
      if (k === 'loc' || k === 'type') continue;
      const v = n[k];
      if (Array.isArray(v)) v.forEach(rec); else if (v && typeof v === 'object') rec(v);
    }
  })(node);
  return out;
}

// PRISM alias/proxy analysis.
// Finds `local x = bit32.bxor`, `local c = string.char`, `local f = a.b.c`
// so that folding/string passes can resolve indirection. Universal: works on any names.
import type * as A from '../ast.js';

export interface AliasMap {
  // local name -> canonical dotted builtin path, e.g. 'J' -> 'bit32.bxor'
  builtins: Map<string, string>;
  resolveBit(name: string): string | null;   // -> 'bxor'|'band'|'bor'|null
  resolveStr(name: string): string | null;    // -> 'string.char'|'table.concat'|...|null
}

const BIT_OPS = new Set(['bxor', 'band', 'bor', 'rshift', 'lshift', 'bnot', 'arshift']);

export function analyzeAliases(chunk: A.Chunk): AliasMap {
  const builtins = new Map<string, string>();

  function dotted(e: A.Expr): string | null {
    if (e.type === 'NameExpr') return builtins.get(e.name) ?? e.name;
    if (e.type === 'MemberExpr') { const base = dotted(e.obj); return base ? base + '.' + e.name : null; }
    return null;
  }

  (function rec(body: A.Stat[]) {
    for (const s of body) {
      if (s.type === 'LocalStat') {
        s.names.forEach((nm, i) => {
          const init = s.init[i];
          if (init) { const d = dotted(init); if (d && d.includes('.')) builtins.set(nm, d); }
        });
      } else if (s.type === 'AssignStat' && s.targets.length === s.values.length) {
        s.targets.forEach((t, i) => {
          if (t.type === 'NameExpr') { const d = dotted(s.values[i]); if (d && d.includes('.')) builtins.set(t.name, d); }
        });
      }
      // recurse
      const kids = childBlocks(s);
      for (const b of kids) rec(b);
    }
  })(chunk.body);

  const resolveBit = (name: string): string | null => {
    const d = builtins.get(name);
    if (!d) return null;
    const last = d.split('.').pop()!;
    return BIT_OPS.has(last) ? last : null;
  };
  const resolveStr = (name: string): string | null => {
    const d = builtins.get(name);
    if (!d) return null;
    if (d === 'string.char' || d === 'string.byte' || d === 'table.concat' || d === 'string.sub' || d === 'string.rep') return d;
    return null;
  };

  return { builtins, resolveBit, resolveStr };
}

function childBlocks(s: A.Stat): A.Stat[][] {
  switch (s.type) {
    case 'DoStat': return [s.body];
    case 'WhileStat': return [s.body];
    case 'RepeatStat': return [s.body];
    case 'IfStat': return [...s.clauses.map(c => c.body), ...(s.elseBody ? [s.elseBody] : [])];
    case 'NumericForStat': return [s.body];
    case 'GenericForStat': return [s.body];
    case 'FunctionStat': return [s.func.body];
    case 'LocalFunctionStat': return [s.func.body];
    default: return [];
  }
}

// PRISM structural metrics + obfuscator-family fingerprinting. Universal heuristics.
import type * as A from '../ast.js';
import { walk } from '../ast.js';
import { lex, T } from '../lexer.js';

export interface Metrics {
  bytes: number;
  lines: number;
  tokens: number;
  nodes: number;
  functions: number;
  strings: number;
  numbers: number;
  maxDepth: number;
  whileTrue: number;        // `while true do` loops (VM trampolines / dispatch)
  longBrackets: number;     // [[..]] / [==[..]]
  gotos: number;
  // lexical tells
  underscoreNumbers: number;
  binaryLiterals: number;
  dupParamFns: number;
  tableReturnHead: boolean; // `return({...})` head (Luraph-style)
}

export interface FamilyGuess { family: string; confidence: number; reasons: string[]; }

export function computeMetrics(src: string, chunk: A.Chunk): Metrics {
  const { tokens } = lex(src);
  let nodes = 0, functions = 0, strings = 0, numbers = 0, whileTrue = 0, gotos = 0;
  walk(chunk, (n) => {
    nodes++;
    if (n.type === 'FunctionExpr') functions++;
    else if (n.type === 'StringLit') strings++;
    else if (n.type === 'NumberLit') numbers++;
    else if (n.type === 'GotoStat') gotos++;
    else if (n.type === 'WhileStat' && n.cond?.type === 'TrueLit') whileTrue++;
  });
  // token-level tells
  let underscoreNumbers = 0, binaryLiterals = 0, longBrackets = 0;
  for (const t of tokens) {
    if (t.type === T.Number) {
      if (t.value.includes('_')) underscoreNumbers++;
      if (/^0[bB]/.test(t.value)) binaryLiterals++;
    } else if (t.type === T.String && t.value.startsWith('[')) longBrackets++;
  }
  // duplicate-parameter functions (function(J,J))
  let dupParamFns = 0;
  walk(chunk, (n) => {
    if (n.type === 'FunctionExpr') { const s = new Set(); for (const p of n.params) { if (s.has(p)) { dupParamFns++; break; } s.add(p); } }
  });
  const maxDepth = depth(chunk);
  const tableReturnHead = chunk.body.length > 0 && chunk.body[chunk.body.length - 1]?.type === 'ReturnStat' &&
    hasTableReturn(chunk);
  return {
    bytes: src.length, lines: src.split('\n').length, tokens: tokens.length, nodes,
    functions, strings, numbers, maxDepth, whileTrue, longBrackets, gotos,
    underscoreNumbers, binaryLiterals, dupParamFns, tableReturnHead,
  };
}

function hasTableReturn(chunk: A.Chunk): boolean {
  for (const s of chunk.body) {
    if (s.type === 'ReturnStat' && s.args[0]) {
      let a: any = s.args[0];
      if (a.type === 'ParenExpr') a = a.expr;
      if (a.type === 'TableExpr') return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

function depth(chunk: A.Chunk): number {
  let max = 0;
  (function rec(body: A.Stat[], d: number) {
    if (d > max) max = d;
    for (const s of body) for (const b of kids(s)) rec(b, d + 1);
  })(chunk.body, 0);
  return max;
}
function kids(s: A.Stat): A.Stat[][] {
  switch (s.type) {
    case 'DoStat': case 'WhileStat': case 'RepeatStat': case 'NumericForStat': case 'GenericForStat': return [s.body];
    case 'IfStat': return [...s.clauses.map(c => c.body), ...(s.elseBody ? [s.elseBody] : [])];
    case 'FunctionStat': return [s.func.body];
    case 'LocalFunctionStat': return [s.func.body];
    default: return [];
  }
}

// Family fingerprinting: header comments + structural signatures.
export function fingerprint(src: string, m: Metrics): FamilyGuess[] {
  const guesses: FamilyGuess[] = [];
  const head = src.slice(0, 4000);
  const add = (family: string, confidence: number, reasons: string[]) => guesses.push({ family, confidence, reasons });

  // explicit header banners
  if (/Luraph Obfuscator/i.test(head)) add('Luraph', 0.99, ['header banner "Luraph Obfuscator"']);
  if (/MoonSec/i.test(head)) add('MoonSec', 0.97, ['header banner "MoonSec"']);
  if (/Prometheus/i.test(head)) add('Prometheus', 0.9, ['header banner "Prometheus"']);
  if (/IronBrew/i.test(head)) add('IronBrew', 0.9, ['header banner "IronBrew"']);
  if (/Hercules/i.test(head)) add('Hercules', 0.9, ['header banner "Hercules"']);

  // structural signatures (used when no banner)
  if (!guesses.length) {
    if (m.tableReturnHead && m.underscoreNumbers > 0 && m.binaryLiterals > 0)
      add('Luraph-like', 0.75, ['return({...}) head', 'underscore/binary numeric literals', 'Luau VM dialect']);
    if (m.whileTrue >= 1 && m.numbers > m.nodes * 0.2)
      add('VM-based (generic)', 0.6, [`${m.whileTrue} while-true dispatch loop(s)`, 'high numeric-literal density']);
    if (m.dupParamFns > 5)
      add('register-VM (dup-param handlers)', 0.6, [`${m.dupParamFns} functions with duplicate params`]);
    if (m.longBrackets > 0 && m.functions < 10 && m.bytes > 20000)
      add('bytecode-blob loader', 0.5, ['few functions + long-bracket blob + large size']);
  }
  guesses.sort((a, b) => b.confidence - a.confidence);
  return guesses;
}

// PRISM call graph + function inventory. Universal: identifies functions by
// their binding name (local f / function a.b / table field / assignment target)
// and builds caller->callee edges from CallExpr/MethodCallExpr.
import type * as A from '../ast.js';

export interface FnInfo {
  id: string;            // stable id f0, f1, ...
  name: string;          // best-effort name
  params: string[];
  vararg: boolean;
  line: number;
  start: number;
  end: number;
  stmts: number;         // body statement count
  calls: string[];       // callee display names
  callees: string[];     // resolved fn ids
  depth: number;
}

export interface CallGraph {
  functions: FnInfo[];

  externalCalls: Record<string, number>; // global/builtin call names -> count
}

export function buildCallGraph(chunk: A.Chunk): CallGraph {
  const functions: FnInfo[] = [];
  const byName = new Map<string, string>();  // binding name -> id
  const externalCalls: Record<string, number> = {};
  let idc = 0;

  const ROOT: FnInfo = { id: 'main', name: '<main chunk>', params: [], vararg: true, line: 1, start: 0, end: 0, stmts: chunk.body.length, calls: [], callees: [], depth: 0 };
  functions.push(ROOT);

    switch (e.type) {
      case 'NameExpr': return e.name;
      case 'MemberExpr': return displayName(e.obj) + '.' + e.name;

        const idx = e.index.type === 'StringLit' ? JSON.stringify(e.index.value)
          : e.index.type === 'NumberLit' ? String(e.index.value) : '?';

      }
      case 'CallExpr': return displayName(e.callee) + '()';
      case 'ParenExpr': return displayName(e.expr);
      default: return '<expr>';
    }
  }

  function registerFn(f: A.FunctionExpr, name: string, depth: number): FnInfo {
    const info: FnInfo = {
      id: 'f' + (idc++), name, params: f.params, vararg: f.vararg,
      line: f.loc?.line ?? 0, start: f.loc?.start ?? 0, end: f.loc?.end ?? 0,
      stmts: f.body.length, calls: [], callees: [], depth,
    };
    functions.push(info);
    if (name && !name.startsWith('<')) byName.set(name, info.id);
    return info;
  }

import { analyze, clean } from '../src/index.js';
import { parse } from '../src/parser.js';
import { readdirSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';

const dir = join(process.cwd(), 'fixtures/samples');
const files = readdirSync(dir).filter(f => f.endsWith('.lua')).sort();
console.log(`PRISM full-pipeline test on ${files.length} real fixtures:\n`);
let rtOk = 0;
for (const f of files) {
  const src = readFileSync(join(dir, f), 'utf8');
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const rep = analyze(src);
  const t1 = Date.now();
  const cl = clean(src, { rounds: 4 });
  const t2 = Date.now();
  // round-trip: cleaned output must re-parse with zero errors
  const rt = parse(cl.code);
  const rtClean = rt.errors.length === 0;
  if (rtClean) rtOk++;
  const fam = rep.families[0];
  const vm = rep.vm;
  const disp = vm.dispatchSummary.map(d => `${d.kind}×${d.count}`).join(' ') || '-';
  console.log(`${f}`);
  console.log(`  family=${fam ? fam.family+' ('+(fam.confidence*100|0)+'%)' : 'unknown'}  fns=${rep.callGraph.functionCount} edges=${rep.callGraph.edgeCount} strings=${rep.strings.total} aliases=${rep.aliases.length}`);
  console.log(`  vm: isVM=${vm.isVM} dispatch=[${disp}] trampolines=${vm.trampolines.length} blobs=${vm.blobs.length} opEst=${vm.opcodeEstimate ?? '-'} clusters=${vm.handlerClusters.length}`);
  console.log(`  clean: folded=${cl.stats.folded}(mba=${cl.stats.mbaFolded}) chars=${cl.stats.charCalls} concat=${cl.stats.concatChains} pruned=${cl.stats.prunedBranches} dead=${cl.stats.removedStmts} rounds=${cl.rounds}`);
  console.log(`  roundtrip-reparse: ${rtClean ? 'OK (0 errors)' : 'FAIL ('+rt.errors.length+' errors, 1st: '+(rt.errors[0]?.message)+' @L'+(rt.errors[0]?.line)+')'}  | analyze=${t1-t0}ms clean=${t2-t1}ms\n`);
}
console.log(`\nRound-trip valid: ${rtOk}/${files.length}`);

## 171. ИИ · шаг

Writing CallGraph part 1
bash
cd /data/prism; cat > apps/web/src/components/CallGraph.tsx <<'EOF'
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { FullReport } from '@prism/core';
import { Copy, Empty } from './ui.js';
import { forceLayout, GNode } from './force.js';

export function CallGraph({ rep }: { rep: FullReport }) {
  const cg = rep.callGraph;
  const [sel, setSel] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [view, setView] = useState<'graph' | 'table'>('graph');
  const wrap = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [size, setSize] = useState({ w: 800, h: 500 });
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = wrap.current; if (!el) return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => setSize({ w: el.clientWidth || 800, h: el.clientHeight || 500 }));
    ro.observe(el); return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, [view]);

  const { nodes, edges } = useMemo(() => {
    const deg = new Map<string, number>();
    for (const e of cg.edges) { deg.set(e.from, (deg.get(e.from) ?? 0) + 1); deg.set(e.to, (deg.get(e.to) ?? 0) + 1); }
    const fns = cg.functions.slice().sort((a, b) => (deg.get(b.id) ?? 0) - (deg.get(a.id) ?? 0)).slice(0, 150);
    const keep = new Set(fns.map(f => f.id));
    const ns: GNode[] = fns.map((f, i) => ({ id: f.id, name: f.name, deg: deg.get(f.id) ?? 0,
      x: size.w / 2 + Math.cos(i * 2.4) * (40 + i * 2), y: size.h / 2 + Math.sin(i * 2.4) * (40 + i * 2), vx: 0, vy: 0 }));
    const es = cg.edges.filter(e => keep.has(e.from) && keep.has(e.to));
    forceLayout(ns, es, size.w, size.h);
    return { nodes: ns, edges: es };
  }, [cg, size.w, size.h]);

  const pos = new Map(nodes.map(n => [n.id, n]));
  const selFn = cg.functions.find(f => f.id === sel);
  const nameOf = (id: string) => cg.functions.find(f => f.id === id)?.name ?? id;
  const dot = 'digraph calls {\n' + cg.edges.map(e => '  "' + nameOf(e.from) + '" -> "' + nameOf(e.to) + '";').join('\n') + '\n}';

  if (!cg.functions.length) return <Empty>No functions found.</Empty>;
EOF

}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import Editor, { DiffEditor } from '@monaco-editor/react';
import type { CleanResult } from '@prism/core';
import { Copy } from './ui.js';

const MONACO_OPTS = {
  minimap: { enabled: false }, fontSize: 12, fontFamily: 'var(--mono)',
  lineNumbers: 'on' as const, scrollBeyondLastLine: false, wordWrap: 'off' as const,
  renderWhitespace: 'none' as const, automaticLayout: true, readOnly: true,
};

export function Cleaned({ original, clean }: { original: string; clean: CleanResult }) {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'clean' | 'diff'>('clean');
  const s = clean.stats;
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', height: '100%' }}>
      <div className="toolbar">
        <div className="seg">
          <label><input type="radio" checked={mode === 'clean'} onChange={() => setMode('clean')} style={{ display: 'none' }} />cleaned</label>
          <label><input type="radio" checked={mode === 'diff'} onChange={() => setMode('diff')} style={{ display: 'none' }} />diff</label>
        </div>
        <div className="chips">
          <span className="chip">folded <b>{s.folded}</b></span>
          <span className="chip">mba <b>{s.mbaFolded}</b></span>
          <span className="chip">strings <b>{s.charCalls + s.concatChains}</b></span>
          <span className="chip">pruned <b>{s.prunedBranches}</b></span>
          <span className="chip">dead <b>{s.removedStmts}</b></span>
          <span className="chip">rounds <b>{clean.rounds}</b></span>
        </div>
        <span className="spacer" />
        <Copy text={clean.code} label="Copy cleaned" />
      </div>
      <div style={{ flex: 1, minHeight: 0 }}>
        {mode === 'clean' ? (
          <Editor height="100%" language="lua" theme="vs-dark" value={clean.code} options={MONACO_OPTS} />
        ) : (
          <DiffEditor height="100%" language="lua" theme="vs-dark" original={original} modified={clean.code} options={{ ...MONACO_OPTS, renderSideBySide: true }} />
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
EOF
