import React from 'react';
import type { FullReport } from '@prism/core';
import { Card, Copy, Empty } from './ui.js';

function Histo({ h }: { h: Array<{ byte: number; count: number }> }) {
  const max = Math.max(1, ...h.map(x => x.count));
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'flex-end', gap: 2, height: 90, padding: '6px 0' }}>
      {h.slice(0, 40).map((x, i) => (
        <div key={i} title={`byte 0x${x.byte.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')} (${x.byte}) × ${x.count}`}
          style={{ flex: 1, height: `${Math.max(3, (x.count / max) * 100)}%`,
            background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, #5ce1ff, #b26bff)', borderRadius: 2, minWidth: 3 }} />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

export function VmAnalysis({ rep }: { rep: FullReport }) {
  const vm = rep.vm;
  if (!vm.isVM && !vm.blobs.length) return <Empty><div><div className="big">No VM / bytecode structure detected</div>This looks like a non-virtualized obfuscation (string/constant/flow only).</div></Empty>;
  const full = JSON.stringify(vm, null, 2);
  return (
    <div className="cards">
      <Card title="Dispatch & control flow" right={<Copy text={full} label="Copy VM report" />}>
        {vm.dispatchSummary.length ? (
          <div className="chips" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
            {vm.dispatchSummary.map((d, i) => <span key={i} className="chip hi">{d.kind} <b>×{d.count}</b> <span className="muted">@L{d.firstLine}</span></span>)}
          </div>
        ) : <div className="muted small">No explicit dispatch loop; may be inlined/linear.</div>}
        {vm.dispatch.filter(d => d.kind === 'cff-state-machine').slice(0, 8).map((d, i) => (
          <div key={i} className="small mono" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>• CFF @L{d.line}: {d.detail} {d.cases ? `(${d.cases} cases)` : ''}</div>
        ))}
        {vm.trampolines.length > 0 && <div className="small" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>Trampolines: {vm.trampolines.length} (e.g. @L{vm.trampolines[0].line} — {vm.trampolines[0].detail})</div>}
        {vm.notes.map((n, i) => <div key={i} className="small" style={{ marginTop: 4, color: 'var(--neon3)' }}>▸ {n}</div>)}
      </Card>

      {vm.blobs.length > 0 && (
        <Card title={`Bytecode / data blobs (${vm.blobs.length})`}>
          {vm.opcodeEstimate != null && (
            <div className="small" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
              Opcode-count upper bound (distinct byte values in dominant blob): <b style={{ color: 'var(--neon3)' }}>~{vm.opcodeEstimate}</b>
            </div>
          )}
          {vm.blobs.slice(0, 4).map((b, i) => (
            <div key={i} style={{ marginBottom: 12, paddingBottom: 10, borderBottom: '1px solid rgba(150,100,240,0.12)' }}>
              <div className="small mono" style={{ marginBottom: 2 }}>
                [{b.kind}] @L{b.line} · {b.length.toLocaleString()} units · {b.distinctBytes} distinct bytes
              </div>
              {b.histogram && <Histo h={b.histogram} />}
              <div className="small muted mono" style={{ marginTop: 2 }}>preview: {b.preview}</div>
            </div>
          ))}
          <div className="small muted">Histogram shows the 40 most frequent byte values. A narrow set with 1-2 dominant values usually means NOP/MOVE/RETURN opcodes; wide spread means encryption at rest.</div>
        </Card>
      )}

      <Card title={`Handler clusters (${vm.handlerClusters.length})`} right={<Copy text={JSON.stringify(vm.handlerClusters, null, 2)} label="Copy clusters" />}>
        <div className="small muted" style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}>
          Functions grouped by control-flow-shape hash. Same hash ⇒ same semantic family — read one representative per cluster instead of every handler.
        </div>
        <table className="data">
          <thead><tr><th>shape hash</th><th>members</th><th>rep. line</th><th>skeleton</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>{vm.handlerClusters.slice(0, 30).map((c, i) => (
            <tr key={i}>
              <td style={{ color: 'var(--neon3)' }}>{c.shapeHash}</td>
              <td className="num">{c.members.length}</td>
              <td className="num">{c.representativeLine}</td>
              <td style={{ maxWidth: 260, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }} title={c.sketch}>{c.sketch || '∅'}</td>
            </tr>
          ))}</tbody>
        </table>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
EOF

bash

import React, { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import Editor from '@monaco-editor/react';
import { engine, FullResult } from './engineClient.js';
import { Overview } from './components/Overview.js';
import { Strings } from './components/Strings.js';
import { CallGraph } from './components/CallGraph.js';
import { Cleaned } from './components/Cleaned.js';
import { VmAnalysis } from './components/VmAnalysis.js';
import { Tokens } from './components/Tokens.js';
import { Copy, Empty, formatBytes } from './components/ui.js';

type Tab = 'overview' | 'cleaned' | 'strings' | 'callgraph' | 'vm' | 'tokens';
const TABS: { id: Tab; label: string }[] = [
  { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview' },
  { id: 'cleaned', label: 'Deobfuscate' },
  { id: 'vm', label: 'VM / Bytecode' },
  { id: 'callgraph', label: 'Call Graph' },
  { id: 'strings', label: 'Strings' },
  { id: 'tokens', label: 'Tokens' },
];

const PLACEHOLDER = `-- Paste obfuscated Luau/Lua here, drop a .lua/.txt file, or load a sample.
-- Everything runs 100% locally in your browser. Static only.
`;

export function App() {
  const [src, setSrc] = useState('');
  const [res, setRes] = useState<FullResult | null>(null);
  const [ms, setMs] = useState(0);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>('overview');
  const [over, setOver] = useState(false);
  const fileRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const run = useCallback(async (text: string) => {
    if (!text.trim()) return;
    setBusy(true); setErr(null);
    try {
      const { result, ms } = await engine.full(text, { rounds: 4 });
      setRes(result); setMs(ms); setTab('overview');
    } catch (e: any) { setErr(String(e?.message || e)); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }, []);

  const onFile = useCallback(async (f: File) => {
    const text = await f.text();
    setSrc(text); run(text);
  }, [run]);

  const onDrop = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault(); setOver(false);
    const f = e.dataTransfer.files?.[0]; if (f) onFile(f);
  }, [onFile]);
EOF

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { engine } from '../engineClient.js';
import { Copy, Empty } from './ui.js';

export function Tokens({ src }: { src: string }) {
  const [toks, setToks] = useState<any[] | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    setBusy(true);
    engine.tokenize(src).then(({ result }) => { if (live) { setToks(result.tokens); setBusy(false); } }).catch(() => setBusy(false));
    return () => { live = false; };
  }, [src]);
  if (busy) return <Empty>Tokenizing…</Empty>;
  if (!toks || !toks.length) return <Empty>No tokens.</Empty>;
  const text = toks.map(t => `${t.line}:${t.col}\t${t.type}\t${t.value}`).join('\n');
  return (
    <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', height: '100%' }}>
      <div className="toolbar">
        <span className="small muted">{toks.length.toLocaleString()} tokens</span>
        <span className="spacer" />
        <Copy text={text} label="Copy tokens" />
      </div>
      <div className="panel-body">
        <table className="data">
          <thead><tr><th style={{ width: 70 }}>pos</th><th style={{ width: 110 }}>type</th><th>value</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>{toks.slice(0, 4000).map((t, i) => (
            <tr key={i}>
              <td className="muted">{t.line}:{t.col}</td>
              <td style={{ color: 'var(--neon3)' }}>{t.type}</td>
              <td style={{ maxWidth: 420, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{t.value}</td>
            </tr>
          ))}</tbody>
        </table>
        {toks.length > 4000 && <div className="small muted" style={{ padding: 10 }}>Showing first 4000 of {toks.length.toLocaleString()}. Copy for full stream.</div>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
EOF

const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 } });

page.on('pageerror', e => errors.push('PAGEERROR: ' + e.message));

await page.waitForTimeout(1500);

console.log('has VM text:', hasVM);

await browser.close();

  // Byte-exact string printer. Code units 0-255 are bytes; valid UTF-8 byte runs
  // are re-emitted as the decoded char (so UTF-8 encoding of the output yields
  // the same bytes); everything else non-printable becomes a 3-digit \\ddd escape
  // (3 digits so a following digit can never be swallowed).

  const q = dq && !sq ? "'" : '"';

# helper

/** Convert a JS (UTF-16) string to a Lua byte string: every code unit of the
 *  result is a byte 0-255 (non-ASCII chars are UTF-8 encoded). Lua strings are
 *  byte strings, so cooked literal values use this representation. */
export function utf8Bytes(str: string): string {
  if (!/[^\\x00-\\x7f]/.test(str)) return str;
  let out = '';
  for (const ch of str) {
    const cp = ch.codePointAt(0)!;
    if (cp < 0x80) out += ch;
    else if (cp < 0x800) out += String.fromCharCode(0xc0 | (cp >> 6), 0x80 | (cp & 63));
    else if (cp < 0x10000) out += String.fromCharCode(0xe0 | (cp >> 12), 0x80 | ((cp >> 6) & 63), 0x80 | (cp & 63));
    else out += String.fromCharCode(0xf0 | (cp >> 18), 0x80 | ((cp >> 12) & 63), 0x80 | ((cp >> 6) & 63), 0x80 | (cp & 63));
  }
  return out;
}

/** Inverse of utf8Bytes for display: decode a byte string as UTF-8 where valid. */
export function bytesToDisplay(bytes: string): string {
  if (!/[\\x80-\\xff]/.test(bytes)) return bytes;
  try {
    const arr = new Uint8Array(bytes.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) arr[i] = bytes.charCodeAt(i) & 0xff;
    return new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: true }).decode(arr);
  } catch { return bytes; }
}

## 236. ИИ · шаг

Writing scope resolver module
bash
cd /data/prism && cat > packages/core/src/analysis/scope.ts <<'EOF'
// PRISM scope resolver — binds every identifier occurrence to its declaration.
// Lua block scoping rules: `local` names become visible after their statement,
// `local function` is visible inside its own body, `repeat ... until cond` sees
// the body's locals, for-loop variables live in the loop scope.
import type * as A from '../ast.js';

export type BindingKind = 'local' | 'localfn' | 'param' | 'for' | 'global';

export interface Binding {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  kind: BindingKind;
  line: number;
  /** declaring node: LocalStat | LocalFunctionStat | FunctionExpr | NumericForStat | GenericForStat */
  decl: any;
  /** position inside the declaring node's name/param list */
  index: number;
  /** the initializer expression for `local x = <init>` (single-value position), if any */
  init?: A.Expr;
  /** true when the init is the last expression of a multi-value init (call/vararg) */
  initMulti?: boolean;
  reads: number;
  writes: number;
  refs: A.NameExpr[];
  writeRefs: A.NameExpr[];
  /** referenced from a function nested inside the declaring function */
  captured: boolean;
  capturedWrite: boolean;
  fn: A.FunctionExpr | A.Chunk;
}

export interface ScopeInfo {
  bindings: Binding[];
  globals: Map<string, Binding>;
  refOf: Map<A.NameExpr, Binding>;
  /** bindings declared directly by each function (params + body locals) */
  fnBindings: Map<A.FunctionExpr | A.Chunk, Binding[]>;
  /** names of any binding (local or global) — for collision-free renaming */
  allNames: Set<string>;
}

export function analyzeScopes(chunk: A.Chunk): ScopeInfo {
  const bindings: Binding[] = [];
  const globals = new Map<string, Binding>();
  const refOf = new Map<A.NameExpr, Binding>();
  const fnBindings = new Map<A.FunctionExpr | A.Chunk, Binding[]>();
  const allNames = new Set<string>();
  const scopes: Array<Map<string, Binding>> = [];
  const fnStack: Array<A.FunctionExpr | A.Chunk> = [];

  const cur = () => fnStack[fnStack.length - 1];
  function declare(name: string, kind: BindingKind, decl: any, index: number, line: number): Binding {
    const b: Binding = { id: bindings.length, name, kind, line, decl, index, reads: 0, writes: 0, refs: [], writeRefs: [], captured: false, capturedWrite: false, fn: cur() };
    bindings.push(b);
    scopes[scopes.length - 1].set(name, b);
    fnBindings.get(cur())!.push(b);
    allNames.add(name);
    return b;
  }
  function resolve(n: A.NameExpr, write: boolean) {
    let b: Binding | undefined;
    for (let i = scopes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const hit = scopes[i].get(n.name); if (hit) { b = hit; break; } }
    if (!b) {
      b = globals.get(n.name);
      if (!b) {
        b = { id: bindings.length, name: n.name, kind: 'global', line: n.loc?.line ?? 0, decl: null, index: 0, reads: 0, writes: 0, refs: [], writeRefs: [], captured: false, capturedWrite: false, fn: chunk };
        bindings.push(b); globals.set(n.name, b); allNames.add(n.name);
      }
    }
    refOf.set(n, b);
    b.refs.push(n);
    if (write) { b.writes++; b.writeRefs.push(n); } else b.reads++;
    if (b.kind !== 'global' && b.fn !== cur()) { b.captured = true; if (write) b.capturedWrite = true; }
  }

  function block(body: A.Stat[]) { scopes.push(new Map()); for (const s of body) stat(s); scopes.pop(); }
  function func(f: A.FunctionExpr) {
    fnStack.push(f); fnBindings.set(f, []); scopes.push(new Map());
    f.params.forEach((p, i) => declare(p, 'param', f, i, f.loc?.line ?? 0));
    for (const s of f.body) stat(s);
    scopes.pop(); fnStack.pop();
  }
  function target(t: A.Expr, alsoRead: boolean) {
    if (t.type === 'NameExpr') { if (alsoRead) resolve(t, false); resolve(t, true); }
    else expr(t);
  }

  function stat(s: A.Stat) {
    switch (s.type) {
      case 'LocalStat': {
        for (const e of s.init) expr(e);
        s.names.forEach((nm, i) => {
          const b = declare(nm, 'local', s, i, s.loc?.line ?? 0);
          const last = s.init.length - 1;
          if (i < s.init.length) {
            const e = s.init[i];
            const multi = i === last && (e.type === 'CallExpr' || e.type === 'MethodCallExpr' || e.type === 'VarargLit');
            if (i === last || !multi) { b.init = e; b.initMulti = multi && s.names.length > s.init.length; }
          }
        });
        break;
      }
      case 'LocalFunctionStat': declare(s.name, 'localfn', s, 0, s.loc?.line ?? 0); func(s.func); break;
      case 'FunctionStat': target(s.target, false); func(s.func); break;
      case 'AssignStat': {
        for (const v of s.values) expr(v);
        for (const t of s.targets) target(t, !!s.op);
        break;
      }
      case 'CallStat': expr(s.expr); break;
      case 'DoStat': block(s.body); break;
      case 'WhileStat': expr(s.cond); block(s.body); break;
      case 'RepeatStat': scopes.push(new Map()); for (const b of s.body) stat(b); expr(s.cond); scopes.pop(); break;
      case 'IfStat': for (const c of s.clauses) { expr(c.cond); block(c.body); } if (s.elseBody) block(s.elseBody); break;
      case 'NumericForStat': {
        expr(s.from); expr(s.to); if (s.step) expr(s.step);
        scopes.push(new Map()); declare(s.var, 'for', s, 0, s.loc?.line ?? 0);
        for (const b of s.body) stat(b); scopes.pop(); break;
      }
      case 'GenericForStat': {
        for (const e of s.iters) expr(e);
        scopes.push(new Map()); s.names.forEach((nm, i) => declare(nm, 'for', s, i, s.loc?.line ?? 0));
        for (const b of s.body) stat(b); scopes.pop(); break;
      }
      case 'ReturnStat': for (const e of s.args) expr(e); break;
      default: break;
    }
  }

  function expr(e: A.Expr | undefined) {
    if (!e) return;
    switch (e.type) {
      case 'NameExpr': resolve(e, false); break;
      case 'IndexExpr': expr(e.obj); expr(e.index); break;
      case 'MemberExpr': expr(e.obj); break;
      case 'CallExpr': expr(e.callee); for (const a of e.args) expr(a); break;
      case 'MethodCallExpr': expr(e.obj); for (const a of e.args) expr(a); break;
      case 'FunctionExpr': func(e); break;
      case 'TableExpr': for (const f of e.fields) { if (f.key) expr(f.key); expr(f.value); } break;
      case 'BinExpr': expr(e.left); expr(e.right); break;
      case 'UnExpr': expr(e.expr); break;
      case 'ParenExpr': expr(e.expr); break;
      case 'InterpExpr': for (const p of e.parts) if (p.kind === 'expr') expr(p.expr); break;
      default: break;
    }
  }

  fnStack.push(chunk); fnBindings.set(chunk, []); scopes.push(new Map());
  for (const s of chunk.body) stat(s);
  scopes.pop(); fnStack.pop();
  return { bindings, globals, refOf, fnBindings, allNames };
}

/** Rename a binding everywhere (declaration + every reference). */
export function renameBinding(b: Binding, to: string) {
  const d = b.decl;
  if (d) {
    switch (d.type) {
      case 'LocalStat': d.names[b.index] = to; break;
      case 'LocalFunctionStat': d.name = to; break;
      case 'FunctionExpr': d.params[b.index] = to; break;
      case 'NumericForStat': d.var = to; break;
      case 'GenericForStat': d.names[b.index] = to; break;
    }
  }
  for (const r of b.refs) r.name = to;
  b.name = to;
}
EOF

bash
cd /data/prism && cat > packages/core/src/passes/scopepasses.ts <<'EOF'
// Scope-aware cleanup passes: constant/alias propagation, dead-local removal,
// smart renaming. All universal — they rely only on Lua scoping semantics.
import type * as A from '../ast.js';
import { analyzeScopes, renameBinding, Binding, ScopeInfo } from '../analysis/scope.js';
import { KEYWORDS } from '../lexer.js';

const LIT = new Set(['NumberLit', 'StringLit', 'TrueLit', 'FalseLit', 'NilLit']);

function unparen(e: A.Expr): A.Expr { while (e.type === 'ParenExpr') e = e.expr; return e; }

function cloneLit(e: A.Expr): A.Expr { const c: any = { ...e }; delete c.loc; return c; }
function cloneExpr<T>(e: T): T { return structuredClone(e); }

/** member chain rooted at a global name: string.byte / math.floor / bit32.bxor */
function globalChain(e: A.Expr, scope: ScopeInfo): { root: string; chain: string[] } | null {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  let cur: A.Expr = e;
  while (cur.type === 'MemberExpr') { parts.unshift(cur.name); cur = cur.obj; }
  if (cur.type !== 'NameExpr') return null;
  const b = scope.refOf.get(cur);
  if (!b || b.kind !== 'global' || b.writes > 0) return null;
  return { root: cur.name, chain: parts };
}

export interface PropStats { propagated: number; aliases: number; }

/** Inline literal-valued, never-reassigned locals and pure global/local aliases. */
export function propagateConstants(chunk: A.Chunk, opts: { maxString?: number } = {}): PropStats {
  const maxStr = opts.maxString ?? 64;
  const scope = analyzeScopes(chunk);
  const nameCount = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const b of scope.bindings) nameCount.set(b.name, (nameCount.get(b.name) ?? 0) + 1);
  const localNames = new Set(scope.bindings.filter(b => b.kind !== 'global').map(b => b.name));
  let propagated = 0, aliases = 0;
  for (const b of scope.bindings) {
    if (b.kind !== 'local' || b.writes > 0 || !b.init || b.initMulti || b.reads === 0) continue;
    const init = unparen(b.init);
    if (LIT.has(init.type)) {
      if (init.type === 'StringLit' && init.value.length > maxStr) continue;
      if (init.type === 'NumberLit' && !Number.isFinite(init.value)) continue;
      for (const r of b.refs) { const lit = cloneLit(init); for (const k of Object.keys(r)) if (k !== 'loc') delete (r as any)[k]; Object.assign(r, lit); }
      propagated += b.refs.length; b.reads = 0; b.refs = [];
      continue;
    }
    // alias of a never-written, uniquely named local
    if (init.type === 'NameExpr') {
      const c = scope.refOf.get(init);
      if (!c) continue;
      if (c.kind === 'global') {
        if (c.writes > 0 || localNames.has(c.name)) continue;
      } else {
        if (c.writes > 0 || (nameCount.get(c.name) ?? 0) !== 1) continue;
      }
      for (const r of b.refs) { r.name = c.name; c.refs.push(r); scope.refOf.set(r, c); }
      aliases += b.refs.length; b.reads = 0; b.refs = [];
      continue;
    }
    // alias of a global member chain: local f = string.byte
    if (init.type === 'MemberExpr') {
      const g = globalChain(init, scope);
      if (!g || localNames.has(g.root)) continue;
      for (const r of b.refs) { const e: any = cloneExpr(init); for (const k of Object.keys(r)) if (k !== 'loc') delete (r as any)[k]; Object.assign(r, e, { loc: r.loc }); }
      aliases += b.refs.length; b.reads = 0; b.refs = [];
    }
  }
  return { propagated, aliases };
}

function isPure(e: A.Expr): boolean {
  switch (e.type) {
    case 'NumberLit': case 'StringLit': case 'TrueLit': case 'FalseLit': case 'NilLit': case 'VarargLit':
    case 'NameExpr': case 'FunctionExpr': return true;
    case 'ParenExpr': return isPure(e.expr);
    case 'UnExpr': return isPure(e.expr);
    case 'BinExpr': return isPure(e.left) && isPure(e.right);
    case 'MemberExpr': return e.obj.type === 'NameExpr';
    case 'IndexExpr': return e.obj.type === 'NameExpr' && isPure(e.index);
    case 'TableExpr': return e.fields.every(f => (!f.key || isPure(f.key)) && isPure(f.value));
    default: return false;
  }
}

/** Visit every statement list in the tree (chunk, blocks, function bodies). */
export function forEachStatList(node: any, fn: (list: A.Stat[]) => void) {
  const seen = new Set<any>();
  const visit = (n: any) => {
    if (!n || typeof n !== 'object' || seen.has(n)) return;
    seen.add(n);
    if (Array.isArray(n)) { for (const x of n) visit(x); return; }
    for (const k of Object.keys(n)) {
      if (k === 'loc') continue;
      const v = n[k];
      if ((k === 'body' || k === 'elseBody') && Array.isArray(v)) { fn(v); }
      if (v && typeof v === 'object') visit(v);
    }
  };
  visit(node);
}

export interface DeadLocalStats { removedLocals: number; removedAssigns: number; }

/** Remove locals that are never read (keeping side-effecting calls). */
export function removeDeadLocals(chunk: A.Chunk): DeadLocalStats {
  const scope = analyzeScopes(chunk);
  let removedLocals = 0, removedAssigns = 0;
  const dead = (b: Binding) => b.reads === 0;
  // assignments to dead locals whose values are pure can go
  const deadWrite = new Set<A.NameExpr>();
  for (const b of scope.bindings) if (b.kind === 'local' || b.kind === 'localfn') { if (dead(b)) for (const w of b.writeRefs) deadWrite.add(w); }
  forEachStatList(chunk, (list) => {
    for (let i = list.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const s = list[i];
      if (s.type === 'LocalStat') {
        const bs = s.names.map((_, k) => scope.bindings.find(() => false)); // placeholder (replaced below)
        void bs;
      }
    }
  });
  // map declarations -> bindings once (avoid O(n^2))
  const byDecl = new Map<any, Binding[]>();
  for (const b of scope.bindings) if (b.decl) { const a = byDecl.get(b.decl) ?? []; a.push(b); byDecl.set(b.decl, a); }
  forEachStatList(chunk, (list) => {
    for (let i = list.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const s = list[i];
      if (s.type === 'LocalStat') {
        const bs = byDecl.get(s) ?? [];
        if (!bs.length || !bs.every(b => dead(b) && b.writeRefs.every(w => deadWrite.has(w)))) continue;
        if (s.init.every(isPure)) { list.splice(i, 1); removedLocals++; continue; }
        if (s.init.length === 1 && (s.init[0].type === 'CallExpr' || s.init[0].type === 'MethodCallExpr')) {
          list[i] = { type: 'CallStat', expr: s.init[0] as any, loc: s.loc }; removedLocals++; continue;
        }
      } else if (s.type === 'LocalFunctionStat') {
        const bs = byDecl.get(s) ?? [];
        if (bs.length && bs.every(b => dead(b) && b.writes === 0)) { list.splice(i, 1); removedLocals++; }
      } else if (s.type === 'AssignStat' && !s.op) {
        if (s.targets.every(t => t.type === 'NameExpr' && deadWrite.has(t)) && s.values.every(isPure)) {
          // only when the matching declaration is also being removed (all writes dead)
          list.splice(i, 1); removedAssigns++;
        }
      }
    }
  });
  return { removedLocals, removedAssigns };
}

bash

// Smart renaming: give every obfuscated local a unique, role-based name
// (fn3, tbl2, str_byte, Players, arg1, i4, k2/v2 ...). Unique names make the
// output collision-free and shadow-free, which also unlocks safe alias passes.
import type * as A from '../ast.js';
import { analyzeScopes, renameBinding, Binding } from '../analysis/scope.js';
import { KEYWORDS } from '../lexer.js';

export type RenameMode = 'none' | 'obfuscated' | 'all';
export interface RenameStats { renamed: number; map: Array<{ from: string; to: string; line: number; kind: string }>; }

const COMMON_OK = new Set(['i', 'j', 'k', 'v', 'n', 'x', 'y', 'z', '_', 'self', 'key', 'value', 'index', 'idx', 'val']);

/** Heuristic: does this identifier look machine-generated / meaningless? */
export function looksObfuscated(name: string): boolean {
  if (COMMON_OK.has(name)) return false;
  if (name.length === 1) return true;
  if (/^[Il1|_]{3,}$/.test(name) || /^[O0o_]{3,}$/.test(name)) return true;
  if (/^_0x[0-9a-f]+$/i.test(name)) return true;
  if (/^[A-Za-z]{1,2}_*\d+_*$/.test(name)) return true;          // v12, L_3_, l__2
  if (/^_+[A-Za-z]?\d*_*$/.test(name) && name !== '_') return true; // __, _1
  if (/^[A-Za-z]{2}$/.test(name)) return true;                   // two-letter minified
  // low-information mixed-case noise (e.g. lIlIIl, IIlIl1)
  if (name.length >= 5 && /^[IlL1i]+$/.test(name)) return true;
  // hex-ish noise: long run without vowels
  if (name.length >= 8 && !/[aeiouAEIOU]/.test(name) && /\d/.test(name)) return true;
  return false;
}

function unparen(e: A.Expr): A.Expr { while (e.type === 'ParenExpr') e = e.expr; return e; }
const ident = (s: string) => s.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_]/g, '_').replace(/^(\d)/, '_$1');

function chainName(e: A.Expr): string | null {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  let cur: A.Expr = e;
  while (cur.type === 'MemberExpr') { parts.unshift(cur.name); cur = cur.obj; }
  if (cur.type !== 'NameExpr') return null;
  parts.unshift(cur.name);
  return parts.join('_');
}

function roleOf(b: Binding): string {
  if (b.kind === 'param') return 'arg';
  if (b.kind === 'localfn') return 'fn';
  if (b.kind === 'for') {
    const d = b.decl;
    if (d.type === 'NumericForStat') return 'i';
    const it = d.iters[0] && unparen(d.iters[0]);
    const callee = it && it.type === 'CallExpr' && it.callee.type === 'NameExpr' ? it.callee.name : '';
    if (callee === 'ipairs') return b.index === 0 ? 'idx' : 'val';
    if (callee === 'pairs' || callee === 'next') return b.index === 0 ? 'key' : 'val';
    return b.index === 0 ? 'k' : b.index === 1 ? 'v' : 'it';
  }
  const init = b.init && unparen(b.init);
  if (!init) return 'var';
  switch (init.type) {
    case 'FunctionExpr': return 'fn';
    case 'StringLit': return 'str';
    case 'NumberLit': return 'num';
    case 'TrueLit': case 'FalseLit': return 'flag';
    case 'NilLit': return 'var';
    case 'VarargLit': return 'arg';
    case 'TableExpr': {
      if (!init.fields.length) return 'tbl';
      if (init.fields.length === 1 && init.fields[0].value.type === 'VarargLit') return 'args';
      if (init.fields.every(f => f.kind === 'item')) return 'arr';
      return 'obj';
    }
    case 'MemberExpr': { const c = chainName(init); return c ? '=' + c : 'field'; }
    case 'NameExpr': return '=' + init.name + '_';
    case 'IndexExpr': return 'elem';
    case 'MethodCallExpr': {
      if (init.method === 'GetService' && init.args[0]?.type === 'StringLit') return '=' + ident(init.args[0].value);
      return 'res';
    }
    case 'CallExpr': {
      const c = chainName(init.callee) ?? '';
      if (c === 'require') return 'module';
      if (c === 'setmetatable') return 'obj';
      if (c === 'getfenv' || c === 'getgenv' || c === 'getrenv') return 'env';
      if (c === 'select' && init.args[0]?.type === 'StringLit' && init.args[0].value === '#') return 'argc';
      if (c === 'Instance_new' && init.args[0]?.type === 'StringLit') return '=' + ident(init.args[0].value);
      if (c === 'string_char' || c === 'string_sub' || c === 'tostring' || c === 'table_concat') return 'str';
      if (c === 'tonumber' || c === 'string_byte' || c === 'math_floor' || c.startsWith('bit32_')) return 'num';
      if (c === 'coroutine_wrap' || c === 'loadstring' || c === 'load') return 'fn';
      return 'ret';
    }
    case 'BinExpr':
      if (init.op === '..') return 'str';
      if (['+', '-', '*', '/', '%', '^', '//'].includes(init.op)) return 'num';
      if (['==', '~=', '<', '>', '<=', '>='].includes(init.op)) return 'cond';
      return 'var';
    case 'UnExpr': return init.op === '#' ? 'len' : init.op === 'not' ? 'cond' : 'num';
    default: return 'var';
  }
}

export function smartRename(chunk: A.Chunk, mode: RenameMode = 'obfuscated'): RenameStats {
  const map: RenameStats['map'] = [];
  if (mode === 'none') return { renamed: 0, map };
  const scope = analyzeScopes(chunk);
  const taken = new Set<string>([...scope.globals.keys()]);
  for (const kw of KEYWORDS) taken.add(kw);
  // keep names of bindings we will not rename
  const toRename: Binding[] = [];
  for (const b of scope.bindings) {
    if (b.kind === 'global') continue;
    if (b.name === 'self' && b.kind === 'param') { taken.add(b.name); continue; }
    if (mode === 'obfuscated' && !looksObfuscated(b.name)) { taken.add(b.name); continue; }
    toRename.push(b);
  }
  const counters = new Map<string, number>();
  const fresh = (role: string): string => {
    if (role.startsWith('=')) {
      const base = ident(role.slice(1)) || 'v';
      if (!taken.has(base)) { taken.add(base); return base; }
      let k = 2; while (taken.has(base + '_' + k)) k++;
      taken.add(base + '_' + k); return base + '_' + k;
    }
    let c = counters.get(role) ?? 0, name: string;
    do { c++; name = role + c; } while (taken.has(name));
    counters.set(role, c); taken.add(name); return name;
  };
  for (const b of toRename) {
    const to = fresh(roleOf(b));
    map.push({ from: b.name, to, line: b.line, kind: b.kind });
    renameBinding(b, to);
  }
  return { renamed: map.length, map };
}

export interface CleanStats {
  folded: number; mbaFolded: number; charCalls: number; concatChains: number;
  prunedBranches: number; removedStmts: number;
  propagated: number; aliases: number; removedLocals: number; removedAssigns: number; renamed: number;
}

export interface CleanResult {
  code: string;
  rounds: number;
  stats: CleanStats;
  renameMap: Array<{ from: string; to: string; line: number; kind: string }>;
  parseErrors: number;
}

/** Parse + run the cleanup pipeline, return readable source. */
export function clean(src: string, opts: CleanOptions = {}): CleanResult {
  const o = { foldConstants: true, recoverStrings: true, removeDeadCode: true, propagate: true, removeUnusedLocals: true, rename: 'none' as RenameMode, rounds: 4, ...opts };
  const { chunk, errors } = parse(src);
  const stats: CleanStats = { folded: 0, mbaFolded: 0, charCalls: 0, concatChains: 0, prunedBranches: 0, removedStmts: 0, propagated: 0, aliases: 0, removedLocals: 0, removedAssigns: 0, renamed: 0 };
  let rounds = 0;

    rounds++;
    let changed = 0;
    const aliases = analyzeAliases(chunk);
    if (o.recoverStrings) { const s = recoverStrings(chunk, { resolveStrAlias: aliases.resolveStr }); stats.charCalls += s.charCalls; stats.concatChains += s.concatChains; changed += s.charCalls + s.concatChains; }
    if (o.foldConstants) { const s = fold(chunk, { resolveBitAlias: aliases.resolveBit }); stats.folded += s.folded; stats.mbaFolded += s.mbaFolded; changed += s.folded; }
    if (o.removeDeadCode) { const s = eliminateDeadCode(chunk); stats.prunedBranches += s.prunedBranches; stats.removedStmts += s.removedStmts; changed += s.prunedBranches + s.removedStmts; }
    if (o.propagate) { const s = propagateConstants(chunk); stats.propagated += s.propagated; stats.aliases += s.aliases; changed += s.propagated + s.aliases; }
    if (o.removeUnusedLocals) { const s = removeDeadLocals(chunk); stats.removedLocals += s.removedLocals; stats.removedAssigns += s.removedAssigns; changed += s.removedLocals + s.removedAssigns; }
    return changed;
  };
  for (let r = 0; r < o.rounds; r++) if (round() === 0) break;
  let renameMap: CleanResult['renameMap'] = [];
  if (o.rename !== 'none') {
    const r = smartRename(chunk, o.rename);
    stats.renamed = r.renamed; renameMap = r.map;
    // unique names make local->local alias propagation safe; run a couple more rounds
    for (let r2 = 0; r2 < 2; r2++) if (round() === 0) break;
  }
  return { code: print(chunk), rounds, stats, renameMap, parseErrors: errors.length };
}

// Semantic-equivalence harness (DEV ONLY): runs synthetic test programs through
// clean() with every option, then compares output of original vs cleaned using the
// stock Luau interpreter. Never used by the product, which stays static-only.
import { clean } from '../../src/index.ts';
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, readdirSync } from 'node:fs';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
const LUAU = '/data/prism/tools/luau/luau';
const dir = new URL('.', import.meta.url).pathname;
let fails = 0;
const run = (file: string) => { try { return execFileSync(LUAU, [file], { encoding: 'latin1' }); } catch (e: any) { return 'ERROR: ' + (e.stdout || '') + (e.stderr || ''); } };
for (const f of readdirSync(dir).filter(f => /^t\d+\.lua$/.test(f))) {
  const src = readFileSync(dir + f, 'utf8');
  const want = run(dir + f);
  for (const rename of ['none', 'obfuscated', 'all'] as const) {
    const r = clean(src, { rename });
    const out = '/tmp/prism_sem_' + rename + '_' + f;
    writeFileSync(out, r.code);
    const got = run(out);
    const ok = got === want;
    if (!ok) fails++;
    console.log((ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL') + ' ' + f + ' rename=' + rename + ' ' + JSON.stringify(r.stats));
    if (!ok) { console.log('--- want\n' + want + '--- got\n' + got); }
  }
}
process.exit(fails ? 1 : 0);

// Remove redundant parentheses. A ParenExpr is only semantically meaningful when
// it truncates a multi-value expression (call / vararg) to one value; all other
// grouping is re-derived by the precedence-aware printer.
export function stripParens(node: any): number {
  let removed = 0;
  const seen = new Set<any>();
  const visit = (n: any) => {
    if (!n || typeof n !== 'object' || seen.has(n)) return;
    seen.add(n);
    const keys = Array.isArray(n) ? n.map((_: any, i: number) => i) : Object.keys(n);
    for (const k of keys) {
      if (k === 'loc') continue;
      let v = n[k];
      while (v && v.type === 'ParenExpr') {
        const inner = v.expr;
        if (!inner || inner.type === 'CallExpr' || inner.type === 'MethodCallExpr' || inner.type === 'VarargLit') break;
        v = inner; removed++;
      }
      if (v !== n[k]) n[k] = v;
      if (v && typeof v === 'object') visit(v);
    }
  };
  visit(node);
  return removed;
}

## 247. ИИ · шаг

Writing opcode mapper part 1 (dispatch flattening)
bash
cd /data/prism && cat > packages/core/src/analysis/opcodes.ts <<'EOF'
// PRISM opcode mapper — universal VM handler extraction + semantic guessing.
//
// 1. Finds dispatch trees: nested if/elseif chains that compare ONE variable with
//    numeric constants (linear chains, binary-search trees, mixed), flattens them
//    into leaves with exact opcode sets using interval constraints.
// 2. Recovers VM roles from the fetch/decode prologue (inst = code[pc]; op = inst[k])
//    with frequency-based fallbacks (stack = most operand-indexed table, ...).
// 3. Lifts every handler into register notation (R[A] = R[B][C]) and classifies it
//    against Lua/Luau instruction semantics. Super-instructions (fused handlers
//    separated by pc = pc + 1; inst = code[pc]) are split into micro-ops.
// 4. For control-flow-flattening state machines (state = <const> transitions) the
//    same trees yield blocks + transition edges (CFF unflattening view).
import type * as A from '../ast.js';
import { walk } from '../ast.js';
import { print } from '../printer.js';

export interface HandlerInfo {
  index: number;
  opcodes: number[];
  rangeText: string;
  line: number;
  stmts: number;
  shape: string;
  code: string;
  lifted: string;
  guess: string;
  confidence: number;
  segments: string[];
  successors?: number[];
}

export interface VmRoles {
  inst?: string; code?: string; pc?: string; stack?: string; opField?: string;
  fields: Record<string, string>;
  tables: Array<{ name: string; reads: number; writes: number; role: string }>;
}

export interface DispatchTree {
  id: number;
  line: number;
  var: string;
  kind: 'vm' | 'cff' | 'switch';
  leaves: number;
  minOp: number;
  maxOp: number;
  inLoop: boolean;
  score: number;
  roles: VmRoles;
  handlers: HandlerInfo[];
  entryState?: number;
}

export interface OpcodeReport {
  trees: DispatchTree[];
  notes: string[];
}

interface Constraint { lo: number; hi: number; excl: Set<number>; }
interface Cmp { op: '<' | '<=' | '>' | '>=' | '==' | '~='; k: number; }

const unparen = (e: A.Expr): A.Expr => { while (e && e.type === 'ParenExpr') e = e.expr; return e; };
const FLIP: Record<string, Cmp['op']> = { '<': '>', '<=': '>=', '>': '<', '>=': '<=', '==': '==', '~=': '~=' };
const NEG: Record<string, Cmp['op']> = { '<': '>=', '<=': '>', '>': '<=', '>=': '<', '==': '~=', '~=': '==' };

function numVal(e: A.Expr): number | null {
  e = unparen(e);
  if (e.type === 'NumberLit') return e.value;
  if (e.type === 'UnExpr' && e.op === '-') { const v = numVal(e.expr); return v === null ? null : -v; }
  return null;
}

/** `V op K` (either side) -> normalized comparison on V, else null */
function cmpOn(cond: A.Expr, v: string): Cmp | null {
  const c = unparen(cond);
  if (c.type !== 'BinExpr' || !(c.op in FLIP)) return null;
  const l = unparen(c.left), r = unparen(c.right);
  if (l.type === 'NameExpr' && l.name === v) { const k = numVal(r); return k === null ? null : { op: c.op as Cmp['op'], k }; }
  if (r.type === 'NameExpr' && r.name === v) { const k = numVal(l); return k === null ? null : { op: FLIP[c.op], k }; }
  return null;
}
function cmpVar(cond: A.Expr): string | null {
  const c = unparen(cond);
  if (c.type !== 'BinExpr' || !(c.op in FLIP)) return null;
  const l = unparen(c.left), r = unparen(c.right);
  if (l.type === 'NameExpr' && numVal(r) !== null) return l.name;
  if (r.type === 'NameExpr' && numVal(l) !== null) return r.name;
  return null;
}

function apply(c: Constraint, p: Cmp): Constraint {
  const n: Constraint = { lo: c.lo, hi: c.hi, excl: new Set(c.excl) };
  const k = p.k;
  switch (p.op) {
    case '<': n.hi = Math.min(n.hi, Math.ceil(k) - 1); break;
    case '<=': n.hi = Math.min(n.hi, Math.floor(k)); break;
    case '>': n.lo = Math.max(n.lo, Math.floor(k) + 1); break;
    case '>=': n.lo = Math.max(n.lo, Math.ceil(k)); break;
    case '==': if (Number.isInteger(k)) { n.lo = Math.max(n.lo, k); n.hi = Math.min(n.hi, k); } else { n.lo = 1; n.hi = 0; } break;
    case '~=': if (Number.isInteger(k)) n.excl.add(k); break;
  }
  return n;
}

interface RawLeaf { c: Constraint; body: A.Stat[]; line: number; }

function flatten(ifs: A.IfStat, v: string, c0: Constraint, leaves: RawLeaf[], consumed: Set<any>, ks: number[]) {
  consumed.add(ifs);
  let c = c0;
  for (let i = 0; i < ifs.clauses.length; i++) {
    const cl = ifs.clauses[i];
    const p = cmpOn(cl.cond, v);
    if (!p) {
      // the rest is not a dispatch comparison: keep it as one opaque leaf
      const rest: A.IfStat = { type: 'IfStat', clauses: ifs.clauses.slice(i), elseBody: ifs.elseBody, loc: ifs.loc };
      leaves.push({ c, body: [rest], line: cl.cond.loc?.line ?? ifs.loc?.line ?? 0 });
      return;
    }
    ks.push(p.k);
    body(cl.body, v, apply(c, p), leaves, consumed, ks, cl.cond.loc?.line ?? ifs.loc?.line ?? 0);
    c = apply(c, { op: NEG[p.op], k: p.k });
  }
  if (ifs.elseBody && ifs.elseBody.length) body(ifs.elseBody, v, c, leaves, consumed, ks, ifs.elseBody[0]?.loc?.line ?? 0);
}
function body(stmts: A.Stat[], v: string, c: Constraint, leaves: RawLeaf[], consumed: Set<any>, ks: number[], line: number) {
  if (stmts.length === 1 && stmts[0].type === 'IfStat' && cmpOn(stmts[0].clauses[0].cond, v)) {
    flatten(stmts[0], v, c, leaves, consumed, ks); return;
  }
  leaves.push({ c, body: stmts, line: stmts[0]?.loc?.line ?? line });
}

function enumerate(c: Constraint, minK: number, maxK: number): { ops: number[]; text: string } {
  let lo = c.lo, hi = c.hi;
  if (lo === -Infinity) lo = Math.min(0, Math.floor(minK));
  if (hi === Infinity) hi = Math.floor(maxK) + 1;
  if (lo > hi) return { ops: [], text: '∅' };
  const ops: number[] = [];
  if (hi - lo <= 512) for (let x = lo; x <= hi; x++) if (!c.excl.has(x)) ops.push(x);
  let text: string;
  if (ops.length === 1) text = String(ops[0]);
  else if (ops.length && ops.length === hi - lo + 1) text = lo + '..' + hi;
  else if (ops.length) text = ops.length <= 6 ? ops.join(',') : lo + '..' + hi + ' (\\' + [...c.excl].join(',') + ')';
  else text = (c.lo === -Infinity ? '≤' + hi : c.hi === Infinity ? '≥' + lo : lo + '..' + hi);
  return { ops, text };
}

function shapeHash(stmts: A.Stat[]): string {
  const sh = (s: A.Stat): string => {
    switch (s.type) {
      case 'IfStat': return 'I(' + s.clauses.map(c => s2(c.body)).join('|') + (s.elseBody ? ';' + s2(s.elseBody) : '') + ')';
      case 'WhileStat': return 'W(' + s2(s.body) + ')';
      case 'RepeatStat': return 'R(' + s2(s.body) + ')';
      case 'NumericForStat': case 'GenericForStat': return 'F(' + s2((s as any).body) + ')';
      case 'DoStat': return 'D(' + s2(s.body) + ')';
      case 'LocalStat': return 'l';
      case 'AssignStat': return 'a';
      case 'CallStat': return 'c';
      case 'ReturnStat': return 'r';
      default: return s.type[0];
    }
  };
  const s2 = (b: A.Stat[]) => b.map(sh).join(',');
  const str = s2(stmts);
  let h = 0x811c9dc5;
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) { h ^= str.charCodeAt(i); h = Math.imul(h, 0x01000193); }
  return (h >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}
EOF

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- roles ----
function stmtsDeep(stmts: A.Stat[], fn: (s: A.Stat) => void) {
  for (const s of stmts) {
    fn(s);
    switch (s.type) {
      case 'DoStat': case 'WhileStat': case 'RepeatStat': case 'NumericForStat': case 'GenericForStat': stmtsDeep((s as any).body, fn); break;
      case 'IfStat': for (const c of s.clauses) stmtsDeep(c.body, fn); if (s.elseBody) stmtsDeep(s.elseBody, fn); break;
    }
  }
}
const nameOf = (e: A.Expr | undefined): string | null => { const u = e && unparen(e); return u && u.type === 'NameExpr' ? u.name : null; };
function assignPairs(s: A.Stat): Array<{ t: A.Expr | string; v: A.Expr }> {
  if (s.type === 'AssignStat' && !s.op) return s.targets.map((t, i) => ({ t, v: s.values[i] })).filter(p => p.v);
  if (s.type === 'LocalStat') return s.names.map((n, i) => ({ t: n, v: s.init[i] })).filter(p => p.v);
  return [];
}
const tname = (t: A.Expr | string) => typeof t === 'string' ? t : nameOf(t);

function detectRoles(v: string, prologue: A.Stat[], leaves: RawLeaf[]): VmRoles {
  const roles: VmRoles = { fields: {}, tables: [] };
  // fetch/decode prologue: op = inst[k] ; inst = code[pc]
  stmtsDeep(prologue, (s) => {
    for (const { t, v: val } of assignPairs(s)) {
      const tn = tname(t); const u = unparen(val);
      if (tn === v) {
        if (u.type === 'IndexExpr' && nameOf(u.obj)) { roles.inst = nameOf(u.obj)!; const k = numVal(u.index); roles.opField = k !== null ? String(k) : u.index.type === 'StringLit' ? u.index.value : undefined; }
        else if (u.type === 'MemberExpr' && nameOf(u.obj)) { roles.inst = nameOf(u.obj)!; roles.opField = u.name; }
        else if (u.type === 'CallExpr') { const a = u.args.map(nameOf).find(Boolean); if (a) { roles.inst = a; roles.opField = 'bits'; } }
      }
    }
  });
  if (roles.inst) stmtsDeep(prologue, (s) => {
    for (const { t, v: val } of assignPairs(s)) {
      const u = unparen(val);
      if (tname(t) === roles.inst && u.type === 'IndexExpr' && nameOf(u.obj) && nameOf(u.index)) { roles.code = nameOf(u.obj)!; roles.pc = nameOf(u.index)!; }
    }
  });
  // frequency fallbacks over the handler bodies
  const instCount = new Map<string, number>(), idxCount = new Map<string, number>();
  const pcCand = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const lf of leaves) walk(lf.body, (n: any) => {
    if (n.type === 'IndexExpr' && n.obj.type === 'NameExpr') {
      if (numVal(n.index) !== null) instCount.set(n.obj.name, (instCount.get(n.obj.name) ?? 0) + 1);
      idxCount.set(n.obj.name, (idxCount.get(n.obj.name) ?? 0) + 1);
    }
    if (n.type === 'AssignStat' && n.targets.length === 1 && n.targets[0].type === 'NameExpr') {
      const val = unparen(n.values[0]);
      if (val?.type === 'BinExpr' && val.op === '+' && nameOf(val.left) === n.targets[0].name) pcCand.set(n.targets[0].name, (pcCand.get(n.targets[0].name) ?? 0) + 1);
    }
  });
  const argmax = (m: Map<string, number>, skip: Set<string>) => { let best: string | undefined, bc = 0; for (const [k, c] of m) if (!skip.has(k) && c > bc) { best = k; bc = c; } return best; };
  if (!roles.inst) roles.inst = argmax(instCount, new Set([v]));
  if (!roles.pc) roles.pc = argmax(pcCand, new Set([v, roles.inst ?? '']));
  // operand fields
  const fieldSet = new Set<string>();
  if (roles.inst) for (const lf of leaves) walk(lf.body, (n: any) => {
    if (n.type === 'IndexExpr' && nameOf(n.obj) === roles.inst) { const k = numVal(n.index); if (k !== null) fieldSet.add(String(k)); else if (n.index.type === 'StringLit') fieldSet.add(n.index.value); }
    if (n.type === 'MemberExpr' && nameOf(n.obj) === roles.inst) fieldSet.add(n.name);
  });
  if (roles.opField) fieldSet.delete(roles.opField);
  const sorted = [...fieldSet].sort((a, b) => { const na = Number(a), nb = Number(b); return isNaN(na) || isNaN(nb) ? a.localeCompare(b) : na - nb; });
  const LET = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E', 'F', 'G', 'H'];

  const stackCount = new Map<string, number>();
  const tabStats = new Map<string, { reads: number; writes: number }>();
  for (const lf of leaves) {
    walk(lf.body, (n: any, parent: any, key: any) => {
      if (n.type === 'IndexExpr' && n.obj.type === 'NameExpr' && n.obj.name !== roles.inst && n.obj.name !== roles.code) {
        const opIdx = isOpRef(n.index) || n.index.type === 'NameExpr' || n.index.type === 'BinExpr';
        if (opIdx) stackCount.set(n.obj.name, (stackCount.get(n.obj.name) ?? 0) + 1);
        if (isOpRef(n.index)) {
          const st = tabStats.get(n.obj.name) ?? { reads: 0, writes: 0 };
          if (parent && parent.type === 'AssignStat' && key === 'targets') st.writes++; else st.reads++;
          tabStats.set(n.obj.name, st);

  roles.stack = argmax(stackCount, new Set([v, roles.inst ?? '', roles.code ?? '', roles.pc ?? '']));
  for (const [name, st] of tabStats) if (name !== roles.stack) roles.tables.push({ name, ...st, role: st.writes === 0 ? 'K (read-only: constants/protos?)' : 'Env/Upvalues (read+write)' });
  roles.tables.sort((a, b) => (b.reads + b.writes) - (a.reads + a.writes));
  return roles;
}

// -------------------------------------------------------------- lifting ----
const NAME = (name: string): A.NameExpr => ({ type: 'NameExpr', name });

/** rewrite a cloned handler body into register notation */
function lift(stmts: A.Stat[], roles: VmRoles): A.Stat[] {
  const body: A.Stat[] = structuredClone(stmts);
  const tabRename = new Map<string, string>();
  roles.tables.forEach((t, i) => tabRename.set(t.name, t.writes === 0 ? (i === 0 ? 'K' : 'K' + i) : (i === 0 ? 'Env' : 'Env' + i)));
  const fieldName = (k: string) => roles.fields[k] ?? ('I' + k);
  const rewrite = (n: any): any => {
    if (!n || typeof n !== 'object') return n;
    if (Array.isArray(n)) { for (let i = 0; i < n.length; i++) n[i] = rewrite(n[i]); return n; }
    if (n.type === 'IndexExpr' && nameOf(n.obj) === roles.inst) {
      const k = numVal(n.index);
      if (k !== null) return NAME(String(k) === roles.opField ? 'OP' : fieldName(String(k)));
      if (n.index.type === 'StringLit') return NAME(n.index.value === roles.opField ? 'OP' : fieldName(n.index.value));
    }
    if (n.type === 'MemberExpr' && nameOf(n.obj) === roles.inst) return NAME(n.name === roles.opField ? 'OP' : fieldName(n.name));
    if (n.type === 'NameExpr') {
      if (n.name === roles.stack) return NAME('R');
      if (n.name === roles.pc) return NAME('pc');
      if (n.name === roles.code) return NAME('Code');
      if (n.name === roles.inst) return NAME('Inst');
      const t = tabRename.get(n.name); if (t) return NAME(t);
      return n;
    }
    for (const k of Object.keys(n)) if (k !== 'loc' && k !== 'type') n[k] = rewrite(n[k]);
    return n;
  };
  rewrite(body);
  // inline operand-only locals:  local n = A  ->  use A directly
  const fields = new Set([...Object.values(roles.fields), 'OP']);
  const opOnly = (e: A.Expr): boolean => { const u = unparen(e); return (u.type === 'NameExpr' && fields.has(u.name)) || u.type === 'NumberLit' || (u.type === 'BinExpr' && ['+', '-'].includes(u.op) && opOnly(u.left) && opOnly(u.right)); };
  for (let i = 0; i < body.length; i++) {
    const s = body[i];
    if (s.type !== 'LocalStat' || s.names.length !== 1 || s.init.length !== 1 || !opOnly(s.init[0])) continue;
    const nm = s.names[0], init = s.init[0];
    let written = false;
    walk(body.slice(i + 1), (m: any) => { if (m.type === 'AssignStat') for (const t of m.targets) if (nameOf(t) === nm) written = true; if (m.type === 'LocalStat' && m.names.includes(nm)) written = true; });
    if (written) continue;
    const sub = (n: any): any => {
      if (!n || typeof n !== 'object') return n;
      if (Array.isArray(n)) { for (let j = 0; j < n.length; j++) n[j] = sub(n[j]); return n; }
      if (n.type === 'NameExpr' && n.name === nm) return structuredClone(init);
      if (n.type === 'FunctionExpr' && n.params.includes(nm)) return n;
      for (const k of Object.keys(n)) if (k !== 'loc' && k !== 'type') n[k] = sub(n[k]);
      return n;
    };
    for (let j = i + 1; j < body.length; j++) body[j] = sub(body[j]);
    body.splice(i, 1); i--;
  }
  return body;
}

/** split fused handlers at `pc = pc + 1; inst = code[pc]` advance points */
function splitSegments(stmts: A.Stat[], roles: VmRoles): A.Stat[][] {
  if (!roles.inst || !roles.code || !roles.pc) return [stmts];
  const segs: A.Stat[][] = [[]];
  for (let i = 0; i < stmts.length; i++) {
    const s = stmts[i];
    const isFetch = s.type === 'AssignStat' && s.targets.length === 1 && nameOf(s.targets[0]) === roles.inst && unparen(s.values[0]).type === 'IndexExpr' && nameOf((unparen(s.values[0]) as A.IndexExpr).obj) === roles.code;
    if (isFetch) {
      const cur = segs[segs.length - 1];
      const last = cur[cur.length - 1];
      if (last && last.type === 'AssignStat' && nameOf(last.targets[0]) === roles.pc) cur.pop();
      segs.push([]);
      continue;
    }
    segs[segs.length - 1].push(s);
  }
  return segs.filter(s => s.length);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------- classification ----
const ARITH: Record<string, string> = { '+': 'ADD', '-': 'SUB', '*': 'MUL', '/': 'DIV', '%': 'MOD', '^': 'POW', '..': 'CONCAT', '//': 'IDIV' };
const CMPN: Record<string, string> = { '==': 'EQ', '~=': 'EQ', '<': 'LT', '>': 'LT', '<=': 'LE', '>=': 'LE' };

function classify(seg: A.Stat[], fieldNames: Set<string>): { name: string; conf: number } {
  const isReg = (e: A.Expr | undefined) => { const u = e && unparen(e); return !!u && u.type === 'IndexExpr' && nameOf(u.obj) === 'R'; };
  const isOp = (e: A.Expr | undefined): boolean => { const u = e && unparen(e); if (!u) return false; if (u.type === 'NameExpr') return fieldNames.has(u.name); if (u.type === 'BinExpr' && (u.op === '+' || u.op === '-')) return isOp(u.left) || isOp(u.right); return false; };
  const isK = (e: A.Expr | undefined) => { const u = e && unparen(e); return !!u && (isOp(u) || u.type === 'NumberLit' || u.type === 'StringLit' || (u.type === 'IndexExpr' && /^K\d*$/.test(nameOf(u.obj) ?? ''))); };
  const has = (pred: (n: any) => boolean) => { let hit = false; walk(seg, (n: any) => { if (!hit && pred(n)) hit = true; }); return hit; };
  const callOnReg = (n: any) => (n.type === 'CallExpr' && isReg(n.callee)) || (n.type === 'MethodCallExpr' && isReg(n.obj));
  const pcWrite = (stmts: A.Stat[]) => { let hit = false; stmtsDeep(stmts, s => { if (s.type === 'AssignStat' && s.targets.some(t => nameOf(t) === 'pc')) hit = true; }); return hit; };
  const top = seg;
  // returns
  const ret = top.find(s => s.type === 'ReturnStat') as A.ReturnStat | undefined;
  let retDeep: A.ReturnStat | undefined; stmtsDeep(top, s => { if (!retDeep && s.type === 'ReturnStat') retDeep = s; });
  if (ret || (retDeep && !pcWrite(top))) {
    const r = (ret ?? retDeep)!;
    if (r.args.length === 1 && callOnReg(unparen(r.args[0]))) return { name: 'TAILCALL', conf: 0.8 };
    return { name: 'RETURN', conf: ret ? 0.85 : 0.6 };
  }
  // conditional jumps / loops
  const ifs = top.find(s => s.type === 'IfStat' && (pcWrite(s.clauses.flatMap(c => c.body)) || pcWrite(s.elseBody ?? []))) as A.IfStat | undefined;
  if (ifs) {
    const forStep = top.some(s => s.type === 'AssignStat' && isReg(s.targets[0]) && unparen(s.values[0])?.type === 'BinExpr' && (unparen(s.values[0]) as A.BinExpr).op === '+' && isReg((unparen(s.values[0]) as A.BinExpr).left));
    if (forStep) return { name: 'FORLOOP', conf: 0.75 };
    if (has(callOnReg)) return { name: 'TFORLOOP', conf: 0.65 };
    let c = unparen(ifs.clauses[0].cond); let neg = false;
    if (c.type === 'UnExpr' && c.op === 'not') { c = unparen(c.expr); neg = true; }
    if (c.type === 'BinExpr' && CMPN[c.op]) {
      const k = isK(c.left) || isK(c.right);
      return { name: CMPN[c.op] + (k ? 'K' : '') + (c.op === '~=' ? ' (not)' : ''), conf: 0.8 };
    }
    if (isReg(c)) {
      const sets = ifs.clauses[0].body.some(s => s.type === 'AssignStat' && isReg(s.targets[0]));
      return { name: (sets ? 'TESTSET' : 'TEST') + (neg ? ' (not)' : ''), conf: 0.75 };
    }
    return { name: 'COND-JMP', conf: 0.45 };
  }
  if (has(callOnReg)) return { name: 'CALL', conf: 0.8 };
  // SELF: R[A+1] = R[B]; R[A] = R[B][C]   (possibly through a temp local)
  const assigns = top.filter(s => s.type === 'AssignStat' || (s.type === 'LocalStat' && s.init.length)) as Array<A.AssignStat | A.LocalStat>;
  if (assigns.length >= 2 && assigns.length <= 4) {
    const regT = assigns.filter(s => s.type === 'AssignStat' && isReg(s.targets[0])) as A.AssignStat[];
    const plus1 = regT.some(s => { const i = unparen((s.targets[0] as A.IndexExpr).index); return i.type === 'BinExpr' && i.op === '+' && numVal(i.right) === 1; });
    const getIdx = regT.some(s => unparen(s.values[0]).type === 'IndexExpr');
    if (plus1 && getIdx && regT.length === 2) return { name: 'SELF', conf: 0.8 };
  }
  // loops
  const loop = top.find(s => s.type === 'NumericForStat' || s.type === 'WhileStat' || s.type === 'GenericForStat') as any;
  if (loop) {
    let setlist = false, nilfill = false, vararg = false, pcInc = false;
    stmtsDeep(loop.body, s => {
      if (s.type === 'AssignStat') {
        const t = unparen(s.targets[0]); const v = unparen(s.values[0]);
        if (t.type === 'IndexExpr' && isReg(t.obj)) setlist = true;
        if (isReg(t) && v?.type === 'NilLit') nilfill = true;
        if (isReg(t) && v?.type === 'IndexExpr' && !isReg(v)) vararg = true;
        if (nameOf(t) === 'pc') pcInc = true;
      }
    });
    if (pcInc || has((n: any) => n.type === 'FunctionExpr')) return { name: 'CLOSURE', conf: 0.65 };
    if (setlist) return { name: 'SETLIST', conf: 0.7 };
    if (nilfill) return { name: 'LOADNIL', conf: 0.75 };
    if (vararg) return { name: 'VARARG', conf: 0.55 };
  }
  if (has((n: any) => n.type === 'FunctionExpr')) return { name: 'CLOSURE', conf: 0.7 };
  if (has((n: any) => n.type === 'VarargLit')) return { name: 'VARARG', conf: 0.6 };
  // main effect: last assignment
  const main = [...assigns].reverse().find(s => s.type === 'AssignStat') as A.AssignStat | undefined;
  if (main) {
    const t = unparen(main.targets[0]); const v = unparen(main.values[main.values.length - 1] ?? main.values[0]);
    if (nameOf(t) === 'pc') return { name: 'JMP', conf: 0.85 };
    if (isReg(t) && v) {
      if (isReg(v)) return { name: 'MOVE', conf: 0.9 };
      if (v.type === 'TrueLit' || v.type === 'FalseLit') return { name: 'LOADBOOL', conf: 0.8 };
      if (v.type === 'NilLit') return { name: 'LOADNIL', conf: 0.8 };
      if (v.type === 'NumberLit' || v.type === 'StringLit' || isOp(v)) return { name: 'LOADK', conf: 0.75 };
      if (v.type === 'IndexExpr') {
        if (isReg(v.obj)) return { name: 'GETTABLE' + (isK(v.index) ? 'K' : ''), conf: 0.85 };
        const tn = nameOf(v.obj) ?? '';
        if (/^K\d*$/.test(tn)) return { name: 'LOADK', conf: 0.6 };
        if (/^Env\d*$/.test(tn)) return { name: 'GETGLOBAL', conf: 0.6 };
        return { name: 'GETUPVAL', conf: 0.45 };
      }
      if (v.type === 'MemberExpr' && isReg(v.obj)) return { name: 'GETTABLEK', conf: 0.8 };
      if (v.type === 'BinExpr' && ARITH[v.op]) return { name: ARITH[v.op] + ((isK(v.left) || isK(v.right)) ? 'K' : ''), conf: 0.85 };
      if (v.type === 'BinExpr' && CMPN[v.op]) return { name: 'CMP→BOOL', conf: 0.5 };
      if (v.type === 'UnExpr') return { name: v.op === '-' ? 'UNM' : v.op === 'not' ? 'NOT' : v.op === '#' ? 'LEN' : 'UNOP', conf: 0.85 };
      if (v.type === 'TableExpr') return { name: 'NEWTABLE', conf: 0.85 };
      if (v.type === 'CallExpr' || v.type === 'MethodCallExpr') return { name: 'CALL?', conf: 0.4 };
    }
    if (t.type === 'IndexExpr' && isReg(t.obj)) return { name: 'SETTABLE' + (isK(t.index) ? 'K' : ''), conf: 0.85 };
    if (t.type === 'MemberExpr' && isReg(t.obj)) return { name: 'SETTABLEK', conf: 0.8 };
    if (t.type === 'IndexExpr') {
      const tn = nameOf(t.obj) ?? '';
      if (/^Env\d*$/.test(tn)) return { name: 'SETGLOBAL', conf: 0.6 };
      return { name: 'SETUPVAL', conf: 0.45 };
    }
  }
  if (top.some(s => s.type === 'CallStat')) return { name: 'CALL?', conf: 0.35 };
  return { name: '?', conf: 0.1 };
}

// ----------------------------------------------------------------- main ----
const printStats = (stmts: A.Stat[], cap = 6000) => { const s = print({ type: 'Chunk', body: stmts }); return s.length > cap ? s.slice(0, cap) + '\n-- …truncated (' + s.length + ' chars)' : s; };

function assignsConst(stmts: A.Stat[], v: string): number[] {
  const out: number[] = [];
  walk(stmts, (n: any) => {
    if (n.type === 'AssignStat') n.targets.forEach((t: A.Expr, i: number) => { if (nameOf(t) === v && n.values[i]) { const k = numVal(n.values[i]); if (k !== null) out.push(k); } });
  });
  return out;
}

function buildTree(id: number, root: A.IfStat, v: string, leaves: RawLeaf[], ks: number[], prologue: A.Stat[], inLoop: boolean, preLoop: A.Stat[]): DispatchTree {
  const minK = Math.min(...ks), maxK = Math.max(...ks);
  const roles = detectRoles(v, prologue, leaves);
  const fetch = !!(roles.code && roles.pc);
  const cffLeaves = leaves.filter(l => assignsConst(l.body, v).length > 0).length;
  const fieldCount = Object.keys(roles.fields).length;
  let kind: DispatchTree['kind'] = 'switch';
  if (fetch && roles.stack && fieldCount >= 1) kind = 'vm';
  else if (cffLeaves >= Math.max(2, leaves.length * 0.4)) kind = 'cff';
  else if (roles.inst && roles.stack && fieldCount >= 2) kind = 'vm';
  const fieldNames = new Set(Object.values(roles.fields));
  const handlers: HandlerInfo[] = leaves.map((lf, index) => {
    const { ops, text } = enumerate(lf.c, minK, maxK);
    const h: HandlerInfo = { index, opcodes: ops, rangeText: text, line: lf.line, stmts: lf.body.length, shape: shapeHash(lf.body), code: printStats(lf.body), lifted: '', guess: '', confidence: 0, segments: [] };
    if (kind === 'vm') {
      const segs = splitSegments(lf.body, roles);
      const lifted = segs.map(sg => lift(sg, roles));
      const cls = lifted.map(l => classify(l, fieldNames));
      h.segments = cls.map(c => c.name);
      h.guess = cls.length > 1 ? 'SUPER[' + cls.map(c => c.name).join(' + ') + ']' : (cls[0]?.name ?? '?');
      h.confidence = cls.length ? Math.round(Math.min(...cls.map(c => c.conf)) * 100) / 100 : 0;
      h.lifted = lifted.map((l, i) => (lifted.length > 1 ? '-- [' + (i + 1) + '] ' + h.segments[i] + '\n' : '') + printStats(l, 3000)).join(lifted.length > 1 ? '-- next instruction\n' : '');
    } else if (kind === 'cff') {
      h.successors = [...new Set(assignsConst(lf.body, v))];
      h.guess = h.successors.length === 0 ? 'EXIT/NOSTATE' : h.successors.length === 1 ? 'GOTO ' + h.successors[0] : 'BRANCH ' + h.successors.join('|');
      h.confidence = 0.7;
    } else { h.guess = 'case'; h.confidence = 0.3; }
    return h;
  });
  let entryState: number | undefined;
  if (kind === 'cff') for (let i = preLoop.length - 1; i >= 0 && entryState === undefined; i--) {
    for (const { t, v: val } of assignPairs(preLoop[i])) if (tname(t) === v) { const k = numVal(val); if (k !== null) entryState = k; }
  }
  const score = leaves.length * (inLoop ? 2 : 1) * (kind === 'vm' ? 3 : kind === 'cff' ? 2 : 1);
  return { id, line: root.loc?.line ?? 0, var: v, kind, leaves: leaves.length, minOp: minK, maxOp: maxK, inLoop, score, roles, handlers, entryState };
}

export function extractOpcodes(chunk: A.Chunk, opts: { minLeaves?: number; maxTrees?: number } = {}): OpcodeReport {
  const minLeaves = opts.minLeaves ?? 4;
  const consumed = new Set<any>();
  const trees: DispatchTree[] = [];
  const notes: string[] = [];
  interface Ctx { loopBody: A.Stat[] | null; loopIdx: { i: number }; preLoop: A.Stat[]; }

  function visitList(list: A.Stat[], ctx: Ctx, isLoopBody: boolean) {
    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      if (isLoopBody) ctx.loopIdx.i = i;
      const s = list[i];
      if (s.type === 'IfStat' && !consumed.has(s)) {
        const v = cmpVar(s.clauses[0].cond);
        if (v) {
          const leaves: RawLeaf[] = []; const ks: number[] = []; const local = new Set<any>();
          flatten(s, v, { lo: -Infinity, hi: Infinity, excl: new Set() }, leaves, local, ks);

  }
  function visitStat(s: A.Stat, ctx: Ctx, list: A.Stat[], i: number) {
    const loopCtx = (body: A.Stat[]): Ctx => ({ loopBody: body, loopIdx: { i: 0 }, preLoop: list.slice(0, i) });
    switch (s.type) {
      case 'WhileStat': case 'RepeatStat': case 'NumericForStat': case 'GenericForStat':
        visitExprs(s); visitList((s as any).body, loopCtx((s as any).body), true); break;
      case 'DoStat': visitList(s.body, ctx, false); break;
      case 'IfStat': for (const c of s.clauses) visitList(c.body, ctx, false); if (s.elseBody) visitList(s.elseBody, ctx, false); visitExprs(s); break;
      case 'LocalFunctionStat': case 'FunctionStat': visitFn(s.func); break;
      default: visitExprs(s);
    }
  }
  function visitFn(f: A.FunctionExpr) { visitList(f.body, { loopBody: null, loopIdx: { i: 0 }, preLoop: [] }, false); }
  function visitExprs(s: any) {
    // find function expressions inside expressions (not inside nested statement lists)
    const scan = (n: any) => {
      if (!n || typeof n !== 'object') return;
      if (Array.isArray(n)) { for (const x of n) scan(x); return; }
      if (n.type === 'FunctionExpr') { visitFn(n); return; }
      for (const k of Object.keys(n)) { if (k === 'loc' || k === 'body' || k === 'elseBody' || k === 'clauses') continue; scan(n[k]); }
      if (n.type === 'IfStat') for (const c of n.clauses) scan(c.cond);
    };
    scan(s);
  }
  visitList(chunk.body, { loopBody: null, loopIdx: { i: 0 }, preLoop: [] }, false);

  // table-of-functions dispatch: { [1] = function .. end, ... } / T[k] = function
  walk(chunk, (n: any) => {
    if (n.type !== 'TableExpr' || n.fields.length < 8) return;
    const fns = n.fields.filter((f: A.TableField) => f.value.type === 'FunctionExpr');
    if (fns.length < 8 || fns.length < n.fields.length * 0.8) return;
    const leaves: RawLeaf[] = []; const ks: number[] = [];
    let pos = 0;
    for (const f of n.fields as A.TableField[]) {
      if (f.kind === 'item') pos++;
      if (f.value.type !== 'FunctionExpr') continue;
      const k = f.kind === 'item' ? pos : f.kind === 'keyed' ? numVal(f.key!) : null;
      if (k === null) continue;
      ks.push(k);
      leaves.push({ c: { lo: k, hi: k, excl: new Set() }, body: (f.value as A.FunctionExpr).body, line: f.value.loc?.line ?? 0 });
    }
    if (leaves.length >= 8) {
      const fake: A.IfStat = { type: 'IfStat', clauses: [], loc: n.loc };
      const t = buildTree(trees.length, fake, '<table>', leaves, ks, [], true, []);
      if (t.kind === 'switch') { t.kind = 'vm'; }
      trees.push(t);
    }
  });

  trees.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  const max = opts.maxTrees ?? 40;
  if (trees.length > max) { notes.push(`${trees.length} dispatch trees found, showing top ${max}`); trees.length = max; }
  trees.forEach((t, i) => t.id = i);
  const vm = trees.find(t => t.kind === 'vm');
  if (vm) notes.push(`VM dispatcher @L${vm.line} on '${vm.var}': ${vm.leaves} handlers, opcodes ${vm.minOp}..${vm.maxOp}; roles inst=${vm.roles.inst ?? '?'} stack=${vm.roles.stack ?? '?'} pc=${vm.roles.pc ?? '?'}`);
  const cff = trees.filter(t => t.kind === 'cff');
  if (cff.length) notes.push(`${cff.length} control-flow-flattening state machine(s); largest has ${cff[0].leaves} blocks`);
  if (!trees.length) notes.push('no numeric dispatch trees found (try lowering minLeaves, or the VM dispatches via a table/function list)');
  return { trees, notes };
}

/** Compact, copy-friendly text rendering of one dispatch tree. */
export function formatOpcodeTree(t: DispatchTree, opts: { code?: boolean; lifted?: boolean } = {}): string {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  lines.push(`-- dispatch tree #${t.id} @L${t.line} var=${t.var} kind=${t.kind} handlers=${t.leaves} range=${t.minOp}..${t.maxOp}` + (t.entryState !== undefined ? ` entry=${t.entryState}` : ''));
  const r = t.roles;
  lines.push(`-- roles: inst=${r.inst ?? '?'} code=${r.code ?? '?'} pc=${r.pc ?? '?'} stack=${r.stack ?? '?'} opField=${r.opField ?? '?'} fields=${Object.entries(r.fields).map(([k, v]) => k + '→' + v).join(',')}`);
  for (const tb of r.tables) lines.push(`--   table ${tb.name}: reads=${tb.reads} writes=${tb.writes} → ${tb.role}`);
  for (const h of t.handlers) {
    lines.push(`[${h.rangeText}] ${h.guess} (conf ${h.confidence}) L${h.line} stmts=${h.stmts} shape=${h.shape}` + (h.successors ? ' → ' + h.successors.join(',') : ''));
    if (opts.lifted && h.lifted) lines.push(h.lifted.replace(/^/gm, '    '));
    if (opts.code) lines.push(h.code.replace(/^/gm, '    '));
  }
  return lines.join('\n');
}

// Control-flow normalisation passes (universal, semantics-preserving):

//    (only when no other break/continue in S binds to that loop)

  const scan = (list: A.Stat[], top: boolean): boolean => {
    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      const s = list[i];
      if (s.type === 'BreakStat' || s.type === 'ContinueStat') { if (!(top && allowLastBreak && i === list.length - 1 && s.type === 'BreakStat')) return true; }

      else if (s.type === 'IfStat') { for (const c of s.clauses) if (scan(c.body, false)) return true; if (s.elseBody && scan(s.elseBody, false)) return true; }

  };

}

export function loopOnce(chunk: A.Chunk): number {

    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      const s = list[i];

/** Inline `do ... end` blocks whose removal cannot change scoping or syntax. */
export function flattenDo(chunk: A.Chunk): number {
  let n = 0;
  const visitList = (list: A.Stat[], inRepeat: boolean) => {
    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      const s = list[i];
      visitStat(s);
      if (s.type !== 'DoStat') continue;
      if (!s.body.length) { list.splice(i, 1); i--; n++; continue; }
      const isLast = i === list.length - 1;
      const last = s.body[s.body.length - 1];
      const endsExit = last.type === 'ReturnStat' || last.type === 'BreakStat' || last.type === 'ContinueStat';
      if (endsExit && !isLast) continue;
      const locals = topLocalNames(s.body);
      if (locals.length && (!isLast || inRepeat)) {
        // safe when later statements never mention the names
        if (inRepeat || mentions(list.slice(i + 1), locals)) continue;
      }
      list.splice(i, 1, ...s.body); i--; n++;
    }
  };
  const visitStat = (s: A.Stat) => {
    switch (s.type) {
      case 'DoStat': visitList(s.body, false); break;
      case 'WhileStat': case 'NumericForStat': case 'GenericForStat': visitList((s as any).body, false); break;
      case 'RepeatStat': visitList(s.body, true); break;
      case 'IfStat': for (const c of s.clauses) visitList(c.body, false); if (s.elseBody) visitList(s.elseBody, false); break;
      case 'LocalFunctionStat': case 'FunctionStat': visitList(s.func.body, false); break;
    }
    // function expressions nested inside expressions
    const scan = (x: any) => {
      if (!x || typeof x !== 'object') return;
      if (Array.isArray(x)) { for (const y of x) scan(y); return; }
      if (x.type === 'FunctionExpr') { visitList(x.body, false); return; }
      for (const k of Object.keys(x)) { if (k === 'loc' || k === 'body' || k === 'elseBody' || k === 'func') continue; if (k === 'clauses') { for (const c of x.clauses) scan(c.cond); continue; } scan(x[k]); }
    };
    scan(s);
  };
  visitList(chunk.body, false);
  return n;
}

bash
cd /data/prism && cat > packages/core/test/semantic/t4.lua <<'EOF'
-- loop normalisation edge cases (single-trip / zero-trip numeric for, do-break)
local out = {}
local function emit(...) out[#out + 1] = table.concat({...}, ",") end

for i = 48, 58 do
  do
    emit("once", i)
    break
  end
  emit("never")
end

for i = 10, 1 do emit("zero-trip") end
for i = 1, 10, -1 do emit("zero-trip2") end

local x = 0
for j = 3, 9, 2 do
  x = x + j
  if x > 1 then
    emit("j", j)
    break
  end
  emit("unreached")
end

local function f(n)
  for k = 1, 5 do
    do
      if n > 2 then emit("big", n, k); break end
      emit("small", n, k)
    end
    emit("after-do", n)
    break
  end
  return n
end
f(1); f(5)

local function g(t)
  while true do
    do
      local y = t * 2
      if y > 4 then emit("g>", y) break end
      emit("g<=", y)
    end
    local y = "shadow"
    emit("tail", y)
    break
  end
end
g(1); g(3)

repeat
  do emit("rep"); break end
until true

for i = 1, 1 do
  local i = i + 100
  emit("inner", i)
  break
end

print(table.concat(out, " | "))
EOF

// PRISM constants finder — universal literal inventory + decoder/deserializer hunting.
//
// * strings: unique literals with count, Shannon entropy, printable ratio and a
//   coarse class (identifier / text / url / base64 / hex / alphabet / binary / blob)
// * numbers: frequency table with tags (byte, large, float, xor-operand, mod-operand ...)
// * arrays: numeric table constructors (byte arrays, key schedules, packed bytecode)
// * decoders: every function scored for string-decryptor / deserializer / bit-helper
//   features, plus its call sites (a function called hundreds of times with literal
//   arguments is almost always the constant decryptor: `w(-46073)`)
// * keys: literal operands of xor / bxor and repeating-key string indexing
import type * as A from '../ast.js';
import { walk } from '../ast.js';
import { bytesToDisplay } from '../lexer.js';
import { analyzeScopes } from './scope.js';

export interface StringConst { value: string; display: string; count: number; len: number; entropy: number; printable: number; kind: string; lines: number[]; }
export interface NumberConst { value: number; raw: string; count: number; lines: number[]; tags: string[]; }
export interface ArrayConst { line: number; pos: number; length: number; min: number; max: number; kind: string; values: number[]; }
export interface DecoderCandidate {
  name: string; line: number; endLine: number; pos: number; params: number;
  score: number; kind: string; reasons: string[];
  callSites: number; literalArgCalls: number; sampleCalls: string[];
}
export interface KeyCandidate { value: string; line: number; context: string; }
export interface ConstantsReport {
  summary: { strings: number; uniqueStrings: number; numbers: number; uniqueNumbers: number; arrays: number; decoders: number; bytes: number };
  strings: StringConst[];
  numbers: NumberConst[];
  arrays: ArrayConst[];
  decoders: DecoderCandidate[];
  keys: KeyCandidate[];
}

export function entropy(s: string): number {
  if (!s.length) return 0;
  const f = new Map<number, number>();
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) { const c = s.charCodeAt(i); f.set(c, (f.get(c) ?? 0) + 1); }
  let h = 0;
  for (const c of f.values()) { const p = c / s.length; h -= p * Math.log2(p); }
  return Math.round(h * 100) / 100;
}
export function printableRatio(s: string): number {
  if (!s.length) return 1;
  let p = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) { const c = s.charCodeAt(i); if ((c >= 32 && c < 127) || c === 9 || c === 10 || c === 13 || c >= 128) p++; }
  return Math.round(p / s.length * 100) / 100;
}
const ROBLOX = new Set(['game', 'workspace', 'Players', 'LocalPlayer', 'GetService', 'HttpGet', 'HttpService', 'RunService', 'ReplicatedStorage', 'UserInputService', 'TweenService', 'Instance', 'FindFirstChild', 'WaitForChild', 'Character', 'Humanoid', 'HumanoidRootPart', 'CoreGui', 'StarterGui', 'Heartbeat', 'RenderStepped', 'Connect', 'Destroy', 'Parent', 'Name', 'CFrame', 'Vector3', 'Enum', 'loadstring', 'getfenv', 'setfenv', 'getgenv', 'hookfunction', 'getrawmetatable', 'setreadonly', 'newcclosure', 'syn', 'request', 'http_request', 'identifyexecutor', 'writefile', 'readfile']);

export function classifyString(s: string): string {
  const n = s.length;
  const pr = printableRatio(s);
  if (n >= 4 && /^https?:\/\//i.test(s)) return 'url';
  if (/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/.test(s)) return ROBLOX.has(s) ? 'api' : 'identifier';
  if (n >= 32) {
    const uniq = new Set(s).size;
    if (uniq >= 32 && uniq === n) return 'alphabet';
  }
  if (n >= 16 && /^[0-9a-fA-F]+$/.test(s) && n % 2 === 0) return 'hex';
  if (n >= 16 && /^[A-Za-z0-9+/_-]+={0,2}$/.test(s) && /[0-9]/.test(s) && /[a-z]/.test(s) && /[A-Z]/.test(s)) return 'base64';
  if (pr < 0.7) return 'binary';
  if (n >= 64 && entropy(s) > 5.2) return 'blob';
  if (n >= 64 && !/\s/.test(s)) return 'blob';

}

const unparen = (e: any): any => { while (e && e.type === 'ParenExpr') e = e.expr; return e; };
const isLit = (e: any): boolean => { const u = unparen(e); if (!u) return false; if (u.type === 'NumberLit' || u.type === 'StringLit' || u.type === 'NilLit' || u.type === 'TrueLit' || u.type === 'FalseLit') return true; return u.type === 'UnExpr' && u.op === '-' && unparen(u.expr)?.type === 'NumberLit'; };
