/** best-effort callee label: name / a.b / a:b */
function calleeName(e: any): string | null {
  const u = unparen(e);
  if (!u) return null;
  if (u.type === 'NameExpr') return u.name;
  if (u.type === 'MemberExpr') { const o = calleeName(u.obj); return o ? o + '.' + u.name : null; }
  if (u.type === 'IndexExpr' && unparen(u.index)?.type === 'StringLit') { const o = calleeName(u.obj); return o ? o + '.' + unparen(u.index).value : null; }
  return null;
}

interface Feat { byte: number; char: number; sub: number; xor: number; bitops: number; mod256: number; len: number; loops: number; concat: number; tconcat: number; tonumberBase: number; posAdvance: number; newTables: number; gsub: number; ldexp: number; selects: number; stringCompares: number; returnsCall: number; }

function features(f: A.FunctionExpr): Feat {
  const ft: Feat = { byte: 0, char: 0, sub: 0, xor: 0, bitops: 0, mod256: 0, len: 0, loops: 0, concat: 0, tconcat: 0, tonumberBase: 0, posAdvance: 0, newTables: 0, gsub: 0, ldexp: 0, selects: 0, stringCompares: 0, returnsCall: 0 };
  walk(f.body, (n: any) => {
    switch (n.type) {
      case 'CallExpr': case 'MethodCallExpr': {
        const nm = n.type === 'MethodCallExpr' ? n.method ?? n.name : calleeName(n.callee ?? n.func);
        const last = (nm ?? '').split('.').pop() ?? '';
        if (last === 'byte') ft.byte++;
        else if (last === 'char') ft.char++;
        else if (last === 'sub') ft.sub++;
        else if (last === 'bxor') ft.xor++;
        else if (['band', 'bor', 'rshift', 'lshift', 'arshift', 'bnot', 'extract', 'replace', 'lrotate', 'rrotate', 'btest'].includes(last)) ft.bitops++;
        else if (last === 'concat') ft.tconcat++;
        else if (last === 'gsub' || last === 'gmatch') ft.gsub++;
        else if (last === 'ldexp' || last === 'frexp') ft.ldexp++;
        else if (last === 'select') ft.selects++;
        else if (last === 'tonumber' && (n.args?.length ?? 0) >= 2) ft.tonumberBase++;
        break;
      }
      case 'BinExpr': {
        if (n.op === '~') ft.xor++;
        else if (['&', '|', '<<', '>>'].includes(n.op)) ft.bitops++;
        else if (n.op === '%') { const r = unparen(n.right); if (r?.type === 'NumberLit' && [256, 65536, 4294967296, 2 ** 53].includes(r.value)) ft.mod256++; }
        else if (n.op === '..') ft.concat++;
        else if ((n.op === '==' || n.op === '~=') && (unparen(n.right)?.type === 'StringLit' || unparen(n.left)?.type === 'StringLit')) ft.stringCompares++;
        break;
      }
      case 'UnExpr': if (n.op === '#') ft.len++; else if (n.op === '~') ft.bitops++; break;
      case 'WhileStat': case 'RepeatStat': case 'NumericForStat': case 'GenericForStat': ft.loops++; break;
      case 'TableExpr': ft.newTables++; break;
      case 'AssignStat': {
        if (n.targets.length === 1 && n.targets[0].type === 'NameExpr') {
          const v = unparen(n.values[0]);
          if (n.op === '+' || (v?.type === 'BinExpr' && v.op === '+' && unparen(v.left)?.type === 'NameExpr' && unparen(v.left).name === n.targets[0].name)) ft.posAdvance++;
        }
        break;
      }
      case 'ReturnStat': if (n.args?.length === 1 && ['CallExpr', 'MethodCallExpr'].includes(unparen(n.args[0])?.type)) ft.returnsCall++; break;
    }
  });
  return ft;
}

function scoreFn(ft: Feat, literalCalls: number, calls: number, params: number): { score: number; kind: string; reasons: string[] } {
  const r: string[] = [];
  let dec = 0, des = 0, bit = 0;
  if (ft.byte) { dec += 2 + Math.min(ft.byte, 4); des += 2 + Math.min(ft.byte, 6); r.push(`string.byte×${ft.byte}`); }
  if (ft.char) { dec += 3 + Math.min(ft.char, 3); r.push(`string.char×${ft.char}`); }
  if (ft.sub) { dec += 1; des += 2 + Math.min(ft.sub, 4); r.push(`string.sub×${ft.sub}`); }
  if (ft.xor) { dec += 4 + Math.min(ft.xor, 4); bit += 3; r.push(`xor×${ft.xor}`); }
  if (ft.bitops) { bit += 2 + Math.min(ft.bitops, 6); des += Math.min(ft.bitops, 4); r.push(`bitops×${ft.bitops}`); }
  if (ft.mod256) { dec += 3; bit += 3; r.push(`% 256-style×${ft.mod256}`); }
  if (ft.len) { dec += 1; des += 1; r.push(`#len×${ft.len}`); }
  if (ft.loops) { dec += 2; des += 2 + Math.min(ft.loops, 4); r.push(`loops×${ft.loops}`); }
  if (ft.tconcat) { dec += 2; r.push('table.concat'); }
  if (ft.concat) { dec += 1; }
  if (ft.tonumberBase) { dec += 3; des += 2; r.push(`tonumber(x, base)×${ft.tonumberBase}`); }
  if (ft.gsub) { dec += 2; r.push(`gsub/gmatch×${ft.gsub}`); }
  if (ft.ldexp) { des += 4; r.push('ldexp/frexp (float decode)'); }
  if (ft.posAdvance) { des += Math.min(ft.posAdvance, 6); r.push(`counter advance×${ft.posAdvance}`); }
  if (ft.newTables >= 2) { des += Math.min(ft.newTables, 5); r.push(`table builds×${ft.newTables}`); }
  if (ft.stringCompares >= 3) { des += 2; r.push(`type-tag compares×${ft.stringCompares}`); }
  if (literalCalls >= 3) { dec += Math.min(12, 3 + Math.log2(literalCalls) * 2); r.unshift(`called ${literalCalls}× with literal args`); }
  else if (calls) r.push(`${calls} call site(s)`);

  else if (dec >= bit && dec >= 6) kind = literalCalls >= 3 && params <= 3 ? 'constant-decryptor' : 'string-decoder';
  else if (bit >= 5) kind = 'bit-helper';

export function findConstants(chunk: A.Chunk, opts: { maxStrings?: number; maxNumbers?: number; maxArrays?: number; maxDecoders?: number } = {}): ConstantsReport {

// PRISM structural search + cross references.
//
// Pattern syntax (any Luau expression or statement list):
//   $X      metavariable: matches any expression / name; repeated $X must match equal code
//   $_      wildcard (no binding)
//   $$$     ellipsis: any number of call arguments / table items / statements
// Examples:  string.char($$$)    $T[$K] = $T[$K] + 1    local $A = $F($$$)    bit32.bxor($X, $X)
import type * as A from '../ast.js';
import { walk } from '../ast.js';
import { parse } from '../parser.js';
import { print } from '../printer.js';
import { analyzeScopes } from './scope.js';

const MV = '__prism_mv_';
const ELL = '__prism_ellipsis__';

export interface PatternMatch { line: number; col: number; start: number; end: number; text: string; bindings: Record<string, string>; }
export interface PatternResult { kind: 'expr' | 'stat'; matches: PatternMatch[]; total: number; error?: string; }

function prep(pattern: string): string {
  return pattern
    .replace(/^\s*\$\$\$\s*;?\s*$/gm, ELL + '()')
    .replace(/\$\$\$/g, ELL)
    .replace(/\$([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)/g, (_m, n) => MV + n);
}

const isEll = (n: any) => n && ((n.type === 'NameExpr' && n.name === ELL) || (n.type === 'CallStat' && n.expr?.type === 'CallExpr' && n.expr.callee?.type === 'NameExpr' && n.expr.callee.name === ELL && !n.expr.args.length));
const unparen = (e: any): any => { while (e && e.type === 'ParenExpr') e = e.expr; return e; };

function same(a: any, b: any): boolean {
  a = unparen(a); b = unparen(b);
  if (a === b) return true;
  if (!a || !b || typeof a !== 'object' || typeof b !== 'object') return a === b;
  if (Array.isArray(a)) { if (!Array.isArray(b) || a.length !== b.length) return false; for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) if (!same(a[i], b[i])) return false; return true; }
  if (a.type !== b.type) return false;
  if (a.type === 'NumberLit') return a.value === b.value;
  for (const k of Object.keys(a)) { if (k === 'loc' || k === 'raw') continue; if (!same(a[k], b[k])) return false; }
  return true;
}

function m(p: any, n: any, env: Map<string, any>): boolean {
  if (p && p.type === 'ParenExpr' && !(n && n.type === 'ParenExpr')) p = unparen(p);
  if (n && n.type === 'ParenExpr' && !(p && p.type === 'ParenExpr')) n = unparen(n);
  if (p && typeof p === 'object' && p.type === 'NameExpr' && p.name.startsWith(MV)) {
    if (!n || typeof n !== 'object' || !n.type) return false;
    const name = p.name.slice(MV.length);
    if (name === '_') return true;
    const prev = env.get(name);
    if (prev) return same(prev, n);
    env.set(name, n); return true;
  }
  if (typeof p === 'string' && p.startsWith(MV)) {   // metavariable in a name slot (local $X = ...)
    if (typeof n !== 'string') return false;
    const name = p.slice(MV.length);
    if (name === '_') return true;
    const prev = env.get(name);
    if (prev !== undefined) return (typeof prev === 'string' ? prev : prev.type === 'NameExpr' ? prev.name : null) === n;
    env.set(name, n); return true;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(p)) return Array.isArray(n) && mList(p, 0, n, 0, env);
  if (!p || typeof p !== 'object') return p === n;
  if (!n || typeof n !== 'object' || p.type !== n.type) {
    // `$X` in a member slot: a.$X  ~ name strings handled above; method names too
    return false;
  }
  if (p.type === 'NumberLit') return p.value === n.value;
  for (const k of Object.keys(p)) {
    if (k === 'loc' || k === 'raw') continue;
    if (!m(p[k], n[k], env)) return false;
  }
  return true;
}
function mList(p: any[], i: number, n: any[], j: number, env: Map<string, any>): boolean {
  if (i === p.length) return j === n.length;
  const pi = p[i];
  const ell = isEll(pi) || (pi && pi.kind === 'item' && isEll(pi.value));
  if (ell) {
    for (let k = j; k <= n.length; k++) {
      const snap = new Map(env);
      if (mList(p, i + 1, n, k, env)) return true;
      env.clear(); for (const [a, b] of snap) env.set(a, b);
    }
    return false;
  }
  if (j >= n.length) return false;
  const snap = new Map(env);
  if (m(pi, n[j], env) && mList(p, i + 1, n, j + 1, env)) return true;
  env.clear(); for (const [a, b] of snap) env.set(a, b);
  return false;
}

function lineCol(src: string, pos: number): { line: number; col: number } {
  let line = 1, last = -1;
  for (let i = 0; i < pos && i < src.length; i++) if (src.charCodeAt(i) === 10) { line++; last = i; }
  return { line, col: pos - last };
}

const show = (v: any): string => typeof v === 'string' ? v : v.type && /Stat$/.test(v.type) ? print({ type: 'Chunk', body: [v] }).trim() : print({ type: 'Chunk', body: [{ type: 'ReturnStat', args: [v] }] }).trim().replace(/^return\s+/, '').replace(/;$/, '');

/** structural AST search. `src` must be the code the positions refer to. */
export function searchPattern(src: string, pattern: string, opts: { max?: number; kind?: 'auto' | 'expr' | 'stat' } = {}): PatternResult {
  const max = opts.max ?? 500;

    if (!pnode.length) return { kind, matches: [], total: 0, error: 'empty pattern' };
  }
  const { chunk } = parse(src);
  const matches: PatternMatch[] = [];
  let total = 0;
  const record = (node: any, env: Map<string, any>, endNode?: any) => {
    total++;
    if (matches.length >= max) return;
    const start = node.loc?.start ?? 0;
    const lc = lineCol(src, start);
    const lineEnd = src.indexOf('\n', start);
    const b: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const [k, v] of env) b[k] = show(v).slice(0, 300);

export interface XrefRef { line: number; col: number; kind: 'read' | 'write' | 'decl'; text: string; }
export interface XrefBinding { name: string; kind: string; line: number; reads: number; writes: number; captured: boolean; refs: XrefRef[]; }

/** scope-aware references of every binding called `name` (optionally only the one visible at `line`) */
export function xrefs(src: string, name: string, opts: { line?: number; max?: number } = {}): XrefBinding[] {
  const { chunk } = parse(src);
  const sc = analyzeScopes(chunk);
  const lines = src.split('\n');
  const text = (l: number) => (lines[l - 1] ?? '').trim().slice(0, 200);
  const lineStart: number[] = [0];
  for (let i = 0; i < src.length; i++) if (src.charCodeAt(i) === 10) lineStart.push(i + 1);
  const colOf = (pos: number, line: number) => pos - (lineStart[line - 1] ?? 0) + 1;
  let cands = sc.bindings.filter(b => b.name === name);
  const globals = [...sc.refOf.entries()].filter(([n, b]) => b.kind === 'global' && n.name === name);
  const out: XrefBinding[] = [];
  if (opts.line !== undefined) {
    // binding whose reference/declaration sits on that line, else nearest declaration above
    const onLine = cands.filter(b => b.line === opts.line || b.refs.some(r => r.loc?.line === opts.line));
    cands = onLine.length ? onLine : cands.filter(b => b.line <= opts.line!).sort((a, b) => b.line - a.line).slice(0, 1);
  }
  const max = opts.max ?? 2000;
  for (const b of cands) {
    const writes = new Set(b.writeRefs);
    const refs: XrefRef[] = [{ line: b.line, col: 0, kind: 'decl', text: text(b.line) }];
    for (const r of b.refs) { if (refs.length >= max) break; const l = r.loc?.line ?? 0; refs.push({ line: l, col: colOf(r.loc?.start ?? 0, l), kind: writes.has(r) ? 'write' : 'read', text: text(l) }); }
    out.push({ name: b.name, kind: b.kind, line: b.line, reads: b.reads, writes: b.writes, captured: b.captured, refs });
  }
  if (globals.length && (!cands.length || opts.line === undefined)) {
    const refs: XrefRef[] = globals.slice(0, max).map(([n]) => { const l = n.loc?.line ?? 0; return { line: l, col: colOf(n.loc?.start ?? 0, l), kind: 'read' as const, text: text(l) }; });
    out.push({ name, kind: 'global', line: 0, reads: globals.length, writes: 0, captured: false, refs });
  }
  return out;
}

    if isinstance(v, bool):
        return 'boolean'
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
        return 'number'
    if isinstance(v, str):
        return 'string'
    if isinstance(v, LuaTable):
        return 'table'
    if callable(v):
        return 'function'
    return 'userdata'


def lua_len(v):
    if isinstance(v, str):
        return len(v)
    if isinstance(v, LuaTable):
        if v.meta is not None and v.meta.h.get('__len') is not None:
            return first(v.meta.h['__len'](v))
        return v.length()
    raise LuaError('attempt to get length of a %s value' % lua_type(v))


def lua_range(a, b, c=1):
    a, b, c = _num(a), _num(b), _num(c)
    if c == 0:
        raise LuaError("'for' step is zero")
    if isinstance(a, int) and isinstance(b, int) and isinstance(c, int):
        return range(a, b + (1 if c > 0 else -1), c)
    return _frange(a, b, c)


def _frange(a, b, c):
    i = a
    while (i <= b) if c > 0 else (i >= b):
        yield i
        i += c


def pairs(t):
    if isinstance(t, LuaTable):
        for k, v in list(t.h.items()):
            if t.h.get(k) is not None:
                yield _unkey(k), v
        return
    raise LuaError("bad argument #1 to 'pairs' (table expected)")


def ipairs(t):
    i = 1
    while True:
        v = t[i]
        if v is None:
            return
        yield i, v
        i += 1


def lua_next(t, k=None):
    keys = list(t.h.keys())
    if k is None:
        idx = 0
    else:
        kk = _key(k)
        idx = keys.index(kk) + 1 if kk in t.h else len(keys)
    if idx >= len(keys):
        return None
    return Multi((_unkey(keys[idx]), t.h[keys[idx]]))


def lua_iter(n, f, s=None, c=None):
    """generic-for protocol: for a, b in f, s, c (also accepts Python iterators)"""
    if hasattr(f, '__next__') or isinstance(f, (list, tuple, range)):
        for item in f:
            yield adj(n, *(item if isinstance(item, tuple) else (item,)))
        return
    while True:
        r = adj(n, *spread(f(s, c)))
        if r[0] is None:
            return
        c = r[0]
        yield r


def select(n, *a):
    if n == '#':
        return len(a)
    n = _int(n)
    if n < 0:
        n = len(a) + n + 1
    return Multi(a[n - 1:])


def lua_unpack(t, i=1, j=None):
    i = _int(i)
    j = lua_len(t) if j is None else _int(j)
    return Multi(t[k] for k in range(i, j + 1))


def lua_print(*a):
    s = '\t'.join(tostring(x) for x in a) + '\n'
    _sys.stdout.buffer.write(s.encode('latin-1', 'replace'))
    _sys.stdout.flush()


def lua_error(msg=None, level=1):
    raise LuaError(msg)


def lua_assert(v=None, msg='assertion failed!', *rest):
    if not truthy(v):
        raise LuaError(msg)
    return Multi((v, msg) + rest) if rest or msg != 'assertion failed!' else v


def pcall(f, *a):
    try:
        return Multi((True,) + tuple(spread(f(*a))))
    except LuaError as e:
        return Multi((False, e.value))
    except Exception as e:
        return Multi((False, str(e)))


def xpcall(f, handler, *a):
    try:
        return Multi((True,) + tuple(spread(f(*a))))
    except LuaError as e:
        return Multi((False, first(handler(e.value))))
    except Exception as e:
        return Multi((False, first(handler(str(e)))))


def setmetatable(t, mt):
    t.meta = mt
    return t


def getmetatable(t):
    if isinstance(t, LuaTable):
        mt = t.meta
        if mt is not None and mt.h.get('__metatable') is not None:
            return mt.h['__metatable']
        return mt
    if isinstance(t, str):
        return _lib(__index=string)
    return None


def rawget(t, k):
    return t.h.get(_key(k))


def rawset(t, k, v):
    kk = _key(k)
    if v is None:
        t.h.pop(kk, None)
    else:
        t.h[kk] = v
    return t


def rawequal(a, b):
    return a is b or (not isinstance(a, LuaTable) and a == b)


def rawlen(t):
    return len(t) if isinstance(t, str) else t.length()


def invoke(obj, name, *a):
    """obj:name(...) - strings dispatch to the string library"""
    if isinstance(obj, str):
        return string.h[name](obj, *a)
    return obj[name](obj, *a)


def _not_static(*_a):
    raise LuaError('dynamic code loading is not available in a static transpile')


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ string --
def _s_sub(s, i=1, j=-1):
    n = len(s)
    i = _int(i)
    j = -1 if j is None else _int(j)
    if i < 0:
        i = max(n + i + 1, 1)
    elif i == 0:
        i = 1
    if j < 0:
        j = n + j + 1
    elif j > n:
        j = n
    return s[i - 1:j] if i <= j else ''


def _s_byte(s, i=1, j=None):
    sub = _s_sub(s, i, i if j is None else j)
    if len(sub) == 1:
        return ord(sub)
    return Multi(ord(ch) for ch in sub)


def _s_char(*cs):
    return ''.join(chr(_int(c) & 0xff) for c in cs)


def _s_rep(s, n, sep=''):
    n = _int(n)
    return sep.join([s] * n) if n > 0 else ''


def _ascii_case(s, upper):
    lo, hi = ('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz', 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ')
    return s.translate(str.maketrans(lo, hi) if upper else str.maketrans(hi, lo))


_CLS = {'a': 'A-Za-z', 'd': '0-9', 'l': 'a-z', 's': ' \\t\\n\\r\\f\\v', 'u': 'A-Z', 'w': 'A-Za-z0-9',
        'x': 'A-Fa-f0-9', 'p': '!-/:-@\\[-`{-~', 'c': '\\x00-\\x1f\\x7f', 'g': '!-~'}


def _lua_pat(p):
    """translate a Lua pattern into a Python regex (no %b / %f support)"""
    out, i, n, depth = [], 0, len(p), 0
    anchored = p.startswith('^')
    if anchored:
        i = 1
    while i < n:
        c = p[i]
        if c == '%':
            i += 1
            d = p[i]
            if d in _CLS:
                out.append('[' + _CLS[d] + ']')
            elif d.lower() in _CLS:
                out.append('[^' + _CLS[d.lower()] + ']')
            elif d.isdigit():
                out.append('\\' + d)
            elif d in 'bf':
                raise LuaError('pattern item %' + d + ' is not supported by the transpiler')
            else:
                out.append(_re.escape(d))
        elif c == '[':
            j = i + 1
            cls = '['
            if j < n and p[j] == '^':
                cls += '^'
                j += 1
            first_ = True
            while j < n and (p[j] != ']' or first_):
                first_ = False
                if p[j] == '%':
                    j += 1
                    d = p[j]
                    cls += _CLS.get(d, '') if d in _CLS else ('' if d.lower() in _CLS else _re.escape(d))
                elif p[j] in '\\[]^':
                    cls += '\\' + p[j]
                else:
                    cls += p[j]
                j += 1
            out.append(cls + ']')
            i = j
        elif c == '(':
            if i + 1 < n and p[i + 1] == ')':
                out.append('()')
                i += 1
            else:
                out.append('(')
                depth += 1
        elif c == ')':
            out.append(')')
            depth -= 1
        elif c == '.':
            out.append('[\\s\\S]')
        elif c == '-':
            if out:
                out.append('*?')
            else:
                out.append('\\-')
        elif c in '*+?':
            out.append(c)
        elif c == '$' and i == n - 1:
            out.append('\\Z')
        else:
            out.append(_re.escape(c))
        i += 1
    return ('^' if anchored else '') + ''.join(out)


def _caps(m):
    if m.re.groups == 0:
        return (m.group(0),)
    return tuple((m.start(g) + 1 if m.group(g) == '' and m.re.pattern.find('()') >= 0 else m.group(g)) for g in range(1, m.re.groups + 1))


def _s_find(s, p, init=1, plain=False):
    init = _int(init)
    if init < 0:
        init = max(len(s) + init + 1, 1)
    elif init == 0:
        init = 1
    if plain or not _re.search(r'[\^$*+?.()\[\]%-]', p):
        k = s.find(p, init - 1)
        return None if k < 0 else Multi((k + 1, k + len(p)))
    m = _re.compile(_lua_pat(p)).search(s, init - 1)
    if not m:
        return None
    return Multi((m.start() + 1, m.end()) + (_caps(m) if m.re.groups else ()))


def _s_match(s, p, init=1):
    init = _int(init)
    if init < 0:
        init = max(len(s) + init + 1, 1)
    m = _re.compile(_lua_pat(p)).search(s, max(init, 1) - 1)
    if not m:
        return None
    c = _caps(m)
    return c[0] if len(c) == 1 else Multi(c)


def _s_gmatch(s, p):
    for m in _re.compile(_lua_pat(p)).finditer(s):
        c = _caps(m)
        yield c


def _s_gsub(s, p, repl, n=None):
    rx = _re.compile(_lua_pat(p))
    count = [0]
    lim = None if n is None else _int(n)

    def sub(m):
        if lim is not None and count[0] >= lim:
            return m.group(0)
        count[0] += 1
        c = _caps(m)
        if isinstance(repl, str):
            def rep(mm):
                d = mm.group(1)
                if d == '%':
                    return '%'
                k = int(d)
                return m.group(0) if k == 0 else tostring(c[k - 1])
            return _re.sub(r'%([0-9%])', rep, repl)
        v = repl[c[0]] if isinstance(repl, LuaTable) else first(repl(*c))
        if v is None or v is False:
            return m.group(0)
        return tostring(v)
    out = rx.sub(sub, s)
    return Multi((out, count[0]))


def _s_format(fmt, *args):
    args = list(args)
    pos = [0]

    def nxt():
        v = args[pos[0]] if pos[0] < len(args) else None
        pos[0] += 1
        return v

    def rep(m):
        flags, conv = m.group(1), m.group(2)
        if conv == '%':
            return '%'
        v = nxt()
        if conv in 'di':
            return ('%' + flags + 'd') % _int(v)
        if conv in 'xXo':
            return ('%' + flags + conv) % (_int(v) & 0xffffffffffffffff if _int(v) < 0 else _int(v))
        if conv == 'c':
            return chr(_int(v))
        if conv == 's':
            return ('%' + flags + 's') % tostring(v)
        if conv == 'q':
            return '"' + tostring(v).replace('\\', '\\\\').replace('"', '\\"').replace('\n', '\\n') + '"'
        if conv in 'eEfgG':
            return ('%' + flags + conv) % float(_num(v))
        if conv == 'u':
            return ('%' + flags + 'd') % _int(v)
        return m.group(0)
    return _re.sub(r'%([-+ #0]*\d*(?:\.\d+)?)([diouxXeEfgGcsq%])', rep, fmt)


def _s_split(s, sep=','):
    return T(s.split(sep))


string = _lib(sub=_s_sub, byte=_s_byte, char=_s_char, len=len, rep=_s_rep, reverse=lambda s: s[::-1],
              lower=lambda s: _ascii_case(s, False), upper=lambda s: _ascii_case(s, True), find=_s_find,
              match=_s_match, gmatch=_s_gmatch, gsub=_s_gsub, format=_s_format, split=_s_split)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------- table --
def _t_insert(t, a, b=None, *rest):
    if b is None and not rest:
        t[t.length() + 1] = a
        return
    pos, v, n = _int(a), b, t.length()
    for k in range(n, pos - 1, -1):
        t[k + 1] = t[k]
    t[pos] = v


def _t_remove(t, pos=None):
    n = t.length()
    if n == 0 and pos is None:
        return None
    pos = n if pos is None else _int(pos)
    v = t[pos]
    for k in range(pos, n):
        t[k] = t[k + 1]
    if pos <= n:
        t[n] = None
    return v


def _t_concat(t, sep='', i=1, j=None):
    j = t.length() if j is None else _int(j)
    return sep.join(concat(t[k]) for k in range(_int(i), j + 1))


def _t_sort(t, comp=None):
    n = t.length()
    items = [t[k] for k in range(1, n + 1)]
    if comp is None:
        items.sort()
    else:
        items.sort(key=_cmp_to_key(lambda a, b: -1 if truthy(comp(a, b)) else (1 if truthy(comp(b, a)) else 0)))
    for k, v in enumerate(items, 1):
        t[k] = v


def _t_pack(*a):
    t = T(list(a))
    t['n'] = len(a)
    return t


def _t_find(t, v, init=1):
    k = _int(init)
    while t[k] is not None:
        if t[k] == v:
            return k
        k += 1
    return None


def _t_create(n, v=None):
    return T([v] * _int(n))


def _t_clear(t):
    t.h.clear()


def _t_move(a1, f, e, t, a2=None):
    a2 = a1 if a2 is None else a2
    f, e, t = _int(f), _int(e), _int(t)
    if e >= f:
        if t > f or t > e or a1 is not a2:
            for k in range(0, e - f + 1):
                a2[t + k] = a1[f + k]
        else:
            for k in range(e - f, -1, -1):
                a2[t + k] = a1[f + k]
    return a2

# -------------------------------------------------------------------- math --
def _floor(x):
    x = _num(x)
    return _m.floor(x) if _m.isfinite(x) else x


def _ceil(x):
    x = _num(x)
    return _m.ceil(x) if _m.isfinite(x) else x


def _modf(x):

    f, i = _m.modf(x)
    return Multi((float(i), f))


def _log(x, b=None):

    return _m.log(x) if b is None else _m.log(x, _num(b))

        return _random_mod.random()
    if b is None:
        return _random_mod.randint(1, _int(a))
    return _random_mod.randint(_int(a), _int(b))


_random_mod = _random.Random(0)
math = _lib(floor=_floor, ceil=_ceil, abs=abs, max=max, min=min, sqrt=lambda x: _m.sqrt(_num(x)), huge=float('inf'),

            clamp=lambda x, lo, hi: max(lo, min(hi, x)), sign=lambda x: (x > 0) - (x < 0), round=lambda x: _m.floor(x + 0.5) if x >= 0 else _m.ceil(x - 0.5),
            tointeger=lambda x: int(x) if isinstance(x, (int, float)) and float(x).is_integer() else None, maxinteger=2 ** 63 - 1, mininteger=-2 ** 63)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------- bit32 --
_M32 = 0xffffffff


def _u32(x):
    return _int(x) & _M32


def _band(*a):
    r = _M32
    for x in a:
        r &= _u32(x)
    return r


def _bor(*a):
    r = 0
    for x in a:
        r |= _u32(x)
    return r


def _bxor(*a):
    r = 0
    for x in a:
        r ^= _u32(x)
    return r


def _lshift(x, n):
    n = _int(n)
    return 0 if abs(n) >= 32 else ((_u32(x) << n) & _M32 if n >= 0 else _u32(x) >> -n)


def _rshift(x, n):
    n = _int(n)
    return 0 if abs(n) >= 32 else (_u32(x) >> n if n >= 0 else (_u32(x) << -n) & _M32)


def _arshift(x, n):
    x, n = _u32(x), _int(n)
    if x & 0x80000000:
        x -= 1 << 32
    return (x >> n) & _M32 if n >= 0 else (x << -n) & _M32


def _lrotate(x, n):
    x, n = _u32(x), _int(n) % 32
    return ((x << n) | (x >> (32 - n))) & _M32


def _extract(x, f, w=1):
    return (_u32(x) >> _int(f)) & ((1 << _int(w)) - 1)

    f, w = _int(f), _int(w)

    return (_u32(x) & ~mask | (_u32(v) << f) & mask) & _M32

    return 32 - x.bit_length()


def _countrz(x):
    x = _u32(x)
    return 32 if x == 0 else (x & -x).bit_length() - 1

         rawget=rawget, rawset=rawset, rawequal=rawequal, rawlen=rawlen, loadstring=_not_static, load=_not_static)
G.h['_G'] = G
getfenv = lambda *a: G
setfenv = lambda f, env=None: f
# ----------------------------------------------------------- end of shim --
`;

cat > /data/prism/packages/core/src/transpile/python.ts <<'EOF'
// PRISM Lua/Luau -> Python 3 transpiler (static; for re-implementing decoders /
// deserializers in Python as in the "rewrite the unpacker" workflow).
//
// * strings are byte strings (see pyprelude), tables are LuaTable, nil = None
// * Lua truthiness is preserved (truthy()) unless both semantics provably agree
// * multiple returns use Multi(...) + first()/spread()/adj()
// * every Lua binding gets a unique Python name (shadowing-safe); captured
//   assignments become `nonlocal`; function expressions are hoisted to defs
import type * as A from '../ast.js';
import { parse } from '../parser.js';
import { analyzeScopes, Binding, ScopeInfo } from '../analysis/scope.js';
import { PY_PRELUDE } from './pyprelude.js';

export interface PyOptions { prelude?: boolean; }
export interface PyResult { code: string; warnings: string[]; freeNames: string[]; }

const PY_RESERVED = new Set(['False', 'None', 'True', 'and', 'as', 'assert', 'async', 'await', 'break', 'class', 'continue', 'def', 'del', 'elif', 'else', 'except', 'finally', 'for', 'from', 'global', 'if', 'import', 'in', 'is', 'lambda', 'nonlocal', 'not', 'or', 'pass', 'raise', 'return', 'try', 'while', 'with', 'yield', 'match', 'case', 'type', 'print', 'len', 'str', 'int', 'float', 'list', 'dict', 'tuple', 'set', 'range', 'object', 'id', 'min', 'max', 'abs', 'ord', 'chr', 'iter', 'next', 'map', 'filter', 'sum', 'any', 'all', 'open', 'input', 'format', 'hash', 'super', 'self_', 'callable', 'isinstance', 'repr', 'sorted', 'reversed', 'zip', 'enumerate', 'bytes', 'bool', 'exec', 'eval', 'compile', 'globals', 'locals', 'vars', 'getattr', 'setattr', 'hasattr', 'delattr',
  // prelude names
  'T', 'G', 'LuaTable', 'LuaError', 'Multi', 'first', 'spread', 'adj', 'truthy', 'concat', 'tostring', 'tonumber', 'lua_type', 'lua_len', 'lua_range', 'lua_iter', 'pairs', 'ipairs', 'lua_next', 'select', 'lua_unpack', 'lua_print', 'lua_error', 'lua_assert', 'pcall', 'xpcall', 'setmetatable', 'getmetatable', 'rawget', 'rawset', 'rawequal', 'rawlen', 'invoke', 'lua_div', 'lua_idiv', 'lua_mod', 'lua_pow', 'string', 'table', 'math', 'bit32', 'utf8', 'os', 'getfenv', 'setfenv', 'main', 'varargs']);

/** Lua global -> prelude expression */
const GLOBAL_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
  print: 'lua_print', tostring: 'tostring', tonumber: 'tonumber', type: 'lua_type', typeof: 'lua_type', pairs: 'pairs', ipairs: 'ipairs', next: 'lua_next',
  select: 'select', unpack: 'lua_unpack', error: 'lua_error', assert: 'lua_assert', pcall: 'pcall', xpcall: 'xpcall', setmetatable: 'setmetatable',
  getmetatable: 'getmetatable', rawget: 'rawget', rawset: 'rawset', rawequal: 'rawequal', rawlen: 'rawlen', string: 'string', table: 'table', math: 'math',
  bit32: 'bit32', utf8: 'utf8', os: 'os', getfenv: 'getfenv', setfenv: 'setfenv', _G: 'G', _ENV: 'G', shared: 'G',
};
const LIBS = new Set(['string', 'table', 'math', 'bit32', 'utf8', 'os']);
const MULTI_LIB = new Set(['string.find', 'string.match', 'string.gsub', 'table.unpack', 'unpack', 'select', 'next', 'pcall', 'xpcall', 'math.modf', 'math.frexp']);

const unparen = (e: any): any => { while (e && e.type === 'ParenExpr') e = e.expr; return e; };

function pyStr(s: string): string {
  let out = "'";
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
    const c = s.charCodeAt(i);
    if (c === 92) out += '\\\\';
    else if (c === 39) out += "\\'";
    else if (c === 10) out += '\\n';
    else if (c === 13) out += '\\r';
    else if (c === 9) out += '\\t';
    else if (c >= 32 && c < 127) out += s[i];
    else out += '\\x' + (c & 255).toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
  }
  return out + "'";
}
function pyNum(v: number): string {
  if (Number.isNaN(v)) return "float('nan')";
  if (v === Infinity) return "float('inf')";
  if (v === -Infinity) return "float('-inf')";
  if (Number.isInteger(v) && Math.abs(v) < 2 ** 63) return BigInt(v).toString();
  return String(v);
}
EOF
echo ok

cat >> /data/prism/packages/core/src/transpile/python.ts <<'EOF'

type PE = [string, number];   // python expression + precedence
const P = { cond: 1, or: 2, and: 3, not: 4, cmp: 5, bor: 6, bxor: 7, band: 8, shift: 9, add: 10, mul: 11, unary: 12, pow: 13, atom: 14 };
const par = (e: PE, min: number) => e[1] >= min ? e[0] : '(' + e[0] + ')';

class PyEmitter {
  sc: ScopeInfo;
  names = new Map<Binding, string>();
  used = new Set<string>(PY_RESERVED);
  decl = new Map<any, Binding[]>();
  multiFns = new Set<A.FunctionExpr>();
  warnings: string[] = [];
  out: string[] = [];
  pre: string[] = [];
  depth = 0;
  tmp = 0;
  fnCount = 0;
  /** bindings that live at Python module level (function-only mode) */
  moduleLevel = new Set<Binding>();

  constructor(public chunk: A.Chunk) {
    this.sc = analyzeScopes(chunk);
    for (const b of this.sc.bindings) { if (b.kind === 'global') continue; const l = this.decl.get(b.decl) ?? []; l[b.index] = b; this.decl.set(b.decl, l); }
    const scanFn = (f: A.FunctionExpr) => {
      const visit = (n: any) => {
        if (!n || typeof n !== 'object') return;
        if (Array.isArray(n)) { n.forEach(visit); return; }
        if (n.type === 'FunctionExpr') return;
        if (n.type === 'ReturnStat') { const last = unparen(n.args[n.args.length - 1]); if (n.args.length >= 2 || (last && ['CallExpr', 'MethodCallExpr', 'VarargLit'].includes(last.type))) this.multiFns.add(f); }
        for (const k of Object.keys(n)) if (k !== 'loc') visit(n[k]);
      };
      visit(f.body);
    };
    const all = (n: any) => { if (!n || typeof n !== 'object') return; if (Array.isArray(n)) { n.forEach(all); return; } if (n.type === 'FunctionExpr') scanFn(n); for (const k of Object.keys(n)) if (k !== 'loc') all(n[k]); };
    all(chunk);
  }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ names --
  fresh(base: string): string {
    let b = base.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_]/g, '_'); if (!/^[A-Za-z_]/.test(b)) b = '_' + b;
    if (PY_RESERVED.has(b)) b += '_';
    let c = b, k = 2; while (this.used.has(c)) c = b + '_' + k++;
    this.used.add(c); return c;
  }
  nameOf(b: Binding): string { let n = this.names.get(b); if (!n) { n = this.fresh(b.name); this.names.set(b, n); } return n; }
  bindingsOf(decl: any): Binding[] { return this.decl.get(decl) ?? []; }
  temp(): string { return '_t' + (++this.tmp); }

  // ------------------------------------------------------------ output --
  line(s: string) { const ind = '    '.repeat(this.depth); for (const p of this.pre) this.out.push(p); this.pre = []; this.out.push(ind + s); }
  block(body: A.Stat[]) { this.depth++; const n = this.out.length; for (const s of body) this.stat(s); if (this.out.length === n && !this.pre.length) this.line('pass'); else if (this.pre.length) { for (const p of this.pre) this.out.push(p); this.pre = []; } this.depth--; }

  // ------------------------------------------------------- expressions --
  calleeFn(e: A.Expr): A.FunctionExpr | undefined {
    const u = unparen(e);
    if (u?.type !== 'NameExpr') return undefined;
    const b = this.sc.refOf.get(u);
    if (!b || b.kind === 'global') return undefined;
    if (b.kind === 'localfn') return (b.decl as A.LocalFunctionStat).func;
    if (b.kind === 'local' && b.writes === 0 && b.init && unparen(b.init).type === 'FunctionExpr') return unparen(b.init);
    return undefined;
  }
  globalName(e: A.Expr): string | null {
    const u = unparen(e);
    if (u?.type === 'NameExpr') { const b = this.sc.refOf.get(u); return !b || b.kind === 'global' ? u.name : null; }
    if (u?.type === 'MemberExpr') { const o = this.globalName(u.obj); return o ? o + '.' + u.name : null; }
    return null;
  }
  /** can this call yield several values? */
  mayMulti(e: A.Expr): boolean {
    const u = unparen(e);
    if (u.type === 'VarargLit') return true;
    if (u.type === 'MethodCallExpr') return ['find', 'match', 'gsub', 'byte'].includes(u.method);
    if (u.type !== 'CallExpr') return false;
    const f = this.calleeFn(u.callee); if (f) return this.multiFns.has(f);
    const g = this.globalName(u.callee); if (g) return MULTI_LIB.has(g) || (g === 'string.byte' && u.args.length >= 3);
    return false;
  }
  isMultiPos(e: A.Expr | undefined): boolean { const u = e && unparen(e); return !!u && e!.type !== 'ParenExpr' && (u.type === 'CallExpr' || u.type === 'MethodCallExpr' || u.type === 'VarargLit'); }
  /** expression in multi-value position -> python starred expression */
  star(e: A.Expr): string { const u = unparen(e); if (u.type === 'VarargLit') return '*varargs'; return '*spread(' + this.raw(u)[0] + ')'; }
  list(es: A.Expr[]): string[] { return es.map((e, i) => i === es.length - 1 && this.isMultiPos(e) ? this.star(e) : this.ex(e)[0]); }

  isBool(e: A.Expr): boolean {
    const u = unparen(e);
    if (u.type === 'TrueLit' || u.type === 'FalseLit') return true;
    if (u.type === 'UnExpr' && u.op === 'not') return true;
    if (u.type === 'BinExpr') { if (['==', '~=', '<', '<=', '>', '>='].includes(u.op)) return true; if (u.op === 'and' || u.op === 'or') return this.isBool(u.left) && this.isBool(u.right); }
    return false;
  }
  /** python truthiness == lua truthiness for this expression's value */
  safeTruth(e: A.Expr): boolean {
    const u = unparen(e);
    if (this.isBool(u) || u.type === 'NilLit' || u.type === 'TableExpr' || u.type === 'FunctionExpr') return true;
    if (u.type === 'NumberLit') return u.value !== 0;
    if (u.type === 'StringLit') return u.value.length > 0;
    if (u.type === 'BinExpr' && (u.op === 'and' || u.op === 'or')) return this.safeTruth(u.left) && this.safeTruth(u.right);
    return false;
  }
  cond(e: A.Expr): string { return this.safeTruth(e) ? this.ex(e)[0] : 'truthy(' + this.ex(e)[0] + ')'; }
  simple(e: A.Expr): boolean { const u = unparen(e); return ['NameExpr', 'NumberLit', 'StringLit', 'NilLit', 'TrueLit', 'FalseLit', 'VarargLit'].includes(u.type) && !(u.type === 'NameExpr' && this.isGlobalLookup(u)); }
  isGlobalLookup(n: A.NameExpr): boolean { const b = this.sc.refOf.get(n); return (!b || b.kind === 'global') && !GLOBAL_MAP[n.name]; }

  /** single-value expression */
  ex(e: A.Expr): PE {
    const r = this.raw(e);
    const u = unparen(e);
    if ((u.type === 'CallExpr' || u.type === 'MethodCallExpr') && this.mayMulti(u)) return ['first(' + r[0] + ')', P.atom];
    return r;
  }
  name(n: A.NameExpr): string {
    const b = this.sc.refOf.get(n);
    if (b && b.kind !== 'global') return this.nameOf(b);
    if (GLOBAL_MAP[n.name]) return GLOBAL_MAP[n.name];
    return 'G[' + pyStr(n.name) + ']';
  }
  raw(e: A.Expr): PE {
    switch (e.type) {
      case 'NilLit': return ['None', P.atom];
      case 'TrueLit': return ['True', P.atom];
      case 'FalseLit': return ['False', P.atom];
      case 'NumberLit': return [pyNum(e.value), e.value < 0 ? P.unary : P.atom];
      case 'StringLit': return [pyStr(e.value), P.atom];
      case 'VarargLit': return ['(varargs[0] if varargs else None)', P.atom];
      case 'NameExpr': return [this.name(e), P.atom];
      case 'ParenExpr': return this.ex(e.expr);
      case 'MemberExpr': {
        const g = this.globalName(e.obj);
        if (g && LIBS.has(g)) return [GLOBAL_MAP[g] + '.' + e.name, P.atom];
        return [par(this.ex(e.obj), P.atom) + '[' + pyStr(e.name) + ']', P.atom];
      }
      case 'IndexExpr': return [par(this.ex(e.obj), P.atom) + '[' + this.ex(e.index)[0] + ']', P.atom];
      case 'CallExpr': return [par(this.ex(e.callee), P.atom) + '(' + this.list(e.args).join(', ') + ')', P.atom];
      case 'MethodCallExpr': return ['invoke(' + [this.ex(e.obj)[0], pyStr(e.method), ...this.list(e.args)].join(', ') + ')', P.atom];
      case 'FunctionExpr': { const nm = this.fresh('_fn' + (++this.fnCount)); this.func(nm, e, true); return [nm, P.atom]; }
      case 'TableExpr': return [this.table(e), P.atom];
      case 'UnExpr': {
        if (e.op === '-') return ['-' + par(this.ex(e.expr), P.unary), P.unary];
        if (e.op === 'not') return this.safeTruth(e.expr) ? ['not ' + par(this.ex(e.expr), P.not), P.not] : ['not truthy(' + this.ex(e.expr)[0] + ')', P.not];
        if (e.op === '#') return ['lua_len(' + this.ex(e.expr)[0] + ')', P.atom];
        if (e.op === '~') return ['~int(' + this.ex(e.expr)[0] + ')', P.unary];
        this.warnings.push('unknown unary ' + e.op); return [e.op + par(this.ex(e.expr), P.unary), P.unary];
      }
      case 'BinExpr': return this.bin(e);
      case 'InterpExpr': return ['concat(' + e.parts.map(p => p.kind === 'str' ? pyStr(p.value) : 'tostring(' + this.ex(p.expr)[0] + ')').join(', ') + ')', P.atom];
    }
    this.warnings.push('unsupported expression ' + (e as any).type);
    return ['None', P.atom];
  }
  bin(e: A.BinExpr): PE {
    const op = e.op;
    if (op === '..') {
      const parts: A.Expr[] = [];
      const flat = (x: A.Expr) => { const u = x.type === 'BinExpr' ? x : null; if (u && u.op === '..') { flat(u.left); flat(u.right); } else parts.push(x); };
      flat(e);
      return ['concat(' + parts.map(p => this.ex(p)[0]).join(', ') + ')', P.atom];
    }
    if (op === 'and' || op === 'or') {
      if (this.safeTruth(e.left)) {
        const p = op === 'and' ? P.and : P.or;
        return [par(this.ex(e.left), p) + ' ' + op + ' ' + par(this.ex(e.right), p + 1), p];
      }
      const l = this.ex(e.left)[0], r = this.ex(e.right)[0];
      if (this.simple(e.left)) return [op === 'and' ? `${r} if truthy(${l}) else ${l}` : `${l} if truthy(${l}) else ${r}`, P.cond];
      const t = this.temp();
      return [op === 'and' ? `${r} if truthy(${t} := ${l}) else ${t}` : `${t} if truthy(${t} := ${l}) else ${r}`, P.cond];
    }
    const cmp: Record<string, string> = { '==': '==', '~=': '!=', '<': '<', '<=': '<=', '>': '>', '>=': '>=' };
    if (cmp[op]) return [par(this.ex(e.left), P.cmp + 1) + ' ' + cmp[op] + ' ' + par(this.ex(e.right), P.cmp + 1), P.cmp];
    const fn: Record<string, string> = { '/': 'lua_div', '%': 'lua_mod', '^': 'lua_pow', '//': 'lua_idiv' };
    if (fn[op]) return [fn[op] + '(' + this.ex(e.left)[0] + ', ' + this.ex(e.right)[0] + ')', P.atom];
    const arith: Record<string, number> = { '+': P.add, '-': P.add, '*': P.mul };
    if (arith[op]) { const p = arith[op]; return [par(this.ex(e.left), p) + ' ' + op + ' ' + par(this.ex(e.right), p + 1), p]; }
    const bits: Record<string, [string, number]> = { '&': ['&', P.band], '|': ['|', P.bor], '~': ['^', P.bxor], '<<': ['<<', P.shift], '>>': ['>>', P.shift] };
    if (bits[op]) { const [o, p] = bits[op]; return ['int(' + this.ex(e.left)[0] + ') ' + o + ' int(' + this.ex(e.right)[0] + ')', p]; }
    this.warnings.push('unknown operator ' + op);
    return ['(' + this.ex(e.left)[0] + ' ' + op + ' ' + this.ex(e.right)[0] + ')', P.atom];
  }
  table(e: A.TableExpr): string {
    const arr: string[] = [], hash: string[] = [];
    e.fields.forEach((f, i) => {
      if (f.kind === 'item') arr.push(i === e.fields.length - 1 && this.isMultiPos(f.value) ? this.star(f.value) : this.ex(f.value)[0]);
      else if (f.kind === 'named') hash.push(pyStr(f.name!) + ': ' + this.ex(f.value)[0]);
      else hash.push(this.ex(f.key!)[0] + ': ' + this.ex(f.value)[0]);
    });
    if (!arr.length && !hash.length) return 'T()';
    if (!hash.length) return 'T([' + arr.join(', ') + '])';
    return 'T(' + (arr.length ? '[' + arr.join(', ') + ']' : 'None') + ', {' + hash.join(', ') + '})';
  }
EOF
echo ok

cat >> /data/prism/packages/core/src/transpile/python.ts <<'EOF'

  // -------------------------------------------------------- statements --
  lvalue(t: A.Expr): string {
    if (t.type === 'NameExpr') { const b = this.sc.refOf.get(t); return b && b.kind !== 'global' ? this.nameOf(b) : 'G[' + pyStr(t.name) + ']'; }
    if (t.type === 'MemberExpr') return par(this.ex(t.obj), P.atom) + '[' + pyStr(t.name) + ']';
    if (t.type === 'IndexExpr') return par(this.ex(t.obj), P.atom) + '[' + this.ex(t.index)[0] + ']';
    if (t.type === 'ParenExpr') return this.lvalue(t.expr);
    this.warnings.push('unsupported assignment target ' + t.type);
    return '_drop';
  }
  assign(targets: string[], values: A.Expr[]) {
    const n = targets.length;
    if (!values.length) { this.line(targets.join(', ') + ' = ' + (n === 1 ? 'None' : targets.map(() => 'None').join(', '))); return; }
    if (n === 1 && values.length === 1) { this.line(targets[0] + ' = ' + this.ex(values[0])[0]); return; }
    const last = values[values.length - 1];
    if (values.length < n && this.isMultiPos(last)) { this.line(targets.join(', ') + ' = adj(' + n + ', ' + this.list(values).join(', ') + ')'); return; }
    const vs = values.map(v => this.ex(v)[0]);
    while (vs.length < n) vs.push('None');
    if (vs.length > n) { this.line(targets.join(', ') + ', *_drop = ' + vs.join(', ')); return; }
    this.line(targets.join(', ') + ' = ' + vs.join(', '));
  }
  func(name: string, f: A.FunctionExpr, hoisted: boolean) {
    const saveOut = this.out, savePre = this.pre;
    this.out = []; this.pre = [];
    const ps = this.bindingsOf(f);
    const params = f.params.map((p, i) => (ps[i] ? this.nameOf(ps[i]) : this.fresh(p)) + '=None');
    params.push(f.vararg ? '*varargs' : '*_rest');
    this.line('def ' + name + '(' + params.join(', ') + '):');
    this.depth++;
    const nl: string[] = [], gl: string[] = [];
    for (const b of this.sc.bindings) if (b.kind !== 'global' && b.fn !== f && b.writeFns.has(f)) (this.moduleLevel.has(b) ? gl : nl).push(this.nameOf(b));
    if (gl.length) this.line('global ' + [...new Set(gl)].join(', '));
    if (nl.length) this.line('nonlocal ' + [...new Set(nl)].join(', '));
    const n0 = this.out.length;
    for (const s of f.body) this.stat(s);
    if (this.pre.length) { this.out.push(...this.pre); this.pre = []; }
    if (this.out.length === n0) this.line('pass');
    this.depth--;
    const lines = this.out;
    this.out = saveOut; this.pre = savePre;
    if (hoisted) this.pre.push(...lines);
    else { this.out.push(...this.pre); this.pre = []; this.out.push(...lines); }
  }
  stat(s: A.Stat) {
    switch (s.type) {
      case 'LocalStat': {
        const bs = this.bindingsOf(s);
        const names = s.names.map((nm, i) => bs[i] ? this.nameOf(bs[i]) : this.fresh(nm));
        if (names.length === 1 && s.init.length === 1 && s.init[0].type === 'FunctionExpr') { this.func(names[0], s.init[0], false); return; }
        this.assign(names, s.init); return;
      }
      case 'LocalFunctionStat': { const b = this.bindingsOf(s)[0]; this.func(b ? this.nameOf(b) : this.fresh(s.name), s.func, false); return; }
      case 'FunctionStat': {
        const t = s.target;
        if (t.type === 'NameExpr') { const b = this.sc.refOf.get(t); if (b && b.kind !== 'global') { this.func(this.nameOf(b), s.func, false); return; } }
        const nm = this.fresh(t.type === 'MemberExpr' ? t.name : t.type === 'NameExpr' ? t.name : 'fn');
        this.func(nm, s.func, false);
        this.line(this.lvalue(t) + ' = ' + nm);
        return;
      }
      case 'AssignStat': {
        const ts = s.targets.map(t => this.lvalue(t));
        if (s.op) { const v = this.ex({ type: 'BinExpr', op: s.op, left: s.targets[0], right: s.values[0] } as A.BinExpr)[0]; this.line(ts[0] + ' = ' + v); return; }
        this.assign(ts, s.values); return;

/** transpile a whole chunk (wrapped in main(*varargs)) */
export function luaToPython(src: string, opts: PyOptions = {}): PyResult {
  const { chunk, errors } = parse(src);
  const em = new PyEmitter(chunk);
  em.used.add('_rest'); em.used.add('_drop');
  if (errors.length) em.warnings.push(`source has ${errors.length} parse error(s); first: ${errors[0].message} @L${errors[0].line}`);
  em.out.push('def main(*varargs):');
  em.depth = 1;
  const n0 = em.out.length;
  for (const s of chunk.body) em.stat(s);
  if (em.pre.length) { em.out.push(...em.pre); em.pre = []; }
  if (em.out.length === n0) em.out.push('    pass');
  em.out.push('', '', "if __name__ == '__main__':", '    main()');
  const header = opts.prelude === false ? '' : PY_PRELUDE + '\n\n';
  return { code: header + em.out.join('\n') + '\n', warnings: em.warnings, freeNames: [] };
}

-- deserializer-style code: byte reader with upvalue position, varint, floats, nested tables
local data = "\5\0\0\0hello\2\1\42\3\255\255\255\255\4\0\0\0\0\0\0\240\63"
local pos = 1
local function u8()
  local b = data:byte(pos)
  pos = pos + 1
  return b
end
local function u32()
  local a, b, c, d = data:byte(pos, pos + 3)
  pos = pos + 4
  return a + b * 256 + c * 65536 + d * 16777216
end
local function str()
  local n = u32()
  local s = data:sub(pos, pos + n - 1)
  pos = pos + n
  return s
end
local function f64()
  local lo, hi = u32(), u32()
  local sign = hi >= 2 ^ 31 and -1 or 1
  local e = math.floor(hi / 2 ^ 20) % 2048
  local m = (hi % 2 ^ 20) * 2 ^ 32 + lo
  if e == 0 then return sign * m * 2 ^ -1074 end
  return sign * (1 + m / 2 ^ 52) * 2 ^ (e - 1023)
end

export interface PyFunctionResult extends PyResult { name: string; line: number; deps: string[]; }

/** transpile one function (by name, callgraph id or a line inside it) plus the local
 *  helper functions / literal upvalues it depends on, as standalone Python. */
export function functionToPython(src: string, query: string | number, opts: PyOptions = {}): PyFunctionResult | null {
  const { chunk } = parse(src);
  const em = new PyEmitter(chunk);
  em.used.add('_rest'); em.used.add('_drop');
  // index every function expression with its declaring statement / binding
  interface FnSite { f: A.FunctionExpr; line: number; endLine: number; name: string; binding?: Binding; stat?: A.Stat; }
  const sites: FnSite[] = [];
  const visit = (n: any, stat?: any) => {
    if (!n || typeof n !== 'object') return;
    if (Array.isArray(n)) { n.forEach(x => visit(x, stat)); return; }
    if (n.type === 'FunctionExpr') {
      let name = '<anonymous>', binding: Binding | undefined;
      if (stat?.type === 'LocalFunctionStat' && stat.func === n) { binding = em.bindingsOf(stat)[0]; name = stat.name; }
      else if (stat?.type === 'LocalStat' && stat.init.length === 1 && stat.init[0] === n && stat.names.length === 1) { binding = em.bindingsOf(stat)[0]; name = stat.names[0]; }
      else if (stat?.type === 'FunctionStat' && stat.func === n) { const t = stat.target; name = t.type === 'NameExpr' ? t.name : t.type === 'MemberExpr' ? t.name : name; if (t.type === 'NameExpr') { const b = em.sc.refOf.get(t); if (b && b.kind !== 'global') binding = b; } }
      sites.push({ f: n, line: n.loc?.line ?? 0, endLine: n.loc?.endLine ?? n.loc?.line ?? 0, name, binding, stat });
    }
    const isStat = typeof n.type === 'string' && /Stat$/.test(n.type);
    for (const k of Object.keys(n)) if (k !== 'loc') visit(n[k], isStat ? n : stat);
  };
  visit(chunk);
  let site: FnSite | undefined;
  const q = String(query);
  if (/^\d+$/.test(q)) {
    const line = Number(q);
    for (const s of sites) if (s.line <= line && line <= s.endLine && (!site || s.endLine - s.line < site.endLine - site.line)) site = s;
  } else site = sites.find(s => s.name === q) ?? sites.find(s => s.binding && em.nameOf(s.binding) === q);
  if (!site) return null;

  const inner = (f: A.FunctionExpr) => { const set = new Set<any>(); const v = (n: any) => { if (!n || typeof n !== 'object') return; if (Array.isArray(n)) { n.forEach(v); return; } if (n.type === 'FunctionExpr') set.add(n); for (const k of Object.keys(n)) if (k !== 'loc') v(n[k]); }; v(f); return set; };
  const freeOf = (node: any, own: Set<any>): Binding[] => {
    const out = new Set<Binding>();
    const v = (n: any) => { if (!n || typeof n !== 'object') return; if (Array.isArray(n)) { n.forEach(v); return; } if (n.type === 'NameExpr') { const b = em.sc.refOf.get(n); if (b && b.kind !== 'global' && !own.has(b.fn)) out.add(b); } for (const k of Object.keys(n)) if (k !== 'loc') v(n[k]); };
    v(node);
    return [...out];
  };
  const fnSites: FnSite[] = [site];
  const values: Array<{ b: Binding; init?: A.Expr }> = [];
  const seen = new Set<Binding>();
  if (site.binding) seen.add(site.binding);
  const work: Array<{ node: any; own: Set<any> }> = [{ node: site.f, own: inner(site.f) }];
  const isStaticInit = (e: A.Expr): boolean => {
    const u = unparen(e);
    if (['NumberLit', 'StringLit', 'NilLit', 'TrueLit', 'FalseLit'].includes(u.type)) return true;
    if (u.type === 'UnExpr') return isStaticInit(u.expr);
    if (u.type === 'BinExpr') return isStaticInit(u.left) && isStaticInit(u.right);
    if (u.type === 'TableExpr') return u.fields.every((f: A.TableField) => isStaticInit(f.value) && (!f.key || isStaticInit(f.key)));
    if (u.type === 'MemberExpr' || u.type === 'NameExpr') return !!em.globalName(u);
    if (u.type === 'CallExpr') { const g = em.globalName(u.callee); return !!g && /^(string|math|bit32|table)\./.test(g) && u.args.every(isStaticInit); }
    return false;
  };
  while (work.length) {
    const { node, own } = work.pop()!;
    for (const b of freeOf(node, own)) {
      if (seen.has(b)) continue;
      seen.add(b);
      em.moduleLevel.add(b);
      const ds = sites.find(s => s.binding === b && (b.kind === 'localfn' || b.writes === 0));
      if (ds) { fnSites.push(ds); work.push({ node: ds.f, own: inner(ds.f) }); continue; }
      if (b.init && b.writes === 0 && isStaticInit(b.init)) { values.push({ b, init: b.init }); work.push({ node: b.init, own: new Set() }); }
      else values.push({ b });
    }
  }
  if (site.binding) em.moduleLevel.add(site.binding);
  for (const s of fnSites) if (s.binding) em.moduleLevel.add(s.binding);
  em.depth = 0;
  em.out.push('# ---- free variables (upvalues of the original script) ----');
  values.sort((a, b) => a.b.line - b.b.line);
  for (const { b, init } of values) {
    if (init) em.line(em.nameOf(b) + ' = ' + em.ex(init)[0] + '  # L' + b.line);
    else em.line(em.nameOf(b) + ' = None  # TODO: upvalue `' + b.name + '` (L' + b.line + ', written ' + b.writes + 'x) - set before calling');
  }
  if (!values.length) em.out.push('# (none)');
  em.out.push('');
  const deps: string[] = [];
  const ordered = [...fnSites.slice(1)].sort((a, b) => a.line - b.line);
  ordered.push(site);
  for (const s of ordered) {
    const nm = s.binding ? em.nameOf(s.binding) : em.fresh(s.name === '<anonymous>' ? 'fn_L' + s.line : s.name);
    if (s !== site) deps.push(nm);
    em.out.push('');
    em.func(nm, s.f, false);
  }
  const target = site.binding ? em.nameOf(site.binding) : em.out.find(l => l.startsWith('def '))?.slice(4).split('(')[0] ?? 'fn';
  em.out.push('', '', "if __name__ == '__main__':", `    # example: lua_print(${target}(...))`, '    pass');
  const header = opts.prelude === false ? '' : PY_PRELUDE + '\n\n';
  return { code: header + em.out.join('\n') + '\n', warnings: em.warnings, freeNames: values.filter(v => !v.init).map(v => em.nameOf(v.b)), name: target, line: site.line, deps };
}
EOF

// PRISM blob lab — byte-level decoding toolkit for embedded payloads
// (constant pools, bytecode strings, key schedules). Pure TS, browser + node.
export type Bytes = Uint8Array;

export const latin1 = (s: string): Bytes => { const b = new Uint8Array(s.length); for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) b[i] = s.charCodeAt(i) & 255; return b; };
export const unlatin1 = (b: Bytes): string => { let s = ''; for (let i = 0; i < b.length; i += 8192) s += String.fromCharCode(...b.subarray(i, i + 8192)); return s; };
export const utf8 = (s: string): Bytes => new TextEncoder().encode(s);

export const STD_B64 = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/';

export function b64decode(s: string, alphabet = STD_B64, pad = '='): Bytes {
  const map = new Map<string, number>();
  for (let i = 0; i < alphabet.length; i++) map.set(alphabet[i], i);
  const out: number[] = [];
  let bits = 0, n = 0;
  for (const ch of s) {
    if (ch === pad) break;
    const v = map.get(ch);
    if (v === undefined) continue;
    bits = (bits << 6) | v; n += 6;
    if (n >= 8) { n -= 8; out.push((bits >> n) & 255); }
  }
  return Uint8Array.from(out);
}
export function b64encode(b: Bytes, alphabet = STD_B64): string {
  let s = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < b.length; i += 3) {
    const n = (b[i] << 16) | ((b[i + 1] ?? 0) << 8) | (b[i + 2] ?? 0);
    s += alphabet[(n >> 18) & 63] + alphabet[(n >> 12) & 63] + (i + 1 < b.length ? alphabet[(n >> 6) & 63] : '=') + (i + 2 < b.length ? alphabet[n & 63] : '=');
  }
  return s;
}
export function hexdecode(s: string): Bytes {
  const h = s.replace(/0x/gi, '').replace(/[^0-9a-fA-F]/g, '');
  const out = new Uint8Array(h.length >> 1);
  for (let i = 0; i < out.length; i++) out[i] = parseInt(h.substr(i * 2, 2), 16);
  return out;
}
export const hexencode = (b: Bytes, sep = ''): string => Array.from(b, x => x.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join(sep);

/** Lua string-literal escapes: \ddd \xNN \n \t \\ \" \u{...} \z */
export function luaUnescape(s: string): Bytes {
  let t = s.trim();
  if ((t.startsWith('"') && t.endsWith('"')) || (t.startsWith("'") && t.endsWith("'"))) t = t.slice(1, -1);
  const out: number[] = [];
  const simple: Record<string, number> = { n: 10, t: 9, r: 13, a: 7, b: 8, f: 12, v: 11, '\\': 92, '"': 34, "'": 39, '\n': 10 };
  for (let i = 0; i < t.length; i++) {
    const c = t[i];
    if (c !== '\\') { const code = t.charCodeAt(i); if (code < 128) out.push(code); else for (const x of utf8(c)) out.push(x); continue; }
    const d = t[++i];
    if (d === undefined) break;
    if (/[0-9]/.test(d)) { let num = d; while (num.length < 3 && /[0-9]/.test(t[i + 1] ?? '')) num += t[++i]; out.push(Number(num) & 255); }
    else if (d === 'x') { out.push(parseInt(t.substr(i + 1, 2), 16) & 255); i += 2; }
    else if (d === 'u' && t[i + 1] === '{') { const e = t.indexOf('}', i); for (const x of utf8(String.fromCodePoint(parseInt(t.slice(i + 2, e), 16)))) out.push(x); i = e; }
    else if (d === 'z') { while (/\s/.test(t[i + 1] ?? '')) i++; }
    else out.push(simple[d] ?? d.charCodeAt(0));
  }
  return Uint8Array.from(out);
}
/** "12, 34, 0x56" / "{12,34}" -> bytes (values masked to 8 bits) */
export function decList(s: string): Bytes {
  const m = s.match(/-?(0x[0-9a-fA-F]+|\d+)/g) ?? [];
  return Uint8Array.from(m.map(x => Number(x) & 255));
}
export function xorBytes(b: Bytes, key: Bytes): Bytes { if (!key.length) return b.slice(); const o = new Uint8Array(b.length); for (let i = 0; i < b.length; i++) o[i] = b[i] ^ key[i % key.length]; return o; }
export function addBytes(b: Bytes, key: Bytes, sign = 1): Bytes { if (!key.length) return b.slice(); const o = new Uint8Array(b.length); for (let i = 0; i < b.length; i++) o[i] = (b[i] + sign * key[i % key.length]) & 255; return o; }

/** IronBrew-style compressor: base36 length-prefixed LZW codes over a 256-char dictionary */
export function lzwBase36(s: string): Bytes {
  let pos = 0;
  const next = (): number => { const len = parseInt(s[pos], 36); pos++; const v = parseInt(s.substr(pos, len), 36); pos += len; return v; };
  const dict: string[] = []; for (let i = 0; i < 256; i++) dict[i] = String.fromCharCode(i);
  let size = 256;
  let w = String.fromCharCode(next());
  const out: string[] = [w];

    const k = next();
    if (isNaN(k)) break;
    const entry = dict[k] !== undefined ? dict[k] : k === size ? w + w[0] : null;
    if (entry === null) break;
    out.push(entry);
    dict[size++] = w + entry[0];
    w = entry;
  }
  return latin1(out.join(''));
}
/** classic LZW over byte codes (code width grows 9..16 bits, LSB-first) */
export function lzwBits(b: Bytes): Bytes {

    const k = read(); if (k < 0) break;
    const e = dict[k] ?? (k === size && prev ? [...prev, prev[0]] : null);
    if (!e) break;
    out.push(...e);
    if (prev) { dict[size++] = [...prev, e[0]]; if (size >= (1 << width) && width < 16) width++; }
    prev = e;
  }

}

export function entropyBytes(b: Bytes): number {

export function detectMagic(b: Bytes): string[] {

  if (at(0, 0x1b, 0x4c, 0x75, 0x61)) out.push('Lua bytecode ' + (b[4] === 0x51 ? '5.1' : b[4] === 0x52 ? '5.2' : b[4] === 0x53 ? '5.3' : b[4] === 0x54 ? '5.4' : '0x' + b[4]?.toString(16)));

  if (at(0, 0x1f, 0x8b)) out.push('gzip');

export interface BlobStep { op: string; arg?: string; }
export const BLOB_OPS: Record<string, { label: string; arg?: string; run: (b: Bytes, arg: string) => Bytes }> = {
  'lua-unescape': { label: 'Lua string escapes → bytes', run: b => luaUnescape(unlatin1(b)) },
  'base64': { label: 'Base64 decode (arg: custom 64-char alphabet)', arg: 'alphabet', run: (b, a) => b64decode(unlatin1(b), a && a.length >= 64 ? a.slice(0, 64) : STD_B64) },
  'base64-encode': { label: 'Base64 encode', run: b => latin1(b64encode(b)) },
  'hex': { label: 'Hex decode', run: b => hexdecode(unlatin1(b)) },
  'hex-encode': { label: 'Hex encode', run: b => latin1(hexencode(b)) },
  'declist': { label: 'Decimal list → bytes', run: b => decList(unlatin1(b)) },
  'xor': { label: 'XOR with key (arg: number, 0xNN, hex:.. or text)', arg: 'key', run: (b, a) => xorBytes(b, parseKey(a)) },
  'add': { label: 'Add key bytes (mod 256)', arg: 'key', run: (b, a) => addBytes(b, parseKey(a), 1) },
  'sub': { label: 'Subtract key bytes (mod 256)', arg: 'key', run: (b, a) => addBytes(b, parseKey(a), -1) },
  'reverse': { label: 'Reverse bytes', run: b => b.slice().reverse() },
  'lzw-base36': { label: 'LZW decompress (IronBrew base36 codes)', run: b => lzwBase36(unlatin1(b)) },
  'lzw-bits': { label: 'LZW decompress (9..16-bit codes)', run: b => lzwBits(b) },
  'slice': { label: 'Slice (arg: start[:end], 0-based)', arg: 'start:end', run: (b, a) => { const [s, e] = (a || '0').split(':').map(Number); return b.slice(s || 0, isNaN(e) ? undefined : e); } },
  'strip-ws': { label: 'Remove whitespace', run: b => b.filter(x => x !== 32 && x !== 9 && x !== 10 && x !== 13) },

export function parseKey(a: string | undefined): Bytes {
  if (!a) return new Uint8Array();

  if (/^(0x[0-9a-f]+|\d+)(\s*,\s*(0x[0-9a-f]+|\d+))*$/i.test(t)) return Uint8Array.from(t.split(',').map(x => Number(x.trim()) & 255));

export function runBlob(input: Bytes, steps: BlobStep[]): { out: Bytes; trace: Array<{ op: string; len: number; error?: string }> } {
  let cur = input; const trace: Array<{ op: string; len: number; error?: string }> = [];
  for (const s of steps) {
    const op = BLOB_OPS[s.op];
    if (!op) { trace.push({ op: s.op, len: cur.length, error: 'unknown op' }); break; }
    try { cur = op.run(cur, s.arg ?? ''); trace.push({ op: s.op, len: cur.length }); } catch (e: any) { trace.push({ op: s.op, len: cur.length, error: String(e?.message ?? e) }); break; }
  }
  return { out: cur, trace };
}

/** single-byte XOR brute force ranked by English/Lua-ish plaintext score */
export function xorSingleCandidates(b: Bytes, top = 5): Array<{ key: number; score: number; preview: string }> {
  const sample = b.subarray(0, 4096);
  const res: Array<{ key: number; score: number; preview: string }> = [];
  for (let k = 0; k < 256; k++) {
    let s = 0;
    for (const x of sample) { const c = x ^ k; if (c >= 97 && c <= 122) s += 3; else if (c === 32) s += 4; else if (c >= 65 && c <= 90) s += 2; else if (c >= 48 && c <= 57) s += 1.5; else if (c >= 32 && c < 127) s += 1; else if (c === 10 || c === 9) s += 1; else s -= 3; }
    res.push({ key: k, score: Math.round(s / sample.length * 100) / 100, preview: unlatin1(xorBytes(sample.subarray(0, 64), Uint8Array.of(k))).replace(/[^\x20-\x7e]/g, '.') });
  }
  return res.sort((a, c) => c.score - a.score).slice(0, top);
}
/** repeating-key XOR key length estimate (normalized Hamming distance) */
export function xorKeyLengths(b: Bytes, maxLen = 32): Array<{ len: number; dist: number }> {
  const out: Array<{ len: number; dist: number }> = [];
  const pop = (x: number) => { let c = 0; while (x) { c += x & 1; x >>= 1; } return c; };
  for (let L = 2; L <= Math.min(maxLen, b.length >> 2); L++) {
    let d = 0, n = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i + 2 * L <= Math.min(b.length, 4096); i += L) { for (let j = 0; j < L; j++) d += pop(b[i + j] ^ b[i + L + j]); n += L; }
    if (n) out.push({ len: L, dist: Math.round(d / n * 1000) / 1000 });
  }

}
/** recover a repeating XOR key from known plaintext at offset */
export function xorKnownPlaintext(b: Bytes, plain: Bytes, offset = 0): Bytes { const k = new Uint8Array(plain.length); for (let i = 0; i < plain.length; i++) k[i] = b[offset + i] ^ plain[i]; return k; }

/** try common decodings of a text/bytes blob and rank the results */
export function autoDecode(input: Bytes): Array<{ steps: BlobStep[]; len: number; printable: number; entropy: number; magic: string[]; preview: string }> {
  const s = unlatin1(input).trim();
  const tries: BlobStep[][] = [[]];
  if (/\\(\d{1,3}|x[0-9a-fA-F]{2})/.test(s)) tries.push([{ op: 'lua-unescape' }]);
  if (/^[0-9a-fA-F\s]+$/.test(s) && s.replace(/\s/g, '').length % 2 === 0) tries.push([{ op: 'hex' }]);
  if (/^[A-Za-z0-9+/=\s]+$/.test(s) && s.length >= 8) tries.push([{ op: 'base64' }]);
  if (/^\s*[{(]?\s*-?\d+(\s*[,;]\s*-?\d+){3,}/.test(s)) tries.push([{ op: 'declist' }]);
  if (/^[0-9A-Za-z]+$/.test(s) && s.length > 16 && !isNaN(parseInt(s[0], 36))) tries.push([{ op: 'lzw-base36' }]);
  // unique-char 64+ alphabets embedded in the text are tried by the caller with an explicit alphabet
  const out = [];
  for (const steps of tries) {
    try {
      const { out: b, trace } = runBlob(input, steps);
      if (trace.some(t => t.error) || (steps.length && !b.length)) continue;
      out.push({ steps, len: b.length, printable: printableBytes(b), entropy: entropyBytes(b), magic: detectMagic(b), preview: unlatin1(b.subarray(0, 96)).replace(/[^\x20-\x7e]/g, '.') });
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) => (b.magic.length - a.magic.length) || (b.printable - a.printable));
}

export const asPythonBytes = (b: Bytes): string => "b'" + Array.from(b, x => x === 92 ? '\\\\' : x === 39 ? "\\'" : x >= 32 && x < 127 ? String.fromCharCode(x) : '\\x' + x.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('') + "'";
export const asLuaString = (b: Bytes): string => '"' + Array.from(b, x => x === 92 ? '\\\\' : x === 34 ? '\\"' : x >= 32 && x < 127 ? String.fromCharCode(x) : '\\' + x).join('') + '"';
export const asCArray = (b: Bytes): string => '{ ' + Array.from(b, x => '0x' + x.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join(', ') + ' }';
export const asLuaTable = (b: Bytes): string => '{' + Array.from(b).join(',') + '}';

class Reader {

    const proto: LuauProto = { id: p, maxStack, numParams, numUpvalues, isVararg, flags, typeInfo, code, consts, children, lineDefined, debugName };
    if (r.u8()) {
      const gap = r.u8();
      const intervals = ((ncode - 1) >> gap) + 1;
      const deltas: number[] = []; let last = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < ncode; i++) { last = (last + r.u8()) & 255; deltas.push(last); }
      const abs: number[] = []; for (let i = 0; i < intervals; i++) abs.push(r.i32());
      proto.lineInfo = deltas.map((d, i) => abs[i >> gap] + d);
    }
    if (r.u8()) {
      const nl = r.varint(); proto.locals = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < nl; i++) proto.locals.push({ name: sref(r.varint()) ?? '?', startPc: r.varint(), endPc: r.varint(), reg: r.u8() });
      const nu = r.varint(); proto.upvalueNames = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < nu; i++) proto.upvalueNames.push(sref(r.varint()) ?? '?');
    }
    protos.push(proto);
  }
  const main = r.varint();
  // resolve import paths
  for (const p of protos) for (const k of p.consts) if (k.type === 'import') {
    const n = k.id >>> 30; const ids = [(k.id >>> 20) & 1023, (k.id >>> 10) & 1023, k.id & 1023].slice(0, n);
    k.path = ids.map(i => { const c = p.consts[i]; return c && c.type === 'string' ? c.value : '?'; }).join('.');
  }
  // opcode encoding: main chunks start with PREPVARARGS (65); Roblox stores op*227
  let encoding: 'plain' | 'roblox' = opts.encoding === 'roblox' ? 'roblox' : 'plain';
  if (opts.encoding !== 'plain' && opts.encoding !== 'roblox') {
    const m = protos[main];
    const first = m?.code[0] & 255;
    if (first === ((OP.PREPVARARGS * 227) & 255)) encoding = 'roblox';
    else if (first !== OP.PREPVARARGS) {
      // fall back to counting invalid opcodes under each interpretation
      let badPlain = 0, badRbx = 0;
      for (const p of protos) for (const ins of p.code.slice(0, 200)) { if ((ins & 255) >= LUAU_OPS.length) badPlain++; if ((((ins & 255) * 203) & 255) >= LUAU_OPS.length) badRbx++; }
      if (badRbx < badPlain) encoding = 'roblox';
    }
  }
  if (encoding === 'roblox') for (const p of protos) p.code = p.code.map(ins => (ins & ~255) | (((ins & 255) * 203) & 255));
  return { version, typesVersion, strings, protos, main, encoding, userdataTypes };
}
EOF

  'FORNPREP', 'FORNLOOP', 'FORGPREP', 'FORGLOOP', 'FORGPREP_INEXT', 'FORGPREP_NEXT', 'JUMPBACK', 'JUMPXEQKNIL', 'JUMPXEQKB', 'JUMPXEQKN',
  'JUMPXEQKS', 'CMPPROTO']);

const NOFALL_OPS = new Set(['RETURN', 'JUMP', 'JUMPBACK', 'JUMPX', 'FORGPREP', 'FORGPREP_NEXT', 'FORGPREP_INEXT']);

export const insC = (i: number) => (i >>> 24) & 255;

export interface LuauChunk {
  version: number; typesVersion: number; strings: string[]; protos: LuauProto[]; main: number;
  encoding: 'plain' | 'roblox'; userdataTypes?: string[]; trailing: number; warnings: string[];

cd /data/prism/packages/core/src/bytecode && cat >> luau.ts <<'EOF'

class Reader {
  pos = 0;
  constructor(public b: Uint8Array) {}
  need(n: number) { if (this.pos + n > this.b.length) throw new Error(`unexpected end of bytecode at byte ${this.pos} (need ${n})`); }
  u8() { this.need(1); return this.b[this.pos++]; }
  u32() { this.need(4); const p = this.pos; this.pos += 4; return (this.b[p] | (this.b[p + 1] << 8) | (this.b[p + 2] << 16) | (this.b[p + 3] << 24)) >>> 0; }
  i32() { return this.u32() | 0; }
  f64() { this.need(8); const v = new DataView(this.b.buffer, this.b.byteOffset + this.pos, 8).getFloat64(0, true); this.pos += 8; return v; }
  f32() { this.need(4); const v = new DataView(this.b.buffer, this.b.byteOffset + this.pos, 4).getFloat32(0, true); this.pos += 4; return v; }
  varint() { let r = 0, s = 0, b: number; do { b = this.u8(); r += (b & 127) * 2 ** s; s += 7; } while (b & 128 && s < 63); return r; }
  varint64() { let r = 0n, s = 0n, b: number; do { b = this.u8(); r |= BigInt(b & 127) << s; s += 7n; } while (b & 128 && s < 70n); return r; }
  bytes(n: number) { this.need(n); const s = this.b.subarray(this.pos, this.pos + n); this.pos += n; return s; }
}
const latin1 = (b: Uint8Array) => { let s = ''; for (let i = 0; i < b.length; i += 8192) s += String.fromCharCode(...b.subarray(i, i + 8192)); return s; };

/** Decode the opcode byte of every instruction word (AUX words untouched). */
function decodeOps(code: number[], map: (op: number) => number) {
  const out = code.slice();
  for (let pc = 0; pc < out.length;) {
    const op = map(out[pc] & 255);
    out[pc] = ((out[pc] & ~255) | op) >>> 0;
    pc += opLength(op);
  }
  return out;
}
function invalidOps(protos: LuauProto[], map: (op: number) => number) {
  let bad = 0, total = 0;
  for (const p of protos) for (let pc = 0; pc < p.code.length && total < 4000;) {
    const op = map(p.code[pc] & 255); total++;
    if (op >= LUAU_OPS.length || op === LUAU_OP.NATIVECALL) bad++;
    pc += opLength(op < LUAU_OPS.length ? op : 0);
  }
  return bad;
}
export const robloxDecodeOp = (op: number) => (op * 203) & 255;
export const robloxEncodeOp = (op: number) => (op * 227) & 255;

export function parseLuauBytecode(bytes: Uint8Array, opts: { encoding?: 'auto' | 'plain' | 'roblox' } = {}): LuauChunk {
  const r = new Reader(bytes);
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  const version = r.u8();
  if (version === 0) throw new Error('bytecode contains a compile error: ' + latin1(bytes.subarray(1)));
  if ((version < 3 || version > 14) && version !== 100) throw new Error('unsupported Luau bytecode version ' + version + ' (expected 3..14)');
  const typesVersion = version >= 4 ? r.u8() : 0;
  if (version >= 4 && (typesVersion < 1 || typesVersion > 3)) warnings.push('unexpected types version ' + typesVersion);
  const nstr = r.varint();
  if (nstr > bytes.length) throw new Error('string count ' + nstr + ' exceeds input size — not Luau bytecode?');
  const strings: string[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < nstr; i++) strings.push(latin1(r.bytes(r.varint())));
  const sref = (i: number) => i === 0 ? null : strings[i - 1] ?? `<str#${i}>`;
  let userdataTypes: string[] | undefined;
  if (typesVersion === 3) { userdataTypes = []; let idx = r.u8(); while (idx !== 0) { userdataTypes.push(sref(r.varint()) ?? '?'); idx = r.u8(); } }
  const nproto = r.varint();
  if (nproto > bytes.length) throw new Error('proto count ' + nproto + ' exceeds input size');
  const protos: LuauProto[] = [];
  for (let p = 0; p < nproto; p++) {
    const protoSize = version >= 12 ? r.varint() : 0;
    const start = r.pos;
    const maxStack = r.u8(), numParams = r.u8(), numUpvalues = r.u8(), isVararg = r.u8() !== 0;
    let flags = 0, typeInfo: number[] = [];
    if (version >= 4) { flags = r.u8(); const n = r.varint(); typeInfo = Array.from(r.bytes(n)); }
    const ncode = r.varint();
    if (ncode * 4 > bytes.length) throw new Error(`proto ${p}: code size ${ncode} exceeds input`);
    const code: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < ncode; i++) code.push(r.u32());
    const nk = r.varint();
    if (nk > bytes.length) throw new Error(`proto ${p}: constant count ${nk} exceeds input`);
    const consts: LuauConst[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < nk; i++) {
      const t = r.u8();
      switch (t) {
        case 0: consts.push({ type: 'nil' }); break;
        case 1: consts.push({ type: 'boolean', value: r.u8() !== 0 }); break;
        case 2: consts.push({ type: 'number', value: r.f64() }); break;
        case 3: consts.push({ type: 'string', value: sref(r.varint()) ?? '' }); break;
        case 4: consts.push({ type: 'import', id: r.u32(), path: '' }); break;
        case 5: { const n = r.varint(); const keys: number[] = []; for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) keys.push(r.varint()); consts.push({ type: 'table', keys }); break; }
        case 6: consts.push({ type: 'closure', proto: r.varint() }); break;
        case 7: consts.push({ type: 'vector', value: [r.f32(), r.f32(), r.f32(), r.f32()] }); break;
        case 8: { const n = r.varint(); const keys: number[] = [], values: number[] = []; for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) { keys.push(r.varint()); values.push(r.i32()); } consts.push({ type: 'table', keys, values }); break; }
        case 9: { const neg = r.u8() !== 0; const mag = r.varint64(); consts.push({ type: 'integer', value: BigInt.asIntN(64, neg ? -mag : mag) }); break; }
        case 10: {
          const name = r.varint(); const privateFields = r.u8(), privateMethods = r.u8();
          const nprops = r.varint(), nmeth = r.varint();
          const fields: number[] = [], methods: number[] = [];
          for (let j = 0; j < nprops - privateFields; j++) fields.push(r.varint());
          for (let j = 0; j < nmeth - privateMethods; j++) methods.push(r.varint());
          consts.push({ type: 'class', name, fields, methods, privateFields, privateMethods }); break;
        }
        case 11: consts.push({ type: 'vector', value: [r.f64(), r.f64(), r.f64(), r.f64()] }); break;
        default: throw new Error(`unknown constant type ${t} (proto ${p}, K${i}, byte ${r.pos - 1})`);
      }
    }
    const np = r.varint();
    const children: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < np; i++) children.push(r.varint());
    const lineDefined = r.varint();
    const debugName = sref(r.varint());
    const proto: LuauProto = { id: p, maxStack, numParams, numUpvalues, isVararg, flags, typeInfo, code, consts, children, lineDefined, debugName, byteOffset: start, byteLength: 0 };
    if (r.u8()) {
      const gap = r.u8();
      const intervals = ((ncode - 1) >> gap) + 1;
      const deltas: number[] = []; let last = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < ncode; i++) { last = (last + r.u8()) & 255; deltas.push(last); }
      const abs: number[] = []; let line = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < intervals; i++) { line = (line + r.i32()) | 0; abs.push(line); }
      proto.lineInfo = deltas.map((d, i) => abs[i >> gap] + d);
    }
    if (r.u8()) {
      const nl = r.varint(); proto.locals = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < nl; i++) proto.locals.push({ name: sref(r.varint()) ?? '?', startPc: r.varint(), endPc: r.varint(), reg: r.u8() });
      const nu = r.varint(); proto.upvalueNames = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < nu; i++) proto.upvalueNames.push(sref(r.varint()) ?? '?');
    }
    if (version >= 11 && version !== 100 || version === 100) {
      const nfb = r.varint(); proto.feedback = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < nfb; i++) { const kind = r.u8(); proto.feedback.push({ kind, value: kind <= 1 ? r.varint() : 0 }); }
    }
    if (version >= 12 && (flags & 8)) proto.cost = Number(r.varint64());
    if (version >= 12) {
      if (r.pos > start + protoSize) warnings.push(`proto ${p}: parsed past declared size (${r.pos - start} > ${protoSize})`);
      r.pos = start + protoSize;
    }
    proto.byteLength = r.pos - start;
    protos.push(proto);
  }
  const main = r.varint();
  if (main >= protos.length) throw new Error('main proto id ' + main + ' out of range');
  const trailing = bytes.length - r.pos;
  if (trailing) warnings.push(trailing + ' trailing bytes after bytecode');
  // resolve import paths
  for (const p of protos) for (const k of p.consts) if (k.type === 'import') {
    const n = k.id >>> 30; const ids = [(k.id >>> 20) & 1023, (k.id >>> 10) & 1023, k.id & 1023].slice(0, n);
    k.path = ids.map(i => { const c = p.consts[i]; return c && c.type === 'string' ? c.value : '?'; }).join('.');
  }
  // opcode encoding: main chunk always starts with PREPVARARGS; Roblox stores op*227 (mod 256)
  let encoding: 'plain' | 'roblox' = opts.encoding === 'roblox' ? 'roblox' : 'plain';
  if (opts.encoding !== 'plain' && opts.encoding !== 'roblox') {
    const first = protos[main].code[0] & 255;
    if (first === robloxEncodeOp(LUAU_OP.PREPVARARGS)) encoding = 'roblox';
    else if (first !== LUAU_OP.PREPVARARGS && invalidOps(protos, robloxDecodeOp) < invalidOps(protos, x => x)) encoding = 'roblox';
  }
  if (encoding === 'roblox') for (const p of protos) p.code = decodeOps(p.code, robloxDecodeOp);
  return { version, typesVersion, strings, protos, main, encoding, userdataTypes, trailing, warnings };
}

/** Heuristic: does this byte string look like Luau bytecode? */
export function looksLikeLuauBytecode(bytes: Uint8Array): boolean {
  if (bytes.length < 8) return false;
  const v = bytes[0];
  if (!((v >= 3 && v <= 14) || v === 100)) return false;
  try { parseLuauBytecode(bytes); return true; } catch { return false; }
}
