// ───────────────────────────── disassembler ─────────────────────────────
/** printf("%.17g")-compatible number formatting (luau-compile style). */
export function fmtG(v: number, p = 17): string {
  if (Number.isNaN(v)) return 'nan';
  if (!Number.isFinite(v)) return v > 0 ? 'inf' : '-inf';
  if (v === 0) return Object.is(v, -0) ? '-0' : '0';
  const [mant, expS] = v.toExponential(p - 1).split('e');
  const x = parseInt(expS, 10);
  const trim = (t: string) => t.includes('.') ? t.replace(/0+$/, '').replace(/\.$/, '') : t;
  if (x < -4 || x >= p) return trim(mant) + 'e' + (x < 0 ? '-' : '+') + String(Math.abs(x)).padStart(2, '0');
  return trim(v.toFixed(Math.max(0, p - 1 - x)));
}
const IDENT = /^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/;
const KEYWORDS = new Set('and break do else elseif end false for function if in local nil not or repeat return then true until while continue'.split(' '));
export function luaQuote(s: string, max = Infinity): string {
  let out = '"';
  const n = Math.min(s.length, max);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const c = s.charCodeAt(i);
    if (c === 34) out += '\\"'; else if (c === 92) out += '\\\\';
    else if (c === 10) out += '\\n'; else if (c === 13) out += '\\r'; else if (c === 9) out += '\\t';
    else if (c < 32 || c === 127 || c > 255) out += '\\' + c;
    else if (c >= 128) out += '\\x' + c.toString(16).padStart(2, '0');
    else out += s[i];
  }
  out += '"';
  if (s.length > n) out += `…(${s.length} bytes)`;
  return out;
}

export interface LuauInsn {
  pc: number; opcode: number; op: string; raw: number; aux?: number;
  a: number; b: number; c: number; d: number; e: number;
  target: number; label?: number; line?: number;
  /** luau-compile compatible operand text, e.g. "LOADK R1 K0 ['x']" */
  asm: string;
  /** pseudo-Lua meaning of the instruction */
  lua: string;
}
export interface LuauDisasmOptions {
  /** 'rich' (default): pc, labels, constants, pseudo-Lua comments. 'luau': mimic `luau-compile --text` (no source lines). */
  style?: 'rich' | 'luau';
  hex?: boolean; lift?: boolean; constants?: boolean; debug?: boolean;
  /** only these proto ids */
  protos?: number[];
  maxInsns?: number;
}

export function fmtLuauConst(chunk: LuauChunk, p: LuauProto, k: number, style: 'rich' | 'luau' = 'rich'): string {
  const c = p.consts[k];
  if (!c) return `<K${k}?>`;
  switch (c.type) {
    case 'nil': return 'nil';
    case 'boolean': return String(c.value);
    case 'number': return style === 'luau' ? fmtG(c.value) : (Object.is(c.value, -0) ? '-0' : String(c.value));
    case 'integer': return c.value.toString() + (style === 'rich' ? 'i' : '');
    case 'vector': {
      const v = c.value[3] === 0 ? c.value.slice(0, 3) : c.value;
      return style === 'luau' ? v.map(x => fmtG(x, 9)).join(', ') : `vector(${v.join(', ')})`;
    }
    case 'string': {
      if (style === 'rich') return luaQuote(c.value, 120);
      const s = c.value; let out = "'";
      for (let i = 0; i < s.length && i < 32; i++) { const ch = s.charCodeAt(i); out += ch < 32 ? '\\x' + ch.toString(16).toUpperCase().padStart(2, '0') : s[i]; }
      return out + (s.length >= 32 ? "'..." : "'");
    }
    case 'import': return c.path;
    case 'table': {
      if (style === 'luau') return '{...}';
      return '{' + c.keys.map((key, i) => {
        const kc = p.consts[key]; const kn = kc?.type === 'string' && IDENT.test(kc.value) && !KEYWORDS.has(kc.value) ? kc.value : '[' + fmtLuauConst(chunk, p, key, style) + ']';
        const v = c.values && c.values[i] >= 0 ? fmtLuauConst(chunk, p, c.values[i], style) : '_';
        return kn + ' = ' + v;
      }).join(', ') + '}';
    }
    case 'closure': {
      const name = chunk.protos[c.proto]?.debugName;
      return style === 'luau' ? (name ? `'${name}'` : '') : `function<P${c.proto}${name ? ' ' + name : ''}>`;
    }
    case 'class': {
      const nm = p.consts[c.name]; const n = nm?.type === 'string' ? nm.value : '?';
      return `class ${n} (public fields: ${c.fields.length}, public methods: ${c.methods.length}, private fields: ${c.privateFields}, private methods: ${c.privateMethods})`;
    }
  }
}

/** Decode every instruction of a proto with luau-style asm text and a pseudo-Lua reading. */
export function decodeLuauProto(chunk: LuauChunk, p: LuauProto, style: 'rich' | 'luau' = 'rich'): LuauInsn[] {
  const code = p.code;
  const labels = new Map<number, number>();
  const targets: number[] = [];
  for (let pc = 0; pc < code.length;) {
    const t = jumpTarget(code[pc], pc);
    if (t >= 0 && t < code.length) targets.push(t);
    pc += opLength(code[pc] & 255);
  }
  [...new Set(targets)].sort((x, y) => x - y).forEach((t, i) => labels.set(t, i));
  const K = (k: number) => fmtLuauConst(chunk, p, k, style);
  const KR = (k: number) => fmtLuauConst(chunk, p, k, 'rich');
  const local = (r: number, pc: number) => {
    if (p.locals) for (const l of p.locals) if (l.reg === r && l.startPc <= pc && pc < l.endPc) return l.name;
    return null;
  };
  const out: LuauInsn[] = [];
  for (let pc = 0; pc < code.length;) {
    const raw = code[pc] >>> 0, opcode = raw & 255, op = opName(opcode);
    const len = opLength(opcode);
    const aux = len === 2 ? code[pc + 1] >>> 0 : undefined;
    const A = insA(raw), B = insB(raw), C = insC(raw), D = insD(raw), E = insE(raw);
    const target = jumpTarget(raw, pc);
    const L = target >= 0 ? `L${labels.get(target) ?? '?'}` : 'L?';
    const R = (r: number) => local(r, pc) ?? `R${r}`;
    const U = (u: number) => p.upvalueNames?.[u] ?? `U${u}`;
    const field = (k: number) => { const c = p.consts[k]; return c?.type === 'string' && IDENT.test(c.value) && !KEYWORDS.has(c.value) ? '.' + c.value : '[' + KR(k) + ']'; };
    const range = (from: number, n: number) => n <= 0 ? '' : Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => R(from + i)).join(', ');
    const args = (from: number, nb: number) => nb === 0 ? `${R(from)}, ...` : range(from, nb - 1);
    const rets = (from: number, nc: number) => nc === 0 ? `${R(from)}, ... = ` : nc === 1 ? '' : range(from, nc - 1) + ' = ';
    let asm = op, lua = '';
    const ar = (sym: string) => { asm = `${op} R${A} R${B} R${C}`; lua = `${R(A)} = ${R(B)} ${sym} ${R(C)}`; };
    const ak = (sym: string) => { asm = `${op} R${A} R${B} K${C} [${K(C)}]`; lua = `${R(A)} = ${R(B)} ${sym} ${KR(C)}`; };
    const cmp = (sym: string, neg: boolean) => { asm = `${op} R${A} R${aux} ${L}`; lua = `if ${neg ? 'not (' : ''}${R(A)} ${sym} ${R(aux!)}${neg ? ')' : ''} then goto ${L}`; };
    const not = aux !== undefined && aux >>> 31 ? ' NOT' : '';
    switch (op) {
      case 'NOP': asm = 'NOP'; lua = '-- nop'; break;
      case 'BREAK': asm = 'BREAK'; lua = '-- debugger break'; break;
      case 'LOADNIL': asm = `LOADNIL R${A}`; lua = `${R(A)} = nil`; break;
      case 'LOADB': asm = C ? `LOADB R${A} ${B} +${C}` : `LOADB R${A} ${B}`; lua = `${R(A)} = ${B ? 'true' : 'false'}${C ? `; goto ${L}` : ''}`; break;
      case 'LOADN': asm = `LOADN R${A} ${D}`; lua = `${R(A)} = ${D}`; break;
      case 'LOADK': asm = `LOADK R${A} K${D} [${K(D)}]`; lua = `${R(A)} = ${KR(D)}`; break;
      case 'MOVE': asm = `MOVE R${A} R${B}`; lua = `${R(A)} = ${R(B)}`; break;
      case 'GETGLOBAL': asm = `GETGLOBAL R${A} K${aux} [${K(aux!)}]`; lua = `${R(A)} = ${globalName(p, aux!)}`; break;
      case 'SETGLOBAL': asm = `SETGLOBAL R${A} K${aux} [${K(aux!)}]`; lua = `${globalName(p, aux!)} = ${R(A)}`; break;
      case 'GETUPVAL': asm = `GETUPVAL R${A} U${B}`; lua = `${R(A)} = ${U(B)}`; break;
      case 'SETUPVAL': asm = `SETUPVAL R${A} U${B}`; lua = `${U(B)} = ${R(A)}`; break;
      case 'CLOSEUPVALS': asm = `CLOSEUPVALS R${A}`; lua = `-- close upvalues >= ${R(A)}`; break;
      case 'GETIMPORT': asm = `GETIMPORT R${A} ${D} [${K(D)}]`; lua = `${R(A)} = ${K(D) || 'import(' + aux + ')'}`; break;
      case 'GETTABLE': asm = `GETTABLE R${A} R${B} R${C}`; lua = `${R(A)} = ${R(B)}[${R(C)}]`; break;
      case 'SETTABLE': asm = `SETTABLE R${A} R${B} R${C}`; lua = `${R(B)}[${R(C)}] = ${R(A)}`; break;
      case 'GETTABLEKS': case 'GETUDATAKS': { const k = op === 'GETUDATAKS' ? aux! & 0xffff : aux!; asm = `${op} R${A} R${B} K${k} [${K(k)}]`; lua = `${R(A)} = ${R(B)}${field(k)}`; break; }
      case 'SETTABLEKS': case 'SETUDATAKS': { const k = op === 'SETUDATAKS' ? aux! & 0xffff : aux!; asm = `${op} R${A} R${B} K${k} [${K(k)}]`; lua = `${R(B)}${field(k)} = ${R(A)}`; break; }
      case 'GETTABLEN': asm = `GETTABLEN R${A} R${B} ${C + 1}`; lua = `${R(A)} = ${R(B)}[${C + 1}]`; break;
      case 'SETTABLEN': asm = `SETTABLEN R${A} R${B} ${C + 1}`; lua = `${R(B)}[${C + 1}] = ${R(A)}`; break;
      case 'NEWCLOSURE': { const id = p.children[D]; const nm = chunk.protos[id]?.debugName; asm = `NEWCLOSURE R${A} P${D}`; lua = `${R(A)} = function<P${id ?? '?'}${nm ? ' ' + nm : ''}>`; break; }
      case 'NAMECALL': case 'NAMECALLUDATA': { const k = op === 'NAMECALLUDATA' ? aux! & 0xffff : aux!; asm = `${op} R${A} R${B} K${k} [${K(k)}]`; lua = `${R(A + 1)} = ${R(B)}; ${R(A)} = ${R(B)}${field(k)}  -- ${R(B)}:${p.consts[k]?.type === 'string' ? (p.consts[k] as { value: string }).value : '?'}(...)`; break; }
      case 'CALL': asm = `CALL R${A} ${B - 1} ${C - 1}`; lua = `${rets(A, C)}${R(A)}(${args(A + 1, B)})`; break;
      case 'CALLFB': asm = `CALLFB R${A} ${B - 1} ${C - 1} [${aux! | 0}]`; lua = `${rets(A, C)}${R(A)}(${args(A + 1, B)})`; break;
      case 'RETURN': asm = `RETURN R${A} ${B - 1}`; lua = B === 0 ? `return ${R(A)}, ...` : `return ${range(A, B - 1)}`.trimEnd(); break;
      case 'JUMP': case 'JUMPBACK': case 'JUMPX': asm = `${op} ${L}`; lua = `goto ${L}`; break;
      case 'JUMPIF': asm = `JUMPIF R${A} ${L}`; lua = `if ${R(A)} then goto ${L}`; break;
      case 'JUMPIFNOT': asm = `JUMPIFNOT R${A} ${L}`; lua = `if not ${R(A)} then goto ${L}`; break;
      case 'JUMPIFEQ': cmp('==', false); break; case 'JUMPIFLE': cmp('<=', false); break; case 'JUMPIFLT': cmp('<', false); break;
      case 'JUMPIFNOTEQ': cmp('~=', false); break; case 'JUMPIFNOTLE': cmp('<=', true); break; case 'JUMPIFNOTLT': cmp('<', true); break;
      case 'ADD': ar('+'); break; case 'SUB': ar('-'); break; case 'MUL': ar('*'); break; case 'DIV': ar('/'); break;
      case 'IDIV': ar('//'); break; case 'MOD': ar('%'); break; case 'POW': ar('^'); break;
      case 'ADDK': ak('+'); break; case 'SUBK': ak('-'); break; case 'MULK': ak('*'); break; case 'DIVK': ak('/'); break;
      case 'IDIVK': ak('//'); break; case 'MODK': ak('%'); break; case 'POWK': ak('^'); break;
      case 'SUBRK': case 'DIVRK': asm = `${op} R${A} K${B} [${K(B)}] R${C}`; lua = `${R(A)} = ${KR(B)} ${op === 'SUBRK' ? '-' : '/'} ${R(C)}`; break;
      case 'AND': ar('and'); break; case 'OR': ar('or'); break;
      case 'ANDK': ak('and'); break; case 'ORK': ak('or'); break;
      case 'CONCAT': asm = `CONCAT R${A} R${B} R${C}`; lua = `${R(A)} = ${Array.from({ length: Math.max(1, C - B + 1) }, (_, i) => R(B + i)).join(' .. ')}`; break;
      case 'NOT': asm = `NOT R${A} R${B}`; lua = `${R(A)} = not ${R(B)}`; break;
      case 'MINUS': asm = `MINUS R${A} R${B}`; lua = `${R(A)} = -${R(B)}`; break;
      case 'LENGTH': asm = `LENGTH R${A} R${B}`; lua = `${R(A)} = #${R(B)}`; break;
      case 'NEWTABLE': asm = `NEWTABLE R${A} ${B === 0 ? 0 : 1 << (B - 1)} ${aux}`; lua = `${R(A)} = {}  -- hash ${B === 0 ? 0 : 1 << (B - 1)}, array ${aux}`; break;
      case 'DUPTABLE': asm = `DUPTABLE R${A} ${D}`; lua = `${R(A)} = ${KR(D)}`; break;
      case 'SETLIST': asm = `SETLIST R${A} R${B} ${C - 1} [${aux}]`; lua = C === 0 ? `${R(A)}[${aux}...] = ${R(B)}, ...` : `${R(A)}[${aux}..${aux! + C - 2}] = ${range(B, C - 1)}`; break;
      case 'FORNPREP': asm = `FORNPREP R${A} ${L}`; lua = `for ${R(A + 2)} = ${R(A + 2)}, ${R(A)}, ${R(A + 1)} do  -- exit: ${L}`; break;
      case 'FORNLOOP': asm = `FORNLOOP R${A} ${L}`; lua = `${R(A + 2)} += ${R(A + 1)}; if ${R(A + 2)} <= ${R(A)} then goto ${L}`; break;
      case 'FORGPREP': case 'FORGPREP_NEXT': case 'FORGPREP_INEXT': asm = `${op} R${A} ${L}`; lua = `for ... in ${R(A)}, ${R(A + 1)}, ${R(A + 2)} do  -- ${op === 'FORGPREP_NEXT' ? 'pairs/next' : op === 'FORGPREP_INEXT' ? 'ipairs' : 'generic'}; goto ${L}`; break;
      case 'FORGLOOP': { const n = aux! & 255; asm = `FORGLOOP R${A} ${L} ${n}${(aux! | 0) < 0 ? ' [inext]' : ''}`; lua = `${range(A + 3, n)} = ${R(A)}(${R(A + 1)}, ${R(A + 2)}); if ${R(A + 3)} ~= nil then goto ${L}`; break; }
      case 'GETVARARGS': asm = `GETVARARGS R${A} ${B - 1}`; lua = B === 0 ? `${R(A)}, ... = ...` : `${range(A, B - 1)} = ...`; break;
      case 'DUPCLOSURE': asm = `DUPCLOSURE R${A} K${D} [${K(D)}]`; lua = `${R(A)} = ${KR(D)}`; break;
      case 'PREPVARARGS': asm = `PREPVARARGS ${A}`; lua = `-- vararg function, ${A} fixed params`; break;
      case 'LOADKX': asm = `LOADKX R${A} K${aux} [${K(aux!)}]`; lua = `${R(A)} = ${KR(aux!)}`; break;
      case 'FASTCALL': asm = `FASTCALL ${A} ${L}`; lua = `-- fastcall ${LUAU_BUILTINS[A] ?? A}(...) → ${L}`; break;
      case 'FASTCALL1': asm = `FASTCALL1 ${A} R${B} ${L}`; lua = `-- fastcall ${LUAU_BUILTINS[A] ?? A}(${R(B)}) → ${L}`; break;
      case 'FASTCALL2': asm = `FASTCALL2 ${A} R${B} R${aux} ${L}`; lua = `-- fastcall ${LUAU_BUILTINS[A] ?? A}(${R(B)}, ${R(aux!)}) → ${L}`; break;
      case 'FASTCALL2K': asm = `FASTCALL2K ${A} R${B} K${aux} ${L} [${K(aux!)}]`; lua = `-- fastcall ${LUAU_BUILTINS[A] ?? A}(${R(B)}, ${KR(aux!)}) → ${L}`; break;
      case 'FASTCALL3': asm = `FASTCALL3 ${A} R${B} R${aux! & 255} R${(aux! >> 8) & 255} ${L}`; lua = `-- fastcall ${LUAU_BUILTINS[A] ?? A}(${R(B)}, ${R(aux! & 255)}, ${R((aux! >> 8) & 255)}) → ${L}`; break;
      case 'FASTPCALL': asm = `FASTPCALL ${A === 0 ? 'pcall' : 'xpcall'} ${L}`; lua = `-- fast ${A === 0 ? 'pcall' : 'xpcall'} (${B} args) → ${L}`; break;
      case 'COVERAGE': asm = 'COVERAGE'; lua = '-- coverage'; break;
      case 'CAPTURE': { const t = A === 0 ? 'VAL' : A === 1 ? 'REF' : A === 2 ? 'UPVAL' : ''; asm = `CAPTURE ${t} ${A === 2 ? 'U' : 'R'}${B}`; lua = `-- capture ${t.toLowerCase()} ${A === 2 ? U(B) : R(B)}`; break; }
      case 'JUMPXEQKNIL': asm = `JUMPXEQKNIL R${A} ${L}${not}`; lua = `if ${R(A)} ${not ? '~=' : '=='} nil then goto ${L}`; break;
      case 'JUMPXEQKB': asm = `JUMPXEQKB R${A} ${aux! & 1} ${L}${not}`; lua = `if ${R(A)} ${not ? '~=' : '=='} ${aux! & 1 ? 'true' : 'false'} then goto ${L}`; break;
      case 'JUMPXEQKN': case 'JUMPXEQKS': { const k = aux! & 0xffffff; asm = `${op} R${A} K${k} ${L}${not} [${K(k)}]`; lua = `if ${R(A)} ${not ? '~=' : '=='} ${KR(k)} then goto ${L}`; break; }
      case 'CMPPROTO': asm = `CMPPROTO R${A} #${aux} ${L}`; lua = `if not (${R(A)} is closure of P${aux}) then goto ${L}`; break;

', flags: ' + flags.join(' ') : ''}`);

    }

    let lastLine = -1;
    for (const i of insns) {
      if (budget-- <= 0) { lines.push('; … truncated (maxInsns)'); break; }
      if (i.label !== undefined) lines.push(`L${i.label}:`);
      let s = '  ' + String(i.pc).padStart(4, '0');
      if (opts.hex) s += '  ' + hex8(i.raw) + (i.aux !== undefined ? ' ' + hex8(i.aux) : '         ');

export interface Lua51Insn { pc: number; raw: number; opcode: number; op: string; a: number; b: number; c: number; bx: number; sbx: number; target: number; line?: number; label?: number; asm: string; lua: string; data?: boolean }
const fmt14 = (v: number) => {
  // printf("%.14g")
  if (Number.isNaN(v)) return v.toString() === 'NaN' ? 'nan' : 'nan';
  if (!Number.isFinite(v)) return v > 0 ? 'inf' : '-inf';
  if (v === 0) return Object.is(v, -0) ? '-0' : '0';
  const [m, e] = v.toExponential(13).split('e'); const x = parseInt(e, 10);
  const trim = (t: string) => t.includes('.') ? t.replace(/0+$/, '').replace(/\.$/, '') : t;
  if (x < -4 || x >= 14) return trim(m) + 'e' + (x < 0 ? '-' : '+') + String(Math.abs(x)).padStart(2, '0');
  return trim(v.toFixed(Math.max(0, 13 - x)));
};
const isprint = (c: number) => c >= 32 && c < 127;
export function luacString(s: string) {
  let o = '"';
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
    const c = s.charCodeAt(i);
    const esc: Record<number, string> = { 34: '\\"', 92: '\\\\', 7: '\\a', 8: '\\b', 12: '\\f', 10: '\\n', 13: '\\r', 9: '\\t', 11: '\\v' };

export function disassembleLua51(chunk: Lua51Chunk, opts: { style?: 'rich' | 'luac'; hex?: boolean; lift?: boolean; constants?: boolean } = {}): string {
  const style = opts.style ?? 'rich'; const lift = opts.lift ?? true;
  const out: string[] = [];
  if (style === 'rich') {
    out.push(`; PRISM Lua 5.1 disassembly — ${chunk.littleEndian ? 'little' : 'big'}-endian, int ${chunk.sizeInt}, size_t ${chunk.sizeSizeT}, number ${chunk.sizeNumber}${chunk.integral ? ' (integral)' : ''}`);
    out.push(`; ${chunk.all.length} functions${chunk.trailing ? `, ${chunk.trailing} trailing bytes` : ''}`, '');
  }
  for (const p of chunk.all) {
    const insns = decodeLua51Proto(p, style);
    if (style === 'luac') {
      out.push(`${p.lineDefined === 0 ? 'main' : 'function'} <${p.lineDefined},${p.lastLineDefined}> (${p.code.length} instructions)`);
      for (const i of insns) if (!i.data) out.push(`\t${i.pc + 1}\t${i.line ? `[${i.line}]` : '[-]'}\t${i.asm}`);
      out.push('');
      continue;
    }
    out.push(`; ${'─'.repeat(70)}`);
    out.push(`function P${p.path}${p.source ? ` <${p.source.replace(/^[@=]/, '')}:${p.lineDefined},${p.lastLineDefined}>` : ` <${p.lineDefined},${p.lastLineDefined}>`}`);
    out.push(`; params ${p.numParams}${p.isVararg ? ' + vararg' : ''}, upvalues ${p.numUpvalues}, maxstack ${p.maxStack}, ${p.code.length} instructions, ${p.consts.length} constants, ${p.protos.length} children`);
    if (p.upvalueNames.length) out.push('; upvalues: ' + p.upvalueNames.map((n, i) => `U${i}=${n}`).join(' '));
    if ((opts.constants ?? true) && p.consts.length) { out.push('; constants:'); p.consts.forEach((k, i) => out.push(`;   K${i} ${k.type.padEnd(7)} ${fmtLua51Const(k)}`)); }
    if (p.locals.length) out.push('; locals: ' + p.locals.map(l => `${l.name}@${l.startPc}-${l.endPc}`).join(' '));
    for (const i of insns) {
      if (i.label !== undefined) out.push(`L${i.label}:`);
      let s = '  ' + String(i.pc).padStart(4, '0');
      if (opts.hex) s += '  ' + i.raw.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');

// PRISM custom-VM disassembler: turn an extracted instruction list (JSON or Lua table literal)
// plus a user-editable opcode map into a readable listing. Works for any obfuscator VM.
import { parse } from '../parser';
import type * as A from '../ast';
import type { DispatchTree } from '../analysis/opcodes';

export interface OpEntry { name: string; lua?: string; args?: string; notes?: string }
export type OpMap = Record<string, OpEntry | string>;
export interface VmInsnIn { [k: string]: unknown }
export interface VmDisasmOptions {
  /** key/position of the opcode inside each instruction (auto: 'op' | 'opcode' | '1' | 0) */
  opField?: string | number;
  /** operand keys → letters, e.g. {"2":"A","3":"B","4":"C"} (auto: remaining keys in order → A,B,C,D…) */
  fields?: Record<string, string>;
  constants?: unknown[];
  /** index base of the constant table (Lua tables are usually 1-based) */
  kBase?: number;
  /** index base of instruction numbering for jump display */
  pcBase?: number;
  max?: number;
}
export interface VmDisasmResult { text: string; count: number; histogram: Array<{ op: string; name: string; count: number }>; unknown: string[]; fields: Record<string, string>; opField: string }

/** Static evaluation of a Lua literal (numbers, strings, booleans, nil, nested table constructors). */
export function luaLiteralToJson(src: string): unknown {
  const text = src.trim().replace(/^return\s+/, '');
  const { chunk } = parse('return ' + text);
  const st = chunk.body[0] as A.ReturnStat | undefined;
  if (!st || st.type !== 'ReturnStat' || st.args.length !== 1) throw new Error('expected a single Lua literal expression');
  const ev = (e: A.Expr): unknown => {
    switch (e.type) {
      case 'NumberLit': return e.value;
      case 'StringLit': return e.value;
      case 'BoolLit': return e.value;
      case 'NilLit': return null;
      case 'ParenExpr': return ev(e.expr);
      case 'UnExpr': if (e.op === '-') { const v = ev(e.expr); if (typeof v === 'number') return -v; } break;
      case 'TableExpr': {
        const arr: unknown[] = []; const obj: Record<string, unknown> = {}; let hasKeys = false;
        for (const it of e.items) {
          if (it.kind === 'pos') arr.push(ev(it.value));
          else { hasKeys = true; const k = it.kind === 'named' ? it.name : ev(it.key as A.Expr); obj[String(k)] = ev(it.value); }
        }
        if (!hasKeys) return arr;
        arr.forEach((v, i) => { obj[String(i + 1)] = v; });
        return obj;
      }
    }
    throw new Error(`non-literal expression at line ${(e as { loc?: { line: number } }).loc?.line ?? '?'} (${e.type}) — static literal evaluation only`);
  };
  return ev(st.args[0]);
}

export function opmapFromTree(tree: DispatchTree): Record<string, OpEntry> {
  const map: Record<string, OpEntry> = {};
  for (const h of tree.handlers) {
    const lua = h.lifted.split('\n').map(l => l.trim()).filter(l => l && !l.startsWith('--')).join(' ').replace(/;\s*/g, '; ').replace(/;\s*$/, '');
    for (const op of h.opcodes) map[String(op)] = { name: h.guess || `OP_${op}`, lua: lua.length > 200 ? lua.slice(0, 200) + '…' : lua };
  }
  return map;
}

const entry = (m: OpMap, op: string): OpEntry | null => { const e = m[op]; return e === undefined ? null : typeof e === 'string' ? { name: e } : e; };
const show = (v: unknown): string => typeof v === 'string' ? JSON.stringify(v).length > 60 ? JSON.stringify(v.slice(0, 50)) + '…' : JSON.stringify(v) : v === null || v === undefined ? 'nil' : typeof v === 'object' ? (Array.isArray(v) ? `{…${v.length}}` : '{…}') : String(v);

export function vmDisassemble(instructions: unknown[], opmap: OpMap = {}, opts: VmDisasmOptions = {}): VmDisasmResult {
  if (!Array.isArray(instructions)) throw new Error('instructions must be an array');
  const norm = instructions.map(ins => Array.isArray(ins) ? Object.fromEntries(ins.map((v, i) => [String(i), v])) : typeof ins === 'object' && ins !== null ? ins as VmInsnIn : { '0': ins });
  const keys = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const i of norm.slice(0, 500)) for (const k of Object.keys(i)) keys.set(k, (keys.get(k) ?? 0) + 1);
  const opField = opts.opField !== undefined ? String(opts.opField) : ['op', 'opcode', 'OP', 'Op', '1', '0'].find(k => keys.has(k)) ?? [...keys.keys()][0] ?? '0';
  let fields = opts.fields;
  if (!fields) {
    fields = {}; let li = 0; const letters = 'ABCDEFGHIJ';
    const ks = [...keys.keys()].filter(k => k !== opField).sort((a, b) => (+a - +b) || a.localeCompare(b));
    for (const k of ks) fields[k] = /^[A-Za-z]{1,3}$/.test(k) && !/^\d+$/.test(k) ? k : letters[li++] ?? k;
  }
  const kBase = opts.kBase ?? 1, pcBase = opts.pcBase ?? 1;
  const hist = new Map<string, number>(); const unknown = new Set<string>();
  const lines: string[] = [];
  const max = opts.max ?? Infinity;
  norm.forEach((ins, idx) => {
    if (idx >= max) return;
    const op = String(ins[opField]);
    hist.set(op, (hist.get(op) ?? 0) + 1);
    const e = entry(opmap, op);
    if (!e) unknown.add(op);
    const vals: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    for (const [k, letter] of Object.entries(fields!)) if (k in ins) vals[letter] = ins[k];
    const operands = Object.entries(vals).map(([l, v]) => `${l}=${show(v)}`).join(' ');
    let lua = e?.lua ?? '';
    if (lua) {
      lua = lua.replace(/\bK\[\s*([A-Z])\s*\]/g, (m, l) => {
        const v = vals[l]; if (typeof v !== 'number' || !opts.constants) return m.replace(l, show(v));
        return show(opts.constants[v - kBase]);
      }).replace(/\b([A-Z])\b/g, (m, l) => l in vals ? show(vals[l]) : m);
    }
    const name = e?.name ?? `OP_${op}`;
    let s = `${String(idx + pcBase).padStart(5, ' ')}  [${op.padStart(3)}] ${name.length > 28 ? name.slice(0, 27) + '…' : name.padEnd(28)} ${operands}`;
    if (lua) s = s.padEnd(78) + ' ; ' + lua;
    lines.push(s);
  });
  if (norm.length > max) lines.push(`; … ${norm.length - max} more instructions`);
  const histogram = [...hist].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).map(([op, count]) => ({ op, name: entry(opmap, op)?.name ?? `OP_${op}`, count }));
  const head = [`; PRISM custom-VM listing — ${norm.length} instructions, opcode field "${opField}", operands ${Object.entries(fields).map(([k, l]) => `${k}→${l}`).join(' ') || '(none)'}`];
  if (unknown.size) head.push(`; unmapped opcodes: ${[...unknown].sort((a, b) => +a - +b).join(' ')}`);
  return { text: head.join('\n') + '\n\n' + lines.join('\n'), count: norm.length, histogram, unknown: [...unknown], fields, opField };
}
EOF

// ───────────── bytecode, blobs, transpilers ─────────────
import { luaToPython, functionToPython } from './transpile/python.js';
import { parseLuauBytecode, disassembleLuau, summarizeLuau, decodeLuauProto, looksLikeLuauBytecode } from './bytecode/luau.js';
import type { LuauChunk, LuauDisasmOptions, LuauSummary } from './bytecode/luau.js';
import { parseLua51Bytecode, disassembleLua51, detectLuaBytecode } from './bytecode/lua51.js';
import type { Lua51Chunk } from './bytecode/lua51.js';
import { vmDisassemble, opmapFromTree, luaLiteralToJson } from './bytecode/customvm.js';
import type { OpMap, OpEntry, VmDisasmOptions, VmDisasmResult } from './bytecode/customvm.js';
import * as Blob from './blob/blob.js';
export * as Blob from './blob/blob.js';
export * as LuauBytecode from './bytecode/luau.js';
export * as Lua51Bytecode from './bytecode/lua51.js';
export { luaToPython, functionToPython, parseLuauBytecode, disassembleLuau, summarizeLuau, decodeLuauProto, looksLikeLuauBytecode, parseLua51Bytecode, disassembleLua51, detectLuaBytecode, vmDisassemble, opmapFromTree, luaLiteralToJson };
export type { LuauChunk, LuauDisasmOptions, LuauSummary, Lua51Chunk, OpMap, OpEntry, VmDisasmOptions, VmDisasmResult };

export interface BytecodeDisasm { format: 'luau' | 'lua51'; text: string; summary: Record<string, unknown>; }
/** Auto-detect Luau / Lua 5.1 bytecode and disassemble it (static parse only). */
export function disassembleBytecode(bytes: Uint8Array, opts: LuauDisasmOptions & { encoding?: 'auto' | 'plain' | 'roblox'; format?: 'auto' | 'luau' | 'lua51' } = {}): BytecodeDisasm {
  const fmt = opts.format ?? 'auto';
  if (fmt === 'lua51' || (fmt === 'auto' && detectLuaBytecode(bytes))) {
    const ch = parseLua51Bytecode(bytes);
    return { format: 'lua51', text: disassembleLua51(ch, { style: opts.style === 'luau' ? 'luac' : 'rich', hex: opts.hex, lift: opts.lift, constants: opts.constants }), summary: { functions: ch.all.length, littleEndian: ch.littleEndian, sizeNumber: ch.sizeNumber, trailing: ch.trailing, instructions: ch.all.reduce((n, p) => n + p.code.length, 0) } };
  }
  const ch = parseLuauBytecode(bytes, { encoding: opts.encoding });
  const s = summarizeLuau(ch);
  return { format: 'luau', text: disassembleLuau(ch, opts), summary: s as unknown as Record<string, unknown> };
}

export interface EmbeddedBytecode { line: number; via: string; format: string; length: number; preview: string; }
/** Scan every string literal (raw, and base64/hex decoded) for embedded Lua/Luau bytecode. */
export function findEmbeddedBytecode(src: string, opts: { max?: number } = {}): EmbeddedBytecode[] {
  const out: EmbeddedBytecode[] = [];
  const { tokens } = lex(src);
  for (const t of tokens) {
    if (t.type !== T.String || out.length >= (opts.max ?? 50)) continue;
    const v = (t as unknown as { value: string }).value ?? '';
    if (v.length < 12) continue;
    const cands: Array<[string, Uint8Array]> = [['raw', Blob.latin1(v)]];
    if (/^[A-Za-z0-9+/=\s]+$/.test(v) && v.length % 4 === 0) { try { cands.push(['base64', Blob.b64decode(v.replace(/\s+/g, ''))]); } catch { /* not base64 */ } }
    if (/^[0-9a-fA-F\s]+$/.test(v) && v.replace(/\s+/g, '').length % 2 === 0) { try { cands.push(['hex', Blob.hexdecode(v)]); } catch { /* not hex */ } }
    for (const [via, b] of cands) {
      const lua = detectLuaBytecode(b);
      const fmt = lua ? lua.lua + ' bytecode' : looksLikeLuauBytecode(b) ? `Luau bytecode v${b[0]}` : '';
      if (fmt) { out.push({ line: (t as unknown as { line: number }).line, via, format: fmt, length: b.length, preview: Blob.hexencode(b.subarray(0, 24), ' ') }); break; }
    }
  }
  return out;
}
EOF

cat > workspace.ts <<'EOF'
// PRISM workspace: everything an analyst (human or AI) produces lives on disk here.
//   scripts/<id>.lua + <id>.json   — imported / derived scripts with metadata + notes
//   opmaps/<name>.json             — custom opcode maps (editable mnemonics)
//   outputs/<name>                 — saved tool outputs (disassembly, python, reports…)
import { mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, readdirSync, existsSync, statSync, unlinkSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, resolve, basename } from 'node:path';
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';

export interface ScriptMeta {
  id: string; name: string; size: number; lines: number; sha1: string; created: string; updated: string;
  parent?: string; derivedBy?: string; tags: string[]; notes: string[];
}
const slug = (s: string) => s.toLowerCase().replace(/\.(lua|luau|txt)$/i, '').replace(/[^a-z0-9._-]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '').slice(0, 48) || 'script';
const safeName = (s: string) => { const b = basename(s).replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+/g, '_'); if (!b || b.startsWith('.')) throw new Error('invalid file name: ' + s); return b; };

export class Workspace {
  readonly root: string;
  constructor(root: string) {
    this.root = resolve(root);
    for (const d of ['scripts', 'opmaps', 'outputs']) mkdirSync(join(this.root, d), { recursive: true });
  }
  private p(...xs: string[]) { return join(this.root, ...xs); }
  listScripts(): ScriptMeta[] {
    return readdirSync(this.p('scripts')).filter(f => f.endsWith('.json')).map(f => { try { return JSON.parse(readFileSync(this.p('scripts', f), 'utf8')) as ScriptMeta; } catch { return null; } })
      .filter((m): m is ScriptMeta => !!m).sort((a, b) => a.created.localeCompare(b.created));
  }
  hasScript(id: string) { return existsSync(this.p('scripts', safeName(id) + '.lua')); }
  getMeta(id: string): ScriptMeta {
    const f = this.p('scripts', safeName(id) + '.json');
    if (!existsSync(f)) throw new Error(`unknown script_id "${id}" — use workspace_list to see stored scripts`);
    return JSON.parse(readFileSync(f, 'utf8'));
  }
  /** script text; latin1 keeps arbitrary bytes 1:1 (obfuscated files often contain raw bytes) */
  getScript(id: string): string {
    const f = this.p('scripts', safeName(id) + '.lua');
    if (!existsSync(f)) throw new Error(`unknown script_id "${id}" — use workspace_list to see stored scripts`);
    return readFileSync(f, 'latin1');
  }
  addScript(name: string, source: string, extra: Partial<ScriptMeta> = {}): ScriptMeta {
    const sha1 = createHash('sha1').update(Buffer.from(source, 'latin1')).digest('hex');
    let id = `${slug(name)}-${sha1.slice(0, 6)}`;
    for (let i = 2; this.hasScript(id) && this.getMeta(id).sha1 !== sha1; i++) id = `${slug(name)}-${sha1.slice(0, 6)}-${i}`;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const prev = this.hasScript(id) ? this.getMeta(id) : null;
    const meta: ScriptMeta = { id, name, size: source.length, lines: source.split('\n').length, sha1, created: prev?.created ?? now, updated: now, tags: prev?.tags ?? [], notes: prev?.notes ?? [], ...extra };
    writeFileSync(this.p('scripts', id + '.lua'), Buffer.from(source, 'latin1'));
    writeFileSync(this.p('scripts', id + '.json'), JSON.stringify(meta, null, 2));
    return meta;
  }
  updateMeta(id: string, patch: Partial<ScriptMeta>): ScriptMeta {
    const m = { ...this.getMeta(id), ...patch, updated: new Date().toISOString() };
    writeFileSync(this.p('scripts', safeName(id) + '.json'), JSON.stringify(m, null, 2));
    return m;
  }
  deleteScript(id: string) { for (const ext of ['.lua', '.json']) { const f = this.p('scripts', safeName(id) + ext); if (existsSync(f)) unlinkSync(f); } }
  listOpmaps(): string[] { return readdirSync(this.p('opmaps')).filter(f => f.endsWith('.json')).map(f => f.slice(0, -5)).sort(); }
  getOpmap(name: string): Record<string, unknown> {
    const f = this.p('opmaps', safeName(name) + '.json');
    if (!existsSync(f)) throw new Error(`unknown opmap "${name}" — available: ${this.listOpmaps().join(', ') || '(none)'}`);
    return JSON.parse(readFileSync(f, 'utf8'));
  }
  setOpmap(name: string, map: Record<string, unknown>) { writeFileSync(this.p('opmaps', safeName(name) + '.json'), JSON.stringify(map, null, 2)); return 'opmaps/' + safeName(name) + '.json'; }
  deleteOpmap(name: string) { const f = this.p('opmaps', safeName(name) + '.json'); if (existsSync(f)) unlinkSync(f); }
  listOutputs(): Array<{ name: string; size: number; modified: string }> {
    return readdirSync(this.p('outputs')).map(f => { const s = statSync(this.p('outputs', f)); return { name: f, size: s.size, modified: s.mtime.toISOString() }; }).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
  }
  saveOutput(name: string, content: string | Uint8Array): string {
    const n = safeName(name);
    writeFileSync(this.p('outputs', n), typeof content === 'string' ? content : Buffer.from(content));
    return 'outputs/' + n;
  }
  readOutput(name: string): Buffer {
    const f = this.p('outputs', safeName(name));
    if (!existsSync(f)) throw new Error(`unknown output "${name}"`);
    return readFileSync(f);
  }
  deleteOutput(name: string) { const f = this.p('outputs', safeName(name)); if (existsSync(f)) unlinkSync(f); }
  abs(rel: string) { return this.p(rel); }
}
EOF

import { z } from 'zod';
import { readFileSync, existsSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';
import { resolve, basename } from 'node:path';
import { Blob, lex, T } from '@prism/core';
import { decodeText } from './workspace.js';
import type { ToolContext } from './types.js';

export const SRC = {
  script_id: z.string().optional().describe('id of a script stored in the PRISM workspace (preferred for large files; see workspace_list)'),
  path: z.string().optional().describe('path of a Lua/Luau file on the PRISM host'),
  source: z.string().optional().describe('inline Lua/Luau source text'),
};
export const OUT = {
  max_chars: z.number().int().min(200).optional().describe('truncate the text result to this many characters (default 60000). Use save_as to keep everything.'),
  save_as: z.string().optional().describe('also save the full text output as workspace outputs/<save_as>'),
};
export const FORMAT = { format: z.enum(['text', 'json']).optional().describe('text (default, readable) or json (structured data)') };

export interface Src { src: string; label: string; scriptId?: string; encoding: 'utf8' | 'latin1' }
export function readFileChecked(path: string): Buffer {
  const p = resolve(path);
  if (!existsSync(p)) throw new Error(`file not found: ${p}`);
  const st = statSync(p);
  if (!st.isFile()) throw new Error(`not a file: ${p}`);
  if (st.size > 64 * 1024 * 1024) throw new Error(`file too large (${st.size} bytes, limit 64 MiB)`);
  return readFileSync(p);
}
export function getSource(a: { script_id?: string; path?: string; source?: string }, ctx: ToolContext): Src {
  if (a.script_id) { const m = ctx.ws.getMeta(a.script_id); return { src: ctx.ws.getScript(a.script_id), label: `${m.name} [${m.id}]`, scriptId: m.id, encoding: m.encoding ?? 'utf8' }; }
  if (a.path) { const d = decodeText(readFileChecked(a.path)); return { src: d.text, label: basename(a.path), encoding: d.encoding }; }
  if (typeof a.source === 'string') return { src: a.source, label: 'inline source', encoding: 'utf8' };
  throw new Error('provide one of: script_id, path, source');
}

export const BYTES = {
  data: z.string().optional().describe('input bytes as text — see "encoding"'),
  encoding: z.enum(['auto', 'hex', 'base64', 'latin1', 'utf8', 'lua', 'decimal']).optional()
    .describe('how to read "data": hex, base64, latin1 (1 char = 1 byte), utf8, lua (Lua string literal / escapes like \\27\\76), decimal ("27,76,117" or "{27,76}"). auto (default) guesses.'),
  file: z.string().optional().describe('read raw bytes from this file on the PRISM host'),
  output: z.string().optional().describe('read raw bytes from a saved workspace output'),
  from_script: z.string().optional().describe('script_id: take the bytes from a string literal of this workspace script (with string_line / string_index)'),
  string_line: z.number().int().optional().describe('with from_script: pick the longest string literal on this line'),
  string_index: z.number().int().optional().describe('with from_script: pick the N-th string literal (0-based) — default: the longest literal in the script'),
};
export type BytesArgs = { data?: string; encoding?: string; file?: string; output?: string; from_script?: string; string_line?: number; string_index?: number };
export function getBytes(a: BytesArgs, ctx: ToolContext): { bytes: Uint8Array; how: string } {
  if (a.file) return { bytes: new Uint8Array(readFileChecked(a.file)), how: 'file ' + basename(a.file) };
  if (a.output) return { bytes: new Uint8Array(ctx.ws.readOutput(a.output)), how: 'output ' + a.output };
  if (a.from_script) {
    const src = ctx.ws.getScript(a.from_script);
    const strs = lex(src).tokens.filter(t => t.type === T.String);
    if (!strs.length) throw new Error('script has no string literals');
    let t = strs[0];
    if (a.string_index !== undefined) { t = strs[a.string_index]; if (!t) throw new Error(`string_index out of range (0..${strs.length - 1})`); }
    else { const pool = a.string_line !== undefined ? strs.filter(s => s.line === a.string_line) : strs; if (!pool.length) throw new Error('no string literal on line ' + a.string_line); t = pool.reduce((x, y) => (y.cooked?.length ?? 0) > (x.cooked?.length ?? 0) ? y : x); }
    return { bytes: Blob.latin1(t.cooked ?? ''), how: `string literal at line ${t.line} (${(t.cooked ?? '').length} bytes)` };
  }
  if (typeof a.data !== 'string') throw new Error('provide one of: data, file, output, from_script');
  return { bytes: decodeBytes(a.data, a.encoding ?? 'auto'), how: 'data (' + (a.encoding ?? 'auto') + ')' };
}
export function decodeBytes(d: string, enc: string): Uint8Array {
  const s = d.trim();
  const fromLua = (x: string) => {
    let body = x;
    const m = /^(["'])([\s\S]*)\1$/.exec(x) ?? /^\[(=*)\[([\s\S]*)\]\1\]$/.exec(x);
    if (m) body = m[2];
    return Blob.luaUnescape(body);
  };
  switch (enc) {
    case 'hex': return Blob.hexdecode(s);
    case 'base64': return Blob.b64decode(s.replace(/\s+/g, ''));
    case 'latin1': return Blob.latin1(d);
    case 'utf8': return Blob.utf8(d);
    case 'lua': return fromLua(s);
    case 'decimal': return Blob.decList(s);
  }
  // auto
  if (/^(["'])[\s\S]*\1$/.test(s) || /\\\d{1,3}|\\x[0-9a-fA-F]{2}/.test(s)) return fromLua(s);
  if (/^\{?\s*\d{1,3}(\s*[,;]\s*\d{1,3})+\s*,?\s*\}?$/.test(s)) return Blob.decList(s);
  if (/^(0x)?[0-9a-fA-F\s]+$/.test(s) && s.replace(/\s+|0x/g, '').length % 2 === 0) return Blob.hexdecode(s.replace(/0x/g, ''));
  if (/^[A-Za-z0-9+/\s]+={0,2}$/.test(s) && s.replace(/\s+/g, '').length % 4 === 0) return Blob.b64decode(s.replace(/\s+/g, ''));
  return Blob.latin1(d);
}

/** number source lines: "  12 | code" */
export function numbered(src: string, from = 1, to = Infinity, mark?: Set<number>): string {
  const lines = src.split('\n');
  const end = Math.min(lines.length, to);
  const w = String(end).length;
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (let i = Math.max(1, from); i <= end; i++) out.push(`${mark?.has(i) ? '>' : ' '}${String(i).padStart(w)} | ${lines[i - 1]}`);
  return out.join('\n');
}
export const trunc = (s: string, n: number) => s.length > n ? s.slice(0, n) + '…' : s;
export function table(rows: Array<Array<string | number>>, head?: string[]): string {
  const all = head ? [head, ...rows] : rows;
  const w: number[] = [];
  for (const r of all) r.forEach((c, i) => { w[i] = Math.max(w[i] ?? 0, Math.min(60, String(c).length)); });
  const fmt = (r: Array<string | number>) => r.map((c, i) => { const t = trunc(String(c), 60); return i === r.length - 1 ? t : t.padEnd(w[i]); }).join('  ');
  const out = all.map(fmt);
  if (head) out.splice(1, 0, w.map(x => '-'.repeat(x)).join('  '));
  return out.join('\n');
}

// Wrappers for the bundled native Luau tools. They only COMPILE / TYPECHECK / PARSE —
// nothing is ever executed (the `luau` runtime binary is intentionally not exposed).
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { mkdtempSync, writeFileSync, rmSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';

export interface NativeResult { code: number | null; stdout: Buffer; stderr: string; timedOut: boolean; ms: number; }
export function runNative(bin: string, args: string[], opts: { timeoutMs?: number; maxBytes?: number } = {}): Promise<NativeResult> {
  if (!existsSync(bin)) return Promise.reject(new Error(`native tool not found: ${bin} (set PRISM_LUAU_DIR)`));
  const t0 = Date.now();
  return new Promise((res, rej) => {
    const p = spawn(bin, args, { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] });
    const out: Buffer[] = []; let err = ''; let size = 0; let timedOut = false;
    const max = opts.maxBytes ?? 64 * 1024 * 1024;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => { timedOut = true; p.kill('SIGKILL'); }, opts.timeoutMs ?? 60000);
    p.stdout.on('data', (d: Buffer) => { size += d.length; if (size <= max) out.push(d); else p.kill('SIGKILL'); });
    p.stderr.on('data', (d: Buffer) => { if (err.length < 200000) err += d.toString(); });
    p.on('error', e => { clearTimeout(timer); rej(e); });
    p.on('close', code => { clearTimeout(timer); res({ code, stdout: Buffer.concat(out), stderr: err, timedOut, ms: Date.now() - t0 }); });
  });
}
/** write source to a private temp file, run, clean up */
export async function withTempSource<T>(src: string, ext: string, fn: (file: string) => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
  const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'prism-'));
  const file = join(dir, 'input' + ext);
  writeFileSync(file, src, 'utf8');
  try { return await fn(file); } finally { rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
}
EOF

import { z } from 'zod';
import { defineTool } from '../types.js';
import { SRC, OUT, FORMAT, getSource, table, trunc } from '../source.js';
import { analyze, parse, buildCallGraph, detectVM, computeMetrics, fingerprint, tokenize, bytesToDisplay } from '@prism/core';

const lineOfPos = (src: string) => { const starts = [0]; for (let i = 0; i < src.length; i++) if (src.charCodeAt(i) === 10) starts.push(i + 1); return (pos: number) => { let lo = 0, hi = starts.length - 1; while (lo < hi) { const m = (lo + hi + 1) >> 1; if (starts[m] <= pos) lo = m; else hi = m - 1; } return lo + 1; }; };

export const analysisTools = [
  defineTool({
    name: 'analyze', title: 'Auto-analysis', category: 'analysis', readOnly: true,
    description: 'One-shot static triage of an obfuscated Lua/Luau script: obfuscator family guesses with reasons, size/complexity metrics, VM / control-flow-flattening detection (dispatch sites, opcode estimate, bytecode blobs), call graph summary, global aliases and parse errors. Run this first.',
    input: { ...SRC, ...FORMAT, ...OUT },
    run: (a, ctx) => {

      const r = analyze(src);

      t.push('family guesses:');
      for (const f of r.families.slice(0, 6)) t.push(`  ${(f.confidence * 100).toFixed(0).padStart(3)}%  ${f.family}${f.reasons.length ? '  — ' + f.reasons.slice(0, 4).join('; ') : ''}`);
      t.push('', `metrics: ${m.bytes} bytes, ${m.lines} lines, ${m.tokens} tokens, ${m.nodes} AST nodes, ${m.functions} functions, ${m.strings} strings, ${m.numbers} numbers, max depth ${m.maxDepth}`);
      t.push(`tells: while-true ${m.whileTrue}, long brackets ${m.longBrackets}, gotos ${m.gotos}, 0x/0b/_ numbers ${m.underscoreNumbers}/${m.binaryLiterals}, dup-param fns ${m.dupParamFns}, table-return head ${m.tableReturnHead}`);
      t.push('', `VM: ${r.vm.isVM ? 'YES' : 'no'}${r.vm.opcodeEstimate ? `, ~${r.vm.opcodeEstimate} opcodes` : ''}`);
      for (const d of r.vm.dispatchSummary) t.push(`  ${d.kind} ×${d.count} (first at line ${d.firstLine})`);
      for (const d of r.vm.dispatch.slice(0, 8)) t.push(`  line ${d.line}: ${d.kind}${d.stateVar ? ` var=${d.stateVar}` : ''}${d.cases ? ` cases=${d.cases}` : ''} — ${trunc(d.detail, 120)}`);
      for (const b of r.vm.blobs.slice(0, 8)) t.push(`  blob line ${b.line}: ${b.kind} len=${b.length}${b.distinctBytes ? ` distinct=${b.distinctBytes}` : ''} ${trunc(b.preview, 60)}`);
      for (const n of r.vm.notes) t.push('  note: ' + n);
      t.push('', `call graph: ${r.callGraph.functionCount} functions, ${r.callGraph.edgeCount} edges`);
      if (r.callGraph.topExternalCalls.length) t.push('top external calls: ' + r.callGraph.topExternalCalls.slice(0, 20).map(c => `${c.name}×${c.count}`).join(', '));
      if (r.aliases.length) t.push('', 'aliases: ' + r.aliases.slice(0, 40).map(x => `${x.name}=${x.target}`).join(', '));
      t.push('', `strings: ${r.strings.total} literals; samples: ` + r.strings.samples.slice(0, 12).map(s => JSON.stringify(trunc(bytesToDisplay(s.value), 40))).join(', '));
      if (r.parseErrors.length) t.push('', `parse errors (${r.parseErrors.length}):`, ...r.parseErrors.slice(0, 10).map(e => `  line ${e.line}: ${e.message}`));
      t.push('', 'next steps: deobfuscate (save_script_as) → constants / opcode_map / find_embedded_bytecode → python_transpile of the decoder');
      return { text: t.join('\n'), data: { families: r.families, metrics: r.metrics, vm: r.vm, callGraph: { functionCount: r.callGraph.functionCount, edgeCount: r.callGraph.edgeCount, topExternalCalls: r.callGraph.topExternalCalls }, aliases: r.aliases, parseErrors: r.parseErrors } };
    },
  }),
  defineTool({
    name: 'fingerprint', title: 'Fingerprint obfuscator', category: 'analysis', readOnly: true,
    description: 'Guess the obfuscator family (Luraph, Moonsec, IronBrew, Prometheus, PSU, Hercules, custom VM…) with confidence and the evidence for each guess.',

      const max = a.max_nodes ?? 400;
      const nodes = cg.functions.slice(0, max); const ids = new Set(nodes.map(n => n.id));
      const edges = cg.edges.filter(e => ids.has(e.from) && ids.has(e.to));

        const t = ['digraph prism {', '  rankdir=LR; node [shape=box, style="rounded,filled", fillcolor="#1e1433", fontcolor="#e9ddff", color="#a855f7", fontname="monospace"]; edge [color="#7c3aed"];',
          ...nodes.map(n => `  "${n.id}" [label="${esc(n.name)}\\nline ${n.line} · ${n.stmts} stmts"];`), ...edges.map(e => `  "${e.from}" -> "${e.to}";`), '}'];
        return { text: t.join('\n'), data: { nodes: nodes.length, edges: edges.length } };
      }
      if (fmt === 'mermaid') {
        const t = ['flowchart LR', ...nodes.map(n => `  ${n.id}["${n.name.replace(/"/g, "'")} (L${n.line})"]`), ...edges.map(e => `  ${e.from} --> ${e.to}`)];
        return { text: t.join('\n'), data: { nodes: nodes.length, edges: edges.length } };
      }
      const callers = new Map<string, string[]>();
      for (const e of cg.edges) { const l = callers.get(e.to) ?? []; l.push(e.from); callers.set(e.to, l); }
      const rows = cg.functions.map(f => [f.id, trunc(f.name, 40), f.line, f.params.join(',') + (f.vararg ? (f.params.length ? ',...' : '...') : ''), f.stmts, cg.edges.filter(e => e.from === f.id).length, callers.get(f.id)?.length ?? 0]);
      const text = `${cg.functions.length} functions, ${cg.edges.length} edges\n\n` + table(rows, ['id', 'name', 'line', 'params', 'stmts', 'calls→', '←callers']) +
        `\n\nexternal calls: ${cg.externalCalls.slice(0, 60).map(c => `${c.name}×${c.count}`).join(', ')}\n\nedges:\n` + cg.edges.slice(0, 2000).map(e => `  ${e.from} → ${e.to}${e.label ? ` (${e.label})` : ''}`).join('\n');
      return { text, data: { functions: cg.functions.length, edges: cg.edges.length } };
    },
  }),

    description: 'Compact function index (id, name, line range, params, size). Sort by line, size or fan-in to find decoders, VM loops and hot helpers.',
    input: { ...SRC, sort: z.enum(['line', 'size', 'callers', 'calls']).optional(), filter: z.string().optional().describe('substring filter on the function name'), max: z.number().int().optional(), ...OUT },
    run: (a, ctx) => {

      fns = fns.slice(0, a.max ?? 500);

      return { text, data: fns.map(f => ({ id: f.id, name: f.name, line: f.line, endLine: f.endLine, params: f.params, vararg: f.vararg, size: f.size, callers: f.callers, calls: f.calls.length })) };

    input: { ...SRC, ...FORMAT, ...OUT },

' top: ' + b.histogram.slice(0, 8).map(h => `${h.byte}×${h.count}`).join(' ') : ''}\n      ${trunc(b.preview, 100)}`));

      const from = a.from_line ?? 1, to = a.to_line ?? from + 20;

      return { text, data: { counts: Object.fromEntries(counts), errors: errors.length } };
    },
  }),

cd /data/prism/packages/core/src && cat > passes/manualrename.ts <<'EOF'
// Scope-aware manual renaming that PRESERVES the original formatting: every reference and the
// declaring identifier of the chosen binding(s) are rewritten in place by source offset.
import { lex, T, Token } from '../lexer.js';
import { parse } from '../parser.js';
import { analyzeScopes, Binding } from '../analysis/scope.js';

export interface RenameRequest { name: string; to: string; line?: number; all?: boolean }
export interface RenameApplied { name: string; to: string; line: number; kind: string; sites: number }
export interface RenameSymbolsResult { code: string; applied: RenameApplied[]; errors: string[]; warnings: string[] }

const KW = new Set('and break do else elseif end false for function if in local nil not or repeat return then true until while goto continue'.split(' '));
const IDENT = /^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/;

export function renameSymbols(src: string, requests: RenameRequest[]): RenameSymbolsResult {
  const { chunk } = parse(src);
  const { tokens } = lex(src);
  const scope = analyzeScopes(chunk);
  const errors: string[] = [], warnings: string[] = [], applied: RenameApplied[] = [];
  const edits = new Map<number, { end: number; to: string }>();
  // token index by start offset
  const byStart = new Map<number, number>(); tokens.forEach((t, i) => byStart.set(t.start, i));
  const firstTokAt = (pos: number) => { let i = byStart.get(pos); if (i !== undefined) return i; i = tokens.findIndex(t => t.start >= pos); return i < 0 ? tokens.length : i; };
  const isP = (t: Token | undefined, v: string) => !!t && t.type !== T.String && t.type !== T.Number && t.value === v;
  /** names in a declaration list starting at token i (skips `: type` and `<attrib>`), until a stop token */
  const declNames = (i: number, stops: string[]): Token[] => {
    const out: Token[] = [];
    while (i < tokens.length) {
      const t = tokens[i];
      if (t.type === T.Name && !KW.has(t.value)) out.push(t); else break;
      i++;
      if (isP(tokens[i], '<')) { while (i < tokens.length && !isP(tokens[i], '>')) i++; i++; }
      if (isP(tokens[i], ':')) { let depth = 0; i++; while (i < tokens.length) { const u = tokens[i]; if (depth === 0 && (isP(u, ',') || stops.some(s => isP(u, s)))) break; if (isP(u, '(') || isP(u, '{') || isP(u, '[') || isP(u, '<')) depth++; if (isP(u, ')') || isP(u, '}') || isP(u, ']') || isP(u, '>')) depth--; i++; } }
      if (isP(tokens[i], ',')) { i++; continue; }
      break;
    }
    return out;
  };
  const declToken = (b: Binding): Token | null => {
    const d = b.decl; if (!d?.loc) return null;
    let i = firstTokAt(d.loc.start);
    switch (d.type) {
      case 'LocalStat': if (isP(tokens[i], 'local')) i++; return declNames(i, ['=', ';'])[b.index] ?? null;
      case 'LocalFunctionStat': { while (i < tokens.length && !isP(tokens[i], 'function')) i++; const t = tokens[i + 1]; return t?.type === T.Name ? t : null; }
      case 'FunctionExpr': { while (i < tokens.length && !isP(tokens[i], '(')) i++; return declNames(i + 1, [')'])[b.index] ?? null; }
      case 'NumericForStat': { if (isP(tokens[i], 'for')) i++; const t = tokens[i]; return t?.type === T.Name ? t : null; }
      case 'GenericForStat': { if (isP(tokens[i], 'for')) i++; return declNames(i, ['in'])[b.index] ?? null; }
    }
    return null;
  };
  for (const r of requests) {
    if (!IDENT.test(r.to) || KW.has(r.to)) { errors.push(`"${r.to}" is not a valid identifier`); continue; }
    let cands = scope.bindings.filter(b => b.kind !== 'global' && b.name === r.name);
    if (r.line !== undefined) {
      const exact = cands.filter(b => b.line === r.line);
      cands = exact.length ? exact : cands.filter(b => b.refs.some(x => x.loc?.line === r.line));
    }
    if (!cands.length) { errors.push(`no local binding named "${r.name}"${r.line !== undefined ? ` declared/used at line ${r.line}` : ''}`); continue; }
    if (cands.length > 1 && !r.all) { errors.push(`"${r.name}" is ambiguous — ${cands.length} bindings (declared at lines ${cands.map(b => b.line).join(', ')}); pass line or all=true`); continue; }
    const clash = scope.bindings.filter(b => b.name === r.to).length + (scope.globals.has(r.to) ? 1 : 0);
    if (clash) warnings.push(`"${r.to}" already names ${clash} other binding(s)/global — check for shadowing`);
    for (const b of cands) {
      let sites = 0;
      const dt = declToken(b);
      if (dt) { edits.set(dt.start, { end: dt.end, to: r.to }); sites++; } else warnings.push(`could not locate the declaration of "${r.name}" (line ${b.line}); only references renamed`);
      for (const ref of b.refs) if (ref.loc) { edits.set(ref.loc.start, { end: ref.loc.start + b.name.length, to: r.to }); sites++; }
      applied.push({ name: r.name, to: r.to, line: b.line, kind: b.kind, sites });
    }
  }
  let code = src;
  for (const [start, e] of [...edits].sort((x, y) => y[0] - x[0])) code = code.slice(0, start) + e.to + code.slice(e.end);
  return { code, applied, errors, warnings };
}
EOF
cat >> index.ts <<'EOF'
export { renameSymbols } from './passes/manualrename.js';
export type { RenameRequest, RenameApplied, RenameSymbolsResult } from './passes/manualrename.js';

/** constant-fold a single expression (number/bit/string junk) — e.g. "bit32.bxor(0x5A ^ 3, 7) + #'abc'" */
export function simplifyExpression(expr: string, opts: CleanOptions = {}): { result: string; changed: boolean } {
  const src = 'return ' + expr;
  const out = clean(src, { rename: 'none', removeUnusedLocals: false, ...opts }).code.trim();
  const result = out.replace(/^return\s+/, '').replace(/;$/, '');
  return { result, changed: result.replace(/\s+/g, '') !== expr.replace(/\s+/g, '') };
}
EOF

import { z } from 'zod';
import { defineTool } from '../types.js';
import { SRC, OUT, getSource, numbered, table } from '../source.js';
import { clean, renameSymbols, simplifyExpression } from '@prism/core';
import type { ToolContext } from '../types.js';

/** store a derived script and report it */
export function saveDerived(ctx: ToolContext, name: string | undefined, code: string, parent: string | undefined, how: string): { line: string; id?: string } {
  if (!name) return { line: '' };
  const m = ctx.ws.addScript(name, code, { parent, derivedBy: how });
  return { line: `saved as script_id "${m.id}"`, id: m.id };
}

export const deobTools = [
  defineTool({
    name: 'deobfuscate', title: 'Deobfuscate / junk removal', category: 'deobfuscation',
    description: 'Universal static cleanup pipeline (no execution): constant & MBA folding (number/bit32 junk), string recovery (string.char / escapes / concat chains), dead-branch pruning, opaque-predicate & state-guard folding, loop-once/while-break unrolling, constant & alias propagation, unused local/assignment removal, paren stripping, optional role-based renaming. Every pass can be toggled. Use save_script_as to store the result as a new workspace script for further analysis.',
    input: {
      ...SRC,
      rename: z.enum(['none', 'obfuscated', 'all']).optional().describe('role-based renaming: none (default), obfuscated-looking names only, or all locals'),
      fold_constants: z.boolean().optional(), recover_strings: z.boolean().optional(), remove_dead_code: z.boolean().optional(),
      propagate: z.boolean().optional(), remove_unused_locals: z.boolean().optional(), strip_parens: z.boolean().optional(), control_flow: z.boolean().optional(),
      rounds: z.number().int().min(1).max(50).optional().describe('max fixpoint rounds (default 8)'),
      show_rename_map: z.boolean().optional(),
      save_script_as: z.string().optional().describe('store the cleaned code as a new workspace script with this name'),
      ...OUT,
    },
    run: (a, ctx) => {
      const { src, scriptId } = getSource(a, ctx);
      const r = clean(src, { rename: a.rename ?? 'none', foldConstants: a.fold_constants, recoverStrings: a.recover_strings, removeDeadCode: a.remove_dead_code, propagate: a.propagate, removeUnusedLocals: a.remove_unused_locals, stripParens: a.strip_parens, controlFlow: a.control_flow, rounds: a.rounds });
      for (const k of Object.keys(r)) void k;
      const s = r.stats;
      const nz = Object.entries(s).filter(([, v]) => v).map(([k, v]) => `${k}=${v}`).join(' ');
      const saved = saveDerived(ctx, a.save_script_as, r.code, scriptId, 'deobfuscate');
      const head = `-- PRISM deobfuscate: ${src.length} → ${r.code.length} chars, ${r.rounds} rounds, ${nz || 'no changes'}${r.parseErrors ? `, ${r.parseErrors} parse errors` : ''}${saved.line ? '\n-- ' + saved.line : ''}\n`;
      const map = a.show_rename_map && r.renameMap.length ? '\n\n-- rename map:\n' + r.renameMap.map(m => `--   ${m.from} → ${m.to} (line ${m.line}, ${m.kind})`).join('\n') : '';
      return { text: head + r.code + map, data: { stats: s, rounds: r.rounds, renameMap: r.renameMap, parseErrors: r.parseErrors, savedScriptId: saved.id, code: r.code } };
    },
  }),
  defineTool({
    name: 'simplify_expression', title: 'Simplify expression', category: 'deobfuscation', readOnly: true,
    description: 'Constant-fold one Lua expression (arithmetic / bit32 / MBA junk / string.char / # of literals), e.g. "bit32.bxor(0x5A, 3) + #\'abc\' * 2^3" → 113. Several expressions can be given separated by newlines.',
    input: { expression: z.string() },
    run: a => {
      const exprs = a.expression.split('\n').map(e => e.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      const res = exprs.map(e => { try { return { expr: e, ...simplifyExpression(e) }; } catch (err) { return { expr: e, result: 'error: ' + (err as Error).message, changed: false }; } });
      return { text: res.map(r => exprs.length > 1 ? `${r.expr}  ⇒  ${r.result}` : r.result).join('\n'), data: res };
    },
  }),
  defineTool({
    name: 'rename_symbols', title: 'Rename symbols', category: 'deobfuscation',
    description: 'Scope-aware renaming of local variables / parameters / local functions that preserves the original formatting (only identifiers change). Each request: {name, to, line?} where line is the declaration line (or any line where that binding is used) to disambiguate; all=true renames every binding with that name.',
    input: { ...SRC, renames: z.array(z.object({ name: z.string(), to: z.string(), line: z.number().int().optional(), all: z.boolean().optional() })).min(1), save_script_as: z.string().optional().describe('store the renamed code as a workspace script (use the same name to keep a single evolving copy)'), ...OUT },
    run: (a, ctx) => {
      const { src, scriptId } = getSource(a, ctx);
      const r = renameSymbols(src, a.renames);
      const saved = r.applied.length ? saveDerived(ctx, a.save_script_as, r.code, scriptId, 'rename_symbols') : { line: '' };
      const t = [
        r.applied.length ? 'renamed:\n' + table(r.applied.map(x => [x.name, '→', x.to, `line ${x.line}`, x.kind, `${x.sites} sites`])) : 'nothing renamed',
        ...r.errors.map(e => 'error: ' + e), ...r.warnings.map(w => 'warning: ' + w), saved.line,
      ].filter(Boolean);
      return { text: t.join('\n') + (saved.id ? '' : '\n\n' + r.code), data: { applied: r.applied, errors: r.errors, warnings: r.warnings, savedScriptId: saved.id } };
    },
  }),
  defineTool({
    name: 'get_lines', title: 'View lines', category: 'search', readOnly: true,
    description: 'Show a numbered line range of a script (with optional context around a single line). Mark lines of interest with ">".',
    input: { ...SRC, line: z.number().int().optional().describe('center line'), context: z.number().int().optional().describe('lines of context around "line" (default 15)'), from_line: z.number().int().optional(), to_line: z.number().int().optional(), ...OUT },
    run: (a, ctx) => {
      const { src } = getSource(a, ctx);
      const c = a.context ?? 15;
      const from = a.from_line ?? (a.line ? a.line - c : 1), to = a.to_line ?? (a.line ? a.line + c : from + 2 * c);
      return { text: numbered(src, from, to, a.line ? new Set([a.line]) : undefined) };
    },
  }),
];

import { z } from 'zod';
import { defineTool } from '../types.js';
import { SRC, OUT, FORMAT, getSource, table, trunc } from '../source.js';
import { searchPattern, xrefs, getFunction, constants, bytesToDisplay } from '@prism/core';

export const searchTools = [
  defineTool({
    name: 'find_text', title: 'Find text / regex', category: 'search', readOnly: true,
    description: 'grep inside a script: plain substring or JavaScript regex, with context lines and match counts. Good for locating getfenv/loadstring/string.byte usage, magic numbers, key strings…',
    input: { ...SRC, pattern: z.string(), regex: z.boolean().optional(), ignore_case: z.boolean().optional(), context: z.number().int().min(0).max(20).optional(), max: z.number().int().optional(), ...OUT },
    run: (a, ctx) => {
      const { src } = getSource(a, ctx);
      const flags = 'g' + (a.ignore_case ? 'i' : '');
      const re = a.regex ? new RegExp(a.pattern, flags) : new RegExp(a.pattern.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'), flags);
      const lines = src.split('\n'); const c = a.context ?? 0; const max = a.max ?? 200;
      const hits: Array<{ line: number; col: number; match: string }> = [];
      let total = 0;
      lines.forEach((l, i) => { re.lastIndex = 0; let m: RegExpExecArray | null; while ((m = re.exec(l))) { total++; if (hits.length < max) hits.push({ line: i + 1, col: m.index + 1, match: m[0] }); if (!m[0].length) re.lastIndex++; } });
      const out: string[] = [`${total} matches${total > hits.length ? ` (showing ${hits.length})` : ''}`];
      let lastShown = 0;
      for (const h of hits) {
        if (c === 0) { out.push(`${h.line}:${h.col}: ${trunc(lines[h.line - 1].trim(), 240)}`); continue; }
        const from = Math.max(1, h.line - c, lastShown + 1), to = Math.min(lines.length, h.line + c);
        if (from > lastShown + 1 && lastShown) out.push('--');
        for (let i = from; i <= to; i++) out.push(`${i === h.line ? '>' : ' '}${i}: ${trunc(lines[i - 1], 240)}`);
        lastShown = to;
      }
      return { text: out.join('\n'), data: { total, hits } };
    },
  }),
  defineTool({
    name: 'pattern_search', title: 'Structural search (AST pattern)', category: 'search', readOnly: true,
    description: 'Search code by AST shape, not text. Metavariables: $X (any expression; repeated $X must match the same code), $_ (wildcard), $$$ (any number of args/items/statements). Examples: "string.char($$$)", "$T[$K] = $T[$K] + 1", "local $A = $B .. $C", "for $I = 1, #$S do $$$ end", "bit32.bxor($X, $X)".',
    input: { ...SRC, pattern: z.string(), kind: z.enum(['auto', 'expr', 'stat']).optional(), max: z.number().int().optional(), ...FORMAT, ...OUT },
    run: (a, ctx) => {
      const { src } = getSource(a, ctx);
      const r = searchPattern(src, a.pattern, { max: a.max ?? 300, kind: a.kind });
      if (a.format === 'json') return { text: JSON.stringify(r, null, 2), data: r };
      if (r.error) return { text: 'pattern error: ' + r.error, data: r };
      const t = [`${r.total} ${r.kind} matches${r.total > r.matches.length ? ` (showing ${r.matches.length})` : ''}`];
      for (const m of r.matches) {
        const b = Object.entries(m.bindings).map(([k, v]) => `${k}=${trunc(v, 60)}`).join('  ');
        t.push(`${m.line}:${m.col}: ${trunc(m.text.replace(/\s+/g, ' '), 200)}${b ? '\n      ' + b : ''}`);
      }
      return { text: t.join('\n'), data: r };
    },
  }),
  defineTool({
    name: 'xrefs', title: 'Cross references', category: 'search', readOnly: true,
    description: 'Scope-aware cross references of a variable: every binding named `name` (or only the one visible at `line`) with its declaration, reads and writes (line, column, code). Globals are listed too.',
    input: { ...SRC, name: z.string(), line: z.number().int().optional(), max: z.number().int().optional(), ...FORMAT, ...OUT },
    run: (a, ctx) => {
      const { src } = getSource(a, ctx);
      const r = xrefs(src, a.name, { line: a.line, max: a.max ?? 500 });
      if (a.format === 'json') return { text: JSON.stringify(r, null, 2), data: r };
      if (!r.length) return { text: `no binding or global named "${a.name}"`, data: r };
      const t: string[] = [];
      for (const b of r) {
        t.push(`${b.kind} ${b.name} (line ${b.line}) — ${b.reads} reads, ${b.writes} writes${b.captured ? ', captured by closures' : ''}`);
        for (const x of b.refs) t.push(`  ${x.kind.padEnd(5)} ${x.line}:${x.col}  ${trunc(x.text, 200)}`);
      }
      return { text: t.join('\n'), data: r };
    },
  }),
  defineTool({
    name: 'get_function', title: 'Get function source', category: 'search', readOnly: true,
    description: 'Extract the full source of one function by call-graph id (f12), name (local/field/method name) or by a line number inside it (innermost function wins).',
    input: { ...SRC, query: z.union([z.string(), z.number()]).describe('function id, name, or line number'), ...OUT },
    run: (a, ctx) => {
      const { src } = getSource(a, ctx);
      const f = getFunction(src, a.query);
      if (!f) return { text: `no function matches "${a.query}" — try list_functions` };
      return { text: `-- ${f.id} ${f.name} (lines ${f.line}-${f.endLine}, params: ${f.params.join(', ') || 'none'})\n${f.code}`, data: f };
    },
  }),
  defineTool({
    name: 'constants', title: 'Constant finder', category: 'search', readOnly: true,
    description: 'Inventory of every literal: strings (kind: url/api/identifier/alphabet/hex/base64/binary/blob/text, entropy, count, lines), numbers (byte/large/float/pow2/xor-operand/mod-operand tags), numeric & string-pool arrays, KEY candidates and DECODER candidates (deserializers, string decoders, constant decryptors/accessors, bit helpers, decode loops) ranked by score with call sites. Use it to find the constant + bytecode unpacker.',
    input: { ...SRC, section: z.enum(['all', 'summary', 'strings', 'numbers', 'arrays', 'decoders', 'keys']).optional(), max: z.number().int().optional().describe('max rows per section (default 60)'), ...FORMAT, ...OUT },
    run: (a, ctx) => {
      const { src } = getSource(a, ctx);
      const max = a.max ?? 60;
      const r = constants(src, { maxStrings: Math.max(max, 300), maxNumbers: Math.max(max, 300), maxArrays: Math.max(max, 100), maxDecoders: Math.max(max, 50) });
      if (a.format === 'json') return { text: JSON.stringify(r, null, 2), data: r };
      const s = a.section ?? 'all'; const t: string[] = [];
      const S = r.summary;
      t.push(`summary: ${S.strings} strings (${S.uniqueStrings} unique), ${S.numbers} numbers (${S.uniqueNumbers} unique), ${S.arrays} arrays, ${S.decoders} decoder candidates, ${S.bytes} literal bytes`);
      if (s === 'all' || s === 'decoders') {
        t.push('', 'DECODER CANDIDATES:');
        for (const d of r.decoders.slice(0, max)) t.push(`  ${d.score.toFixed(1).padStart(5)}  ${d.kind.padEnd(19)} ${d.name} (lines ${d.line}-${d.endLine}, ${d.params} params, ${d.callSites} calls, ${d.literalArgCalls} with literal args)\n         ${d.reasons.join('; ')}${d.sampleCalls.length ? '\n         e.g. ' + d.sampleCalls.slice(0, 3).map(x => trunc(x, 80)).join(' | ') : ''}`);
      }
      if (s === 'all' || s === 'keys') { t.push('', 'KEY CANDIDATES:'); for (const k of r.keys.slice(0, max)) t.push(`  line ${k.line}: ${trunc(JSON.stringify(bytesToDisplay(k.value)), 80)}  — ${trunc(k.context, 100)}`); }
      if (s === 'all' || s === 'strings') {
        t.push('', 'STRINGS:');
        t.push(table(r.strings.slice(0, max).map(x => [x.kind, x.len, x.count, x.entropy.toFixed(2), x.lines.slice(0, 4).join(',') + (x.lines.length > 4 ? '…' : ''), trunc(x.display, 90)]), ['kind', 'len', 'count', 'H', 'lines', 'value']));
      }
      if (s === 'all' || s === 'numbers') {
        t.push('', 'NUMBERS:');
        t.push(table(r.numbers.slice(0, max).map(n => [n.raw, n.value, n.count, n.tags.join(','), n.lines.slice(0, 5).join(',')]), ['raw', 'value', 'count', 'tags', 'lines']));
      }
      if (s === 'all' || s === 'arrays') {
        t.push('', 'ARRAYS:');
        for (const x of r.arrays.slice(0, max)) t.push(`  line ${x.line}: ${x.kind} ×${x.length} [${x.min}..${x.max}]${x.avgEntropy !== undefined ? ` avgH=${x.avgEntropy.toFixed(2)}` : ''}  ${trunc(x.strings ? x.strings.slice(0, 6).map(v => JSON.stringify(v)).join(', ') : x.values.slice(0, 24).join(','), 120)}`);
      }
      return { text: t.join('\n'), data: s === 'all' ? r : { summary: r.summary, [s]: (r as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)[s] } };
    },
  }),
  defineTool({
    name: 'strings', title: 'Strings', category: 'search', readOnly: true,
    description: 'List string literals with filters (min length, kind, substring/regex, entropy) — decoded bytes shown as UTF-8 when valid, escapes otherwise.',
    input: { ...SRC, min_len: z.number().int().optional(), kind: z.string().optional().describe('url | api | identifier | alphabet | hex | base64 | binary | blob | text'), filter: z.string().optional().describe('regex on the decoded value'), min_entropy: z.number().optional(), sort: z.enum(['count', 'len', 'entropy', 'line']).optional(), max: z.number().int().optional(), ...FORMAT, ...OUT },
    run: (a, ctx) => {
      const { src } = getSource(a, ctx);
      const r = constants(src, { maxStrings: 100000, maxNumbers: 0, maxArrays: 0, maxDecoders: 0 });
      let xs = r.strings.filter(x => x.len >= (a.min_len ?? 0) && (!a.kind || x.kind === a.kind) && (a.min_entropy === undefined || x.entropy >= a.min_entropy));
      if (a.filter) { const re = new RegExp(a.filter, 'i'); xs = xs.filter(x => re.test(x.display) || re.test(x.value)); }
      const so = a.sort ?? 'count';
      xs.sort((p, q) => so === 'len' ? q.len - p.len : so === 'entropy' ? q.entropy - p.entropy : so === 'line' ? (p.lines[0] ?? 0) - (q.lines[0] ?? 0) : q.count - p.count);
      const shown = xs.slice(0, a.max ?? 300);
      if (a.format === 'json') return { text: JSON.stringify(shown, null, 2), data: shown };
      return { text: `${xs.length} strings match\n` + table(shown.map(x => [x.kind, x.len, x.count, x.entropy.toFixed(2), x.lines[0] ?? '', trunc(x.display, 120)]), ['kind', 'len', 'count', 'H', 'line', 'value']), data: shown };
    },
  }),
];
