import { z } from 'zod';
import { defineTool } from '../types.js';
import { SRC, OUT, FORMAT, getSource, table, trunc } from '../source.js';
import { mapOpcodes, formatOpcodeTree, opmapFromTree, vmDisassemble, luaLiteralToJson } from '@prism/core';
import type { OpMap } from '@prism/core';
import { saveDerived } from './deob.js';

const OPENTRY = z.union([z.string(), z.object({ name: z.string(), lua: z.string().optional(), args: z.string().optional(), notes: z.string().optional() })]);

export const vmTools = [
  defineTool({
    name: 'opcode_map', title: 'Opcode map (VM handlers)', category: 'vm', readOnly: false,
    description: 'Universal VM opcode extraction: finds every dispatch tree (if-chains / binary-search trees over an opcode or state variable, including CFF state machines), resolves which opcode numbers reach each handler, infers VM roles (instruction/opcode field, operand fields A/B/C…, register stack, constant table, pc, env) and guesses a Lua-style mnemonic per handler (MOVE, LOADK, GETTABLE, CALL, EQ, JMP, SUPER[...] for fused handlers…) with lifted pseudo-code. By default runs on the cleaned code (line numbers refer to it; use save_script_as to keep that code). save_opmap_as stores the guessed map for editing and vm_disasm.',
    input: {
      ...SRC, tree: z.number().int().optional().describe('only this dispatch tree index'), opcode: z.number().int().optional().describe('only the handler for this opcode'),
      clean: z.boolean().optional().describe('clean first (default true)'), code: z.boolean().optional().describe('include handler source (default false)'), lifted: z.boolean().optional().describe('include lifted pseudo-code (default true)'),
      min_leaves: z.number().int().optional(), max_trees: z.number().int().optional(),
      save_opmap_as: z.string().optional().describe('save the guessed opcode map of the chosen (or first VM) tree under this name'),
      save_script_as: z.string().optional().describe('store the analysed (cleaned) code as a workspace script so handler line numbers can be viewed'),
      ...FORMAT, ...OUT,
    },
    run: (a, ctx) => {
      const { src, scriptId } = getSource(a, ctx);
      const r = mapOpcodes(src, { clean: a.clean ?? true, minLeaves: a.min_leaves, maxTrees: a.max_trees });
      const trees = a.tree !== undefined ? r.report.trees.filter(t => t.id === a.tree || r.report.trees.indexOf(t) === a.tree) : r.report.trees;
      const saved = saveDerived(ctx, a.save_script_as, r.code, scriptId, 'opcode_map(clean)');
      const files: string[] = [];
      let opmapNote = '';
      if (a.save_opmap_as) {
        const t = trees.find(x => x.kind === 'vm') ?? trees[0];
        if (t) { const f = ctx.ws.setOpmap(a.save_opmap_as, { $meta: { tree: t.id, var: t.var, kind: t.kind, roles: t.roles, from: scriptId ?? 'inline' }, ...opmapFromTree(t) }); files.push(f); opmapNote = `saved opcode map ${f} (${t.handlers.length} handlers)`; }
      }
      if (a.format === 'json') return { text: JSON.stringify({ trees, notes: r.report.notes }, null, 2), data: { trees, notes: r.report.notes }, files };
      const t: string[] = [];
      t.push(`${r.report.trees.length} dispatch trees${r.cleaned ? ' (on cleaned code)' : ''}: ` + r.report.trees.map((x, i) => `#${i} ${x.kind} var=${x.var} line ${x.line} ${x.leaves} leaves ops ${x.minOp}..${x.maxOp}`).join(' | '));
      for (const n of r.report.notes) t.push('note: ' + n);
      if (saved.line) t.push(saved.line); if (opmapNote) t.push(opmapNote);
      for (const tr of trees) {
        const view = a.opcode !== undefined ? { ...tr, handlers: tr.handlers.filter(h => h.opcodes.includes(a.opcode!)) } : tr;
        t.push('', formatOpcodeTree(view, { code: a.code ?? false, lifted: a.lifted ?? true }));
      }
      return { text: t.join('\n'), data: { trees: trees.map(x => ({ id: x.id, kind: x.kind, var: x.var, line: x.line, leaves: x.leaves, roles: x.roles, handlers: x.handlers.map(h => ({ opcodes: h.opcodes, guess: h.guess, confidence: h.confidence, line: h.line })) })), notes: r.report.notes, savedScriptId: saved.id }, files };
    },
  }),
  defineTool({
    name: 'opmap_get', title: 'Get opcode map', category: 'vm', readOnly: true,
    description: 'Show a saved (editable) opcode map: opcode → mnemonic + pseudo-Lua template. Without name: list maps.',
    input: { name: z.string().optional(), ...FORMAT },
    run: (a, { ws }) => {
      if (!a.name) return { text: ws.listOpmaps().join('\n') || '(no opcode maps saved)', data: ws.listOpmaps() };
      const m = ws.getOpmap(a.name);
      if (a.format === 'json') return { text: JSON.stringify(m, null, 2), data: m };
      const rows = Object.entries(m).filter(([k]) => k !== '$meta').sort((x, y) => +x[0] - +y[0]).map(([k, v]) => { const e = typeof v === 'string' ? { name: v } : v as { name: string; lua?: string; notes?: string }; return [k, e.name, trunc(e.lua ?? '', 100), e.notes ?? '']; });
      return { text: (m.$meta ? `meta: ${JSON.stringify(m.$meta).slice(0, 300)}\n\n` : '') + table(rows, ['op', 'name', 'lua', 'notes']), data: m };
    },
  }),
  defineTool({
    name: 'opmap_set', title: 'Create / edit opcode map', category: 'vm',
    description: 'Create or edit a custom opcode map. "set" merges entries {opcode: "NAME"} or {opcode: {name, lua, notes}} (lua is a pseudo-code template using field letters, e.g. "R[A] = K[B]"); "remove" deletes opcodes; replace=true starts from scratch. Use this to correct guesses — vm_disasm uses the map.',
    input: { name: z.string(), set: z.record(OPENTRY).optional(), remove: z.array(z.union([z.string(), z.number()])).optional(), replace: z.boolean().optional() },
    run: (a, { ws }) => {
      let m: Record<string, unknown> = {};
      if (!a.replace) { try { m = ws.getOpmap(a.name); } catch { m = {}; } }
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(a.set ?? {})) m[k] = v;
      for (const k of a.remove ?? []) delete m[String(k)];
      const f = ws.setOpmap(a.name, m);
      return { text: `saved ${f}: ${Object.keys(m).filter(k => k !== '$meta').length} opcodes`, files: [f], data: m };
    },
  }),
  defineTool({
    name: 'vm_disasm', title: 'Custom VM disassembler', category: 'vm', readOnly: true,
    description: 'Disassemble instructions of ANY custom VM once you have extracted them statically (e.g. with your Python decoder): give the instruction list as JSON ([[op,a,b,c],…] or [{"op":..,"A":..},…]) or as a Lua table literal ({{1,0,5},…} / {{[1]=…}}), plus an opcode map (saved name or inline). Optional constants array resolves K[x] in templates. Prints mnemonic, operands and the substituted pseudo-Lua per instruction, plus an opcode histogram and unmapped opcodes.',
    input: {
      instructions: z.string().optional().describe('JSON or Lua-literal instruction list'),
      instructions_output: z.string().optional().describe('read the instruction list from a saved workspace output instead'),
      opmap: z.string().optional().describe('name of a saved opcode map'),
      opmap_inline: z.record(OPENTRY).optional(),
      op_field: z.union([z.string(), z.number()]).optional().describe('key/position of the opcode (auto)'),
      fields: z.record(z.string()).optional().describe('operand key → letter, e.g. {"2":"A","3":"B","4":"C"} (auto, or taken from the saved map roles)'),
      constants: z.string().optional().describe('JSON or Lua-literal constant array for K[x] substitution'),
      k_base: z.number().int().optional().describe('constant index base (default 1)'),
      max: z.number().int().optional(),
      ...OUT,
    },
    run: (a, { ws }) => {
      const parse = (s: string): unknown => { const t = s.trim(); try { return JSON.parse(t); } catch { return luaLiteralToJson(t); } };
      const raw = a.instructions ?? (a.instructions_output ? ws.readOutput(a.instructions_output).toString('utf8') : undefined);
      if (!raw) throw new Error('provide instructions or instructions_output');
      let ins = parse(raw);
      if (ins && typeof ins === 'object' && !Array.isArray(ins)) ins = Object.keys(ins).sort((x, y) => +x - +y).map(k => (ins as Record<string, unknown>)[k]);
      let map: OpMap = {}; let fields = a.fields; let opField = a.op_field;
      if (a.opmap) {
        const m = ws.getOpmap(a.opmap) as Record<string, unknown>;
        const meta = m.$meta as { roles?: { fields?: Record<string, string>; opField?: string } } | undefined;
        if (!fields && meta?.roles?.fields && Object.keys(meta.roles.fields).length) fields = meta.roles.fields;
        if (opField === undefined && meta?.roles?.opField) opField = meta.roles.opField;
        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(m)) if (k !== '$meta') map[k] = v as OpMap[string];
      }
      if (a.opmap_inline) map = { ...map, ...a.opmap_inline };
      const consts = a.constants ? parse(a.constants) : undefined;
      const r = vmDisassemble(ins as unknown[], map, { fields, opField, constants: Array.isArray(consts) ? consts : consts && typeof consts === 'object' ? Object.keys(consts).sort((x, y) => +x - +y).map(k => (consts as Record<string, unknown>)[k]) : undefined, kBase: a.k_base, max: a.max });
      const hist = '\n\nopcode histogram:\n' + table(r.histogram.slice(0, 80).map(h => [h.op, h.name, h.count]), ['op', 'name', 'count']);
      return { text: r.text + hist, data: { count: r.count, histogram: r.histogram, unknown: r.unknown, fields: r.fields, opField: r.opField } };
    },
  }),
];

import { z } from 'zod';
import { inflateSync, gunzipSync, inflateRawSync } from 'node:zlib';
import { defineTool } from '../types.js';
import { OUT, BYTES, getBytes, table } from '../source.js';
import { Blob } from '@prism/core';

const OUTFMT = z.enum(['hexdump', 'hex', 'latin1', 'utf8', 'base64', 'python', 'lua', 'c', 'decimal', 'json']).optional();
export function renderBytes(b: Uint8Array, fmt = 'hexdump'): string {
  switch (fmt) {
    case 'hex': return Blob.hexencode(b);
    case 'latin1': return Blob.unlatin1(b);
    case 'utf8': return new TextDecoder().decode(b);
    case 'base64': return Blob.b64encode(b);
    case 'python': return Blob.asPythonBytes(b);
    case 'lua': return Blob.asLuaString(b);
    case 'c': return Blob.asCArray(b);
    case 'decimal': return Blob.asLuaTable(b);
    case 'json': return JSON.stringify(Array.from(b));
    default: return Blob.hexdump(b, 1 << 20);
  }
}
const NODE_OPS: Record<string, (b: Uint8Array) => Uint8Array> = {
  inflate: b => new Uint8Array(inflateSync(b)), gunzip: b => new Uint8Array(gunzipSync(b)), 'inflate-raw': b => new Uint8Array(inflateRawSync(b)),
};
const info = (b: Uint8Array) => `${b.length} bytes, entropy ${Blob.entropyBytes(b).toFixed(3)} bits/byte, printable ${(Blob.printableBytes(b) * 100).toFixed(1)}%${Blob.detectMagic(b).length ? ', looks like: ' + Blob.detectMagic(b).join(', ') : ''}`;

export const blobTools = [
  defineTool({
    name: 'blob_transform', title: 'Blob Lab: decode pipeline', category: 'blob', readOnly: false,
    description: 'Run a chain of byte transforms over a blob (static, pure functions): ' + Object.entries(Blob.BLOB_OPS).map(([k, v]) => `${k} (${v.label})`).join('; ') + '; inflate / gunzip / inflate-raw (zlib). Output as hexdump/hex/latin1/utf8/base64/python/lua/c/decimal/json. save_output stores the raw resulting bytes in workspace outputs (chain further with input "output").',
    input: { ...BYTES, steps: z.array(z.object({ op: z.string(), arg: z.string().optional() })).describe('e.g. [{"op":"base64"},{"op":"xor","arg":"0x5A"}]'), out: OUTFMT, save_output: z.string().optional().describe('save resulting raw bytes as outputs/<name>'), ...OUT },
    run: (a, ctx) => {
      const { bytes, how } = getBytes(a, ctx);
      let cur = bytes; const trace: string[] = [];
      for (const s of a.steps) {
        try {
          if (NODE_OPS[s.op]) cur = NODE_OPS[s.op](cur);
          else { const r = Blob.runBlob(cur, [s]); if (r.trace[0]?.error) throw new Error(r.trace[0].error); cur = r.out; }
          trace.push(`  ${s.op}${s.arg ? `(${s.arg})` : ''} → ${cur.length} bytes`);
        } catch (e) { trace.push(`  ${s.op} FAILED: ${(e as Error).message}`); break; }
      }
      const files = a.save_output ? [ctx.ws.saveOutput(a.save_output, cur)] : [];
      return { text: `input: ${how}, ${bytes.length} bytes\n${trace.join('\n')}\nresult: ${info(cur)}${files.length ? `\nsaved ${files[0]}` : ''}\n\n${renderBytes(cur, a.out)}`, data: { length: cur.length, hex: cur.length <= 1 << 16 ? Blob.hexencode(cur) : undefined }, files };
    },
  }),
  defineTool({
    name: 'blob_info', title: 'Blob Lab: inspect', category: 'blob', readOnly: true,
    description: 'Inspect a blob: size, entropy, printable ratio, magic detection (Lua/Luau bytecode, zlib, gzip, zip, PNG, JSON, Lua source…), byte histogram and a hexdump head.',
    input: { ...BYTES, head: z.number().int().optional().describe('hexdump bytes (default 512)') },
    run: (a, ctx) => {
      const { bytes, how } = getBytes(a, ctx);
      const hist = new Map<number, number>(); for (const x of bytes) hist.set(x, (hist.get(x) ?? 0) + 1);
      const top = [...hist].sort((p, q) => q[1] - p[1]).slice(0, 16).map(([k, v]) => `0x${k.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}×${v}`).join(' ');
      return { text: `input: ${how}\n${info(bytes)}\ndistinct bytes: ${hist.size}, range ${bytes.length ? Math.min(...bytes.subarray(0, 1 << 16)) : 0}..${bytes.length ? Math.max(...bytes.subarray(0, 1 << 16)) : 0}\ntop bytes: ${top}\n\n${Blob.hexdump(bytes, a.head ?? 512)}`, data: { length: bytes.length, entropy: Blob.entropyBytes(bytes), printable: Blob.printableBytes(bytes), magic: Blob.detectMagic(bytes), distinct: hist.size } };
    },
  }),
  defineTool({
    name: 'blob_auto', title: 'Blob Lab: auto-decode', category: 'blob', readOnly: true,
    description: 'Try the common encodings (Lua escapes, hex, base64, decimal lists, IronBrew LZW base36, zlib) on a blob and rank the results by magic / printability / entropy.',
    input: { ...BYTES },
    run: (a, ctx) => {
      const { bytes, how } = getBytes(a, ctx);
      const r = Blob.autoDecode(bytes);
      for (const [op, fn] of Object.entries(NODE_OPS)) { try { const b = fn(bytes); r.push({ steps: [{ op }], len: b.length, printable: Blob.printableBytes(b), entropy: Blob.entropyBytes(b), magic: Blob.detectMagic(b), preview: Blob.unlatin1(b.subarray(0, 96)).replace(/[^\x20-\x7e]/g, '.') }); } catch { /* not compressed */ } }
      return { text: `input: ${how}, ${bytes.length} bytes\n\n` + table(r.map(x => [x.steps.map(s => s.op).join(' → ') || '(raw)', x.len, (x.printable * 100).toFixed(0) + '%', x.entropy.toFixed(2), x.magic.join(', '), x.preview]), ['steps', 'len', 'print', 'H', 'magic', 'preview']), data: r };
    },
  }),
  defineTool({
    name: 'blob_xor', title: 'Blob Lab: XOR key recovery', category: 'blob', readOnly: true,
    description: 'Recover XOR keys statically: single-byte brute force ranked by plaintext score, repeating-key length estimation (Hamming distance), or known-plaintext key recovery (e.g. known "\\27Lua" header or "local ").',
    input: { ...BYTES, mode: z.enum(['single', 'keylen', 'known']).optional(), known_plaintext: z.string().optional(), offset: z.number().int().optional() },
    run: (a, ctx) => {
      const { bytes } = getBytes(a, ctx);
      const mode = a.mode ?? (a.known_plaintext ? 'known' : 'single');
      if (mode === 'known') {
        if (!a.known_plaintext) throw new Error('known_plaintext required');
        const k = Blob.xorKnownPlaintext(bytes, Blob.luaUnescape(a.known_plaintext), a.offset ?? 0);
        return { text: `key bytes at offset ${a.offset ?? 0}: ${Blob.hexencode(k, ' ')}  (${JSON.stringify(Blob.unlatin1(k))})\nif the key repeats, look for the period in these bytes.`, data: { key: Array.from(k) } };
      }
      if (mode === 'keylen') { const r = Blob.xorKeyLengths(bytes); return { text: table(r.map(x => [x.len, x.dist]), ['key length', 'norm. hamming']), data: r }; }
      const r = Blob.xorSingleCandidates(bytes, 10);
      return { text: table(r.map(x => ['0x' + x.key.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'), x.key, x.score, x.preview]), ['key', 'dec', 'score', 'preview']), data: r };
    },
  }),
];

import { z } from 'zod';
import { defineTool } from '../types.js';
import { SRC, OUT, getSource } from '../source.js';
import { luaToPython, functionToPython, luaLiteralToJson } from '@prism/core';

export const transpileTools = [
  defineTool({
    name: 'python_transpile', title: 'Lua → Python', category: 'transpile', readOnly: true,
    description: 'Transpile Lua/Luau to standalone Python 3 with a faithful Lua-semantics prelude (tables, metatables, multiple returns, truthiness, string library incl. Lua patterns, bit32, math, utf8). Whole script, or just one function (by name / line) together with the local helper functions and static upvalues it depends on — ideal to port a constant/bytecode unpacker to Python and run it OUTSIDE of Lua. The output is only generated, never executed by PRISM.',
    input: { ...SRC, function: z.union([z.string(), z.number()]).optional().describe('function name or a line inside it (omit = whole script)'), prelude: z.boolean().optional().describe('include the Lua runtime prelude (default true)'), ...OUT },
    run: (a, ctx) => {
      const { src } = getSource(a, ctx);
      if (a.function !== undefined) {
        const r = functionToPython(src, a.function, { prelude: a.prelude ?? true });
        const head = `# PRISM: ${r.name} (line ${r.line})${r.deps?.length ? ` + deps: ${r.deps.join(', ')}` : ''}${r.freeNames.length ? `\n# free names (globals): ${r.freeNames.join(', ')}` : ''}${r.warnings.length ? '\n# warnings:\n' + r.warnings.map(w => '#   ' + w).join('\n') : ''}\n`;
        return { text: head + r.code, data: { name: r.name, line: r.line, deps: r.deps, warnings: r.warnings, freeNames: r.freeNames } };
      }
      const r = luaToPython(src, { prelude: a.prelude ?? true });
      const head = `${r.freeNames.length ? `# free names (globals): ${r.freeNames.join(', ')}\n` : ''}${r.warnings.length ? '# warnings:\n' + r.warnings.map(w => '#   ' + w).join('\n') + '\n' : ''}`;
      return { text: head + r.code, data: { warnings: r.warnings, freeNames: r.freeNames } };
    },
  }),
  defineTool({
    name: 'lua_literal_to_json', title: 'Lua literal → JSON', category: 'transpile', readOnly: true,
    description: 'Statically convert a Lua table/constant literal ({1,2,{x="y"}}) into JSON — handy for constant pools and instruction tables found in scripts (combine with get_lines / pattern_search).',
    input: { literal: z.string().optional(), ...SRC, line: z.number().int().optional().describe('with script_id/path/source: convert the table literal assigned/starting on this line'), ...OUT },
    run: (a, ctx) => {
      let lit = a.literal;
      if (!lit) {
        const { src } = getSource(a, ctx);
        if (a.line === undefined) lit = src;
        else {
          const lines = src.split('\n'); let off = 0; for (let i = 0; i < a.line - 1; i++) off += lines[i].length + 1;
          const start = src.indexOf('{', off); if (start < 0) throw new Error('no { on or after line ' + a.line);
          let depth = 0, i = start, q = '';
          for (; i < src.length; i++) { const c = src[i]; if (q) { if (c === '\\') i++; else if (c === q) q = ''; continue; } if (c === '"' || c === "'") q = c; else if (c === '{') depth++; else if (c === '}' && --depth === 0) break; }
          lit = src.slice(start, i + 1);
        }
      }
      const v = luaLiteralToJson(lit);
      return { text: JSON.stringify(v), data: v };
    },
  }),
];

const triage = defineTool({

  input: { ...SRC, name: z.string().optional().describe('base name for stored scripts') },

    const { src, scriptId, label } = getSource(a, ctx);
    const base = a.name ?? (scriptId ? ctx.ws.getMeta(scriptId).name : 'inline');
    const orig = scriptId ?? ctx.ws.addScript(base, src).id;
    const sec: string[] = [`# PRISM auto triage — ${label}`, `original script_id: ${orig}`];
    const run = async (n: string, args: Record<string, unknown>) => { try { return await runTool(n, args, ctx); } catch (e) { return { text: `(${n} failed: ${(e as Error).message})` } as ToolResult; } };
    const an = await run('analyze', { script_id: orig, max_chars: 4000 });
    sec.push('', '## analysis', an.text);
    const cl = await run('deobfuscate', { script_id: orig, rename: 'obfuscated', save_script_as: base.replace(/\.(lua|luau)$/i, '') + '.clean.lua', max_chars: 600 });
    const cleanId = (cl.data as { savedScriptId?: string } | undefined)?.savedScriptId;
    sec.push('', '## deobfuscate', cl.text.split('\n').slice(0, 3).join('\n'));
    const target = cleanId ?? orig;
    const co = await run('constants', { script_id: target, section: 'decoders', max: 8, max_chars: 5000 });
    sec.push('', '## decoder candidates (on cleaned code)', co.text);
    const ks = await run('constants', { script_id: target, section: 'keys', max: 8, max_chars: 2000 });
    sec.push('', '## key candidates', ks.text.split('\n').slice(1).join('\n'));
    const om = await run('opcode_map', { script_id: target, clean: false, lifted: false, max_trees: 4, max_chars: 4000 });
    sec.push('', '## dispatch / opcode map', om.text.split('\n').slice(0, 40).join('\n'));
    const eb = await run('find_embedded_bytecode', { script_id: orig });
    sec.push('', '## embedded bytecode', eb.text);
    sec.push('', '## next steps',
      `- read the top decoder: get_function {script_id:"${target}", query:<line>} → python_transpile {function:<name|line>}`,
      `- refine names: rename_symbols {script_id:"${target}", renames:[…], save_script_as:"…"}`,
      `- VM: opcode_map {script_id:"${target}", clean:false, code:true, save_opmap_as:"${base}"} → opmap_set to correct → vm_disasm`,
      `- blobs/keys: blob_auto / blob_transform / blob_xor {from_script:"${target}", string_line:N}`,
      `- record findings: workspace_note {script_id:"${target}", note:"…"}`);
    return { text: sec.join('\n'), data: { original: orig, cleaned: cleanId } };
  },
});

export const TOOLS: ToolDef[] = [...workspaceTools, triage, ...analysisTools, ...deobTools, ...searchTools, ...vmTools, ...bytecodeTools, ...blobTools, ...transpileTools] as unknown as ToolDef[];
const BY_NAME = new Map(TOOLS.map(t => [t.name, t]));
export const getTool = (name: string) => BY_NAME.get(name);

export const DEFAULT_MAX_CHARS = 60000;
/** validate args, run, apply save_as / max_chars */
export async function runTool(name: string, args: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: ToolContext): Promise<ToolResult & { truncated?: boolean; fullLength?: number }> {
  const t = BY_NAME.get(name);
  if (!t) throw new Error(`unknown tool "${name}". Available: ${TOOLS.map(x => x.name).join(', ')}`);
  const parsed = z.object(t.input).strict().safeParse(args ?? {});
  if (!parsed.success) throw new Error('invalid arguments: ' + parsed.error.issues.map(i => `${i.path.join('.') || '(root)'}: ${i.message}`).join('; '));
  const res = await t.run(parsed.data as never, ctx);
  const a = parsed.data as { save_as?: string; max_chars?: number };
  const files = [...(res.files ?? [])];
  if (a.save_as && !files.some(f => f.endsWith('/' + a.save_as))) files.push(ctx.ws.saveOutput(a.save_as, res.text));
  const max = a.max_chars ?? DEFAULT_MAX_CHARS;
  let text = res.text;
  let truncated = false;
  if (text.length > max) { truncated = true; text = text.slice(0, max) + `\n\n… [truncated: ${res.text.length - max} of ${res.text.length} chars omitted — raise max_chars or use save_as to keep the full output]`; }
  if (files.length) text += `\n\n[saved: ${files.join(', ')}]`;
  return { ...res, text, files, truncated, fullLength: res.text.length };
}

export interface ToolInfo { name: string; title: string; category: string; description: string; readOnly: boolean; inputSchema: Record<string, unknown>; }
export function listTools(): ToolInfo[] {
  return TOOLS.map(t => {
    const schema = zodToJsonSchema(z.object(t.input), { $refStrategy: 'none' }) as Record<string, unknown>;
    delete schema.$schema;
    return { name: t.name, title: t.title, category: t.category, description: t.description, readOnly: !!t.readOnly, inputSchema: schema };
  });
}
EOF

// Shared workflow guide: MCP server instructions, the prism_guide tool, MCP prompts and the web Help panel.
export const GUIDE = `PRISM — static reverse-engineering toolkit for obfuscated Lua 5.1 / Luau (Roblox) scripts.
STATIC ONLY: user scripts are never executed. Works for any obfuscator (generic passes + heuristics, nothing hardcoded per family).

INPUT: every analysis tool accepts exactly one of script_id (stored in the workspace), path (file on the server) or source (inline text).
OUTPUT: plain copyable text by default; format:"json" (where offered) returns structured data. Long output is cut at max_chars (default 60000) —
raise max_chars or pass save_as:"name.txt" to keep the full result in workspace outputs/ (read back with workspace_read_output).
Derived scripts (deobfuscate/rename_symbols/opcode_map save_script_as) keep lineage; workspace_list shows the tree.

RECOMMENDED WORKFLOW
1. Load:      workspace_add_script {path|source, name}  → script_id
2. Overview:  auto_triage {script_id}  (analyze + deobfuscate copy + decoder/key candidates + opcode map summary + embedded bytecode)
              or individually: analyze, fingerprint, vm_detect, list_functions, call_graph (text|json|dot|mermaid)
3. Junk:      deobfuscate {script_id, save_script_as} — constant folding, number/bit32/MBA simplification, opaque predicates,
              dead code, proxy/alias inlining, string decoding, renaming (rename: none|obfuscated|all). simplify_expression for one expression.
4. Unpacker:  constants {section:"decoders"|"keys"|"strings"|"numbers"|"arrays"} → get_function {query:<name|line>} → xrefs {name, line}
              → python_transpile {function} to port the constant/bytecode decoder to Python (keys usually derive from data inside the file).
              Blobs: strings, blob_info, blob_auto (guess the layer stack), blob_transform (base64/base85/hex/xor/rc4/zlib/… pipeline),
              blob_xor (known-plaintext / repeating-key recovery).
5. VM:        opcode_map {script_id, save_opmap_as} (dispatch trees → handler classes → guessed mnemonics) → opmap_get / opmap_set to fix names
              → vm_disasm {instructions, opmap} on decoded instruction arrays (lua_literal_to_json converts Lua tables to JSON).
6. Bytecode:  find_embedded_bytecode → bytecode_disasm (Luau v3–v14, Roblox op*227 encoding, Lua 5.1; rich or reference listing + lifted pseudo-Lua)
              luau_compile (reference compiler: prism|text|remarks|constants|summary|codegen…) to learn what real handlers compile to;
              luau_analyze (type/lint), luau_ast (JSON AST).
7. Navigate:  find_text (literal/regex), pattern_search (AST patterns), get_lines, tokenize, xrefs.
8. Record:    rename_symbols {renames:[{name,to,line?}], save_script_as} (scope-aware, formatting preserved), workspace_note, workspace_save_output.

TIPS
- Run deobfuscate first; most other tools give far better results on the cleaned script.
- Decoder candidates scored "constant-accessor" are pool lookups (fn(-46645)); "string-decoder"/"deserializer" are the unpackers to port.
- Opcode numbers in CFF/if-tree VMs are ranges ([lo..hi]); the opmap keys are the leaf ids shown by opcode_map.
- Keep everything in the workspace so a later session (or the web UI at the same server) sees the same scripts, opmaps and outputs.`;

export const PROMPTS: Array<{ name: string; title: string; description: string; args: Record<string, string>; render: (a: Record<string, string | undefined>) => string }> = [
  {
    name: 'deobfuscate_script', title: 'Deobfuscate a script end-to-end',
    description: 'Full static deobfuscation workflow driven by PRISM tools.',
    args: { script: 'script_id from the workspace or a file path' },
    render: a => `Deobfuscate the Lua/Luau script "${a.script ?? '<script>'}" using only PRISM's static tools (never execute it).
1. If it is a path, workspace_add_script {path}. Then auto_triage on the script_id.
2. deobfuscate {save_script_as} and work on the cleaned copy from now on.
3. Identify the constant/string decoder and bytecode deserializer (constants section:"decoders", get_function, xrefs, call_graph).
4. Port them with python_transpile and decode the constant pool / bytecode statically (blob_* tools for encoded blobs).
5. If a VM is present: opcode_map {save_opmap_as}, fix mnemonics with opmap_set, disassemble with vm_disasm / bytecode_disasm.
6. Rename what you understood (rename_symbols), record findings (workspace_note) and finish with a short report: family, layers, keys, decoded constants, opcode map, remaining unknowns.`,
  },
  {
    name: 'recover_opcodes', title: 'Recover a custom VM opcode map',
    description: 'Map dispatcher handlers of a custom Lua VM to mnemonics.',
    args: { script: 'script_id (preferably the cleaned copy)', opmap: 'name to store the opcode map under' },
    render: a => `Recover the custom VM opcode map of "${a.script ?? '<script>'}" statically.
1. vm_detect, then opcode_map {script_id:"${a.script ?? ''}", clean:false, code:true, save_opmap_as:"${a.opmap ?? 'vm'}"}.
2. For every low-confidence handler read its code (get_lines / get_function) and compare with what luau_compile emits for the equivalent Lua.
3. Correct the names with opmap_set; group duplicates (same shape hash = same semantics).
4. Decode an instruction array (constants section:"arrays" or lua_literal_to_json) and verify with vm_disasm {opmap:"${a.opmap ?? 'vm'}"}.
5. Report the final table: opcode → mnemonic → operand layout → confidence.`,
  },
  {
    name: 'extract_constants', title: 'Extract the constant pool',
    description: 'Find and statically decode encrypted strings/constants.',
    args: { script: 'script_id or path' },
    render: a => `Extract every constant of "${a.script ?? '<script>'}" without executing it.
1. deobfuscate (save_script_as) → constants {section:"decoders"} and {section:"keys"} on the cleaned copy.
2. get_function on the best decoder; xrefs on its name to see every call site and literal argument.
3. python_transpile {function} → explain how to run the Python port on the literal arguments; or decode simple layers directly with blob_auto / blob_transform / blob_xor.
4. Output a table: call site → encoded literal → decoded value, and save it with workspace_save_output.`,
  },
  {
    name: 'port_to_python', title: 'Port a decoder to Python',
    description: 'Translate a Lua decoder/unpacker function into standalone Python.',
    args: { script: 'script_id or path', function: 'function name or line number' },
    render: a => `Port the function "${a.function ?? '<fn>'}" of "${a.script ?? '<script>'}" to standalone Python 3.
1. get_function {query:"${a.function ?? ''}"} to read it; xrefs for the helpers and upvalues it uses.
2. python_transpile {function:"${a.function ?? ''}"} — then fix anything flagged (1-based indexing, integer division, bit32 semantics, string bytes).
3. Include every helper and key table it needs so the script runs on its own, and show how to call it on the literals found in the file.`,
  },
];
EOF

// PRISM MCP server: exposes every tool of the shared registry, the workspace as resources and workflow prompts.
import { McpServer, ResourceTemplate } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/mcp.js';
import { StreamableHTTPServerTransport } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/streamableHttp.js';
import type { IncomingMessage, ServerResponse } from 'node:http';
import { readFileSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { resolve } from 'node:path';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { TOOLS, runTool, listTools, GUIDE, PROMPTS, REPO_ROOT, type ToolContext } from '@prism/tools';

export const VERSION = '0.1.0';

const DESTRUCTIVE = new Set(['workspace_delete']);

function textOf(buf: Buffer): { text?: string; blob?: string } {
  const t = buf.toString('utf8');
  // binary when it has NULs or many replacement chars
  if (/\u0000/.test(t) || (t.match(/\uFFFD/g)?.length ?? 0) > t.length / 50) return { blob: buf.toString('base64') };
  return { text: t };
}

export function buildMcpServer(ctx: ToolContext): McpServer {
  const server = new McpServer({ name: 'prism', title: 'PRISM static Luau reverse engine', version: VERSION }, { instructions: GUIDE, capabilities: { logging: {} } });

  for (const t of TOOLS) {
    server.registerTool(t.name, {
      title: t.title,
      description: t.description,
      inputSchema: t.input,
      annotations: { title: t.title, readOnlyHint: !!t.readOnly, destructiveHint: DESTRUCTIVE.has(t.name), idempotentHint: !!t.readOnly, openWorldHint: false },
    }, async (args: Record<string, unknown>) => {
      try {
        const r = await runTool(t.name, args ?? {}, ctx);
        return { content: [{ type: 'text' as const, text: r.text || '(empty result)' }] };
      } catch (e) {
        return { content: [{ type: 'text' as const, text: `error in ${t.name}: ${(e as Error).message}` }], isError: true };
      }
    });
  }

  // ---------- resources ----------
  server.registerResource('guide', 'prism://guide', { title: 'PRISM workflow guide', description: 'How to drive the PRISM tools for static deobfuscation', mimeType: 'text/markdown' },
    async uri => ({ contents: [{ uri: uri.href, mimeType: 'text/markdown', text: GUIDE }] }));
  server.registerResource('tools', 'prism://tools', { title: 'Tool catalog (JSON schemas)', mimeType: 'application/json' },
    async uri => ({ contents: [{ uri: uri.href, mimeType: 'application/json', text: JSON.stringify(listTools(), null, 2) }] }));
  server.registerResource('workspace', 'prism://workspace', { title: 'Workspace index', description: 'stored scripts (with lineage), opcode maps and outputs', mimeType: 'application/json' },
    async uri => ({ contents: [{ uri: uri.href, mimeType: 'application/json', text: JSON.stringify({ root: ctx.ws.root, scripts: ctx.ws.listScripts(), opmaps: ctx.ws.listOpmaps(), outputs: ctx.ws.listOutputs() }, null, 2) }] }));
  const techniques = resolve(REPO_ROOT, 'docs/STATIC-TECHNIQUES.md');
  if (existsSync(techniques)) server.registerResource('techniques', 'prism://docs/static-techniques', { title: 'Static technique catalog', mimeType: 'text/markdown' },
    async uri => ({ contents: [{ uri: uri.href, mimeType: 'text/markdown', text: readFileSync(techniques, 'utf8') }] }));

  server.registerResource('script', new ResourceTemplate('prism://scripts/{id}', {
    list: async () => ({ resources: ctx.ws.listScripts().map(m => ({ uri: `prism://scripts/${m.id}`, name: m.name, title: `${m.name} (${m.id})`, mimeType: 'text/x-lua', description: `${m.size} bytes, ${m.lines} lines${m.derivedBy ? `, ${m.derivedBy} of ${m.parent}` : ''}` })) }),
    complete: { id: v => ctx.ws.listScripts().map(m => m.id).filter(id => id.startsWith(v)) },
  }), { title: 'Workspace script source', mimeType: 'text/x-lua' },
    async (uri, vars) => ({ contents: [{ uri: uri.href, mimeType: 'text/x-lua', text: ctx.ws.getScript(String(vars.id)) }] }));

  server.registerResource('output', new ResourceTemplate('prism://outputs/{name}', {
    list: async () => ({ resources: ctx.ws.listOutputs().map(o => ({ uri: `prism://outputs/${encodeURIComponent(o.name)}`, name: o.name, description: `${o.size} bytes, ${o.modified}` })) }),
    complete: { name: v => ctx.ws.listOutputs().map(o => o.name).filter(n => n.startsWith(v)) },
  }), { title: 'Workspace output file' },
    async (uri, vars) => {
      const name = decodeURIComponent(String(vars.name));
      const c = textOf(ctx.ws.readOutput(name));
      return { contents: [c.text !== undefined ? { uri: uri.href, mimeType: 'text/plain', text: c.text } : { uri: uri.href, mimeType: 'application/octet-stream', blob: c.blob! }] };
    });

  server.registerResource('opmap', new ResourceTemplate('prism://opmaps/{name}', {
    list: async () => ({ resources: ctx.ws.listOpmaps().map(n => ({ uri: `prism://opmaps/${encodeURIComponent(n)}`, name: n, mimeType: 'application/json' })) }),
    complete: { name: v => ctx.ws.listOpmaps().filter(n => n.startsWith(v)) },
  }), { title: 'Stored opcode map', mimeType: 'application/json' },
    async (uri, vars) => ({ contents: [{ uri: uri.href, mimeType: 'application/json', text: JSON.stringify(ctx.ws.getOpmap(decodeURIComponent(String(vars.name))), null, 2) }] }));

  // ---------- prompts ----------
  for (const p of PROMPTS) {
    const shape: Record<string, z.ZodOptional<z.ZodString>> = {};
    for (const [k, d] of Object.entries(p.args)) shape[k] = z.string().optional().describe(d);
    server.registerPrompt(p.name, { title: p.title, description: p.description, argsSchema: shape },
      (a: Record<string, string | undefined>) => ({ messages: [{ role: 'user' as const, content: { type: 'text' as const, text: p.render(a) } }] }));
  }
  return server;
}

/** Stateless Streamable-HTTP handler (one short-lived server per request). Mount at POST /mcp. */
export async function handleMcpHttp(req: IncomingMessage, res: ServerResponse, ctx: ToolContext, body?: unknown, allowedHosts?: string[]): Promise<void> {
  if (req.method !== 'POST') {
    res.writeHead(405, { 'content-type': 'application/json', allow: 'POST' }).end(JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', error: { code: -32000, message: 'Method not allowed (stateless server: use POST)' }, id: null }));
    return;
  }
  const server = buildMcpServer(ctx);
  const transport = new StreamableHTTPServerTransport({ sessionIdGenerator: undefined, enableJsonResponse: true, ...(allowedHosts ? { allowedHosts, enableDnsRebindingProtection: true } : {}) });
  res.on('close', () => { void transport.close(); void server.close(); });
  try {
    await server.connect(transport);
    await transport.handleRequest(req, res, body);
  } catch (e) {
    if (!res.headersSent) res.writeHead(500, { 'content-type': 'application/json' }).end(JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', error: { code: -32603, message: (e as Error).message }, id: null }));
  }
}
EOF
cat > src/server.ts <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env -S npx tsx
// PRISM MCP server entry point.
//   stdio (default):   tsx apps/mcp/src/server.ts [--workspace DIR] [--luau DIR]
//   HTTP:              tsx apps/mcp/src/server.ts --http 7778 [--host 127.0.0.1]   → POST http://127.0.0.1:7778/mcp
import { createServer } from 'node:http';
import { StdioServerTransport } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/stdio.js';
import { createContext } from '@prism/tools';
import { buildMcpServer, handleMcpHttp, VERSION } from './mcp.js';

function arg(name: string): string | undefined {
  const i = process.argv.indexOf('--' + name);
  if (i >= 0) return process.argv[i + 1];
  const eq = process.argv.find(a => a.startsWith(`--${name}=`));
  return eq?.slice(name.length + 3);
}
if (process.argv.includes('--help') || process.argv.includes('-h')) {
  process.stderr.write(`prism-mcp ${VERSION}\n  --workspace DIR   workspace folder (default <repo>/workspace or $PRISM_WORKSPACE)\n  --luau DIR        native luau tools folder (default <repo>/tools/luau)\n  --http PORT       serve Streamable HTTP on /mcp instead of stdio\n  --host HOST       bind address for --http (default 127.0.0.1)\n`);
  process.exit(0);
}
const ctx = createContext({ workspace: arg('workspace'), luauDir: arg('luau') });
const httpPort = arg('http');

if (httpPort) {
  const host = arg('host') ?? '127.0.0.1';
  const port = Number(httpPort);
  const allowed = host === '127.0.0.1' || host === 'localhost' ? [`127.0.0.1:${port}`, `localhost:${port}`] : undefined;
  createServer(async (req, res) => {
    const url = new URL(req.url ?? '/', 'http://x');
    if (url.pathname !== '/mcp') { res.writeHead(404, { 'content-type': 'text/plain' }).end('PRISM MCP — POST JSON-RPC to /mcp'); return; }
    let body: unknown;
    if (req.method === 'POST') {
      const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
      for await (const c of req) chunks.push(c as Buffer);
      try { body = JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8')); } catch { res.writeHead(400, { 'content-type': 'application/json' }).end(JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', error: { code: -32700, message: 'Parse error' }, id: null })); return; }
    }
    await handleMcpHttp(req, res, ctx, body, allowed);
  }).listen(port, host, () => process.stderr.write(`PRISM MCP (Streamable HTTP) on http://${host}:${port}/mcp — workspace ${ctx.ws.root}\n`));
} else {
  // stdout belongs to the protocol: route stray logging to stderr
  for (const k of ['log', 'info', 'debug'] as const) console[k] = (...a: unknown[]) => process.stderr.write(a.map(String).join(' ') + '\n');
  const server = buildMcpServer(ctx);
  await server.connect(new StdioServerTransport());
  process.stderr.write(`PRISM MCP ${VERSION} ready on stdio — workspace ${ctx.ws.root}\n`);
}
EOF

// PRISM backend: serves the web UI, the tool HTTP API, the workspace and the MCP endpoint on one local port.
//   tsx apps/server/src/server.ts [--port 7777] [--host 127.0.0.1] [--workspace DIR] [--luau DIR]
import { createServer, type IncomingMessage, type ServerResponse } from 'node:http';
import { existsSync, readFileSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';
import { resolve, join, extname, normalize, sep } from 'node:path';
import { createContext, listTools, runTool, getTool, REPO_ROOT, TOOLS, GUIDE } from '@prism/tools';
import { decodeText } from '../../../packages/tools/src/workspace.js';
import { handleMcpHttp, VERSION } from '../../mcp/src/mcp.js';

function arg(name: string): string | undefined {
  const i = process.argv.indexOf('--' + name);
  if (i >= 0) return process.argv[i + 1];
  return process.argv.find(a => a.startsWith(`--${name}=`))?.slice(name.length + 3);
}
const PORT = Number(arg('port') ?? process.env.PRISM_PORT ?? 7777);
const HOST = arg('host') ?? process.env.PRISM_HOST ?? '127.0.0.1';
const ctx = createContext({ workspace: arg('workspace'), luauDir: arg('luau') });
const DIST = resolve(arg('web') ?? resolve(REPO_ROOT, 'apps/web/dist'));
const MAX_BODY = 96 * 1024 * 1024;
const LOCAL = HOST === '127.0.0.1' || HOST === 'localhost' || HOST === '::1';
const ALLOWED_HOSTS = [`127.0.0.1:${PORT}`, `localhost:${PORT}`, `[::1]:${PORT}`];

const MIME: Record<string, string> = {
  '.html': 'text/html; charset=utf-8', '.js': 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8', '.mjs': 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8', '.css': 'text/css; charset=utf-8',
  '.json': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', '.svg': 'image/svg+xml', '.png': 'image/png', '.ico': 'image/x-icon', '.woff2': 'font/woff2', '.woff': 'font/woff',
  '.ttf': 'font/ttf', '.lua': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8', '.luau': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8', '.txt': 'text/plain; charset=utf-8', '.map': 'application/json', '.wasm': 'application/wasm',
};

const send = (res: ServerResponse, code: number, body: unknown, headers: Record<string, string> = {}) => {
  const isBuf = Buffer.isBuffer(body) || typeof body === 'string';
  res.writeHead(code, { 'content-type': isBuf ? 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' : 'application/json; charset=utf-8', 'cache-control': 'no-store', ...headers });
  res.end(isBuf ? body : JSON.stringify(body));
};
async function readBody(req: IncomingMessage): Promise<Buffer> {
  const chunks: Buffer[] = []; let n = 0;
  for await (const c of req) { n += (c as Buffer).length; if (n > MAX_BODY) throw Object.assign(new Error('request body too large'), { status: 413 }); chunks.push(c as Buffer); }
  return Buffer.concat(chunks);
}
const json = async (req: IncomingMessage) => { const b = await readBody(req); if (!b.length) return {}; try { return JSON.parse(b.toString('utf8')); } catch { throw Object.assign(new Error('invalid JSON body'), { status: 400 }); } };

function luauStatus() {
  const has = (b: string) => existsSync(join(ctx.luauDir, b));
  return { dir: ctx.luauDir, compile: has('luau-compile'), analyze: has('luau-analyze'), ast: has('luau-ast') };
}

async function api(req: IncomingMessage, res: ServerResponse, url: URL) {
  const parts = url.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean).slice(1).map(decodeURIComponent); // drop "api"
  const m = req.method ?? 'GET';
  const [a, b, c, d] = parts;
  if (a === 'health') return send(res, 200, { ok: true, name: 'prism', version: VERSION, workspace: ctx.ws.root, luau: luauStatus(), tools: TOOLS.length, mcp: `http://${req.headers.host}/mcp` });
  if (a === 'guide') return send(res, 200, { guide: GUIDE });
  if (a === 'tools' && m === 'GET') return send(res, 200, listTools());
  if (a === 'tool' && b && m === 'POST') {
    if (!getTool(b)) return send(res, 404, { ok: false, error: `unknown tool "${b}"` });
    const args = await json(req);
    const t0 = performance.now();
    try {
      const r = await runTool(b, args, ctx);
      return send(res, 200, { ok: true, tool: b, ms: Math.round(performance.now() - t0), text: r.text, data: r.data ?? null, files: r.files ?? [], truncated: !!r.truncated, fullLength: r.fullLength });
    } catch (e) {
      return send(res, 200, { ok: false, tool: b, ms: Math.round(performance.now() - t0), error: (e as Error).message });
    }
  }
  if (a === 'workspace') {
    if (!b) return send(res, 200, { root: ctx.ws.root, scripts: ctx.ws.listScripts(), opmaps: ctx.ws.listOpmaps(), outputs: ctx.ws.listOutputs() });
    if (b === 'scripts') {
      if (!c && m === 'GET') return send(res, 200, ctx.ws.listScripts());
      if (!c && m === 'POST') {
        // raw upload (?name=) keeps the exact bytes; JSON {name, source} for pasted text
        const ct = String(req.headers['content-type'] ?? '');
        if (ct.includes('application/json')) {
          const j = await json(req) as { name?: string; source?: string; parent?: string; derivedBy?: string };
          if (typeof j.source !== 'string') return send(res, 400, { error: 'missing "source"' });
          return send(res, 200, ctx.ws.addScript(j.name || 'pasted.lua', j.source, { ...(j.parent ? { parent: j.parent } : {}), ...(j.derivedBy ? { derivedBy: j.derivedBy } : {}) }));
        }
        const buf = await readBody(req);
        const { text, encoding } = decodeText(buf);
        return send(res, 200, ctx.ws.addScript(url.searchParams.get('name') || 'upload.lua', text, { encoding }));
      }
      if (c && !d && m === 'GET') return send(res, 200, { meta: ctx.ws.getMeta(c), source: ctx.ws.getScript(c) });
      if (c && d === 'raw' && m === 'GET') { const meta = ctx.ws.getMeta(c); return send(res, 200, Buffer.from(ctx.ws.getScript(c), meta.encoding === 'latin1' ? 'latin1' : 'utf8'), { 'content-disposition': `attachment; filename="${meta.name.replace(/"/g, '')}"` }); }
      if (c && !d && m === 'DELETE') { ctx.ws.getMeta(c); ctx.ws.deleteScript(c); return send(res, 200, { ok: true }); }
      if (c && !d && m === 'PATCH') { const j = await json(req) as Record<string, unknown>; const patch: Record<string, unknown> = {}; for (const k of ['name', 'tags', 'notes']) if (k in j) patch[k] = j[k]; return send(res, 200, ctx.ws.updateMeta(c, patch)); }
    }
    if (b === 'opmaps') {
      if (!c) return send(res, 200, ctx.ws.listOpmaps());
      if (m === 'GET') return send(res, 200, ctx.ws.getOpmap(c));
      if (m === 'PUT' || m === 'POST') { const j = await json(req); if (!j || typeof j !== 'object' || Array.isArray(j)) return send(res, 400, { error: 'opmap must be a JSON object' }); return send(res, 200, { ok: true, file: ctx.ws.setOpmap(c, j as Record<string, unknown>) }); }
      if (m === 'DELETE') { ctx.ws.deleteOpmap(c); return send(res, 200, { ok: true }); }
    }
    if (b === 'outputs') {
      if (!c) return send(res, 200, ctx.ws.listOutputs());
      if (m === 'GET') return send(res, 200, ctx.ws.readOutput(c), { 'content-type': MIME[extname(c)] ?? 'application/octet-stream', ...(url.searchParams.has('download') ? { 'content-disposition': `attachment; filename="${c.replace(/"/g, '')}"` } : {}) });
      if (m === 'PUT' || m === 'POST') { const buf = await readBody(req); return send(res, 200, { ok: true, file: ctx.ws.saveOutput(c, buf) }); }
      if (m === 'DELETE') { ctx.ws.deleteOutput(c); return send(res, 200, { ok: true }); }
    }
  }
  return send(res, 404, { error: `no route ${m} ${url.pathname}` });
}

function serveStatic(req: IncomingMessage, res: ServerResponse, url: URL) {
  if (!existsSync(DIST)) return send(res, 503, `PRISM web UI is not built yet.\nRun:  npm run build:web   (then reload)\nAPI: /api/health, /api/tools — MCP: POST /mcp`);
  let rel = normalize(decodeURIComponent(url.pathname)).replace(/^([/\\])+/, '');
  let file = join(DIST, rel);
  if (!file.startsWith(DIST + sep) && file !== DIST) return send(res, 403, 'forbidden');
  if (!rel || !existsSync(file) || statSync(file).isDirectory()) file = join(DIST, 'index.html'); // SPA fallback
  const ext = extname(file);
  const immutable = rel.startsWith('assets/');
  res.writeHead(200, { 'content-type': MIME[ext] ?? 'application/octet-stream', 'cache-control': immutable ? 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable' : 'no-cache' });
  res.end(readFileSync(file));
}

const server = createServer(async (req, res) => {
  const url = new URL(req.url ?? '/', 'http://local');
  try {
    // DNS-rebinding guard for the default local bind
    if (LOCAL && req.headers.host && !ALLOWED_HOSTS.includes(req.headers.host)) return send(res, 403, 'forbidden host');
    if (url.pathname === '/mcp') {
      let body: unknown;
      if (req.method === 'POST') body = await json(req);
      return await handleMcpHttp(req, res, ctx, body, LOCAL ? ALLOWED_HOSTS : undefined);
    }
    if (url.pathname.startsWith('/api/')) return await api(req, res, url);
    if (req.method !== 'GET' && req.method !== 'HEAD') return send(res, 405, 'method not allowed');
    return serveStatic(req, res, url);
  } catch (e) {
    const err = e as Error & { status?: number };
    const status = err.status ?? (/unknown (script_id|opmap|output)/.test(err.message) ? 404 : 500);
    if (!res.headersSent) send(res, status, { ok: false, error: err.message });
    else res.end();
  }
});
server.requestTimeout = 0; // long analyses are fine locally
server.listen(PORT, HOST, () => {
  const l = luauStatus();
  process.stdout.write(`\n  PRISM ${VERSION} — static Luau reverse engine\n  web  http://${HOST === '0.0.0.0' ? '127.0.0.1' : HOST}:${PORT}/\n  api  http://${HOST}:${PORT}/api/tools  (${TOOLS.length} tools)\n  mcp  http://${HOST}:${PORT}/mcp  (Streamable HTTP)\n  workspace ${ctx.ws.root}\n  luau ${l.compile ? 'luau-compile ✓' : 'luau-compile ✗'} ${l.analyze ? 'luau-analyze ✓' : 'luau-analyze ✗'} ${l.ast ? 'luau-ast ✓' : 'luau-ast ✗'}\n  ui   ${existsSync(DIST) ? DIST : 'NOT BUILT — run npm run build:web'}\n\n`);
});
EOF
cd /data/prism && node_modules/.bin/tsc -p apps/server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && echo SERVER-TSC-OK

// Backend client (PRISM server). Every call degrades gracefully when the UI runs as a static site.
export interface ToolInfo { name: string; title: string; category: string; description: string; readOnly: boolean; inputSchema: JsonSchema; }
export interface JsonSchema { type?: string | string[]; properties?: Record<string, JsonSchema>; required?: string[]; enum?: unknown[]; items?: JsonSchema; description?: string; default?: unknown; anyOf?: JsonSchema[]; minimum?: number; maximum?: number; additionalProperties?: unknown; }
export interface ToolRun { ok: boolean; tool: string; ms: number; text?: string; data?: unknown; files?: string[]; truncated?: boolean; fullLength?: number; error?: string; }
export interface ScriptMeta { id: string; name: string; size: number; lines: number; sha1: string; created: string; updated: string; encoding: string; parent?: string; derivedBy?: string; tags: string[]; notes: string[]; }
export interface Health { ok: boolean; name: string; version: string; workspace: string; luau: { dir: string; compile: boolean; analyze: boolean; ast: boolean }; tools: number; mcp: string; }
export interface WorkspaceIndex { root: string; scripts: ScriptMeta[]; opmaps: string[]; outputs: Array<{ name: string; size: number; modified: string }>; }

const BASE = (import.meta as any).env?.VITE_PRISM_API ?? '';

async function req<T>(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  const r = await fetch(BASE + path, init);
  const ct = r.headers.get('content-type') ?? '';
  const body = ct.includes('application/json') ? await r.json() : await r.text();
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error(typeof body === 'object' && body && 'error' in body ? String((body as any).error) : `HTTP ${r.status}`);
  return body as T;
}
const jsonInit = (method: string, body: unknown): RequestInit => ({ method, headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });

export const api = {
  health: async (): Promise<Health | null> => {
    try {
      const ctl = new AbortController(); const t = setTimeout(() => ctl.abort(), 2500);
      const h = await req<Health>('/api/health', { signal: ctl.signal }); clearTimeout(t);
      return h?.ok ? h : null;
    } catch { return null; }
  },
  tools: () => req<ToolInfo[]>('/api/tools'),
  guide: () => req<{ guide: string }>('/api/guide'),
  run: (name: string, args: Record<string, unknown>) => req<ToolRun>('/api/tool/' + encodeURIComponent(name), jsonInit('POST', args)),
  workspace: () => req<WorkspaceIndex>('/api/workspace'),
  addScript: (name: string, source: string, extra: { parent?: string; derivedBy?: string } = {}) => req<ScriptMeta>('/api/workspace/scripts', jsonInit('POST', { name, source, ...extra })),
  uploadScript: (name: string, bytes: ArrayBuffer) => req<ScriptMeta>('/api/workspace/scripts?name=' + encodeURIComponent(name), { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/octet-stream' }, body: bytes }),
  getScript: (id: string) => req<{ meta: ScriptMeta; source: string }>('/api/workspace/scripts/' + encodeURIComponent(id)),
  deleteScript: (id: string) => req<{ ok: boolean }>('/api/workspace/scripts/' + encodeURIComponent(id), { method: 'DELETE' }),
  patchScript: (id: string, patch: Partial<Pick<ScriptMeta, 'name' | 'tags' | 'notes'>>) => req<ScriptMeta>('/api/workspace/scripts/' + encodeURIComponent(id), jsonInit('PATCH', patch)),
  rawScriptUrl: (id: string) => BASE + '/api/workspace/scripts/' + encodeURIComponent(id) + '/raw',
  opmaps: () => req<string[]>('/api/workspace/opmaps'),
  getOpmap: (name: string) => req<Record<string, unknown>>('/api/workspace/opmaps/' + encodeURIComponent(name)),
  putOpmap: (name: string, map: Record<string, unknown>) => req<{ ok: boolean; file: string }>('/api/workspace/opmaps/' + encodeURIComponent(name), jsonInit('PUT', map)),
  deleteOpmap: (name: string) => req<{ ok: boolean }>('/api/workspace/opmaps/' + encodeURIComponent(name), { method: 'DELETE' }),
  outputUrl: (name: string, download = false) => BASE + '/api/workspace/outputs/' + encodeURIComponent(name) + (download ? '?download=1' : ''),
  readOutput: async (name: string) => { const r = await fetch(api.outputUrl(name)); if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status); return new Uint8Array(await r.arrayBuffer()); },
  saveOutput: (name: string, content: string | Uint8Array) => req<{ ok: boolean; file: string }>('/api/workspace/outputs/' + encodeURIComponent(name), { method: 'PUT', body: content as BodyInit }),
  deleteOutput: (name: string) => req<{ ok: boolean }>('/api/workspace/outputs/' + encodeURIComponent(name), { method: 'DELETE' }),
};
EOF

/// <reference lib="webworker" />
// PRISM engine worker — every static analysis runs here, off the main thread, fully offline.
import {
  analyze, clean, tokenize, mapOpcodes, formatOpcodeTree, opmapFromTree, constants, searchPattern, xrefs, getFunction,
  luaToPython, functionToPython, renameSymbols, simplifyExpression, findEmbeddedBytecode, disassembleBytecode,
  vmDisassemble, luaLiteralToJson, lex, Blob,
} from '@prism/core';

type Req = { id: number; op: string; src: string; opts?: any };

function findText(src: string, o: { query: string; regex?: boolean; caseSensitive?: boolean; word?: boolean; max?: number }) {
  const lines = src.split('\n');
  const max = o.max ?? 2000;
  let re: RegExp;
  const flags = o.caseSensitive ? 'g' : 'gi';
  if (o.regex) re = new RegExp(o.query, flags);
  else { const e = o.query.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&'); re = new RegExp(o.word ? `(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])${e}(?![A-Za-z0-9_])` : e, flags); }
  const hits: Array<{ line: number; col: number; text: string; match: string }> = [];
  let total = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    re.lastIndex = 0; let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
    while ((m = re.exec(lines[i]))) {
      total++;
      if (hits.length < max) {
        const s = Math.max(0, m.index - 60);
        hits.push({ line: i + 1, col: m.index + 1, text: (s > 0 ? '…' : '') + lines[i].slice(s, m.index + m[0].length + 100), match: m[0] });
      }
      if (!m[0].length) re.lastIndex++;
    }
  }
  return { hits, total };
}

function stringLiterals(src: string, line: number) {
  const { tokens } = lex(src);
  return tokens.filter(t => t.line === line && T_STRING.has(t.type)).map(t => ({ col: t.col, len: t.cooked?.length ?? 0, cooked: t.cooked ?? '' }));
}
// token types of string literals (lexer enum names)
const T_STRING = new Set<number>();

function blobInfo(b: Uint8Array) {
  return { length: b.length, entropy: Blob.entropyBytes(b), printable: Blob.printableBytes(b), magic: Blob.detectMagic(b), hexdump: Blob.hexdump(b, 8192) };
}

self.onmessage = (e: MessageEvent<Req>) => {
  const { id, op, src, opts = {} } = e.data;
  const t0 = performance.now();
  try {
    let result: any;
    switch (op) {
      case 'analyze': result = analyze(src); break;
      case 'clean': result = clean(src, opts); break;
      case 'tokenize': result = tokenize(src); break;
      case 'full': result = { report: analyze(src), clean: clean(src, opts ?? { rounds: 4 }) }; break;
      case 'opcodes': {
        const r = mapOpcodes(src, { clean: false, maxTrees: opts.maxTrees ?? 8, minLeaves: opts.minLeaves });
        result = { report: r.report, opmaps: r.report.trees.map(t => opmapFromTree(t)), texts: r.report.trees.map(t => formatOpcodeTree(t, { lifted: true })) };
        break;
      }
      case 'constants': result = constants(src, opts); break;
      case 'find': result = findText(src, opts); break;
      case 'pattern': result = searchPattern(src, opts.pattern, { max: opts.max ?? 500, kind: opts.kind }); break;
      case 'xrefs': result = xrefs(src, opts.name, { line: opts.line || undefined, max: opts.max }); break;
      case 'getFunction': result = getFunction(src, opts.query); break;
      case 'python': result = opts.fn !== undefined && opts.fn !== '' ? functionToPython(src, opts.fn, { prelude: opts.prelude }) : luaToPython(src, { prelude: opts.prelude }); break;
      case 'rename': result = renameSymbols(src, opts.renames); break;
      case 'simplify': result = simplifyExpression(opts.expr, opts.clean ?? {}); break;
      case 'embedded': result = findEmbeddedBytecode(src, { max: opts.max ?? 50 }); break;
      case 'disasm': result = disassembleBytecode(opts.bytes as Uint8Array, opts.options ?? {}); break;
      case 'blob': { const r = Blob.runBlob(opts.bytes as Uint8Array, opts.steps ?? []); result = { out: r.out, trace: r.trace, info: blobInfo(r.out) }; break; }
      case 'blobAuto': result = Blob.autoDecode(opts.bytes as Uint8Array); break;
      case 'xor': {
        const b = opts.bytes as Uint8Array;
        result = { single: Blob.xorSingleCandidates(b, 8), lengths: Blob.xorKeyLengths(b, 32).slice(0, 8), known: opts.plain ? Array.from(Blob.xorKnownPlaintext(b, Blob.latin1(opts.plain), opts.offset ?? 0)) : null };
        break;
      }
      case 'vmdisasm': result = vmDisassemble(opts.instructions, opts.opmap ?? {}, opts.options ?? {}); break;
      case 'literal': result = luaLiteralToJson(opts.text); break;
      case 'stringsOnLine': result = stringLiterals(src, opts.line); break;
      default: throw new Error('unknown op ' + op);
    }
    (self as any).postMessage({ id, ok: true, result, ms: Math.round(performance.now() - t0) });
  } catch (err: any) {
    (self as any).postMessage({ id, ok: false, error: String(err?.message || err) });
  }
};
EOF

// Typed promise bridge to the engine worker. A crashed/hung worker is replaced transparently.
import type { FullReport, CleanResult } from '@prism/core';

let worker: Worker | null = null;
let seq = 1;
const pending = new Map<number, { resolve: (v: any) => void; reject: (e: any) => void }>();

function getWorker(): Worker {
  if (!worker) {
    worker = new Worker(new URL('./engine.worker.ts', import.meta.url), { type: 'module' });
    worker.onmessage = (e: MessageEvent) => {
      const { id, ok, result, error, ms } = e.data;
      const p = pending.get(id);
      if (!p) return;
      pending.delete(id);
      if (ok) p.resolve({ result, ms }); else p.reject(new Error(error));
    };
    worker.onerror = (e) => { for (const [, p] of pending) p.reject(new Error(e.message || 'engine worker crashed')); pending.clear(); worker?.terminate(); worker = null; };
  }
  return worker;
}

export function call<T = any>(op: string, src: string, opts?: any): Promise<{ result: T; ms: number }> {
  const id = seq++;
  const w = getWorker();
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    pending.set(id, { resolve, reject });
    w.postMessage({ id, op, src, opts });
  });
}

/** abort everything in flight (e.g. a runaway analysis) by recycling the worker */
export function resetEngine() {
  worker?.terminate(); worker = null;
  for (const [, p] of pending) p.reject(new Error('cancelled')); pending.clear();
}
export const busyCount = () => pending.size;

export interface FullResult { report: FullReport; clean: CleanResult; }

export const engine = {
  full: (src: string, opts?: any) => call<FullResult>('full', src, opts),
  analyze: (src: string) => call<FullReport>('analyze', src),
  clean: (src: string, opts?: any) => call<CleanResult>('clean', src, opts),
  tokenize: (src: string) => call<any>('tokenize', src),
  op: call,
};

/** Save any text/bytes as a file (works offline). */
export function download(name: string, content: string | Uint8Array, mime = 'text/plain') {
  const blob = new Blob([content as BlobPart], { type: mime });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a'); a.href = url; a.download = name; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 2000);
}
export function Download({ name, content, label = 'Download', mime }: { name: string; content: string | Uint8Array | (() => string | Uint8Array); label?: string; mime?: string }) {
  return <span className="copy-btn" title={`Save as ${name}`} onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); download(name, typeof content === 'function' ? content() : content, mime); }}>{label}</span>;
}

/** Segmented control (radio group) */
export function Seg<T extends string>({ value, options, onChange, title }: { value: T; options: Array<T | { v: T; label: React.ReactNode; title?: string }>; onChange: (v: T) => void; title?: string }) {
  return (
    <div className="seg" title={title}>
      {options.map(o => {
        const v = typeof o === 'string' ? o : o.v;
        const label = typeof o === 'string' ? o : o.label;
        return <label key={v} title={typeof o === 'string' ? undefined : o.title}><input type="radio" checked={value === v} onChange={() => onChange(v)} style={{ display: 'none' }} />{label}</label>;
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

export function Toggle({ on, onChange, children, title }: { on: boolean; onChange: (v: boolean) => void; children: React.ReactNode; title?: string }) {
  return <label className={'toggle ' + (on ? 'on' : '')} title={title}><input type="checkbox" checked={on} onChange={e => onChange(e.target.checked)} />{children}</label>;
}

export function Field({ label, children, hint }: { label: string; children: React.ReactNode; hint?: string }) {
  return <label className="field" title={hint}><span>{label}</span>{children}</label>;
}

export function Busy({ on, label = 'Working' }: { on: boolean; label?: string }) {
  if (!on) return null;
  return <div className="busy"><span className="spin-loader" />{label}…</div>;
}

export function ErrorBox({ error }: { error: string | null | undefined }) {
  if (!error) return null;
  return <div className="errbox"><b>Error</b> {error}<Copy text={error} /></div>;
}

/** clickable line reference */
export function LineLink({ line, onClick, prefix = 'L' }: { line: number; onClick: (line: number) => void; prefix?: string }) {
  return <span className="line-link" onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); onClick(line); }} title="Show in editor">{prefix}{line}</span>;
}

/** collapsible JSON viewer with copy */
export function JsonView({ value, label = 'JSON', open = false, max = 200000 }: { value: unknown; label?: string; open?: boolean; max?: number }) {
  const [o, setO] = useState(open);
  const text = React.useMemo(() => { try { return JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) ?? 'undefined'; } catch (e) { return String(e); } }, [value]);
  return (
    <div className="jsonview">
      <div className="jsonview-h" onClick={() => setO(!o)}><span>{o ? '▾' : '▸'} {label}</span><span className="muted small">{text.length.toLocaleString()} chars</span><span className="spacer" /><Copy text={text} label="Copy JSON" /></div>
      {o && <pre className="block">{text.length > max ? text.slice(0, max) + '\n… (copy for full)' : text}</pre>}
    </div>
  );
}

export function useLocal<T>(key: string, init: T): [T, (v: T | ((p: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [v, setV] = useState<T>(() => { try { const s = localStorage.getItem('prism:' + key); return s ? JSON.parse(s) as T : init; } catch { return init; } });
  const set = useCallback((x: T | ((p: T) => T)) => setV(p => { const n = typeof x === 'function' ? (x as (p: T) => T)(p) : x; try { localStorage.setItem('prism:' + key, JSON.stringify(n)); } catch { /* quota */ } return n; }), [key]);
  return [v, set];
}

export const latin1Bytes = (s: string) => { const b = new Uint8Array(s.length); for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) b[i] = s.charCodeAt(i) & 255; return b; };
export const bytesLatin1 = (b: Uint8Array) => { let s = ''; for (let i = 0; i < b.length; i += 8192) s += String.fromCharCode(...b.subarray(i, i + 8192)); return s; };

// Global UI context: current script, analysis target, backend link, cross-tab navigation and toasts.
import React, { createContext, useContext } from 'react';
import type { FullReport, CleanResult } from '@prism/core';
import type { Health } from './api.js';

export type Target = 'input' | 'cleaned';
export type TabId = 'overview' | 'cleaned' | 'callgraph' | 'strings' | 'tokens' | 'vm' | 'opcodes' | 'disasm' | 'constants' | 'search' | 'python' | 'blob' | 'tools' | 'workspace';

export interface Inbox { kind: 'blob' | 'disasm' | 'vm' | 'search' | 'python' | 'tool'; payload: any; nonce: number; }

export interface PrismCtx {
  src: string;
  name: string;
  clean: CleanResult | null;
  report: FullReport | null;
  target: Target;
  /** text of the current analysis target (input or cleaned) */
  text: string;
  setTarget: (t: Target) => void;
  backend: Health | null;
  refreshBackend: () => void;
  /** workspace script ids (uploaded on demand when the backend is connected) */
  ensureScriptId: (t?: Target) => Promise<string | null>;
  reveal: (line: number, col?: number, t?: Target) => void;
  goTab: (t: TabId) => void;
  send: (kind: Inbox['kind'], payload: any) => void;
  inbox: Inbox | null;
  setInput: (text: string, name?: string) => void;
  toast: (msg: string, kind?: 'ok' | 'bad' | 'info') => void;
}

export const Ctx = createContext<PrismCtx>(null as unknown as PrismCtx);
export const usePrism = () => useContext(Ctx);

/** read an inbox message addressed to `kind` once */
export function useInbox(kind: Inbox['kind'], onMsg: (payload: any) => void) {
  const { inbox } = usePrism();
  const seen = React.useRef(0);
  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (inbox && inbox.kind === kind && inbox.nonce !== seen.current) { seen.current = inbox.nonce; onMsg(inbox.payload); }
  }, [inbox, kind, onMsg]);
}
