import { Disassembly } from './components/Disassembly.js';
import { Constants } from './components/Constants.js';
import { Search } from './components/Search.js';
import { Python } from './components/Python.js';
import { BlobLab } from './components/BlobLab.js';
import { ToolsConsole } from './components/ToolsConsole.js';
import { WorkspacePanel } from './components/Workspace.js';
import { Help } from './components/Help.js';
import { Copy, Empty, formatBytes, useLocal } from './components/ui.js';

const GROUPS: Array<{ label: string; tabs: Array<{ id: TabId; label: string; needs?: 'report' | 'text' | 'backend'; hint: string }> }> = [
  { label: 'analyze', tabs: [
    { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', needs: 'report', hint: 'family, metrics, VM summary' },
    { id: 'cleaned', label: 'Deobfuscate', needs: 'report', hint: 'junk removal passes, diff, rename map' },
    { id: 'callgraph', label: 'Call Graph', needs: 'report', hint: 'functions and calls' },
    { id: 'strings', label: 'Strings', needs: 'report', hint: 'string literals' },
    { id: 'tokens', label: 'Tokens', needs: 'text', hint: 'raw lexer view' },
  ] },
  { label: 'reverse', tabs: [
    { id: 'vm', label: 'VM', needs: 'report', hint: 'dispatch loops, blobs, handler clusters' },
    { id: 'opcodes', label: 'Opcode Map', needs: 'text', hint: 'editable opcode → mnemonic map' },
    { id: 'disasm', label: 'Disassembly', hint: 'Luau / Lua 5.1 bytecode + custom VM instruction arrays' },
    { id: 'constants', label: 'Constants', needs: 'text', hint: 'decoders, keys, strings, numbers, arrays' },
    { id: 'search', label: 'Search & Xrefs', needs: 'text', hint: 'text/regex, AST patterns, scope-aware xrefs' },
  ] },
  { label: 'extract', tabs: [
    { id: 'python', label: 'Python', needs: 'text', hint: 'port Lua to Python (whole file or one function)' },
    { id: 'blob', label: 'Blob Lab', hint: 'decode pipelines, XOR key recovery, magic detection' },
  ] },
  { label: 'server', tabs: [
    { id: 'tools', label: 'All Tools', needs: 'backend', hint: 'every backend/MCP tool with a generated form' },
    { id: 'workspace', label: 'Workspace', needs: 'backend', hint: 'stored scripts, opmaps, outputs' },
  ] },
];

const SAMPLES = [
  'luraph_v14.8.lua', 'luraph_v14.7.lua', 'luraph_v14.5.1.lua', 'prometheus_strong_1.lua', 'prometheus_strong_2.lua', 'prometheus_weak_1.lua', 'prometheus_weak_2.lua',
  'prometheus_wearedevs_1.lua', 'moonsec_v3_1.lua', 'moonsec_v3_2.lua', 'moonsec_v2_1.lua', 'moonsec_v2_2.lua', 'ironbrew2_1.lua', 'ironbrew2_2.lua',
  'hercules_max_1.lua', 'hercules_max_2.lua', 'luaobf_vm_1.lua', 'luaobf_vm_2.lua',
];

const PLACEHOLDER = `-- Paste obfuscated Luau/Lua here, drop a .lua/.luau/.txt file (or bytecode), or load a sample.
-- Static analysis only: nothing is ever executed.  Ctrl+Enter = Analyze
`;

function quickHash(s: string): string { let h = 2166136261; for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i += Math.max(1, s.length >> 16)) h = Math.imul(h ^ s.charCodeAt(i), 16777619); return (h >>> 0).toString(16) + ':' + s.length; }

function decodeFile(buf: ArrayBuffer): { text?: string; bytes?: Uint8Array } {
  const b = new Uint8Array(buf);
  const head = b.subarray(0, 4096);
  let ctrl = 0; for (const x of head) if (x < 9 || (x > 13 && x < 32)) ctrl++;
  const isLuaBc = b[0] === 0x1b && b[1] === 0x4c && b[2] === 0x75 && b[3] === 0x61;
  if (isLuaBc || ctrl > head.length * 0.05) return { bytes: b };
  try { return { text: new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: true }).decode(b) }; } catch { let s = ''; for (let i = 0; i < b.length; i += 8192) s += String.fromCharCode(...b.subarray(i, i + 8192)); return { text: s }; }
}

export function App() {
  const [src, setSrc] = useState('');
  const [name, setName] = useState('untitled.lua');
  const [res, setRes] = useState<FullResult | null>(null);
  const [cleanedReport, setCleanedReport] = useState<FullReport | null>(null);
  const [analyzedHash, setAnalyzedHash] = useState('');
  const [ms, setMs] = useState(0);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [tab, setTab] = useLocal<TabId>('tab', 'overview');
  const [target, setTarget] = useLocal<Target>('target', 'cleaned');
  const [cleanOpts, setCleanOpts] = useLocal<CleanOptions>('cleanOpts', { rounds: 4 });
  const [edTab, setEdTab] = useState<Target>('input');
  const [focus, setFocus] = useState(false);
  const [help, setHelp] = useState(false);
  const [over, setOver] = useState(false);
  const [backend, setBackend] = useState<Health | null>(null);
  const [inbox, setInbox] = useState<Inbox | null>(null);
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState<Array<{ id: number; msg: string; kind: string }>>([]);
  const fileRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const editorRef = useRef<any>(null);
  const monacoRef = useRef<any>(null);
  const decoRef = useRef<string[]>([]);
  const idCache = useRef(new Map<string, string>());

  const toast = useCallback((msg: string, kind: 'ok' | 'bad' | 'info' = 'info') => {
    const id = Date.now() + Math.random();
    setToasts(t => [...t.slice(-4), { id, msg, kind }]);
    setTimeout(() => setToasts(t => t.filter(x => x.id !== id)), kind === 'bad' ? 6000 : 3200);
  }, []);

  const refreshBackend = useCallback(() => { api.health().then(setBackend); }, []);
  useEffect(() => { refreshBackend(); const t = setInterval(refreshBackend, 15000); return () => clearInterval(t); }, [refreshBackend]);

  const run = useCallback(async (text: string, opts?: CleanOptions) => {
    if (!text.trim()) return;
    setBusy(true); setErr(null);
    try {
      const { result, ms } = await engine.full(text, opts ?? cleanOpts);
      setRes(result); setMs(ms); setCleanedReport(null); setAnalyzedHash(quickHash(text));
    } catch (e: any) { setErr(String(e?.message || e)); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }, [cleanOpts]);

  const reclean = useCallback(async (opts: CleanOptions) => {
    setCleanOpts(opts);
    if (!res || !src.trim()) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try { const { result } = await engine.clean(src, opts); setRes({ ...res, clean: result }); setCleanedReport(null); toast(`re-cleaned: ${result.rounds} rounds`, 'ok'); }
    catch (e: any) { toast(String(e?.message || e), 'bad'); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }, [res, src, setCleanOpts, toast]);

  const setInput = useCallback((text: string, n?: string) => { setSrc(text); if (n) setName(n); setEdTab('input'); run(text); }, [run]);

  const onFile = useCallback(async (f: File) => {
    const d = decodeFile(await f.arrayBuffer());
    if (d.bytes) { setInbox({ kind: 'disasm', payload: { bytes: d.bytes, label: f.name }, nonce: Date.now() }); setTab('disasm'); toast(`${f.name}: binary file → Disassembly`, 'info'); return; }
    setInput(d.text!, f.name);
  }, [setInput, setTab, toast]);

  const onDrop = useCallback((e: React.DragEvent) => { e.preventDefault(); setOver(false); const f = e.dataTransfer.files?.[0]; if (f) onFile(f); }, [onFile]);

  const loadSample = useCallback(async (n: string) => {
    try { const r = await fetch('samples/' + n); if (!r.ok) throw new Error('sample not found'); setInput(await r.text(), n); }
    catch (e: any) { setErr(String(e?.message || e)); }
  }, [setInput]);

  const cleanedText = res?.clean.code ?? '';
  const text = target === 'cleaned' && cleanedText ? cleanedText : src;
  const effTarget: Target = target === 'cleaned' && cleanedText ? 'cleaned' : 'input';

  // lazily analyze the cleaned code when a report-based tab needs it
  const needsReport = GROUPS.flatMap(g => g.tabs).find(t => t.id === tab)?.needs === 'report';
  useEffect(() => {
    if (effTarget === 'cleaned' && needsReport && tab !== 'overview' && tab !== 'cleaned' && res && !cleanedReport && cleanedText) {
      engine.analyze(cleanedText).then(r => setCleanedReport(r.result)).catch(e => toast(String(e.message || e), 'bad'));
    }
  }, [effTarget, needsReport, tab, res, cleanedReport, cleanedText, toast]);
  const report = effTarget === 'cleaned' ? cleanedReport : res?.report ?? null;

  const reveal = useCallback((line: number, col = 1, t?: Target) => {
    const tt = t ?? effTarget;
    setFocus(false); setEdTab(tt);
    setTimeout(() => {
      const ed = editorRef.current, m = monacoRef.current; if (!ed || !m) return;
      ed.revealLineInCenter(line); ed.setPosition({ lineNumber: line, column: col });
      decoRef.current = ed.deltaDecorations(decoRef.current, [{ range: new m.Range(line, 1, line, 1), options: { isWholeLine: true, className: 'hl-line', glyphMarginClassName: 'hl-glyph' } }]);
      ed.focus();
    }, 80);
  }, [effTarget]);

  const ensureScriptId = useCallback(async (t?: Target): Promise<string | null> => {
    if (!backend) return null;
    const tt = t ?? effTarget;
    const body = tt === 'cleaned' ? cleanedText : src;
    if (!body.trim()) return null;
    const key = tt + '|' + quickHash(body);
    const hit = idCache.current.get(key); if (hit) return hit;
    try {
      let parent: string | undefined;
      if (tt === 'cleaned') parent = await ensureScriptId('input') ?? undefined;
      const base = name.replace(/\.(lua|luau|txt)$/i, '');
      const meta = await api.addScript(tt === 'cleaned' ? base + '.clean.lua' : name, body, parent ? { parent, derivedBy: 'web deobfuscate' } : {});
      idCache.current.set(key, meta.id);
      return meta.id;
    } catch (e: any) { toast('workspace upload failed: ' + e.message, 'bad'); return null; }
  }, [backend, effTarget, cleanedText, src, name, toast]);

  const send = useCallback((kind: Inbox['kind'], payload: any) => {
    setInbox({ kind, payload, nonce: Date.now() + Math.random() });
    const map: Record<Inbox['kind'], TabId> = { blob: 'blob', disasm: 'disasm', vm: 'disasm', search: 'search', python: 'python', tool: 'tools' };
    setTab(map[kind]);
  }, [setTab]);

  // keyboard shortcuts
  useEffect(() => {
    const h = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); run(src); }
      else if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.shiftKey && (e.key === 'F' || e.key === 'f')) { e.preventDefault(); setTab('search'); }
      else if (e.key === 'F1') { e.preventDefault(); setHelp(true); }
      else if (e.key === 'Escape') setHelp(false);
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', h); return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', h);
  }, [run, src, setTab]);

  const ctx: PrismCtx = useMemo(() => ({
    src, name, clean: res?.clean ?? null, report, target: effTarget, text, setTarget, backend, refreshBackend, ensureScriptId,
    reveal, goTab: setTab, send, inbox, setInput, toast,
  }), [src, name, res, report, effTarget, text, setTarget, backend, refreshBackend, ensureScriptId, reveal, setTab, send, inbox, setInput, toast]);

  const rep = res?.report;
  const stale = !!res && quickHash(src) !== analyzedHash;
  const exportAll = rep ? JSON.stringify({ name, report: rep, cleanStats: res?.clean.stats, renameMap: res?.clean.renameMap }, null, 2) : '';
  const curTab = GROUPS.flatMap(g => g.tabs).find(t => t.id === tab) ?? GROUPS[0].tabs[0];

  const body = (() => {
    if (curTab.needs === 'backend' && !backend) return <Empty><div><div className="big">Backend not connected</div>Start the PRISM server (<span className="kbd">npm start</span>) and open the site from it — then all {''}
      tools, the workspace, native luau-compile/analyze and MCP become available.<div style={{ marginTop: 12 }}><button className="btn sm" onClick={refreshBackend}>Retry connection</button></div></div></Empty>;
    if (curTab.needs === 'report' && !rep) return <Empty><div><div className="big">Load or paste a script, then Analyze</div>Generic static engine for any Lua 5.1 / Luau obfuscator — Luraph, Prometheus, MoonSec, IronBrew, Hercules, LuaObfuscator, custom VMs.</div></Empty>;
    if (curTab.needs === 'report' && effTarget === 'cleaned' && tab !== 'overview' && tab !== 'cleaned' && !cleanedReport) return <Empty><div><span className="spin-loader" style={{ display: 'inline-block' }} /><div className="big" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>Analyzing cleaned code…</div></div></Empty>;
    if (curTab.needs === 'text' && !text.trim()) return <Empty><div><div className="big">No script yet</div>Paste or open a script on the left.</div></Empty>;
    switch (tab) {
      case 'overview': return <Overview rep={rep!} ms={ms} cleaned={res!.clean} />;
      case 'cleaned': return <Cleaned original={src} clean={res!.clean} opts={cleanOpts} onReclean={reclean} />;
      case 'vm': return <VmAnalysis rep={report!} />;
      case 'callgraph': return <CallGraph rep={report!} />;
      case 'strings': return <Strings rep={report!} />;
      case 'tokens': return <Tokens src={text} />;
      case 'opcodes': return <OpcodeMap />;
      case 'disasm': return <Disassembly />;
      case 'constants': return <Constants />;
      case 'search': return <Search />;
      case 'python': return <Python />;
      case 'blob': return <BlobLab />;
      case 'tools': return <ToolsConsole />;
      case 'workspace': return <WorkspacePanel />;
    }
  })();

  return (
    <Ctx.Provider value={ctx}>
      <div className="app" onDragOver={e => { e.preventDefault(); setOver(true); }} onDragLeave={e => { if (e.currentTarget === e.target) setOver(false); }} onDrop={onDrop}>
        <div className="topbar">
          <div className="brand">
            <div className="logo" />
            <div><h1>PRISM</h1><div className="tag">static luau reverse engine</div></div>
          </div>
          <div className="spacer" />
          <div className="meta">
            {rep && <span className={'pill ' + (rep.ok ? 'ok' : 'bad')} title={rep.parseErrors.slice(0, 5).map(e => `L${e.line}: ${e.message}`).join('\n')}>{rep.ok ? 'parsed clean' : rep.parseErrors.length + ' parse errors'}</span>}
            {rep && <span className="mono" title={name}>{name.length > 28 ? name.slice(0, 26) + '…' : name} · {formatBytes(rep.metrics.bytes)} · {ms}ms</span>}
            {stale && <span className="pill warn link" onClick={() => run(src)} title="Input changed since the last analysis">stale — re-analyze</span>}
            {rep && <Copy text={exportAll} label="Export report" />}
            <span className={'pill link ' + (backend ? 'ok' : '')} onClick={() => { refreshBackend(); if (backend) setTab('workspace'); }}
              title={backend ? `server ${backend.version} · workspace ${backend.workspace}\nMCP: ${backend.mcp}` : 'static mode — everything runs in your browser. Start the server for the workspace, native luau tools and MCP.'}>
              {backend ? `● server · ${backend.tools} tools` : '○ local engine'}
            </span>
            <span className="pill link" onClick={() => setHelp(true)} title="Help, workflow & MCP setup (F1)">? Help</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className={'body ' + (focus ? 'focus' : '')}>
          <div className="panel">
            <div className="panel-head">
              <div className="edtabs">
                <span className={'edtab ' + (edTab === 'input' ? 'active' : '')} onClick={() => setEdTab('input')}>Input</span>
                <span className={'edtab ' + (edTab === 'cleaned' ? 'active' : '') + (cleanedText ? '' : ' dis')} onClick={() => setEdTab('cleaned')}>Cleaned</span>
              </div>
              <span className="spacer" />
              {edTab === 'cleaned' && cleanedText && <><Copy text={cleanedText} label="Copy" /><span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => { setInput(cleanedText, name.replace(/\.(lua|luau|txt)$/i, '') + '.clean.lua'); toast('cleaned code is now the input', 'ok'); }} title="Use the cleaned code as new input (iterate)">Use as input</span></>}
              {edTab === 'input' && src && <Copy text={src} label="Copy" />}
              <SampleMenu onPick={loadSample} />
              <button className="btn ghost sm" onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()}>Open file</button>
              <input ref={fileRef} type="file" style={{ display: 'none' }} onChange={e => { const f = e.target.files?.[0]; if (f) onFile(f); e.target.value = ''; }} />
              <button className="btn primary" disabled={busy || !src.trim()} onClick={() => run(src)} title="Ctrl+Enter">
                {busy ? <span className="spin-loader" /> : '▶'} {busy ? 'Analyzing' : 'Analyze'}
              </button>
              {busy && <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => { resetEngine(); setBusy(false); toast('analysis cancelled', 'info'); }}>Cancel</span>}
            </div>
            <div style={{ flex: 1, minHeight: 0, position: 'relative' }}>
              {over && <div className="drop over" style={{ position: 'absolute', inset: 0, zIndex: 5, display: 'grid', placeItems: 'center', margin: 0 }}>Drop a .lua / .luau file (or compiled bytecode)</div>}
              <Editor height="100%" language="lua" theme="prism" path={edTab === 'input' ? 'input.lua' : 'cleaned.lua'}
                value={edTab === 'input' ? (src || '') : cleanedText}
                onChange={v => { if (edTab === 'input') setSrc(v ?? ''); }}
                onMount={(ed, m) => { editorRef.current = ed; monacoRef.current = m; }}
                options={{ minimap: { enabled: false }, fontSize: 12, wordWrap: 'on', scrollBeyondLastLine: false, automaticLayout: true, glyphMargin: true, readOnly: edTab === 'cleaned', placeholder: PLACEHOLDER } as any} />
              {edTab === 'input' && !src && <div className="editor-ph">{PLACEHOLDER}</div>}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="panel">
            <div className="tabbar">
              <span className="copy-btn" style={{ alignSelf: 'center', marginRight: 6 }} onClick={() => setFocus(!focus)} title="Toggle the editor panel (focus mode)">{focus ? '⇥' : '⇤'}</span>
              {GROUPS.map(g => (
                <div className="grp" key={g.label}>
                  <span className="grp-l">{g.label}</span>
                  {g.tabs.map(t => (
                    <div key={t.id} title={t.hint} className={'tab ' + (tab === t.id ? 'active ' : '') + ((t.needs === 'backend' && !backend) || (t.needs === 'report' && !rep) ? 'off' : '')} onClick={() => setTab(t.id)}>{t.label}</div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              ))}
              <div className="target-switch" title="Which code the analysis tabs work on">
                on
                <div className="seg">
                  <label><input type="radio" checked={target === 'input'} onChange={() => setTarget('input')} style={{ display: 'none' }} />input</label>
                  <label style={cleanedText ? undefined : { opacity: .5 }}><input type="radio" checked={target === 'cleaned'} onChange={() => setTarget('cleaned')} style={{ display: 'none' }} />cleaned</label>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="panel-body" style={{ position: 'relative' }}>
              {err && <div className="errbox"><b>Error</b> {err}<Copy text={err} /></div>}
              {body}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
        {help && <Help onClose={() => setHelp(false)} />}
        <div className="toasts">{toasts.map(t => <div key={t.id} className={'toast ' + t.kind}>{t.msg}</div>)}</div>
      </div>
    </Ctx.Provider>
  );
}

function SampleMenu({ onPick }: { onPick: (n: string) => void }) {
  return (
    <select className="btn ghost sm" defaultValue="" onChange={e => { if (e.target.value) { onPick(e.target.value); e.target.value = ''; } }} style={{ appearance: 'none', paddingRight: 12, maxWidth: 140 }}>
      <option value="" disabled>Load sample…</option>
      {SAMPLES.map(s => <option key={s} value={s}>{s}</option>)}
    </select>
  );
}

cd /data/prism/apps/web/src && cat > components/Cleaned.tsx <<'EOF'
import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import Editor, { DiffEditor } from '@monaco-editor/react';
import type { CleanResult, CleanOptions } from '@prism/core';
import { Copy, Download, Seg, Toggle, Field, LineLink } from './ui.js';
import { usePrism } from '../ctx.js';
import { engine } from '../engineClient.js';
import { api } from '../api.js';

const MONACO_OPTS = {
  minimap: { enabled: false }, fontSize: 12, lineNumbers: 'on' as const, scrollBeyondLastLine: false, wordWrap: 'off' as const,
  renderWhitespace: 'none' as const, automaticLayout: true, readOnly: true,
};

const PASSES: Array<{ k: keyof CleanOptions; label: string; hint: string }> = [
  { k: 'foldConstants', label: 'fold numbers / MBA', hint: 'constant folding incl. bit32 & mixed boolean-arithmetic identities' },
  { k: 'recoverStrings', label: 'decode strings', hint: 'string.char(...), escapes, concat chains, byte tables' },
  { k: 'removeDeadCode', label: 'dead code', hint: 'opaque predicates, unreachable branches, no-ops' },
  { k: 'propagate', label: 'inline aliases', hint: 'inline literal locals and pure builtin aliases (local f = string.byte)' },
  { k: 'removeUnusedLocals', label: 'drop junk locals', hint: 'never-read locals and assignments' },
  { k: 'controlFlow', label: 'control flow', hint: 'while-break → if, repeat-until-true → do, opaque state guards' },
  { k: 'stripParens', label: 'strip parens', hint: 'drop redundant parentheses' },
];

export function Cleaned({ original, clean, opts, onReclean }: { original: string; clean: CleanResult; opts: CleanOptions; onReclean: (o: CleanOptions) => void }) {
  const { backend, toast, name, setInput, reveal } = usePrism();
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'clean' | 'diff' | 'renames' | 'passes'>('clean');
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<CleanOptions>(opts);
  const [code, setCode] = useState<string | null>(null); // manual renames applied on top
  const [rFrom, setRFrom] = useState(''); const [rTo, setRTo] = useState(''); const [rLine, setRLine] = useState('');
  const shown = code ?? clean.code;
  const s = clean.stats;
  const on = (k: keyof CleanOptions) => draft[k] !== false;
  const renameCsv = useMemo(() => 'from,to,line,kind\n' + clean.renameMap.map(r => `${r.from},${r.to},${r.line},${r.kind}`).join('\n'), [clean.renameMap]);

  const applyRename = async () => {
    if (!rFrom || !rTo) return;
    try {
      const { result } = await engine.op('rename', shown, { renames: [{ name: rFrom, to: rTo, line: rLine ? Number(rLine) : undefined, all: !rLine }] });
      setCode(result.code);
      toast(`renamed ${rFrom} → ${rTo}: ${result.applied.map((a: any) => a.refs + ' refs').join(', ') || 'no match'}`, result.applied.length ? 'ok' : 'bad');
    } catch (e: any) { toast(e.message, 'bad'); }
  };
  const save = async () => {
    try {
      const base = name.replace(/\.(lua|luau|txt)$/i, '');
      const parent = await api.addScript(name, original);
      const m = await api.addScript(base + '.clean.lua', shown, { parent: parent.id, derivedBy: 'web deobfuscate' });
      toast(`saved to workspace as ${m.id}`, 'ok');
    } catch (e: any) { toast(e.message, 'bad'); }
  };

  return (
    <div className="col">
      <div className="toolbar">
        <Seg value={mode} onChange={setMode} options={[{ v: 'clean', label: 'cleaned' }, { v: 'diff', label: 'diff' }, { v: 'renames', label: `renames (${clean.renameMap.length})` }, { v: 'passes', label: 'passes ⚙' }]} />
        <div className="chips">
          <span className="chip" title="constant folds">folded <b>{s.folded}</b></span>
          <span className="chip" title="MBA / bit32 identities">mba <b>{s.mbaFolded}</b></span>
          <span className="chip">strings <b>{s.charCalls + s.concatChains}</b></span>
          <span className="chip">pruned <b>{s.prunedBranches}</b></span>
          <span className="chip">dead <b>{s.removedStmts + s.removedLocals + s.removedAssigns}</b></span>
          <span className="chip">inlined <b>{s.propagated + s.aliases}</b></span>
          <span className="chip">cf <b>{s.loopsToIf + s.guardsFolded + s.guardsMerged + s.blocksFlattened}</b></span>
          <span className="chip">rounds <b>{clean.rounds}</b></span>
          {code !== null && <span className="chip hi">manual renames</span>}
        </div>
        <span className="spacer" />
        <Copy text={shown} label="Copy cleaned" />
        <Download name={name.replace(/\.(lua|luau|txt)$/i, '') + '.clean.lua'} content={shown} />
        <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => setInput(shown, name.replace(/\.(lua|luau|txt)$/i, '') + '.clean.lua')} title="Iterate: analyze the cleaned code as new input">Use as input</span>
        {backend && <span className="copy-btn" onClick={save} title="Store original + cleaned (with lineage) in the server workspace">Save to workspace</span>}
      </div>
      {mode === 'clean' && (
        <div className="toolbar" style={{ paddingTop: 6, paddingBottom: 6 }}>
          <span className="small muted">rename symbol</span>
          <input className="inp" style={{ width: 120 }} placeholder="old name" value={rFrom} onChange={e => setRFrom(e.target.value)} />
          <span className="muted">→</span>
          <input className="inp" style={{ width: 120 }} placeholder="new name" value={rTo} onChange={e => setRTo(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && applyRename()} />
          <input className="inp" style={{ width: 70 }} placeholder="line?" value={rLine} onChange={e => setRLine(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ''))} title="optional: only the binding visible at this line (else every binding with that name)" />
          <button className="btn sm" onClick={applyRename} disabled={!rFrom || !rTo}>Rename</button>
          {code !== null && <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => setCode(null)}>Reset renames</span>}
          <span className="small muted">scope-aware, formatting preserved</span>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="fill">
        {mode === 'clean' && <Editor height="100%" language="lua" theme="prism" path="deob-view.lua" value={shown} options={MONACO_OPTS} />}
        {mode === 'diff' && <DiffEditor height="100%" language="lua" theme="prism" original={original} modified={shown} options={{ ...MONACO_OPTS, renderSideBySide: true }} />}
        {mode === 'renames' && (
          <div className="scroll" style={{ height: '100%' }}>
            <div className="toolbar"><span className="small muted">role-based names given by the rename pass (mode: {draft.rename ?? 'obfuscated'})</span><span className="spacer" />
              <Copy text={renameCsv} label="Copy CSV" /><Copy text={JSON.stringify(clean.renameMap, null, 2)} label="Copy JSON" /></div>
            <table className="data"><thead><tr><th>from</th><th>to</th><th>kind</th><th>line</th></tr></thead>
              <tbody>{clean.renameMap.slice(0, 3000).map((r, i) => <tr key={i}><td>{r.from}</td><td style={{ color: 'var(--ok)' }}>{r.to}</td><td>{r.kind}</td><td><LineLink line={r.line} onClick={l => reveal(l, 1, 'cleaned')} /></td></tr>)}</tbody></table>
          </div>
        )}
        {mode === 'passes' && (
          <div className="cards">
            <div className="card"><div className="card-h"><span className="dot" />Junk-removal passes</div><div className="card-b">
              <div className="row" style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}>
                {PASSES.map(p => <Toggle key={p.k} on={on(p.k)} onChange={v => setDraft({ ...draft, [p.k]: v })} title={p.hint}>{p.label}</Toggle>)}
              </div>
              <div className="row">
                <Field label="rename"><select value={draft.rename ?? 'obfuscated'} onChange={e => setDraft({ ...draft, rename: e.target.value as CleanOptions['rename'] })}>
                  <option value="none">none</option><option value="obfuscated">obfuscated names only</option><option value="all">all locals</option></select></Field>
                <Field label="rounds"><input type="number" min={1} max={12} value={draft.rounds ?? 4} onChange={e => setDraft({ ...draft, rounds: Math.max(1, Math.min(12, Number(e.target.value) || 4)) })} style={{ width: 60 }} /></Field>
                <button className="btn primary sm" onClick={() => { setCode(null); onReclean(draft); setMode('clean'); }}>Re-run cleanup</button>
                <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => setDraft({ rounds: 4 })}>defaults</span>
              </div>
              <div className="small muted" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>Every pass is semantics-preserving and purely static. Turn passes off to inspect what a single layer does (e.g. only number/MBA folding first).</div>
            </div></div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import type { FullReport, CleanResult } from '@prism/core';
import { Card, Stat, Copy, formatBytes } from './ui.js';
import { usePrism } from '../ctx.js';

export function Overview({ rep, ms, cleaned }: { rep: FullReport; ms: number; cleaned: CleanResult }) {
  const { goTab, backend, reveal } = usePrism();
  const m = rep.metrics;
  const top = rep.families[0];
  const vm = rep.vm;
  const summary = JSON.stringify({ families: rep.families, metrics: m, vm: vm.dispatchSummary, notes: vm.notes }, null, 2);
  const s = cleaned.stats;
  const cleanedLines = cleaned.code.split('\n').length;
  const steps: Array<{ t: string; d: string; tab: Parameters<typeof goTab>[0] }> = [
    { t: 'Deobfuscate', d: `${s.folded + s.mbaFolded} folds, ${s.charCalls + s.concatChains} strings, ${s.removedStmts + s.removedLocals} junk removed — review the diff, tune passes`, tab: 'cleaned' },
    { t: 'Constants', d: 'find the constant/string decoder and the bytecode deserializer (ranked candidates)', tab: 'constants' },
    ...(vm.isVM ? [{ t: 'Opcode Map', d: `VM detected (${vm.dispatchSummary.map(d => d.kind).join(', ')}) — map handlers to mnemonics, edit and export`, tab: 'opcodes' as const }] : []),
    { t: 'Python', d: 'port the decoder you found to Python and decode statically', tab: 'python' },
    { t: 'Blob Lab', d: 'peel encoded blobs (base64/xor/rc4/zlib/…) and recover keys', tab: 'blob' },
    ...(backend ? [{ t: 'All Tools', d: 'every backend tool (auto_triage, luau_compile, …) with a generated form', tab: 'tools' as const }] : []),
  ];
  return (
    <div className="cards">
      <Card title="Identification" right={<Copy text={summary} label="Copy" />}>
        {top ? (
          <div>
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'baseline', gap: 12, marginBottom: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: 22, fontWeight: 800, color: '#fff', textShadow: '0 0 18px rgba(178,107,255,.6)' }}>{top.family}</span>
              <span className="pill ok">{Math.round(top.confidence * 100)}%</span>
            </div>
            <div className="bar" style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}><i style={{ width: Math.round(top.confidence * 100) + '%' }} /></div>
            <ul style={{ margin: '0 0 0 16px', padding: 0 }}>{top.reasons.map((r, i) => <li key={i} className="small">{r}</li>)}</ul>
            {rep.families.length > 1 && <div className="small muted" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>Also: {rep.families.slice(1).map(f => f.family + ' (' + Math.round(f.confidence * 100) + '%)').join(', ')}</div>}
          </div>
        ) : <div className="muted">No known signature matched — generic heuristics apply (PRISM is not tied to any obfuscator).</div>}
      </Card>

      <Card title="Suggested next steps">
        <div className="list">
          {steps.map((x, i) => (
            <div key={i} className="li" onClick={() => goTab(x.tab)}><span className="chip hi">{i + 1}</span><b style={{ color: '#fff', minWidth: 96 }}>{x.t}</b><span className="small">{x.d}</span></div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </Card>

      <Card title="Structure">
        <div className="chips">
          <Stat k="size" v={formatBytes(m.bytes)} />
          <Stat k="lines" v={m.lines} />
          <Stat k="tokens" v={m.tokens.toLocaleString()} />
          <Stat k="nodes" v={m.nodes.toLocaleString()} />
          <Stat k="functions" v={m.functions} hi />
          <Stat k="strings" v={m.strings} />
          <Stat k="numbers" v={m.numbers.toLocaleString()} />
          <Stat k="depth" v={m.maxDepth} />
          <Stat k="analyzed" v={ms + 'ms'} />
          <Stat k="cleaned lines" v={cleanedLines.toLocaleString()} hi />
        </div>
        {rep.parseErrors.length > 0 && (
          <div className="small" style={{ marginTop: 8, color: 'var(--warn)' }}>
            {rep.parseErrors.length} parse error(s) — analysis continued with error recovery:{' '}
            {rep.parseErrors.slice(0, 4).map((e, i) => <span key={i}><span className="line-link" onClick={() => reveal(e.line, 1, 'input')}>L{e.line}</span> {e.message}{i < 3 ? '; ' : ''}</span>)}
          </div>
        )}
      </Card>

      <Card title="Luau dialect tells">
        <div className="chips">
          <Stat k="underscore nums" v={m.underscoreNumbers} hi={m.underscoreNumbers > 0} />
          <Stat k="binary 0b" v={m.binaryLiterals} hi={m.binaryLiterals > 0} />
          <Stat k="dup-param fns" v={m.dupParamFns} hi={m.dupParamFns > 0} />
          <Stat k="while-true" v={m.whileTrue} hi={m.whileTrue > 0} />
          <Stat k="long brackets" v={m.longBrackets} />
          <Stat k="return({..})" v={m.tableReturnHead ? 'yes' : 'no'} hi={m.tableReturnHead} />
        </div>
        <div className="small muted" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>Underscore and binary literals are Luau-only; stock Lua 5.1 rejects them.</div>
      </Card>

      <Card title="Virtual machine" right={<span className={'pill ' + (vm.isVM ? 'ok' : '')}>{vm.isVM ? 'VM detected' : 'no VM'}</span>}>
        <div className="chips" style={{ marginBottom: 10 }}>
          {vm.dispatchSummary.length ? vm.dispatchSummary.map((d, i) => <Stat key={i} k={d.kind} v={'×' + d.count} hi />) : <span className="muted small">no dispatch loop found</span>}
          {vm.trampolines.length > 0 && <Stat k="trampolines" v={vm.trampolines.length} />}
          {vm.opcodeEstimate != null && <Stat k="opcode est." v={'~' + vm.opcodeEstimate} hi />}
          {vm.blobs.length > 0 && <Stat k="blobs" v={vm.blobs.length} />}
          <Stat k="handler clusters" v={vm.handlerClusters.length} />
        </div>
        {vm.notes.map((n, i) => <div key={i} className="small">• {n}</div>)}
      </Card>

      {rep.aliases.length > 0 && (
        <Card title={`Builtin aliases (${rep.aliases.length})`} right={<Copy text={rep.aliases.map(a => `${a.name} = ${a.target}`).join('\n')} />}>
          <div className="chips">{rep.aliases.slice(0, 80).map((a, i) => <span key={i} className="chip">{a.name} <b>{a.target}</b></span>)}</div>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
EOF

cd /data/prism/apps/web/src && cat > components/OpcodeMap.tsx <<'EOF'
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { OpcodeReport, DispatchTree, HandlerInfo } from '@prism/core';
import { usePrism } from '../ctx.js';
import { engine } from '../engineClient.js';
import { api } from '../api.js';
import { Copy, Download, Empty, ErrorBox, Busy, Toggle, LineLink, useLocal, download } from './ui.js';

type Edit = { name?: string; lua?: string; notes?: string };
type Edits = Record<string, Edit>; // key = handler index
interface OpData { report: OpcodeReport; opmaps: Array<Record<string, { name: string; lua?: string }>>; texts: string[]; }

const hue = (s: string) => { let h = 0; for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) h = (h * 31 + s.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0; return h % 360; };
const hash = (s: string) => { let h = 2166136261; for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i += Math.max(1, s.length >> 15)) h = Math.imul(h ^ s.charCodeAt(i), 16777619); return (h >>> 0).toString(36) + s.length.toString(36); };

function exportMap(t: DispatchTree, edits: Edits): Record<string, { name: string; lua?: string; notes?: string; conf?: number; shape?: string; line?: number }> {
  const out: Record<string, { name: string; lua?: string; notes?: string; conf?: number; shape?: string; line?: number }> = {};
  for (const h of t.handlers) {
    const e = edits[h.index] ?? {};
    const lua = e.lua ?? h.lifted.split('\n').map(l => l.trim()).filter(l => l && !l.startsWith('--')).join(' ').slice(0, 240);
    for (const op of h.opcodes) out[String(op)] = { name: e.name || h.guess || `OP_${op}`, ...(lua ? { lua } : {}), ...(e.notes ? { notes: e.notes } : {}), conf: e.name ? 1 : h.confidence, shape: h.shape, line: h.line };
  }
  return out;
}
const asText = (t: DispatchTree, edits: Edits) => t.handlers.map(h => `[${h.rangeText}]`.padEnd(22) + ' ' + (edits[h.index]?.name || h.guess || '?').padEnd(18) + ` conf=${edits[h.index]?.name ? 'user' : h.confidence}  L${h.line}  shape=${h.shape}`).join('\n');
const asLua = (m: ReturnType<typeof exportMap>) => 'local OPCODES = {\n' + Object.entries(m).sort((a, b) => Number(a[0]) - Number(b[0])).map(([k, v]) => `  [${k}] = ${JSON.stringify(v.name)},${v.lua ? ' -- ' + v.lua.replace(/\n/g, ' ').slice(0, 120) : ''}`).join('\n') + '\n}';
const asPy = (m: ReturnType<typeof exportMap>) => 'OPCODES = {\n' + Object.entries(m).sort((a, b) => Number(a[0]) - Number(b[0])).map(([k, v]) => `    ${k}: ${JSON.stringify(v.name)},`).join('\n') + '\n}';

export function OpcodeMap() {
  const { text, target, reveal, backend, toast, send, name } = usePrism();
  const [data, setData] = useState<OpData | null>(null);
  const [forHash, setForHash] = useState('');
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [sel, setSel] = useState(0);
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const [lowOnly, setLowOnly] = useState(false);
  const [byShape, setByShape] = useState(false);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [maxTrees, setMaxTrees] = useLocal('opmap:maxTrees', 8);
  const h = useMemo(() => hash(text), [text]);
  const [allEdits, setAllEdits] = useLocal<Record<string, Edits>>('opmap:edits', {});
  const [wsName, setWsName] = useState(name.replace(/\.(lua|luau|txt)$/i, ''));
  const [wsList, setWsList] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const fileRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const runMap = useCallback(async () => {
    setBusy(true); setErr(null);
    try { const { result } = await engine.op<OpData>('opcodes', text, { maxTrees }); setData(result); setForHash(h); setSel(0); setOpen(null); }
    catch (e: any) { setErr(e.message); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  }, [text, h, maxTrees]);
  useEffect(() => { if (forHash !== h) runMap(); }, [h]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  useEffect(() => { if (backend) api.opmaps().then(setWsList).catch(() => {}); }, [backend]);

  const tree = data?.report.trees[sel];
  const ekey = `${h}:${tree?.id ?? 0}`;
  const edits: Edits = allEdits[ekey] ?? {};
  const setEdit = (idx: number, patch: Edit) => setAllEdits(a => ({ ...a, [ekey]: { ...(a[ekey] ?? {}), [idx]: { ...((a[ekey] ?? {})[idx] ?? {}), ...patch } } }));
  const shapeCount = useMemo(() => { const m = new Map<string, number>(); tree?.handlers.forEach(x => m.set(x.shape, (m.get(x.shape) ?? 0) + 1)); return m; }, [tree]);

  const rows = useMemo(() => {
    if (!tree) return [] as HandlerInfo[];
    const ql = q.toLowerCase();
    let r = tree.handlers.filter(x => (!lowOnly || (x.confidence < 0.6 && !edits[x.index]?.name)) && (!ql || (edits[x.index]?.name ?? x.guess).toLowerCase().includes(ql) || x.rangeText.includes(ql) || x.lifted.toLowerCase().includes(ql) || x.shape.includes(ql)));
    if (byShape) r = [...r].sort((a, b) => a.shape.localeCompare(b.shape) || a.opcodes[0] - b.opcodes[0]);
    return r;
  }, [tree, q, lowOnly, byShape, edits]);

  if (!data && busy) return <Empty><div><span className="spin-loader" style={{ display: 'inline-block' }} /><div className="big" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>Mapping dispatch trees…</div></div></Empty>;
  if (err) return <ErrorBox error={err} />;
  if (!data) return null;
  if (!data.report.trees.length) return <Empty><div><div className="big">No dispatch tree found in the {target} code</div>{data.report.notes.join(' · ') || 'Not a VM / CFF script, or the dispatcher is hidden behind another layer — try the other target, or Deobfuscate first.'}<div style={{ marginTop: 10 }}><button className="btn sm" onClick={runMap}>Re-scan</button></div></div></Empty>;

  const map = tree ? exportMap(tree, edits) : {};
  const nEdited = Object.values(edits).filter(e => e.name).length;
  const applyShape = (hh: HandlerInfo) => { const nm = edits[hh.index]?.name; if (!nm || !tree) return; let n = 0; for (const x of tree.handlers) if (x.shape === hh.shape && x.index !== hh.index && !edits[x.index]?.name) { setEdit(x.index, { name: nm }); n++; } toast(`applied "${nm}" to ${n} same-shape handlers`, 'ok'); };
  const importJson = (txt: string) => {
    try {
      const j = JSON.parse(txt) as Record<string, string | { name: string; lua?: string; notes?: string }>;
      const next: Edits = { ...edits }; let n = 0;
      for (const hh of tree!.handlers) for (const op of hh.opcodes) { const e = j[String(op)]; if (e) { next[hh.index] = typeof e === 'string' ? { name: e } : { name: e.name, ...(e.notes ? { notes: e.notes } : {}) }; n++; break; } }
      setAllEdits(a => ({ ...a, [ekey]: next })); toast(`imported ${n} opcode names`, n ? 'ok' : 'bad');
    } catch (e: any) { toast('import failed: ' + e.message, 'bad'); }
  };
  const saveWs = async () => { try { const r = await api.putOpmap(wsName || 'opmap', map as any); toast('saved ' + r.file, 'ok'); setWsList(await api.opmaps()); } catch (e: any) { toast(e.message, 'bad'); } };
  const loadWs = async (n: string) => { try { importJson(JSON.stringify(await api.getOpmap(n))); } catch (e: any) { toast(e.message, 'bad'); } };

  return (
    <div className="col">
      <Busy on={busy} label="Mapping" />
      <div className="toolbar">
        <select className="inp" value={sel} onChange={e => { setSel(Number(e.target.value)); setOpen(null); }} style={{ maxWidth: 360 }}>
          {data.report.trees.map((t, i) => <option key={i} value={i}>#{t.id} {t.kind} var={t.var} · {t.leaves} handlers · L{t.line} · score {Math.round(t.score)}</option>)}
        </select>
        <input className="inp" placeholder="filter name / opcode / code / shape…" value={q} onChange={e => setQ(e.target.value)} style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 140 }} />
        <Toggle on={lowOnly} onChange={setLowOnly} title="only unnamed handlers with confidence < 0.6">low conf</Toggle>
        <Toggle on={byShape} onChange={setByShape} title="sort by CFG shape hash: equal hash ⇒ same semantics">group shape</Toggle>
        <span className="copy-btn" onClick={runMap} title="re-run the opcode mapper">↻</span>
        <select className="inp" value={maxTrees} onChange={e => setMaxTrees(Number(e.target.value))} title="max dispatch trees to extract"><option value={4}>4 trees</option><option value={8}>8 trees</option><option value={16}>16 trees</option><option value={32}>32 trees</option></select>
      </div>
      {tree && (
        <div className="toolbar" style={{ paddingTop: 6, paddingBottom: 6 }}>
          <div className="chips">
            <span className="chip hi">{tree.kind}</span>
            <span className="chip">range <b>{tree.minOp}..{tree.maxOp}</b></span>
            <span className="chip">handlers <b>{tree.leaves}</b></span>
            <span className="chip">shapes <b>{shapeCount.size}</b></span>
            <span className="chip">named <b>{nEdited}</b></span>
            {Object.entries({ inst: tree.roles.inst, code: tree.roles.code, pc: tree.roles.pc, stack: tree.roles.stack, opField: tree.roles.opField }).filter(([, v]) => v).map(([k, v]) => <span key={k} className="chip">{k} <b>{v}</b></span>)}
            {Object.entries(tree.roles.fields).map(([k, v]) => <span key={k} className="chip">{k}→<b>{v}</b></span>)}
          </div>
          <span className="spacer" />
          <Copy text={asText(tree, edits)} label="Copy table" />
          <Copy text={JSON.stringify(map, null, 2)} label="Copy JSON" />
          <Copy text={asLua(map)} label="Copy Lua" />
          <Copy text={asPy(map)} label="Copy Python" />
          <Copy text={data.texts[sel] ?? ''} label="Copy full dump" />
          <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => download(`${wsName || 'opmap'}.json`, JSON.stringify(map, null, 2), 'application/json')}>Export</span>
          <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()}>Import</span>
          <input ref={fileRef} type="file" accept=".json" style={{ display: 'none' }} onChange={async e => { const f = e.target.files?.[0]; if (f) importJson(await f.text()); e.target.value = ''; }} />
          <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => send('vm', { opmap: map, roles: tree.roles })} title="open the custom-VM disassembler with this map">→ VM disasm</span>
          {nEdited > 0 && <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => { if (confirm('Discard all opcode names you entered for this tree?')) setAllEdits(a => { const n = { ...a }; delete n[ekey]; return n; }); }}>Reset</span>}
        </div>
      )}
      {backend && tree && (
        <div className="toolbar" style={{ paddingTop: 4, paddingBottom: 6 }}>
          <span className="small muted">workspace opmap</span>
          <input className="inp" style={{ width: 150 }} value={wsName} onChange={e => setWsName(e.target.value)} />
          <button className="btn sm" onClick={saveWs}>Save</button>
          {wsList.length > 0 && <select className="inp" value="" onChange={e => e.target.value && loadWs(e.target.value)}><option value="">Load…</option>{wsList.map(n => <option key={n} value={n}>{n}</option>)}</select>}
          <span className="small muted">shared with MCP tools opmap_get / vm_disasm</span>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="fill scroll">
        <table className="data">
          <thead><tr><th style={{ width: 120 }}>opcode</th><th style={{ width: 190 }}>mnemonic (editable)</th><th style={{ width: 60 }}>conf</th><th style={{ width: 110 }}>shape</th><th style={{ width: 54 }}>line</th><th>lifted semantics</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>
            {rows.slice(0, 1500).map(x => {
              const e = edits[x.index] ?? {};
              const hu = hue(x.shape);
              const same = shapeCount.get(x.shape) ?? 1;
              const liftedOne = x.lifted.split('\n').map(l => l.trim()).filter(l => l && !l.startsWith('--')).join('  ');
              return (
                <React.Fragment key={x.index}>
                  <tr onClick={() => setOpen(open === x.index ? null : x.index)} style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>
                    <td style={{ color: 'var(--neon3)' }}>{x.rangeText}</td>
                    <td onClick={ev => ev.stopPropagation()}><input className={'op-name ' + (e.name ? 'edited' : '')} value={e.name ?? ''} placeholder={x.guess || '?'} onChange={ev => setEdit(x.index, { name: ev.target.value })} /></td>
                    <td><span className="conf" title={String(x.confidence)}><i style={{ width: `${Math.round((e.name ? 1 : x.confidence) * 100)}%` }} /></span></td>
                    <td title={`${same} handler(s) share this shape`}><span className="shape-dot" style={{ color: `hsl(${hu} 90% 65%)`, background: `hsl(${hu} 90% 65%)` }} />{x.shape.slice(0, 8)}{same > 1 && <span className="muted"> ×{same}</span>}</td>
                    <td><LineLink line={x.line} onClick={l => reveal(l)} /></td>
                    <td style={{ maxWidth: 420, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }} title={liftedOne}>{liftedOne || <span className="muted">∅</span>}</td>
                  </tr>
                  {open === x.index && (
                    <tr><td colSpan={6} style={{ background: 'rgba(10,6,22,0.55)' }}>
                      <div className="row" style={{ marginBottom: 4 }}>
                        <span className="small muted">opcodes {x.opcodes.slice(0, 20).join(', ')}{x.opcodes.length > 20 ? '…' : ''} · {x.stmts} stmts{x.successors ? ' · → ' + x.successors.join(', ') : ''}</span>
                        <span className="spacer" />
                        {e.name && same > 1 && <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => applyShape(x)}>Apply “{e.name}” to {same - 1} same-shape</span>}
                        <Copy text={x.lifted} label="Copy lifted" /><Copy text={x.code} label="Copy code" />
                      </div>
                      {x.lifted && <div className="code-peek">{x.lifted}</div>}
                      <div className="code-peek">{x.code}</div>
                      <input className="inp" style={{ width: '100%' }} placeholder="notes (exported with the map)" value={e.notes ?? ''} onChange={ev => setEdit(x.index, { notes: ev.target.value })} />
                    </td></tr>
                  )}
                </React.Fragment>
              );
            })}
          </tbody>
        </table>
        {rows.length > 1500 && <div className="small muted" style={{ padding: 10 }}>showing 1500 of {rows.length} — use the filter or Copy for everything</div>}
        {data.report.notes.length > 0 && <div className="small muted" style={{ padding: 10 }}>{data.report.notes.map((n, i) => <div key={i}>▸ {n}</div>)}</div>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
EOF

/** Parse a textual byte representation: hex | base64 | lua (quoted/escaped literal) | decimal list | latin1 | utf8 | auto-detect. */
export function parseBytes(d: string, enc: string = 'auto'): Bytes {
  const s = d.trim();
  const fromLua = (x: string) => {
    let body = x;
    const m = /^(["'])([\s\S]*)\1$/.exec(x) ?? /^\[(=*)\[([\s\S]*)\]\1\]$/.exec(x);
    if (m) body = m[2];
    return luaUnescape(body);
  };
  switch (enc) {
    case 'hex': return hexdecode(s.replace(/0x/gi, ''));
    case 'base64': return b64decode(s.replace(/\s+/g, ''));
    case 'latin1': return latin1(d);
    case 'utf8': return utf8(d);
    case 'lua': return fromLua(s);
    case 'decimal': return decList(s);
  }
  if (/^(["'])[\s\S]*\1$/.test(s) || /\\\d{1,3}|\\x[0-9a-fA-F]{2}/.test(s)) return fromLua(s);
  if (/^\{?\s*\d{1,3}(\s*[,;]\s*\d{1,3})+\s*,?\s*\}?$/.test(s)) return decList(s);
  if (/^(0x)?[0-9a-fA-F\s]+$/.test(s) && s.replace(/\s+|0x/g, '').length % 2 === 0) return hexdecode(s.replace(/0x/g, ''));
  if (/^[A-Za-z0-9+/\s]+={0,2}$/.test(s) && s.replace(/\s+/g, '').length % 4 === 0) return b64decode(s.replace(/\s+/g, ''));
  return latin1(d);
}
EOF

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import Editor from '@monaco-editor/react';
import { usePrism, useInbox } from '../ctx.js';
import { engine } from '../engineClient.js';
import { api } from '../api.js';
import { Copy, Download, Empty, ErrorBox, Busy, Seg, Toggle, Field, LineLink, useLocal, bytesLatin1 } from './ui.js';

const RO = { minimap: { enabled: false }, fontSize: 12, readOnly: true, scrollBeyondLastLine: false, automaticLayout: true, wordWrap: 'off' as const, lineNumbers: 'off' as const, glyphMargin: false, folding: true };
type Src = { bytes: Uint8Array; label: string };
type Emb = { line: number; via: string; format: string; length: number; preview: string };

export function Disassembly() {
  const [mode, setMode] = useLocal<'bytecode' | 'vm'>('disasm:mode', 'bytecode');
  const [vmSeed, setVmSeed] = useState<any>(null);
  const [bcSeed, setBcSeed] = useState<Src | null>(null);
  useInbox('disasm', useCallback((p: Src) => { setMode('bytecode'); setBcSeed(p); }, [setMode]));
  useInbox('vm', useCallback((p: any) => { setMode('vm'); setVmSeed(p); }, [setMode]));
  return (
    <div className="col">
      <div className="toolbar">
        <Seg value={mode} onChange={setMode} options={[{ v: 'bytecode', label: 'Luau / Lua 5.1 bytecode' }, { v: 'vm', label: 'Custom VM instructions' }]} />
        <span className="small muted">{mode === 'bytecode' ? 'auto-detects Luau v3–v14 (plain or Roblox op×227) and Lua 5.1 — exact luau-compile / luac listings + lifted pseudo-Lua' : 'decoded instruction arrays + your opcode map → readable listing'}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="fill">{mode === 'bytecode' ? <BytecodeView seed={bcSeed} /> : <VmView seed={vmSeed} />}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

function BytecodeView({ seed }: { seed: Src | null }) {
  const { text, backend, toast, send, reveal, target } = usePrism();
  const [srcBytes, setSrcBytes] = useState<Src | null>(seed);
  const [paste, setPaste] = useState('');
  const [enc, setEnc] = useState('auto');
  const [emb, setEmb] = useState<Emb[] | null>(null);
  const [opt, setOpt] = useLocal('disasm:opts', { style: 'rich', hex: false, lift: true, constants: true, debug: true, encoding: 'auto', format: 'auto' });
  const [cOpt, setCOpt] = useLocal('disasm:compile', { optimize: 1, debug: 2 });
  const [out, setOut] = useState<{ text: string; format: string; summary: any } | null>(null);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => { if (seed) setSrcBytes(seed); }, [seed]);
  useEffect(() => { let live = true; if (text.trim()) engine.op<Emb[]>('embedded', text).then(r => live && setEmb(r.result)).catch(() => live && setEmb([])); else setEmb([]); return () => { live = false; }; }, [text]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!srcBytes) return;
    let live = true; setBusy(true); setErr(null);
    engine.op('disasm', '', { bytes: srcBytes.bytes, options: { ...opt, maxInsns: 200000 } })
      .then(r => { if (live) setOut(r.result); }).catch(e => { if (live) { setErr(e.message); setOut(null); } }).finally(() => live && setBusy(false));
    return () => { live = false; };
  }, [srcBytes, opt]);

  const fromPaste = async () => { try { const { result } = await engine.op<Uint8Array>('parseBytes', '', { data: paste, encoding: enc }); setSrcBytes({ bytes: result, label: `pasted (${enc})` }); } catch (e: any) { setErr(e.message); } };
  const fromEmb = async (e: Emb) => { try { const { result } = await engine.op<Uint8Array>('embeddedBytes', text, e); setSrcBytes({ bytes: result, label: `L${e.line} (${e.via})` }); } catch (x: any) { setErr(x.message); } };
  const compile = async () => {
    setBusy(true); setErr(null);
    try {
      const r = await api.run('luau_compile', { source: text, mode: 'binary', optimize: cOpt.optimize, debug: cOpt.debug, max_chars: 400 });
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.error);
      const hex = (r.data as any)?.hex; if (!hex) throw new Error(r.text ?? 'compile failed');
      const { result } = await engine.op<Uint8Array>('parseBytes', '', { data: hex, encoding: 'hex' });
      setSrcBytes({ bytes: result, label: `luau-compile -O${cOpt.optimize} -g${cOpt.debug} (${target})` });
    } catch (e: any) { setErr(e.message); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  const onFile = async (f: File) => setSrcBytes({ bytes: new Uint8Array(await f.arrayBuffer()), label: f.name });
  const sum = out?.summary ?? {};

  return (
    <div className="split" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: 'minmax(250px, 320px) 1fr' }}>
      <div className="scroll">
        <div className="cards" style={{ padding: 10, gap: 10 }}>
          <div className="card"><div className="card-h"><span className="dot" />Embedded in script ({target})</div><div className="card-b" style={{ padding: 0 }}>
            {emb === null ? <div className="small muted" style={{ padding: 10 }}>scanning…</div> : emb.length === 0 ? <div className="small muted" style={{ padding: 10 }}>no Lua/Luau bytecode found in string literals (raw, base64, hex). Custom-VM scripts store their own format — use Constants / Blob Lab / Custom VM.</div> :
              <div className="list">{emb.map((e, i) => <div key={i} className="li" onClick={() => fromEmb(e)}><LineLink line={e.line} onClick={l => reveal(l)} /><span className="t">{e.format}</span><span className="small muted">{e.via} · {e.length} B</span></div>)}</div>}
          </div></div>
          <div className="card"><div className="card-h"><span className="dot" />Paste bytes</div><div className="card-b">
            <textarea className="inp" rows={5} placeholder={'hex / base64 / "\\27Lua..." / {27,76,117,97,…}'} value={paste} onChange={e => setPaste(e.target.value)} />
            <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>
              <select className="inp" value={enc} onChange={e => setEnc(e.target.value)}>{['auto', 'hex', 'base64', 'lua', 'decimal', 'latin1'].map(x => <option key={x}>{x}</option>)}</select>
              <button className="btn sm" disabled={!paste.trim()} onClick={fromPaste}>Disassemble</button>
            </div>
          </div></div>
          <div className="card"><div className="card-h"><span className="dot" />File</div><div className="card-b">
            <input type="file" onChange={e => { const f = e.target.files?.[0]; if (f) onFile(f); e.target.value = ''; }} style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--txt-dim)' }} />
            <div className="small muted" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>.luac / .luau bytecode — dropping a binary file anywhere also lands here</div>
          </div></div>
          <div className="card"><div className="card-h"><span className="dot" />Compile {target} code (luau-compile)</div><div className="card-b">
            {backend?.luau.compile ? <>
              <div className="row">
                <Field label="-O"><select value={cOpt.optimize} onChange={e => setCOpt({ ...cOpt, optimize: Number(e.target.value) })}>{[0, 1, 2].map(x => <option key={x}>{x}</option>)}</select></Field>
                <Field label="-g"><select value={cOpt.debug} onChange={e => setCOpt({ ...cOpt, debug: Number(e.target.value) })}>{[0, 1, 2].map(x => <option key={x}>{x}</option>)}</select></Field>
                <button className="btn sm" onClick={compile} disabled={!text.trim()}>Compile → disasm</button>
              </div>
              <div className="small muted" style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>reference compiler: learn what real Luau handlers/opcodes look like, or diff against a VM's semantics</div>
            </> : <div className="small muted">needs the PRISM server with tools/luau (native luau-compile)</div>}
          </div></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="col">
        <Busy on={busy} label="Disassembling" />
        <div className="toolbar">
          <Seg value={opt.style} onChange={v => setOpt({ ...opt, style: v })} options={[{ v: 'rich', label: 'rich' }, { v: 'luau', label: 'reference', title: 'byte-identical to luau-compile --text / luac -l' }]} />
          <Toggle on={opt.lift} onChange={v => setOpt({ ...opt, lift: v })} title="pseudo-Lua per instruction">lift</Toggle>
          <Toggle on={opt.hex} onChange={v => setOpt({ ...opt, hex: v })}>hex</Toggle>
          <Toggle on={opt.constants} onChange={v => setOpt({ ...opt, constants: v })}>constants</Toggle>
          <Toggle on={opt.debug} onChange={v => setOpt({ ...opt, debug: v })} title="line info + local names">debug</Toggle>
          <Field label="format"><select value={opt.format} onChange={e => setOpt({ ...opt, format: e.target.value })}>{['auto', 'luau', 'lua51'].map(x => <option key={x}>{x}</option>)}</select></Field>
          <Field label="opcodes"><select value={opt.encoding} onChange={e => setOpt({ ...opt, encoding: e.target.value })} title="Roblox client bytecode stores op×227 mod 256"><option value="auto">auto</option><option value="plain">plain</option><option value="roblox">roblox ×227</option></select></Field>
          <span className="spacer" />
          {out && <><Copy text={out.text} label="Copy listing" /><Download name={(srcBytes?.label ?? 'bytecode').replace(/[^\w.-]+/g, '_') + '.disasm.txt'} content={out.text} /></>}
          {srcBytes && <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => send('blob', { bytes: srcBytes.bytes, label: srcBytes.label })}>→ Blob Lab</span>}
        </div>
        {srcBytes && out && (
          <div className="toolbar" style={{ paddingTop: 5, paddingBottom: 5 }}>
            <div className="chips">
              <span className="chip hi">{out.format === 'luau' ? `Luau v${sum.version ?? '?'}` : 'Lua 5.1'}</span>
              <span className="chip">{srcBytes.label}</span>
              <span className="chip">bytes <b>{srcBytes.bytes.length}</b></span>
              {sum.protos && <span className="chip">functions <b>{sum.protos.length}</b></span>}
              {sum.functions !== undefined && <span className="chip">functions <b>{sum.functions}</b></span>}
              {sum.instructions !== undefined && <span className="chip">insns <b>{sum.instructions}</b></span>}
              {sum.strings !== undefined && <span className="chip">strings <b>{Array.isArray(sum.strings) ? sum.strings.length : sum.strings}</b></span>}
              {sum.encoding && <span className="chip">opcodes <b>{sum.encoding}</b></span>}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        <ErrorBox error={err} />
        <div className="fill">
          {out ? <Editor height="100%" language="prism-asm" theme="prism" path="disasm.asm" value={out.text} options={RO} />
            : !err && <Empty><div><div className="big">Pick a bytecode source on the left</div>embedded literal · pasted hex/base64/escaped string · file · or compile the current script with luau-compile</div></Empty>}
        </div>
        {srcBytes && !out && err && <div className="small muted" style={{ padding: 10 }}>first bytes: {Array.from(srcBytes.bytes.subarray(0, 32), b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join(' ')} — not standard bytecode? Try Blob Lab (it may be encrypted/compressed) or the Custom VM mode. <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => send('blob', { bytes: srcBytes.bytes, label: srcBytes.label })}>→ Blob Lab</span> <Copy text={bytesLatin1(srcBytes.bytes)} label="Copy raw" /></div>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const VM_EXAMPLE = `-- instructions: JSON array or Lua table literal (e.g. decoded by your Python port)
{ {op=3, a=0, b=1, c=0}, {op=7, a=0, b=2}, {op=12, a=0, b=1} }`;

function VmView({ seed }: { seed: any }) {
  const { backend, toast } = usePrism();
  const [insn, setInsn] = useLocal('vm:insn', VM_EXAMPLE);
  const [consts, setConsts] = useLocal('vm:consts', '');
  const [mapTxt, setMapTxt] = useLocal('vm:opmap', '{\n  "3": {"name": "LOADK", "lua": "R[A] = K[B]"},\n  "7": {"name": "GETGLOBAL", "lua": "R[A] = _ENV[K[B]]"},\n  "12": {"name": "CALL", "lua": "R[A](R[A+1..A+B-1])"}\n}');
  const [o, setO] = useLocal('vm:opts', { opField: '', fields: '', kBase: 1, pcBase: 1 });
  const [out, setOut] = useState<any>(null);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [wsList, setWsList] = useState<string[]>([]);
  useEffect(() => { if (seed?.opmap) { setMapTxt(JSON.stringify(seed.opmap, null, 2)); if (seed.roles?.opField) setO(p => ({ ...p, opField: seed.roles.opField })); toast('opcode map loaded into the VM disassembler', 'ok'); } }, [seed]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  useEffect(() => { if (backend) api.opmaps().then(setWsList).catch(() => {}); }, [backend]);

  const parse = async (t: string): Promise<unknown> => { const s = t.replace(/^\s*--.*$/gm, '').trim(); if (!s) return undefined; try { return JSON.parse(s); } catch { return (await engine.op('literal', '', { text: s })).result; } };
  const run = async () => {
    setErr(null);
    try {
      const instructions = await parse(insn); if (!Array.isArray(instructions)) throw new Error('instructions must be an array (JSON) or a Lua table literal');
      const constants = await parse(consts); const opmap = (await parse(mapTxt)) ?? {};
      const fields: Record<string, string> = {}; for (const p of o.fields.split(/[,\s]+/).filter(Boolean)) { const [k, v] = p.split(/[:=]/); if (k && v) fields[k] = v; }
      const { result } = await engine.op('vmdisasm', '', { instructions, opmap, options: { opField: o.opField || undefined, fields: Object.keys(fields).length ? fields : undefined, constants: Array.isArray(constants) ? constants : undefined, kBase: o.kBase, pcBase: o.pcBase } });
      setOut(result);
    } catch (e: any) { setErr(e.message); }
  };
  return (
    <div className="split" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: 'minmax(300px, 40%) 1fr' }}>
      <div className="scroll" style={{ padding: 10 }}>
        <div className="sec-title">instructions</div>
        <textarea className="inp" rows={9} value={insn} onChange={e => setInsn(e.target.value)} spellCheck={false} />
        <div className="sec-title" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>constants (optional, JSON / Lua table)</div>
        <textarea className="inp" rows={3} value={consts} onChange={e => setConsts(e.target.value)} placeholder='{"print", "hello", 42}' spellCheck={false} />
        <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
          <span className="sec-title" style={{ margin: 0 }}>opcode map</span><span className="spacer" />
          {wsList.length > 0 && <select className="inp" value="" onChange={async e => { if (e.target.value) { setMapTxt(JSON.stringify(await api.getOpmap(e.target.value), null, 2)); } }}><option value="">from workspace…</option>{wsList.map(n => <option key={n}>{n}</option>)}</select>}
        </div>
        <textarea className="inp" rows={8} value={mapTxt} onChange={e => setMapTxt(e.target.value)} spellCheck={false} />
        <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
          <Field label="op field" hint="key/index of the opcode in each instruction (auto: op/opcode/1/0)"><input value={o.opField} onChange={e => setO({ ...o, opField: e.target.value })} style={{ width: 70 }} placeholder="auto" /></Field>
          <Field label="fields" hint='operand keys → letters, e.g. "2:A 3:B 4:C"'><input value={o.fields} onChange={e => setO({ ...o, fields: e.target.value })} style={{ width: 110 }} placeholder="2:A 3:B 4:C" /></Field>
          <Field label="K base"><input type="number" value={o.kBase} onChange={e => setO({ ...o, kBase: Number(e.target.value) })} style={{ width: 50 }} /></Field>
          <Field label="pc base"><input type="number" value={o.pcBase} onChange={e => setO({ ...o, pcBase: Number(e.target.value) })} style={{ width: 50 }} /></Field>
        </div>
        <button className="btn primary sm" style={{ marginTop: 10 }} onClick={run}>Disassemble</button>
        <div className="small muted" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>Templates in the map (<span className="mono">R[A] = K[B]</span>) are filled with operands and constants. Get a map from the Opcode Map tab (“→ VM disasm”).</div>
      </div>
      <div className="col">
        <ErrorBox error={err} />
        {out ? <>
          <div className="toolbar">

        </> : !err && <Empty>Fill in instructions + opcode map, then Disassemble.</Empty>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import type { ConstantsReport, DecoderCandidate } from '@prism/core';
import { usePrism } from '../ctx.js';
import { engine } from '../engineClient.js';
import { Copy, Empty, ErrorBox, Busy, Seg, LineLink, Toggle, latin1Bytes, download } from './ui.js';

type Sec = 'decoders' | 'keys' | 'strings' | 'numbers' | 'arrays';

export function Constants() {
  const { text, target } = usePrism();

  const [sec, setSec] = useState<Sec>('decoders');
  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true; setBusy(true); setErr(null);
    engine.op<ConstantsReport>('constants', text, { maxStrings: 5000, maxNumbers: 4000, maxArrays: 300, maxDecoders: 40 })
      .then(r => live && setRep(r.result)).catch(e => live && setErr(e.message)).finally(() => live && setBusy(false));
    return () => { live = false; };
  }, [text]);
  if (err) return <ErrorBox error={err} />;
  if (!rep) return <Empty><div><span className="spin-loader" style={{ display: 'inline-block' }} /><div className="big" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>Collecting constants…</div></div></Empty>;
  const s = rep.summary;
  return (
    <div className="col">
      <Busy on={busy} label="Collecting" />
      <div className="toolbar">
        <Seg value={sec} onChange={setSec} options={[
          { v: 'decoders', label: `decoders ${rep.decoders.length}` }, { v: 'keys', label: `keys ${rep.keys.length}` },
          { v: 'strings', label: `strings ${s.uniqueStrings}` }, { v: 'numbers', label: `numbers ${s.uniqueNumbers}` }, { v: 'arrays', label: `arrays ${s.arrays}` }]} />
        <span className="small muted">{s.strings} string literals ({s.bytes.toLocaleString()} bytes), {s.numbers} numbers — on {target} code</span>
        <span className="spacer" />
        <Copy text={JSON.stringify(rep, null, 2)} label="Copy all JSON" />
      </div>
      <div className="fill scroll">
        {sec === 'decoders' && <Decoders list={rep.decoders} />}
        {sec === 'keys' && <Keys rep={rep} />}
        {sec === 'strings' && <StringsT rep={rep} />}
        {sec === 'numbers' && <Numbers rep={rep} />}
        {sec === 'arrays' && <Arrays rep={rep} />}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Decoders({ list }: { list: DecoderCandidate[] }) {
  const { text, reveal, send } = usePrism();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<Record<number, string>>({});
  if (!list.length) return <Empty>No decoder-like functions found (no loops over bytes / pool accessors). Try Deobfuscate first, or switch the target.</Empty>;
  const view = async (i: number, d: DecoderCandidate) => {
    if (open[i] !== undefined) { const n = { ...open }; delete n[i]; setOpen(n); return; }
    const { result } = await engine.op('getFunction', text, { query: d.line });
    setOpen({ ...open, [i]: result?.code ?? '(function source not found)' });
  };
  const all = list.map(d => `${d.score.toFixed(1)}  ${d.kind.padEnd(18)} ${d.name}  L${d.line}-${d.endLine}  params=${d.params} calls=${d.callSites} literal=${d.literalArgCalls}\n    ${d.reasons.join('; ')}${d.sampleCalls.length ? '\n    e.g. ' + d.sampleCalls.join(' | ') : ''}`).join('\n');
  return (
    <div className="cards">
      <div className="row"><span className="small muted">Ranked by static evidence: byte loops, % 256 / bit ops, string.char/byte, table.concat, literal-argument call sites. “constant-accessor” = pool lookup, “string-decoder”/“deserializer” = the unpacker to port.</span><span className="spacer" /><Copy text={all} label="Copy list" /></div>
      {list.map((d, i) => (
        <div className="card" key={i}>
          <div className="card-h"><span className="dot" /><span className="chip hi">{d.kind}</span><span className="mono" style={{ color: '#fff' }}>{d.name}</span>
            <LineLink line={d.line} onClick={l => reveal(l)} /><span className="muted small">→ L{d.endLine} · {d.params} params{d.stmts ? ` · ${d.stmts} stmts` : ''}</span>
            <span className="spacer" /><span className="chip">score <b>{d.score.toFixed(1)}</b></span></div>
          <div className="card-b">
            <div className="small">{d.reasons.join(' · ')}</div>
            <div className="small muted" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>{d.callSites} call site(s), {d.literalArgCalls} with literal args</div>
            {d.sampleCalls.length > 0 && <div className="code-peek" style={{ maxHeight: 90 }}>{d.sampleCalls.join('\n')}</div>}
            <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>
              <button className="btn sm" onClick={() => view(i, d)}>{open[i] !== undefined ? 'Hide code' : 'View code'}</button>
              <button className="btn sm" onClick={() => send('python', { fn: String(d.line) })}>→ Python</button>
              <button className="btn sm" onClick={() => send('search', { mode: 'xrefs', name: d.name.replace(/^<.*>$/, ''), line: d.line })} disabled={/^</.test(d.name)}>Xrefs</button>
              {open[i] && <Copy text={open[i]} label="Copy code" />}
            </div>
            {open[i] !== undefined && <div className="code-peek" style={{ maxHeight: 420 }}>{open[i]}</div>}
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

function Keys({ rep }: { rep: ConstantsReport }) {

  return (
    <>

          <td><Copy text={k.value} /> <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => send('blob', { bytes: latin1Bytes(k.value), label: `key L${k.line}` })}>→ Blob</span></td></tr>)}</tbody></table>
    </>
  );
}

function StringsT({ rep }: { rep: ConstantsReport }) {
  const { reveal, send } = usePrism();
  const [q, setQ] = useState(''); const [kind, setKind] = useState('all'); const [hiEnt, setHiEnt] = useState(false);
  const kinds = useMemo(() => [...new Set(rep.strings.map(s => s.kind))].sort(), [rep]);

        <Toggle on={hiEnt} onChange={setHiEnt} title="entropy > 4.5 bits/byte: encrypted / compressed / encoded">high entropy</Toggle>
        <span className="small muted">{rows.length}</span><span className="spacer" />
        <Copy text={rows.map(r => r.display).join('\n')} label="Copy values" />
        <Copy text={rows.map(r => `${r.lines[0] ?? ''}\t${r.kind}\t${r.len}\t${r.entropy.toFixed(2)}\t${r.display}`).join('\n')} label="Copy TSV" />
      </div>
      <table className="data"><thead><tr><th>value</th><th>kind</th><th className="num">len</th><th className="num">H</th><th className="num">×</th><th>line</th><th /></tr></thead>
        <tbody>{rows.slice(0, 2000).map((r, i) => <tr key={i}>
          <td style={{ maxWidth: 420, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', color: 'var(--ok)' }} title={r.display.slice(0, 2000)}>{r.display.slice(0, 300)}</td>
          <td>{r.kind}</td><td className="num">{r.len}</td><td className="num">{r.entropy.toFixed(2)}</td><td className="num">{r.count}</td>
          <td>{r.lines[0] !== undefined && <LineLink line={r.lines[0]} onClick={l => reveal(l)} />}{r.lines.length > 1 && <span className="muted"> +{r.lines.length - 1}</span>}</td>
          <td style={{ whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}><Copy text={r.value} /> <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => send('blob', { bytes: latin1Bytes(r.value), label: `string L${r.lines[0] ?? '?'}` })}>→ Blob</span></td></tr>)}</tbody></table>
      {rows.length > 2000 && <div className="small muted" style={{ padding: 10 }}>showing 2000 of {rows.length} — Copy gets all</div>}
    </>

}

function Numbers({ rep }: { rep: ConstantsReport }) {
