import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import type { PatternResult, XrefBinding } from '@prism/core';
import { usePrism, useInbox } from '../ctx.js';
import { engine } from '../engineClient.js';
import { Copy, Empty, ErrorBox, Busy, Seg, Toggle, LineLink, useLocal } from './ui.js';

type Mode = 'text' | 'pattern' | 'xrefs' | 'functions';
const PATTERNS = ['string.char($$$)', 'bit32.bxor($X, $Y)', '$T[$K] = $T[$K] + 1', 'local $A = $F($$$)', 'for $I = 1, #$S do $$$ end', 'while true do $$$ end', 'getfenv($$$)', 'loadstring($$$)', 'string.byte($S, $I)', 'setmetatable($T, $M)', '$X % 256', 'select("#", ...)'];

export function Search() {
  const { text, reveal, target, send } = usePrism();
  const [mode, setMode] = useLocal<Mode>('search:mode', 'text');
  const [q, setQ] = useLocal('search:q', '');
  const [regex, setRegex] = useLocal('search:regex', false);
  const [cs, setCs] = useLocal('search:cs', false);
  const [word, setWord] = useLocal('search:word', false);
  const [pat, setPat] = useLocal('search:pat', 'string.char($$$)');
  const [xname, setXname] = useState(''); const [xline, setXline] = useState('');
  const [res, setRes] = useState<any>(null);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [fnq, setFnq] = useState('');

  const go = useCallback(async (m: Mode = mode, over?: { name?: string; line?: string }) => {
    setErr(null); setBusy(true);
    try {
      if (m === 'text') { if (!q) { setRes(null); return; } setRes({ m, ...(await engine.op('find', text, { query: q, regex, caseSensitive: cs, word, max: 3000 })).result }); }
      else if (m === 'pattern') setRes({ m, ...(await engine.op<PatternResult>('pattern', text, { pattern: pat, max: 2000 })).result });
      else if (m === 'xrefs') { const name = over?.name ?? xname; const line = over?.line ?? xline; if (!name) { setRes(null); return; } setRes({ m, list: (await engine.op<XrefBinding[]>('xrefs', text, { name, line: line ? Number(line) : undefined, max: 5000 })).result }); }
      else setRes({ m, rep: (await engine.analyze(text)).result });
    } catch (e: any) { setErr(e.message); setRes(null); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  }, [mode, q, regex, cs, word, pat, xname, xline, text]);

  useInbox('search', useCallback((p: any) => { if (p.mode === 'xrefs') { setMode('xrefs'); setXname(p.name ?? ''); setXline(p.line ? String(p.line) : ''); go('xrefs', { name: p.name, line: p.line ? String(p.line) : '' }); } else if (p.query) { setMode('text'); setQ(p.query); } }, [go, setMode, setQ]));
  useEffect(() => { if (mode === 'functions') go('functions'); }, [mode, text]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  const copyText = useMemo(() => {
    if (!res) return '';
    if (res.m === 'text') return res.hits.map((h: any) => `${h.line}:${h.col}: ${h.text}`).join('\n');
    if (res.m === 'pattern') return res.matches.map((h: any) => `${h.line}:${h.col}: ${h.text}${Object.keys(h.bindings).length ? '   ' + Object.entries(h.bindings).map(([k, v]) => `${k}=${v}`).join(' ') : ''}`).join('\n');
    if (res.m === 'xrefs') return res.list.map((b: XrefBinding) => `${b.kind} ${b.name} (line ${b.line}) — ${b.reads} reads, ${b.writes} writes\n` + b.refs.map(r => `  ${r.kind.padEnd(5)} ${r.line}:${r.col}  ${r.text}`).join('\n')).join('\n\n');
    return res.rep.callGraph.functions.map((f: any) => `${f.line}\t${f.name}\t(${f.params.join(', ')})\t${f.stmts} stmts\t${f.calls.length} calls`).join('\n');
  }, [res]);

  return (
    <div className="col">
      <Busy on={busy} label="Searching" />
      <div className="toolbar">
        <Seg value={mode} onChange={m => { setMode(m); setRes(null); }} options={[{ v: 'text', label: 'text / regex' }, { v: 'pattern', label: 'AST pattern' }, { v: 'xrefs', label: 'xrefs' }, { v: 'functions', label: 'functions' }]} />
        <span className="small muted">on {target} code</span><span className="spacer" />
        {res && <Copy text={copyText} label="Copy results" />}
      </div>
      <div className="toolbar" style={{ paddingTop: 6 }}>
        {mode === 'text' && <>
          <input className="inp" autoFocus style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 180 }} placeholder="search text… (Enter)" value={q} onChange={e => setQ(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && go()} />
          <Toggle on={regex} onChange={setRegex}>.* regex</Toggle><Toggle on={cs} onChange={setCs}>Aa case</Toggle><Toggle on={word} onChange={setWord}>whole word</Toggle>
          <button className="btn sm" onClick={() => go()}>Find</button>
        </>}
        {mode === 'pattern' && <>
          <input className="inp" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 200 }} placeholder="Lua code with $X / $_ / $$$" value={pat} onChange={e => setPat(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && go()} />
          <button className="btn sm" onClick={() => go()}>Match</button>
          <div className="row" style={{ width: '100%' }}>{PATTERNS.map(p => <span key={p} className="chip" style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }} onClick={() => { setPat(p); }}>{p}</span>)}</div>
          <div className="small muted">$X = any expression (repeated $X must be equal) · $_ = wildcard · $$$ = any number of args/items/statements</div>
        </>}
        {mode === 'xrefs' && <>
          <input className="inp" style={{ width: 200 }} placeholder="identifier" value={xname} onChange={e => setXname(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && go()} />
          <input className="inp" style={{ width: 90 }} placeholder="at line?" value={xline} onChange={e => setXline(e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, ''))} onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && go()} title="only the binding visible at this line" />
          <button className="btn sm" onClick={() => go()}>Xrefs</button>
          <span className="small muted">scope-aware: every local with that name is a separate binding; globals listed separately</span>
        </>}
        {mode === 'functions' && <input className="inp" style={{ flex: 1 }} placeholder="filter functions…" value={fnq} onChange={e => setFnq(e.target.value)} />}
      </div>
      <ErrorBox error={err || res?.error} />
      <div className="fill scroll">
        {!res && !busy && <Empty>{mode === 'text' ? 'Type a query and press Enter.' : mode === 'pattern' ? 'Structural search over the AST — pick an example or write your own.' : mode === 'xrefs' ? 'Every read / write / declaration of a variable, scope-aware.' : ''}</Empty>}
        {res?.m === 'text' && <>
          <div className="small muted" style={{ padding: '6px 12px' }}>{res.total} matches{res.total > res.hits.length ? ` (showing ${res.hits.length})` : ''}</div>
          <table className="data"><tbody>{res.hits.map((h: any, i: number) => <tr key={i}><td style={{ width: 70 }}><LineLink line={h.line} onClick={l => reveal(l, h.col)} /></td><td style={{ whiteSpace: 'pre', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', maxWidth: 700 }}><Hi text={h.text} m={h.match} /></td></tr>)}</tbody></table>
        </>}
        {res?.m === 'pattern' && <>
          <div className="small muted" style={{ padding: '6px 12px' }}>{res.total} matches ({res.kind})</div>
          <table className="data"><tbody>{res.matches.map((h: any, i: number) => <tr key={i}><td style={{ width: 70 }}><LineLink line={h.line} onClick={l => reveal(l, h.col)} /></td><td style={{ maxWidth: 520, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }} title={h.text}>{h.text}</td><td>{Object.entries(h.bindings).map(([k, v]) => <span key={k} className="chip" style={{ marginRight: 4 }}>{k}=<b>{String(v).slice(0, 40)}</b></span>)}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table>
        </>}
        {res?.m === 'xrefs' && (res.list.length === 0 ? <Empty>No binding named “{xname}”.</Empty> : res.list.map((b: XrefBinding, i: number) => (
          <div className="card" key={i} style={{ margin: 10 }}>
            <div className="card-h"><span className="dot" /><span className="chip hi">{b.kind}</span><span className="mono" style={{ color: '#fff' }}>{b.name}</span>{b.line > 0 && <LineLink line={b.line} onClick={l => reveal(l)} />}<span className="small muted">{b.reads} reads · {b.writes} writes{b.captured ? ' · captured as upvalue' : ''}</span>
              <span className="spacer" />{b.line > 0 && <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => send('python', { fn: String(b.line) })}>→ Python</span>}</div>
            <table className="data"><tbody>{b.refs.map((r, j) => <tr key={j}><td style={{ width: 54, color: r.kind === 'write' ? 'var(--warn)' : r.kind === 'decl' ? 'var(--neon2)' : 'var(--txt-mute)' }}>{r.kind}</td><td style={{ width: 80 }}><LineLink line={r.line} onClick={l => reveal(l, r.col)} />:{r.col}</td><td style={{ whiteSpace: 'nowrap', overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', maxWidth: 640 }}>{r.text}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table>
          </div>)))}
        {res?.m === 'functions' && (
          <table className="data"><thead><tr><th>line</th><th>name</th><th>params</th><th className="num">stmts</th><th className="num">calls</th><th>depth</th><th /></tr></thead>
            <tbody>{res.rep.callGraph.functions.filter((f: any) => !fnq || f.name.toLowerCase().includes(fnq.toLowerCase())).slice(0, 3000).map((f: any) => <tr key={f.id}>
              <td><LineLink line={f.line} onClick={l => reveal(l)} /></td><td style={{ color: '#fff' }}>{f.name}</td><td>({f.params.join(', ')}{f.vararg ? (f.params.length ? ', ...' : '...') : ''})</td><td className="num">{f.stmts}</td><td className="num">{f.calls.length}</td><td className="num">{f.depth}</td>
              <td style={{ whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}><span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => send('python', { fn: String(f.line) })}>→ Python</span> {f.id !== 'main' && !/^</.test(f.name) && <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => { setMode('xrefs'); setXname(f.name.split(/[.:]/).pop()!); setXline(''); go('xrefs', { name: f.name.split(/[.:]/).pop()!, line: '' }); }}>xrefs</span>}</td></tr>)}</tbody></table>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Hi({ text, m }: { text: string; m: string }) {
  const i = m ? text.indexOf(m) : -1;
  if (i < 0) return <>{text}</>;
  return <>{text.slice(0, i)}<b style={{ color: 'var(--neon2)', textShadow: '0 0 8px rgba(255,92,225,.5)' }}>{m}</b>{text.slice(i + m.length)}</>;
}
EOF

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import Editor from '@monaco-editor/react';
import { usePrism, useInbox } from '../ctx.js';
import { engine } from '../engineClient.js';
import { Copy, Download, Empty, ErrorBox, Busy, Seg, Toggle, useLocal } from './ui.js';

export function Python() {
  const { text, target, name } = usePrism();
  const [mode, setMode] = useLocal<'function' | 'whole'>('py:mode', 'function');
  const [fn, setFn] = useState('');
  const [prelude, setPrelude] = useLocal('py:prelude', true);
  const [fns, setFns] = useState<Array<{ id: string; name: string; line: number; params: string[]; stmts: number }>>([]);
  const [out, setOut] = useState<any>(null);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => { let live = true; engine.analyze(text).then(r => live && setFns(r.result.callGraph.functions.filter(f => f.id !== 'main').map(f => ({ id: f.id, name: f.name, line: f.line, params: f.params, stmts: f.stmts })))).catch(() => {}); return () => { live = false; }; }, [text]);

  const go = useCallback(async (m = mode, f = fn) => {
    setErr(null); setBusy(true);
    try {
      if (m === 'function' && !f) { setOut(null); return; }
      const q = m === 'function' ? (/^\d+$/.test(f) ? Number(f) : f) : '';
      const { result } = await engine.op('python', text, { fn: m === 'function' ? q : '', prelude });
      if (!result) throw new Error(`function "${f}" not found — pick one from the list (name or line number)`);
      setOut(result);
    } catch (e: any) { setErr(e.message); setOut(null); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  }, [mode, fn, text, prelude]);

  useInbox('python', useCallback((p: any) => { setMode('function'); setFn(String(p.fn)); go('function', String(p.fn)); }, [go, setMode]));
  useEffect(() => { if (mode === 'whole') go('whole'); }, [mode, text, prelude]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  useEffect(() => { if (mode === 'function' && fn) go('function', fn); }, [prelude]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps

  const file = (mode === 'function' && out?.name ? out.name.replace(/[^\w]+/g, '_') : name.replace(/\.(lua|luau|txt)$/i, '')) + '.py';
  return (
    <div className="col">
      <Busy on={busy} label="Transpiling" />
      <div className="toolbar">
        <Seg value={mode} onChange={setMode} options={[{ v: 'function', label: 'one function (+ deps)' }, { v: 'whole', label: 'whole script' }]} />
        {mode === 'function' && <>
          <input className="inp" list="py-fns" placeholder="function name or line" value={fn} onChange={e => setFn(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && go()} style={{ width: 200 }} />
          <datalist id="py-fns">{fns.slice(0, 2000).map(f => <option key={f.id} value={String(f.line)}>{f.name} ({f.params.join(', ')}) · {f.stmts} stmts</option>)}</datalist>
          <select className="inp" value="" onChange={e => { if (e.target.value) { setFn(e.target.value); go('function', e.target.value); } }} style={{ maxWidth: 240 }}>
            <option value="">pick… ({fns.length})</option>{fns.slice(0, 2000).map(f => <option key={f.id} value={String(f.line)}>L{f.line} {f.name}({f.params.join(',')})</option>)}
          </select>
          <button className="btn sm" onClick={() => go()} disabled={!fn}>Transpile</button>
        </>}
        <Toggle on={prelude} onChange={setPrelude} title="include the Lua-semantics runtime helpers (1-based strings, bit32, string.byte/char/sub, table ops)">runtime prelude</Toggle>
        <span className="small muted">on {target} code</span>
        <span className="spacer" />
        {out && <><Copy text={out.code} label="Copy Python" /><Download name={file} content={out.code} mime="text/x-python" /></>}
      </div>
      {out && (out.warnings?.length > 0 || out.freeNames?.length > 0 || out.deps?.length > 0) && (
        <div className="toolbar" style={{ paddingTop: 5, paddingBottom: 5 }}>
          {out.deps?.length > 0 && <span className="small">deps: <span className="mono" style={{ color: 'var(--neon3)' }}>{out.deps.join(', ')}</span></span>}
          {out.freeNames?.length > 0 && <span className="small">free names: <span className="mono" style={{ color: 'var(--warn)' }}>{out.freeNames.slice(0, 30).join(', ')}</span></span>}
          {out.warnings?.length > 0 && <span className="small" style={{ color: 'var(--warn)' }} title={out.warnings.join('\n')}>⚠ {out.warnings.length} warning(s): {out.warnings.slice(0, 2).join(' · ')}</span>}
          {out.warnings?.length > 0 && <Copy text={out.warnings.join('\n')} label="Copy warnings" />}
        </div>
      )}
      <ErrorBox error={err} />
      <div className="fill">
        {out ? <Editor height="100%" language="python" theme="prism" path={'py-' + file} value={out.code} options={{ minimap: { enabled: false }, fontSize: 12, readOnly: true, scrollBeyondLastLine: false, automaticLayout: true }} />
          : !err && <Empty><div><div className="big">Lua → Python 3</div>Port a decoder/unpacker (pick it from Constants → “→ Python”, or by name / line here). The result runs standalone with the prelude: keys and blobs inside the file can then be decoded statically.</div></Empty>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

## 541. ИИ · шаг

Добавляю асинхронный blob-конвейер с zlib в воркер
bash
cd /data/prism/apps/web/src && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='engine.worker.ts'
s=open(p).read()
old="self.onmessage = (e: MessageEvent<Req>) => {"
new="""const ZLIB: Record<string, CompressionFormat> = { inflate: 'deflate', gunzip: 'gzip', 'inflate-raw': 'deflate-raw' };
async function decompress(b: Uint8Array, fmt: CompressionFormat): Promise<Uint8Array> {
  const ds = new DecompressionStream(fmt);
  const stream = new Blob([b as BlobPart]).stream().pipeThrough(ds);
  return new Uint8Array(await new Response(stream).arrayBuffer());
}
async function runBlobAsync(input: Uint8Array, steps: Array<{ op: string; arg?: string }>) {
  let cur = input; const trace: Array<{ op: string; len: number; error?: string }> = [];
  for (const st of steps) {
    try {
      if (ZLIB[st.op]) cur = await decompress(cur, ZLIB[st.op]);
      else { const r = Blob.runBlob(cur, [st]); if (r.trace[0]?.error) { trace.push(r.trace[0]); break; } cur = r.out; }
      trace.push({ op: st.op, len: cur.length });
    } catch (err: any) { trace.push({ op: st.op, len: cur.length, error: String(err?.message ?? err) }); break; }
  }
  return { out: cur, trace, info: blobInfo(cur) };
}

self.onmessage = async (e: MessageEvent<Req>) => {"""
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
old2="      case 'blob': { const r = Blob.runBlob(opts.bytes as Uint8Array, opts.steps ?? []); result = { out: r.out, trace: r.trace, info: blobInfo(r.out) }; break; }"
new2="""      case 'blob': result = await runBlobAsync(opts.bytes as Uint8Array, opts.steps ?? []); break;
      case 'blobAutoZ': {
        // auto-decode + zlib attempts on the raw input and on each candidate
        const base = Blob.autoDecode(opts.bytes as Uint8Array);
        const extra: typeof base = [];
        for (const c of [{ steps: [] as Array<{ op: string; arg?: string }> }, ...base.slice(0, 4)]) {
          for (const z of Object.keys(ZLIB)) {
            const r = await runBlobAsync(opts.bytes as Uint8Array, [...c.steps, { op: z }]);
            if (!r.trace.some(t => t.error) && r.out.length) extra.push({ steps: [...c.steps, { op: z }], len: r.out.length, printable: r.info.printable, entropy: r.info.entropy, magic: r.info.magic, preview: Blob.unlatin1(r.out.subarray(0, 80)).replace(/[^\\x20-\\x7e]/g, '.') });
          }
        }
        result = [...extra, ...base];
        break;
      }"""
assert old2 in s
s=s.replace(old2,new2)
open(p,'w').write(s)

bash
cd /data/prism/apps/web/src && cat > components/BlobLab.tsx <<'EOF'
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { BLOB_OPS, asPythonBytes, asLuaString, asCArray, asLuaTable, b64encode, hexencode } from '../../../../packages/core/src/blob/blob.js';
import { usePrism, useInbox } from '../ctx.js';
import { engine } from '../engineClient.js';
import { api } from '../api.js';
import { Copy, Empty, ErrorBox, Seg, Field, useLocal, download, bytesLatin1 } from './ui.js';

type Step = { op: string; arg?: string };
type Info = { length: number; entropy: number; printable: number; magic: string[]; hexdump: string };
const ZOPS: Record<string, string> = { inflate: 'zlib inflate (DecompressionStream)', gunzip: 'gzip decompress', 'inflate-raw': 'raw deflate decompress' };
const ALL_OPS: Array<[string, string, string | undefined]> = [...Object.entries(BLOB_OPS).map(([k, v]) => [k, v.label, v.arg] as [string, string, string | undefined]), ...Object.entries(ZOPS).map(([k, v]) => [k, v, undefined] as [string, string, undefined])];
type View = 'hexdump' | 'text' | 'utf8' | 'python' | 'lua' | 'c' | 'table' | 'base64' | 'hex';

export function BlobLab() {
  const { text, send, backend, toast, reveal } = usePrism();
  const [raw, setRaw] = useLocal('blob:raw', '');
  const [enc, setEnc] = useLocal('blob:enc', 'auto');
  const [bin, setBin] = useState<{ bytes: Uint8Array; label: string } | null>(null);
  const [steps, setSteps] = useLocal<Step[]>('blob:steps', []);
  const [view, setView] = useLocal<View>('blob:view', 'hexdump');
  const [input, setInput] = useState<Uint8Array | null>(null);
  const [res, setRes] = useState<{ out: Uint8Array; trace: Array<{ op: string; len: number; error?: string }>; info: Info } | null>(null);
  const [auto, setAuto] = useState<any[] | null>(null);
  const [xor, setXor] = useState<any>(null);
  const [plain, setPlain] = useState(''); const [plainOff, setPlainOff] = useState(0);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [lit, setLit] = useState('');

  useInbox('blob', useCallback((p: { bytes: Uint8Array; label: string }) => { setBin(p); setAuto(null); setXor(null); }, []));

  // resolve the input bytes
  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true; setErr(null);
    if (bin) { setInput(bin.bytes); return; }
    if (!raw.trim()) { setInput(null); return; }
    engine.op<Uint8Array>('parseBytes', '', { data: raw, encoding: enc }).then(r => live && setInput(r.result)).catch(e => live && setErr(e.message));
    return () => { live = false; };
  }, [raw, enc, bin]);
  // run the pipeline
  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    if (!input) { setRes(null); return; }
    engine.op('blob', '', { bytes: input, steps }).then(r => live && setRes(r.result)).catch(e => live && setErr(e.message));
    return () => { live = false; };
  }, [input, steps]);

  const out = res?.out;
  const rendered = useMemo(() => {
    if (!out || !res) return '';
    const cap = out.length > 2_000_000 ? out.subarray(0, 2_000_000) : out;
    switch (view) {
      case 'hexdump': return res.info.hexdump + (out.length > 8192 ? `\n… ${out.length - 8192} more bytes (Copy/Download in another format for everything)` : '');
      case 'text': return bytesLatin1(cap);
      case 'utf8': return new TextDecoder().decode(cap);
      case 'python': return asPythonBytes(cap);
      case 'lua': return asLuaString(cap);
      case 'c': return asCArray(cap);
      case 'table': return asLuaTable(cap);
      case 'base64': return b64encode(cap);
      case 'hex': return hexencode(cap);
    }
  }, [out, res, view]);
  const fullFor = (v: View) => { if (!out) return ''; switch (v) { case 'hexdump': return res!.info.hexdump; case 'text': return bytesLatin1(out); case 'utf8': return new TextDecoder().decode(out); case 'python': return asPythonBytes(out); case 'lua': return asLuaString(out); case 'c': return asCArray(out); case 'table': return asLuaTable(out); case 'base64': return b64encode(out); case 'hex': return hexencode(out); } };

  const runAuto = async () => { if (!input) return; try { setAuto((await engine.op('blobAutoZ', '', { bytes: input })).result); } catch (e: any) { setErr(e.message); } };
  const runXor = async () => { const b = out ?? input; if (!b) return; try { setXor((await engine.op('xor', '', { bytes: b, plain: plain || undefined, offset: plainOff })).result); } catch (e: any) { setErr(e.message); } };
  const fromLiteral = async () => { const [l, i] = lit.split(/[:#]/).map(Number); if (!l) return; try { const { result } = await engine.op<Uint8Array>('literalBytes', text, { line: l, index: (i || 1) - 1 }); setBin({ bytes: result, label: `string literal L${l}${i ? '#' + i : ''}` }); } catch (e: any) { setErr(e.message); } };
  const isBc = !!res?.info.magic.some(m => /bytecode/i.test(m));
  const saveWs = async () => { if (!out) return; const n = prompt('workspace output name', 'blob.bin'); if (!n) return; try { const r = await api.saveOutput(n, out); toast('saved ' + r.file, 'ok'); } catch (e: any) { toast(e.message, 'bad'); } };
  const recipe = JSON.stringify(steps);

  return (
    <div className="split" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: 'minmax(300px, 38%) 1fr' }}>
      <div className="scroll" style={{ padding: 10 }}>
        <div className="sec-title">input</div>
        {bin ? (
          <div className="step"><span className="n">bytes</span><span className="mono">{bin.label}</span><span className="muted">{bin.bytes.length} B</span><span className="spacer" /><span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => setBin(null)}>use text input</span></div>
        ) : <>
          <textarea className="inp" rows={6} value={raw} onChange={e => setRaw(e.target.value)} placeholder={'paste a blob: base64 / hex / "\\27\\76…" / {1,2,3} / raw text'} spellCheck={false} />
          <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>
            <Field label="as"><select value={enc} onChange={e => setEnc(e.target.value)}>{['auto', 'latin1', 'utf8', 'lua', 'hex', 'base64', 'decimal'].map(x => <option key={x}>{x}</option>)}</select></Field>
            <input type="file" style={{ fontSize: 11, color: 'var(--txt-dim)', maxWidth: 190 }} onChange={async e => { const f = e.target.files?.[0]; if (f) setBin({ bytes: new Uint8Array(await f.arrayBuffer()), label: f.name }); e.target.value = ''; }} />
          </div>
        </>}
        <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>
          <Field label="string literal at line" hint="line[:n] — n-th literal on that line (current target code)"><input value={lit} onChange={e => setLit(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && fromLiteral()} placeholder="123 or 123:2" style={{ width: 100 }} /></Field>
          <button className="btn sm" onClick={fromLiteral} disabled={!lit}>Load</button>
        </div>

        <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}><span className="sec-title" style={{ margin: 0 }}>pipeline</span><span className="spacer" /><Copy text={recipe} label="Copy recipe" /><span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => { const r = prompt('paste a recipe (JSON array of {op,arg})', recipe); if (r) { try { setSteps(JSON.parse(r)); } catch { toast('invalid recipe', 'bad'); } } }}>Paste recipe</span>{steps.length > 0 && <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => setSteps([])}>Clear</span>}</div>
        <div className="col" style={{ gap: 6, height: 'auto' }}>
          {steps.map((s, i) => {
            const meta = ALL_OPS.find(o => o[0] === s.op); const tr = res?.trace[i];
            return (
              <div key={i} className={'step ' + (tr?.error ? 'err' : '')}>
                <span className="n">{i + 1}</span>
                <select className="inp" value={s.op} onChange={e => setSteps(steps.map((x, j) => j === i ? { op: e.target.value } : x))} style={{ maxWidth: 140 }}>{ALL_OPS.map(([k]) => <option key={k}>{k}</option>)}</select>
                {meta?.[2] && <input className="inp" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 60 }} placeholder={meta[2]} value={s.arg ?? ''} onChange={e => setSteps(steps.map((x, j) => j === i ? { ...x, arg: e.target.value } : x))} />}
                <span className="spacer" />
                <span className="small muted" title={tr?.error}>{tr ? (tr.error ? '✗ ' + tr.error.slice(0, 40) : tr.len + ' B') : ''}</span>
                <span className="x-btn" onClick={() => setSteps(steps.filter((_, j) => j !== i))} title="remove">×</span>
              </div>
            );
          })}
          <select className="inp" value="" onChange={e => { if (e.target.value) setSteps([...steps, { op: e.target.value }]); }}>
            <option value="">+ add step…</option>{ALL_OPS.map(([k, l]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{k} — {l}</option>)}
          </select>
        </div>

        <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}><span className="sec-title" style={{ margin: 0 }}>auto-decode</span><span className="spacer" /><button className="btn sm" onClick={runAuto} disabled={!input}>Try encodings</button></div>
        {auto && (auto.length === 0 ? <div className="small muted">nothing decoded cleanly</div> : <div className="list" style={{ border: '1px solid var(--stroke)', borderRadius: 9, marginTop: 6 }}>
          {auto.slice(0, 12).map((a, i) => <div key={i} className="li" onClick={() => setSteps(a.steps)} title="apply this pipeline">
            <span className="mono" style={{ color: 'var(--neon3)', minWidth: 110 }}>{a.steps.map((s: Step) => s.op).join(' → ') || '(raw)'}</span>
            <span className="small muted">{a.len} B · {(a.printable * 100).toFixed(0)}% print · H {a.entropy.toFixed(2)}</span>
            {a.magic.length > 0 && <span className="chip hi">{a.magic[0]}</span>}
          </div>)}</div>)}

        <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 14 }}><span className="sec-title" style={{ margin: 0 }}>xor key recovery</span><span className="spacer" /><button className="btn sm" onClick={runXor} disabled={!input}>Analyze {out && steps.length ? 'output' : 'input'}</button></div>
        <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>
          <Field label="known plaintext"><input value={plain} onChange={e => setPlain(e.target.value)} placeholder='e.g. "\x1bLua" or local ' style={{ width: 130 }} /></Field>
          <Field label="@"><input type="number" value={plainOff} onChange={e => setPlainOff(Number(e.target.value))} style={{ width: 60 }} /></Field>
        </div>
        {xor && <div style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>
          <div className="small muted">single-byte keys (best plaintext score):</div>
          <div className="list">{xor.single.map((c: any, i: number) => <div key={i} className="li" onClick={() => setSteps([...steps, { op: 'xor', arg: String(c.key) }])} title="add as xor step"><span className="chip hi">0x{c.key.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')}</span><span className="small muted">{c.score.toFixed(2)}</span><span className="t small">{c.preview}</span></div>)}</div>
          <div className="small muted" style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>repeating-key length guesses (normalized Hamming): {xor.lengths.map((l: any) => `${l.len} (${l.dist.toFixed(2)})`).join(', ')}</div>
          {xor.known && <div className="small" style={{ marginTop: 6 }}>key from known plaintext: <span className="mono" style={{ color: 'var(--ok)' }}>{xor.known.map((x: number) => x.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join(' ')}</span> <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => setSteps([...steps, { op: 'xor', arg: 'hex:' + xor.known.map((x: number) => x.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('') }])}>add xor step</span></div>}
        </div>}
      </div>

      <div className="col">
        <ErrorBox error={err} />
        {res && out ? <>
          <div className="toolbar">
            <div className="chips">
              <span className="chip hi">{out.length.toLocaleString()} B</span>
              <span className="chip">H <b>{res.info.entropy.toFixed(2)}</b></span>
              <span className="chip">printable <b>{(res.info.printable * 100).toFixed(0)}%</b></span>
              {res.info.magic.map((m, i) => <span key={i} className="chip hi">{m}</span>)}
            </div>
            <span className="spacer" />
            {isBc && <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => send('disasm', { bytes: out, label: 'Blob Lab output' })}>→ Disassemble</span>}
            <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => { setBin({ bytes: out, label: 'previous output' }); setSteps([]); }} title="chain: use this output as the new input">Use as input</span>
            <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => download('blob.bin', out, 'application/octet-stream')}>Download .bin</span>
            {backend && <span className="copy-btn" onClick={saveWs}>Save to workspace</span>}
          </div>
          <div className="toolbar" style={{ paddingTop: 5, paddingBottom: 5 }}>
            <Seg value={view} onChange={setView} options={['hexdump', 'text', 'utf8', 'python', 'lua', 'c', 'table', 'base64', 'hex'] as View[]} />
            <span className="spacer" /><Copy text={fullFor(view)} label={`Copy ${view}`} />
          </div>
          <div className="fill scroll"><pre className="block" style={{ maxHeight: 'none', border: 'none', borderRadius: 0, minHeight: '100%' }}>{rendered.length > 400000 ? rendered.slice(0, 400000) + '\n… (Copy / Download for everything)' : rendered}</pre></div>
        </> : <Empty><div><div className="big">Blob Lab</div>Paste or send a blob (Constants/Strings “→ Blob”, Disassembly, files). Build a decode pipeline step by step — every step is a pure static transform; copy the recipe, export the bytes.</div></Empty>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { usePrism, useInbox } from '../ctx.js';
import { api, type ToolInfo, type JsonSchema, type ToolRun, type ScriptMeta } from '../api.js';
import { Copy, Download, Empty, ErrorBox, Toggle, JsonView, useLocal } from './ui.js';

const LONG = new Set(['source', 'data', 'instructions', 'constants', 'text', 'lua', 'expression', 'pattern', 'renames', 'opmap', 'map', 'steps', 'note', 'content', 'plaintext', 'fields']);
const SRC_KEYS = ['script_id', 'path', 'source'];
type SrcMode = 'target' | 'input' | 'cleaned' | 'script' | 'path' | 'inline' | 'none';

const typeOf = (s: JsonSchema): string => { const t = Array.isArray(s.type) ? s.type.find(x => x !== 'null') : s.type; if (t) return t; if (s.anyOf) return s.anyOf.map(typeOf).includes('string') ? 'string' : typeOf(s.anyOf[0]); return 'string'; };

export function ToolsConsole() {
  const { ensureScriptId, target, toast, backend } = usePrism();
  const [tools, setTools] = useState<ToolInfo[] | null>(null);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [sel, setSel] = useLocal('tools:sel', 'auto_triage');
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const [vals, setVals] = useLocal<Record<string, Record<string, string>>>('tools:vals', {});
  const [srcMode, setSrcMode] = useLocal<SrcMode>('tools:src', 'target');
  const [srcVal, setSrcVal] = useState('');
  const [scripts, setScripts] = useState<ScriptMeta[]>([]);
  const [run, setRun] = useState<ToolRun | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [hist, setHist] = useLocal<Array<{ tool: string; args: Record<string, unknown>; ok: boolean; ms: number; at: string }>>('tools:hist', []);

  useEffect(() => { api.tools().then(setTools).catch(e => setErr(e.message)); api.workspace().then(w => setScripts(w.scripts)).catch(() => {}); }, [backend]);
  useInbox('tool', useCallback((p: { name: string; args?: Record<string, string> }) => { setSel(p.name); if (p.args) setVals(v => ({ ...v, [p.name]: p.args! })); }, [setSel, setVals]));

  const tool = tools?.find(t => t.name === sel);
  const props = tool?.inputSchema.properties ?? {};
  const hasSrc = SRC_KEYS.some(k => k in props);
  const v = vals[sel] ?? {};
  const setV = (k: string, x: string) => setVals(all => ({ ...all, [sel]: { ...(all[sel] ?? {}), [k]: x } }));
  const groups = useMemo(() => {
    const ql = q.toLowerCase(); const m = new Map<string, ToolInfo[]>();
    for (const t of tools ?? []) if (!ql || t.name.includes(ql) || t.title.toLowerCase().includes(ql) || t.description.toLowerCase().includes(ql)) { if (!m.has(t.category)) m.set(t.category, []); m.get(t.category)!.push(t); }
    return [...m.entries()];
  }, [tools, q]);

  const buildArgs = async (): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> => {
    const args: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    for (const [k, s] of Object.entries(props)) {
      if (SRC_KEYS.includes(k)) continue;
      const raw = v[k]; if (raw === undefined || raw === '') continue;
      const t = typeOf(s);
      if (t === 'number' || t === 'integer') { const n = Number(raw); if (Number.isNaN(n)) throw new Error(`${k}: not a number`); args[k] = n; }
      else if (t === 'boolean') args[k] = raw === 'true';
      else if (t === 'array' || t === 'object') { try { args[k] = JSON.parse(raw); } catch { throw new Error(`${k}: invalid JSON`); } }
      else args[k] = raw;
    }
    if (hasSrc) {
      if (srcMode === 'target' || srcMode === 'input' || srcMode === 'cleaned') { const id = await ensureScriptId(srcMode === 'target' ? undefined : srcMode); if (!id) throw new Error('no current script — paste/open one first'); args.script_id = id; }
      else if (srcMode === 'script') { if (!srcVal) throw new Error('pick a workspace script'); args.script_id = srcVal; }
      else if (srcMode === 'path') { if (!srcVal) throw new Error('enter a path on the server'); args.path = srcVal; }
      else if (srcMode === 'inline') { if (!srcVal) throw new Error('enter source'); args.source = srcVal; }
    }
    return args;
  };
  const exec = async () => {
    if (!tool) return;
    setBusy(true); setErr(null);
    try {
      const args = await buildArgs();
      const r = await api.run(tool.name, args);
      setRun(r);
      setHist(h => [{ tool: tool.name, args, ok: r.ok, ms: r.ms, at: new Date().toLocaleTimeString() }, ...h].slice(0, 40));
      if (r.files?.length || /script_id|saved/.test(r.text ?? '')) api.workspace().then(w => setScripts(w.scripts)).catch(() => {});
    } catch (e: any) { setErr(e.message); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  const restore = (h: { tool: string; args: Record<string, unknown> }) => {
    setSel(h.tool);
    const o: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const [k, x] of Object.entries(h.args)) { if (SRC_KEYS.includes(k)) continue; o[k] = typeof x === 'string' ? x : JSON.stringify(x); }
    setVals(all => ({ ...all, [h.tool]: o }));
    if (h.args.script_id) { setSrcMode('script'); setSrcVal(String(h.args.script_id)); } else if (h.args.path) { setSrcMode('path'); setSrcVal(String(h.args.path)); }
  };

  if (err && !tools) return <ErrorBox error={err} />;
  if (!tools) return <Empty><span className="spin-loader" /></Empty>;
  const mcpCall = (a: Record<string, unknown>) => JSON.stringify({ name: sel, arguments: a }, null, 2);
  const lastArgs = hist.find(h => h.tool === sel)?.args ?? {};

  return (
    <div className="split" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: 'minmax(220px, 270px) 1fr' }}>
      <div className="col">
        <div className="toolbar"><input className="inp" style={{ flex: 1 }} placeholder={`filter ${tools.length} tools…`} value={q} onChange={e => setQ(e.target.value)} /></div>
        <div className="fill scroll">
          {groups.map(([cat, ts]) => (
            <div key={cat}>
              <div className="sec-title" style={{ padding: '8px 12px 2px' }}>{cat}</div>
              <div className="list">{ts.map(t => <div key={t.name} className={'li ' + (t.name === sel ? 'sel' : '')} onClick={() => { setSel(t.name); setRun(null); }} title={t.description}>
                <div style={{ minWidth: 0 }}><div className="t" style={{ fontSize: 11.5 }}>{t.name}</div><div className="small muted" style={{ overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>{t.title}</div></div>
                <span className="spacer" />{!t.readOnly && <span title="may write to the workspace" style={{ color: 'var(--warn)', fontSize: 10 }}>✎</span>}
              </div>)}</div>
            </div>
          ))}
          {hist.length > 0 && <>
            <div className="row" style={{ padding: '12px 12px 2px' }}><span className="sec-title" style={{ margin: 0 }}>history</span><span className="spacer" /><span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => setHist([])}>clear</span></div>
            <div className="list">{hist.map((h, i) => <div key={i} className="li" onClick={() => restore(h)} title={JSON.stringify(h.args).slice(0, 400)}><span style={{ color: h.ok ? 'var(--ok)' : 'var(--bad)' }}>●</span><span className="t small">{h.tool}</span><span className="spacer" /><span className="small muted">{h.ms}ms · {h.at}</span></div>)}</div>
          </>}
        </div>
      </div>
      <div className="col">
        {tool ? <>
          <div className="toolbar" style={{ alignItems: 'flex-start' }}>
            <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
              <div className="row"><b style={{ color: '#fff' }}>{tool.title}</b><span className="chip">{tool.name}</span><span className="chip">{tool.category}</span>{tool.readOnly ? <span className="chip">read-only</span> : <span className="chip" style={{ color: 'var(--warn)' }}>writes workspace</span>}</div>
              <div className="small" style={{ marginTop: 4, maxHeight: 74, overflow: 'auto' }}>{tool.description}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="fill scroll">
            <div style={{ padding: 12, display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'minmax(120px, 170px) 1fr', gap: '8px 12px', alignItems: 'start' }}>
              {hasSrc && <>
                <span className="small" style={{ paddingTop: 6, color: 'var(--txt)' }}>source</span>
                <div>
                  <div className="row">
                    <select className="inp" value={srcMode} onChange={e => { setSrcMode(e.target.value as SrcMode); setSrcVal(''); }}>
                      <option value="target">current ({target})</option><option value="input">current input</option><option value="cleaned">current cleaned</option>
                      <option value="script">workspace script…</option><option value="path">file path on server…</option><option value="inline">inline source…</option><option value="none">none</option>
                    </select>
                    {srcMode === 'script' && <select className="inp" value={srcVal} onChange={e => setSrcVal(e.target.value)} style={{ maxWidth: 320 }}><option value="">pick ({scripts.length})…</option>{scripts.map(s => <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>{s.id} — {s.lines} lines{s.derivedBy ? ` (${s.derivedBy})` : ''}</option>)}</select>}
                    {srcMode === 'path' && <input className="inp" style={{ flex: 1 }} value={srcVal} onChange={e => setSrcVal(e.target.value)} placeholder="/abs/path/to/script.lua" />}
                  </div>
                  {srcMode === 'inline' && <textarea className="inp" rows={4} value={srcVal} onChange={e => setSrcVal(e.target.value)} style={{ marginTop: 6 }} />}
                  <div className="small muted" style={{ marginTop: 3 }}>current script is uploaded to the workspace once and passed as script_id</div>
                </div>
              </>}
              {Object.entries(props).filter(([k]) => !SRC_KEYS.includes(k)).map(([k, s]) => {
                const t = typeOf(s); const req = tool.inputSchema.required?.includes(k);
                const en = s.enum ?? s.anyOf?.flatMap(a => a.enum ?? []);
                return (
                  <React.Fragment key={k}>
                    <span className="small mono" style={{ paddingTop: 6, color: req ? '#fff' : 'var(--txt-dim)' }} title={s.description}>{k}{req && <span style={{ color: 'var(--neon2)' }}> *</span>}<div className="muted" style={{ fontSize: 9.5, fontFamily: 'var(--sans)' }}>{t}</div></span>
                    <div>
                      {en && en.length ? <select className="inp" value={v[k] ?? ''} onChange={e => setV(k, e.target.value)}><option value="">(default)</option>{en.map(x => <option key={String(x)} value={String(x)}>{String(x)}</option>)}</select>
                        : t === 'boolean' ? <select className="inp" value={v[k] ?? ''} onChange={e => setV(k, e.target.value)}><option value="">(default)</option><option value="true">true</option><option value="false">false</option></select>
                        : t === 'array' || t === 'object' || LONG.has(k) ? <textarea className="inp" rows={t === 'array' || t === 'object' ? 3 : 4} value={v[k] ?? ''} onChange={e => setV(k, e.target.value)} placeholder={t === 'array' ? '[ … ] JSON' : t === 'object' ? '{ … } JSON' : ''} spellCheck={false} />
                        : <input className="inp" style={{ width: t === 'number' || t === 'integer' ? 140 : '100%' }} type={t === 'number' || t === 'integer' ? 'number' : 'text'} value={v[k] ?? ''} onChange={e => setV(k, e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && exec()} />}
                      {s.description && <div className="small muted" style={{ marginTop: 2 }}>{s.description}</div>}
                    </div>
                  </React.Fragment>
                );
              })}
            </div>
            <div className="row" style={{ padding: '0 12px 12px' }}>
              <button className="btn primary" onClick={exec} disabled={busy}>{busy ? <span className="spin-loader" /> : '▶'} Run {tool.name}</button>
              <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => setVals(all => ({ ...all, [sel]: {} }))}>reset form</span>
              <span className="spacer" />
              <Copy text={mcpCall(lastArgs)} label="Copy as MCP call" />
              <Copy text={`curl -s -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '${JSON.stringify(lastArgs).replace(/'/g, "'\\''")}' ${location.origin}/api/tool/${sel}`} label="Copy as curl" />
            </div>
            <ErrorBox error={err} />
            {run && (
              <div style={{ padding: '0 12px 12px' }}>
                <div className="row" style={{ marginBottom: 6 }}>
                  <span className={'pill ' + (run.ok ? 'ok' : 'bad')}>{run.ok ? 'ok' : 'error'}</span><span className="small muted">{run.ms} ms{run.fullLength ? ` · ${run.fullLength.toLocaleString()} chars` : ''}{run.truncated ? ' · truncated (raise max_chars or use save_as)' : ''}</span>
                  <span className="spacer" />{run.ok && <><Copy text={run.text ?? ''} label="Copy output" /><Download name={`${run.tool}.txt`} content={run.text ?? ''} /></>}
                </div>
                {run.ok ? <pre className="block" style={{ maxHeight: 'none' }}>{run.text}</pre> : <ErrorBox error={run.error} />}
                {run.files && run.files.length > 0 && <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 6 }}><span className="small muted">files:</span>{run.files.map(f => <a key={f} className="chip" href={f.startsWith('outputs/') ? api.outputUrl(f.slice(8), true) : '#'} onClick={e => { if (!f.startsWith('outputs/')) { e.preventDefault(); toast(f, 'info'); } }}>{f}</a>)}</div>}
                {run.data != null && <JsonView value={run.data} label="structured data" />}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </> : <Empty>Pick a tool.</Empty>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { usePrism } from '../ctx.js';
import { api, type WorkspaceIndex, type ScriptMeta } from '../api.js';
import { Copy, Empty, ErrorBox, formatBytes, bytesLatin1 } from './ui.js';

export function WorkspacePanel() {
  const { backend, setInput, toast, src, name, ensureScriptId, send } = usePrism();
  const [ws, setWs] = useState<WorkspaceIndex | null>(null);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [peek, setPeek] = useState<{ title: string; text: string } | null>(null);
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [note, setNote] = useState('');
  const load = useCallback(() => { api.workspace().then(setWs).catch(e => setErr(e.message)); }, []);
  useEffect(load, [load]);

  const tree = useMemo(() => {
    if (!ws) return [] as Array<{ m: ScriptMeta; depth: number }>;
    const ids = new Set(ws.scripts.map(s => s.id));
    const kids = new Map<string, ScriptMeta[]>();
    for (const s of ws.scripts) { const p = s.parent && ids.has(s.parent) ? s.parent : ''; if (!kids.has(p)) kids.set(p, []); kids.get(p)!.push(s); }
    const out: Array<{ m: ScriptMeta; depth: number }> = [];
    const walk = (p: string, d: number) => { for (const s of kids.get(p) ?? []) { out.push({ m: s, depth: d }); if (d < 20) walk(s.id, d + 1); } };
    walk('', 0);
    return out;
  }, [ws]);

  if (err) return <ErrorBox error={err} />;
  if (!ws) return <Empty><span className="spin-loader" /></Empty>;
  const openScript = async (id: string) => { try { const r = await api.getScript(id); setInput(r.source, r.meta.name); toast(`opened ${id}`, 'ok'); } catch (e: any) { toast(e.message, 'bad'); } };
  const del = async (id: string) => { if (!confirm(`Delete script ${id}?`)) return; await api.deleteScript(id); load(); };
  const upload = async (f: File) => { try { const m = await api.uploadScript(f.name, await f.arrayBuffer()); toast(`stored ${m.id}`, 'ok'); load(); } catch (e: any) { toast(e.message, 'bad'); } };
  const addNote = async (m: ScriptMeta) => { if (!note.trim()) return; await api.patchScript(m.id, { notes: [...m.notes, note.trim()] }); setNote(''); load(); };
  const viewOutput = async (n: string) => { try { const b = await api.readOutput(n); let t: string; try { t = new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: true }).decode(b); } catch { t = bytesLatin1(b); } setPeek({ title: n, text: t }); } catch (e: any) { toast(e.message, 'bad'); } };
  const viewOpmap = async (n: string) => { try { setPeek({ title: `opmap ${n}`, text: JSON.stringify(await api.getOpmap(n), null, 2) }); } catch (e: any) { toast(e.message, 'bad'); } };

  return (
    <div className="cards">
      <div className="card"><div className="card-h"><span className="dot" />Server workspace<span className="spacer" /><span className="copy-btn" onClick={load}>↻ refresh</span></div><div className="card-b">
        <div className="kv"><dt>root</dt><dd>{ws.root} <Copy text={ws.root} /></dd><dt>MCP</dt><dd>{backend?.mcp} <Copy text={backend?.mcp ?? ''} /></dd><dt>native luau</dt><dd>{backend ? ['compile', 'analyze', 'ast'].map(k => `${k} ${(backend.luau as any)[k] ? '✓' : '✗'}`).join('  ') : ''}</dd></div>
        <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>
          <button className="btn sm" disabled={!src.trim()} onClick={async () => { const id = await ensureScriptId('input'); if (id) { toast(`stored ${id}`, 'ok'); load(); } }}>Store current input ({name})</button>
          <label className="btn sm ghost" style={{ cursor: 'pointer' }}>Upload file…<input type="file" style={{ display: 'none' }} onChange={e => { const f = e.target.files?.[0]; if (f) upload(f); e.target.value = ''; }} /></label>
          <span className="small muted">the MCP server and this UI share the same workspace — an AI agent's results show up here</span>
        </div>
      </div></div>

      <div className="card"><div className="card-h"><span className="dot" />Scripts ({ws.scripts.length})<span className="spacer" /><Copy text={ws.scripts.map(s => `${s.id}\t${s.name}\t${s.lines}\t${s.size}\t${s.derivedBy ?? ''}\t${s.parent ?? ''}`).join('\n')} label="Copy list" /></div>
        <div className="card-b" style={{ padding: 0 }}>
          {tree.length === 0 ? <div className="small muted" style={{ padding: 12 }}>empty — store a script, or let an MCP agent add some</div> :
            <div className="list">{tree.map(({ m, depth }) => (
              <React.Fragment key={m.id}>
                <div className={'li ' + (open === m.id ? 'sel' : '')} onClick={() => setOpen(open === m.id ? null : m.id)}>
                  <span style={{ width: depth * 16 }} />{depth > 0 && <span className="muted">↳</span>}
                  <span className="t">{m.id}</span><span className="small muted">{m.lines.toLocaleString()} lines · {formatBytes(m.size)}{m.derivedBy ? ` · ${m.derivedBy}` : ''}{m.notes.length ? ` · ${m.notes.length} notes` : ''}</span>
                  <span className="spacer" />
                  <span className="copy-btn" onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); openScript(m.id); }}>Open</span>
                  <Copy text={m.id} label="id" />
                  <a className="copy-btn" href={api.rawScriptUrl(m.id)} onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>Download</a>
                  <span className="copy-btn" onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); send('tool', { name: 'auto_triage', args: {} }); }} title="open in All Tools">Tools</span>
                  <span className="x-btn" onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); del(m.id); }} title="delete">×</span>
                </div>
                {open === m.id && <div style={{ padding: '8px 14px 12px', background: 'rgba(10,6,22,0.4)' }}>
                  <div className="kv"><dt>name</dt><dd>{m.name}</dd><dt>sha1</dt><dd>{m.sha1}</dd><dt>created</dt><dd>{m.created}</dd><dt>updated</dt><dd>{m.updated}</dd><dt>encoding</dt><dd>{m.encoding}</dd>{m.parent && <><dt>parent</dt><dd>{m.parent}</dd></>}</div>
                  <div className="sec-title" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>notes</div>
                  {m.notes.map((n, i) => <div key={i} className="small" style={{ marginBottom: 3 }}>• {n} <Copy text={n} /></div>)}
                  <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}><input className="inp" style={{ flex: 1 }} value={note} onChange={e => setNote(e.target.value)} placeholder="add a finding…" onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && addNote(m)} /><button className="btn sm" onClick={() => addNote(m)}>Add note</button></div>
                </div>}
              </React.Fragment>
            ))}</div>}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="card"><div className="card-h"><span className="dot" />Opcode maps ({ws.opmaps.length})</div><div className="card-b" style={{ padding: 0 }}>
        {ws.opmaps.length === 0 ? <div className="small muted" style={{ padding: 12 }}>none yet — save one from the Opcode Map tab or via opcode_map save_opmap_as</div> :
          <div className="list">{ws.opmaps.map(n => <div key={n} className="li" onClick={() => viewOpmap(n)}><span className="t">{n}</span><span className="spacer" /><span className="x-btn" onClick={async e => { e.stopPropagation(); if (confirm(`Delete opmap ${n}?`)) { await api.deleteOpmap(n); load(); } }}>×</span></div>)}</div>}
      </div></div>

      <div className="card"><div className="card-h"><span className="dot" />Outputs ({ws.outputs.length})</div><div className="card-b" style={{ padding: 0 }}>
        {ws.outputs.length === 0 ? <div className="small muted" style={{ padding: 12 }}>tool outputs saved with save_as / save_output land here</div> :
          <div className="list">{ws.outputs.map(o => <div key={o.name} className="li" onClick={() => viewOutput(o.name)}><span className="t">{o.name}</span><span className="small muted">{formatBytes(o.size)} · {new Date(o.modified).toLocaleString()}</span><span className="spacer" /><a className="copy-btn" href={api.outputUrl(o.name, true)} onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>Download</a><span className="x-btn" onClick={async e => { e.stopPropagation(); if (confirm(`Delete ${o.name}?`)) { await api.deleteOutput(o.name); load(); } }}>×</span></div>)}</div>}
      </div></div>

      {peek && <div className="modal-bg" onClick={() => setPeek(null)}><div className="modal" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="modal-h">{peek.title}<span className="spacer" /><Copy text={peek.text} /><span className="x-btn" onClick={() => setPeek(null)}>×</span></div>
        <div className="modal-b"><pre className="block" style={{ maxHeight: '70vh' }}>{peek.text.length > 500000 ? peek.text.slice(0, 500000) + '\n… (Copy for everything)' : peek.text}</pre></div>
      </div></div>}
    </div>
  );
}
EOF

import React from 'react';
import { GUIDE } from '../../../../packages/tools/src/guide.js';
import { usePrism } from '../ctx.js';
import { Copy } from './ui.js';

export function Help({ onClose }: { onClose: () => void }) {
  const { backend } = usePrism();
  const mcpUrl = backend?.mcp ?? `${location.origin}/mcp`;
  const repo = '/path/to/prism';
  const desktop = JSON.stringify({ mcpServers: { prism: { command: 'npx', args: ['tsx', `${repo}/apps/mcp/src/server.ts`, '--workspace', `${repo}/workspace`] } } }, null, 2);
  const httpCfg = JSON.stringify({ mcpServers: { prism: { type: 'http', url: mcpUrl } } }, null, 2);
  const claudeCode = `claude mcp add --transport http prism ${mcpUrl}\n# or stdio:\nclaude mcp add prism -- npx tsx ${repo}/apps/mcp/src/server.ts`;
  return (
    <div className="modal-bg" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className="modal" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="modal-h"><span className="dot" style={{ width: 8, height: 8, borderRadius: '50%', background: 'var(--neon)', boxShadow: '0 0 8px var(--neon)' }} />PRISM — help, workflow & MCP<span className="spacer" /><span className="x-btn" onClick={onClose}>×</span></div>
        <div className="modal-b">
          <div className="cards" style={{ padding: 0 }}>
            <div className="card"><div className="card-h"><span className="dot" />Shortcuts</div><div className="card-b">
              <div className="row"><span className="kbd">Ctrl+Enter</span> analyze <span className="kbd">Ctrl+Shift+F</span> search tab <span className="kbd">F1</span> help <span className="kbd">Ctrl+F</span> find in editor <span className="kbd">Ctrl+G</span> go to line <span className="kbd">Esc</span> close</div>
              <div className="small" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>Every line number (<span className="line-link">L123</span>) jumps to the code in the left editor. The <b>on input | cleaned</b> switch picks which code the analysis tabs work on. Every output has a Copy button; tables copy as TSV/JSON.</div>
            </div></div>
            <div className="card"><div className="card-h"><span className="dot" />Connect an AI (MCP)<span className="spacer" /><span className={'pill ' + (backend ? 'ok' : '')}>{backend ? 'server online' : 'server offline'}</span></div><div className="card-b">
              <div className="small">Streamable HTTP endpoint (same server as this UI): <span className="mono" style={{ color: 'var(--neon3)' }}>{mcpUrl}</span> <Copy text={mcpUrl} /></div>
              <div className="sec-title" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>Claude Code</div>
              <div style={{ position: 'relative' }}><div style={{ position: 'absolute', right: 8, top: 8 }}><Copy text={claudeCode} /></div><pre className="block">{claudeCode}</pre></div>
              <div className="sec-title" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>Claude Desktop / Cursor (stdio) — replace {repo}</div>
              <div style={{ position: 'relative' }}><div style={{ position: 'absolute', right: 8, top: 8 }}><Copy text={desktop} /></div><pre className="block">{desktop}</pre></div>
              <div className="sec-title" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>HTTP clients</div>
              <div style={{ position: 'relative' }}><div style={{ position: 'absolute', right: 8, top: 8 }}><Copy text={httpCfg} /></div><pre className="block">{httpCfg}</pre></div>
            </div></div>
            <div className="card"><div className="card-h"><span className="dot" />Workflow guide (also served to AI agents)<span className="spacer" /><Copy text={GUIDE} /></div><div className="card-b"><pre className="block" style={{ maxHeight: 'none' }}>{GUIDE}</pre></div></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

## 550. ИИ · шаг

Улучшаю граф вызовов (зум, связи, переходы)
bash
cd /data/prism/apps/web/src/components && cat force.ts | head -30 && cat > CallGraph.tsx <<'EOF'
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { FullReport } from '@prism/core';
import { Copy, Empty, Seg, LineLink } from './ui.js';
import { forceLayout, GNode } from './force.js';
import { usePrism } from '../ctx.js';

export function CallGraph({ rep }: { rep: FullReport }) {
  const { reveal, send } = usePrism();
  const cg = rep.callGraph;
  const [sel, setSel] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [view, setView] = useState<'graph' | 'table'>('graph');
  const [limit, setLimit] = useState(150);
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const [tf, setTf] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0, k: 1 });
  const drag = useRef<{ x: number; y: number; tx: number; ty: number } | null>(null);
  const wrap = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [size, setSize] = useState({ w: 800, h: 500 });
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = wrap.current; if (!el) return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => setSize({ w: el.clientWidth || 800, h: el.clientHeight || 500 }));
    ro.observe(el); return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, [view]);

  const byId = useMemo(() => new Map(cg.functions.map(f => [f.id, f])), [cg]);
  const { nodes, edges } = useMemo(() => {
    const deg = new Map<string, number>();
    for (const e of cg.edges) { deg.set(e.from, (deg.get(e.from) ?? 0) + 1); deg.set(e.to, (deg.get(e.to) ?? 0) + 1); }
    const fns = cg.functions.slice().sort((a, b) => (deg.get(b.id) ?? 0) - (deg.get(a.id) ?? 0)).slice(0, limit);
    const keep = new Set(fns.map(f => f.id));
    const ns: GNode[] = fns.map((f, i) => ({ id: f.id, name: f.name, deg: deg.get(f.id) ?? 0,
      x: size.w / 2 + Math.cos(i * 2.4) * (40 + i * 2), y: size.h / 2 + Math.sin(i * 2.4) * (40 + i * 2), vx: 0, vy: 0 }));
    const es = cg.edges.filter(e => keep.has(e.from) && keep.has(e.to));
    forceLayout(ns, es, size.w, size.h);
    return { nodes: ns, edges: es };
  }, [cg, size.w, size.h, limit]);

  const pos = new Map(nodes.map(n => [n.id, n]));
  const selFn = sel ? byId.get(sel) : undefined;
  const nameOf = (id: string) => byId.get(id)?.name ?? id;
  const callers = useMemo(() => sel ? [...new Set(cg.edges.filter(e => e.to === sel).map(e => e.from))] : [], [cg, sel]);
  const callees = useMemo(() => sel ? [...new Set(cg.edges.filter(e => e.from === sel).map(e => e.to))] : [], [cg, sel]);
  const ql = q.toLowerCase();
  const match = (n: string) => !!ql && n.toLowerCase().includes(ql);
  const dot = 'digraph calls {\n  node [shape=box];\n' + cg.edges.map(e => '  "' + nameOf(e.from) + '" -> "' + nameOf(e.to) + '";').join('\n') + '\n}';
  const mermaid = 'graph LR\n' + cg.edges.map(e => `  ${e.from.replace(/\W/g, '_')}["${nameOf(e.from).replace(/"/g, "'")}"] --> ${e.to.replace(/\W/g, '_')}["${nameOf(e.to).replace(/"/g, "'")}"]`).join('\n');
  const tsv = cg.functions.map(f => `${f.id}\t${f.name}\t${f.line}\t${f.params.join(',')}\t${f.stmts}\t${f.calls.length}`).join('\n');

  if (!cg.functions.length) return <Empty>No functions found.</Empty>;
  const onWheel = (e: React.WheelEvent) => { const r = wrap.current!.getBoundingClientRect(); const mx = e.clientX - r.left, my = e.clientY - r.top; const k = Math.min(6, Math.max(0.2, tf.k * (e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.15 : 1 / 1.15))); setTf({ k, x: mx - (mx - tf.x) * (k / tf.k), y: my - (my - tf.y) * (k / tf.k) }); };
  return (
    <div className="col">
      <div className="toolbar">
        <Seg value={view} onChange={setView} options={[{ v: 'graph', label: 'graph' }, { v: 'table', label: 'functions' }]} />
        <input className="inp" placeholder="highlight function…" value={q} onChange={e => setQ(e.target.value)} style={{ width: 160 }} />
        {view === 'graph' && <select className="inp" value={limit} onChange={e => setLimit(Number(e.target.value))} title="nodes shown (by degree)">{[50, 150, 300, 600].map(n => <option key={n} value={n}>{n} nodes</option>)}</select>}
        {view === 'graph' && <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => setTf({ x: 0, y: 0, k: 1 })}>reset view</span>}
        <span className="small muted">{cg.functionCount} functions · {cg.edgeCount} edges</span>
        <span className="spacer" />
        <Copy text={dot} label="Copy DOT" /><Copy text={mermaid} label="Copy Mermaid" /><Copy text={tsv} label="Copy TSV" />
        <Copy text={JSON.stringify({ functions: cg.functions, edges: cg.edges }, null, 2)} label="Copy JSON" />
      </div>
      {view === 'graph' ? (
        <div style={{ flex: 1, display: 'flex', minHeight: 0 }}>
          <div className="graph-wrap" ref={wrap} style={{ flex: 1, cursor: drag.current ? 'grabbing' : 'grab' }} onWheel={onWheel}
            onMouseDown={e => { drag.current = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, tx: tf.x, ty: tf.y }; }}
            onMouseMove={e => { const d = drag.current; if (d) setTf({ ...tf, x: d.tx + e.clientX - d.x, y: d.ty + e.clientY - d.y }); }}
            onMouseUp={() => { drag.current = null; }} onMouseLeave={() => { drag.current = null; }}>
            <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${size.w} ${size.h}`}>
              <defs>
                <marker id="arr" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="16" refY="5" markerWidth="5" markerHeight="5" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="rgba(178,107,255,0.7)" /></marker>
                <radialGradient id="ng"><stop offset="0%" stopColor="#ff5ce1" /><stop offset="100%" stopColor="#b26bff" /></radialGradient>
                <filter id="glow"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3" result="b" /><feMerge><feMergeNode in="b" /><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic" /></feMerge></filter>
              </defs>
              <g transform={`translate(${tf.x},${tf.y}) scale(${tf.k})`}>
                {edges.map((e, i) => {
                  const a = pos.get(e.from), b = pos.get(e.to); if (!a || !b) return null;
                  const hot = sel && (e.from === sel || e.to === sel);
                  return <line key={i} x1={a.x} y1={a.y} x2={b.x} y2={b.y} stroke={hot ? (e.from === sel ? '#ff5ce1' : '#5ce1ff') : 'rgba(178,107,255,0.25)'} strokeWidth={(hot ? 1.8 : 1) / Math.sqrt(tf.k)} markerEnd="url(#arr)" />;
                })}
                {nodes.map(n => {
                  const m = match(n.name);
                  return (
                    <g key={n.id} className="graph-node" transform={`translate(${n.x},${n.y})`} onMouseDown={e => e.stopPropagation()} onClick={() => setSel(n.id === sel ? null : n.id)}>
                      <circle r={4 + Math.min(10, n.deg * 1.3)} fill={n.id === 'main' ? '#5ce1ff' : m ? '#ffcf5c' : 'url(#ng)'} stroke={n.id === sel ? '#fff' : 'none'} strokeWidth={2} filter={m || n.id === sel ? 'url(#glow)' : undefined} />
                      {(n.deg > 1 || n.id === sel || m || nodes.length < 40 || tf.k > 1.8) && <text x={9} y={4} fontSize={10 / Math.sqrt(tf.k)} fill={m ? '#ffcf5c' : '#d8ccff'} style={{ pointerEvents: 'none', fontFamily: 'var(--mono)' }}>{n.name.length > 26 ? n.name.slice(0, 24) + '…' : n.name}</text>}
                    </g>
                  );
                })}
              </g>
            </svg>
            <div className="small muted" style={{ position: 'absolute', left: 10, bottom: 8, pointerEvents: 'none' }}>wheel = zoom · drag = pan · click node = details · pink = calls, cyan = called by</div>
          </div>
          {selFn && (
            <div style={{ width: 280, borderLeft: '1px solid var(--stroke)', padding: 12, overflow: 'auto' }} className="fade">
              <div style={{ fontWeight: 700, color: '#fff', marginBottom: 6, wordBreak: 'break-all' }}>{selFn.name}</div>
              <div className="small muted"><LineLink line={selFn.line} onClick={l => reveal(l)} /> · {selFn.stmts} stmts · depth {selFn.depth}</div>
              <div className="small" style={{ margin: '6px 0' }}>params: <span className="mono">({selFn.params.join(', ')}{selFn.vararg ? (selFn.params.length ? ', ...' : '...') : ''})</span></div>
              <div className="row" style={{ margin: '8px 0' }}>
                <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => send('python', { fn: String(selFn.line) })}>→ Python</span>
                {!/^</.test(selFn.name) && <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => send('search', { mode: 'xrefs', name: selFn.name.split(/[.:]/).pop(), line: selFn.line })}>Xrefs</span>}
                <Copy text={JSON.stringify(selFn, null, 2)} label="Copy info" />
              </div>
              <div className="small muted" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>called by ({callers.length}):</div>
              <div className="chips" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>{callers.slice(0, 60).map(c => <span key={c} className="chip" style={{ fontSize: 10, cursor: 'pointer', color: 'var(--neon3)' }} onClick={() => setSel(c)}>{nameOf(c)}</span>)}</div>
              <div className="small muted" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>calls functions ({callees.length}):</div>
              <div className="chips" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>{callees.slice(0, 60).map(c => <span key={c} className="chip" style={{ fontSize: 10, cursor: 'pointer', color: 'var(--neon2)' }} onClick={() => setSel(c)}>{nameOf(c)}</span>)}</div>
              <div className="small muted" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>all call expressions ({selFn.calls.length}):</div>
              <div className="chips" style={{ marginTop: 4 }}>{[...new Set(selFn.calls)].slice(0, 80).map((c, i) => <span key={i} className="chip" style={{ fontSize: 10 }}>{c}</span>)}</div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="fill scroll">
          <table className="data">
            <thead><tr><th>id</th><th>name</th><th>line</th><th className="num">params</th><th className="num">stmts</th><th className="num">calls</th><th /></tr></thead>
            <tbody>{cg.functions.filter(f => !ql || f.name.toLowerCase().includes(ql)).slice(0, 5000).map(f => (
              <tr key={f.id} onClick={() => setSel(f.id)} style={{ cursor: 'pointer', background: f.id === sel ? 'rgba(178,107,255,0.12)' : undefined }}>
                <td>{f.id}</td>
                <td style={{ maxWidth: 260, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap', color: '#fff' }} title={f.name}>{f.name}</td>
                <td><LineLink line={f.line} onClick={l => reveal(l)} /></td>
                <td className="num">{f.params.length + (f.vararg ? 1 : 0)}</td>
                <td className="num">{f.stmts}</td>
                <td className="num">{f.calls.length}</td>
                <td><span className="copy-btn" onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); send('python', { fn: String(f.line) }); }}>→ Py</span></td>
              </tr>
            ))}</tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

bash
cd /data/prism/apps/web/src/components && cat > Tokens.tsx <<'EOF'
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { engine } from '../engineClient.js';
import { Copy, Empty, LineLink } from './ui.js';
import { usePrism } from '../ctx.js';

export function Tokens({ src }: { src: string }) {
  const { reveal } = usePrism();
  const [toks, setToks] = useState<any[] | null>(null);
  const [errs, setErrs] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(true);
  const [type, setType] = useState('all');
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true; setBusy(true);
    engine.tokenize(src).then(({ result }) => { if (live) { setToks(result.tokens); setErrs(result.errors ?? []); setBusy(false); } }).catch(() => setBusy(false));
    return () => { live = false; };
  }, [src]);
  const hist = useMemo(() => { const m = new Map<string, number>(); for (const t of toks ?? []) m.set(t.type, (m.get(t.type) ?? 0) + 1); return [...m.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]); }, [toks]);
  const rows = useMemo(() => (toks ?? []).filter(t => (type === 'all' || t.type === type) && (!q || String(t.value).includes(q))), [toks, type, q]);
  if (busy) return <Empty><span className="spin-loader" /></Empty>;
  if (!toks || !toks.length) return <Empty>No tokens.</Empty>;
  const text = rows.map(t => `${t.line}:${t.col}\t${t.type}\t${t.value}`).join('\n');
  return (
    <div className="col">
      <div className="toolbar">
        <select className="inp" value={type} onChange={e => setType(e.target.value)}><option value="all">all types ({toks.length.toLocaleString()})</option>{hist.map(([k, n]) => <option key={k} value={k}>{k} ({n.toLocaleString()})</option>)}</select>
        <input className="inp" placeholder="filter value…" value={q} onChange={e => setQ(e.target.value)} style={{ width: 160 }} />
        <div className="chips">{hist.slice(0, 6).map(([k, n]) => <span key={k} className="chip">{k} <b>{n.toLocaleString()}</b></span>)}</div>
        {errs.length > 0 && <span className="chip" style={{ color: 'var(--bad)' }} title={errs.slice(0, 10).map((e: any) => `L${e.line}: ${e.message}`).join('\n')}>lexer errors <b>{errs.length}</b></span>}
        <span className="spacer" />
        <Copy text={text} label={`Copy ${rows.length.toLocaleString()} tokens`} />
      </div>
      <div className="fill scroll">
        <table className="data">
          <thead><tr><th style={{ width: 80 }}>pos</th><th style={{ width: 110 }}>type</th><th>value</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>{rows.slice(0, 5000).map((t, i) => (
            <tr key={i}>
              <td><LineLink line={t.line} onClick={l => reveal(l, t.col)} /><span className="muted">:{t.col}</span></td>
              <td style={{ color: 'var(--neon3)' }}>{t.type}</td>
              <td style={{ maxWidth: 520, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }} title={String(t.value).slice(0, 1000)}>{t.value}</td>
            </tr>
          ))}</tbody>
        </table>
        {rows.length > 5000 && <div className="small muted" style={{ padding: 10 }}>Showing first 5000 of {rows.length.toLocaleString()}. Copy for the full stream.</div>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
EOF

cd /data/prism && mkdir -p scratch/shots && cat > scratch/e2e.mjs <<'EOF'
import { chromium } from 'playwright-core';
const URL = process.argv[2] ?? 'http://127.0.0.1:7790/';
const SAMPLE = process.argv[3] ?? 'ironbrew2_1.lua';
const browser = await chromium.launch({ executablePath: '/usr/local/bin/chromium', headless: true, args: ['--no-sandbox', '--disable-gpu'] });
const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1600, height: 950 } });
const errors = [];
page.on('console', m => { if (m.type() === 'error') errors.push('CONSOLE: ' + m.text().slice(0, 300)); });
page.on('pageerror', e => errors.push('PAGEERROR: ' + e.message.slice(0, 300)));
await page.goto(URL, { waitUntil: 'networkidle', timeout: 30000 });
await page.waitForTimeout(1200);
await page.selectOption('.panel-head select', SAMPLE);
await page.waitForSelector('.pill.ok, .pill.bad', { timeout: 60000 });
await page.waitForTimeout(800);
const shot = async n => page.screenshot({ path: `scratch/shots/${n}.png` });
const tab = async label => { await page.locator('.tabbar .tab', { hasText: new RegExp('^' + label + '$') }).first().click(); await page.waitForTimeout(1500); };
await shot('01-overview');
const report = {};
for (const [label, wait] of [['Deobfuscate', 800], ['Call Graph', 1500], ['Strings', 500], ['Tokens', 800], ['VM', 1500], ['Opcode Map', 3000], ['Disassembly', 1200], ['Constants', 2500], ['Search & Xrefs', 500], ['Python', 1000], ['Blob Lab', 500], ['All Tools', 1500], ['Workspace', 1000]]) {
  await tab(label); await page.waitForTimeout(wait);
  const txt = await page.locator('.panel-body').last().innerText().catch(() => '');
  report[label] = txt.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 160);
  await shot('tab-' + label.replace(/\W+/g, '_'));
}
for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(report)) console.log(k.padEnd(16), '|', v);
console.log('errors:', errors.length ? '\n' + errors.slice(0, 15).join('\n') : 'none');
await browser.close();
EOF

## 608. ИИ · шаг

Пишу и тестирую загрузчик бинарников Luau
bash
cd /data/prism && cat > tools/fetch-luau.mjs <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env node
// Downloads the official prebuilt Luau CLI tools for this OS into tools/luau/.
// PRISM only uses them to COMPILE (luau-compile), TYPECHECK (luau-analyze) and PARSE (luau-ast).
// The `luau` runtime/REPL in the release archive is deliberately NOT extracted: PRISM is static-only.
//
//   node tools/fetch-luau.mjs [--version 0.745|latest] [--force] [--optional]
//   env: LUAU_VERSION, PRISM_LUAU_DIR (destination, default tools/luau)
import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync, existsSync, chmodSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, dirname, basename } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { inflateRawSync } from 'node:zlib';

const here = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const optional = args.includes('--optional');
const force = args.includes('--force');
const vi = args.indexOf('--version');
const version = vi >= 0 ? args[vi + 1] : (process.env.LUAU_VERSION || '0.745');
const dest = process.env.PRISM_LUAU_DIR || join(here, 'luau');
const asset = { win32: 'luau-windows.zip', darwin: 'luau-macos.zip', linux: 'luau-ubuntu.zip' }[process.platform];
const exe = n => (process.platform === 'win32' ? n + '.exe' : n);
const WANT = ['luau-compile', 'luau-analyze', 'luau-ast'];

function fail(msg) { console.error('[fetch-luau] ' + msg); process.exit(optional ? 0 : 1); }

/** minimal ZIP reader (stored + deflate), enough for the official release archives */
function unzip(buf) {
  let eocd = -1;
  for (let i = buf.length - 22; i >= Math.max(0, buf.length - 65557); i--) if (buf.readUInt32LE(i) === 0x06054b50) { eocd = i; break; }
  if (eocd < 0) throw new Error('not a zip archive');
  const count = buf.readUInt16LE(eocd + 10);
  let p = buf.readUInt32LE(eocd + 16);
  const out = new Map();
  for (let k = 0; k < count; k++) {
    if (buf.readUInt32LE(p) !== 0x02014b50) throw new Error('corrupt central directory');
    const method = buf.readUInt16LE(p + 10), csize = buf.readUInt32LE(p + 20);
    const nlen = buf.readUInt16LE(p + 28), xlen = buf.readUInt16LE(p + 30), clen = buf.readUInt16LE(p + 32), loff = buf.readUInt32LE(p + 42);
    const name = buf.toString('utf8', p + 46, p + 46 + nlen);
    p += 46 + nlen + xlen + clen;
    if (name.endsWith('/')) continue;
    const start = loff + 30 + buf.readUInt16LE(loff + 26) + buf.readUInt16LE(loff + 28);
    const data = buf.subarray(start, start + csize);
    out.set(name, method === 0 ? data : method === 8 ? () => inflateRawSync(data) : null);
  }
  return out;
}

if (!asset) fail(`no prebuilt Luau for platform "${process.platform}" — build https://github.com/luau-lang/luau yourself and start PRISM with --luau <dir>`);
if (!force && WANT.every(n => existsSync(join(dest, exe(n))))) { console.log(`[fetch-luau] already present in ${dest} (use --force to re-download)`); process.exit(0); }
const url = version === 'latest'
  ? `https://github.com/luau-lang/luau/releases/latest/download/${asset}`
  : `https://github.com/luau-lang/luau/releases/download/${version}/${asset}`;
console.log(`[fetch-luau] downloading ${url}`);
let buf;
try {
  const r = await fetch(url, { redirect: 'follow' });
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
  buf = Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer());
} catch (e) { fail('download failed: ' + (e?.message ?? e) + ' — PRISM still works without native tools (only luau_compile / luau_analyze / luau_ast are disabled)'); }
let entries;
try { entries = unzip(buf); } catch (e) { fail('could not read archive: ' + e.message); }
mkdirSync(dest, { recursive: true });
const got = [];
for (const [name, data] of entries) {
  const base = basename(name);
  const tool = WANT.find(n => base === exe(n));
  if (!tool) continue;
  if (!data) { console.warn(`[fetch-luau] skip ${name}: unsupported compression`); continue; }
  const file = join(dest, base);
  writeFileSync(file, typeof data === 'function' ? data() : data);
  try { chmodSync(file, 0o755); } catch {}
  got.push(base);
}
if (!got.length) fail('archive did not contain luau-compile / luau-analyze / luau-ast');
console.log(`[fetch-luau] Luau ${version}: ${got.join(', ')} → ${dest}`);
EOF
PRISM_LUAU_DIR=/tmp/luau-fetch-test timeout 120 node tools/fetch-luau.mjs && ls -la /tmp/luau-fetch-test && for b in luau-compile luau-analyze luau-ast; do cmp /tmp/luau-fetch-test/$b tools/luau/$b && echo "$b identical"; done
