// Smoke test for every PRISM tool (the same registry the web UI, HTTP API and MCP server use).
//   npx tsx packages/tools/test/smoke.ts [-v]
import { createContext, runTool, listTools, hasNative } from '../src/index.ts';
import { rmSync, writeFileSync, mkdtempSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';

const verbose = process.argv.includes('-v');
const root = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'prism-smoke-'));
const ctx = createContext({ workspace: join(root, 'ws') });
const SAMPLES = join(process.cwd(), 'apps/web/public/samples');
const tools = listTools();
const used = new Set<string>();
let fails = 0;
const show = async (n: string, a: Record<string, unknown>, lines = 6) => {
  used.add(n);
  const t0 = Date.now();
  try {
    const r = await runTool(n, a, ctx);
    console.log(`ok   ${n.padEnd(24)} ${String(Date.now() - t0).padStart(5)}ms ${r.fullLength ?? r.text.length} chars`);
    if (verbose) console.log(r.text.split('\n').slice(0, lines).map(l => '     | ' + l).join('\n'));
    return r;
  } catch (e) { fails++; console.log(`FAIL ${n.padEnd(24)} ${(e as Error).message}`); return null; }
};
const native = hasNative(ctx.luauDir, 'luau-compile');

await show('prism_guide', {});
const add = await show('workspace_add_script', { path: join(SAMPLES, 'ironbrew2_1.lua') });
const id = (add!.data as { id: string }).id;
await show('workspace_list', {});
await show('workspace_get_script', { script_id: id, max_chars: 200 });
await show('analyze', { script_id: id });
await show('fingerprint', { script_id: id });
const cl = await show('deobfuscate', { script_id: id, rename: 'obfuscated', save_script_as: 'ib2.clean.lua' });
const cid = (cl!.data as { savedScriptId: string }).savedScriptId;
await show('call_graph', { script_id: cid, format: 'mermaid' });
await show('list_functions', { script_id: cid, sort: 'size', max: 5 });
await show('vm_detect', { script_id: cid });
await show('tokenize', { script_id: cid, from_line: 1, to_line: 2 });
await show('simplify_expression', { expression: 'bit32.bxor(0x5A, 3) + #"abc"\n(5 * 2) // 3' });
await show('get_lines', { script_id: cid, line: 10, context: 2 });
await show('find_text', { script_id: cid, pattern: 'string\\.(byte|char|sub)', regex: true, context: 0, max: 3 });
await show('pattern_search', { script_id: cid, pattern: 'string.char($$$)', max: 3 });
await show('xrefs', { script_id: cid, name: 'fn1' });
await show('get_function', { script_id: cid, query: 'fn1' });
await show('constants', { script_id: cid, section: 'decoders', max: 3 });
await show('strings', { script_id: cid, min_len: 8, max: 4 });
await show('opcode_map', { script_id: cid, clean: false, lifted: false, save_opmap_as: 'ib2', max_trees: 2 });
await show('opmap_list', {});
await show('opmap_get', { name: 'ib2' });
await show('opmap_set', { name: 'ib2', set: { '0': { name: 'MOVE_FUSED', lua: 'R[A] = R[B]' } } });
await show('vm_disasm', { instructions: '{{0,1,2,0},{7,0,0,0},{2,1,"x",3}}', opmap: 'ib2', fields: { '1': 'A', '2': 'B', '3': 'C' }, op_field: 0 });
await show('python_transpile', { script_id: cid, function: 'fn1', prelude: false });
await show('lua_literal_to_json', { literal: '{1, 2, {x = "y"}, [10] = true}' });
if (native) {
  await show('luau_compile', { source: 'local x = 1 for i=1,10 do x = x * i end print(x)', mode: 'prism' });
  await show('luau_compile', { source: 'local x = 1 print(x + 2)', mode: 'text' });
  await show('luau_compile', { source: 'local x = 1 print(x + 2)', mode: 'summary' });
  const bin = await show('luau_compile', { source: 'local t = {} for i = 1, 3 do t[i] = ("x"):rep(i) end print(table.concat(t, ","))', mode: 'binary', save_as: 'x.luauc' });
  await show('bytecode_disasm', { output: 'x.luauc', style: 'luau' });

  await show('luau_analyze', { source: 'local x: number = "a"\nprint(y)' });

await show('blob_info', { data: '\\27Lua\\81\\0\\1\\4\\8', encoding: 'lua' });

## 617. ИИ · шаг

bash
mkdir -p /data/prism/apps/mcp/test && cat > /data/prism/apps/mcp/test/mcp.ts <<'EOF'
// End-to-end MCP test: real SDK client ↔ PRISM MCP server over stdio AND Streamable HTTP.
//   npx tsx apps/mcp/test/mcp.ts
import { Client } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/index.js';
import { StdioClientTransport } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/stdio.js';
import { StreamableHTTPClientTransport } from '@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/streamableHttp.js';
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';
import { mkdtempSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';

const root = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'prism-mcp-test-'));
const sample = join(process.cwd(), 'apps/web/public/samples/prometheus_weak_1.lua');
let fails = 0;
const check = (ok: unknown, what: string) => { console.log(`${ok ? 'ok  ' : 'FAIL'} ${what}`); if (!ok) fails++; };
const text = (r: any) => String(r?.content?.[0]?.text ?? '');

// ---- stdio
const stdio = new StdioClientTransport({ command: process.execPath, args: ['--import', 'tsx', 'apps/mcp/src/server.ts', '--workspace', join(root, 'ws1')], cwd: process.cwd(), stderr: 'pipe' });
const c = new Client({ name: 'prism-test', version: '1' });
await c.connect(stdio);
check((c.getInstructions()?.length ?? 0) > 500, 'stdio: server instructions (workflow guide)');
const tools = (await c.listTools()).tools;
check(tools.length >= 40, `stdio: ${tools.length} tools listed`);
check(tools.find(t => t.name === 'workspace_delete')?.annotations?.destructiveHint === true, 'stdio: destructive annotation');
const add = await c.callTool({ name: 'workspace_add_script', arguments: { path: sample } });
const id = (add.structuredContent as any)?.id ?? /([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+-[0-9a-f]{6})/.exec(text(add))?.[1];
check(id, 'stdio: workspace_add_script → ' + id);
const an = await c.callTool({ name: 'analyze', arguments: { script_id: id, max_chars: 2000 } });
check(/Prometheus/.test(text(an)), 'stdio: analyze fingerprints Prometheus');
const bad = await c.callTool({ name: 'get_lines', arguments: { script_id: 'nope', line: 1 } });
check(bad.isError === true, 'stdio: errors surface as isError');
const res = await c.listResources();
check(res.resources.some(r => r.uri === 'prism://guide'), 'stdio: resources ' + res.resources.map(r => r.uri).join(' '));
const rd = await c.readResource({ uri: `prism://scripts/${id}` });
check(((rd.contents[0] as any).text?.length ?? 0) > 1000, 'stdio: read prism://scripts/{id}');
const pr = await c.listPrompts();
check(pr.prompts.length >= 4, 'stdio: prompts ' + pr.prompts.map(p => p.name).join(', '));
const gp = await c.getPrompt({ name: 'deobfuscate_script', arguments: { script: id } });
check(/deobfuscate/i.test((gp.messages[0].content as any).text), 'stdio: prompt renders');
await c.close();

// ---- Streamable HTTP
const port = 17000 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 2000);
const srv = spawn(process.execPath, ['--import', 'tsx', 'apps/mcp/src/server.ts', '--http', String(port), '--workspace', join(root, 'ws2')], { cwd: process.cwd(), stdio: ['ignore', 'ignore', 'pipe'] });
await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
  const t = setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('http server did not start')), 30000);
  srv.stderr!.on('data', d => { if (/listening|http:\/\//i.test(String(d))) { clearTimeout(t); resolve(); } });
});
const h = new Client({ name: 'prism-test-http', version: '1' });
await h.connect(new StreamableHTTPClientTransport(new URL(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/mcp`)));
check((await h.listTools()).tools.length >= 40, 'http: tools listed');
const s = await h.callTool({ name: 'simplify_expression', arguments: { expression: 'bit32.bxor(0x55, 0x55) + (3*4)' } });
check(/12/.test(text(s)), 'http: simplify_expression → ' + text(s).trim().split('\n')[0]);
await h.close();
const get = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/mcp`);
check(get.status === 405, 'http: GET /mcp → 405');
const evil = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${port}/mcp`, { method: 'POST', headers: { host: 'evil.example', 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: '{}' }).catch(() => null);
check(!evil || evil.status === 403, 'http: foreign Host header rejected (DNS-rebinding guard)');
srv.kill();
rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
console.log(fails ? `\n${fails} FAILED` : '\nall MCP checks passed');
process.exit(fails ? 1 : 0);
EOF

def lua_dump(v, path=None, indent=1):
    """Print (or save to path) any Lua value as JSON: tables -> list/dict, non-text strings ->

    def conv(x):

            return [conv(e) for e in x]

                return '<cycle>'
            seen.add(id(x))
            n = x.length()

                out = [conv(x.h.get(i)) for i in range(1, n + 1)]
            else:
                out = {}
                for k, val in x.h.items():
                    k = _unkey(k)
                    out[k if isinstance(k, str) else tostring(k) if not isinstance(k, LuaTable) else '<table>'] = conv(val)
            seen.discard(id(x))
            return out
        if isinstance(x, str):
            return x if all(32 <= ord(c) < 127 or c in '\\t\\n\\r' for c in x) else {'$bytes': x.encode('latin-1', 'replace').hex()}
        if x is None or isinstance(x, (bool, int, float)):
            return x
        if callable(x):
            return '<function>'
        return repr(x)

    s = _json.dumps(conv(v), indent=indent, ensure_ascii=False)
    if path:
        with open(path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            f.write(s)
    else:

Пишу модуль анатомии ВМ (часть 1)
bash
cd /data/prism && cat > packages/core/src/analysis/anatomy.ts <<'EOF'
// VM anatomy — one static map of how an obfuscated script boots, runs and exits, for ANY obfuscator:
//   payload blob → its consumer → deserializer → closure factory ("wrap") → interpreter function →
//   dispatch loop → instruction fetch → handlers → exits (RETURN) / closure creation / env access → entry call,
// plus a ranked inventory of the main chunks (functions) with the roles they play.
// Purely structural (AST + scope + the generic dispatch-tree extractor); nothing is executed.
import type * as A from '../ast.js';
import { walk } from '../ast.js';
import { print } from '../printer.js';
import { analyzeScopes, type Binding, type ScopeInfo } from './scope.js';
import { extractOpcodes, type DispatchTree } from './opcodes.js';
import { findConstants, type DecoderCandidate } from './constants.js';

export interface AnatomyPart {
  role: 'payload' | 'payload-consumer' | 'deserializer' | 'string-decoder' | 'wrapper' | 'interpreter' | 'dispatch-loop' | 'fetch' | 'pc-advance' | 'dispatch' | 'exit' | 'closure' | 'env' | 'varargs' | 'entry' | 'cff-entry' | 'cff-exit';
  name?: string;
  line: number;
  endLine?: number;
  pos?: number;
  detail: string;
  code?: string;
}
export interface ChunkInfo { id: number; name: string; line: number; endLine: number; pos: number; size: number; callers: number; refs: number; roles: string[]; parent?: string; params: string; }
export interface VmAnatomy {
  kind: 'vm' | 'cff' | 'plain';
  pipeline: string[];
  parts: AnatomyPart[];
  chunks: ChunkInfo[];
  tree?: { id: number; line: number; var: string; kind: string; handlers: number; minOp: number; maxOp: number; roles: DispatchTree['roles'] };
  notes: string[];
}

interface Fn { id: number; f: A.FunctionExpr; name: string; line: number; endLine: number; start: number; end: number; parent: Fn | null; binding?: Binding; gname?: string; size: number; calls: number; refs: number; roles: Set<string>; }

const unparen = (e: any): any => { while (e && e.type === 'ParenExpr') e = e.expr; return e; };
const short = (s: string, n = 160) => { const t = s.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); return t.length > n ? t.slice(0, n - 1) + '…' : t; };
const code = (n: any, max = 160) => { try { return short(print(n as any), max); } catch { return ''; } };
const posOf = (n: any) => n?.loc?.start ?? 0;
const lineOf = (n: any) => n?.loc?.line ?? 0;

export function vmAnatomy(chunk: A.Chunk, opts: { maxChunks?: number } = {}): VmAnatomy {
  const sc: ScopeInfo = analyzeScopes(chunk);
  const notes: string[] = [];
  const parts: AnatomyPart[] = [];

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- function index
  const fns: Fn[] = [];
  const byExpr = new Map<A.FunctionExpr, Fn>();
  const declOf = new Map<A.FunctionExpr, { stat: any }>();
  walk(chunk, (n, parent) => {
    if (n.type === 'LocalFunctionStat' || n.type === 'FunctionStat') declOf.set(n.func, { stat: n });
    if (n.type === 'LocalStat') n.init.forEach((e: any, i: number) => { const u = unparen(e); if (u?.type === 'FunctionExpr' && n.names[i]) declOf.set(u, { stat: { type: 'LocalStat', idx: i, n } }); });
    if (n.type === 'AssignStat') n.targets.forEach((t: any, i: number) => { const u = unparen(n.values[i]); if (u?.type === 'FunctionExpr') declOf.set(u, { stat: { type: 'AssignStat', target: t } }); });
    void parent;
  });
  const stack: Fn[] = [];
  const visit = (n: any) => {
    if (!n || typeof n !== 'object') return;
    if (Array.isArray(n)) { n.forEach(visit); return; }
    let pushed = false;
    if (n.type === 'FunctionExpr') {
      const d = declOf.get(n)?.stat;
      let name = '', binding: Binding | undefined, gname: string | undefined;
      if (d?.type === 'LocalFunctionStat') { name = d.name; binding = sc.fnBindings.get(findFnOf(d)!)?.find(b => b.decl === d); }
      else if (d?.type === 'FunctionStat') { name = code(d.target, 60); if (d.target.type === 'NameExpr') { const b = sc.refOf.get(d.target); if (b && b.kind !== 'global') binding = b; else gname = d.target.name; } }
      else if (d?.type === 'LocalStat') { name = d.n.names[d.idx]; binding = (sc.bindings.find(b => b.decl === d.n && b.index === d.idx)); }
      else if (d?.type === 'AssignStat') { name = code(d.target, 60); if (d.target.type === 'NameExpr') { const b = sc.refOf.get(d.target); if (b && b.kind !== 'global') binding = b; else gname = d.target.name; } }
      const fn: Fn = { id: fns.length, f: n, name: name || `<fn@L${lineOf(n)}>`, line: lineOf(n), endLine: n.loc?.endLine ?? lineOf(n), start: posOf(n), end: n.loc?.end ?? posOf(n), parent: stack[stack.length - 1] ?? null, binding, gname, size: 0, calls: 0, refs: 0, roles: new Set() };
      fns.push(fn); byExpr.set(n, fn); stack.push(fn); pushed = true;
    }
    if (typeof n.type === 'string') for (const f of stack) f.size++;
    for (const k of Object.keys(n)) if (k !== 'loc') visit(n[k]);
    if (pushed) stack.pop();
  };
  // which function declares a LocalFunctionStat (needed to find its binding)
  const parentFnOfStat = new Map<any, any>();
  { const st: any[] = [chunk]; const v = (n: any) => { if (!n || typeof n !== 'object') return; if (Array.isArray(n)) { n.forEach(v); return; } if (n.type === 'LocalFunctionStat') parentFnOfStat.set(n, st[st.length - 1]); const isF = n.type === 'FunctionExpr'; if (isF) st.push(n); for (const k of Object.keys(n)) if (k !== 'loc') v(n[k]); if (isF) st.pop(); }; v(chunk); }
  function findFnOf(stat: any) { return parentFnOfStat.get(stat); }
  visit(chunk);

  // resolve a callee expression to one of our functions
  const fnOfBinding = new Map<Binding, Fn>();
  for (const f of fns) if (f.binding) fnOfBinding.set(f.binding, f);
  const fnOfGlobal = new Map<string, Fn>();
  for (const f of fns) if (f.gname) fnOfGlobal.set(f.gname, f);
  const resolve = (callee: any): Fn | undefined => {
    const u = unparen(callee);
    if (!u) return undefined;
    if (u.type === 'FunctionExpr') return byExpr.get(u);
    if (u.type === 'NameExpr') { const b = sc.refOf.get(u); if (b && b.kind !== 'global') return fnOfBinding.get(b); return fnOfGlobal.get(u.name); }
    return undefined;
  };
  const callsOf = new Map<Fn, any[]>();
  walk(chunk, n => {
    if (n.type === 'CallExpr') { const f = resolve(n.callee); if (f) { f.calls++; const l = callsOf.get(f) ?? []; l.push(n); callsOf.set(f, l); } }
    if (n.type === 'NameExpr') { const b = sc.refOf.get(n); const f = b && b.kind !== 'global' ? fnOfBinding.get(b) : fnOfGlobal.get(n.name); if (f) f.refs++; }
  });
  const innermost = (pos: number): Fn | undefined => { let best: Fn | undefined; for (const f of fns) if (f.start <= pos && pos <= f.end && (!best || f.end - f.start < best.end - best.start)) best = f; return best; };
  const inside = (f: Fn, n: any) => posOf(n) >= f.start && posOf(n) <= f.end;
  const fnLabel = (f?: Fn) => f ? `${f.name} (L${f.line}${f.endLine !== f.line ? '–' + f.endLine : ''})` : '?';

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- constants / decoders
  let decoders: DecoderCandidate[] = [];
  try { decoders = findConstants(chunk, { maxDecoders: 20, maxStrings: 50, maxNumbers: 10, maxArrays: 10 }).decoders; } catch (e) { notes.push('constant finder failed: ' + (e as Error).message); }
  const fnAtDecoder = (d: DecoderCandidate) => fns.find(f => f.start === d.pos) ?? innermost(d.pos);
  for (const d of decoders) { const f = fnAtDecoder(d); if (f && f.line === d.line) f.roles.add(d.kind); }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- payload blob
  let blob: { n: A.StringLit; len: number } | undefined;
  walk(chunk, n => { if (n.type === 'StringLit' && n.value.length >= 256 && (!blob || n.value.length > blob.len)) blob = { n, len: n.value.length }; });
  let payloadFn: Fn | undefined;
  if (blob) {
    // consumer: a call taking the literal (directly or through a local) as an argument
    let consumer: any;
    walk(chunk, n => { if (!consumer && n.type === 'CallExpr' && n.args.some((a: any) => unparen(a) === blob!.n)) consumer = n; });
    if (!consumer) {
      const holder = sc.bindings.find(b => b.init && unparen(b.init) === blob!.n);
      if (holder) walk(chunk, n => { if (!consumer && n.type === 'CallExpr' && n.args.some((a: any) => { const u = unparen(a); return u?.type === 'NameExpr' && sc.refOf.get(u) === holder; })) consumer = n; });
      if (!consumer && holder) notes.push(`payload is bound to local \`${holder.name}\` (L${holder.line}) and read ${holder.reads}x`);
    }
    parts.push({ role: 'payload', line: lineOf(blob.n), pos: posOf(blob.n), detail: `${blob.len.toLocaleString('en-US')}-byte string literal (largest in the script)`, code: short(blob.n.raw ?? '', 90) });
    if (consumer) {
      payloadFn = resolve(consumer.callee);
      if (payloadFn) payloadFn.roles.add('payload-consumer');
      parts.push({ role: 'payload-consumer', name: payloadFn?.name ?? code(consumer.callee, 40), line: lineOf(consumer), pos: posOf(consumer), detail: payloadFn ? `${fnLabel(payloadFn)} receives the payload` : 'payload passed to ' + code(consumer.callee, 60), code: code(consumer, 120) });
    }
  }
EOF
echo ok

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- interpreter / dispatch
  let trees: DispatchTree[] = [];
  try { trees = extractOpcodes(chunk, { maxTrees: 8 }).trees; } catch (e) { notes.push('dispatch extractor failed: ' + (e as Error).message); }
  const vmTree = trees.filter(t => t.kind === 'vm').sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)[0];
  const cffTree = trees.filter(t => t.kind === 'cff').sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)[0];
  const tree = vmTree ?? cffTree;
  const kind: VmAnatomy['kind'] = vmTree ? 'vm' : cffTree ? 'cff' : 'plain';
  let interp: Fn | undefined, wrapper: Fn | undefined, loop: any;
  if (tree) {
    const tpos = tree.handlers[0]?.pos ?? 0;
    interp = innermost(tpos);
    // innermost loop around the dispatch tree (inside the interpreter function)
    const loops: any[] = [];
    walk(interp?.f ?? chunk, n => { if ((n.type === 'WhileStat' || n.type === 'RepeatStat' || n.type === 'NumericForStat' || n.type === 'GenericForStat') && posOf(n) <= tpos && tpos <= (n.loc?.end ?? 0)) loops.push(n); });
    loop = loops.sort((a, b) => (a.loc.end - a.loc.start) - (b.loc.end - b.loc.start))[0];
    if (kind === 'vm' && interp) {
      interp.roles.add('interpreter');
      parts.push({ role: 'interpreter', name: interp.name, line: interp.line, endLine: interp.endLine, pos: interp.start, detail: `${fnLabel(interp)} runs the dispatch on \`${tree.var}\` — ${tree.handlers.length} handlers, opcodes ${tree.minOp}..${tree.maxOp}`, code: `function(${interp.f.params.join(', ')}${interp.f.vararg ? (interp.f.params.length ? ', ' : '') + '...' : ''})` });
      // closure factory: the function that creates (returns) the interpreter closure
      const p = interp.parent;
      if (p) {
        let returns = false;
        walk(p.f, n => { if (n.type === 'ReturnStat' && n.args.some((a: any) => { const u = unparen(a); return u === interp!.f || (u?.type === 'NameExpr' && interp!.binding && sc.refOf.get(u) === interp!.binding); })) returns = true; });
        if (returns || p.f.body.length <= 12) { wrapper = p; p.roles.add('wrapper'); parts.push({ role: 'wrapper', name: p.name, line: p.line, endLine: p.endLine, pos: p.start, detail: `${fnLabel(p)} ${returns ? 'returns' : 'builds'} the interpreter closure — params (${p.f.params.join(', ')}${p.f.vararg ? ', ...' : ''}) usually = (proto/chunk, upvalues, env)`, code: `function(${p.f.params.join(', ')})` }); }
      }
    }
    if (loop) parts.push({ role: 'dispatch-loop', line: lineOf(loop), endLine: loop.loc?.endLine, pos: posOf(loop), detail: `${loop.type.replace('Stat', '')} loop around the dispatch${tree.inLoop ? '' : ' (tree not marked in-loop)'}`, code: loop.type === 'WhileStat' ? 'while ' + code(loop.cond, 60) + ' do' : loop.type === 'RepeatStat' ? 'repeat … until ' + code(loop.cond, 60) : code({ ...loop, body: [] }, 80) });
    parts.push({ role: 'dispatch', line: tree.line, pos: tpos, detail: `${tree.kind} dispatch tree #${tree.id} on \`${tree.var}\` (${tree.leaves} leaves, score ${tree.score})${tree.entryState !== undefined ? `, entry state ${tree.entryState}` : ''}` });

    // instruction fetch + pc advance (inside the loop, before the tree)
    const r = tree.roles;
    if (loop && (r.code || r.pc || r.inst)) {
      let fetch: any, adv: any;
      walk(loop, n => {
        if (posOf(n) > tpos) return;
        if (!fetch && (n.type === 'LocalStat' || n.type === 'AssignStat')) {
          const vals = n.type === 'LocalStat' ? n.init : n.values;
          if (vals.some((v: any) => { const u = unparen(v); return u?.type === 'IndexExpr' && unparen(u.obj)?.type === 'NameExpr' && (unparen(u.obj).name === r.code || (r.pc && code(u.index, 40).includes(r.pc))); })) fetch = n;
        }
        if (!adv && n.type === 'AssignStat' && n.targets.length === 1 && n.targets[0].type === 'NameExpr' && n.targets[0].name === r.pc) adv = n;
      });
      if (fetch) parts.push({ role: 'fetch', line: lineOf(fetch), pos: posOf(fetch), detail: `instruction fetch${r.inst ? ` → \`${r.inst}\`` : ''}${r.code ? ` from \`${r.code}\`` : ''}${r.pc ? ` at pc \`${r.pc}\`` : ''}`, code: code(fetch, 120) });
      if (adv) parts.push({ role: 'pc-advance', line: lineOf(adv), pos: posOf(adv), detail: `program counter \`${r.pc}\` advances`, code: code(adv, 80) });
    }

    // exits: returns inside the interpreter loop (RETURN / TAILCALL handlers) or the CFF terminator
    if (loop) {
      const hs = [...tree.handlers].sort((a, b) => a.pos - b.pos);
      const handlerAt = (pos: number) => { let h; for (const x of hs) if (x.pos <= pos) h = x; else break; return h; };
      const exits: any[] = [];
      const visitExit = (n: any, depthFn: number) => {
        if (!n || typeof n !== 'object') return;
        if (Array.isArray(n)) { n.forEach(x => visitExit(x, depthFn)); return; }
        if (n.type === 'FunctionExpr') return; // returns of nested closures are not interpreter exits
        if (n.type === 'ReturnStat' || (kind === 'cff' && n.type === 'BreakStat')) exits.push(n);
        for (const k of Object.keys(n)) if (k !== 'loc') visitExit(n[k], depthFn);
      };
      visitExit(loop.body, 0);
      for (const e of exits.slice(0, 12)) {
        const h = handlerAt(posOf(e));
        parts.push({ role: kind === 'cff' ? 'cff-exit' : 'exit', line: lineOf(e), pos: posOf(e), detail: (e.type === 'BreakStat' ? 'break out of the state machine' : 'return from the interpreter') + (h ? ` — handler op ${h.rangeText}${h.guess ? ' ' + h.guess : ''}` : ''), code: code(e, 100) });
      }
      if (exits.length > 12) notes.push(`${exits.length - 12} more exit points not listed`);
      if (kind === 'cff' && tree.entryState !== undefined) parts.push({ role: 'cff-entry', line: lineOf(loop), pos: posOf(loop), detail: `state machine starts in state ${tree.entryState}` });
    }

    // closure creation inside the interpreter (CLOSURE handler calls the wrapper again)
    if (wrapper) for (const c of (callsOf.get(wrapper) ?? []).filter(c => interp && inside(interp, c)).slice(0, 4)) {
      const h = [...tree.handlers].sort((a, b) => a.pos - b.pos).filter(x => x.pos <= posOf(c)).pop();
      parts.push({ role: 'closure', line: lineOf(c), pos: posOf(c), detail: `interpreter calls the closure factory again${h ? ` in handler op ${h.rangeText}${h.guess ? ' ' + h.guess : ''}` : ''} (CLOSURE / nested proto)`, code: code(c, 100) });
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- entry point
  const parentOf = new Map<any, any>();
  walk(chunk, (n, parent) => { if (parent) parentOf.set(n, parent); });
  const stmtOf = (n: any) => { let x = n; while (x && !(typeof x.type === 'string' && /Stat$/.test(x.type))) x = parentOf.get(x); return x ?? n; };
  // effective main body: peel `return (function(...) … end)(...)` style wrappers
  let main: { body: A.Stat[]; fn?: Fn } = { body: chunk.body };
  for (let guard = 0; guard < 4; guard++) {
    const last = main.body[main.body.length - 1] as any;
    const call = last?.type === 'ReturnStat' && last.args.length === 1 ? unparen(last.args[0]) : last?.type === 'CallStat' ? last.expr : null;
    const f = call?.type === 'CallExpr' ? byExpr.get(unparen(call.callee)) : undefined;
    if (!f || main.body.length > 3) break;
    f.roles.add('main-wrapper');
    main = { body: f.f.body, fn: f };
  }
  const outsideVm = (c: any) => !(interp && inside(interp, c)) && !(wrapper && inside(wrapper, c));
  let entryCall: any;
  if (wrapper) entryCall = (callsOf.get(wrapper) ?? []).find(outsideVm);
  if (!entryCall && interp) entryCall = (callsOf.get(interp) ?? []).find(outsideVm);
  let deser: Fn | undefined;
  if (entryCall) {
    const st = stmtOf(entryCall);
    // the deserializer is whatever function's result is fed into the closure factory

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- text report (shared by the tool, MCP and the web UI)
function textTable(rows: Array<Array<string | number>>, head: string[], maxCol = 70): string {
  const all = [head, ...rows.map(r => r.map(c => { const s = String(c ?? ''); return s.length > maxCol ? s.slice(0, maxCol - 1) + '…' : s; }))];
  const w = head.map((_, i) => Math.max(...all.map(r => (r[i] ?? '').length)));
  return all.map((r, ri) => r.map((c, i) => i === r.length - 1 ? c : c.padEnd(w[i])).join('  ') + (ri === 0 ? '\n' + w.map(x => '-'.repeat(x)).join('  ') : '')).join('\n');
}
const KIND_LABEL: Record<VmAnatomy['kind'], string> = { vm: 'bytecode interpreter (virtual machine)', cff: 'control-flow-flattened state machine (no bytecode VM)', plain: 'no VM / dispatcher found' };
export function formatAnatomy(a: VmAnatomy, opts: { label?: string; maxChunks?: number; code?: boolean } = {}): string {
  const out: string[] = [`VM ANATOMY${opts.label ? ' — ' + opts.label : ''}: ${KIND_LABEL[a.kind]}`];
  if (a.pipeline.length) { out.push('', 'PIPELINE  (boot → run → exit)'); for (const l of a.pipeline) out.push('  ' + l); }
  if (a.tree) {
    const r = a.tree.roles;
    const roles = [r.inst && `inst=${r.inst}`, r.opField && `op field=${r.opField}`, r.code && `code=${r.code}`, r.pc && `pc=${r.pc}`, r.stack && `stack=${r.stack}`,
      ...Object.entries(r.fields ?? {}).slice(0, 8).map(([k, v]) => `${v}=${k}`)].filter(Boolean).join(', ');
    out.push('', `DISPATCH  tree #${a.tree.id} (${a.tree.kind}) on \`${a.tree.var}\` L${a.tree.line}: ${a.tree.handlers} handlers, ops ${a.tree.minOp}..${a.tree.maxOp}${roles ? ' — ' + roles : ''}`);
  }
  if (a.parts.length) {
    out.push('', `PARTS (${a.parts.length})`);
    out.push(textTable(a.parts.map(p => [p.role, p.name ?? '', 'L' + p.line + (p.endLine && p.endLine !== p.line ? '–' + p.endLine : ''), p.detail + (opts.code !== false && p.code ? `  ⟨${p.code}⟩` : '')]), ['role', 'name', 'lines', 'detail'], 400));
  }
  const ch = a.chunks.slice(0, opts.maxChunks ?? 25);
  if (ch.length) {
    out.push('', `MAIN CHUNKS (${ch.length} largest functions; size = AST nodes)`);
    out.push(textTable(ch.map(c => [c.name, `L${c.line}–${c.endLine}`, c.size, c.callers, c.refs, c.roles.join(',') || '-', c.parent ?? '-', c.params]), ['name', 'lines', 'size', 'calls', 'refs', 'roles', 'parent', 'params'], 48));
  }
  if (a.notes.length) { out.push('', 'NOTES'); for (const n of a.notes) out.push('- ' + n); }
  return out.join('\n');
}

// VM Map — static anatomy of how the script boots, runs and exits (payload → deserializer → wrapper → interpreter → exits → entry)
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import type { VmAnatomy, AnatomyPart, ChunkInfo } from '@prism/core';
import { usePrism } from '../ctx.js';
import { engine } from '../engineClient.js';
import { Card, Copy, Download, Empty, ErrorBox, Busy, LineLink, JsonView } from './ui.js';

interface Res { anatomy: VmAnatomy; text: string; }
type Stage = { key: string; title: string; hint: string; parts: AnatomyPart[]; sub?: AnatomyPart[]; py?: boolean; op?: boolean; blob?: boolean };
const KIND: Record<VmAnatomy['kind'], { label: string; cls: string }> = {
  vm: { label: 'bytecode VM', cls: 'ok' }, cff: { label: 'CFF state machine', cls: 'warn' }, plain: { label: 'no VM found', cls: '' },
};
const ROLE_HUE: Record<string, number> = { payload: 300, 'payload-consumer': 300, deserializer: 190, 'string-decoder': 160, wrapper: 265, interpreter: 280, 'dispatch-loop': 280, fetch: 230, 'pc-advance': 230, dispatch: 280, exit: 340, 'cff-exit': 340, 'cff-entry': 40, closure: 210, env: 50, varargs: 50, entry: 120 };
const roleChip = (r: string) => { const h = ROLE_HUE[r] ?? (r.length * 47) % 360; return <span className="chip role" style={{ borderColor: `hsla(${h},90%,70%,.45)`, color: `hsl(${h},95%,80%)` }}>{r}</span>; };
const lines = (p: { line: number; endLine?: number }) => 'L' + p.line + (p.endLine && p.endLine !== p.line ? '–' + p.endLine : '');

export function Anatomy() {
  const { text, target, reveal, send, goTab, toast, name } = usePrism();
  const [res, setRes] = useState<Res | null>(null);
  const [ms, setMs] = useState(0);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const [allChunks, setAllChunks] = useState(false);

  const go = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!text.trim()) return;
    setBusy(true); setErr(null);
    try { const r = await engine.op<Res>('anatomy', text, { maxChunks: 80 }); setRes(r.result); setMs(Math.round(r.ms)); }
    catch (e: any) { setErr(String(e?.message || e)); setRes(null); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }, [text]);
  useEffect(() => { go(); }, [go]);

  const a = res?.anatomy;
  const stages: Stage[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (!a) return [];
    const by = (...r: string[]) => a.parts.filter(p => r.includes(p.role));
    return [
      { key: 'payload', title: 'Payload', hint: 'largest string literal and the call that consumes it', parts: by('payload'), sub: by('payload-consumer'), blob: true },
      { key: 'unpack', title: 'Deserializer', hint: 'turns the payload into the chunk (protos, constants, instructions) — port it to Python', parts: by('deserializer'), py: true },
      { key: 'decoders', title: 'String decoders', hint: 'constant / string decryptors', parts: by('string-decoder'), py: true },
      { key: 'wrap', title: 'Closure factory', hint: 'wraps a proto into a callable Lua closure', parts: by('wrapper') },
      { key: 'run', title: a.kind === 'cff' ? 'State machine' : 'Interpreter', hint: 'dispatch loop, instruction fetch, pc advance', parts: by('interpreter').length ? by('interpreter') : by('dispatch-loop'), sub: [...by('fetch', 'pc-advance', 'dispatch', 'varargs', 'cff-entry'), ...(by('interpreter').length ? by('dispatch-loop') : [])], op: true },
      { key: 'exit', title: 'Exits', hint: 'RETURN / TAILCALL handlers, CLOSURE creation', parts: by('exit', 'cff-exit'), sub: by('closure') },
      { key: 'entry', title: 'Entry', hint: 'the statement that starts the protected program', parts: by('entry'), sub: by('env') },
    ];
  }, [a]);

  const toBlob = useCallback(async (p: AnatomyPart) => {
    try { const { result } = await engine.op('literalBytes', text, { line: p.line, largest: true }); send('blob', { bytes: result, label: `payload L${p.line}` }); }
    catch (e: any) { toast(String(e?.message || e), 'bad'); }
  }, [text, send, toast]);

  if (!text.trim()) return <Empty><div><div className="big">No script yet</div>Paste or open a script on the left.</div></Empty>;
  const chunks = (a?.chunks ?? []).filter(c => !q || (c.name + ' ' + c.roles.join(' ') + ' ' + c.params + ' ' + (c.parent ?? '')).toLowerCase().includes(q.toLowerCase()));
  const shown = allChunks ? chunks : chunks.slice(0, 30);
  const maxSize = Math.max(1, ...(a?.chunks ?? []).map(c => c.size));
  const tsvParts = a ? 'role\tname\tline\tendLine\tdetail\tcode\n' + a.parts.map(p => [p.role, p.name ?? '', p.line, p.endLine ?? '', p.detail, p.code ?? ''].join('\t')).join('\n') : '';
  const tsvChunks = a ? 'name\tline\tendLine\tsize\tcallers\trefs\troles\tparent\tparams\n' + a.chunks.map((c: ChunkInfo) => [c.name, c.line, c.endLine, c.size, c.callers, c.refs, c.roles.join(','), c.parent ?? '', c.params].join('\t')).join('\n') : '';
  const json = a ? JSON.stringify(a, null, 2) : '';
  const k = a ? KIND[a.kind] : null;

  return (
    <div className="col">
      <Busy on={busy} label="Mapping the VM" />
      <div className="toolbar">
        {k && <span className={'pill ' + k.cls}>{k.label}</span>}
        <span className="small muted">static boot → run → exit map on {target} code{ms ? ` · ${ms}ms` : ''}</span>
        <span className="spacer" />
        {res && <><Copy text={res.text} label="Copy report" /><Copy text={json} label="Copy JSON" /><Download name={name.replace(/\.(lua|luau|txt)$/i, '') + '.anatomy.txt'} content={res.text} /></>}
        <button className="btn sm" onClick={go} disabled={busy}>Re-run</button>
      </div>
      <ErrorBox error={err} />
      <div className="fill scroll">
        {a && <div className="cards">
          <Card title="Boot chain" right={<Copy text={a.pipeline.join('\n')} label="Copy pipeline" />}>
            <div className="flow">

                <React.Fragment key={st.key}>
                  {i > 0 && <div className="flow-arrow">→</div>}
                  <div className={'flow-node' + (st.parts.length ? '' : ' missing')} title={st.hint}>
                    <div className="flow-t"><span>{st.title}</span>{st.parts.length > 1 && <span className="muted"> ×{st.parts.length}</span>}</div>
                    {st.parts.length === 0 && <div className="small muted">not found</div>}
                    {st.parts.slice(0, st.key === 'exit' ? 4 : 2).map((p, j) => (
                      <div key={j} className="flow-p">
                        {p.name && <b className="mono">{p.name} </b>}<LineLink line={p.line} onClick={l => reveal(l)} />{p.endLine && p.endLine !== p.line ? <span className="muted mono">–{p.endLine}</span> : null}
                        {st.key === 'exit' && <span className="muted small"> {p.detail.replace(/^.*handler op /, 'op ')}</span>}
                        {st.key !== 'exit' && <div className="small muted flow-d">{p.detail}</div>}
                      </div>
                    ))}
                    {st.key === 'exit' && st.parts.length > 4 && <div className="small muted">+{st.parts.length - 4} more</div>}
                    {st.sub && st.sub.length > 0 && <div className="flow-sub">{st.sub.slice(0, 5).map((p, j) => <div key={j} className="small" title={p.detail}>{roleChip(p.role)} <LineLink line={p.line} onClick={l => reveal(l)} /> <span className="mono muted">{(p.code ?? p.name ?? '').slice(0, 48)}</span></div>)}</div>}
                    <div className="flow-a">
                      {st.py && st.parts[0] && <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => send('python', { fn: String(st.parts[0].line) })} title="port this function (+ deps) to Python; __main__ calls it at its call sites and dumps the result">→ Python</span>}
                      {st.blob && st.parts[0] && <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => toBlob(st.parts[0])}>→ Blob Lab</span>}
                      {st.op && st.parts[0] && <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => goTab('opcodes')}>→ Opcode Map</span>}
                      {st.parts[0] && <Copy text={[...st.parts, ...(st.sub ?? [])].map(p => `${p.role} ${p.name ?? ''} ${lines(p)}: ${p.detail}${p.code ? ' | ' + p.code : ''}`).join('\n')} label="Copy" />}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </React.Fragment>
              ))}
            </div>
            {a.pipeline.length > 0 && <pre className="block" style={{ marginTop: 10 }}>{a.pipeline.join('\n')}</pre>}
          </Card>

          {a.tree && (
            <Card title={`Dispatch tree #${a.tree.id} · ${a.tree.kind}`} right={<span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => goTab('opcodes')}>Open Opcode Map →</span>}>
              <div className="chips">
                <span className="chip hi">var <b>{a.tree.var}</b></span>
                <span className="chip">handlers <b>{a.tree.handlers}</b></span>
                <span className="chip">ops <b>{a.tree.minOp}..{a.tree.maxOp}</b></span>
                <span className="chip line-chip" onClick={() => reveal(a.tree!.line)}>L<b>{a.tree.line}</b></span>
                {a.tree.roles.inst && <span className="chip">inst <b>{a.tree.roles.inst}</b></span>}
                {a.tree.roles.opField && <span className="chip">op field <b>{a.tree.roles.opField}</b></span>}
                {a.tree.roles.code && <span className="chip">code <b>{a.tree.roles.code}</b></span>}
                {a.tree.roles.pc && <span className="chip">pc <b>{a.tree.roles.pc}</b></span>}
                {a.tree.roles.stack && <span className="chip">stack <b>{a.tree.roles.stack}</b></span>}
                {Object.entries(a.tree.roles.fields ?? {}).slice(0, 10).map(([f, r]) => <span key={f} className="chip">{r} <b>{f}</b></span>)}
              </div>
            </Card>
          )}

          <Card title={`Parts (${a.parts.length})`} right={<Copy text={tsvParts} label="Copy TSV" />}>
            <div className="scroll" style={{ maxHeight: 420 }}>
              <table className="data">
                <thead><tr><th>role</th><th>name</th><th>lines</th><th>detail</th><th>code</th><th /></tr></thead>
                <tbody>{a.parts.map((p, i) => (

''} ${lines(p)}: ${p.detail}${p.code ? ' | ' + p.code : ''}`} label="copy" /></td>
                  </tr>
                ))}</tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </Card>

          <Card title={`Main chunks (${a.chunks.length} largest functions)`} right={<><input className="inp" placeholder="filter name / role…" value={q} onChange={e => setQ(e.target.value)} style={{ width: 160, padding: '3px 8px' }} /><Copy text={tsvChunks} label="Copy TSV" /></>}>
            <div className="small muted" style={{ marginBottom: 6 }}>size = AST nodes (nested functions included) · calls = resolved call sites · refs = name references · roles from the anatomy + constant finder</div>
            <div className="scroll" style={{ maxHeight: 460 }}>
              <table className="data">
                <thead><tr><th>name</th><th>lines</th><th>size</th><th>calls</th><th>refs</th><th>roles</th><th>parent</th><th>params</th><th /></tr></thead>
                <tbody>{shown.map(c => (
                  <tr key={c.id}>
                    <td style={{ color: 'var(--txt)' }}>{c.name}</td>
                    <td><LineLink line={c.line} onClick={l => reveal(l)} /><span className="muted">–{c.endLine}</span></td>
                    <td className="num" style={{ minWidth: 90 }}><div className="bar" title={String(c.size)} style={{ display: 'inline-block', width: 44, verticalAlign: 'middle', marginRight: 6 }}><i style={{ width: `${Math.max(3, (c.size / maxSize) * 100)}%` }} /></div>{c.size}</td>
                    <td className="num">{c.callers}</td>
                    <td className="num">{c.refs}</td>
                    <td><div className="chips" style={{ flexWrap: 'nowrap' }}>{c.roles.map(r => <React.Fragment key={r}>{roleChip(r)}</React.Fragment>)}</div></td>
                    <td className="muted">{c.parent ?? ''}</td>
                    <td className="muted" style={{ maxWidth: 180, overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis' }} title={c.params}>{c.params}</td>
                    <td><span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => send('python', { fn: String(c.line) })}>→ Py</span></td>
                  </tr>
                ))}</tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
            {chunks.length > 30 && <div style={{ marginTop: 6 }}><span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => setAllChunks(v => !v)}>{allChunks ? 'show top 30' : `show all ${chunks.length}`}</span></div>}
          </Card>

          {a.notes.length > 0 && <Card title="Notes">{a.notes.map((n, i) => <div key={i} className="small" style={{ color: 'var(--neon3)', marginBottom: 3 }}>▸ {n}</div>)}</Card>}
          <Card title="Full report" right={<Copy text={res!.text} />}><JsonView value={a} label="anatomy JSON" /><pre className="block" style={{ marginTop: 8, maxHeight: 360, overflow: 'auto' }}>{res!.text}</pre></Card>
        </div>}
        {!a && !busy && !err && <Empty><div><div className="big">VM Map</div>Static boot → run → exit map: payload, deserializer, closure factory, interpreter, exits, entry and the main chunks.</div></Empty>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

## 749. ИИ · шаг

Пишу модуль Chunk Explorer в ядре
bash
cd /data/prism && cat > packages/core/src/bytecode/chunk.ts <<'EOF'
// Chunk explorer — auto-infers the layout of a decoded VM chunk and disassembles every proto with an editable opcode map.
// Input: any JSON (e.g. the lua_dump() output of a Python-ported deserializer) or a Lua table literal.
// Layouts recognised generically (nothing obfuscator-specific):
//   • proto records holding an instruction array (tuples {op,A,B,C} / records {op=…} / packed 32-bit words),
//     struct-of-arrays protos (parallel opcode/operand integer arrays), a constant array, nested protos of the same shape;
//   • lists are addressed with Lua keys (first element = "1"), dicts keep their keys — the same keys the Opcode Map roles use.
import { vmDisassemble, type OpMap } from './customvm.js';

type J = unknown;
type Obj = Record<string, J>;
const isBytes = (v: J): v is { $bytes: string } => !!v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v) && typeof (v as Obj).$bytes === 'string' && Object.keys(v as Obj).length === 1;
const hexLatin1 = (h: string) => { let s = ''; for (let i = 0; i + 1 < h.length; i += 2) s += String.fromCharCode(parseInt(h.slice(i, i + 2), 16)); return s; };
/** {"$bytes": hex} (lua_dump's encoding of non-text strings) → latin1 string */
export const unbytes = (v: J): J => isBytes(v) ? hexLatin1(v.$bytes) : v;
const isScalar = (v: J) => v === null || typeof v !== 'object' || isBytes(v);
const isCont = (v: J): v is Obj | J[] => !!v && typeof v === 'object' && !isBytes(v);
const isInt = (v: J) => typeof v === 'number' && Number.isInteger(v);
/** entries with Lua keys: list index i → "i+1" */
function ents(v: J): Array<[string, J]> { if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map((x, i) => [String(i + 1), x]); if (isCont(v)) return Object.entries(v as Obj); return []; }
const sizeOf = (v: J) => Array.isArray(v) ? v.length : isCont(v) ? Object.keys(v).length : 0;
/** ordered elements of an array-like container (list, or dict with integer keys — holes become null) */
function elems(v: J): { items: J[]; base: number } | null {
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return { items: v, base: 1 };
  if (!isCont(v)) return null;
  const ks = Object.keys(v);
  if (!ks.length) return { items: [], base: 1 };
  if (!ks.every(k => /^-?\d+$/.test(k))) return null;
  const nums = ks.map(Number).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const base = nums[0], span = nums[nums.length - 1] - base + 1;
  if (span > nums.length * 2 + 8) return null;
  const items: J[] = new Array(span).fill(null);
  for (const n of nums) items[n - base] = (v as Obj)[String(n)];
  return { items, base };
}

export interface ChunkLayout {
  kind: 'tuple' | 'soa' | 'packed';
  /** key of the instruction array inside a proto (tuple/packed) or the parallel arrays (soa) */
  instr: string | string[];
  protos?: string;
  consts?: string;
  opField: string;
  fields: Record<string, string>;
  bits?: Array<{ name: string; shift: number; width: number }>;
}
export interface ChunkProto { id: string; depth: number; instructions: number; children: number; consts: number; scalars: Record<string, J>; other: Record<string, string>; }
export interface ChunkDisasmOptions {
  opField?: string | number;
  fields?: Record<string, string>;
  /** packed words: "op:0:8 A:8:8 B:16:8 C:24:8" or preset "luau" | "lua51" */
  bits?: string;
  /** JSON path (dot or / separated keys, Lua keys for lists) to the root proto when auto-detection picks the wrong node */
  select?: string;
  /** instructions shown per proto (default 4000) */
  max?: number;
  /** only this proto id (e.g. "F.2.0") */
  proto?: string;
  maxProtos?: number;
  pcBase?: number;
}
export interface ChunkDisasmResult {
  text: string;
  layout: ChunkLayout;
  rootPath: string[];
  protos: ChunkProto[];
  totalInstructions: number;
  histogram: Array<{ op: string; name: string; count: number }>;
  unknown: string[];
  strings: Array<{ value: string; count: number; first: string }>;
  notes: string[];
}

const PRESETS: Record<string, string> = { luau: 'op:0:8 A:8:8 B:16:8 C:24:8 D:16:16', lua51: 'op:0:6 A:6:8 C:14:9 B:23:9 Bx:14:18' };
function parseBits(s: string) {
  const spec = PRESETS[s.trim().toLowerCase()] ?? s;
  const out = spec.split(/[\s,;]+/).filter(Boolean).map(p => { const [name, sh, w] = p.split(':'); return { name, shift: Number(sh), width: Number(w) }; });
  if (!out.length || out.some(b => !b.name || !Number.isFinite(b.shift) || !Number.isFinite(b.width) || b.width < 1 || b.width > 32)) throw new Error(`bad bits spec "${s}" — use e.g. "op:0:8 A:8:8 B:16:8 C:24:8" or a preset (luau, lua51)`);
  return out;
}

/** score a container as an instruction array; returns op-field candidates (keys that are integers in ~every instruction) */
function insnArray(v: J): { n: number; kind: 'tuple' | 'packed'; cands: string[]; keys: string[]; score: number } | null {
  const e = elems(v);
  if (!e || !e.items.length) return null;
  const items = e.items.filter(x => x !== null);
  if (!items.length) return null;
  if (items.every(isInt)) {
    if (items.length < 4 || !items.some(x => (x as number) > 0xffff)) return null; // a plain int list (line info, sizes…) is not code
    return { n: items.length, kind: 'packed', cands: ['op'], keys: [], score: items.length * 0.6 };
  }
  const sample = items.length > 3000 ? items.filter((_, i) => i % Math.ceil(items.length / 3000) === 0) : items;
  let recs = 0, scal = 0, tot = 0;
  const keyN = new Map<string, number>(), intN = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const r of sample) {
    if (!isCont(r)) continue;
    const es = ents(r);
    if (es.length > 24) return null;
    recs++;
    for (const [k, x] of es) { tot++; if (isScalar(x)) scal++; keyN.set(k, (keyN.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (isInt(x)) intN.set(k, (intN.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); }
  }
  if (recs < sample.length * 0.9 || !tot || scal < tot * 0.85) return null;
  const order = (a: string, b: string) => (/^\d+$/.test(a) && /^\d+$/.test(b) ? +a - +b : a.localeCompare(b));
  const keys = [...keyN.keys()].sort(order);
  const cands = keys.filter(k => (intN.get(k) ?? 0) >= recs * 0.97);
  if (!cands.length) return null;
  const named = cands.find(k => /^(op|opcode|OP|Op|Opcode|code)$/.test(k));
  if (named) cands.unshift(...cands.splice(cands.indexOf(named), 1));
  return { n: items.length, kind: 'tuple', cands, keys, score: items.length * (scal / tot) + (named ? 50 : 0) };
}

interface ProtoShape { instr: string | string[]; kind: 'tuple' | 'soa' | 'packed'; n: number; cands: string[]; keys: string[] }
/** does this container look like a proto (holds an instruction array or parallel int arrays)? */
function protoShape(v: J, prefer?: string | string[]): ProtoShape | null {
  if (!isCont(v)) return null;
  const es = ents(v);
  if (prefer && typeof prefer === 'string') { const x = es.find(([k]) => k === prefer); if (x) { const ia = insnArray(x[1]); if (ia) return { instr: prefer, kind: ia.kind, n: ia.n, cands: ia.cands, keys: ia.keys }; if (sizeOf(x[1]) === 0) return { instr: prefer, kind: 'tuple', n: 0, cands: [], keys: [] }; } }
  let best: ProtoShape & { score: number } | null = null;
  for (const [k, x] of es) { const ia = insnArray(x); if (ia && (!best || ia.score > best.score)) best = { instr: k, kind: ia.kind, n: ia.n, cands: ia.cands, keys: ia.keys, score: ia.score }; }
  if (best) return best;
  // struct of arrays: ≥ 2 integer arrays of the same length
  const intArrays = es.filter(([, x]) => { const e = elems(x); return !!e && e.items.length >= 3 && e.items.every(y => y === null || isInt(y)); });
  const byLen = new Map<number, string[]>();
  for (const [k, x] of intArrays) { const n = elems(x)!.items.length; byLen.set(n, [...(byLen.get(n) ?? []), k]); }
  const grp = [...byLen.entries()].filter(([, ks]) => ks.length >= 2).sort((a, b) => b[1].length - a[1].length || b[0] - a[0])[0];
  if (grp) return { instr: grp[1], kind: 'soa', n: grp[0], cands: grp[1], keys: grp[1] };
  return null;
}

function getPath(root: J, path: string[]): J {
  let cur = root;
  for (const k of path) { const e = ents(cur).find(([kk]) => kk === k); if (!e) throw new Error(`select: key "${k}" not found (available: ${ents(cur).slice(0, 20).map(x => x[0]).join(', ')})`); cur = e[1]; }
  return cur;
}

/** infer the chunk layout and disassemble every proto */
export function chunkDisassemble(json: J, opmap: OpMap = {}, opts: ChunkDisasmOptions = {}): ChunkDisasmResult {
  const notes: string[] = [];
  // ---- locate the root proto (shallowest container holding code; the root itself may be a bare instruction array)
  let rootPath: string[] = [];
  let root: J = json, shape: ProtoShape | null = null;
  if (opts.select) { rootPath = opts.select.split(/[./]/).filter(Boolean); root = getPath(json, rootPath); }
  const bare = insnArray(root);
  if (bare && !opts.select) { root = { '1': root }; shape = { instr: '1', kind: bare.kind, n: bare.n, cands: bare.cands, keys: bare.keys }; notes.push('input is a bare instruction array (one proto)'); }
  else {
    const queue: Array<{ v: J; path: string[]; d: number }> = [{ v: root, path: rootPath, d: 0 }];
    let found: { v: J; path: string[]; s: ProtoShape; d: number } | null = null;
    while (queue.length) {
      const q = queue.shift()!;
      const s = protoShape(q.v);
      if (s && s.n > 0) { if (!found || (q.d === found.d && s.n > found.s.n)) found = { ...q, s }; if (found.d < q.d) break; }
      if (q.d < 5 && !found) for (const [k, x] of ents(q.v)) if (isCont(x) && sizeOf(x) > 0) queue.push({ v: x, path: [...q.path, k], d: q.d + 1 });
      if (queue.length > 20000) break;
    }
    if (!found) throw new Error('no instruction array found — expected a list of instruction tuples/records ({op, A, B, C}), packed integer words, or parallel opcode/operand arrays. Use select to point at the proto');
    root = found.v; rootPath = found.path; shape = found.s;
  }
  // ---- layout: op field + operand letters
  const sh = shape!;
  let opField = opts.opField !== undefined ? String(opts.opField) : '';
  const mapKeys = new Set(Object.keys(opmap).filter(k => k !== '$meta'));
  const instrRecords = (p: J, s: ProtoShape): Obj[] => {
    if (s.kind === 'soa') {
      const arrs = (s.instr as string[]).map(k => [k, elems(ents(p).find(([kk]) => kk === k)?.[1])?.items ?? []] as const);
      const n = Math.max(0, ...arrs.map(([, a]) => a.length));
      return Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => Object.fromEntries(arrs.map(([k, a]) => [k, a[i] ?? null])));
    }
    const arr = elems(ents(p).find(([kk]) => kk === s.instr)?.[1])?.items ?? [];
    if (s.kind === 'packed') return arr.map(w => { const o: Obj = { word: w }; if (isInt(w)) for (const b of bits!) o[b.name] = Math.floor(Number(w) / 2 ** b.shift) % 2 ** b.width; return o; });
    return arr.map(r => Object.fromEntries(ents(r).map(([k, x]) => [k, unbytes(x)])));
  };
  let bits: ChunkLayout['bits'];
  if (sh.kind === 'packed') {
    bits = parseBits(opts.bits ?? 'luau');
    if (!opts.bits) notes.push('packed instruction words decoded with the Luau-style layout op:0:8 A:8:8 B:16:8 C:24:8 D:16:16 — pass bits (e.g. "lua51" or "op:0:6 A:6:8 …") if the handlers extract fields differently');
    opField = opField || (bits.find(b => /^op/i.test(b.name))?.name ?? bits[0].name);
  }
  if (!opField) {
    const sample = instrRecords(root, sh).slice(0, 3000);
    if (mapKeys.size && sh.cands.length > 1) {
      // the opcode field is the one whose values the opcode map knows best
      const hit = (k: string) => sample.reduce((n, r) => n + (mapKeys.has(String(r[k])) ? 1 : 0), 0);
      opField = [...sh.cands].sort((a, b) => hit(b) - hit(a))[0];
    } else opField = sh.cands[0] ?? '1';
  }
  let fields = opts.fields;
  if (!fields) {
    fields = {};
    const letters = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMN';
    let li = 0;
    const ks = sh.kind === 'packed' ? bits!.map(b => b.name) : sh.keys;
    for (const k of ks) if (k !== opField) fields[k] = sh.kind === 'packed' || /^[A-Za-z]{1,3}$/.test(k) ? k : letters[li++] ?? k;
  }
  // ---- nested protos + constants keys (decided on the root, reused for every proto)
  const rootEnts = ents(root);
  const instrKeys = new Set(Array.isArray(sh.instr) ? sh.instr : [sh.instr]);
  let protosKey: string | undefined, constsKey: string | undefined;
  let bestP = 0, bestC = -1;
  for (const [k, x] of rootEnts) {
    if (instrKeys.has(k) || !isCont(x)) continue;
    const items = elems(x)?.items ?? ents(x).map(e => e[1]);
    const protoLike = items.filter(it => protoShape(it, sh.kind === 'soa' ? undefined : (sh.instr as string)) !== null).length;
    if (protoLike > 0 && protoLike >= items.length * 0.5 && protoLike > bestP) { bestP = protoLike; protosKey = k; continue; }
    const e = elems(x);
    if (e && e.items.length && e.items.every(isScalar)) {
      const strs = e.items.filter(y => typeof y === 'string' || isBytes(y)).length, nonInt = e.items.filter(y => y !== null && !isInt(y)).length;
      const sc = strs * 3 + nonInt + e.items.length * 0.01;
      if (nonInt > 0 && sc > bestC) { bestC = sc; constsKey = k; }
    }
  }
  // sub-protos without children store an empty table under the protos key: find it via a second proto if the root had none
  const layout: ChunkLayout = { kind: sh.kind, instr: sh.instr, protos: protosKey, consts: constsKey, opField, fields, bits };

  // ---- walk all protos
  const protos: ChunkProto[] = [];
  const out: string[] = [];
  const hist = new Map<string, number>(), unknown = new Set<string>();
  const strings = new Map<string, { count: number; first: string }>();
  const max = opts.max ?? 4000, maxProtos = opts.maxProtos ?? 5000;
  let total = 0;
  const addStr = (v: J, where: string) => { if (typeof v === 'string' && v.length) { const s = strings.get(v); if (s) s.count++; else strings.set(v, { count: 1, first: where }); } };
  const visit = (p: J, id: string, depth: number) => {
    if (protos.length >= maxProtos) return;
    const s = protoShape(p, sh.kind === 'soa' ? undefined : (sh.instr as string)) ?? { ...sh, n: 0 };
    const recs = s.n ? instrRecords(p, s.kind === sh.kind ? s : sh) : [];
    const pe = ents(p);
    const cv = constsKey ? pe.find(([k]) => k === constsKey)?.[1] : undefined;
    const ce = cv !== undefined ? elems(cv) : null;
    const consts = ce ? ce.items.map(unbytes) : [];
    const kids = protosKey ? pe.find(([k]) => k === protosKey)?.[1] : undefined;
    const kidEnts = kids !== undefined ? ents(kids) : [];
    const scalars: Record<string, J> = {}, other: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const [k, x] of pe) {
      if (instrKeys.has(k) || k === protosKey || k === constsKey) continue;
      if (isScalar(x)) scalars[k] = unbytes(x); else other[k] = `${Array.isArray(x) ? 'list' : 'dict'}[${sizeOf(x)}]`;
    }
    protos.push({ id, depth, instructions: recs.length, children: kidEnts.length, consts: consts.length, scalars, other });
    total += recs.length;
    for (const r of recs) for (const v of Object.values(r)) addStr(v, id);
    for (const c of consts) addStr(c, id + ' K');
    if (!opts.proto || opts.proto === id) {
      const meta = [`${recs.length} instructions`, kidEnts.length ? `${kidEnts.length} child protos` : '', consts.length ? `${consts.length} constants` : '',
        Object.keys(scalars).length ? 'fields ' + Object.entries(scalars).map(([k, v]) => `[${k}]=${JSON.stringify(v)}`).join(' ') : '',
        Object.keys(other).length ? Object.entries(other).map(([k, v]) => `[${k}]=${v}`).join(' ') : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
      out.push('', `; ======== proto ${id}${depth ? '' : ' (main)'} — ${meta}`);
      if (consts.length) out.push('; constants: ' + consts.slice(0, 40).map((c, i) => `K${i + (ce?.base ?? 1)}=${typeof c === 'string' ? JSON.stringify(c.length > 40 ? c.slice(0, 40) + '…' : c) : String(c)}`).join(' ') + (consts.length > 40 ? ` … (+${consts.length - 40})` : ''));
      if (recs.length) {
        const r = vmDisassemble(recs, opmap, { opField, fields, constants: consts.length ? consts : undefined, kBase: ce?.base ?? 1, pcBase: opts.pcBase ?? 1, max });
        out.push(...r.text.split('\n').filter(l => !l.startsWith('; PRISM custom-VM listing') && !l.startsWith('; unmapped opcodes')).filter((l, i) => !(i === 0 && !l)));
      }
    }
    for (const r of recs) { const op = String(r[opField]); hist.set(op, (hist.get(op) ?? 0) + 1); if (!mapKeys.has(op)) unknown.add(op); }
    for (const [k, c] of kidEnts) if (isCont(c)) visit(c, `${id}.${k}`, depth + 1);
  };
  visit(root, 'F', 0);
  if (protos.length >= maxProtos) notes.push(`stopped after ${maxProtos} protos`);
  const histogram = [...hist].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).map(([op, count]) => { const e = opmap[op]; return { op, name: e === undefined ? `OP_${op}` : typeof e === 'string' ? e : e.name, count }; });
  const strs = [...strings].sort((a, b) => b[1].count - a[1].count).map(([value, s]) => ({ value, ...s }));
  const lay = `${sh.kind === 'soa' ? 'parallel arrays ' + (sh.instr as string[]).map(k => `[${k}]`).join(',') : sh.kind === 'packed' ? `packed words [${sh.instr}] (${bits!.map(b => `${b.name}:${b.shift}:${b.width}`).join(' ')})` : `instructions [${sh.instr}]`}` +
    `${protosKey ? `, nested protos [${protosKey}]` : ''}${constsKey ? `, constants [${constsKey}]` : ', constants inline (no constant array)'}`;
  const head = [
    `; PRISM chunk disassembly — root ${rootPath.length ? rootPath.map(k => `[${k}]`).join('') : '(top level)'} · ${protos.length} protos · ${total.toLocaleString('en-US')} instructions`,
    `; layout: ${lay}`,
    `; opcode field [${opField}] · operands ${Object.entries(fields).map(([k, l]) => `[${k}]→${l}`).join(' ') || '(none)'} · opcode map ${mapKeys.size ? mapKeys.size + ' entries' : 'empty (OP_n names) — build one in Opcode Map'}`,
  ];
  if (unknown.size && mapKeys.size) head.push(`; unmapped opcodes (${unknown.size}): ${[...unknown].sort((a, b) => +a - +b).slice(0, 80).join(' ')}`);
  for (const n of notes) head.push('; note: ' + n);
  return { text: head.join('\n') + '\n' + out.join('\n') + '\n', layout, rootPath, protos, totalInstructions: total, histogram, unknown: [...unknown], strings: strs, notes };
}

// Value re-injection: replace call sites with the values your Python port computed for them.
// The Python __main__ produced by functionToPython keys every result by its call site "L<line>:<col>" (position of the
// call's first character); this pass parses the same source, finds those calls and splices literal values in place —
// formatting of the rest of the file is preserved. Static: the values come from the user, nothing is executed here.
import type * as A from '../ast.js';
import { parse } from '../parser.js';
import { lex, T } from '../lexer.js';
import { print } from '../printer.js';

const unparen = (e: any): any => { while (e && e.type === 'ParenExpr') e = e.expr; return e; };
/** offset of the first character of an expression (suffixed expressions carry the loc of their suffix token) */
export function exprStart(e: any): number {
  if (!e) return 0;
  switch (e.type) {
    case 'MemberExpr': case 'IndexExpr': case 'MethodCallExpr': return exprStart(e.obj);
    case 'CallExpr': return exprStart(e.callee);
    case 'BinExpr': return exprStart(e.left);
    default: return e.loc?.start ?? 0;
  }
}
/** offset → 1-based line/col */
export function lineIndex(src: string) {
  const starts = [0];
  for (let i = 0; i < src.length; i++) if (src.charCodeAt(i) === 10) starts.push(i + 1);
  return (off: number) => { let lo = 0, hi = starts.length - 1; while (lo < hi) { const m = (lo + hi + 1) >> 1; if (starts[m] <= off) lo = m; else hi = m - 1; } return { line: lo + 1, col: off - starts[lo] + 1 }; };
}
/** "L<line>:<col>" key of a call expression */
export function siteKeyer(src: string) {
  const lc = lineIndex(src);
  return (call: any) => { const p = lc(exprStart(call)); return `L${p.line}:${p.col}`; };
}

export interface InlineOptions {
  /** longest literal to inject (default 4000 chars) */
  maxLen?: number;
  /** also inject tables as table constructors (default true) */
  tables?: boolean;
  /** only replace calls whose callee text is this (e.g. "decode" or "fn12") */
  callee?: string;
}
export interface InlineResult {
  code: string;
  replaced: Array<{ key: string; line: number; callee: string; literal: string }>;
  skipped: Array<{ key: string; reason: string }>;
}

const isIdent = (s: string) => /^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/.test(s) && !/^(and|break|do|else|elseif|end|false|for|function|goto|if|in|local|nil|not|or|repeat|return|then|true|until|while|continue)$/.test(s);
function luaString(bytes: string): string {
  let out = '"';
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
    const c = bytes.charCodeAt(i);
    const nx = bytes.charCodeAt(i + 1);
    if (c === 34) out += '\\"'; else if (c === 92) out += '\\\\'; else if (c === 10) out += '\\n'; else if (c === 13) out += '\\r'; else if (c === 9) out += '\\t';
    else if (c >= 32 && c < 127) out += bytes[i];
    else out += '\\' + (nx >= 48 && nx <= 57 ? String(c & 255).padStart(3, '0') : String(c & 255));
  }
  return out + '"';
}
const hexLatin1 = (h: string) => { let s = ''; for (let i = 0; i + 1 < h.length; i += 2) s += String.fromCharCode(parseInt(h.slice(i, i + 2), 16)); return s; };
/** JSON value (lua_dump encoding) → Lua literal source, or a reason why it cannot be inlined */
export function jsonToLua(v: unknown, opts: { tables?: boolean } = {}, depth = 0): { lua?: string; why?: string } {
  if (v === null || v === undefined) return { lua: 'nil' };
  if (typeof v === 'boolean') return { lua: String(v) };
  if (typeof v === 'number') return { lua: Number.isNaN(v) ? '(0/0)' : v === Infinity ? 'math.huge' : v === -Infinity ? '(-math.huge)' : v < 0 || Object.is(v, -0) ? `(${Object.is(v, -0) ? '-0' : String(v)})` : String(v) };
  if (typeof v === 'string') return v === '<function>' || v === '<cycle>' ? { why: `value is ${v}` } : { lua: luaString(v) };
  if (typeof v === 'object') {
    const o = v as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (!Array.isArray(o) && typeof o.$bytes === 'string' && Object.keys(o).length === 1) return { lua: luaString(hexLatin1(o.$bytes as string)) };
    if (!Array.isArray(o) && '$error' in o) return { why: 'the call raised ' + String(o.$error).slice(0, 120) };
    if (!Array.isArray(o) && '$multi' in o) return { why: 'multiple return values' };
    if (opts.tables === false) return { why: 'table value (tables disabled)' };
    if (depth > 12) return { why: 'table nested too deeply' };
    const parts: string[] = [];
    if (Array.isArray(o)) for (const x of o) { const r = jsonToLua(x, opts, depth + 1); if (r.why) return r; parts.push(r.lua!); }
    else for (const [k, x] of Object.entries(o)) {
      const r = jsonToLua(x, opts, depth + 1); if (r.why) return r;
      const key = /^-?\d+$/.test(k) ? `[${k}]` : isIdent(k) ? k : `[${luaString(k)}]`;
      parts.push(`${key} = ${r.lua}`);
    }
    return { lua: '{' + parts.join(', ') + '}' };
  }
  return { why: 'unsupported value' };
}

/** replace calls keyed "L<line>:<col>" by the given values */
export function inlineValues(src: string, values: Record<string, unknown>, opts: InlineOptions = {}): InlineResult {
  const { chunk } = parse(src);
  const key = siteKeyer(src);
  const maxLen = opts.maxLen ?? 4000;
  const parentOf = new Map<any, any>();
  const calls = new Map<string, any>();
  const visit = (n: any, parent: any) => {
    if (!n || typeof n !== 'object') return;
    if (Array.isArray(n)) { n.forEach(x => visit(x, parent)); return; }
    if (typeof n.type === 'string') { parentOf.set(n, parent); if (n.type === 'CallExpr' || n.type === 'MethodCallExpr') { const k = key(n); if (!calls.has(k)) calls.set(k, n); } }
    for (const k of Object.keys(n)) if (k !== 'loc') visit(n[k], typeof n.type === 'string' ? n : parent);
  };
  visit(chunk, null);
  // token index by start offset → find each call's closing bracket
  const { tokens } = lex(src);
  const tokAt = new Map<number, number>();
  tokens.forEach((t, i) => tokAt.set(t.start, i));
  const callEnd = (c: any): number | null => {
    let i = tokAt.get(c.loc?.start);
    if (i === undefined) return null;
    if (c.type === 'MethodCallExpr') { while (i < tokens.length && !(tokens[i].type === T.Punct && tokens[i].value === '(') && tokens[i].type !== T.String && !(tokens[i].type === T.Punct && tokens[i].value === '{')) i++; }
    const t = tokens[i];
    if (!t) return null;
    if (t.type === T.String || t.type === T.InterpString) return t.end;
    const open = t.value, close = open === '(' ? ')' : open === '{' ? '}' : null;
    if (!close) return null;
    let depth = 0;
    for (let j = i; j < tokens.length; j++) {
      const x = tokens[j];
      if (x.type !== T.Punct) continue;
      if (x.value === '(' || x.value === '{' || x.value === '[') depth++;
      else if (x.value === ')' || x.value === '}' || x.value === ']') { depth--; if (depth === 0) return x.value === close ? x.end : null; }
    }
    return null;
  };
  const replaced: InlineResult['replaced'] = [], skipped: InlineResult['skipped'] = [];
  const edits: Array<{ start: number; end: number; text: string; key: string }> = [];
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(values)) {
    if (!/^L\d+:\d+$/.test(k)) { skipped.push({ key: k, reason: 'not a call-site key (expected "L<line>:<col>")' }); continue; }
    const c = calls.get(k);
    if (!c) { skipped.push({ key: k, reason: 'no call starts at this position — is this the same source the Python port was generated from?' }); continue; }
    const calleeText = (() => { try { return print((c.type === 'CallExpr' ? c.callee : c.obj) as any).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 60) + (c.type === 'MethodCallExpr' ? ':' + c.method : ''); } catch { return '?'; } })();
    if (opts.callee && calleeText !== opts.callee && !calleeText.endsWith('.' + opts.callee)) { skipped.push({ key: k, reason: `callee ${calleeText} ≠ ${opts.callee}` }); continue; }
    const r = jsonToLua(v, { tables: opts.tables });
    if (r.why) { skipped.push({ key: k, reason: r.why }); continue; }
    let lit = r.lua!;
    if (lit.length > maxLen) { skipped.push({ key: k, reason: `literal too long (${lit.length} > ${maxLen} chars)` }); continue; }
    const p = parentOf.get(c);
    const prefix = p && (((p.type === 'MemberExpr' || p.type === 'IndexExpr' || p.type === 'MethodCallExpr') && p.obj === c) || (p.type === 'CallExpr' && p.callee === c));
    if (prefix && !lit.startsWith('(')) lit = `(${lit})`;
    const start = exprStart(c), end = callEnd(c);
    if (end === null || end <= start) { skipped.push({ key: k, reason: 'could not delimit the call in the source' }); continue; }
    edits.push({ start, end, text: lit, key: k });
    replaced.push({ key: k, line: c.loc?.line ?? 0, callee: calleeText, literal: lit.length > 80 ? lit.slice(0, 79) + '…' : lit });

  let code = src;

  return { code, replaced, skipped };
}
export type { A };

  const src = clean(readFileSync('apps/web/public/samples/' + name, 'utf8'), { rename: 'obfuscated' }).code;
  writeFileSync('/tmp/pyx/clean_' + name, src);
  const c = constants(src, { section: 'decoders', max: 6 } as any) as any;
  const decs = (c.decoders ?? []).filter((d: any) => d.literalArgCalls > 0).sort((a: any, b: any) => b.literalArgCalls - a.literalArgCalls);
  const d = decs[0];
  if (!d) { console.log(`== ${name}: no decoder with literal-arg calls`); continue; }
  const r = functionToPython(src, d.line)!;
  const py = `/tmp/pyx/loop_${name}.py`, js = `/tmp/pyx/loop_${name}.json`;
  writeFileSync(py, r.code);
  let ok = true;
  try { execFileSync('python3', [py, js], { timeout: 120000, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }); } catch (e: any) { ok = false; console.log(`== ${name}: python failed: ${String(e.stderr ?? e.message).split('\n').slice(-4).join(' | ')}`); }
  if (!ok || !existsSync(js)) continue;
  const values = JSON.parse(readFileSync(js, 'utf8'));
  const inl = inlineValues(src, values);
  const pe = parse(inl.code).errors.length;
  const errs = Object.values(values).filter((v: any) => v && typeof v === 'object' && '$error' in v).length;
  console.log(`== ${name}: decoder ${r.name} L${d.line} (${d.kind}, ${d.literalArgCalls} literal calls) → ${Object.keys(values).length} site values (${errs} errors) → replaced ${inl.replaced.length}, skipped ${inl.skipped.length}, parse errors after: ${pe}`);
  for (const x of inl.replaced.slice(0, 4)) console.log(`   ${x.key} ${x.callee} → ${x.literal.slice(0, 70)}`);
  const reasons = new Map<string, number>(); for (const s of inl.skipped) reasons.set(s.reason.slice(0, 60), (reasons.get(s.reason.slice(0, 60)) ?? 0) + 1);
  for (const [k, v] of reasons) console.log(`   skipped ×${v}: ${k}`);

}

const CHUNK_EXAMPLE = `-- paste the JSON printed by the Python port of the deserializer (python3 file.py out.json), any JSON, or a Lua table
{ {{3,0,1},{7,0,2},{12,0,1,1}}, { { {{3,1,2}}, {}, {"x"} } }, {"print","hello"} }`;

type ChunkOut = { text: string; layout: any; protos: Array<{ id: string; depth: number; instructions: number; children: number; consts: number }>; totalInstructions: number; histogram: Array<{ op: string; name: string; count: number }>; unknown: string[]; strings: Array<{ value: string; count: number; first: string }>; notes: string[]; rootPath: string[] };

function ChunkView({ seed }: { seed: any }) {
  const { text, backend, toast, name } = usePrism();
  const [chunk, setChunk] = useState(CHUNK_EXAMPLE);
  const [mapTxt, setMapTxt] = useLocal('chunk:opmap', '{}');
  const [o, setO] = useLocal('chunk:opts', { opField: '', fields: '', bits: '', select: '', proto: '', max: 4000 });
  const [out, setOut] = useState<ChunkOut | null>(null);
  const [view, setView] = useState<'listing' | 'strings' | 'protos'>('listing');
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [wsList, setWsList] = useState<string[]>([]);
