  useEffect(() => { if (backend) api.opmaps().then(setWsList).catch(() => {}); }, [backend]);
  const fromScript = async () => {
    setBusy(true); setErr(null);
    try {
      const { result } = await engine.op('opcodes', text, { maxTrees: 8 });
      const trees = result.report.trees as Array<{ kind: string; score: number; roles: any; handlers: unknown[]; var: string }>;
      const i = trees.map((t, k) => ({ t, k })).filter(x => x.t.kind === 'vm').sort((a, b) => b.t.score - a.t.score)[0]?.k ?? (trees.length ? 0 : -1);
      if (i < 0) throw new Error('no dispatch tree in the current script');
      const t = trees[i];
      setMapTxt(JSON.stringify(result.opmaps[i], null, 2));
      setO(p => ({ ...p, opField: t.roles?.opField ?? p.opField, fields: t.roles?.fields ? Object.entries(t.roles.fields).map(([k, v]) => `${k}:${v}`).join(' ') : p.fields }));
      toast(`opcode map from tree on ${t.var}: ${t.handlers.length} handlers`, 'ok');
    } catch (e: any) { setErr(e.message); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  const run = async () => {
    setErr(null); setBusy(true);
    try {
      const body = chunk.replace(/^\\s*--.*$/gm, '').trim();
      const opmap = mapTxt.trim() ? JSON.parse(mapTxt) : {};
      const fields: Record<string, string> = {}; for (const p of o.fields.split(/[,\\s]+/).filter(Boolean)) { const [k, v] = p.split(/[:=]/); if (k && v) fields[k] = v; }
      const { result } = await engine.op<ChunkOut>('chunkdisasm', '', { chunk: body, opmap, options: { opField: o.opField || undefined, fields: Object.keys(fields).length ? fields : undefined, bits: o.bits || undefined, select: o.select || undefined, proto: o.proto || undefined, max: o.max || 4000 } });
      setOut(result); setView('listing');
    } catch (e: any) { setErr(e.message); setOut(null); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  const stringsText = out ? out.strings.map(s => `${String(s.count).padStart(6)}×  ${JSON.stringify(s.value)}   (${s.first})`).join('\\n') : '';
  const protosText = out ? out.protos.map(p => `${'  '.repeat(p.depth)}${p.id}  ${p.instructions} insns${p.children ? ` · ${p.children} children` : ''}${p.consts ? ` · ${p.consts} consts` : ''}`).join('\\n') : '';
  const shown = view === 'listing' ? out?.text ?? '' : view === 'strings' ? stringsText : protosText;
  return (
    <div className="split" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: 'minmax(300px, 38%) 1fr' }}>
      <Busy on={busy} label="Disassembling chunk" />
      <div className="scroll" style={{ padding: 10 }}>
        <div className="row"><span className="sec-title" style={{ margin: 0 }}>decoded chunk</span><span className="spacer" />
          <button className="btn ghost sm" onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()}>Open JSON</button>
          <input ref={fileRef} type="file" accept=".json,.txt,.lua" style={{ display: 'none' }} onChange={async e => { const f = e.target.files?.[0]; if (f) { setChunk(await f.text()); toast(`${f.name} loaded`, 'ok'); } e.target.value = ''; }} />
        </div>
        <textarea className="inp" rows={9} value={chunk.length > 400000 ? chunk.slice(0, 400000) : chunk} onChange={e => setChunk(e.target.value)} spellCheck={false} readOnly={chunk.length > 400000} />
        {chunk.length > 400000 && <div className="small muted">{(chunk.length / 1e6).toFixed(1)} MB loaded (preview truncated, read-only) <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => setChunk(CHUNK_EXAMPLE)}>clear</span></div>}
        <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
          <span className="sec-title" style={{ margin: 0 }}>opcode map</span><span className="spacer" />
          <span className="copy-btn" onClick={fromScript} title="guess the map + operand roles from the interpreter of the script on the left">Map from script</span>
          {wsList.length > 0 && <select className="inp" value="" onChange={async e => { if (e.target.value) { const m = await api.getOpmap(e.target.value) as any; const meta = m.$meta; delete m.$meta; setMapTxt(JSON.stringify(m, null, 2)); if (meta?.roles) setO(p => ({ ...p, opField: meta.roles.opField ?? p.opField, fields: meta.roles.fields ? Object.entries(meta.roles.fields).map(([k, v]) => `${k}:${v}`).join(' ') : p.fields })); } }}><option value="">from workspace…</option>{wsList.map(n => <option key={n}>{n}</option>)}</select>}
        </div>
        <textarea className="inp" rows={6} value={mapTxt} onChange={e => setMapTxt(e.target.value)} spellCheck={false} />
        <div className="row" style={{ marginTop: 8, flexWrap: 'wrap' }}>
          <Field label="op field" hint='opcode key; lists use Lua keys ("1" = first element). auto = from roles / map / data'><input value={o.opField} onChange={e => setO({ ...o, opField: e.target.value })} style={{ width: 60 }} placeholder="auto" /></Field>
          <Field label="fields" hint='operand keys → letters, e.g. "2:A 3:B 4:C"'><input value={o.fields} onChange={e => setO({ ...o, fields: e.target.value })} style={{ width: 100 }} placeholder="auto" /></Field>
          <Field label="bits" hint='packed words: "op:0:8 A:8:8 B:16:8 C:24:8", or luau / lua51'><input value={o.bits} onChange={e => setO({ ...o, bits: e.target.value })} style={{ width: 90 }} placeholder="luau" /></Field>
          <Field label="root" hint='key path to the root proto when auto-detection is wrong, e.g. "L10123:12" or "1.2"'><input value={o.select} onChange={e => setO({ ...o, select: e.target.value })} style={{ width: 80 }} placeholder="auto" /></Field>
          <Field label="proto" hint="only list this proto (F, F.0, F.2.1 …)"><input value={o.proto} onChange={e => setO({ ...o, proto: e.target.value })} style={{ width: 60 }} placeholder="all" /></Field>
          <Field label="max/proto"><input type="number" value={o.max} onChange={e => setO({ ...o, max: Number(e.target.value) })} style={{ width: 64 }} /></Field>
        </div>
        <button className="btn primary sm" style={{ marginTop: 10 }} onClick={run} disabled={busy}>Disassemble chunk</button>
        <div className="small muted" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>Workflow: VM Map → deserializer “→ Python” → run <span className="kbd">python3 file.py out.json</span> → open out.json here. Lists use Lua keys, so the Opcode Map roles (<span className="mono">inst[1]</span> = opcode) apply directly. Strings found anywhere in the chunk are the VM's real constants.</div>
      </div>
      <div className="col">
        <ErrorBox error={err} />
        {out ? <>
          <div className="toolbar">
            <div className="chips">
              <span className="chip hi">{out.protos.length} protos</span><span className="chip">{out.totalInstructions.toLocaleString()} insns</span>
              <span className="chip">{out.layout.kind} · op <b>[{out.layout.opField}]</b></span>
              {out.layout.protos && <span className="chip">protos <b>[{out.layout.protos}]</b></span>}
              <span className="chip">consts <b>{out.layout.consts ? `[${out.layout.consts}]` : 'inline'}</b></span>
              {out.unknown.length > 0 && <span className="chip" style={{ color: 'var(--warn)' }}>{out.unknown.length} unmapped</span>}
            </div>
            <Seg value={view} onChange={setView} options={[{ v: 'listing', label: 'listing' }, { v: 'strings', label: `strings (${out.strings.length})` }, { v: 'protos', label: 'protos' }]} />
            <span className="spacer" /><Copy text={shown} label="Copy" /><Copy text={JSON.stringify({ layout: out.layout, protos: out.protos, histogram: out.histogram, strings: out.strings }, null, 2)} label="Copy JSON" /><Download name={name.replace(/\\.(lua|luau|txt)$/i, '') + (view === 'listing' ? '.chunk.asm.txt' : view === 'strings' ? '.chunk.strings.txt' : '.chunk.protos.txt')} content={shown} />
          </div>
          {out.notes.length > 0 && <div className="small" style={{ padding: '4px 12px', color: 'var(--neon3)' }}>{out.notes.map((n, i) => <div key={i}>▸ {n}</div>)}</div>}
          <div className="fill"><Editor height="100%" language={view === 'listing' ? 'prism-asm' : 'plaintext'} theme="prism" path={'chunk-' + view} value={shown} options={RO} /></div>
        </> : !err && <Empty><div><div className="big">VM chunk explorer</div>Paste / open the decoded chunk, optionally add an opcode map (“Map from script”), then Disassemble.</div></Empty>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
"""

// Behaviour / IOC report — "what does this script do?" from static evidence only:
// API names used as identifiers, method names or (decoded) string constants, plus URLs / webhooks / asset ids.
// Works on source text and/or a list of strings (e.g. the constants of a decoded VM chunk or inlined values). Nothing is executed.
import { lex, T } from '../lexer.js';

export interface BehaviorHit { indicator: string; line?: number; where?: string; text: string; }
export interface BehaviorCategory { id: string; title: string; severity: 'info' | 'notice' | 'warn' | 'high'; count: number; indicators: string[]; hits: BehaviorHit[]; }
export interface BehaviorReport { categories: BehaviorCategory[]; urls: Array<{ url: string; kind: string; line?: number; where?: string }>; verdict: string[]; scanned: { names: number; strings: number }; }

const RULES: Array<{ id: string; title: string; severity: BehaviorCategory['severity']; names: string[] }> = [
  { id: 'network', title: 'Network access', severity: 'warn', names: ['HttpGet', 'HttpGetAsync', 'HttpPost', 'HttpPostAsync', 'http_request', 'request', 'RequestAsync', 'GetAsync', 'PostAsync', 'HttpService', 'WebSocket', 'websocket', 'syn.request', 'fluxus.request', 'http.request'] },
  { id: 'loader', title: 'Remote / dynamic code loading', severity: 'warn', names: ['loadstring', 'load', 'dofile', 'loadfile', 'getscriptbytecode', 'decompile', 'require'] },
  { id: 'filesystem', title: 'Executor file system', severity: 'warn', names: ['writefile', 'readfile', 'appendfile', 'isfile', 'isfolder', 'makefolder', 'delfile', 'delfolder', 'listfiles', 'loadfile'] },
  { id: 'clipboard', title: 'Clipboard', severity: 'notice', names: ['setclipboard', 'toclipboard', 'getclipboard', 'set_clipboard', 'Clipboard'] },
  { id: 'identity', title: 'Identity / device fingerprinting', severity: 'high', names: ['gethwid', 'get_hwid', 'GetClientId', 'RbxAnalyticsService', 'HWID', 'hwid', 'identifyexecutor', 'getexecutorname', 'GetCountryRegionForPlayerAsync', 'LocalizationService', 'MembershipType', 'AccountAge'] },
  { id: 'hooks', title: 'Hooks & metatable tampering', severity: 'warn', names: ['hookfunction', 'hookmetamethod', 'replaceclosure', 'detour_function', 'newcclosure', 'getrawmetatable', 'setrawmetatable', 'setreadonly', 'make_writeable', 'make_readonly', 'isreadonly', 'getnamecallmethod', 'setnamecallmethod', 'checkcaller', '__namecall', '__index', '__newindex'] },
  { id: 'executor', title: 'Executor environment / introspection', severity: 'notice', names: ['getgenv', 'getrenv', 'getsenv', 'getreg', 'getgc', 'getinstances', 'getnilinstances', 'getconnections', 'getcallingscript', 'getupvalue', 'getupvalues', 'setupvalue', 'getconstant', 'getconstants', 'setconstant', 'getprotos', 'getproto', 'iscclosure', 'islclosure', 'cloneref', 'gethui', 'get_hidden_gui', 'sethiddenproperty', 'gethiddenproperty', 'setsimulationradius', 'queue_on_teleport', 'queueonteleport', 'syn', 'KRNL_LOADED', 'is_sirhurt_closure', 'pebc_execute', 'Drawing', 'firesignal', 'fireclickdetector', 'firetouchinterest', 'fireproximityprompt', 'getthreadidentity', 'setthreadidentity', 'getidentity', 'setidentity'] },
  { id: 'anti', title: 'Anti-tamper / anti-debug', severity: 'notice', names: ['getinfo', 'traceback', 'sethook', 'gethook', 'getfenv', 'setfenv', 'newproxy', 'dump', 'collectgarbage', 'getlocal', 'getregistry', 'islclosure'] },
  { id: 'remote', title: 'Game remotes & input automation', severity: 'notice', names: ['FireServer', 'InvokeServer', 'RemoteEvent', 'RemoteFunction', 'UnreliableRemoteEvent', 'VirtualInputManager', 'VirtualUser', 'SendKeyEvent', 'SendMouseButtonEvent', 'mouse1click', 'mouse1press', 'keypress', 'keyrelease', 'mousemoveabs', 'mousemoverel'] },
  { id: 'moderation', title: 'Kick / teleport / server hop', severity: 'notice', names: ['Kick', 'TeleportService', 'Teleport', 'TeleportToPlaceInstance', 'TeleportAsync', 'Shutdown'] },
  { id: 'ui', title: 'UI library / interface', severity: 'info', names: ['Rayfield', 'OrionLib', 'Orion', 'Kavo', 'Fluent', 'Linoria', 'WindUI', 'Venyx', 'ScreenGui', 'CoreGui', 'StarterGui', 'SetCore'] },
  { id: 'crypto', title: 'Crypto / encoding helpers', severity: 'info', names: ['base64encode', 'base64decode', 'base64_encode', 'base64_decode', 'crypt', 'lz4compress', 'lz4decompress', 'JSONEncode', 'JSONDecode', 'GenerateGUID'] },
];
const URL_RE = /\b(?:https?|wss?):\/\/[^\s"'<>\\`]{3,}/gi;
const ASSET_RE = /\brbxassetid:\/\/\d+|\brbxasset:\/\/[^\s"']+/gi;
function urlKind(u: string): string {
  const l = u.toLowerCase();
  if (/discord(app)?\.com\/api\/webhooks|webhook/.test(l)) return 'discord-webhook';
  if (/discord\.gg\/|discord(app)?\.com\/invite/.test(l)) return 'discord-invite';
  if (/pastebin\.com|raw\.githubusercontent\.com|gist\.github|github\.com|gitlab\.com|pastefy|rentry\.co|hastebin|controlc\.com/.test(l)) return 'code-host';
  if (/ipify|ip-api\.com|ipinfo\.io|ifconfig|icanhazip|myip|geoip|ipapi/.test(l)) return 'ip-lookup';
  if (/roblox\.com|rbxcdn\.com|roproxy/.test(l)) return 'roblox';
  if (/grabify|iplogger|2no\.co|yip\.su|blasze/.test(l)) return 'ip-logger';
  return 'other';
}

export function behaviorReport(input: { src?: string; strings?: Array<{ value: string; where?: string }> }, opts: { maxHits?: number } = {}): BehaviorReport {
  const maxHits = opts.maxHits ?? 12;
  const byName = new Map<string, Array<{ id: string }>>();
  for (const r of RULES) for (const n of r.names) { const l = byName.get(n) ?? []; l.push({ id: r.id }); byName.set(n, l); }
  const cats = new Map<string, BehaviorCategory>();
  for (const r of RULES) cats.set(r.id, { id: r.id, title: r.title, severity: r.severity, count: 0, indicators: [], hits: [] });
  const urls = new Map<string, { url: string; kind: string; line?: number; where?: string }>();
  let names = 0, strings = 0;
  const lineText = (() => { const ls = input.src ? input.src.split('\n') : []; return (l: number) => (ls[l - 1] ?? '').trim().slice(0, 140); })();
  const hit = (name: string, h: Omit<BehaviorHit, 'indicator'>) => {
    for (const { id } of byName.get(name) ?? []) {
      const c = cats.get(id)!;
      c.count++;
      if (!c.indicators.includes(name)) c.indicators.push(name);
      if (c.hits.length < maxHits && !c.hits.some(x => x.indicator === name && x.line === h.line && x.where === h.where)) c.hits.push({ indicator: name, ...h });
    }
  };
  const scanString = (s: string, at: { line?: number; where?: string }) => {
    strings++;
    // exact API names used as string constants (obfuscators index by string: game["HttpGet"], or decoded constants)
    const key = s.trim();
    if (key.length <= 40 && byName.has(key)) hit(key, { ...at, text: at.line ? lineText(at.line) : JSON.stringify(s) });
    // dotted paths inside one string: "syn.request"
    for (const part of key.length <= 80 ? key.split(/[.:]/) : []) if (part !== key && byName.has(part) && part.length > 3) hit(part, { ...at, text: JSON.stringify(s.slice(0, 120)) });
    for (const m of s.matchAll(URL_RE)) { const u = m[0].replace(/[),;]+$/, ''); if (!urls.has(u)) urls.set(u, { url: u, kind: urlKind(u), ...at }); }
    for (const m of s.matchAll(ASSET_RE)) if (!urls.has(m[0])) urls.set(m[0], { url: m[0], kind: 'roblox-asset', ...at });
  };
  if (input.src) {
    const { tokens } = lex(input.src);
    for (let i = 0; i < tokens.length; i++) {
      const t = tokens[i];
      if (t.type === T.Name) {
        names++;
        if (byName.has(t.value)) {
          // skip local re-declarations' noise only for very generic names used as plain identifiers (load/request/dump/Kick…)
          const prev = tokens[i - 1], next = tokens[i + 1];
          const generic = /^(load|request|dump|require|Teleport|Kick|crypt|syn|Drawing|Orion|Fluent|hwid|HWID|Clipboard)$/.test(t.value);
          const asApi = (prev && prev.type === T.Punct && (prev.value === '.' || prev.value === ':')) || (next && next.type === T.Punct && (next.value === '(' || next.value === '.' || next.value === ':')) || (next && next.type === T.String);
          if (!generic || asApi) hit(t.value, { line: t.line, text: lineText(t.line) });
        }
      } else if (t.type === T.String && t.cooked !== undefined) scanString(t.cooked, { line: t.line });
    }
  }
  for (const s of input.strings ?? []) scanString(s.value, { where: s.where });
  // require(<asset id>) loads a remote module
  if (input.src) for (const m of input.src.matchAll(/\brequire\s*\(\s*(\d{5,})\s*\)/g)) { const u = 'require(' + m[1] + ')'; if (!urls.has(u)) urls.set(u, { url: u, kind: 'roblox-module', line: input.src.slice(0, m.index).split('\n').length }); }
  const urlList = [...urls.values()];
  // verdict
  const has = (id: string) => (cats.get(id)?.count ?? 0) > 0;
  const kinds = new Set(urlList.map(u => u.kind));
  const verdict: string[] = [];
  if (kinds.has('discord-webhook')) verdict.push('HIGH: posts to a Discord webhook — typical of loggers/stealers (check what data is sent)');
  if (kinds.has('ip-logger') || kinds.has('ip-lookup')) verdict.push('HIGH: contacts an IP lookup / IP logger service');
  if (has('identity') && (has('network') || kinds.size)) verdict.push('HIGH: reads identifying data (HWID / client id / account info) and has network access — possible data exfiltration');
  if (has('loader') && (has('network') || kinds.has('code-host'))) verdict.push('loader: downloads code (HttpGet / code host URL) and runs it with loadstring — the real payload is remote');
  if (has('filesystem')) verdict.push('writes / reads files in the executor workspace (config, keys or cached payloads)');
  if (has('hooks')) verdict.push('hooks functions or metatables (__namecall / hookfunction) — remote spy, anti-cheat bypass or tamper protection');
  if (has('clipboard')) verdict.push('touches the clipboard (key systems often copy a link)');
  if (has('remote')) verdict.push('fires game remotes / simulates input (game automation)');
  if (has('anti') && cats.get('anti')!.count >= 3) verdict.push('anti-tamper / anti-debug checks (debug.getinfo / traceback / getfenv)');
  if (!verdict.length) verdict.push(names + strings ? 'no high-risk indicator found in the visible names/strings (decode constants or the VM chunk first — obfuscated scripts hide them)' : 'nothing scanned');
  const order = { high: 0, warn: 1, notice: 2, info: 3 };
  const categories = [...cats.values()].filter(c => c.count).sort((a, b) => order[a.severity] - order[b.severity] || b.count - a.count);
  return { categories, urls: urlList.slice(0, 500), verdict, scanned: { names, strings } };
}

export function formatBehavior(r: BehaviorReport, opts: { label?: string } = {}): string {
  const out = [`BEHAVIOUR / IOC REPORT${opts.label ? ' — ' + opts.label : ''}  (static: ${r.scanned.names.toLocaleString('en-US')} identifiers, ${r.scanned.strings.toLocaleString('en-US')} strings scanned)`, '', 'VERDICT', ...r.verdict.map(v => '- ' + v)];
  if (r.urls.length) { out.push('', `URLS / ASSETS (${r.urls.length})`); for (const u of r.urls.slice(0, 80)) out.push(`  [${u.kind}] ${u.url}${u.line ? `  (L${u.line})` : u.where ? `  (${u.where})` : ''}`); }
  for (const c of r.categories) {
    out.push('', `${c.severity.toUpperCase().padEnd(6)} ${c.title} — ${c.count} hit(s): ${c.indicators.join(', ')}`);
    for (const h of c.hits) out.push(`    ${h.line ? ('L' + h.line).padEnd(7) : (h.where ?? '').padEnd(7)} ${h.indicator.padEnd(18)} ${h.text}`);
  }
  return out.join('\n');
}

helper='''
/** Every string value inside a dumped chunk / JSON document, with its key path (structural keys are skipped). */
export function collectJsonStrings(json: unknown, max = 200000): Array<{ value: string; where: string }> {
  const out: Array<{ value: string; where: string }> = [];
  const seen = new Set<unknown>();
  const walk = (v: unknown, path: string) => {
    if (out.length >= max) return;
    const u = unbytes(v as never) as unknown;
    if (typeof u === 'string') { out.push({ value: u, where: path || '$' }); return; }
    if (!u || typeof u !== 'object' || seen.has(u)) return;
    seen.add(u);
    if (Array.isArray(u)) u.forEach((x, i) => walk(x, path ? `${path}.${i + 1}` : String(i + 1)));
    else for (const [k, x] of Object.entries(u as Record<string, unknown>)) walk(x, path ? `${path}.${k}` : k);
  };
  walk(json, '');
  return out;
}
/** Strings given as a JSON array (of strings or {value}), a JSON object (values), or newline-separated text. */
export function parseStringList(raw: string): Array<{ value: string; where?: string }> {
  const t = raw.trim();
  if (t.startsWith('[') || t.startsWith('{')) {
    try { return collectJsonStrings(JSON.parse(t)); } catch { /* fall through to lines */ }
  }
  return t.split(/\\r?\\n/).filter(Boolean).map((value, i) => ({ value, where: `#${i + 1}` }));
}

Nothing is executed.',

## 826. ИИ · шаг

Создаю панель «Поведение / IOC» для веб-интерфейса
bash
cd /data/prism && cat > apps/web/src/components/Behavior.tsx <<'EOF'
// Behaviour / IOC panel — "what does this script do?" from static evidence (identifiers, methods, decoded strings, URLs).
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import type { BehaviorReport } from '@prism/core';
import { Copy, Download, ErrorBox, LineLink } from './ui.js';
import { usePrism } from '../ctx.js';
import { engine } from '../engineClient.js';

type Res = { report: BehaviorReport; text: string };
const SEV: Record<string, string> = { high: 'bad', warn: 'warn', notice: 'ok', info: '' };
const URLSEV: Record<string, string> = { 'discord-webhook': 'bad', 'ip-lookup': 'bad', 'code-host': 'warn', 'paste': 'warn', 'telegram': 'bad' };

/** Runs behaviorReport in the worker on the current analysis text and/or a decoded chunk / string list. */
export function BehaviorPanel({ chunk, strings, noSource, label, compact }: { chunk?: string; strings?: Array<{ value: string; where?: string }>; noSource?: boolean; label?: string; compact?: boolean }) {
  const { text, reveal, name, toast } = usePrism();
  const [res, setRes] = useState<Res | null>(null);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [extra, setExtra] = useState('');
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const fileRef = React.useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const run = async (more = extra) => {
    setBusy(true); setErr(null);
    try {
      const mine = more.trim();
      let extraChunk: string | undefined; let extraStrings: Array<{ value: string; where?: string }> | undefined;
      if (mine) { if (/^[[{]/.test(mine)) extraChunk = mine; else extraStrings = mine.split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean).map((value, i) => ({ value, where: '#' + (i + 1) })); }
      if (chunk && extraChunk) extraChunk = `[${chunk},${extraChunk}]`;
      const { result } = await engine.op<Res>('behavior', noSource ? '' : text, { chunk: extraChunk ?? chunk, strings: [...(strings ?? []), ...(extraStrings ?? [])], noSource, label: label ?? name, maxHits: 30 });
      setRes(result);
    } catch (e: any) { setErr(e.message); } finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  useEffect(() => { run(); /* eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps */ }, [text, chunk, strings, noSource]);
  const r = res?.report;
  const urls = r?.urls ?? [];
  const cats = (r?.categories ?? []).filter(c => c.count > 0);
  return (
    <div className="beh">
      <ErrorBox error={err} />
      {busy && !r && <div className="small muted">scanning…</div>}
      {r && <>
        <div className="row" style={{ gap: 6, flexWrap: 'wrap', marginBottom: 6 }}>
          <span className="small muted">{r.scanned.names.toLocaleString()} identifiers · {r.scanned.strings.toLocaleString()} strings scanned{busy ? ' · updating…' : ''}</span>
          <span className="spacer" />
          {urls.length > 0 && <Copy text={urls.map(u => u.url).join('\n')} label={`Copy URLs (${urls.length})`} />}
          <Copy text={res!.text} label="Copy report" />
          <Download name={(name || 'script').replace(/\.(lua|luau|txt)$/i, '') + '.iocs.txt'} content={res!.text} />
          <Copy text={JSON.stringify(r, null, 2)} label="JSON" />
        </div>
        <div className="beh-verdict">{r.verdict.map((v, i) => <div key={i} className={/^HIGH/.test(v) ? 'v-high' : ''}>▸ {v}</div>)}</div>
        {urls.length > 0 && (
          <div className="scroll" style={{ maxHeight: compact ? 180 : 320, marginTop: 8 }}>
            <table className="data"><thead><tr><th>kind</th><th>url / asset</th><th>where</th><th /></tr></thead>
              <tbody>{urls.slice(0, 300).map((u, i) => (
                <tr key={i}><td><span className={'pill ' + (URLSEV[u.kind] ?? '')}>{u.kind}</span></td><td className="wrap">{u.url}</td>
                  <td>{u.line ? <LineLink line={u.line} onClick={l => reveal(l)} /> : <span className="muted">{u.where ?? ''}</span>}</td>
                  <td><Copy text={u.url} label="Copy" /></td></tr>))}</tbody></table>
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="beh-cats">
          {cats.length ? cats.map(c => (
            <div key={c.id} className={'beh-cat' + (open === c.id ? ' open' : '')}>
              <div className="beh-cat-h" onClick={() => setOpen(open === c.id ? null : c.id)}>
                <span className={'pill ' + SEV[c.severity]}>{c.severity}</span><b>{c.title}</b><span className="chip">{c.count}</span>
                <span className="chips" style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>{c.indicators.slice(0, compact ? 6 : 14).map(n => <span key={n} className="chip role">{n}</span>)}{c.indicators.length > (compact ? 6 : 14) ? <span className="muted small">+{c.indicators.length - (compact ? 6 : 14)}</span> : null}</span>
                <span className="muted small">{open === c.id ? '▾' : '▸'}</span>
              </div>
              {open === c.id && <div className="beh-hits">{c.hits.map((h, i) => (
                <div key={i} className="small mono">{h.line ? <LineLink line={h.line} onClick={l => reveal(l)} /> : <span className="muted">{h.where ?? '—'}</span>} <b>{h.indicator}</b> <span className="muted">{h.text}</span></div>))}
                <Copy text={c.hits.map(h => `${h.line ? 'L' + h.line : h.where ?? ''}\t${h.indicator}\t${h.text}`).join('\n')} label="Copy hits" />
              </div>}
            </div>)) : <div className="small muted">no behaviour indicators — if strings are still encrypted, decode them first (Constants → Python → Results → Lua) and rescan.</div>}
        </div>
      </>}
      <details className="beh-more" style={{ marginTop: 8 }}>
        <summary className="small muted">add decoded strings / JSON (Python out.json, chunk dump, one string per line)</summary>
        <textarea className="inp" rows={4} value={extra} onChange={e => setExtra(e.target.value)} spellCheck={false} placeholder='["https://…", "writefile"]  or  {"L12:5": "decoded"}  or  one string per line' />
        <div className="row" style={{ gap: 6, marginTop: 4 }}>
          <button className="btn primary sm" onClick={() => run()} disabled={busy}>Rescan</button>
          <button className="btn ghost sm" onClick={() => fileRef.current?.click()}>Open JSON</button>
          <input ref={fileRef} type="file" accept=".json,.txt,.lua" style={{ display: 'none' }} onChange={async e => { const f = e.target.files?.[0]; if (f) { const t = await f.text(); setExtra(t); toast(`${f.name} loaded`, 'ok'); run(t); } e.target.value = ''; }} />
          {extra && <span className="copy-btn" onClick={() => { setExtra(''); run(''); }}>clear</span>}
        </div>
      </details>
    </div>
  );
}
EOF

.beh-verdict .v-high { color: var(--bad); text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255,92,138,0.35); }

## 859. ИИ · шаг

Выношу сбор зависимостей в общую функцию
bash
cd /data/prism && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='packages/core/src/transpile/python.ts'
s=open(p).read()
start_old="""export function functionToPython(src: string, query: string | number, opts: PyOptions = {}): PyFunctionResult | null {
  const { chunk } = parse(src);
  const em = new PyEmitter(chunk);
  em.used.add('_rest'); em.used.add('_drop');
  // index every function expression with its declaring statement / binding
  interface FnSite { f: A.FunctionExpr; line: number; endLine: number; name: string; binding?: Binding; stat?: A.Stat; }
  const sites: FnSite[] = [];"""
assert start_old in s
start_new="""interface FnSite { f: A.FunctionExpr; line: number; endLine: number; name: string; binding?: Binding; stat?: A.Stat; }
/** The static dependency closure of one function: helper functions, upvalues with static initializers,
 *  globals assigned once, table populators and the call sites with statically known arguments.
 *  Shared by the Python port (functionToPython) and the exact Lua slice (functionToLua). */
interface SliceClosure {
  chunk: A.Chunk; em: PyEmitter; site: FnSite; sites: FnSite[]; fnSites: FnSite[];
  values: Array<{ b: Binding; init?: A.Expr }>; gValues: Array<{ name: string; init: A.Expr; line: number }>; gFns: Array<{ name: string; site: FnSite }>;
  populate: A.Stat[]; callSites: Array<{ call: A.CallExpr; keys: string[] }>; totalSites: number; skippedSites: number; initOf: (b: Binding) => A.Expr | undefined;
}
function sliceClosure(src: string, query: string | number, opts: PyOptions): SliceClosure | null {
  const { chunk } = parse(src);
  const em = new PyEmitter(chunk);
  em.used.add('_rest'); em.used.add('_drop');
  // index every function expression with its declaring statement / binding
  const sites: FnSite[] = [];"""
s=s.replace(start_old,start_new,1)
mid_old="""  if (site.binding) em.moduleLevel.add(site.binding);
  for (const s of fnSites) if (s.binding) em.moduleLevel.add(s.binding);"""
assert mid_old in s
mid_new="""  return { chunk, em, site, sites, fnSites, values, gValues, gFns, populate, callSites, totalSites, skippedSites, initOf };
}

export function functionToPython(src: string, query: string | number, opts: PyOptions = {}): PyFunctionResult | null {
  const cl = sliceClosure(src, query, opts);
  if (!cl) return null;
  const { em, site, fnSites, values, gValues, gFns, populate, callSites, totalSites, skippedSites } = cl;
  if (site.binding) em.moduleLevel.add(site.binding);
  for (const s of fnSites) if (s.binding) em.moduleLevel.add(s.binding);"""
s=s.replace(mid_old,mid_new,1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF

## 863. ИИ · шаг

Пишу генератор автономного Lua-среза функции
bash
mkdir -p /data/prism/packages/core/src/transpile && cat > /data/prism/packages/core/src/transpile/luaslice.ts <<'EOF'
// PRISM Lua slice — the exact ORIGINAL code of one function plus everything it statically depends on
// (helper functions, upvalues with static initializers, globals assigned once, table populators),
// re-assembled as a standalone Lua/Luau program with a harness that evaluates every call site with static
// arguments and prints ONE JSON object {"L<line>:<col>": value} — the same contract as the Python port, so
// inline_values / chunk_disasm consume either. No transpilation: when the Python port struggles with an
// exotic construct, the slice still runs unchanged in the user's own Lua 5.1 / Luau. PRISM never runs it.
import type * as A from '../ast.js';
import { print } from '../printer.js';
import { renameBinding, Binding } from '../analysis/scope.js';
import { sliceClosure, PyOptions, FnSite } from './python.js';

export interface LuaSliceResult { code: string; name: string; line: number; deps: string[]; freeNames: string[]; renamed: Array<{ from: string; to: string; line: number }>; sites: number; warnings: string[] }

const LUA_COMPAT = String.raw`-- ---- compat (only fills what the host lacks: Lua 5.1 / 5.2 / 5.3+ / Luau) ----
unpack = unpack or table.unpack
loadstring = loadstring or load
if not bit32 then -- pure-arithmetic bit32 for hosts without it
  local M = 4294967296
  local function n32(x) return math.floor(x) % M end
  local function op(a, b, f) a, b = n32(a), n32(b) local r, p = 0, 1 for _ = 1, 32 do local x, y = a % 2, b % 2 if f(x, y) then r = r + p end a, b, p = (a - x) / 2, (b - y) / 2, p * 2 end return r end
  local function fold(f, init) return function(...) local r = init for i = 1, select('#', ...) do r = op(r, (select(i, ...)), f) end return r end end
  bit32 = {}
  bit32.band = fold(function(x, y) return x == 1 and y == 1 end, M - 1)
  bit32.bor = fold(function(x, y) return x == 1 or y == 1 end, 0)
  bit32.bxor = fold(function(x, y) return x ~= y end, 0)
  bit32.btest = function(...) return bit32.band(...) ~= 0 end
  bit32.bnot = function(x) return M - 1 - n32(x) end
  bit32.lshift = function(x, n) if n < 0 then return bit32.rshift(x, -n) end if n >= 32 then return 0 end return n32(n32(x) * 2 ^ n) end
  bit32.rshift = function(x, n) if n < 0 then return bit32.lshift(x, -n) end if n >= 32 then return 0 end return math.floor(n32(x) / 2 ^ n) end
  bit32.arshift = function(x, n) x = n32(x) if n <= 0 then return bit32.lshift(x, -n) end if n >= 32 then return x >= 2 ^ 31 and M - 1 or 0 end local r = math.floor(x / 2 ^ n) if x >= 2 ^ 31 then r = r + (M - 2 ^ (32 - n)) end return r end
  bit32.lrotate = function(x, n) n = n % 32 return n32(bit32.lshift(x, n) + bit32.rshift(x, 32 - n)) end
  bit32.rrotate = function(x, n) return bit32.lrotate(x, (-n) % 32) end
  bit32.extract = function(x, f, w) w = w or 1 return bit32.band(bit32.rshift(x, f), 2 ^ w - 1) end
  bit32.replace = function(x, v, f, w) w = w or 1 local m = 2 ^ w - 1 return bit32.bor(bit32.band(x, bit32.bnot(bit32.lshift(m, f))), bit32.lshift(bit32.band(v, m), f)) end
  bit32.countlz = function(x) x = n32(x) local c = 0 for i = 31, 0, -1 do if x >= 2 ^ i then return c end c = c + 1 end return 32 end
  bit32.countrz = function(x) x = n32(x) if x == 0 then return 32 end local c = 0 while x % 2 == 0 do x = x / 2 c = c + 1 end return c end
  bit32.byteswap = function(x) x = n32(x) local a, b, c, d = x % 256, math.floor(x / 256) % 256, math.floor(x / 65536) % 256, math.floor(x / 16777216) return ((a * 256 + b) * 256 + c) * 256 + d end
end
`;

const LUA_HARNESS = String.raw`-- ---- harness: one JSON object {"L<line>:<col>": value}; non-text strings as {"$bytes": hex} ----
local __NULL, __sites, __keys = {}, {}, {}
local function __json(v, seen)
  local t = type(v)
  if v == __NULL or t == 'nil' then return 'null' end
  if t == 'boolean' then return v and 'true' or 'false' end
  if t == 'number' then
    if v ~= v or v == math.huge or v == -math.huge then return 'null' end
    if v == math.floor(v) and v >= -2 ^ 53 and v <= 2 ^ 53 then return string.format('%.0f', v) end
    return string.format('%.17g', v)
  end
  if t == 'string' then
    if v:find('[^\9\10\13\32-\126]') then return '{"$bytes":"' .. (v:gsub('.', function(c) return string.format('%02x', c:byte()) end)) .. '"}' end
    return '"' .. (v:gsub('[%c"\\]', function(c) return ({ ['"'] = '\\"', ['\\'] = '\\\\', ['\n'] = '\\n', ['\r'] = '\\r', ['\t'] = '\\t' })[c] or string.format('\\u%04x', c:byte()) end)) .. '"'
  end
  if t == 'table' then
    seen = seen or {}
    if seen[v] then return '"<cycle>"' end
    seen[v] = true
    local n, count, parts = #v, 0, {}
    for _ in pairs(v) do count = count + 1 end
    local arr = n > 0 and count == n
    if arr then for i = 1, n do if v[i] == nil then arr = false break end end end
    if arr then for i = 1, n do parts[i] = __json(v[i], seen) end
    else for k, x in pairs(v) do parts[#parts + 1] = __json(type(k) == 'table' and '<table>' or tostring(k)) .. ':' .. __json(x, seen) end end
    seen[v] = nil
    return arr and '[' .. table.concat(parts, ',') .. ']' or '{' .. table.concat(parts, ',') .. '}'
  end
  return '"<' .. t .. '>"'
end
local function __pack(...) return { n = select('#', ...), ... } end
local function __site(keys, f) -- one failing call must not hide the others
  local r, v = __pack(pcall(f))
  if not r[1] then v = { ['$error'] = tostring(r[2]) }
  elseif r.n <= 1 then v = __NULL
  elseif r.n == 2 then v = r[2] == nil and __NULL or r[2]
  else v = { ['$multi'] = {} } for i = 2, r.n do v['$multi'][i - 1] = r[i] == nil and __NULL or r[i] end end
  for _, k in ipairs(keys) do if __sites[k] == nil then __keys[#__keys + 1] = k end __sites[k] = v end
end
`;

const LUA_OUTPUT = String.raw`local __parts = {}
for i, k in ipairs(__keys) do __parts[i] = __json(k) .. ': ' .. __json(__sites[k]) end
local __out = '{\n ' .. table.concat(__parts, ',\n ') .. '\n}'
local __path = arg and arg[1]
if __path and io and io.open then
  local f = assert(io.open(__path, 'w')) f:write(__out) f:close()
  print('saved ' .. #__keys .. ' call-site results to ' .. __path)
else
  print(__out)
end
`;

const ident = (s: string) => s.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_]+/g, '_').replace(/^(\d)/, '_$1') || 'fn';
const luaStr = (s: string) => JSON.stringify(s).replace(/\$/g, '$');

/** Extract one function (name | line inside it) + its static dependency closure as runnable Lua. */
export function functionToLua(src: string, query: string | number, opts: PyOptions = {}): LuaSliceResult | null {
  const cl = sliceClosure(src, query, opts);
  if (!cl) return null;
  const { em, site, fnSites, values, gValues, gFns, populate, callSites, totalSites, skippedSites } = cl;
  const sc = em.sc;
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  // ---- unique, global-safe names for every binding that becomes top level in the slice ----
  const tops: Binding[] = [];
  const addTop = (b?: Binding) => { if (b && !tops.includes(b)) tops.push(b); };
  fnSites.forEach(s => addTop(s.binding));
  values.forEach(v => addTop(v.b));
  tops.sort((a, b) => a.line - b.line);
  const taken = new Set<string>(); const renamed: LuaSliceResult['renamed'] = [];
  const globalsUsed = new Set(sc.globals.keys());
  for (const b of tops) {
    let n = b.name;
    if (taken.has(n) || (globalsUsed.has(n) && b.kind !== 'global')) {
      let i = 2; while (taken.has(`${b.name}_${i}`) || sc.allNames.has(`${b.name}_${i}`)) i++;
      n = `${b.name}_${i}`;
    }
    taken.add(n);
    if (n !== b.name) { renamed.push({ from: b.name, to: n, line: b.line }); renameBinding(b, n); }
  }
  const fresh = (base: string) => { let n = ident(base), i = 2; const b0 = n; while (taken.has(n) || sc.allNames.has(n)) n = `${b0}_${i++}`; taken.add(n); return n; };
  // ---- entries in source order (lexical order of the original keeps every upvalue reference valid) ----
  const entries: Array<{ line: number; ord: number; text: string }> = [];
  let ord = 0;
  const add = (line: number, text: string) => entries.push({ line, ord: ord++, text });
  const P = (n: A.Stat | A.Expr) => print(n).replace(/\n+$/, '');
  const declared = new Set<Binding>();
  const declare = (b: Binding) => { if (declared.has(b)) return; declared.add(b); add(b.line, `local ${b.name} -- L${b.line}`); };
  const fnName = new Map<FnSite, string>();
  const deps: string[] = [];
  for (const s of fnSites) {
    const st = s.stat as any;
    let text: string; let nm: string;
    if (st && st.type === 'LocalFunctionStat' && st.func === s.f) { text = P(st); nm = st.name; if (s.binding) declared.add(s.binding); }
    else if (st && st.type === 'LocalStat' && st.init?.[0] === s.f && st.names.length === 1) { text = `local ${st.names[0]} = ${P(s.f)}`; nm = st.names[0]; if (s.binding) declared.add(s.binding); }
    else if (st && st.type === 'FunctionStat' && st.func === s.f && st.target.type === 'NameExpr') {
      nm = st.target.name;
      if (s.binding && s.binding.kind !== 'global') declare(s.binding);
      text = P(st);
    } else {
      nm = fresh(s.name === '<anonymous>' ? 'fn_L' + s.line : s.name);
      text = `local ${nm} = ${P(s.f)}`;
      if (s !== site) warnings.push(`helper at L${s.line} has no local name — emitted as ${nm}; calls to it through other expressions are kept as in the original`);
    }
    fnName.set(s, nm);
    if (s !== site) deps.push(nm);
    const gf = gFns.find(x => x.site === s);
    add(s.line, `-- L${s.line}${s === site ? '  ◀ TARGET' : ''}${gf ? ' (global function)' : ''}\n${text}`);
  }
  const freeNames: string[] = [];
  for (const { b, init } of values) {
    if (init && b.init) add(b.line, `local ${b.name} = ${P(init)} -- L${b.line}${b.writes ? ` (initial value; reassigned ${b.writes}x)` : ''}`);
    else if (init) { declare(b); add(init.loc?.line ?? b.line, `${b.name} = ${P(init)} -- L${init.loc?.line ?? b.line} (assigned once after its declaration)`); }
    else { freeNames.push(b.name); add(b.line, `local ${b.name} = nil -- TODO: upvalue \`${b.name}\` (L${b.line}, written ${b.writes}x) — set it before the calls`); declared.add(b); }
  }
  for (const g of gValues) add(g.line, `${g.name} = ${P(g.init)} -- L${g.line} global, assigned once`);
  for (const st of populate) add(st.loc?.line ?? 0, `-- L${st.loc?.line ?? '?'}: fills a table used above\n${P(st)}`);
  entries.sort((a, b) => a.line - b.line || a.ord - b.ord);
  const target = fnName.get(site) ?? 'target';
  const out: string[] = [];
  out.push(`-- PRISM Lua slice: ${target} (L${site.line})${deps.length ? ` + ${deps.length} helper(s)` : ''}${values.length ? ` + ${values.length} upvalue(s)` : ''} — the ORIGINAL code, extracted statically.`,
    `-- Run it yourself (PRISM never executes scripts):  lua5.1 slice.lua out.json   |   luau slice.lua > out.json`,
    `-- then: inline_values {values_path:"out.json"} puts every decoded value back into the script (or open it in Python → Results → Lua).`);
  if (renamed.length) out.push(`-- renamed to avoid clashes in one scope: ${renamed.map(r => `${r.from}→${r.to} (L${r.line})`).join(', ')}`);
  if (freeNames.length) out.push(`-- free upvalues without a static value: ${freeNames.join(', ')} (calls that need them report $error)`);
  out.push('');
  if (opts.prelude !== false) out.push(LUA_COMPAT);
  out.push('-- ---- slice (source order) ----');
  for (const e of entries) out.push(e.text, '');
  if (callSites.length) {
    const nSites = callSites.reduce((n, c) => n + c.keys.length, 0);
    out.push(LUA_HARNESS, `-- ${nSites} of ${totalSites} call site(s) of ${target} have statically known arguments (${callSites.length} distinct argument lists${skippedSites ? `, ${skippedSites} more skipped — raise max_calls` : ''})`);
    for (const c of callSites) out.push(`__site({${c.keys.map(luaStr).join(', ')}}, function() return ${target}(${c.call.args.map(a => P(a)).join(', ')}) end)`);
    out.push('', LUA_OUTPUT);
  } else out.push(`-- no call site with static arguments found — call it yourself, e.g. print(${target}(...))`);
  return { code: out.join('\n'), name: target, line: site.line, deps, freeNames, renamed, sites: callSites.reduce((n, c) => n + c.keys.length, 0), warnings };
}
EOF

import { clean, constants, functionToLua } from '../packages/core/src/index.ts';
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
const args = process.argv.slice(2);
const DEC = 'local function dec(s) local o = {} for i = 1, #s do o[i] = string.char(string.byte(s, i) - 1) end return table.concat(o) end\nprint(dec("Ifmmp"), dec("xpsme"))\nlocal t = { dec("bc"), dec("Ifmmp") }\nreturn t\n';
const jobs: Array<{ name: string; src: string; q: string | number }> = [{ name: 'dec', src: DEC, q: 'dec' }];
for (const name of args) {
  const src = name.startsWith('/') ? readFileSync(name, 'utf8') : clean(readFileSync('apps/web/public/samples/' + name, 'utf8'), { rename: 'obfuscated' }).code;
  const c = constants(src, { section: 'decoders', max: 6 } as any) as any;
  const d = (c.decoders ?? []).filter((d: any) => d.literalArgCalls > 0).sort((a: any, b: any) => b.literalArgCalls - a.literalArgCalls)[0];
  if (d) jobs.push({ name: name.replace(/.*\//, ''), src, q: d.line });
}
for (const j of jobs) {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const r = functionToLua(j.src, j.q, { maxCalls: 1000 });
  if (!r) { console.log(`== ${j.name}: no function`); continue; }
  const f = `/tmp/pyx/slice_${j.name}.lua`;
  writeFileSync(f, r.code);
  let syn = 'ok';
  try { execFileSync('tools/luau/luau-compile', ['--text', f], { stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'], timeout: 60000, maxBuffer: 1 << 28 }); } catch (e: any) { syn = String(e.stdout ?? '').split('\n').filter((l: string) => /error|Error/.test(l)).slice(0, 3).join(' | ') || String(e.stderr ?? e.message).slice(0, 300); }
  console.log(`== ${j.name}: ${r.name} L${r.line} deps=${r.deps.length} free=${r.freeNames.length} renamed=${r.renamed.length} sites=${r.sites} ${r.code.length}B ${Date.now() - t0}ms  luau-compile: ${syn}`);
}
EOF

## 889. ИИ · шаг

Пишу генератор единой программы для всех декодеров
bash
cat > /data/prism/packages/core/src/transpile/bundle.ts <<'EOF'
// PRISM decode bundle — every decoder of a script in ONE program that prints ONE JSON object for ALL their call sites.
// Python: each decoder port runs in its own namespace on top of one shared Lua-semantics prelude.
// Lua: each exact slice lives in its own do … end block on top of one shared compat + harness.
// The user runs it once (`python3 bundle.py out.json` / `luau bundle.lua > out.json`), inline_values consumes the result.
// PRISM generates it statically; it never runs it.
import { parse } from '../parser.js';
import { findConstants } from '../analysis/constants.js';
import { functionToPython } from './python.js';
import { PY_PRELUDE } from './pyprelude.js';
import { functionToLua, LUA_COMPAT, LUA_HARNESS, LUA_OUTPUT } from './luaslice.js';

export interface BundlePart { query: string | number; name: string; line: number; kind?: string; sites: number; deps: string[]; freeNames: string[]; error?: string }
export interface BundleResult { code: string; lang: 'python' | 'lua'; parts: BundlePart[]; sites: number; warnings: string[] }
export interface BundleOptions { lang?: 'python' | 'lua'; maxCalls?: number; maxDecoders?: number; label?: string }

/** Decoder candidates worth evaluating: functions called with literal arguments, most call sites first. */
export function pickDecoders(src: string, max = 6): Array<{ line: number; name: string; kind: string; literalArgCalls: number }> {
  const rep = findConstants(parse(src).chunk, { section: 'decoders', max: 40 } as never) as { decoders?: Array<{ line: number; name: string; kind: string; literalArgCalls: number; endLine: number }> };
  const seen = new Set<number>();
  return (rep.decoders ?? []).filter(d => d.literalArgCalls > 0 && d.endLine > 0 && !seen.has(d.line) && (seen.add(d.line), true))
    .sort((a, b) => b.literalArgCalls - a.literalArgCalls).slice(0, max)
    .map(d => ({ line: d.line, name: d.name, kind: d.kind, literalArgCalls: d.literalArgCalls }));
}

const pyStr = (s: string) => JSON.stringify(s); // a JSON string literal is a valid Python 3 str literal

export function decodeBundle(src: string, targets: Array<string | number> | 'auto', opts: BundleOptions = {}): BundleResult {
  const lang = opts.lang ?? 'python';
  const maxCalls = opts.maxCalls ?? 1000;
  const picked = targets === 'auto' ? pickDecoders(src, opts.maxDecoders ?? 6) : targets.map(q => ({ line: typeof q === 'number' ? q : NaN, name: String(q), kind: '', literalArgCalls: 0, q }));
  const parts: BundlePart[] = [];
  const warnings: string[] = [];
  const blocks: string[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (const p of picked) {
    const q: string | number = (p as { q?: string | number }).q ?? p.line;
    if (lang === 'python') {
      const r = functionToPython(src, q, { prelude: false, maxCalls });
      if (!r) { parts.push({ query: q, name: String(q), line: 0, sites: 0, deps: [], freeNames: [], error: 'no function matches' }); continue; }
      if (seen.has(r.name + '@' + r.line)) continue; seen.add(r.name + '@' + r.line);
      const sites = (r.code.match(/^\s+_site\(/gm) ?? []).reduce((n, l) => n + 1, 0);
      const keys = [...r.code.matchAll(/_site\((\[[^\]]*\])/g)].reduce((n, m) => n + (JSON.parse(m[1]) as string[]).length, 0);
      parts.push({ query: q, name: r.name, line: r.line, kind: p.kind, sites: keys || sites, deps: r.deps, freeNames: r.freeNames });
      r.warnings.forEach(w => warnings.push(`${r.name} L${r.line}: ${w}`));
      blocks.push(`    (${pyStr(`${r.name} L${r.line}`)}, ${pyStr(r.code)}),`);
    } else {
      const r = functionToLua(src, q, { prelude: false, maxCalls });
      if (!r) { parts.push({ query: q, name: String(q), line: 0, sites: 0, deps: [], freeNames: [], error: 'no function matches' }); continue; }
      if (seen.has(r.name + '@' + r.line)) continue; seen.add(r.name + '@' + r.line);
      parts.push({ query: q, name: r.name, line: r.line, kind: p.kind, sites: r.sites, deps: r.deps, freeNames: r.freeNames });
      r.warnings.forEach(w => warnings.push(`${r.name} L${r.line}: ${w}`));
      blocks.push(`do -- ==== [${parts.length}] ${r.name} (L${r.line})${p.kind ? ' · ' + p.kind : ''} — ${r.sites} call site(s) ====\n${r.body}\n${r.calls.join('\n')}\nend\n`);
    }
  }
  const ok = parts.filter(p => !p.error);
  const total = ok.reduce((n, p) => n + p.sites, 0);
  const list = ok.map((p, i) => `[${i + 1}] ${p.name} L${p.line}${p.kind ? ' ' + p.kind : ''}: ${p.sites} call site(s)`);
  let code: string;
  if (lang === 'python') {
    code = [`#!/usr/bin/env python3`,
      `# PRISM decode bundle${opts.label ? ' — ' + opts.label : ''}: ${ok.length} decoder(s), ${total} call site(s), ONE JSON object for all of them.`,
      ...list.map(l => '#   ' + l),
      `# Run:  python3 bundle.py out.json   → then inline_values {values_path:"out.json"} on the SAME script (or Python → Results → Lua).`,
      `# Generated statically by PRISM; PRISM never executes it.`, '', PY_PRELUDE, '',
      'import sys as _sys',
      '_PROGRAMS = [', ...blocks, ']', '',
      'def _run_all(out_path=None):',
      '    merged = {}',
      '    base = dict(globals())',
      '    for title, code in _PROGRAMS:',
      "        ns = dict(base)",
      "        ns['__name__'] = '__main__'",
      "        ns['lua_dump'] = lambda v, path=None, indent=1: None  # results are collected below",
      '        saved_argv, _sys.argv = _sys.argv, [title]',
      '        try:',
      "            exec(compile(code, title, 'exec'), ns)",
      "            sites = ns.get('_sites') or {}",
      '            merged.update(sites)',
      "            print('# %s: %d call-site value(s)' % (title, len(sites)), file=_sys.stderr)",
      '        except Exception as e:  # one broken decoder must not hide the others',
      "            print('# %s failed: %s: %s' % (title, type(e).__name__, e), file=_sys.stderr)",
      '        finally:',
      '            _sys.argv = saved_argv',
      '    lua_dump(merged, out_path)',
      '    if out_path:',
      "        print('saved %d call-site results to %s' % (len(merged), out_path))",
      '', '',
      "if __name__ == '__main__':",
      '    _run_all(_sys.argv[1] if len(_sys.argv) > 1 else None)', ''].join('\n');
  } else {
    code = [`-- PRISM decode bundle${opts.label ? ' — ' + opts.label : ''}: ${ok.length} decoder(s), ${total} call site(s), ONE JSON object for all of them.`,
      ...list.map(l => '--   ' + l),
      `-- Run:  lua5.1 bundle.lua out.json  |  luau bundle.lua > out.json   → then inline_values {values_path:"out.json"} on the SAME script.`,
      `-- Each decoder is the ORIGINAL code (exact slice) in its own do … end block. Generated statically; PRISM never executes it.`, '',
      LUA_COMPAT, LUA_HARNESS, ...blocks, LUA_OUTPUT].join('\n');
  }
  if (!ok.length) warnings.push('no decoder with literal-argument call sites found — pass functions explicitly (names or lines)');
  return { code, lang, parts, sites: total, warnings };
}
EOF

## 909. ИИ · шаг

Пишу README и документацию MCP
bash
cd /data/prism && cat > README.md <<'EOF'
# PRISM — статический реверс-инжиниринг обфусцированных Lua / Luau (Roblox) скриптов

**Только статический анализ.** PRISM никогда не запускает пользовательские скрипты. Всё, что «нужно выполнить»
(порт декодера на Python, Lua-срез, пакет декодеров), PRISM только *генерирует* — запускаете вы сами, где хотите.

**Универсальность.** Ни одного правила «под конкретный обфускатор»: все проходы — обобщённая семантика Lua
(свёртка констант, MBA/bit32, непрозрачные предикаты, мёртвый код, алиасы, CFF-машины состояний, деревья диспетчеризации VM,
поиск десериализатора/интерпретатора по форме кода). Образцы Hercules / IronBrew2 / Luraph / MoonSec / Prometheus / luaobf
в `apps/web/public/samples` — только тестовые данные.

Один процесс = веб-интерфейс + HTTP API + MCP-сервер (ИИ может управлять всеми 46 инструментами) + общий workspace.

---

## Быстрый старт

```bash
npm install            # зависимости (Node ≥ 20.10)
npm run fetch-luau     # (опц.) нативные luau-compile / luau-analyze / luau-ast в tools/luau
npm run build          # собрать веб-интерфейс (apps/web/dist)
npm start              # → http://127.0.0.1:7777   (UI + /api + /mcp)
```

Или одной командой: `./start.sh` (Linux/macOS) / `start.bat` (Windows). Параметры:
`--port 7777 --host 127.0.0.1 --workspace DIR --luau DIR` (или `PRISM_PORT`, `PRISM_WORKSPACE`).

Проверки: `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` (лексер/парсер на 18 образцах, round-trip, smoke всех 46 инструментов, MCP).

---

## Веб-интерфейс (фиолетовый неон, всё копируется)

Слева — исходник (Input / Cleaned), справа — вкладки. Любой результат: **Copy / Download / JSON**, номера строк кликабельны.

| Группа | Вкладка | Что делает |
|---|---|---|
| Analyze | **Overview** | семейство обфускатора с причинами, метрики, VM, алиасы, **Behaviour / IOCs** (что делает скрипт: сеть, вебхуки, загрузчики, хуки, файлы, все URL) |
| | **Deobfuscate** | очистка мусора: свёртка, MBA, предикаты, мёртвый код, алиасы, строки, переименование; diff |
| | **Call Graph** | граф вызовов (force-layout), Mermaid / DOT |
| | Strings / Tokens | все литералы и токены |
| Reverse | **VM Map** | анатомия VM: payload → десериализатор → декодеры строк → фабрика замыканий → интерпретатор → выходы → точка входа; **главные чанки** |
| | VM | диспетчеризация и CFF |
| | **Opcode Map** | деревья диспетчеризации → хендлеры → угаданные мнемоники, редактирование, экспорт, роли операндов |
| | **Disassembly** | Luau v3–v14 / Lua 5.1 байткод · кастомные VM-инструкции · **VM chunk explorer** (декодированный чанк → протоза, инструкции, константы, IOC) |
| | **Constants** | кандидаты в декодеры/ключи/строки/числа/массивы + **Decode kit** (все декодеры → одна программа) |
| | Search & Xrefs | текст/regex, AST-шаблоны, перекрёстные ссылки |
| Extract | **Python** | порт функции (+зависимости) или всего скрипта; **Lua slice (exact)**; **Results → Lua** (JSON обратно в код) |
| | **Blob Lab** | конвейер base64/base85/hex/xor/rc4/zlib/lz…, авто-подбор слоёв, восстановление XOR-ключа |
| Server | All Tools | каждый инструмент бэкенда с автоформой |
| | Workspace | сохранённые скрипты (с родословной), opmaps, outputs; адрес MCP |

---

## Главный статический цикл: «декодировать все константы, не запуская скрипт»

1. **Constants → Decode kit** (или `decode_bundle`) — все функции-декодеры, вызываемые с литералами, собираются в **одну** программу:
   - **Python**: каждый декодер портирован со всей цепочкой зависимостей поверх общего прелюда с семантикой Lua;
   - **Lua**: точные *оригинальные* срезы кода, каждый в своём `do … end`, + совместимость (bit32 на чистой арифметике для Lua 5.1/5.3).
2. Вы запускаете: `python3 bundle.py out.json` (или `luau bundle.lua > out.json`) → один JSON `{"L<строка>:<колонка>": значение}`.
3. **Python → Results → Lua** (или `inline_values`) — значения подставляются обратно в *тот же* скрипт, затем Deobfuscate сворачивает остальное.
4. **Behaviour / IOCs** на получившемся коде — URL, вебхуки, загрузчики, HWID, хуки.

Для VM: **VM Map** → десериализатор «→ Python» → вы запускаете → `out.json` → **VM chunk explorer** (раскладка определяется сама,
опкоды и роли операндов берутся из интерпретатора) → листинг всех протозов + строки + IOC.

Python-порт и Lua-срез проверены друг против друга: на тестовых Prometheus-образцах результаты совпали по всем ключам.

---

## MCP (ИИ управляет всеми инструментами)

- **HTTP** (вместе с сервером): `http://127.0.0.1:7777/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- **stdio**: `node --import tsx apps/mcp/src/server.ts --workspace ./workspace`

Claude Code: `claude mcp add prism -- node --import tsx /путь/к/prism/apps/mcp/src/server.ts`
или по HTTP: `claude mcp add --transport http prism http://127.0.0.1:7777/mcp`.

Claude Desktop (`claude_desktop_config.json`):
```json
{ "mcpServers": { "prism": { "command": "node", "args": ["--import", "tsx", "/путь/к/prism/apps/mcp/src/server.ts"], "cwd": "/путь/к/prism" } } }
```
Подробно — [docs/MCP.md](docs/MCP.md): 46 инструментов, ресурсы `prism://…`, промпты-сценарии.

---

## Безопасность

- Сервер слушает только `127.0.0.1`; защита от DNS-rebinding (чужой `Host` → 403).
- Аргументы `path` / `chunk_path` / `file` читают файлы **на машине сервера** — не открывайте порт в сеть.
- Скрипты не выполняются; генерируемые программы запускайте сами (лучше в песочнице).

## Структура

```
packages/core    — лексер, парсер (Lua 5.1 + Luau), принтер, проходы очистки, анализ (VM, opcodes, anatomy, constants,
                   behaviour), байткод Luau/Lua 5.1, кастомные VM и чанки, Blob Lab, Python-транспилятор, Lua-срезы, bundle
packages/tools   — реестр 46 инструментов (общий для UI, HTTP API и MCP), workspace, guide/prompts
apps/server      — HTTP: UI + /api + /mcp     apps/mcp — MCP stdio/HTTP     apps/web — React + Monaco UI
docs/            — MCP.md, STATIC-TECHNIQUES.md
```
EOF
cat > docs/MCP.md <<'EOF'
# PRISM MCP

Один реестр инструментов обслуживает веб-интерфейс, HTTP API (`POST /api/tools/<name>`) и MCP. Всё статическое.

## Подключение

| Транспорт | Команда / адрес |
|---|---|
| HTTP вместе с UI | `npm start` → `http://127.0.0.1:7777/mcp` |
| отдельный HTTP | `node --import tsx apps/mcp/src/server.ts --http 7778` → `http://127.0.0.1:7778/mcp` |
| stdio | `node --import tsx apps/mcp/src/server.ts [--workspace DIR] [--luau DIR]` |

Workspace общий: скрипты, opcode maps и outputs, созданные ИИ, сразу видны в UI (вкладка Workspace) и наоборот.

## Ввод / вывод

- Любой инструмент анализа принимает ровно одно из: `script_id` (workspace), `path` (файл на сервере), `source` (текст).
- По умолчанию — читаемый копируемый текст; `format:"json"` — структурированные данные.
- Длинный вывод режется по `max_chars` (60000); `save_as:"name.txt"` сохраняет полный результат в outputs.
- `save_script_as` у преобразующих инструментов сохраняет новый скрипт с родословной.

## Ресурсы

`prism://guide` · `prism://tools` (JSON-схемы) · `prism://workspace` · `prism://scripts/{id}` · `prism://outputs/{name}` ·
`prism://opmaps/{name}` · `prism://docs/static-techniques`

## Промпты-сценарии

`deobfuscate_script` · `recover_opcodes` · `extract_constants` · `port_to_python` · `unpack_vm` · `assess_behavior`

## Инструменты (46)

| Категория | Инструменты |
|---|---|
| workspace | `prism_guide`, `workspace_list`, `workspace_add_script`, `workspace_get_script`, `workspace_note`, `workspace_delete`, `workspace_read_output`, `workspace_save_output` |
| analysis | `auto_triage` (всё за один вызов), `analyze`, `fingerprint`, `call_graph` (text/json/dot/mermaid), `list_functions`, `behavior_report` (IOC), `tokenize` |
| deobfuscation | `deobfuscate`, `simplify_expression`, `rename_symbols`, `inline_values` |
| search | `get_lines`, `find_text`, `pattern_search` (AST-шаблоны `$X`, `$$$`), `xrefs`, `get_function`, `constants`, `strings` |
| vm | `vm_detect`, `vm_anatomy` (вход/выходы/главные чанки), `opcode_map`, `opmap_get`, `opmap_set`, `vm_disasm`, `chunk_disasm` |
| bytecode | `bytecode_disasm` (Luau v3–v14, Roblox op×227, Lua 5.1), `find_embedded_bytecode` |
| luau (нативные) | `luau_compile`, `luau_analyze`, `luau_ast` |
| blob | `blob_transform`, `blob_info`, `blob_auto`, `blob_xor` |
| transpile | `python_transpile`, `lua_slice`, `decode_bundle`, `lua_literal_to_json` |

## Типовой сценарий для ИИ

```
workspace_add_script {path}            → script_id
auto_triage {script_id}                → чистая копия, декодеры, VM-анатомия, opcode map, байткод, IOC
decode_bundle {script_id:<clean>}      → программа; пользователь запускает → out.json
inline_values {script_id:<clean>, values_path:"out.json", save_script_as:"x.inlined.lua"}
deobfuscate {script_id:<inlined>}      → свёртка того, что стало константой
behavior_report {script_id:<inlined>}  → что делает скрипт
vm_anatomy → python_transpile {function:<десериализатор>} → пользователь запускает → chunk_disasm {chunk_path, script_id}
```
EOF
echo ok

## 915. ИИ · шаг

Пишу каталог статических техник
bash
cd /data/prism && cat > docs/STATIC-TECHNIQUES.md <<'EOF'
# PRISM static technique catalog

> Каталог статических техник PRISM (для людей и для ИИ через ресурс `prism://docs/static-techniques`).
> Everything below is generic Lua/Luau semantics — no rule is keyed to a specific obfuscator. Nothing is executed.

## 1. Front end
- **Lexer / parser**: Lua 5.1 + Luau (types, `continue`, compound assignment, `if`-expressions, interpolated strings,
  `0b`/`_` numbers, long brackets) with error recovery; round-trip printer. Latin-1 safe (binary strings survive).
- **Scope analysis**: every binding with reads/writes/captures, used by renaming, slicing, inlining and xrefs.

## 2. Junk removal (`deobfuscate`)
| Pass | What it removes |
|---|---|
| constant folding | arithmetic, string concatenation, `#"lit"`, comparisons, `not`, `and`/`or` on constants |
| bit32 / MBA | `bit32.*` on constants; mixed boolean-arithmetic identities (`(a ~ b) + 2*(a & b)` → `a + b` …) |
| string recovery | `string.char(…)`, `("\x41"):rep`, escaped bytes, concat chains → plain literals |
| opaque predicates | branches whose condition folds to a constant; guard folding / merging |
| dead code | unreachable statements, empty blocks, unused locals, write-only assignments |
| alias / proxy inlining | `local f = string.char`, wrapper functions that only forward, constant propagation |
| control flow | `while true do … break end` loops that run once, `do` flattening, switch-loop unrolling |
| renaming | `rename: obfuscated` (only junk-looking names) or `all`, role-based names (`str_decode`, `bytecode`…) |

## 3. Finding the unpacker
- **constants / decoders**: functions ranked by evidence (byte loops, `% 256`, xor/bit ops, `string.char/byte`, `table.concat`,
  literal-argument call sites). Kinds: `string-decoder`, `constant-accessor` (pool lookup `fn(-46645)`), `deserializer`, `bit-helper`.
- **keys**: strings/numbers used next to xor / byte arithmetic.
- **blobs**: long literals with entropy / alphabet statistics → Blob Lab (`blob_auto` guesses the layer stack).

## 4. Static decoding loop (the user runs the generated program)
1. `python_transpile {function}` — the function + its dependency closure (helpers, upvalues with static initializers,
   globals assigned once, statements that fill its tables, read-only aliases) as Python with a faithful Lua prelude.
   `__main__` evaluates every call site with static arguments (identical argument lists once).
2. `lua_slice {function}` — the same closure as the ORIGINAL Lua (source order, clashing names renamed, compat shims).
3. `decode_bundle` — all decoders in one program (Python namespaces / Lua `do…end` blocks).
4. Output contract: ONE JSON object `{"L<line>:<col>": value}`; non-text strings as `{"$bytes": hex}`, failures `{"$error"}`,
   multiple returns `{"$multi": [...]}`.
5. `inline_values` replaces each call expression at that position with the literal (token-exact, parenthesised where needed),
   then `deobfuscate` folds what became constant.

## 5. VM reverse engineering
- **vm_detect**: dispatch kinds (if-chains / binary if-trees on an opcode variable, table dispatch, CFF state machines),
  trampolines, handler clusters, opcode estimate.
- **vm_anatomy** (VM Map): boot chain by code shape — payload literal → deserializer (byte reader + loops building
  instruction/constant/proto tables) → string decoders → closure factory (function returning a closure over the proto) →
  interpreter (loop + dispatch over `inst[op]`) → exits (`return` of the wrapped closure, `pcall`/error paths) → entry call;
  **main chunks** = largest functions with their roles.
- **opcode_map**: every dispatch tree → leaves (opcode ranges) → handler bodies → class (MOVE, LOADK, GETTABLE, CALL, JMP,
  EQ/LT/LE, FORPREP/FORLOOP, CLOSURE, VARARG, RETURN …) by data flow on the register array, plus operand roles
  (which `inst[k]` is A/B/C/op). Editable opmaps with `$meta` are stored in the workspace.
- **vm_disasm**: decoded instruction arrays → listing with mnemonics, `R[A] = K[B]` pseudo-code, inline constants.
- **chunk_disasm** (chunk explorer): a dumped chunk (JSON / Lua literal) → auto layout (instruction arrays as tuples,
  records, packed 32-bit words with bit presets, struct-of-arrays), nested protos, constants, op field; full listing,
  strings, histogram, IOC scan.

## 6. Real bytecode
- Luau bytecode v3–v14 (plain or Roblox `op × 227` encoding) and Lua 5.1: reference-quality listing + lifted pseudo-Lua.
- `find_embedded_bytecode` scans literals for `\27Lua` / Luau headers (raw, escaped, base64, hex).
- Native `luau-compile` shows what real handlers compile to (learn the VM by comparison).

## 7. Blob Lab
Pipelines of base64 / base85 / base32 / hex / url / Lua-escape / xor (key or rolling) / add / rotate / reverse / rc4 /
zlib / deflate / gzip / lz / substitution; `blob_auto` searches the layer stack; `blob_xor` recovers keys by known plaintext
or repeating-key analysis.

## 8. Behaviour / IOCs (`behavior_report`)
Identifiers, method names, strings (incl. decoded values and dumped chunks) → categories: network, remote loaders,
executor file system, clipboard, identity/fingerprinting, hooks & metatables, executor introspection, anti-debug,
game remotes, kick/teleport, UI, crypto. URLs classified: discord-webhook, telegram-bot, webhook, ip-lookup, ip-logger,
code-host, discord-invite, roblox, `require(<asset id>)`. Verdict lines summarise the risk.
EOF
wc -l README.md docs/*.md

## 950. ИИ

Да, универсальные инструменты готовы. Я добавил ещё несколько, и полный проект лежит в архивах ниже. Архив проверен с нуля: распаковал, `npm install`, запустил — сервер поднимается, работают все 46 инструментов, интерфейс и API.

<file source="session-file://7277e9a5-77e2-4d17-b856-28cb4a3c81ba">prism-release.7z</file>

<file source="session-file://7c0c5785-d0c1-4421-bb68-7daedfcb166d">prism-release.zip</file>

**Что добавилось:**
- **VM Map (`vm_anatomy`)** показывает, как VM запускается: где лежит payload, кто его разбирает, где декодеры строк, интерпретатор, точки входа и выхода. Плюс таблица главных чанков с их ролями.
- **VM chunk explorer (`chunk_disasm`)**: загружаете декодированный дамп VM (`out.json`), он сам находит структуру, дизассемблирует все прото и выводит строки. Номера опкодов берутся из интерпретатора скрипта.
- **Цикл декодирования констант.** PRISM генерирует программу, вы её запускаете и получаете один JSON со значениями по местам вызова. «Results → Lua» (`inline_values`) подставляет их обратно в скрипт.
- **Decode kit (`decode_bundle`)**: все декодеры скрипта собираются в одну программу на Python или Lua и дают один JSON на весь скрипт.
- **Lua slice (`lua_slice`)**: функция со всеми зависимостями в оригинальном Lua-коде, без перевода. Пригодится, если порт на Python споткнётся о редкую конструкцию. На тестовых образцах Prometheus результаты Python-порта и Lua-среза совпали по всем ключам.
- **Behaviour / IOCs (`behavior_report`)** — что делает скрипт: сеть, вебхуки Discord/Telegram, IP-логгеры, загрузка кода, файлы, хуки, HWID, анти-отладка. Показывает все найденные URL с типом. Есть в Overview, в обозревателе чанков и в `auto_triage`.
- В MCP добавлен сценарий `assess_behavior`. Написал документацию: `README.md` (на русском), `docs/MCP.md`, `docs/STATIC-TECHNIQUES.md`.

**Ничего не захардкожено.** Все приёмы опираются на общую семантику Lua: форма кода, поток данных, области видимости. Образцы Hercules, IronBrew, Luraph, MoonSec, Prometheus и luaobf служат только тестами.

**Только статика.** Сам PRISM ничего не выполняет, программы он только генерирует. Для проверки я запускал сгенерированные программы в своей песочнице, но только на тестовых образцах и синтетических тестах.

**Проверки пройдены:** проверка типов во всех 5 пакетах, парсер (18 из 18 образцов), проверка всех 46 инструментов без ошибок, MCP, браузерный прогон всех вкладок без ошибок. Отдельно проверил, что очищенный код работает так же, как оригинал (12 из 12).

**Запуск:**
```
npm install
npm run fetch-luau   # по желанию: нативные luau-compile / analyze / ast
npm start            # → http://127.0.0.1:7777
```
Интерфейс уже собран и лежит в архиве. Если npm предупредит про install-scripts у esbuild, это можно игнорировать: с чистой установки всё работало.

MCP:
- по HTTP: `http://127.0.0.1:7777/mcp`;
- через stdio: `node --import tsx apps/mcp/src/server.ts`.

Готовые конфиги для Claude Code и Desktop есть в README.

После каждого большого шага я сохранял резервную копию в `/data/backups/` и скачивал её. Проект DataSecure не трогал.

p='packages/core/src/index.ts'

old="""  const o = { foldConstants: true, recoverStrings: true, removeDeadCode: true, propagate: true, removeUnusedLocals: true, rename: 'none' as RenameMode, stripParens: true, controlFlow: true, rounds: 8, ...opts };"""
new="""  // explicit `undefined` (e.g. an omitted tool argument) must not override a default
  const given = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(opts).filter(([, v]) => v !== undefined)) as CleanOptions;
  const o = { foldConstants: true, recoverStrings: true, removeDeadCode: true, propagate: true, removeUnusedLocals: true, rename: 'none' as RenameMode, stripParens: true, controlFlow: true, rounds: 8, ...given };"""
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF

}

## 1028. ИИ · шаг

Добавляю buffer/pack/coroutine в прелюдию
bash
cd /data/prism/packages/core/src/transpile && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p='pyprelude.ts'
s=open(p).read()
anchor = "# globals table seen by the script (_G / getfenv()); unknown globals are nil\n"
assert anchor in s
add = r'''# ------------------------------------------------- string.pack / unpack --
import struct as _struct


def _pk_tokens(fmt):
    fmt = first(fmt)
    i, n, little, out = 0, len(fmt), True, []

    def num(default):
        nonlocal i
        j = i
        while i < n and fmt[i].isdigit():
            i += 1
        return int(fmt[j:i]) if i > j else default
    while i < n:
        c = fmt[i]
        i += 1
        if c in '<=':
            little = True
        elif c == '>':
            little = False
        elif c == '!':
            num(8)
        elif c == ' ':
            pass
        elif c in 'bB':
            out.append(('i', 1, c == 'b', little))
        elif c in 'hH':
            out.append(('i', 2, c == 'h', little))
        elif c in 'lj':
            out.append(('i', 8, True, little))
        elif c in 'LJT':
            out.append(('i', 8, False, little))
        elif c in 'iI':
            out.append(('i', num(4), c == 'i', little))
        elif c == 'f':
            out.append(('f', 4, None, little))
        elif c in 'dn':
            out.append(('f', 8, None, little))
        elif c == 's':
            out.append(('s', num(8), None, little))
        elif c == 'z':
            out.append(('z', 0, None, little))
        elif c == 'x':
            out.append(('x', 1, None, little))
        elif c == 'c':
            out.append(('c', num(-1), None, little))
        elif c == 'X':
            if i < n:
                i += 1
        else:
            raise LuaError("invalid format option '%s'" % c)
    return out


def _pk_int(v, size, signed, little):
    x = int(_num(v)) & ((1 << (8 * size)) - 1)
    return x.to_bytes(size, 'little' if little else 'big')


def _s_pack(fmt, *vals):
    out, k = bytearray(), 0
    for kind, size, signed, little in _pk_tokens(fmt):
        if kind == 'x':
            out += b'\0'
            continue
        v = vals[k] if k < len(vals) else None
        k += 1
        if kind == 'i':
            out += _pk_int(v, size, signed, little)
        elif kind == 'f':
            out += _struct.pack(('<' if little else '>') + ('f' if size == 4 else 'd'), float(_num(v)))
        elif kind == 's':
            b = str(v).encode('latin-1')
            out += _pk_int(len(b), size, False, little) + b
        elif kind == 'z':
            out += str(v).encode('latin-1') + b'\0'
        elif kind == 'c':
            b = str(v).encode('latin-1')
            out += b if size < 0 else (b + b'\0' * size)[:size]
    return out.decode('latin-1')


def _s_packsize(fmt):
    total = 0
    for kind, size, _s, _l in _pk_tokens(fmt):
        if kind in 'sz':
            raise LuaError('variable-length format in packsize')
        total += max(size, 0)
    return total


def _s_unpack(fmt, s, pos=1):
    data, p, res = first(s).encode('latin-1'), _int(pos) - 1, []
    if p < 0:
        p += len(data) + 1
    for kind, size, signed, little in _pk_tokens(fmt):
        if kind == 'x':
            p += 1
            continue
        if kind == 'z':
            e = data.index(b'\0', p)
            res.append(data[p:e].decode('latin-1'))
            p = e + 1
            continue
        if kind == 's':
            ln = int.from_bytes(data[p:p + size], 'little' if little else 'big')
            p += size
            if p + ln > len(data):
                raise LuaError('data string too short')
            res.append(data[p:p + ln].decode('latin-1'))
            p += ln
            continue
        if kind == 'c':
            size = len(data) - p if size < 0 else size
        if p + size > len(data):
            raise LuaError('data string too short')
        chunk = data[p:p + size]
        p += size
        if kind == 'i':
            v = int.from_bytes(chunk, 'little' if little else 'big', signed=signed)
            res.append(float(v) if abs(v) > 9007199254740992 else v)
        elif kind == 'f':
            res.append(_struct.unpack(('<' if little else '>') + ('f' if size == 4 else 'd'), chunk)[0])
        else:
            res.append(chunk.decode('latin-1'))
    res.append(p + 1)
    return Multi(tuple(res))


string.h['pack'] = _s_pack
string.h['unpack'] = _s_unpack
string.h['packsize'] = _s_packsize


# --------------------------------------------------------- buffer (Luau) --
class LuaBuffer:
    __slots__ = ('b',)

    def __init__(self, n=0, data=None):
        self.b = bytearray(data) if data is not None else bytearray(int(_num(n)))

    def __repr__(self):
        return 'buffer: 0x%08x' % (id(self) & 0xffffffff)


def _bof(b, off, n):
    if not isinstance(b, LuaBuffer):
        raise LuaError('invalid argument #1 (buffer expected, got %s)' % lua_type(b))
    off = int(_num(off))
    if off < 0 or off + n > len(b.b):
        raise LuaError('buffer access out of bounds')
    return off


def _b_rd(code, n):
    return lambda b, off: _struct.unpack_from('<' + code, b.b, _bof(b, off, n))[0]


def _b_wint(code, n):
    bits = 8 * n

    def w(b, off, v):
        x = int(_num(v)) & ((1 << bits) - 1)
        if code.islower() and x >= 1 << (bits - 1):
            x -= 1 << bits
        _struct.pack_into('<' + code, b.b, _bof(b, off, n), x)
    return w


def _b_wflt(code, n):
    def w(b, off, v):
        _struct.pack_into('<' + code, b.b, _bof(b, off, n), float(_num(v)))
    return w


def _b_readstring(b, off, count):
    count = int(_num(count))
    o = _bof(b, off, count)
    return bytes(b.b[o:o + count]).decode('latin-1')


def _b_writestring(b, off, s, count=None):
    data = first(s).encode('latin-1')
    if count is not None:
        data = data[:int(_num(count))]
    o = _bof(b, off, len(data))
    b.b[o:o + len(data)] = data


def _b_copy(target, toff, source, soff=0, count=None):
    soff = int(_num(soff or 0))
    count = len(source.b) - soff if count is None else int(_num(count))
    _bof(source, soff, count)
    o = _bof(target, toff, count)
    target.b[o:o + count] = source.b[soff:soff + count]


def _b_fill(b, off, value, count=None):
    off = int(_num(off))
    count = len(b.b) - off if count is None else int(_num(count))
    o = _bof(b, off, count)
    b.b[o:o + count] = bytes([int(_num(value)) & 255]) * count


def _b_readbits(b, bitoff, bitcount):
    bitoff, bitcount = int(_num(bitoff)), int(_num(bitcount))
    v = int.from_bytes(bytes(b.b), 'little')
    return (v >> bitoff) & ((1 << bitcount) - 1)


def _b_writebits(b, bitoff, bitcount, value):
    bitoff, bitcount = int(_num(bitoff)), int(_num(bitcount))
    v = int.from_bytes(bytes(b.b), 'little')
    mask = ((1 << bitcount) - 1) << bitoff
    v = (v & ~mask) | ((int(_num(value)) << bitoff) & mask)

# ---------------------------------------------- coroutine (thread-backed) --
import threading as _th
try:
    _th.stack_size(512 * 1024 * 1024)
except Exception:
    pass


class LuaCoroutine:
    __slots__ = ('fn', 'status', 'transfer', 'resume_ev', 'yield_ev', 'thread', 'done')

    def __init__(self, fn):
        self.fn, self.status, self.transfer, self.thread, self.done = fn, 'suspended', (), None, False
        self.resume_ev, self.yield_ev = _th.Semaphore(0), _th.Semaphore(0)

    def __repr__(self):
        return 'thread: 0x%08x' % (id(self) & 0xffffffff)


_co_stack = []


def _co_start(co):
    def body():
        co.resume_ev.acquire()
        try:
            co.transfer = (True,) + tuple(spread(co.fn(*co.transfer)))
        except LuaError as e:
            co.transfer = (False, e.value)
        except Exception as e:
            co.transfer = (False, '%s: %s' % (type(e).__name__, e))
        co.done, co.status = True, 'dead'
        co.yield_ev.release()
    co.thread = _th.Thread(target=body, daemon=True)
    co.thread.start()


def _co_resume(co, *args):
    if not isinstance(co, LuaCoroutine):
        raise LuaError('bad argument #1 to resume (thread expected)')
    if co.status == 'dead':
        return Multi((False, 'cannot resume dead coroutine'))
    if co.status != 'suspended':
        return Multi((False, 'cannot resume non-suspended coroutine'))
    prev = _co_stack[-1] if _co_stack else None
    if prev is not None:
        prev.status = 'normal'
    co.status, co.transfer = 'running', args
    _co_stack.append(co)
    if co.thread is None:
        _co_start(co)
    co.resume_ev.release()
    co.yield_ev.acquire()
    _co_stack.pop()
    if prev is not None:
        prev.status = 'running'
    if co.done:
        return Multi(co.transfer)
    co.status = 'suspended'
    return Multi((True,) + tuple(co.transfer))


def _co_yield(*vals):
    co = _co_stack[-1] if _co_stack else None
    if co is None:
        raise LuaError('attempt to yield from outside a coroutine')
    co.transfer = vals
    co.yield_ev.release()
    co.resume_ev.acquire()
    return Multi(tuple(co.transfer))


def _co_wrap(fn):
    co = LuaCoroutine(fn)

    def f(*a):
        r = _co_resume(co, *a)
        if not r[0]:
            raise LuaError(r[1] if len(r) > 1 else None)
        return Multi(tuple(r[1:]))
    return f


coroutine = _lib(create=lambda fn: LuaCoroutine(fn), resume=_co_resume, yield_=None, status=lambda co: co.status,
                 wrap=_co_wrap, running=lambda: _co_stack[-1] if _co_stack else None,
                 isyieldable=lambda: bool(_co_stack), close=lambda co: True)
coroutine.h.pop('yield_', None)
coroutine.h['yield'] = _co_yield
