## 1087. ИИ · шаг

Регенерирую порт с хуком и дампом k-таблицы
bash
mkdir -p /data/work && cat > /data/work/hook3.py <<'EOF'
# Inject a stop hook at VM-closure creation (_fn129) into p3boot.py: dumps proto/upvals/env/k-table, then stops.
import re
p='/data/work/p3boot.py'
s=open(p).read()
sig="        def _fn129(arg364=None, k_85=None, arg365=None, *_rest):\n"
assert s.count(sig)==1
hook = '''            import json as _json
            _seen = {}
            _fnames = {}
            for _k, _v in G.h.items():
                _kk = _unkey(_k)
                if callable(_v) and not isinstance(_v, LuaTable): _fnames.setdefault(id(_v), str(_kk))
                if isinstance(_v, LuaTable):
                    for _k2, _v2 in _v.h.items():
                        if callable(_v2) and not isinstance(_v2, LuaTable): _fnames.setdefault(id(_v2), str(_kk) + '.' + str(_unkey(_k2)))
            def _conv(x, depth=0):
                if isinstance(x, LuaTable):
                    if id(x) in _seen: return {'$ref': _seen[id(x)]}
                    _seen[id(x)] = len(_seen) + 1
                    me = _seen[id(x)]
                    n = x.length()
                    out = {'$id': me}
                    if n: out['$arr'] = [_conv(x.h.get(i), depth+1) for i in range(1, n+1)]
                    rest = {}
                    for k, v in x.h.items():
                        kk = _unkey(k)
                        if isinstance(kk, (int, float)) and not isinstance(kk, bool) and 1 <= kk <= n and float(kk).is_integer(): continue
                        rest[str(kk) if not isinstance(kk, LuaTable) else '<table>'] = _conv(v, depth+1)
                    if rest: out['$map'] = rest
                    if x.meta is not None: out['$meta'] = _conv(x.meta, depth+1)
                    return out
                if isinstance(x, LuaBuffer): return {'$buffer': bytes(x.b).hex()}
                if isinstance(x, str):
                    return x if all(32 <= ord(c) < 127 for c in x) else {'$bytes': x.encode('latin-1','replace').hex()}
                if x is None or isinstance(x, (bool, int, float)): return x
                if callable(x): return {'$fn': _fnames.get(id(x), getattr(x, '__name__', '?'))}
                return repr(x)
            _dump = {'proto': _conv(arg364), 'upvals': _conv(k_85), 'env': _conv(arg365), 'k': _conv(arg361)}
            open('/data/work/boot3.json', 'w').write(_json.dumps(_dump))
            raise SystemExit('PRISM boot stop: VM closure creation reached, proto dumped')
'''
s=s.replace(sig, sig+hook)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('hooked')
EOF
cd /data/work && ./regen3.sh && python3 hook3.py && timeout 600 python3 run3.py 2>&1 | tail -5; ls -la boot3.json

## 1099. ИИ · шаг

Исправляю fold.ts для точной семантики bit32
bash
cd /data/prism && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='packages/core/src/passes/fold.ts'
s=open(p).read()
old=s[s.index("// Map of known bit32.* builtins"):s.index("function lit(")]
new='''// Map of known bit32.* builtins -> operation (populated from alias analysis later; here the literal names).
function bitFn(name: string): ((a: number, b: number) => number) | null {
  switch (name) {
    case 'bxor': return (a, b) => toU32(toU32(a) ^ toU32(b));
    case 'band': return (a, b) => toU32(toU32(a) & toU32(b));
    case 'bor': return (a, b) => toU32(toU32(a) | toU32(b));
    default: return null;
  }
}

/** Exact Lua 5.2 / Luau `bit32` semantics over integer literals (results are unsigned 32-bit).
 *  Returns null when the call cannot be folded safely (non-integer args, bad arity, unknown fn). */
export function evalBit32(name: string, args: number[]): number | boolean | null {
  if (!args.every(a => Number.isFinite(a) && Number.isInteger(a))) return null;
  const u = args.map(toU32);
  const shl = (x: number, d: number): number => d <= -32 || d >= 32 ? 0 : d >= 0 ? toU32(x * Math.pow(2, d)) : Math.floor(x / Math.pow(2, -d));
  switch (name) {
    case 'band': return u.reduce((x, y) => toU32(x & y), 0xFFFFFFFF);
    case 'bor': return u.reduce((x, y) => toU32(x | y), 0);
    case 'bxor': return u.reduce((x, y) => toU32(x ^ y), 0);
    case 'btest': return u.reduce((x, y) => toU32(x & y), 0xFFFFFFFF) !== 0;
    case 'bnot': return u.length >= 1 ? toU32(~u[0]) : null;
    case 'lshift': return u.length >= 2 ? shl(u[0], args[1]) : null;
    case 'rshift': return u.length >= 2 ? shl(u[0], -args[1]) : null;
    case 'arshift': {
      if (u.length < 2) return null;
      const d = args[1];
      if (d < 0) return shl(u[0], -d);
      const neg = u[0] >= 0x80000000;
      if (d >= 32) return neg ? 0xFFFFFFFF : 0;
      const r = Math.floor(u[0] / Math.pow(2, d));
      return neg ? toU32(r + (0xFFFFFFFF - (Math.pow(2, 32 - d) - 1))) : r;
    }
    case 'lrotate': case 'rrotate': {
      if (u.length < 2) return null;
      let d = ((name === 'lrotate' ? args[1] : -args[1]) % 32 + 32) % 32;
      if (d === 0) return u[0];
      return toU32(toU32(u[0] * Math.pow(2, d)) + Math.floor(u[0] / Math.pow(2, 32 - d)));
    }
    case 'countlz': { if (u.length < 1) return null; return u[0] === 0 ? 32 : Math.clz32(u[0]); }
    case 'countrz': { if (u.length < 1) return null; let x = u[0]; if (x === 0) return 32; let n = 0; while ((x & 1) === 0) { x >>>= 1; n++; } return n; }
    case 'extract': {
      if (u.length < 2) return null;
      const f = args[1], w = args.length >= 3 ? args[2] : 1;
      if (f < 0 || w <= 0 || f + w > 32) return null;
      return Math.floor(u[0] / Math.pow(2, f)) % Math.pow(2, w);
    }
    case 'replace': {
      if (u.length < 3) return null;
      const f = args[2], w = args.length >= 4 ? args[3] : 1;
      if (f < 0 || w <= 0 || f + w > 32) return null;
      const mask = (Math.pow(2, w) - 1) * Math.pow(2, f);
      const v = (u[1] % Math.pow(2, w)) * Math.pow(2, f);
      return toU32((u[0] - (toU32(u[0] & mask) >>> 0)) + v);
    }
    case 'byteswap': { if (u.length < 1) return null; const x = u[0]; return toU32(((x & 0xFF) << 24) | ((x >>> 8 & 0xFF) << 16) | ((x >>> 16 & 0xFF) << 8) | (x >>> 24)); }
    default: return null;
  }
}

'''
s=s.replace(old,new)
old='''        // fold bit32.op(litA, litB)
        const bc = asBitCall(e, resolve);
        if (bc) {
          const a = lit(bc.a), b = lit(bc.b);
          if (isNum(a) && isNum(b)) {

new='''        // fold bit32.op(lit, ...) — every bit32 function, exact unsigned-32 semantics
        {

          if (e.callee.type === 'MemberExpr' && e.callee.obj.type === 'NameExpr' && e.callee.obj.name === 'bit32') name = e.callee.name;
          else if (e.callee.type === 'NameExpr') name = resolve(e.callee.name);
          if (name) {

            if (vals.every(isNum)) {
              const r = evalBit32(name, vals as number[]);
              if (r !== null) { stats.folded++; return typeof r === 'boolean' ? mkBool(r, e.loc) : mkNum(r, e.loc); }
            }
          }
        }
        return e;'''

open(p,'w').write(s)

assert old in s; s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)

Создаю модуль восстановления CFF
bash
mkdir -p /data/prism/packages/core/src/passes && cat > /data/prism/packages/core/src/passes/cff.ts <<'EOF'
// CFF (control-flow flattening) recovery — universal and semantics-preserving.
//
//  * guardConstProp: inside `if V == K then BODY` (and in the branches after a failed
//    `V ~= K` test) every read of the uncaptured local V that happens before V can
//    change is replaced by K. State transitions such as `V = f(V, 72)` become
//    literal arithmetic that the fold pass evaluates.
//
//  * unflattenStateLoops: a dispatcher loop
//        V = K0
//        while true do            -- or `repeat … until false`, `while V do`, `while V ~= Kx do`
//          if V == K1 then B1 elseif V < K2 then … end   -- if-chain or binary search tree
//        end
//    whose reachable blocks all end in a constant transition (`V = K`,
//    `V = c and K1 or K2`, `if c then …; V = K1 else …; V = K2 end`), `break` or
//    `return` is rebuilt as structured code: sequences, if/else (joins found with
//    post-dominators) and `while true do … end` loops for cyclic state graphs.
//    Unreachable blocks (junk states) disappear.
import type * as A from '../ast.js';
import { walk } from '../ast.js';
import { analyzeScopes, Binding, ScopeInfo } from '../analysis/scope.js';
import { forEachStatList } from './scopepasses.js';

const unparen = (e: A.Expr): A.Expr => { while (e && e.type === 'ParenExpr') e = e.expr; return e; };

/** literal key: numbers and strings only (the values a state variable takes) */
function litKey(e: A.Expr | undefined): string | null {
  if (!e) return null;
  const u = unparen(e);
  if (u.type === 'NumberLit') return 'n:' + u.value;
  if (u.type === 'UnExpr' && u.op === '-') { const v = unparen(u.expr); if (v.type === 'NumberLit') return 'n:' + (-v.value); }
  if (u.type === 'StringLit') return 's:' + u.value;
  return null;
}
function keyExpr(k: string): A.Expr {
  if (k.startsWith('n:')) { const v = Number(k.slice(2)); return v < 0 ? { type: 'UnExpr', op: '-', expr: { type: 'NumberLit', value: -v, raw: String(-v) } } : { type: 'NumberLit', value: v, raw: String(v) }; }
  const s = k.slice(2); return { type: 'StringLit', value: s, raw: JSON.stringify(s) };
}
const clone = <T>(x: T): T => structuredClone(x);

interface Guard { b: Binding; k: string; }
function guardOn(cond: A.Expr, scope: ScopeInfo, want: '==' | '~='): Guard | null {
  let c = unparen(cond);
  let neg = false;
  if (c.type === 'UnExpr' && c.op === 'not') { c = unparen(c.expr); neg = true; }
  if (c.type !== 'BinExpr' || (c.op !== '==' && c.op !== '~=')) return null;
  const op = (c.op === '==') !== neg ? '==' : '~=';
  if (op !== want) return null;
  const l = unparen(c.left), r = unparen(c.right);
  let name: A.NameExpr | null = null, k: string | null = null;
  if (l.type === 'NameExpr') { name = l; k = litKey(r); } else if (r.type === 'NameExpr') { name = r; k = litKey(l); }
  if (!name || k === null) return null;
  const b = scope.refOf.get(name);
  if (!b || b.kind === 'global' || b.capturedWrite) return null;
  return { b, k };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- guardConstProp
export function guardConstProp(chunk: A.Chunk): number {
  const scope = analyzeScopes(chunk);
  let n = 0;
  const writeSets = new Map<Binding, Set<A.NameExpr>>();
  const wset = (b: Binding) => { let s = writeSets.get(b); if (!s) { s = new Set(b.writeRefs); writeSets.set(b, s); } return s; };
  const writes = (node: any, b: Binding): boolean => {
    const ws = wset(b); if (!ws.size) return false;
    let hit = false;
    walk(node, (m: any) => { if (!hit && m.type === 'NameExpr' && ws.has(m)) hit = true; });
    return hit;
  };
  /** replace reads of b inside an expression tree (never entering functions) */
  const substExpr = (node: any, b: Binding, k: string): void => {
    if (!node || typeof node !== 'object') return;
    const ws = wset(b);
    const isRead = (e: any) => e && e.type === 'NameExpr' && scope.refOf.get(e) === b && !ws.has(e);
    for (const key of Object.keys(node)) {
      if (key === 'loc') continue;
      const v = node[key];
      if (Array.isArray(v)) {
        for (let i = 0; i < v.length; i++) {
          if (isRead(v[i])) { v[i] = keyExpr(k); n++; } else if (v[i] && typeof v[i] === 'object' && v[i].type !== 'FunctionExpr') substExpr(v[i], b, k);
        }
      } else if (v && typeof v === 'object') {
        if (isRead(v)) { node[key] = keyExpr(k); n++; } else if (v.type !== 'FunctionExpr') substExpr(v, b, k);
      }
    }
  };
  const substTargets = (targets: A.Expr[], b: Binding, k: string) => {
    for (const t of targets) { if (t.type === 'IndexExpr') { substExpr(t, b, k); } else if (t.type === 'MemberExpr') substExpr(t, b, k); }
  };
  /** true while b is still known to equal k after the statements */
  const applyBody = (body: A.Stat[], b: Binding, k: string): boolean => {
    for (const s of body) if (!applyStat(s, b, k)) return false;
    return true;
  };
  const applyStat = (s: A.Stat, b: Binding, k: string): boolean => {
    switch (s.type) {
      case 'LocalStat': for (const e of s.init) substExpr({ e }, b, k); s.init = s.init.map(e => { const h = { e }; substExpr(h, b, k); return h.e; }); return true;
      case 'AssignStat': {
        const w = writes(s, b);
        const h = { values: s.values }; substExpr(h, b, k);
        if (!s.op) substTargets(s.targets, b, k);
        return !w;
      }
      case 'CallStat': { const h = { e: s.expr }; substExpr(h, b, k); s.expr = h.e as any; return true; }
      case 'ReturnStat': { const h = { args: s.args }; substExpr(h, b, k); return true; }
      case 'IfStat': {
        const w = writes(s, b);
        for (const c of s.clauses) { const h = { e: c.cond }; substExpr(h, b, k); c.cond = h.e; }
        for (const c of s.clauses) applyBody(c.body, b, k);
        if (s.elseBody) applyBody(s.elseBody, b, k);
        return !w;
      }
      case 'WhileStat': case 'RepeatStat': {
        if (writes(s, b)) return false;
        const h = { e: s.cond }; substExpr(h, b, k); s.cond = h.e;
        applyBody(s.body, b, k); return true;
      }
      case 'NumericForStat': {
        const h = { from: s.from, to: s.to, step: s.step }; substExpr(h, b, k); s.from = h.from; s.to = h.to; s.step = h.step;
        if (writes(s, b)) return false;
        applyBody(s.body, b, k); return true;
      }
      case 'GenericForStat': {
        const h = { iters: s.iters }; substExpr(h, b, k);
        if (writes(s, b)) return false;
        applyBody(s.body, b, k); return true;
      }
      case 'DoStat': return applyBody(s.body, b, k);
      case 'LabelStat': case 'GotoStat': return false;
      default: return !writes(s, b);
    }
  };
  walk(chunk, (node: any) => {
    if (node.type !== 'IfStat') return;
    const st = node as A.IfStat;
    let known: Guard | null = null;     // from an earlier failed `V ~= K`
    st.clauses.forEach((cl) => {
      if (known) { const h = { e: cl.cond }; substExpr(h, known.b, known.k); cl.cond = h.e; applyBody(cl.body, known.b, known.k); }
      const g = guardOn(cl.cond, scope, '==');
      if (g) applyBody(cl.body, g.b, g.k);
      if (!known) { const ne = guardOn(cl.cond, scope, '~='); if (ne) known = ne; }
    });
    if (known && st.elseBody) applyBody(st.elseBody, (known as Guard).b, (known as Guard).k);
  });
  return n;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- unflattenStateLoops
interface Constraint { lo: number; hi: number; excl: Set<number>; eqStr?: string; neStr: Set<string>; }
interface Leaf { c: Constraint; body: A.Stat[]; }
const EMPTY = (): Constraint => ({ lo: -Infinity, hi: Infinity, excl: new Set(), neStr: new Set() });
const NEG: Record<string, string> = { '<': '>=', '<=': '>', '>': '<=', '>=': '<', '==': '~=', '~=': '==' };
const FLIP: Record<string, string> = { '<': '>', '<=': '>=', '>': '<', '>=': '<=', '==': '==', '~=': '~=' };

interface Cmp { op: string; k: string; }
function cmpOn(cond: A.Expr, isV: (e: A.Expr) => boolean): Cmp | null {
  const c = unparen(cond);
  if (c.type === 'UnExpr' && c.op === 'not') { const p = cmpOn(c.expr, isV); return p ? { op: NEG[p.op], k: p.k } : null; }
  if (c.type !== 'BinExpr' || !(c.op in FLIP)) return null;
  const l = unparen(c.left), r = unparen(c.right);
  if (isV(l)) { const k = litKey(r); return k ? { op: c.op, k } : null; }
  if (isV(r)) { const k = litKey(l); return k ? { op: FLIP[c.op], k } : null; }
  return null;
}
function applyC(c: Constraint, p: Cmp): Constraint {
  const n: Constraint = { lo: c.lo, hi: c.hi, excl: new Set(c.excl), eqStr: c.eqStr, neStr: new Set(c.neStr) };
  if (p.k.startsWith('s:')) {
    const s = p.k.slice(2);
    if (p.op === '==') { n.eqStr = s; n.lo = 1; n.hi = 0; } else if (p.op === '~=') n.neStr.add(s); else { n.lo = 1; n.hi = 0; n.eqStr = undefined; n.neStr.add('\0all'); }
    return n;
  }
  const k = Number(p.k.slice(2));
  switch (p.op) {
    case '<': n.hi = Math.min(n.hi, k - 1e-9); break;
    case '<=': n.hi = Math.min(n.hi, k); break;
    case '>': n.lo = Math.max(n.lo, k + 1e-9); break;
    case '>=': n.lo = Math.max(n.lo, k); break;
    case '==': n.lo = Math.max(n.lo, k); n.hi = Math.min(n.hi, k); n.neStr.add('\0all'); break;
    case '~=': n.excl.add(k); break;
  }
  return n;
}
function admits(c: Constraint, key: string): boolean {
  if (key.startsWith('s:')) { const s = key.slice(2); if (c.neStr.has('\0all') || c.neStr.has(s)) return false; if (c.eqStr !== undefined) return c.eqStr === s; return c.lo === -Infinity && c.hi === Infinity && c.excl.size === 0 ? true : false; }
  if (c.eqStr !== undefined) return false;
  const v = Number(key.slice(2));
  return v >= c.lo && v <= c.hi && !c.excl.has(v);
}
/** flatten an if-chain / search tree over V into leaves; null if some test is not on V */
function flattenTree(ifs: A.IfStat, isV: (e: A.Expr) => boolean, c0: Constraint, out: Leaf[]): boolean {
  let c = c0;
  for (const cl of ifs.clauses) {
    const p = cmpOn(cl.cond, isV);
    if (!p) return false;
    if (!subtree(cl.body, isV, applyC(c, p), out)) return false;
    c = applyC(c, { op: NEG[p.op], k: p.k });
  }
  return subtree(ifs.elseBody ?? [], isV, c, out);
}
function subtree(body: A.Stat[], isV: (e: A.Expr) => boolean, c: Constraint, out: Leaf[]): boolean {
  if (body.length === 1 && body[0].type === 'IfStat' && cmpOn(body[0].clauses[0].cond, isV)) return flattenTree(body[0], isV, c, out);
  out.push({ c, body });
  return true;
}

/** break/continue binding to the dispatcher loop anywhere in stmts (not in nested loops/functions) */
function loopExits(stmts: A.Stat[]): boolean {
  let hit = false;
  const scan = (list: A.Stat[]) => {
    for (const s of list) {
      if (hit) return;
      if (s.type === 'BreakStat' || s.type === 'ContinueStat' || s.type === 'GotoStat' || s.type === 'LabelStat') { hit = true; return; }
      if (s.type === 'IfStat') { for (const c of s.clauses) scan(c.body); if (s.elseBody) scan(s.elseBody); }
      else if (s.type === 'DoStat') scan(s.body);
    }
  };
  scan(stmts); return hit;
}
function endsWithExit(stmts: A.Stat[]): boolean {
  const last = stmts[stmts.length - 1];
  if (!last) return false;
  if (last.type === 'ReturnStat') return true;
  if (last.type === 'DoStat') return endsWithExit(last.body);
  if (last.type === 'IfStat') return !!last.elseBody && last.clauses.every(c => endsWithExit(c.body)) && endsWithExit(last.elseBody);
  return false;
}

type Target = { kind: 'state'; k: string } | { kind: 'exit' } | { kind: 'ret' };
interface Branch { cond?: A.Expr; prefix: A.Stat[]; to: Target; }
interface Block { key: string; prefix: A.Stat[]; branches: Branch[] | null; /* null = plain goto via prefix-less single branch */ }

export interface UnflattenOptions { maxGrowth?: number; maxStates?: number; }

export function unflattenStateLoops(chunk: A.Chunk, opts: UnflattenOptions = {}): number {
  const scope = analyzeScopes(chunk);
  const maxGrowth = opts.maxGrowth ?? 2.5, maxStates = opts.maxStates ?? 4000;
  let n = 0;
  forEachStatList(chunk, (list) => {
    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      const r = tryUnflatten(list, i, scope, maxGrowth, maxStates);
      if (r) { list.splice(i, 1, ...r); n++; i += r.length - 1; }
    }
  });
  return n;
}

function countStats(stmts: A.Stat[]): number { let c = 0; walk(stmts, (m: any) => { if (m && typeof m.type === 'string' && /Stat$/.test(m.type)) c++; }); return c; }

function tryUnflatten(list: A.Stat[], i: number, scope: ScopeInfo, maxGrowth: number, maxStates: number): A.Stat[] | null {
  const loop = list[i];
  let body: A.Stat[]; let exitOn: ((k: string | 'nil') => boolean) = () => false; let vName: A.NameExpr | null = null;
  if (loop.type === 'WhileStat') {
    const c = unparen(loop.cond);
    if (c.type === 'TrueLit' || c.type === 'NumberLit' || c.type === 'StringLit') { /* forever */ }
    else if (c.type === 'NameExpr') { vName = c; exitOn = (k) => k === 'nil'; }
    else if (c.type === 'BinExpr' && c.op === '~=') {
      const l = unparen(c.left), r = unparen(c.right);
      const nm = l.type === 'NameExpr' ? l : r.type === 'NameExpr' ? r : null; const kx = litKey(nm === l ? r : l);
      if (!nm || !kx) return null; vName = nm; exitOn = (k) => k === kx;
    } else return null;
    body = loop.body;
  } else if (loop.type === 'RepeatStat') {
    const c = unparen(loop.cond);
    if (c.type !== 'FalseLit' && c.type !== 'NilLit') return null;
    body = loop.body;
  } else return null;
  if (body.length !== 1 || body[0].type !== 'IfStat') return null;
  const disp = body[0];
  // the state variable
  if (!vName) {
    const c = unparen(disp.clauses[0].cond);
    const pick = (e: A.Expr): A.NameExpr | null => { const u = unparen(e); if (u.type === 'UnExpr' && u.op === 'not') return pick(u.expr); if (u.type !== 'BinExpr') return null; const l = unparen(u.left), r = unparen(u.right); if (l.type === 'NameExpr' && litKey(r)) return l; if (r.type === 'NameExpr' && litKey(l)) return r; return null; };
    vName = pick(c);
    if (!vName) return null;
  }
  const b = scope.refOf.get(vName);
  if (!b || b.kind === 'global' || b.captured || b.capturedWrite) return null;
  const isV = (e: A.Expr) => { const u = unparen(e); return u.type === 'NameExpr' && scope.refOf.get(u) === b; };
  const leaves: Leaf[] = [];
  if (!flattenTree(disp, isV, EMPTY(), leaves)) return null;
  // entry state: the last write of V before the loop must be a literal
  let entry: string | null = null;
  const wset = new Set(b.writeRefs);
  const writesV = (node: any) => { let hit = false; walk(node, (m: any) => { if (!hit && m.type === 'NameExpr' && wset.has(m)) hit = true; }); return hit; };
  for (let j = i - 1; j >= 0 && entry === null; j--) {
    const s = list[j];
    if (s.type === 'LocalStat') {
      const idx = s.names.findIndex((_, q) => b.decl === s && b.index === q);
      if (idx >= 0) { if (s.init.length > idx && (idx < s.init.length - 1 || s.init.length === s.names.length)) entry = litKey(s.init[idx]); if (entry === null) return null; break; }
      if (writesV(s)) return null;
      continue;
    }
    if (s.type === 'AssignStat' && !s.op) {
      const idx = s.targets.findIndex(t => t.type === 'NameExpr' && wset.has(t));
      if (idx >= 0) { if (s.values.length === s.targets.length) entry = litKey(s.values[idx]); if (entry === null) return null; break; }
    }
    if (writesV(s)) return null;
  }
  if (entry === null) return null;
  // V must not be read outside the dispatcher (we drop its assignments)
  const dispReads = new Set<A.NameExpr>();
  walk(disp, (m: any) => { if (m.type === 'NameExpr' && scope.refOf.get(m) === b) dispReads.add(m); });
  const leafFor = (k: string): Leaf | null => { const ls = leaves.filter(l => admits(l.c, k)); return ls.length === 1 ? ls[0] : null; };
  // which reads are "cond reads" of the dispatch tree (not inside leaves)
  const leafReads = new Set<A.NameExpr>();
  for (const l of leaves) walk(l.body, (m: any) => { if (m.type === 'NameExpr' && scope.refOf.get(m) === b && !wset.has(m)) leafReads.add(m); });
  for (const r of b.refs) if (!wset.has(r) && !dispReads.has(r)) return null;
  // parse blocks
  const blocks = new Map<string, Block>();
  const parseTarget = (v: A.Expr): Target | null => {
    const u = unparen(v);
    if (u.type === 'NilLit' || u.type === 'FalseLit') return exitOn('nil') ? { kind: 'exit' } : null;
    const k = litKey(u); if (k === null) return null;
    if (exitOn(k)) return { kind: 'exit' };
    return { kind: 'state', k };
  };
  const isVAssign = (s: A.Stat | undefined): s is A.AssignStat => !!s && s.type === 'AssignStat' && !s.op && s.targets.length === 1 && s.values.length === 1 && isV(s.targets[0]);
  /** a branch body: prefix + transfer */
  const parseBranch = (stmts: A.Stat[], cond?: A.Expr): Branch[] | null => {
    let st = stmts;
    if (st.length && st[st.length - 1].type === 'ContinueStat') st = st.slice(0, -1);
    const last = st[st.length - 1];
    const pre = st.slice(0, -1);
    if (!last) return null;
    if (last.type === 'BreakStat') { if (loopExits(pre) || writesV(pre)) return null; return [{ cond, prefix: pre, to: { kind: 'exit' } }]; }
    if (endsWithExit(st) && !loopExits(st) && !writesV(st)) return [{ cond, prefix: st, to: { kind: 'ret' } }];
    if (loopExits(pre) || writesV(pre)) return null;
    if (isVAssign(last)) {
      const v = unparen(last.values[0]);
      // V = c and K1 or K2
      if (v.type === 'BinExpr' && v.op === 'or') {
        const l = unparen(v.left);
        if (l.type === 'BinExpr' && l.op === 'and') {
          const t1 = parseTarget(l.right), t2 = parseTarget(v.right);
          const k1 = litKey(l.right);
          if (t1 && t2 && k1 !== null) {
            if (cond) return null;    // nested conditional transfer inside a branch: keep simple
            return [{ cond: l.left, prefix: [], to: t1 }, { prefix: [], to: t2 }].map((x, q) => q === 0 ? { ...x, prefix: pre } as Branch : x as Branch).map((x, q, arr) => x) as Branch[];
          }
        }
        return null;
      }
      const t = parseTarget(v); if (!t) return null;
      return [{ cond, prefix: pre, to: t }];
    }
    if (last.type === 'IfStat' && last.elseBody) {
      // if c1 then …; V = K1 elseif … else …; V = Kn end
      if (cond) return null;
      const out: Branch[] = [];
      for (const c of last.clauses) { const br = parseBranch(c.body, c.cond); if (!br || br.length !== 1) return null; out.push(br[0]); }
      const eb = parseBranch(last.elseBody); if (!eb || eb.length !== 1) return null;
      out.push({ ...eb[0], cond: undefined });
      return [{ cond: undefined, prefix: pre, to: { kind: 'state', k: '\0split' } }, ...out];
    }
    if (last.type === 'IfStat' && !last.elseBody && last.clauses.length === 1) {
      // `V = K2; if c then V = K1 end` (default first, then override)
      const prev = pre[pre.length - 1];
      if (isVAssign(prev)) {
        const t2 = parseTarget(prev.values[0]);
        const br = parseBranch(last.clauses[0].body, last.clauses[0].cond);
        if (t2 && br && br.length === 1 && br[0].prefix.length === 0) {
          const pre2 = pre.slice(0, -1); if (loopExits(pre2) || writesV(pre2)) return null;
          return [{ cond: undefined, prefix: pre2, to: { kind: 'state', k: '\0split' } }, br[0], { prefix: [], to: t2 }];
        }
      }
    }
    return null;
  };
  const queue: string[] = [entry];
  const seen = new Set<string>([entry]);
  while (queue.length) {
    const k = queue.shift()!;
    if (seen.size > maxStates) return null;
    const lf = leafFor(k); if (!lf) return null;
    const brs = parseBranch(lf.body);
    if (!brs) return null;
    let blk: Block;
    if (brs.length > 1 && brs[0].to.kind === 'state' && brs[0].to.k === '\0split') blk = { key: k, prefix: brs[0].prefix, branches: brs.slice(1) };
    else if (brs.length === 2) { /* V = c and K1 or K2 */ blk = { key: k, prefix: brs[0].prefix, branches: [{ cond: brs[0].cond, prefix: [], to: brs[0].to }, { prefix: [], to: brs[1].to }] }; }
    else blk = { key: k, prefix: brs[0].prefix, branches: [{ prefix: [], to: brs[0].to }] };
    blocks.set(k, blk);
    for (const br of blk.branches!) if (br.to.kind === 'state' && !seen.has(br.to.k)) { seen.add(br.to.k); queue.push(br.to.k); }
  }
  // two states must not share one leaf (its body could depend on V)
  const usedLeaves = new Set<Leaf>();
  for (const k of blocks.keys()) { const lf = leafFor(k)!; if (usedLeaves.has(lf)) return null; usedLeaves.add(lf); }
  // graph: nodes = state keys + EXIT
  const EXIT = '\0exit';
  const succ = (k: string): string[] => {
    const blk = blocks.get(k)!; const out: string[] = [];
    for (const br of blk.branches!) { const t = br.to.kind === 'state' ? br.to.k : EXIT; if (br.to.kind !== 'ret' && !out.includes(t)) out.push(t); }
    return out;
  };
  const nodes = [...blocks.keys()];
  // reverse graph for post-dominators (rets have no edge to EXIT: they leave the function)
  const preds = new Map<string, string[]>(); for (const k of [...nodes, EXIT]) preds.set(k, []);
  for (const k of nodes) for (const s of succ(k)) preds.get(s)!.push(k);
  // add ret edges to EXIT for post-dominance purposes (a return ends every path too)
  const pdSucc = (k: string) => { const blk = blocks.get(k)!; const s = succ(k); if (blk.branches!.some(br => br.to.kind === 'ret') && !s.includes(EXIT)) s.push(EXIT); return s; };
  const ipdom = postDominators([...nodes, EXIT], EXIT, pdSucc);
  // loops: DFS back edges from entry
  const color = new Map<string, number>(); const backTo = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  const dfs = (k: string) => { color.set(k, 1); for (const s of succ(k)) { if (s === EXIT) continue; const c = color.get(s) ?? 0; if (c === 0) dfs(s); else if (c === 1) { if (!backTo.has(s)) backTo.set(s, new Set()); backTo.get(s)!.add(k); } } color.set(k, 2); };
  try { dfs(entry); } catch { return null; }

  const BRK: A.Stat = { type: 'BreakStat' }; const CONT: A.Stat = { type: 'ContinueStat' };

      visiting.add(k);
      entered = null;
      const blk = blocks.get(k)!;
      out.push(...take(blk.prefix));
      const brs = blk.branches!;

        const to = brs[0].to;

        k = to.k; continue;

        if (q < brs.length - 1 || br.cond) { if (!br.cond) { fail = true; return; } ifs.clauses.push({ cond: br.cond, body: bb }); }
        else ifs.elseBody = bb.length ? bb : undefined;

/** immediate post-dominators (Cooper–Harvey–Kennedy on the reverse graph) */
function postDominators(nodes: string[], exit: string, succ: (k: string) => string[]): Map<string, string> {
  const preds = new Map<string, string[]>(); for (const k of nodes) preds.set(k, []);
  for (const k of nodes) if (k !== exit) for (const s of succ(k)) preds.get(s)?.push(k);
  // reverse graph: edges s -> k for k -> s ; DFS postorder from exit
  const order: string[] = []; const seen = new Set<string>();
  const stack: Array<[string, number]> = [[exit, 0]]; seen.add(exit);
  while (stack.length) {
    const top = stack[stack.length - 1]; const ps = preds.get(top[0]) ?? [];
    if (top[1] < ps.length) { const p = ps[top[1]++]; if (!seen.has(p)) { seen.add(p); stack.push([p, 0]); } }
    else { order.push(top[0]); stack.pop(); }
  }
  const po = new Map<string, number>(); order.forEach((k, i) => po.set(k, i));
  const rpo = [...order].reverse();
  const idom = new Map<string, string>(); idom.set(exit, exit);
  const intersect = (a: string, b: string): string => {
    while (a !== b) {
      while (po.get(a)! < po.get(b)!) a = idom.get(a)!;
      while (po.get(b)! < po.get(a)!) b = idom.get(b)!;
    }
    return a;
  };
  let changed = true; let guard = 0;
  while (changed && guard++ < 1000) {
    changed = false;
    for (const k of rpo) {
      if (k === exit) continue;
      // "predecessors" in the reverse graph = successors in the original
      const ss = succ(k).filter(s => idom.has(s) && po.has(s));
      if (!ss.length) continue;
      let nd = ss[0];
      for (const s of ss.slice(1)) nd = intersect(s, nd);
      if (idom.get(k) !== nd) { idom.set(k, nd); changed = true; }
    }
  }
  idom.delete(exit);
  return idom;
}

  local out = {}
  local V = 10

    if V == 10 then
      out[1] = a

      if a > 3 then V = 30 else V = 40 end

      out[2] = "big"
      V = 50

    end

end
local function g(n)
  local s, i = 0, 1
  local st = 7
  repeat
    if st < 8 then
      if st == 7 then
        st = (i <= n) and 9 or 11
      end
    elseif st == 9 then
      s = s + i
      i = i + 1
      st = 7
    else
      st = 12
      break
    end
  until false
  return s
end

  local V = 5
  while V do
    if V == 5 then x = x * 2; V = -3
    elseif V == -3 then x = x + 1; V = nil end
  end
  return x
end

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- while-true normalisation
/** `while true do if C then B; continue end; break end` -> `while C do B end`
 *  `while true do if C then break end; B end`            -> `while not C do B end` */
export function simplifyWhileTrue(chunk: A.Chunk): number {
  let n = 0;
  forEachStatList(chunk, (list) => {
    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      const s = list[i];
      if (s.type !== 'WhileStat' || unparen(s.cond).type !== 'TrueLit') continue;
      const b = s.body;
      if (b.length === 2 && b[0].type === 'IfStat' && b[0].clauses.length === 1 && !b[0].elseBody && b[1].type === 'BreakStat') {
        const cb = b[0].clauses[0].body;
        const last = cb[cb.length - 1];
        if (last && last.type === 'ContinueStat' && !loopExits(cb.slice(0, -1))) {
          list[i] = { type: 'WhileStat', cond: b[0].clauses[0].cond, body: cb.slice(0, -1), loc: s.loc }; n++; continue;
        }
      }
      if (b.length >= 1 && b[0].type === 'IfStat' && b[0].clauses.length === 1 && !b[0].elseBody && b[0].clauses[0].body.length === 1 && b[0].clauses[0].body[0].type === 'BreakStat') {
        const c = b[0].clauses[0].cond;
        const u = unparen(c);
        const cond: A.Expr = u.type === 'UnExpr' && u.op === 'not' ? u.expr : { type: 'UnExpr', op: 'not', expr: { type: 'ParenExpr', expr: c } };
        list[i] = { type: 'WhileStat', cond, body: b.slice(1), loc: s.loc }; n++; continue;
      }
    }
  });
  return n;
}
'''

// Per-opcode handler simplification: substitute the opcode literal + resolved aliases, then clean.
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'fs';
import { parse, extractOpcodes, clean } from '../packages/core/src/index.js';
const [, , srcPath, lineStr, dumpPath, outPath] = process.argv;
const src = readFileSync(srcPath, 'utf8');
const r = extractOpcodes(parse(src).chunk, { minLeaves: 4, maxTrees: 60 });
const t = r.trees.find(t => t.line === Number(lineStr))!;
const dump = JSON.parse(readFileSync(dumpPath, 'utf8'));
const kmap = dump.k.$map as Record<string, any>;
const alias = new Map<string, string>();
for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(kmap)) {
  if (v && v.$fn && /^[a-z0-9]+\.[a-z0-9]+$|^[a-z]+$/i.test(v.$fn) && !/^_fn/.test(v.$fn)) alias.set(`arg361[${k}]`, v.$fn);
  if (v && v.$map) for (const [k2, v2] of Object.entries(v.$map as Record<string, any>)) if (v2 && v2.$fn) alias.set(`arg361[${k}][${k2}]`, v2.$fn);
}
const scratchVars = 'var53, var54, var55, var56, var57, var58, var59, z, var60, var61, var62';
const out: string[] = [];
for (const h of t.handlers) {
  let code = h.code;
  // longest keys first
  for (const [k, v] of [...alias].sort((a, b) => b[0].length - a[0].length)) code = code.split(k).join(v);
  const op = h.opcodes.length === 1 ? h.opcodes[0] : null;
  const snippet = `local ${scratchVars}\n${op !== null ? `local elem8 = ${op}\n` : ''}${code}\nUSE(${scratchVars})\n`;
  let res: string;
  try { res = clean(snippet, { rename: 'none' as any }).code; } catch (e) { res = '-- clean failed: ' + e + '\n' + code; }
  res = res.replace(/^local var53, var54, var55, var56, var57, var58, var59, z, var60, var61, var62;\n/, '').replace(/\nUSE\(var53, var54, var55, var56, var57, var58, var59, z, var60, var61, var62\);\s*$/, '\n');
  out.push(`==== OP ${h.rangeText}  (L${h.line})\n${res.trim()}`);
}
writeFileSync(outPath, out.join('\n'));
console.log('handlers', t.handlers.length);

// Forward substitution (copy propagation) of temporaries — universal, conservative.
//   x = <stable expr>; …; use(x)   ->   use(<stable expr>)
// Stable expressions: literals, locals, varargs, globals and table paths (a.b[1][k]) and
// side-effect-free arithmetic over them. The value must provably not change between the
// definition and the use: no intervening write of a dependency, and — when the expression
// reads memory (globals / table fields) — no intervening call or table/global store.
// The definition is deleted when x is certainly dead afterwards (redefined in the same block
// before any other read, with no exits in between).
import type * as A from '../ast.js';
import { walk } from '../ast.js';
import { analyzeScopes, Binding, ScopeInfo } from '../analysis/scope.js';
import { forEachStatList } from './scopepasses.js';

const unparen = (e: A.Expr): A.Expr => { while (e && e.type === 'ParenExpr') e = e.expr; return e; };
const PURE_BIN = new Set(['+', '-', '*', '/', '//', '%', '^', '..', '==', '~=', '<', '<=', '>', '>=', 'and', 'or']);

interface Info { ok: boolean; mem: boolean; deps: Set<Binding>; cheap: boolean; }
function stable(e: A.Expr, scope: ScopeInfo): Info {
  const info: Info = { ok: true, mem: false, deps: new Set(), cheap: true };
  const visit = (x: A.Expr) => {
    if (!info.ok) return;
    switch (x.type) {
      case 'NumberLit': case 'StringLit': case 'TrueLit': case 'FalseLit': case 'NilLit': case 'VarargLit': return;
      case 'ParenExpr': visit(x.expr); return;
      case 'NameExpr': { const b = scope.refOf.get(x); if (!b || b.kind === 'global') { info.mem = true; return; } if (b.capturedWrite) { info.ok = false; return; } info.deps.add(b); return; }
      case 'IndexExpr': info.mem = true; info.cheap = false; visit(x.obj); visit(x.index); return;
      case 'MemberExpr': info.mem = true; info.cheap = false; visit(x.obj); return;
      case 'BinExpr': if (!PURE_BIN.has(x.op)) { info.ok = false; return; } info.cheap = false; visit(x.left); visit(x.right); return;
      case 'UnExpr': if (x.op !== '-' && x.op !== 'not' && x.op !== '#') { info.ok = false; return; } info.cheap = false; visit(x.expr); return;
      default: info.ok = false;
    }
  };
  visit(e);
  return info;

/** does the node contain calls / table or global stores / loop or function exits? */
function effects(node: any, scope: ScopeInfo): { call: boolean; store: boolean; exit: boolean } {
  const r = { call: false, store: false, exit: false };
  walk(node, (m: any) => {
    if (m.type === 'FunctionExpr') return;
    if (m.type === 'CallExpr' || m.type === 'MethodCallExpr') r.call = true;
    if (m.type === 'BreakStat' || m.type === 'ReturnStat' || m.type === 'ContinueStat' || m.type === 'GotoStat' || m.type === 'LabelStat') r.exit = true;
    if (m.type === 'AssignStat') for (const t of m.targets) {

      else if (t.type === 'NameExpr') { const b = scope.refOf.get(t); if (!b || b.kind === 'global') r.store = true; }

export function forwardSubst(chunk: A.Chunk): number {
  const scope = analyzeScopes(chunk);
  let n = 0;
  const readRefs = new Map<Binding, Set<A.NameExpr>>();

      let blocked = false;

        if (w) { redefined = j; break; }

          const ef = effects(t, scope);
          if (ef.exit) exitsBetween = true;
          let depW = false; for (const d of info.deps) if (countIn(t, writes(d)) > 0) depW = true;
          if (depW || (info.mem && (ef.call || ef.store))) { blocked = true; break; }

      if (blocked || useIdx < 0) continue;
      const u = list[useIdx];
      // shape of the use statement: the read must happen before any side effect inside it
      const ok = (() => {
        const ef = effects(u, scope);
        let depW = false; for (const d of info.deps) if (countIn(u, writes(d)) > 0) depW = true;
        if (u.type === 'IfStat' || u.type === 'WhileStat' || u.type === 'RepeatStat' || u.type === 'NumericForStat' || u.type === 'GenericForStat' || u.type === 'DoStat') {

      if (laterReads && !info.cheap) continue;

        for (const key of Object.keys(node)) {

// Forward substitution (copy propagation) of temporaries — universal, conservative.
//   x = <stable expr>; …; use(x)   ->   use(<stable expr>)
// Stable expressions: literals, locals, varargs, globals and table paths (a.b[1][k]) and
// side-effect-free arithmetic over them. The value must provably not change between the
// definition and the use: no intervening write of a dependency, and — when the expression
// reads memory (globals / table fields) — no intervening call or table/global store.
// Only the first statement that reads x is rewritten per run (clean() iterates). The
// definition is deleted when x is certainly dead afterwards (unconditionally redefined in
// the same block, no other read and no exit in between).
import type * as A from '../ast.js';
import { walk } from '../ast.js';
import { analyzeScopes, Binding, ScopeInfo } from '../analysis/scope.js';
import { forEachStatList } from './scopepasses.js';

const PURE_BIN = new Set(['+', '-', '*', '/', '//', '%', '^', '..', '==', '~=', '<', '<=', '>', '>=', 'and', 'or']);

interface Info { ok: boolean; mem: boolean; deps: Set<Binding>; cheap: boolean; }
function stable(e: A.Expr, scope: ScopeInfo): Info {
  const info: Info = { ok: true, mem: false, deps: new Set(), cheap: true };
  const visit = (x: A.Expr) => {
    if (!info.ok) return;
    switch (x.type) {
      case 'NumberLit': case 'StringLit': case 'TrueLit': case 'FalseLit': case 'NilLit': case 'VarargLit': return;
      case 'ParenExpr': visit(x.expr); return;
      case 'NameExpr': {
        const b = scope.refOf.get(x);
        if (!b) { info.ok = false; return; }                 // unknown node: be safe
        if (b.kind === 'global') { info.mem = true; return; }

      }
      case 'IndexExpr': info.mem = true; info.cheap = false; visit(x.obj); visit(x.index); return;
      case 'MemberExpr': info.mem = true; info.cheap = false; visit(x.obj); return;
      case 'BinExpr': if (!PURE_BIN.has(x.op)) { info.ok = false; return; } info.cheap = false; visit(x.left); visit(x.right); return;
      case 'UnExpr': if (x.op !== '-' && x.op !== 'not' && x.op !== '#') { info.ok = false; return; } info.cheap = false; visit(x.expr); return;

cd /data/work && cat > protolib.py <<'EOF'
import json
def load(path='/data/work/boot3.json'):
    d=json.load(open(path))
    ids={}
    def index(x):
        if isinstance(x, dict):
            if '$id' in x: ids[x['$id']]=x
            for k,v in x.items():
                if k=='$arr': [index(e) for e in v]
                elif k=='$map': [index(e) for e in v.values()]
                elif k not in ('$id','$ref','$bytes','$buffer','$fn'): index(v)
        elif isinstance(x, list):
            for v in x: index(v)
    index(d)
    return d, ids
def deref(x, ids):
    if isinstance(x, dict) and '$ref' in x: return ids[x['$ref']]
    return x
def isproto(x):
    a=x.get('$arr',[]) if isinstance(x, dict) else []
    return len(a)==11 and isinstance(a[10],dict) and isinstance(a[8],(int,float))
def arr(t, ids, n=None):
    """Lua table -> python dict index->value (1-based), sparse aware"""
    t=deref(t, ids)
    out={}
    if not isinstance(t, dict): return out
    for i,v in enumerate(t.get('$arr',[]),1):
        if v is not None: out[i]=v
    for k,v in t.get('$map',{}).items():
        try:
            kf=float(k)
            if kf.is_integer(): out[int(kf)]=v
            else: out[k]=v
        except ValueError: out[k]=v
    return out
EOF

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- for-loop sequence flattening
/** `for i = a, b, c do if <test on i> then … elseif … end end` with constant bounds, where every
 *  iteration selects exactly one case (tests may be compound: `i > 647 and i < 881`) ->
 *  the selected case bodies in order (`continue` = next case, `break` = stop). */
export function unrollSwitchFor(chunk: A.Chunk, maxIter = 64): number {
  const scope = analyzeScopes(chunk);
  let n = 0;
  const numLit = (e: A.Expr | undefined): number | null => { if (!e) return null; const k = litKey(e); return k && k.startsWith('n:') ? Number(k.slice(2)) : null; };
  forEachStatList(chunk, (list) => {
    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      const s = list[i];
      if (s.type !== 'NumericForStat') continue;
      const a = numLit(s.from), b = numLit(s.to), c = s.step ? numLit(s.step) : 1;
      if (a === null || b === null || c === null || c === 0) continue;
      const iters = Math.floor((b - a) / c) + 1;
      if (!(iters >= 1 && iters <= maxIter)) continue;
      const bind = scope.bindings.find(x => x.kind === 'for' && x.decl === s);
      if (!bind || bind.writes > 0 || bind.captured) continue;
      if (s.body.length !== 1 || s.body[0].type !== 'IfStat') continue;
      const mark = ++cffAttempt;
      for (const r of bind.refs) (r as any).__cffR = mark;
      const isV = (e: A.Expr) => { const u: any = unparen(e); return u.type === 'NameExpr' && u.__cffR === mark; };
      const disp = s.body[0];
      if (!pureOnV(disp.clauses[0].cond, isV)) continue;
      const select = (ifs: A.IfStat, key: string, depth: number): A.Stat[] | null => {
        if (depth > 64) return null;
        for (const cl of ifs.clauses) {
          if (!pureOnV(cl.cond, isV)) return null;
          const t = evalPred({ e: cl.cond, truth: true, isV, memo: new Map() }, key);
          if (t === null) return null;
          if (t) return descend(cl.body, key, depth);
        }
        return descend(ifs.elseBody ?? [], key, depth);
      };
      const descend = (body: A.Stat[], key: string, depth: number): A.Stat[] | null =>
        body.length === 1 && body[0].type === 'IfStat' && pureOnV(body[0].clauses[0].cond, isV) ? select(body[0], key, depth + 1) : body;
      const blocks: A.Stat[] = [];
      let ok = true;
      for (let q = 0; q < iters; q++) {
        const v = a + q * c;
        const body = select(disp, 'n:' + v, 0);
        if (!body) { ok = false; break; }
        let bb = body; let stop = false;
        if (bb.length && bb[bb.length - 1].type === 'ContinueStat') bb = bb.slice(0, -1);
        else if (bb.length && bb[bb.length - 1].type === 'BreakStat') { bb = bb.slice(0, -1); stop = true; }
        if (loopExits(bb)) { ok = false; break; }
        const cl: A.Stat[] = structuredClone(bb);
        const sub = (node: any): void => {
          if (!node || typeof node !== 'object') return;
          for (const key of Object.keys(node)) {
            if (key === 'loc') continue;
            const x = node[key];
            const hit = (y: any) => y && y.type === 'NameExpr' && y.__cffR === mark;
            if (Array.isArray(x)) { for (let z = 0; z < x.length; z++) { if (hit(x[z])) x[z] = keyExpr('n:' + v); else sub(x[z]); } }
            else if (x && typeof x === 'object') { if (hit(x)) node[key] = keyExpr('n:' + v); else sub(x); }
          }
        };
        sub(cl);
        if (cl.length) blocks.push({ type: 'DoStat', body: cl, loc: s.loc });
        if (stop) break;
      }
      if (!ok) continue;
      list.splice(i, 1, ...blocks); i += blocks.length - 1; n++;
    }
  });
  return n;
}
EOF

            ex.setdefault((fi+1,k), v)

## 1220. ИИ · шаг

Пишу проход потокового распространения констант
bash
mkdir -p /data/prism/packages/core/src/vm && cat > /data/prism/packages/core/src/passes/constflow.ts <<'EOF'
// Flow-sensitive constant & copy propagation over the structured AST — universal, conservative.
//
//   x = 5; …; f(x)          ->  f(5)        (x not reassigned on any path in between)
//   t = R; …; t[k] = v      ->  R[k] = v    (copy of a local that is still unchanged)
//
// Tracked: locals that are never written from a nested closure (so no call can change them).
// Values: number/string/boolean/nil literals, copies of tracked locals, and caller-declared
// constant globals (e.g. the read-only record names introduced by the VM specialiser).
// Control flow: if/elseif/else branches are processed separately and merged (a branch that
// ends in return/break/continue does not reach the join); loops first forget every variable
// assigned anywhere inside them, so no iteration can observe a stale value. Reads inside
// nested functions are never replaced (they may run later). Functions containing goto/labels
// are skipped.
import type * as A from '../ast.js';
import { walk } from '../ast.js';
import { analyzeScopes, Binding } from '../analysis/scope.js';

interface Val { key: string; expr: A.Expr; src?: Binding; }
type Env = Map<Binding, Val>;

export interface ConstFlowOptions {
  /** global names whose value never changes (treated like literals) */
  constGlobals?: (name: string) => boolean;
  /** longest string literal that is copied into use sites (default 80) */
  maxString?: number;
}

const unparen = (e: A.Expr): A.Expr => { while (e && e.type === 'ParenExpr') e = e.expr; return e; };
const isMulti = (e: A.Expr | undefined) => !!e && (e.type === 'CallExpr' || e.type === 'MethodCallExpr' || e.type === 'VarargLit');

export function constFlow(chunk: A.Chunk, opts: ConstFlowOptions = {}): number {
  const scope = analyzeScopes(chunk);
  const maxStr = opts.maxString ?? 80;
  const declOf = new Map<any, Binding[]>();
  for (const b of scope.bindings) if (b.decl) { let l = declOf.get(b.decl); if (!l) { l = []; declOf.set(b.decl, l); } l[b.index] = b; }
  const writeSet = new Set<A.NameExpr>(); for (const b of scope.bindings) for (const w of b.writeRefs) writeSet.add(w);
  let n = 0;
  const scopes: Array<Map<string, Binding>> = [];
  const visible = (name: string): Binding | undefined => { for (let i = scopes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const b = scopes[i].get(name); if (b) return b; } return scope.globals.get(name); };
  const trackable = (b: Binding | undefined): b is Binding => !!b && b.kind !== 'global' && !b.capturedWrite;
  const declare = (name: string, b: Binding | undefined) => { if (b) scopes[scopes.length - 1].set(name, b); };

  const valOf = (e: A.Expr): Val | null => {
    const u = unparen(e);
    switch (u.type) {
      case 'NumberLit': return Number.isFinite(u.value) ? { key: 'n:' + (Object.is(u.value, -0) ? '-0' : String(u.value)), expr: u } : null;
      case 'StringLit': return u.value.length <= maxStr ? { key: 's:' + u.value, expr: u } : null;
      case 'TrueLit': return { key: 'b:1', expr: u };
      case 'FalseLit': return { key: 'b:0', expr: u };
      case 'NilLit': return { key: 'nil', expr: u };
      case 'UnExpr': { const v = unparen(u.expr); if (u.op === '-' && v.type === 'NumberLit' && Number.isFinite(v.value)) return { key: 'n:' + String(-v.value), expr: u }; return null; }
      case 'NameExpr': {
        const b = scope.refOf.get(u); if (!b) return null;
        if (b.kind === 'global') return opts.constGlobals?.(u.name) && visible(u.name) === b ? { key: 'g:' + u.name, expr: u, src: b } : null;
        if (!trackable(b)) return null;
        return { key: 'v:' + b.id, expr: { type: 'NameExpr', name: b.name }, src: b };
      }
    }
    return null;
  };
  const invalidate = (env: Env, b: Binding) => { env.delete(b); for (const [k, v] of env) if (v.src === b) env.delete(k); };

  const sub = (e: A.Expr, env: Env): A.Expr => {
    if (!e) return e;
    switch (e.type) {
      case 'NameExpr': {
        const b = scope.refOf.get(e);
        if (!b || !env.size || writeSet.has(e)) return e;
        const v = env.get(b); if (!v) return e;
        if (v.src && visible(v.src.name) !== v.src) return e;
        n++;
        const c = structuredClone(v.expr) as A.Expr;
        if (c.type === 'NameExpr' && v.src) { scope.refOf.set(c, v.src); v.src.refs.push(c); }
        return c;
      }
      case 'ParenExpr': e.expr = sub(e.expr, env); return e;
      case 'UnExpr': e.expr = sub(e.expr, env); return e;
      case 'BinExpr': e.left = sub(e.left, env); e.right = sub(e.right, env); return e;
      case 'CallExpr': e.callee = sub(e.callee, env); e.args = e.args.map(a => sub(a, env)); return e;
      case 'MethodCallExpr': e.obj = sub(e.obj, env); e.args = e.args.map(a => sub(a, env)); return e;
      case 'IndexExpr': e.obj = sub(e.obj, env); e.index = sub(e.index, env); return e;
      case 'MemberExpr': e.obj = sub(e.obj, env); return e;
      case 'TableExpr': for (const f of e.fields) { if (f.key) f.key = sub(f.key, env); f.value = sub(f.value, env); } return e;
      case 'InterpExpr': for (const p of e.parts) if (p.kind === 'expr') p.expr = sub(p.expr, env); return e;
      case 'FunctionExpr': fn(e); return e;
      default: return e;
    }
  };
  const copy = (env: Env): Env => new Map(env);
  const merge = (envs: Env[]): Env | null => {
    if (!envs.length) return null;
    const out = copy(envs[0]);
    for (const e of envs.slice(1)) for (const [k, v] of out) { const w = e.get(k); if (!w || w.key !== v.key) out.delete(k); }
    return out;
  };
  /** every binding assigned or declared inside node (nested functions included: conservative) */
  const killSet = (node: any): Set<Binding> => {
    const s = new Set<Binding>();
    walk(node, (m: any) => {
      if (m.type === 'NameExpr' && writeSet.has(m)) { const b = scope.refOf.get(m); if (b) s.add(b); }
      if (m.type === 'LocalStat' || m.type === 'NumericForStat' || m.type === 'GenericForStat' || m.type === 'LocalFunctionStat') for (const b of declOf.get(m) ?? []) if (b) s.add(b);
    });
    return s;
  };
  const killed = (env: Env, node: any): Env => { const out = copy(env); for (const b of killSet(node)) invalidate(out, b); return out; };

  const list = (stmts: A.Stat[], env: Env, ownScope = true): Env | null => {
    if (ownScope) scopes.push(new Map());
    let cur: Env | null = env;
    for (const s of stmts) { if (!cur) break; cur = stat(s, cur); }
    if (ownScope) scopes.pop();
    return cur;
  };
  const stat = (s: A.Stat, env: Env): Env | null => {
    switch (s.type) {
      case 'LocalStat': {
        s.init = s.init.map(e => sub(e, env));
        const bs = declOf.get(s) ?? [];
        const vals: Array<Val | null> = s.names.map((_, q) => {
          if (q < s.init.length) { if (q === s.init.length - 1 && q < s.names.length - 1 && isMulti(s.init[q])) return null; if (q === s.init.length - 1 && isMulti(s.init[q]) && s.init.length < s.names.length) return null; return valOf(s.init[q]); }
          if (s.init.length && isMulti(s.init[s.init.length - 1])) return null;
          return { key: 'nil', expr: { type: 'NilLit' } };
        });
        s.names.forEach((nm, q) => { const b = bs[q]; declare(nm, b); if (!b) return; invalidate(env, b); const v = vals[q]; if (v && trackable(b) && !(s.attribs && s.attribs[q] === 'close')) env.set(b, v); });
        return env;
      }
      case 'AssignStat': {
        for (const t of s.targets) { if (t.type === 'IndexExpr') { t.obj = sub(t.obj, env); t.index = sub(t.index, env); } else if (t.type === 'MemberExpr') t.obj = sub(t.obj, env); }
        s.values = s.values.map(e => sub(e, env));
        const tb: Array<Binding | undefined> = s.targets.map(t => t.type === 'NameExpr' ? scope.refOf.get(t) : undefined);
        const vals: Array<Val | null> = s.targets.map((_, q) => {
          if (s.op) return null;
          if (q < s.values.length) { if (q === s.values.length - 1 && isMulti(s.values[q]) && s.values.length < s.targets.length) return null; return valOf(s.values[q]); }
          if (s.values.length && isMulti(s.values[s.values.length - 1])) return null;
          return { key: 'nil', expr: { type: 'NilLit' } };
        });
        for (const b of tb) if (b) invalidate(env, b);
        tb.forEach((b, q) => { const v = vals[q]; if (b && v && trackable(b) && !(v.src && tb.includes(v.src))) env.set(b, v); });
        return env;
      }
      case 'CallStat': s.expr = sub(s.expr, env) as any; return env;
      case 'DoStat': return list(s.body, env);
      case 'IfStat': {
        const outs: Env[] = [];
        for (const c of s.clauses) { c.cond = sub(c.cond, env); const r = list(c.body, copy(env)); if (r) outs.push(r); }
        if (s.elseBody) { const r = list(s.elseBody, copy(env)); if (r) outs.push(r); } else outs.push(env);
        return merge(outs);
      }
      case 'WhileStat': {
        const e2 = killed(env, s);
        s.cond = sub(s.cond, e2);
        list(s.body, copy(e2));
        return e2;
      }
      case 'RepeatStat': {
        const e2 = killed(env, s);
        scopes.push(new Map());
        const end = list(s.body, copy(e2), false);
        s.cond = sub(s.cond, end ?? e2);
        scopes.pop();
        return e2;
      }
      case 'NumericForStat': {
        s.from = sub(s.from, env); s.to = sub(s.to, env); if (s.step) s.step = sub(s.step, env);
        const e2 = killed(env, s);
        scopes.push(new Map()); declare(s.var, (declOf.get(s) ?? [])[0]);
        list(s.body, copy(e2));
        scopes.pop();
        return e2;
      }
      case 'GenericForStat': {
        s.iters = s.iters.map(e => sub(e, env));
        const e2 = killed(env, s);
        scopes.push(new Map()); s.names.forEach((nm, q) => declare(nm, (declOf.get(s) ?? [])[q]));
        list(s.body, copy(e2));
        scopes.pop();
        return e2;
      }
      case 'ReturnStat': s.args = s.args.map(e => sub(e, env)); return null;
      case 'BreakStat': case 'ContinueStat': case 'GotoStat': return null;
      case 'FunctionStat': {
        if (s.target.type === 'IndexExpr') { s.target.obj = sub(s.target.obj, env); s.target.index = sub(s.target.index, env); }
        else if (s.target.type === 'MemberExpr') s.target.obj = sub(s.target.obj, env);
        else if (s.target.type === 'NameExpr') { const b = scope.refOf.get(s.target); if (b) invalidate(env, b); }
        fn(s.func);
        return env;
      }
      case 'LocalFunctionStat': { const b = (declOf.get(s) ?? [])[0]; declare(s.name, b); if (b) invalidate(env, b); fn(s.func); return env; }
      default: return env;
    }
  };
  const hasGoto = (f: A.FunctionExpr | A.Chunk) => { let hit = false; walk(f.body, (m: any) => { if (m.type === 'GotoStat' || m.type === 'LabelStat') hit = true; }); return hit; };
  const fn = (f: A.FunctionExpr) => {
    scopes.push(new Map());
    f.params.forEach((p, q) => declare(p, (declOf.get(f) ?? [])[q]));
    if (!hasGoto(f)) list(f.body, new Map());
    else walk(f.body, (m: any) => { if (m.type === 'FunctionExpr' && m !== f) { /* nested functions are visited by their own walk below */ } });
    scopes.pop();
  };
  scopes.push(new Map());
  if (!hasGoto(chunk)) list(chunk.body, new Map(), false);
  scopes.pop();
  return n;
}

cat >> packages/core/src/passes/constflow.ts <<'EOF'

/** `for i = a, b[, s] do BODY end` with integer literal bounds and at most maxIter iterations
 *  -> `do local i = a; BODY end do local i = a + s; BODY end …` (fresh local per iteration, as in
 *  Lua). Loops whose body breaks/continues/jumps at loop level, or whose body is large, stay. */
export function unrollSmallFor(chunk: A.Chunk, maxIter = 8, maxBody = 60): number {
  let n = 0;
  const num = (e: A.Expr | undefined, d: number): number | null => {
    if (!e) return d;
    const u = unparen(e);
    if (u.type === 'NumberLit') return Number.isInteger(u.value) ? u.value : null;
    if (u.type === 'UnExpr' && u.op === '-') { const v = unparen(u.expr); if (v.type === 'NumberLit' && Number.isInteger(v.value)) return -v.value; }
    return null;
  };
  const loopLevelJump = (body: A.Stat[]): boolean => {
    let hit = false;
    const scan = (m: any, nested: boolean) => {
      if (hit || !m || typeof m !== 'object') return;
      if (Array.isArray(m)) { for (const x of m) scan(x, nested); return; }
      if (m.type === 'FunctionExpr') return;
      if ((m.type === 'BreakStat' || m.type === 'ContinueStat') && !nested) { hit = true; return; }
      if (m.type === 'GotoStat' || m.type === 'LabelStat') { hit = true; return; }
      const loop = m.type === 'WhileStat' || m.type === 'RepeatStat' || m.type === 'NumericForStat' || m.type === 'GenericForStat';
      for (const k of Object.keys(m)) if (k !== 'loc') scan(m[k], nested || loop);
    };
    scan(body, false);
    return hit;
  };
  const size = (x: any) => { let c = 0; walk(x, (m: any) => { if (m && typeof m.type === 'string' && /Stat$/.test(m.type)) c++; }); return c; };
  const visit = (list: A.Stat[]) => {
    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
      const s = list[i];
      if (s.type !== 'NumericForStat') continue;
      const a = num(s.from, NaN), b = num(s.to, NaN), st = num(s.step, 1);
      if (a === null || b === null || st === null || !Number.isFinite(a) || !Number.isFinite(b) || st === 0) continue;
      const trips = st > 0 ? (b >= a ? Math.floor((b - a) / st) + 1 : 0) : (a >= b ? Math.floor((a - b) / -st) + 1 : 0);
      if (trips > maxIter || loopLevelJump(s.body) || size(s.body) * trips > maxBody * Math.max(1, Math.min(trips, 4))) continue;
      const out: A.Stat[] = [];
      for (let q = 0; q < trips; q++) {
        const v = a + q * st;
        const init: A.Expr = v < 0 ? { type: 'UnExpr', op: '-', expr: { type: 'NumberLit', value: -v, raw: String(-v) } } : { type: 'NumberLit', value: v, raw: String(v) };
        out.push({ type: 'DoStat', body: [{ type: 'LocalStat', names: [s.var], init: [init] }, ...structuredClone(s.body)] });
      }
      // a return inside a do-block is fine; keep the statement count stable for callers
      list.splice(i, 1, ...out);
      i += out.length - 1;
      n++;
    }
  };
  // innermost lists first is not required: the clean() rounds repeat until nothing changes
  const lists: A.Stat[][] = [];
  walk(chunk, (m: any) => { for (const k of ['body', 'elseBody']) if (Array.isArray(m[k])) lists.push(m[k]); if (m.type === 'IfStat') for (const c of m.clauses) lists.push(c.body); });
  lists.push(chunk.body);
  for (const l of lists) visit(l);
  return n;
}

cat > /data/prism/packages/core/src/vm/dump.ts <<'EOF'
// Reader for runtime/table dumps (JSON) — the format written by PRISM's Python-port dump hooks:
//   table   {"$id": n, "$arr": [v1, v2, …], "$map": {"key": v, …}, "$meta": t}
//   ref     {"$ref": n}          function {"$fn": "string.byte"}
//   bytes   {"$bytes": "hex"}    buffer   {"$buffer": "hex"}
// Plain JSON (lists = 1-based Lua arrays, objects = maps) is accepted as well.
import type * as A from '../ast.js';

export type DumpVal = unknown;
type Obj = Record<string, any>;
const isObj = (v: unknown): v is Obj => !!v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v);
const hexLatin1 = (h: string) => { let s = ''; for (let i = 0; i + 1 < h.length; i += 2) s += String.fromCharCode(parseInt(h.slice(i, i + 2), 16)); return s; };
const utf8Latin1 = (s: string) => { if (/^[\x00-\x7f]*$/.test(s)) return s; return Array.from(new TextEncoder().encode(s), b => String.fromCharCode(b)).join(''); };
const NUMKEY = /^-?(\d+(\.\d+)?|\.\d+)(e[+-]?\d+)?$/i;

export type Scalar =
  | { kind: 'nil' } | { kind: 'bool'; value: boolean } | { kind: 'num'; value: number } | { kind: 'str'; value: string }
  | { kind: 'fn'; name: string } | { kind: 'buffer'; hex: string } | { kind: 'table'; id: string };

export class LuaDump {
  readonly ids = new Map<number, Obj>();
  private synth = new WeakMap<object, string>();
  private nextSynth = 1;
  constructor(readonly root: unknown) { this.index(root, 0); }
  private index(x: unknown, depth: number) {
    if (depth > 4000) return;
    if (Array.isArray(x)) { for (const v of x) this.index(v, depth + 1); return; }
    if (!isObj(x)) return;
    if (typeof x.$id === 'number') this.ids.set(x.$id, x);
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(x)) {
      if (k === '$ref' || k === '$fn' || k === '$bytes' || k === '$buffer' || k === '$id') continue;
      this.index(v, depth + 1);
    }
  }
  deref(v: unknown): unknown { return isObj(v) && typeof v.$ref === 'number' ? this.ids.get(v.$ref) : v; }
  isTable(v: unknown): boolean {
    const d = this.deref(v);
    if (Array.isArray(d)) return true;
    return isObj(d) && d.$fn === undefined && d.$bytes === undefined && d.$buffer === undefined;
  }
  /** stable identity of a table value */
  tableId(v: unknown): string {
    const d = this.deref(v) as any;
    if (isObj(d) && typeof d.$id === 'number') return String(d.$id);
    let s = this.synth.get(d); if (!s) { s = 's' + this.nextSynth++; this.synth.set(d, s); } return s;
  }
  scalar(v: unknown): Scalar {
    const d = this.deref(v);
    if (d === null || d === undefined) return { kind: 'nil' };
    if (typeof d === 'boolean') return { kind: 'bool', value: d };
    if (typeof d === 'number') return { kind: 'num', value: d };
    if (typeof d === 'string') return { kind: 'str', value: utf8Latin1(d) };
    if (isObj(d)) {
      if (typeof d.$bytes === 'string') return { kind: 'str', value: hexLatin1(d.$bytes) };
      if (typeof d.$fn === 'string') return { kind: 'fn', name: d.$fn };
      if (typeof d.$buffer === 'string') return { kind: 'buffer', hex: d.$buffer };
    }
    return { kind: 'table', id: this.tableId(d) };
  }
  /** Lua t[key] */
  get(t: unknown, key: number | string | boolean): unknown {
    const d = this.deref(t) as any;
    if (Array.isArray(d)) { if (typeof key === 'number' && Number.isInteger(key) && key >= 1 && key <= d.length) return d[key - 1]; return undefined; }
    if (!isObj(d)) return undefined;
    if (typeof key === 'number') {
      const arr = d.$arr as unknown[] | undefined;
      if (arr && Number.isInteger(key) && key >= 1 && key <= arr.length) return arr[key - 1];
      const m = d.$map as Obj | undefined;
      if (m) { const s = String(key); if (s in m) return m[s]; if (Number.isInteger(key) && (s + '.0') in m) return m[s + '.0']; }
      if (!('$id' in d) && !('$arr' in d) && !('$map' in d) && String(key) in d) return d[String(key)];
      return undefined;
    }
    const k = String(key);
    const m = d.$map as Obj | undefined;
    if (m && k in m && !NUMKEY.test(k)) return m[k];
    if (!('$id' in d) && !('$arr' in d) && !('$map' in d) && !k.startsWith('$') && k in d) return d[k];
    return undefined;
  }
  /** border of the array part (#t for a proper sequence) */
  len(t: unknown): number {
    const d = this.deref(t) as any;
    if (Array.isArray(d)) { let n = d.length; while (n > 0 && (d[n - 1] === null || d[n - 1] === undefined)) n--; return n; }
    if (!isObj(d)) return 0;
    let n = Array.isArray(d.$arr) ? d.$arr.length : 0;
    while (n > 0 && (d.$arr[n - 1] === null || d.$arr[n - 1] === undefined)) n--;
    if (n === (Array.isArray(d.$arr) ? d.$arr.length : 0)) { while (this.get(d, n + 1) !== undefined && this.get(d, n + 1) !== null) n++; }
    return n;
  }
  /** all entries as [luaKey, value] */
  entries(t: unknown): Array<[number | string, unknown]> {
    const d = this.deref(t) as any;
    const out: Array<[number | string, unknown]> = [];
    if (Array.isArray(d)) { d.forEach((v, i) => { if (v !== null && v !== undefined) out.push([i + 1, v]); }); return out; }

    for (let ci = 0; ci < s.clauses.length; ci++) {
      const v = evalOn(s.clauses[ci].cond, opVar, op);

      }
      if (v !== false && v !== null) { out.push(...selectHandler(s.clauses[ci].body, opVar, op)); done = true; break; }
    }
    if (!done && s.elseBody) out.push(...selectHandler(s.elseBody, opVar, op));
  }
  return out;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ protos
export interface ProtoRef { id: string; value: unknown; instrs: number; }
export function findProtos(dump: LuaDump, shape: VmShape, rootPath?: string): ProtoRef[] {
  const keys = [...new Set(shape.fieldVars.values())];
  const isProto = (t: unknown): boolean => {
    const ops = dump.get(t, shape.opsKey as any);
    if (!dump.isTable(ops)) return false;
    const n = dump.len(ops); if (!n) return false;
    for (let i = 1; i <= Math.min(n, 64); i++) if (dump.scalar(dump.get(ops, i)).kind !== 'num') return false;
    return keys.every(k => dump.get(t, k as any) !== undefined || k === shape.opsKey) || keys.filter(k => dump.get(t, k as any) !== undefined).length >= Math.ceil(keys.length * 0.6);
  };
  let start: unknown = dump.root;
  if (rootPath) for (const p of rootPath.split(/[./]/).filter(Boolean)) start = dump.get(start, /^\d+$/.test(p) ? Number(p) : p) ?? (dump.deref(start) as any)?.[p];
  const out: ProtoRef[] = [];
  for (const t of dump.tables(start)) if (isProto(t)) out.push({ id: dump.tableId(t), value: t, instrs: dump.len(dump.get(t, shape.opsKey as any)) });
  // stable order: numeric ids ascending
  out.sort((a, b) => (Number(a.id) || 0) - (Number(b.id) || 0));
  return out;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ specialisation
export interface SpecializeOptions {
  /** dump path of the root proto / of the search start (default: whole dump) */
  root?: string;
  /** helper table: the interpreter's name for it and its dump path; library functions stored
   *  in it (recorded as {"$fn": "table.create"}) are substituted for `name[k]` reads */
  helper?: { name: string; path: string };

  only?: string[];
  maxProtos?: number;
  maxInstrs?: number;
}
export interface SpecializedProto { id: string; name: string; instrs: number; blocks: number; code: string; notes: string[]; }
export interface SpecializeResult {
  ok: boolean; notes: string[]; shape?: VmShape;
  protos: SpecializedProto[];
  /** names of read-only records used in the residual code -> dump table */
  constNames: Map<string, unknown>;
  dump: LuaDump;

const LIB = /^(?:(?:string|table|math|bit32|buffer|coroutine|utf8|os|debug|task)\.[A-Za-z_]\w*|pcall|xpcall|select|type|typeof|tostring|tonumber|error|assert|getfenv|setfenv|setmetatable|getmetatable|rawget|rawset|rawequal|rawlen|next|pairs|ipairs|unpack|print|newproxy|gcinfo|collectgarbage)$/;

/** property path from root to target node (object keys / array indexes) */
function findPath(root: any, target: any): Array<string | number> {
  const path: Array<string | number> = [];

    if (n === target) return true;
    if (!n || typeof n !== 'object') return false;

export { astRewrite, globalsFromEnv, compileRules, specializeVM, findVmShape, selectHandler, LuaDump };
export type { RewriteRule, SpecializeOptions, SpecializeResult, VmShape };
export interface VmSpecializeOptions extends SpecializeOptions {

export interface VmSpecializeResult { ok: boolean; notes: string[]; protos: VmSpecializedProto[]; code: string; }
/** Devirtualise: residual program of the VM interpreter for every dumped proto, cleaned + structured. */
export function vmSpecialize(src: string, dumpJson: unknown, opts: VmSpecializeOptions = {}): VmSpecializeResult {
  const r = specializeVM(src, dumpJson, opts);
  const out: VmSpecializeResult = { ok: r.ok, notes: r.notes.slice(), protos: [], code: '' };

      structured = !new RegExp('\\\\b' + pcVar + '\\\\b').test(code);

    out.protos.push({ id: p.id, instrs: p.instrs, blocks: p.blocks, code, structured, notes: p.notes, stats });
  }
  out.code = ['-- PRISM vm_specialize: residual program of the VM interpreter (one maker per proto).',

  return out;
}

-- t11: flattened state machines with unstructured shapes (multi-level jumps, break regions, irreducible cycles)
local function sm1(n)
  -- nested loops; the inner loop continues / breaks the OUTER loop directly
  local out = {}
  local st = 1
  local i, j = 0, 0
  while true do
    if st == 1 then
      i = i + 1; j = 0
      if i > n then st = 9 else st = 2 end
    elseif st == 2 then
      j = j + 1
      if j > i then st = 1 else st = 3 end

      if (i * j) % 5 == 0 then out[#out + 1] = 'c' .. i .. j; st = 1
      elseif i + j == 11 then out[#out + 1] = 'b' .. i .. j; st = 9
      else out[#out + 1] = tostring(i * j); st = 2 end
    elseif st == 9 then
      break
    end
  end
  return table.concat(out, ',')
end

local function sm2(t)
  -- loop with a break region that has code (exits: 50 normal, 30 break-with-code); both reach 60
  local s = 10
  local acc, k = 0, 0
  while true do
    if s == 10 then k = k + 1; if k > #t then s = 50 else s = 20 end
    elseif s == 20 then if t[k] < 0 then s = 30 else s = 40 end
    elseif s == 30 then acc = acc * 2; s = 60
    elseif s == 40 then acc = acc + t[k]; s = 10
    elseif s == 50 then acc = acc + 1000; s = 60
    elseif s == 60 then acc = acc - 1; s = 70
    elseif s == 70 then break
    end
  end
  return acc, k
end

local function sm3(x)
  -- irreducible: the cycle {2,3} is entered at 2 or at 3
  local s = 1
  local out, n = '', 0
  while true do
    if s == 1 then if x > 3 then s = 2 else s = 3 end
    elseif s == 2 then out = out .. 'a'; n = n + 1; if n > 5 then s = 4 else s = 3 end
    elseif s == 3 then out = out .. 'b'; n = n + 2; if n > 7 then s = 4 else s = 2 end
    elseif s == 4 then break
    end
  end
  return out, n
end

local function sm4(t)
  -- dispatcher exit from inside a nested loop whose own follow is elsewhere; return inside a break region
  local s = 1
  local i, r = 0, 0
  while true do
    if s == 1 then i = i + 1; if i > #t then s = 5 else s = 2 end
    elseif s == 2 then
      if t[i] == 0 then s = 8                         -- leave the whole machine from inside the loop
      elseif t[i] < 0 then s = 6 else s = 3 end
    elseif s == 3 then r = r + t[i]; s = 1
    elseif s == 5 then r = r * 10; s = 7
    elseif s == 6 then if r > 100 then return 'big', r end; r = -r; s = 7
    elseif s == 7 then r = r + 0.5; s = 8
    elseif s == 8 then break
    end
  end
  return 'end', r, i
end

print(sm1(4)); print(sm1(7))
print(sm2({ 1, 2, 3 })); print(sm2({ 5, -1, 7 })); print(sm2({}))
print(sm3(1)); print(sm3(5))
print(sm4({ 1, 2, 3 })); print(sm4({ 4, 0, 9 })); print(sm4({ 50, 60, -1 })); print(sm4({ 2, -3 }))
EOF

/** Find program stores into dump records (`K_7[262] = 101`, or through a holder: `R[28] = K_413; …; R[28][103] = 27`).
 *  recordId maps a residual record name to its dump table id. Keys/values that are not literals (after a
 *  straight-line look-up of literal assignments) are reported as `dynamic` / `anyKey`. */
export function collectPatches(chunk: A.Chunk, recordId: (name: string) => string | null): PatchSpec[] {
  const out = new Map<string, PatchSpec>();
  const litOf = (e: A.Expr | undefined): { ok: boolean; v: number | string | boolean | null } => {
    const u = e ? unparen(e) : undefined;
    if (!u) return { ok: false, v: null };
    if (u.type === 'NumberLit') return { ok: true, v: u.value };
    if (u.type === 'UnExpr' && u.op === '-' && unparen(u.expr).type === 'NumberLit') return { ok: true, v: -(unparen(u.expr) as A.NumberLit).value };
    if (u.type === 'StringLit') return { ok: true, v: u.value };
    if (u.type === 'TrueLit') return { ok: true, v: true };
    if (u.type === 'FalseLit') return { ok: true, v: false };
    if (u.type === 'NilLit') return { ok: true, v: null };
    return { ok: false, v: null };
  };
  // function-wide fallback: holders assigned exactly one record (other writes only nil)
  const unique = new Map<string, string | null>();
  walk(chunk, (m: any) => {
    if (m.type !== 'AssignStat' || m.op) return;
    m.targets.forEach((t: A.Expr, q: number) => {
      const key = printExpr(t); const v = m.values[q] ? unparen(m.values[q]) : undefined;
      const id = v && v.type === 'NameExpr' ? recordId(v.name) : null;
      if (v && v.type === 'NilLit') return;
      const prev = unique.get(key);
      if (id === null) unique.set(key, null);
      else if (prev === undefined) unique.set(key, id);
      else if (prev !== id) unique.set(key, null);
    });
  });
  const record = (tid: string, k: { ok: boolean; v: any }, v: { ok: boolean; v: any }) => {
    const key = k.ok ? (typeof k.v === 'number' ? 'n:' + k.v : 's:' + String(k.v)) : '*';
    const id = tid + '|' + key;
    let ps = out.get(id);
    if (!ps) { ps = k.ok ? { table: tid, key: k.v as number | string, values: [] } : { table: tid, anyKey: true, values: [] }; out.set(id, ps); }
    if (v.ok) { if (!ps.values.includes(v.v)) ps.values.push(v.v); } else ps.dynamic = true;
  };
  type St = { holders: Map<string, string>; lits: Map<string, { ok: boolean; v: any }> };
  const assignedIn = (node: any): Set<string> => { const s = new Set<string>(); walk(node, (m: any) => { if (m.type === 'AssignStat') for (const t of m.targets) s.add(printExpr(t)); }); return s; };
  const list = (stmts: A.Stat[], st: St): void => {
    for (const s of stmts) {
      if (s.type === 'AssignStat' && !s.op) {
        s.targets.forEach((t, q) => {
          const v = s.values[q];
          if (t.type === 'IndexExpr') {
            const o = unparen(t.obj);
            const ok = printExpr(o);
            const tid = (o.type === 'NameExpr' ? recordId(o.name) : null) ?? st.holders.get(ok) ?? unique.get(ok) ?? null;
            if (tid !== null) {

              let vv = litOf(v); if (!vv.ok && v) vv = st.lits.get(printExpr(v)) ?? vv;

          const u = v ? unparen(v) : undefined;
          const rid = u && u.type === 'NameExpr' ? recordId(u.name) : null;
          if (rid !== null) st.holders.set(key, rid); else st.holders.delete(key);
          const l = litOf(v); if (l.ok) st.lits.set(key, l); else st.lits.delete(key);

        });

      }
      const nested: A.Stat[][] = [];
      if (s.type === 'IfStat') { for (const c of s.clauses) nested.push(c.body); if (s.elseBody) nested.push(s.elseBody); }
      else if (s.type === 'WhileStat' || s.type === 'RepeatStat' || s.type === 'DoStat' || s.type === 'NumericForStat' || s.type === 'GenericForStat') nested.push(s.body);
      const loop = s.type === 'WhileStat' || s.type === 'RepeatStat' || s.type === 'NumericForStat' || s.type === 'GenericForStat';
      const changed = nested.length ? assignedIn(s) : new Set<string>();
      const base: St = loop ? { holders: new Map([...st.holders].filter(([k]) => !changed.has(k))), lits: new Map([...st.lits].filter(([k]) => !changed.has(k))) } : st;

}

const patchKey = (p: PatchSpec) => p.table + '|' + (p.anyKey || p.key === undefined ? '*' : (typeof p.key === 'number' ? 'n:' + p.key : 's:' + p.key));

  let changed = false;

  }

}
