// Static resolution of run-time patched dump-record slots (self-modifying bytecode).
//
// After patch discovery every instruction whose opcode/operand slot is written by the program is
// specialised once per possible value and selected by reading the slot (`if K_7[262] == 101 then …`).
// This pass runs a forward must-analysis over the cleaned, structured residual code of every proto:
// slots definitely stored (directly `K_n[k] = v` or through a register holding the record) are known
// at later reads, which are replaced by the stored literal. Single-valued slots (every store in the
// program writes the same literal) are monotone: once written they keep the value across calls, loops
// and closure boundaries, so the state at a closure-creation site (`MAKER(PROTO_n, …)`) is a valid
// entry state for proto n. Multi-valued slots are tracked straight-line only (calls / aliasing stores kill).
// Stores into records whose slots are no longer read anywhere are dropped afterwards.
import type * as A from '../ast.js';
import { printExpr } from './specialize.js';
import type { PatchSpec } from './specialize.js';

type Lit = number | string | boolean | null;
interface SlotInfo { values: Lit[]; dynamic: boolean; single: boolean; }
interface St { known: Map<string, Lit>; holders: Map<string, string>; lits: Map<string, Lit>; }
export interface ResolveReport { resolved: number; remaining: number; dropped: number; notes: string[]; }

const unparen = (e: A.Expr): A.Expr => { while (e && e.type === 'ParenExpr') e = e.expr; return e; };
const litOf = (e: A.Expr | undefined): { ok: boolean; v: Lit } => {
  const u = e ? unparen(e) : undefined;
  if (!u) return { ok: false, v: null };
  if (u.type === 'NumberLit') return { ok: true, v: u.value };
  if (u.type === 'UnExpr' && u.op === '-' && unparen(u.expr).type === 'NumberLit') return { ok: true, v: -(unparen(u.expr) as A.NumberLit).value };
  if (u.type === 'StringLit') return { ok: true, v: u.value };
  if (u.type === 'TrueLit') return { ok: true, v: true };
  if (u.type === 'FalseLit') return { ok: true, v: false };
  if (u.type === 'NilLit') return { ok: true, v: null };
  return { ok: false, v: null };
};
const numRaw = (v: number) => Number.isInteger(v) ? String(v) : String(v);
const litExpr = (v: Lit): A.Expr => {
  if (v === null) return { type: 'NilLit' };
  if (v === true) return { type: 'TrueLit' };
  if (v === false) return { type: 'FalseLit' };
  if (typeof v === 'number') return v < 0 ? { type: 'UnExpr', op: '-', expr: { type: 'NumberLit', value: -v, raw: numRaw(-v) } } : { type: 'NumberLit', value: v, raw: numRaw(v) };
  return { type: 'StringLit', value: v, raw: '' };
};
const slotKey = (tid: string, k: Lit) => tid + '|' + (typeof k === 'number' ? 'n:' + k : 's:' + String(k));
const keyStr = (k: Lit) => typeof k === 'number' ? numRaw(k) : JSON.stringify(k);
/** tracked expression keys: `name` or `name[literal]` */
const trackKey = (e: A.Expr): string | null => {
  const u = unparen(e);
  if (u.type === 'NameExpr') return u.name;
  if (u.type === 'IndexExpr') { const o = unparen(u.obj); const k = litOf(u.index); if (o.type === 'NameExpr' && k.ok && (typeof k.v === 'number' || typeof k.v === 'string')) return o.name + '[' + keyStr(k.v) + ']'; }
  return null;
};
const copySt = (s: St): St => ({ known: new Map(s.known), holders: new Map(s.holders), lits: new Map(s.lits) });
function meet(states: Array<St | null>): St | null {
  const live = states.filter((s): s is St => !!s);
  if (!live.length) return null;
  const out = copySt(live[0]);
  for (const s of live.slice(1)) {
    for (const [k, v] of out.known) if (!s.known.has(k) || s.known.get(k) !== v) out.known.delete(k);
    for (const [k, v] of out.holders) if (s.holders.get(k) !== v) out.holders.delete(k);
    for (const [k, v] of out.lits) if (!s.lits.has(k) || s.lits.get(k) !== v) out.lits.delete(k);
  }
  return out;
}

export interface ResolveOptions {
  /** residual record name -> dump table id (K_n / PROTO_n) */
  recordId: (name: string) => string | null;
  /** dump value of a record slot (to seed slots whose only written value equals it) */
  dumpValue?: (tid: string, key: number | string) => unknown;
  /** closure creation site -> created proto id */
  createdProto?: (call: A.CallExpr) => string | null;
}

export function resolvePatchedReads(protos: Array<{ id: string; chunk: A.Chunk }>, patches: PatchSpec[], o: ResolveOptions): ResolveReport {
  const rep: ResolveReport = { resolved: 0, remaining: 0, dropped: 0, notes: [] };
  const slots = new Map<string, SlotInfo>();
  const dynTables = new Set<string>();
  for (const p of patches) {
    if (p.anyKey || p.key === undefined) { dynTables.add(p.table); continue; }
    const sk = slotKey(p.table, p.key);
    let e = slots.get(sk); if (!e) { e = { values: [], dynamic: false, single: false }; slots.set(sk, e); }
    for (const v of p.values) if (!e.values.some(x => x === v)) e.values.push(v);
    if (p.dynamic) e.dynamic = true;
  }
  const patchedTables = new Set<string>([...dynTables, ...[...slots.keys()].map(k => k.slice(0, k.indexOf('|')))]);
  const seed = new Map<string, Lit>();
  for (const [sk, e] of slots) {
    const tid = sk.slice(0, sk.indexOf('|'));
    e.single = !e.dynamic && e.values.length === 1 && !dynTables.has(tid);
    if (e.single && o.dumpValue) {
      const kk = sk.slice(sk.indexOf('|') + 1); const key: number | string = kk.startsWith('n:') ? Number(kk.slice(2)) : kk.slice(2);
      const dv = o.dumpValue(tid, key);
      const d = dv === undefined ? null : dv;
      if ((typeof d === 'number' || typeof d === 'string' || typeof d === 'boolean' || d === null) && d === e.values[0]) seed.set(sk, d);
    }
  }
  const slotOf = (tid: string, k: Lit): SlotInfo | null => dynTables.has(tid) ? { values: [], dynamic: true, single: false } : (slots.get(slotKey(tid, k)) ?? null);
  const remainingBy = new Map<string, number>();
  const escaped = new Set<string>();
  // ---- creation graph
  const created = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  const creators = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  const scanCalls = (node: any, fn: (c: A.CallExpr) => void) => { const st: any[] = [node]; while (st.length) { const x = st.pop(); if (!x || typeof x !== 'object') continue; if (Array.isArray(x)) { for (const y of x) st.push(y); continue; } if (x.type === 'CallExpr') fn(x); for (const k of Object.keys(x)) if (k !== 'loc') st.push(x[k]); } };
  for (const p of protos) {
    const s = new Set<string>();
    if (o.createdProto) scanCalls(p.chunk, (c) => { const id = o.createdProto!(c); if (id !== null) s.add(id); });
    created.set(p.id, s);
    for (const c of s) { let cs = creators.get(c); if (!cs) { cs = new Set(); creators.set(c, cs); } cs.add(p.id); }
  }
  const byId = new Map(protos.map(p => [p.id, p]));
  const order: string[] = []; const done = new Set<string>();
  const indeg = new Map(protos.map(p => [p.id, [...(creators.get(p.id) ?? [])].filter(c => byId.has(c) && c !== p.id).length]));
  const queue = protos.filter(p => indeg.get(p.id) === 0).map(p => p.id);
  while (queue.length) { const id = queue.shift()!; if (done.has(id)) continue; done.add(id); order.push(id); for (const c of created.get(id) ?? []) { if (!indeg.has(c) || c === id) continue; indeg.set(c, indeg.get(c)! - 1); if (indeg.get(c) === 0) queue.push(c); } }
  const cyclic = new Set(protos.filter(p => !done.has(p.id)).map(p => p.id));
  for (const p of protos) if (!done.has(p.id)) order.push(p.id);
  const entry = new Map<string, Map<string, Lit> | null>();   // proto -> known single-valued slots at every creation site
  // ---- analysis
  let captured = new Set<string>();
  const singlesOf = (st: St) => { const m = new Map<string, Lit>(); for (const [k, v] of st.known) if (slots.get(k)?.single) m.set(k, v); return m; };
  const killCall = (st: St) => {
    for (const k of [...st.holders.keys()]) if (k.includes('[') || captured.has(k)) st.holders.delete(k);
    for (const k of [...st.lits.keys()]) if (k.includes('[') || captured.has(k)) st.lits.delete(k);
    for (const k of [...st.known.keys()]) if (!slots.get(k)?.single) st.known.delete(k);
  };
  const killName = (st: St, n: string) => {
    for (const m of [st.holders, st.lits] as Array<Map<string, unknown>>) for (const k of [...m.keys()]) if (k === n || k.startsWith(n + '[')) m.delete(k);
  };
  const killIndex = (st: St, k: Lit | undefined) => {   // a store X[k] with unknown X (k undefined: non-literal key)
    const suf = k === undefined ? null : '[' + keyStr(k) + ']';
    for (const m of [st.holders, st.lits] as Array<Map<string, unknown>>) for (const key of [...m.keys()]) if (key.includes('[') && (suf === null || key.endsWith(suf))) m.delete(key);
    for (const sk of [...st.known.keys()]) { if (slots.get(sk)?.single) continue; if (k === undefined || sk.endsWith('|' + (typeof k === 'number' ? 'n:' + k : 's:' + String(k)))) st.known.delete(sk); }
  };
  const tableOf = (e: A.Expr, st: St): string | null => {
    const u = unparen(e);
    if (u.type === 'NameExpr') { const r = o.recordId(u.name); if (r !== null) return r; }
    const tk = trackKey(u); return tk === null ? null : (st.holders.get(tk) ?? null);
  };
  const keyOf = (e: A.Expr, st: St): { ok: boolean; v: Lit } => { const l = litOf(e); if (l.ok) return l; const tk = trackKey(e); if (tk !== null && st.lits.has(tk)) return { ok: true, v: st.lits.get(tk)! }; return { ok: false, v: null }; };
  const valueOf = keyOf;
  const noteEscape = (e: A.Expr, st: St) => { const t = tableOf(e, st); if (t !== null && patchedTables.has(t)) escaped.add(t); };

  // expression visitor: resolves patched reads; applies call effects (in evaluation order)
  const visitE = (e: A.Expr, st: St, asBase = false): A.Expr => {
    if (!e || typeof e !== 'object') return e;
    switch (e.type) {
      case 'IndexExpr': {
        e.obj = visitE(e.obj, st, true);
        e.index = visitE(e.index, st);
        const tid = tableOf(e.obj, st);
        if (tid !== null && patchedTables.has(tid)) {
          const k = keyOf(e.index, st);
          if (!k.ok) { rep.remaining++; remainingBy.set(tid, (remainingBy.get(tid) ?? 0) + 1); return e; }
          const si = slotOf(tid, k.v);
          if (si) {
            const sk = slotKey(tid, k.v);
            if (st.known.has(sk)) { rep.resolved++; return litExpr(st.known.get(sk)!); }
            rep.remaining++; remainingBy.set(tid, (remainingBy.get(tid) ?? 0) + 1);
          }
        }
        return e;
      }
      case 'NameExpr': case 'NumberLit': case 'StringLit': case 'NilLit': case 'TrueLit': case 'FalseLit': case 'VarargLit':
        if (!asBase && e.type === 'NameExpr') noteEscape(e, st);
        return e;
      case 'CallExpr': {
        e.callee = visitE(e.callee, st, true);
        e.args = e.args.map(a => { const r = visitE(a, st); noteEscapeDeep(r, st); return r; });
        const pid = o.createdProto ? o.createdProto(e) : null;
        if (pid !== null) { const s = singlesOf(st); const prev = entry.get(pid); entry.set(pid, prev === undefined ? s : (prev === null ? null : new Map([...prev].filter(([k, v]) => s.has(k) && s.get(k) === v)))); }
        killCall(st);
        return e;
      }
      case 'MethodCallExpr': {
        e.obj = visitE(e.obj, st, true);
        e.args = e.args.map(a => { const r = visitE(a, st); noteEscapeDeep(r, st); return r; });
        killCall(st);
        return e;
      }
      case 'FunctionExpr': {
        analyzeFn(e, { known: singlesOf(st), holders: new Map(), lits: new Map() });
        return e;
      }
      case 'BinExpr': {
        e.left = visitE(e.left, st);
        if (e.op === 'and' || e.op === 'or') { const s2 = copySt(st); e.right = visitE(e.right, s2); const m = meet([st, s2])!; st.known = m.known; st.holders = m.holders; st.lits = m.lits; }
        else e.right = visitE(e.right, st);
        return e;
      }
      default: {
        const x: any = e;
        for (const k of Object.keys(x)) {
          if (k === 'loc') continue;
          const v = x[k];
          if (Array.isArray(v)) x[k] = v.map((y: any) => y && typeof y === 'object' && typeof y.type === 'string' ? visitE(y, st) : (y && typeof y === 'object' && 'value' in y && y.value && typeof y.value === 'object' ? { ...y, key: y.key ? visitE(y.key, st) : y.key, value: visitE(y.value, st) } : (y && typeof y === 'object' && y.kind === 'expr' ? { ...y, expr: visitE(y.expr, st) } : y)));
          else if (v && typeof v === 'object' && typeof v.type === 'string') x[k] = visitE(v, st);
        }
        // a record placed into a table constructor escapes
        if (x.type === 'TableExpr') for (const f of x.fields) noteEscapeDeep(f.value, st);
        return e;
      }
    }
  };
  const noteEscapeDeep = (e: A.Expr, st: St) => { const u = unparen(e); if (u.type === 'NameExpr' || u.type === 'IndexExpr') noteEscape(u, st); };

  interface Loop { breaks: Array<St | null>; conts: Array<St | null>; }
  const loopKill = (body: A.Stat[], st: St) => {
    const visit = (x: any) => {
      if (!x || typeof x !== 'object') return;
      if (Array.isArray(x)) { for (const y of x) visit(y); return; }
      if (x.type === 'FunctionExpr') return;
      if (x.type === 'AssignStat') for (const t of x.targets) { const u = unparen(t); if (u.type === 'NameExpr') killName(st, u.name); else if (u.type === 'IndexExpr') { const k = litOf(u.index); const tk = trackKey(u); if (tk) killName(st, tk); killIndex(st, k.ok ? k.v : undefined); } }
      if (x.type === 'LocalStat') for (const n of x.names) killName(st, n);
      if (x.type === 'NumericForStat') killName(st, x.var);
      if (x.type === 'GenericForStat') for (const n of x.names) killName(st, n);
      if (x.type === 'LocalFunctionStat') killName(st, x.name);
      if (x.type === 'CallExpr' || x.type === 'MethodCallExpr') killCall(st);
      for (const k of Object.keys(x)) if (k !== 'loc') visit(x[k]);
    };
    visit(body);
  };
  const assign = (st: St, target: A.Expr, value: A.Expr | undefined, valueIsLast: boolean) => {
    const u = unparen(target);
    if (u.type === 'NameExpr') {
      killName(st, u.name);
      if (value) { const t = tableOf(value, st); if (t !== null) st.holders.set(u.name, t); const l = valueOf(value, st); if (l.ok) st.lits.set(u.name, l.v); }
      else if (!valueIsLast) st.lits.set(u.name, null);
      return;
    }
    if (u.type === 'IndexExpr') {
      const tid = tableOf(u.obj, st);
      const k = keyOf(u.index, st);
      if (tid !== null) {
        if (patchedTables.has(tid)) {
          if (k.ok) { const sk = slotKey(tid, k.v); const v = value ? valueOf(value, st) : (valueIsLast ? { ok: false, v: null } : { ok: true, v: null }); if (v.ok) st.known.set(sk, v.v); else if (!slots.get(sk)?.single) st.known.delete(sk); }
          else for (const sk of [...st.known.keys()]) if (sk.startsWith(tid + '|') && !slots.get(sk)?.single) st.known.delete(sk);
        }
      } else killIndex(st, k.ok ? k.v : undefined);
      const tk = trackKey(u);
      if (tk !== null) {
        killName(st, tk);
        if (value) { const t = tableOf(value, st); if (t !== null) st.holders.set(tk, t); const l = valueOf(value, st); if (l.ok) st.lits.set(tk, l.v); }
      }
      return;
    }
  };
  const list = (stmts: A.Stat[], st: St | null, loop: Loop | null): St | null => {
    for (const s of stmts) {
      if (!st) return null;
      st = stat(s, st, loop);
    }
    return st;
  };
  const stat = (s: A.Stat, st: St, loop: Loop | null): St | null => {
    switch (s.type) {
      case 'LocalStat': {
        s.init = s.init.map(e => visitE(e, st));
        s.names.forEach((n, i) => assign(st, { type: 'NameExpr', name: n }, s.init[i], i >= s.init.length && s.init.length > 0 && isMulti(s.init[s.init.length - 1])));
        return st;
      }
      case 'AssignStat': {
        if (s.op) { s.values = s.values.map(e => visitE(e, st)); for (const t of s.targets) { visitTargetParts(t, st); assign(st, t, undefined, true); } return st; }
        for (const t of s.targets) visitTargetParts(t, st);
        s.values = s.values.map(e => visitE(e, st));
        s.targets.forEach((t, i) => assign(st, t, s.values[i], i >= s.values.length && s.values.length > 0 && isMulti(s.values[s.values.length - 1])));
        return st;
      }
      case 'CallStat': { s.expr = visitE(s.expr, st) as any; return st; }
      case 'DoStat': return list(s.body, st, loop);
      case 'IfStat': {
        const ends: Array<St | null> = [];
        let cur: St = st;
        for (const c of s.clauses) {
          c.cond = visitE(c.cond, cur);
          ends.push(list(c.body, copySt(cur), loop));
        }
        if (s.elseBody) ends.push(list(s.elseBody, copySt(cur), loop)); else ends.push(cur);
        return meet(ends);
      }
      case 'WhileStat': {
        const head = copySt(st); loopKill(s.body, head);
        const always = unparen(s.cond).type === 'TrueLit';
        s.cond = visitE(s.cond, head);
        const lp: Loop = { breaks: [], conts: [] };
        list(s.body, copySt(head), lp);
        return meet(always ? lp.breaks : [head, ...lp.breaks]);
      }
      case 'RepeatStat': {
        const once = unparen(s.cond).type === 'TrueLit';
        const head = copySt(st); if (!once) loopKill(s.body, head);
        const lp: Loop = { breaks: [], conts: [] };
        const end = list(s.body, head, lp);
        const atCond = meet([end, ...lp.conts]);
        if (atCond) s.cond = visitE(s.cond, atCond);
        return meet([atCond, ...lp.breaks]);
      }
      case 'NumericForStat': {
        s.from = visitE(s.from, st); s.to = visitE(s.to, st); if (s.step) s.step = visitE(s.step, st);
        const head = copySt(st); loopKill(s.body, head); killName(head, s.var);
        const lp: Loop = { breaks: [], conts: [] };
        list(s.body, copySt(head), lp);
        return meet([head, ...lp.breaks]);
      }
      case 'GenericForStat': {
        s.iters = s.iters.map(e => visitE(e, st));
        killCall(st);
        const head = copySt(st); loopKill(s.body, head); for (const n of s.names) killName(head, n);
        const lp: Loop = { breaks: [], conts: [] };
        list(s.body, copySt(head), lp);
        return meet([head, ...lp.breaks]);
      }
      case 'ReturnStat': { s.args = s.args.map(e => { const r = visitE(e, st); noteEscapeDeep(r, st); return r; }); return null; }
      case 'BreakStat': { if (loop) loop.breaks.push(copySt(st)); return null; }
      case 'ContinueStat': { if (loop) loop.conts.push(copySt(st)); return null; }
      case 'FunctionStat': { visitTargetParts(s.target, st); analyzeFn(s.func, { known: singlesOf(st), holders: new Map(), lits: new Map() }); assign(st, s.target, undefined, true); return st; }
      case 'LocalFunctionStat': { killName(st, s.name); analyzeFn(s.func, { known: singlesOf(st), holders: new Map(), lits: new Map() }); return st; }
      case 'GotoStat': case 'LabelStat': { return { known: singlesOf(st), holders: new Map(), lits: new Map() }; }
      default: return st;
    }
  };
  const visitTargetParts = (t: A.Expr, st: St) => {
    const u = unparen(t);
    if (u.type === 'IndexExpr') { u.obj = visitE(u.obj, st, true); u.index = visitE(u.index, st); }
    else if (u.type === 'MemberExpr') u.obj = visitE(u.obj, st, true);
  };
  const isMulti = (e: A.Expr) => { const u = e; return u.type === 'CallExpr' || u.type === 'MethodCallExpr' || u.type === 'VarargLit'; };
  const analyzeFn = (f: A.FunctionExpr, st: St) => { for (const p of f.params) killName(st, p); list(f.body, st, null); };

  for (const id of order) {
    const p = byId.get(id)!;
    captured = new Set<string>();
    // names referenced inside nested functions (a call may change them)
    const collect = (x: any, depth: number) => { if (!x || typeof x !== 'object') return; if (Array.isArray(x)) { for (const y of x) collect(y, depth); return; } if (x.type === 'FunctionExpr') { for (const k of Object.keys(x)) if (k !== 'loc') collect(x[k], depth + 1); return; } if (x.type === 'NameExpr' && depth > 1) captured.add(x.name); for (const k of Object.keys(x)) if (k !== 'loc') collect(x[k], depth); };
    collect(p.chunk, 0);
    const ent = cyclic.has(id) ? null : entry.get(id);
    const known = new Map<string, Lit>(seed);
    if (ent) for (const [k, v] of ent) known.set(k, v);
    list(p.chunk.body, { known, holders: new Map(), lits: new Map() }, null);
  }
  // ---- drop stores into records that are never read any more
  const dead = new Set([...patchedTables].filter(t => !(remainingBy.get(t)) && !escaped.has(t)));
  if (dead.size) {
    for (const p of protos) rep.dropped += dropStores(p.chunk, dead, o.recordId);
  }
  rep.notes.push(`patched-slot reads resolved statically: ${rep.resolved}, still read at run time: ${rep.remaining}${remainingBy.size ? ' (' + [...remainingBy].slice(0, 12).map(([t, n]) => `K_${t}×${n}`).join(', ') + ')' : ''}`);
  if (rep.dropped) rep.notes.push(`${rep.dropped} store(s) into ${dead.size} record(s) no longer read anywhere removed`);
  if (escaped.size) rep.notes.push(`patched record(s) escaping into calls/tables (kept): ${[...escaped].slice(0, 12).map(t => 'K_' + t).join(', ')}`);
  return rep;
}

/** remove `R[k] = v` stores (direct or through a straight-line holder) into dead records; values must be side-effect free */
function dropStores(chunk: A.Chunk, dead: Set<string>, recordId: (n: string) => string | null): number {
  let n = 0;
  const pure = (e: A.Expr): boolean => { const u = unparen(e); switch (u.type) { case 'NumberLit': case 'StringLit': case 'NilLit': case 'TrueLit': case 'FalseLit': case 'NameExpr': return true; case 'UnExpr': return pure(u.expr); case 'BinExpr': return pure(u.left) && pure(u.right); case 'IndexExpr': return pure(u.obj) && pure(u.index); default: return false; } };
  const list = (stmts: A.Stat[], holders: Map<string, string>): A.Stat[] => {
    const out: A.Stat[] = [];
    for (const s of stmts) {
      if (s.type === 'AssignStat' && !s.op && s.targets.length === 1 && s.values.length === 1) {
        const t = unparen(s.targets[0]);
        if (t.type === 'IndexExpr') {
          const o = unparen(t.obj);
          const tk = trackKey(o);
          const tid = (o.type === 'NameExpr' ? recordId(o.name) : null) ?? (tk !== null ? holders.get(tk) ?? null : null);
          if (tid !== null && dead.has(tid) && pure(s.values[0]) && pure(t.index)) { n++; continue; }
        }
        const tk = trackKey(t);
        if (tk !== null) {
          for (const k of [...holders.keys()]) if (k === tk || k.startsWith(tk + '[')) holders.delete(k);
          const v = unparen(s.values[0]);
          const rid = v.type === 'NameExpr' ? recordId(v.name) : null;
          if (rid !== null) holders.set(tk, rid);
        } else if (t.type === 'IndexExpr') for (const k of [...holders.keys()]) if (k.includes('[')) holders.delete(k);
        walkNested(s, holders);
        out.push(s); continue;
      }

// Static resolution of run-time patched dump-record slots (self-modifying bytecode).
//
// After patch discovery every instruction whose opcode/operand slot is written by the program is
// specialised once per possible value and selected by reading the slot (`if K_7[262] == 101 then …`).
// A forward must-analysis decides which slots are definitely stored before such a read: stores are
// direct (`K_n[k] = v`) or through a register/local holding the record (`R[33] = K_7; R[33][262] = 101`).
// Single-valued slots (every store in the program writes the same literal) are monotone — once
// written they keep the value across calls, loops and closure boundaries — so the state at a
// closure-creation site (`MAKER(PROTO_n, …)`) is a valid entry state for proto n.
//  * analyzeBlockGraph: on the residual state machine of one proto (blocks keyed by pc, `pc = K`
//    transfers) — optimistic reachability + must-analysis (SCCP style); resolved reads are replaced
//    by literals, unreachable blocks reported.
//  * resolvePatchedReads: on cleaned structured code (all protos) — remaining reads, and stores into
//    records that are no longer read anywhere are dropped.
import type * as A from '../ast.js';
import { printExpr } from './specialize.js';
import type { PatchSpec } from './specialize.js';
import { fold } from '../passes/fold.js';

export type Lit = number | string | boolean | null;
interface SlotInfo { values: Lit[]; dynamic: boolean; single: boolean; }
interface St { known: Map<string, Lit>; holders: Map<string, string>; lits: Map<string, Lit>; }
export type Known = Map<string, Lit>;

const unparen = (e: A.Expr): A.Expr => { while (e && e.type === 'ParenExpr') e = e.expr; return e; };
const clone = <T>(x: T): T => structuredClone(x);
export const litOf = (e: A.Expr | undefined): { ok: boolean; v: Lit } => {
  const u = e ? unparen(e) : undefined;
  if (!u) return { ok: false, v: null };
  if (u.type === 'NumberLit') return { ok: true, v: u.value };
  if (u.type === 'UnExpr' && u.op === '-' && unparen(u.expr).type === 'NumberLit') return { ok: true, v: -(unparen(u.expr) as A.NumberLit).value };
  if (u.type === 'StringLit') return { ok: true, v: u.value };
  if (u.type === 'TrueLit') return { ok: true, v: true };
  if (u.type === 'FalseLit') return { ok: true, v: false };
  if (u.type === 'NilLit') return { ok: true, v: null };
  return { ok: false, v: null };
};
const numRaw = (v: number) => String(v);
const litExpr = (v: Lit): A.Expr => {
  if (v === null) return { type: 'NilLit' };
  if (v === true) return { type: 'TrueLit' };
  if (v === false) return { type: 'FalseLit' };
  if (typeof v === 'number') return v < 0 ? { type: 'UnExpr', op: '-', expr: { type: 'NumberLit', value: -v, raw: numRaw(-v) } } : { type: 'NumberLit', value: v, raw: numRaw(v) };
  return { type: 'StringLit', value: v, raw: '' };
};
export const slotKey = (tid: string, k: Lit) => tid + '|' + (typeof k === 'number' ? 'n:' + k : 's:' + String(k));
const keyStr = (k: Lit) => typeof k === 'number' ? numRaw(k) : JSON.stringify(k);
/** tracked expression keys: `name` or `name[literal]` */
const trackKey = (e: A.Expr): string | null => {
  const u = unparen(e);
  if (u.type === 'NameExpr') return u.name;
  if (u.type === 'IndexExpr') { const o = unparen(u.obj); const k = litOf(u.index); if (o.type === 'NameExpr' && k.ok && (typeof k.v === 'number' || typeof k.v === 'string')) return o.name + '[' + keyStr(k.v) + ']'; }
  return null;
};
const copySt = (s: St): St => ({ known: new Map(s.known), holders: new Map(s.holders), lits: new Map(s.lits) });
export const intersect = (a: Known, b: Known): Known => { const m = new Map<string, Lit>(); for (const [k, v] of a) if (b.has(k) && b.get(k) === v) m.set(k, v); return m; };
function meet(states: Array<St | null>): St | null {
  const live = states.filter((s): s is St => !!s);
  if (!live.length) return null;
  const out = copySt(live[0]);
  for (const s of live.slice(1)) {
    for (const [k, v] of out.known) if (!s.known.has(k) || s.known.get(k) !== v) out.known.delete(k);
    for (const [k, v] of out.holders) if (s.holders.get(k) !== v) out.holders.delete(k);
    for (const [k, v] of out.lits) if (!s.lits.has(k) || s.lits.get(k) !== v) out.lits.delete(k);
  }
  return out;
}
const truth = (e: A.Expr): boolean | null => {
  const ch: A.Chunk = { type: 'Chunk', body: [{ type: 'ReturnStat', args: [clone(e)] }] };
  try { fold(ch); } catch { return null; }
  const u = unparen((ch.body[0] as A.ReturnStat).args[0]);
  if (u.type === 'TrueLit' || u.type === 'NumberLit' || u.type === 'StringLit' || u.type === 'TableExpr' || u.type === 'FunctionExpr') return true;
  if (u.type === 'FalseLit' || u.type === 'NilLit') return false;
  return null;
};

/** the written slots of all dump records */
export class PatchModel {
  readonly slots = new Map<string, SlotInfo>();
  readonly dynTables = new Set<string>();
  readonly tables = new Set<string>();
  constructor(patches: PatchSpec[]) {
    for (const p of patches) {
      const t = String(p.table);
      this.tables.add(t);
      if (p.anyKey || p.key === undefined) { this.dynTables.add(t); continue; }
      const sk = slotKey(t, p.key);
      let e = this.slots.get(sk); if (!e) { e = { values: [], dynamic: false, single: false }; this.slots.set(sk, e); }
      for (const v of p.values) if (!e.values.some(x => x === v)) e.values.push(v);
      if (p.dynamic) e.dynamic = true;
    }
    for (const [sk, e] of this.slots) e.single = !e.dynamic && e.values.length === 1 && !this.dynTables.has(sk.slice(0, sk.indexOf('|')));
  }
  slot(tid: string, k: Lit): SlotInfo | null { return this.dynTables.has(tid) ? { values: [], dynamic: true, single: false } : (this.slots.get(slotKey(tid, k)) ?? null); }
  single(sk: string): boolean { return !!this.slots.get(sk)?.single; }
}

export interface AnalyzerHooks {
  model: PatchModel;
  recordId: (name: string) => string | null;
  createdProto?: (call: A.CallExpr) => string | null;
  /** replace resolved reads in the AST (otherwise expressions are evaluated on copies) */
  mutate: boolean;
  /** state-machine mode: assignments `pcVar = K` are edges */
  pcVar?: string;
  onEdge?: (target: number | null, known: Known) => void;
  onCreate?: (proto: string, known: Known) => void;
  onRead?: (tid: string, resolved: boolean) => void;
  onEscape?: (tid: string) => void;
  /** names a call may change (captured by closures) */
  captured?: Set<string>;
}
interface Loop { breaks: Array<St | null>; conts: Array<St | null>; }

/** statement-level must-analysis (one function body / block list) */
export function makeAnalyzer(h: AnalyzerHooks) {
  const model = h.model;
  const captured = h.captured ?? new Set<string>();
  const singlesOf = (st: St): Known => { const m = new Map<string, Lit>(); for (const [k, v] of st.known) if (model.single(k)) m.set(k, v); return m; };
  const killCall = (st: St) => {
    for (const k of [...st.holders.keys()]) if (k.includes('[') || captured.has(k)) st.holders.delete(k);
    for (const k of [...st.lits.keys()]) if (k.includes('[') || captured.has(k)) st.lits.delete(k);
    for (const k of [...st.known.keys()]) if (!model.single(k)) st.known.delete(k);
  };
  const killName = (st: St, n: string) => {
    for (const m of [st.holders, st.lits] as Array<Map<string, unknown>>) for (const k of [...m.keys()]) if (k === n || k.startsWith(n + '[')) m.delete(k);
  };
  const killIndex = (st: St, k: Lit | undefined) => {   // a store X[k] into an unknown table
    const suf = k === undefined ? null : '[' + keyStr(k) + ']';
    for (const m of [st.holders, st.lits] as Array<Map<string, unknown>>) for (const key of [...m.keys()]) if (key.includes('[') && (suf === null || key.endsWith(suf))) m.delete(key);
    const ks = k === undefined ? null : '|' + (typeof k === 'number' ? 'n:' + k : 's:' + String(k));
    for (const sk of [...st.known.keys()]) { if (model.single(sk)) continue; if (ks === null || sk.endsWith(ks)) st.known.delete(sk); }
  };
  const tableOf = (e: A.Expr, st: St): string | null => {
    const u = unparen(e);
    if (u.type === 'NameExpr') { const r = h.recordId(u.name); if (r !== null) return r; }
    const tk = trackKey(u); return tk === null ? null : (st.holders.get(tk) ?? null);
  };
  const keyOf = (e: A.Expr, st: St): { ok: boolean; v: Lit } => { const l = litOf(e); if (l.ok) return l; const tk = trackKey(e); if (tk !== null && st.lits.has(tk)) return { ok: true, v: st.lits.get(tk)! }; return { ok: false, v: null }; };
  const escape = (e: A.Expr, st: St) => { if (!h.onEscape) return; const u = unparen(e); if (u.type !== 'NameExpr' && u.type !== 'IndexExpr') return; const t = tableOf(u, st); if (t !== null && model.tables.has(t)) h.onEscape(t); };

  const visitE = (e: A.Expr, st: St, ctx: 'value' | 'base' | 'copy' = 'value'): A.Expr => {

      }

      }

      case 'BinExpr': {
        e.left = visitE(e.left, st);
        if (e.op === 'and' || e.op === 'or') { const s2 = copySt(st); e.right = visitE(e.right, s2); const m = meet([st, s2])!; st.known = m.known; st.holders = m.holders; st.lits = m.lits; }

        for (const k of Object.keys(x)) {
          if (k === 'loc') continue;
          const v = x[k];
          if (Array.isArray(v)) x[k] = v.map((y: any) => y && typeof y === 'object' && typeof y.type === 'string' ? visitE(y, st) : (y && typeof y === 'object' && y.kind === 'expr' ? { ...y, expr: visitE(y.expr, st) } : y));
          else if (v && typeof v === 'object' && typeof v.type === 'string') x[k] = visitE(v, st);
        }
        return e;
      }
    }
  };
  /** evaluate an expression slot of a statement (copy unless mutating) */
  const ev = (e: A.Expr, st: St, ctx: 'value' | 'base' | 'copy' = 'value'): A.Expr => visitE(h.mutate ? e : clone(e), st, ctx);
  const fnBody = (f: A.FunctionExpr, st: St) => {
    const s2: St = { known: singlesOf(st), holders: new Map(), lits: new Map() };
    const sub = makeAnalyzer({ ...h, pcVar: undefined, onEdge: undefined });
    sub.list(f.body, s2);
  };
  const loopKill = (body: A.Stat[], st: St) => {
    const visit = (x: any) => {
      if (!x || typeof x !== 'object') return;
      if (Array.isArray(x)) { for (const y of x) visit(y); return; }
      if (x.type === 'FunctionExpr') return;
      if (x.type === 'AssignStat') for (const t of x.targets) { const u = unparen(t); if (u.type === 'NameExpr') killName(st, u.name); else if (u.type === 'IndexExpr') { const k = litOf(u.index); const tk = trackKey(u); if (tk) killName(st, tk); killIndex(st, k.ok ? k.v : undefined); } }
      if (x.type === 'LocalStat') for (const n of x.names) killName(st, n);
      if (x.type === 'NumericForStat') killName(st, x.var);
      if (x.type === 'GenericForStat') for (const n of x.names) killName(st, n);
      if (x.type === 'LocalFunctionStat') killName(st, x.name);
      if (x.type === 'CallExpr' || x.type === 'MethodCallExpr') killCall(st);
      for (const k of Object.keys(x)) if (k !== 'loc') visit(x[k]);
    };
    visit(body);
  };
  const isMulti = (e: A.Expr | undefined) => !!e && (e.type === 'CallExpr' || e.type === 'MethodCallExpr' || e.type === 'VarargLit');
  const assign = (st: St, target: A.Expr, value: A.Expr | undefined, valueUnknown: boolean) => {
    const u = unparen(target);
    const setTrack = (tk: string) => {
      killName(st, tk);
      if (value) { const t = tableOf(value, st); if (t !== null) st.holders.set(tk, t); const l = keyOf(value, st); if (l.ok) st.lits.set(tk, l.v); }
      else if (!valueUnknown) st.lits.set(tk, null);
    };
    if (u.type === 'NameExpr') { setTrack(u.name); return; }
    if (u.type === 'IndexExpr') {
      const tid = tableOf(u.obj, st);
      const k = keyOf(u.index, st);
      if (tid !== null) {
        if (model.tables.has(tid)) {
          if (k.ok) {
            const sk = slotKey(tid, k.v);
            const v = value ? keyOf(value, st) : (valueUnknown ? { ok: false, v: null as Lit } : { ok: true, v: null as Lit });
            if (v.ok && model.slot(tid, k.v)) st.known.set(sk, v.v); else if (!model.single(sk)) st.known.delete(sk);
          } else for (const sk of [...st.known.keys()]) if (sk.startsWith(tid + '|') && !model.single(sk)) st.known.delete(sk);
        }
      } else killIndex(st, k.ok ? k.v : undefined);
      const tk = trackKey(u);
      if (tk !== null) setTrack(tk);
      return;
    }
  };
  const list = (stmts: A.Stat[], st: St | null, loop: Loop | null = null): St | null => {
    for (const s of stmts) { if (!st) return null; st = stat(s, st, loop); }
    return st;
  };
  const stat = (s: A.Stat, st: St, loop: Loop | null): St | null => {
    switch (s.type) {
      case 'LocalStat': {
        const vals = s.init.map(e => ev(e, st, 'copy'));
        if (h.mutate) s.init = vals;
        s.names.forEach((n, i) => assign(st, { type: 'NameExpr', name: n }, vals[i], i >= vals.length && isMulti(vals[vals.length - 1])));
        return st;
      }
      case 'AssignStat': {
        const tgts = s.targets.map(t => { const u = h.mutate ? t : clone(t); const x = unparen(u); if (x.type === 'IndexExpr') { x.obj = visitE(x.obj, st, 'base'); x.index = visitE(x.index, st); } else if (x.type === 'MemberExpr') x.obj = visitE(x.obj, st, 'base'); return u; });
        if (h.mutate) s.targets = tgts;
        if (s.op) { const vals = s.values.map(e => ev(e, st)); if (h.mutate) s.values = vals; for (const t of tgts) assign(st, t, undefined, true); return st; }
        const vals = s.values.map((e, i) => ev(e, st, tgts[i] && trackKey(tgts[i]) !== null ? 'copy' : 'value'));
        if (h.mutate) s.values = vals;
        // state transfer
        if (h.pcVar && tgts.length === 1 && unparen(tgts[0]).type === 'NameExpr' && (unparen(tgts[0]) as A.NameExpr).name === h.pcVar) {
          const v = litOf(vals[0]);
          h.onEdge?.(v.ok && typeof v.v === 'number' ? v.v : null, new Map(st.known));
          return st;
        }
        tgts.forEach((t, i) => assign(st, t, vals[i], i >= vals.length && isMulti(vals[vals.length - 1])));
        return st;
      }
      case 'CallStat': {
        const c = ev(s.expr, st) as any; if (h.mutate) s.expr = c;
        if (c.type === 'CallExpr' && c.callee.type === 'NameExpr' && c.callee.name === 'error') return null;
        return st;
      }
      case 'DoStat': return list(s.body, st, loop);
      case 'IfStat': {
        const ends: Array<St | null> = [];
        let decided = false;
        for (const c of s.clauses) {
          const cond = ev(c.cond, st); if (h.mutate) c.cond = cond;
          const t = truth(cond);
          if (t === false) continue;
          ends.push(list(c.body, copySt(st), loop));
          if (t === true) { decided = true; break; }
        }
        if (!decided) ends.push(s.elseBody ? list(s.elseBody, copySt(st), loop) : st);
        return meet(ends);
      }
      case 'WhileStat': {
        const head = copySt(st); loopKill(s.body, head);
        const cond = ev(s.cond, head); if (h.mutate) s.cond = cond;
        const t = truth(cond);
        if (t === false) return head;
        const lp: Loop = { breaks: [], conts: [] };
        list(s.body, copySt(head), lp);
        return meet(t === true ? lp.breaks : [head, ...lp.breaks]);
      }
      case 'RepeatStat': {
        const once = truth(s.cond) === true;
        const head = copySt(st); if (!once) loopKill(s.body, head);
        const lp: Loop = { breaks: [], conts: [] };
        const end = list(s.body, head, lp);
        const atCond = meet([end, ...lp.conts]);
        if (atCond) { const cond = ev(s.cond, atCond); if (h.mutate) s.cond = cond; }
        return meet([atCond, ...lp.breaks]);
      }
      case 'NumericForStat': {
        const f = ev(s.from, st), t = ev(s.to, st), p = s.step ? ev(s.step, st) : undefined;
        if (h.mutate) { s.from = f; s.to = t; s.step = p; }
        const head = copySt(st); loopKill(s.body, head); killName(head, s.var);
        const lp: Loop = { breaks: [], conts: [] };
        list(s.body, copySt(head), lp);
        return meet([head, ...lp.breaks]);
      }
      case 'GenericForStat': {
        const its = s.iters.map(e => ev(e, st)); if (h.mutate) s.iters = its;
        killCall(st);
        const head = copySt(st); loopKill(s.body, head); for (const n of s.names) killName(head, n);
        const lp: Loop = { breaks: [], conts: [] };
        list(s.body, copySt(head), lp);
        return meet([head, ...lp.breaks]);
      }
      case 'ReturnStat': { const a = s.args.map(e => ev(e, st)); if (h.mutate) s.args = a; return null; }
      case 'BreakStat': { if (loop) loop.breaks.push(copySt(st)); return null; }
      case 'ContinueStat': { if (loop) loop.conts.push(copySt(st)); return null; }
      case 'FunctionStat': { fnBody(s.func, st); assign(st, s.target, undefined, true); return st; }
      case 'LocalFunctionStat': { killName(st, s.name); fnBody(s.func, st); return st; }
      case 'GotoStat': case 'LabelStat': return { known: singlesOf(st), holders: new Map(), lits: new Map() };
      default: return st;
    }
  };
  return { list, fresh: (known: Known): St => ({ known: new Map(known), holders: new Map(), lits: new Map() }) };
}

/** names referenced inside nested functions (a call may change them) */
export function capturedNames(root: any): Set<string> {
  const out = new Set<string>();
  const visit = (x: any, depth: number) => {
    if (!x || typeof x !== 'object') return;
    if (Array.isArray(x)) { for (const y of x) visit(y, depth); return; }
    if (x.type === 'FunctionExpr') { for (const k of Object.keys(x)) if (k !== 'loc') visit(x[k], depth + 1); return; }
    if (x.type === 'NameExpr' && depth > 1) out.add(x.name);
    for (const k of Object.keys(x)) if (k !== 'loc') visit(x[k], depth);
  };
  visit(root, 0);
  return out;
}

export interface BlockGraphResult { reached: Set<number>; resolved: number; unresolved: number; creates: Map<string, Known>; }
/** must-analysis over the residual state machine of one proto; resolved reads are replaced in `blocks` */
export function analyzeBlockGraph(blocks: Map<number, A.Stat[]>, entryPc: number, entryKnown: Known, hooks: Omit<AnalyzerHooks, 'mutate' | 'onEdge' | 'pcVar'> & { pcVar: string }): BlockGraphResult {
  const IN = new Map<number, Known>([[entryPc, new Map(entryKnown)]]);
  const work: number[] = [entryPc];
  const all = [...blocks.keys()];
  let guard = 0;
  while (work.length && guard++ < 200000) {
    const b = work.pop()!;
    const stmts = blocks.get(b); if (!stmts) continue;
    const edges = new Map<number, Known>(); let dyn: Known | null = null;
    const an = makeAnalyzer({ ...hooks, onCreate: undefined, onRead: undefined, onEscape: undefined, mutate: false, onEdge: (t, k) => { if (t === null) dyn = dyn ? intersect(dyn, k) : k; else edges.set(t, edges.has(t) ? intersect(edges.get(t)!, k) : k); } });
    an.list(stmts, an.fresh(IN.get(b)!));
    const outs: Array<[number, Known]> = [...edges];
    if (dyn) for (const t of all) outs.push([t, edges.has(t) ? intersect(edges.get(t)!, dyn) : dyn]);
    for (const [t, k] of outs) {
      if (!blocks.has(t)) continue;
      const prev = IN.get(t);
      if (prev === undefined) { IN.set(t, k); work.push(t); continue; }
      const nk = intersect(prev, k);
      if (nk.size < prev.size) { IN.set(t, nk); work.push(t); }
    }
  }
  const res: BlockGraphResult = { reached: new Set(IN.keys()), resolved: 0, unresolved: 0, creates: new Map() };
  for (const [b, known] of IN) {
    const stmts = blocks.get(b); if (!stmts) continue;
    const an = makeAnalyzer({ ...hooks, mutate: true, onEdge: undefined, onRead: (_t, ok) => { if (ok) res.resolved++; else res.unresolved++; }, onCreate: (pid, k) => { const prev = res.creates.get(pid); res.creates.set(pid, prev ? intersect(prev, k) : k); } });
    an.list(stmts, an.fresh(known));
  }
  return res;
}

export interface ResolveReport { resolved: number; remaining: number; dropped: number; notes: string[]; }
export interface ResolveOptions {
  /** residual record name -> dump table id (K_n / PROTO_n) */
  recordId: (name: string) => string | null;
  /** closure creation site -> created proto id */
  createdProto?: (call: A.CallExpr) => string | null;
}
/** structured code of all protos: resolve remaining patched reads, then drop stores into records no longer read */
export function resolvePatchedReads(protos: Array<{ id: string; chunk: A.Chunk }>, patches: PatchSpec[], o: ResolveOptions): ResolveReport {
  const rep: ResolveReport = { resolved: 0, remaining: 0, dropped: 0, notes: [] };
  const model = new PatchModel(patches);
  const remainingBy = new Map<string, number>();
  const escaped = new Set<string>();
  // creation order (parents first)
  const created = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  const scanCalls = (node: any, fn: (c: A.CallExpr) => void) => { const st: any[] = [node]; while (st.length) { const x = st.pop(); if (!x || typeof x !== 'object') continue; if (Array.isArray(x)) { for (const y of x) st.push(y); continue; } if (x.type === 'CallExpr') fn(x); for (const k of Object.keys(x)) if (k !== 'loc') st.push(x[k]); } };
  for (const p of protos) { const s = new Set<string>(); if (o.createdProto) scanCalls(p.chunk, (c) => { const id = o.createdProto!(c); if (id !== null) s.add(id); }); created.set(p.id, s); }
  const order = creationOrder(protos.map(p => p.id), created);
  const byId = new Map(protos.map(p => [p.id, p]));
  const entry = new Map<string, Known>();
  for (const { id, cyclic } of order) {
    const p = byId.get(id)!;
    const an = makeAnalyzer({ model, recordId: o.recordId, createdProto: o.createdProto, mutate: true, captured: capturedNames(p.chunk),
      onRead: (t, ok) => { if (ok) rep.resolved++; else { rep.remaining++; remainingBy.set(t, (remainingBy.get(t) ?? 0) + 1); } },
      onEscape: (t) => escaped.add(t),
      onCreate: (pid, k) => { const prev = entry.get(pid); entry.set(pid, prev ? intersect(prev, k) : k); } });
    an.list(p.chunk.body, an.fresh(cyclic ? new Map() : (entry.get(id) ?? new Map())));
  }
  const dead = new Set([...model.tables].filter(t => !remainingBy.get(t) && !escaped.has(t)));
  if (dead.size) for (const p of protos) rep.dropped += dropStores(p.chunk, dead, o.recordId);
  rep.notes.push(`patched-slot reads in the structured code: ${rep.resolved} resolved, ${rep.remaining} still read at run time${remainingBy.size ? ' (' + [...remainingBy].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 12).map(([t, n]) => `K_${t}×${n}`).join(', ') + ')' : ''}`);
  if (rep.dropped) rep.notes.push(`${rep.dropped} store(s) into ${dead.size} record(s) that are never read any more removed`);
  if (escaped.size) rep.notes.push(`patched record(s) escaping into calls/tables (kept): ${[...escaped].slice(0, 12).map(t => 'K_' + t).join(', ')}`);
  return rep;
}

/** topological order of the closure-creation graph (parents first); members of cycles last, flagged */
export function creationOrder(ids: string[], created: Map<string, Set<string>>): Array<{ id: string; cyclic: boolean }> {
  const set = new Set(ids);
  const indeg = new Map(ids.map(id => [id, 0]));
  for (const [p, cs] of created) if (set.has(p)) for (const c of cs) if (set.has(c) && c !== p) indeg.set(c, indeg.get(c)! + 1);
  const queue = ids.filter(id => indeg.get(id) === 0);
  const out: Array<{ id: string; cyclic: boolean }> = []; const done = new Set<string>();
  while (queue.length) { const id = queue.shift()!; if (done.has(id)) continue; done.add(id); out.push({ id, cyclic: false }); for (const c of created.get(id) ?? []) { if (!set.has(c) || c === id) continue; indeg.set(c, indeg.get(c)! - 1); if (indeg.get(c) === 0) queue.push(c); } }
  for (const id of ids) if (!done.has(id)) out.push({ id, cyclic: true });
  return out;
}

/** remove `R[k] = v` stores (direct or through a straight-line holder) into dead records; values must be side-effect free */
function dropStores(chunk: A.Chunk, dead: Set<string>, recordId: (n: string) => string | null): number {
  let n = 0;
  const pure = (e: A.Expr): boolean => { const u = unparen(e); switch (u.type) { case 'NumberLit': case 'StringLit': case 'NilLit': case 'TrueLit': case 'FalseLit': case 'NameExpr': return true; case 'UnExpr': return pure(u.expr); case 'BinExpr': return pure(u.left) && pure(u.right); case 'IndexExpr': return pure(u.obj) && pure(u.index); default: return false; } };
  const fns = (x: any, top: boolean) => {
    if (!x || typeof x !== 'object') return;
    if (Array.isArray(x)) { for (const y of x) fns(y, top); return; }
    if (x.type === 'FunctionExpr') { x.body = list(x.body, new Map()); return; }
    for (const k of Object.keys(x)) { if (k === 'loc') continue; if (top && (k === 'body' || k === 'elseBody')) continue; if (top && k === 'clauses') { for (const c of x.clauses) fns(c.cond, false); continue; } fns(x[k], false); }
  };
  const list = (stmts: A.Stat[], holders: Map<string, string>): A.Stat[] => {
    const out: A.Stat[] = [];
    for (const s of stmts) {
      if (s.type === 'AssignStat' && !s.op && s.targets.length === 1 && s.values.length === 1) {
        const t = unparen(s.targets[0]);
        if (t.type === 'IndexExpr') {
          const ob = unparen(t.obj);
          const tk0 = trackKey(ob);
          const tid = (ob.type === 'NameExpr' ? recordId(ob.name) : null) ?? (tk0 !== null ? holders.get(tk0) ?? null : null);
          if (tid !== null && dead.has(tid) && pure(s.values[0]) && pure(t.index)) { n++; continue; }
        }
        const tk = trackKey(t);
        if (tk !== null) {
          for (const k of [...holders.keys()]) if (k === tk || k.startsWith(tk + '[')) holders.delete(k);
          const v = unparen(s.values[0]);
          const rid = v.type === 'NameExpr' ? recordId(v.name) : null;
          if (rid !== null) holders.set(tk, rid);
        } else holders.clear();
        fns(s, true);
        if (s.values.some(v => JSON.stringify(v).includes('"CallExpr"'))) holders.clear();
        out.push(s); continue;
      }
      if (s.type === 'AssignStat' || s.type === 'LocalStat' || s.type === 'CallStat' || s.type === 'ReturnStat') { holders.clear(); fns(s, true); out.push(s); continue; }
      const x: any = s;
      if (Array.isArray(x.body)) x.body = list(x.body, new Map());
      if (x.clauses) for (const c of x.clauses) c.body = list(c.body, new Map());
      if (x.elseBody) x.elseBody = list(x.elseBody, new Map());
      if (x.func) x.func.body = list(x.func.body, new Map());
      holders.clear();
      fns(s, true);
      out.push(s);
    }
    return out;
  };
  chunk.body = list(chunk.body, new Map());
  return n;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- one-time patch trampolines
/** A jump whose target slot is patched, `if S == w then pc = T else pc = P end`, where the chain from P only
 *  writes dump records / scratch registers and ends at T (pattern A), or a patched instruction whose decoy
 *  jumps to such a chain that returns to the instruction (pattern B). The program runs the chain once and
 *  then takes the patched path; the chain's stores are idempotent (single-valued), so the jump can always
 *  run the chain: the guard disappears and the stores dominate every later read. The chain's scratch-register
 *  writes are assumed dead at the join (they are on the patched path the program itself takes). */
export function foldTrampolines(blocks: Map<number, A.Stat[]>, model: PatchModel, recordId: (n: string) => string | null, pcVar: string): number {
  const isPc = (e: A.Expr | undefined) => !!e && unparen(e).type === 'NameExpr' && (unparen(e) as A.NameExpr).name === pcVar;
  const jumpOf = (s: A.Stat | undefined): number | null => {
    if (!s || s.type !== 'AssignStat' || s.op || s.targets.length !== 1 || !isPc(s.targets[0])) return null;
    const v = litOf(s.values[0]); return v.ok && typeof v.v === 'number' ? v.v : null;
  };
  const hasCode = (x: any): boolean => { let bad = false; const v = (y: any) => { if (bad || !y || typeof y !== 'object') return; if (Array.isArray(y)) { for (const z of y) v(z); return; } if (y.type === 'CallExpr' || y.type === 'MethodCallExpr' || y.type === 'FunctionExpr' || y.type === 'VarargLit' || y.type === 'ReturnStat' || y.type === 'BreakStat' || y.type === 'ContinueStat' || y.type === 'GotoStat' || y.type === 'WhileStat' || y.type === 'RepeatStat' || y.type === 'GenericForStat' || y.type === 'IfStat') { bad = true; return; } for (const k of Object.keys(y)) if (k !== 'loc') v(y[k]); }; v(x); return bad; };
  /** block = patch-only statements + final `pc = K`; returns K (stores recorded) */
  const patchOnly = (stmts: A.Stat[], stored: Map<string, Lit>): number | null => {
    if (!stmts.length) return null;
    const target = jumpOf(stmts[stmts.length - 1]);
    if (target === null) return null;
    const body = stmts.slice(0, -1);
    if (hasCode(body)) return null;
    // register tables: bases of record-holder writes, and their aliases
    const regs = new Set<string>();
    const holderWrite = (s: any) => { if (s.type !== 'AssignStat' || s.targets.length !== 1) return; const t = unparen(s.targets[0]); const v = s.values[0] ? unparen(s.values[0]) : undefined; if (t.type === 'IndexExpr' && unparen(t.obj).type === 'NameExpr' && v && v.type === 'NameExpr' && recordId(v.name) !== null) regs.add((unparen(t.obj) as A.NameExpr).name); };
    const all: any[] = []; const flat = (l: A.Stat[]) => { for (const s of l) { all.push(s); if (s.type === 'DoStat' || s.type === 'NumericForStat') flat(s.body); } }; flat(body);
    for (const s of all) holderWrite(s);

    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) for (const s of all) if (s.type === 'AssignStat' && s.targets.length === 1 && s.values.length === 1) { const t = unparen(s.targets[0]), v = unparen(s.values[0]); if (t.type === 'NameExpr' && v.type === 'NameExpr' && regs.has(v.name)) regs.add(t.name); }
    const holders = new Map<string, string>();
    const lits = new Map<string, Lit>();

    const run = (l: A.Stat[]): boolean => {

      last = b; b = r;
    }
    return { stored, last };
  };
  const guardSlots = (cond: A.Expr): Array<[string, Lit]> | null => {
    const out: Array<[string, Lit]> = [];
    const flat = (e: A.Expr): boolean => {
      const u = unparen(e);
      if (u.type === 'BinExpr' && u.op === 'and') return flat(u.left) && flat(u.right);
      if (u.type !== 'BinExpr' || u.op !== '==') return false;
      let ix = unparen(u.left), lv = litOf(u.right);
      if (ix.type !== 'IndexExpr' || !lv.ok) { ix = unparen(u.right); lv = litOf(u.left); }
      if (ix.type !== 'IndexExpr' || !lv.ok) return false;
      const ob = unparen(ix.obj); if (ob.type !== 'NameExpr') return false;

    };
    return flat(cond) && out.length ? out : null;
  };
  let folded = 0;
  let nextKey = Math.max(0, ...blocks.keys()) + 1;
  for (const [x, stmts] of [...blocks]) {
    const last = stmts[stmts.length - 1];
    if (!last || last.type !== 'IfStat' || last.clauses.length !== 1 || !last.elseBody || last.elseBody.length !== 1) continue;
    const p = jumpOf(last.elseBody[0]); if (p === null) continue;
    const gs = guardSlots(last.clauses[0].cond); if (!gs) continue;
    const arm = last.clauses[0].body;
    const t = arm.length === 1 ? jumpOf(arm[0]) : null;
    if (t !== null && t !== x) {
      // pattern A: patched jump target; the chain from the decoy target ends at the patched target
      const c = chain(p, t);
      if (!c || !gs.every(([sk, v]) => c.stored.get(sk) === v)) continue;

    if (stmts.length !== 1) continue;
    const c = chain(p, x);
    if (!c || !gs.every(([sk, v]) => c.stored.get(sk) === v)) continue;
    const lastStmts = blocks.get(c.last)!;
    const k2 = nextKey++;
    blocks.set(k2, arm);

    blocks.set(x, [{ type: 'AssignStat', targets: [{ type: 'NameExpr', name: pcVar }], values: [{ type: 'NumberLit', value: p, raw: String(p) }] }]);

  }
  return folded;
}

// print predecessors (blocks jumping to) and contents of block(s) of a proto
import { readFileSync } from 'fs';
import { specializeVM } from '../packages/core/src/index.js';
import { print } from '../packages/core/src/printer.js';
const src = readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8');
const dump = JSON.parse(readFileSync(process.argv[3], 'utf8'));

const pid = process.argv[5];

  for (const [k, b] of blocks) txt.set(k, print({ type: 'Chunk', body: b } as any));
  for (const [k, t] of txt) {

  }
} });

// print block(s) by id with predecessors, recursively up to depth
import { readFileSync } from 'fs';
import { specializeVM } from '../packages/core/src/index.js';
import { print } from '../packages/core/src/printer.js';
const src = readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8');
const dump = JSON.parse(readFileSync(process.argv[3], 'utf8'));
const patches = JSON.parse(readFileSync(process.argv[4], 'utf8'));
const pid = process.argv[5];
const ids = process.argv[6].split(',').map(Number);
const depth = Number(process.argv[7] ?? 1);
specializeVM(src, dump, { helper: { name: 'arg361', path: 'k' }, only: [pid], patches, onBlocks: (id, blocks, pcVar) => {
  const txt = new Map<number, string>();
  for (const [k, b] of blocks) txt.set(k, print({ type: 'Chunk', body: b } as any));
  const seen = new Set<number>();
  const show = (k: number, d: number) => {
    if (seen.has(k)) return; seen.add(k);
    const preds = [...txt].filter(([, u]) => new RegExp('\\b' + pcVar + ' = ' + k + '\\b').test(u)).map(([j]) => j);
    console.log(`=== block ${k} preds [${preds.join(',')}]\n${txt.get(k) ?? '(missing)'}`);
    if (d > 0) for (const j of preds.slice(0, 6)) show(j, d - 1);
  };
  for (const k of ids) show(k, depth);
} });
EOF

## 1490. ИИ · шаг

Пишу проход продвижения регистров в локальные
bash
mkdir -p /data/prism/packages/core/src/passes && cat > /data/prism/packages/core/src/passes/regpromote.ts <<'EOF'
// Register-file promotion — universal, conservative.
//
//   local R = table.create(40)          local R = table.create(40)
//   R[3] = f(R[2]); g(R[3])        ->   local r2, r3; r3 = f(r2); g(r3)
//
// A local table that is used as a register file (initialised with `table.create(n)` or `{}`, never
// reassigned, not referenced from nested functions) has the slots it is only ever accessed through
// with literal indices turned into plain locals, so the usual propagation / dead-store / state-machine
// passes see them. Slots that can be reached in any other way stay in the table:
//   * upvalue cells `{[1] = n, [2] = R}` (another closure reads / writes slot n through the cell);
//   * ranges with a non-literal bound (`table.unpack(R, a, top)`, `for i = a, top do R[i] = … end`):
//     every slot from a upwards;
//   * `R[k]` with k a key of a generic-for over a local table whose keys are all literal (closing upvalue
//     cells): exactly those keys.
// `table.unpack(R, a, b)` with literal bounds becomes the list of the slots (one value when it is not the
// last expression of a list). Any other use of R (passed to a call, stored, a live alias, an unknown index)
// leaves the whole table untouched. A dead alias (`t = R` overwritten before any read) is harmless.
import type * as A from '../ast.js';
import { analyzeScopes, Binding, ScopeInfo } from '../analysis/scope.js';

const unparen = (e: A.Expr): A.Expr => { while (e && e.type === 'ParenExpr') e = e.expr; return e; };
const intLit = (e: A.Expr | undefined): number | null => {
  if (!e) return null;
  const u = unparen(e);
  if (u.type === 'NumberLit' && Number.isInteger(u.value)) return u.value;
  if (u.type === 'UnExpr' && u.op === '-') { const v = unparen(u.expr); if (v.type === 'NumberLit' && Number.isInteger(v.value)) return -v.value; }
  return null;
};
const isMulti = (e: A.Expr | undefined) => !!e && (e.type === 'CallExpr' || e.type === 'MethodCallExpr' || e.type === 'VarargLit');
const calleeName = (c: A.Expr): string => {
  const u = unparen(c);
  if (u.type === 'NameExpr') return u.name;
  if (u.type === 'MemberExpr' && unparen(u.obj).type === 'NameExpr') return (unparen(u.obj) as A.NameExpr).name + '.' + u.name;
  if (u.type === 'IndexExpr' && unparen(u.obj).type === 'NameExpr' && unparen(u.index).type === 'StringLit') return (unparen(u.obj) as A.NameExpr).name + '.' + (unparen(u.index) as A.StringLit).value;
  return '';
};

interface Link { parent: any; key: string; index: number; }
function parentLinks(root: any): Map<any, Link> {
  const m = new Map<any, Link>();
  const visit = (node: any) => {
    for (const k of Object.keys(node)) {
      if (k === 'loc' || k === 'type') continue;
      const v = node[k];
      if (Array.isArray(v)) v.forEach((el, i) => { if (el && typeof el === 'object') { m.set(el, { parent: node, key: k, index: i }); visit(el); } });
      else if (v && typeof v === 'object') { m.set(v, { parent: node, key: k, index: -1 }); visit(v); }
    }
  };
  visit(root);
  return m;
}

export interface PromoteOptions {
  /** most locals a function may hold after promotion (Luau: 200) */
  maxLocals?: number;
}
export interface PromoteResult { promoted: number; tables: number; notes: string[]; }

export function promoteRegisters(chunk: A.Chunk, o: PromoteOptions = {}): PromoteResult {
  const maxLocals = o.maxLocals ?? 190;
  const res: PromoteResult = { promoted: 0, tables: 0, notes: [] };
  const scope: ScopeInfo = analyzeScopes(chunk);
  const links = parentLinks(chunk);
  const isTarget = (node: any): boolean => { const l = links.get(node); return !!l && l.parent.type === 'AssignStat' && l.key === 'targets'; };
  for (const b of scope.bindings) {
    if (b.kind !== 'local' || !b.init || b.initMulti) continue;
    const init = unparen(b.init);
    const fresh = (init.type === 'CallExpr' && calleeName(init.callee) === 'table.create') || (init.type === 'TableExpr' && init.fields.length === 0);
    if (!fresh || b.writeRefs.length || b.captured) continue;
    const why = analyzeTable(b);
    if (typeof why === 'string') { if (b.refs.length > 20) res.notes.push(`register table ${b.name}: not promoted (${why})`); continue; }
    const { uses, unsafe, minRange, unpacks } = why;
    // slots: used literally, not reachable otherwise; literal unpack ranges must be wholly promotable
    const ok = (n: number) => !unsafe.has(n) && n < minRange;
    let changed = true;
    const bad = new Set<number>();
    while (changed) {
      changed = false;
      for (const u of unpacks) {
        let all = true;
        for (let n = u.a; n <= u.b; n++) if (!ok(n) || bad.has(n)) { all = false; break; }
        if (!all) for (let n = u.a; n <= u.b; n++) if (!bad.has(n)) { bad.add(n); changed = true; }
      }
    }
    let slots = [...uses.keys()].filter(n => ok(n) && !bad.has(n));
    // keep within the local-variable budget of the function: the most used slots first
    const fnLocals = (scope.fnBindings.get(b.fn) ?? []).length;
    const room = Math.max(0, maxLocals - fnLocals);
    if (slots.length > room) {
      slots.sort((x, y) => uses.get(y)!.length - uses.get(x)!.length);
      slots = slots.slice(0, room);
      // an unpack range needs all of its slots

// Dead-store elimination by liveness — universal, conservative.
//
//   x = t; y = 8; …; x = 5; return f(x)     ->   …; x = 5; return f(x)
//
// Per function: a statement-level control-flow graph of the structured body (if / loops / break /
// continue / return), then backward liveness of its locals. An assignment whose targets are all
// locals that are dead afterwards is removed when its values have no effect (literals, names,
// closures, table constructors of such; with `pureIndex` also table reads), or reduced to the call
// when it is a single call. Locals referenced from nested functions are never touched (a call may
// read them), nor are functions with goto/labels.
import type * as A from '../ast.js';
import { analyzeScopes, Binding, ScopeInfo } from '../analysis/scope.js';

const unparen = (e: A.Expr): A.Expr => { while (e && e.type === 'ParenExpr') e = e.expr; return e; };
export interface DeadStoreOptions { /** table reads have no side effects (no __index metamethods), e.g. VM residual code */ pureIndex?: boolean; }

class Bail extends Error {}

export function removeDeadStores(chunk: A.Chunk, o: DeadStoreOptions = {}): number {
  const scope = analyzeScopes(chunk);
  let removed = 0;
  const fns: Array<A.FunctionExpr | A.Chunk> = [chunk];
  const collect = (m: any) => { if (!m || typeof m !== 'object') return; if (Array.isArray(m)) { for (const x of m) collect(x); return; } if (m.type === 'FunctionExpr') fns.push(m); for (const k of Object.keys(m)) if (k !== 'loc') collect(m[k]); };
  collect(chunk.body);
  for (const fn of fns) { try { removed += perFunction(fn, scope, o); } catch (e) { if (!(e instanceof Bail)) throw e; } }
  return removed;
}

  const W = Math.ceil(tracked.size / 32);
  interface Node { uses: Uint32Array; defs: Uint32Array; succ: number[]; stmt?: A.AssignStat; list?: A.Stat[]; }

        case 'RepeatStat': { const c = mk([s.cond]); const bd = seq(s.body, c, { brk: next, cont: c }); nodes[c].succ.push(next, bd); return bd; }

        case 'GenericForStat': { const init = mk(s.iters); const h = mk([]); const bd = seq(s.body, h, { brk: next, cont: h }); nodes[h].succ.push(bd, next); nodes[init].succ.push(h); return init; }

    const W = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(slotBits.size / 32));
    const N = nodes.length;

    const hasBit = (bs: Uint32Array, n: number) => { const i = slotBits.get(n); return i !== undefined && (bs[i >>> 5] & (1 << (i & 31))) !== 0; };

## 1638. ИИ · шаг

Пишу общий модуль графа потока управления
bash
mkdir -p /data/prism/packages/core/src/analysis && cat > /data/prism/packages/core/src/analysis/stmtcfg.ts <<'EOF'
// Statement-level control-flow graph of a structured function body (no goto) — shared by the forward
// data-flow analyses. Nested functions are not entered.
import type * as A from '../ast.js';

export interface CfgNode {
  /** the simple statement (assign / local / call / return / function decl / other) or the loop / if owning a test */
  stmt?: A.Stat;
  /** what the node is: a statement, an if-clause test, a loop test, a for-loop header (initialisers / variables) */
  kind: 'stmt' | 'cond' | 'loop' | 'forinit' | 'forvars' | 'jump' | 'exit';
  /** expression roots evaluated at the node */
  exprs: any[];
  succ: number[];
}
export interface StmtCfg { nodes: CfgNode[]; entry: number; exit: number; nodeOf: Map<A.Stat, number>; }

export function buildStmtCfg(body: A.Stat[]): StmtCfg | null {
  const nodes: CfgNode[] = [];
  const nodeOf = new Map<A.Stat, number>();
  let bad = false;
  const mk = (kind: CfgNode['kind'], exprs: any[], stmt?: A.Stat): number => { nodes.push({ kind, exprs, stmt, succ: [] }); return nodes.length - 1; };
  interface Loop { brk: number; cont: number; }
  const seq = (stmts: A.Stat[], next: number, L: Loop | null): number => { let cur = next; for (let i = stmts.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) cur = stat(stmts[i], cur, L); return cur; };
  const simple = (s: A.Stat, exprs: any[], next: number): number => { const n = mk('stmt', exprs, s); nodes[n].succ.push(next); nodeOf.set(s, n); return n; };
  const stat = (s: A.Stat, next: number, L: Loop | null): number => {
    switch (s.type) {
      case 'AssignStat': {
        const ex: any[] = [...s.values];
        for (const t of s.targets) { if (t.type === 'IndexExpr') ex.push(t.obj, t.index); else if (t.type === 'MemberExpr') ex.push(t.obj); else if (s.op) ex.push(t); }
        return simple(s, ex, next);
      }
      case 'LocalStat': return simple(s, s.init, next);
      case 'CallStat': return simple(s, [s.expr], next);
      case 'DoStat': return seq(s.body, next, L);
      case 'IfStat': {
        let alt = s.elseBody ? seq(s.elseBody, next, L) : next;
        for (let i = s.clauses.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const c = s.clauses[i]; const n = mk('cond', [c.cond], s); nodes[n].succ.push(seq(c.body, next, L), alt); alt = n; }
        nodeOf.set(s, alt);
        return alt;
      }
      case 'WhileStat': { const h = mk('loop', [s.cond], s); nodeOf.set(s, h); const bd = seq(s.body, h, { brk: next, cont: h }); nodes[h].succ.push(bd, next); return h; }
      case 'RepeatStat': { const c = mk('loop', [s.cond], s); const bd = seq(s.body, c, { brk: next, cont: c }); nodes[c].succ.push(next, bd); nodeOf.set(s, bd); return bd; }
      case 'NumericForStat': { const init = mk('forinit', [s.from, s.to, s.step], s); const h = mk('forvars', [], s); const bd = seq(s.body, h, { brk: next, cont: h }); nodes[h].succ.push(bd, next); nodes[init].succ.push(h); nodeOf.set(s, init); return init; }
      case 'GenericForStat': { const init = mk('forinit', s.iters, s); const h = mk('forvars', [], s); const bd = seq(s.body, h, { brk: next, cont: h }); nodes[h].succ.push(bd, next); nodes[init].succ.push(h); nodeOf.set(s, init); return init; }
      case 'ReturnStat': { const n = mk('stmt', s.args, s); nodeOf.set(s, n); return n; }
      case 'BreakStat': { const n = mk('jump', [], s); if (L) nodes[n].succ.push(L.brk); return n; }
      case 'ContinueStat': { const n = mk('jump', [], s); if (L) nodes[n].succ.push(L.cont); return n; }
      case 'GotoStat': case 'LabelStat': bad = true; return mk('jump', [], s);
      default: return simple(s, [s], next);
    }
  };
  const exit = mk('exit', []);
  const entry = seq(body, exit, null);
  return bad ? null : { nodes, entry, exit, nodeOf };
}

/** expression visitor that does not enter nested functions */
export function visitExpr(root: any, f: (node: any, parent: any, key: string, index: number) => boolean | void) {
  const v = (m: any, parent: any, key: string, index: number) => {
    if (!m || typeof m !== 'object') return;
    if (Array.isArray(m)) { m.forEach((x, i) => v(x, parent, key, i)); return; }
    if (m.type === 'FunctionExpr') return;
    if (f(m, parent, key, index) === false) return;
    for (const k of Object.keys(m)) if (k !== 'loc') { const x = m[k]; if (x && typeof x === 'object') { if (Array.isArray(x)) x.forEach((y, i) => v(y, m, k, i)); else v(x, m, k, -1); } }

import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'fs';
import { parse, print } from '../packages/core/src/index.js';
import { substituteConstPools, findPackHelpers } from '../packages/core/src/vm/constpool.js';

for (const l of lines) {
  const m = /^PROTOS\[(\d+)\] = function/.exec(l);
  if (m) { if (cur) parts.push({ id: cur.id, code: cur.ls.join('\n') }); cur = { id: m[1], ls: [l] }; continue; }
  if (cur) cur.ls.push(l); else head.push(l);
}
if (cur) parts.push({ id: cur.id, code: cur.ls.join('\n') });
const t0 = Date.now();
const helpers = findPackHelpers(parse(cleanSrc).chunk);
console.log('pack helpers:', [...helpers]);
const chunks = parts.map(p => ({ id: p.id, chunk: parse(p.code).chunk }));
const r = substituteConstPools(chunks, { isPack: (c) => helpers.has(printExpr(c)) });
console.log('replaced', r.replaced, 'changed', [...r.changed], Date.now() - t0, 'ms');
for (const n of r.notes) console.log(' -', n);
writeFileSync(out, head.join('\n') + '\n' + chunks.map(c => print(c.chunk)).join('\n'));
EOF

import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'fs';

if (cur) parts.push(cur.join('\n'));
const tot = { fused: 0, fixed: 0, setlists: 0 }; const sk = new Map<string, number>();
const outs: string[] = [];
for (const p of parts) {
  const { chunk } = parse(p);
  const r = fuseMultret(chunk, { isPack: (c) => helpers.has(printExpr(c)) });
  tot.fused += r.fused; tot.fixed += r.fixed; tot.setlists += r.setlists;
  for (const [k, v] of r.skipped) sk.set(k, (sk.get(k) ?? 0) + v);
  outs.push(print(chunk));
}
console.log(tot, [...sk]);
writeFileSync(process.argv[4] ?? '/tmp/mr.lua', head.join('\n') + '\n' + outs.join('\n'));
EOF

// Unobserved dump records — universal clean-up of self-modifying-bytecode leftovers in residual programs.
//
// After specialisation the residual code may still write into the dump's records (the patches the original
// bytecode applied to itself) and test them in one-time guards:
//

//   K_16[1684] = 2403
//
// A record that the residual program only ever writes at literal keys, or tests in such guards (an if whose
// branches do nothing but write records of the same kind), can no longer influence the program: its stores
// and guards are removed. A record read anywhere else (a run-time selected variant, an alias, a call
// argument) keeps all of its stores, and so do the records written under a guard on it (fixpoint).

export interface RecordCleanResult { stores: number; guards: number; records: number; changed: Set<string>; notes: string[]; }

const unparen = (e: A.Expr): A.Expr => { while (e && e.type === 'ParenExpr') e = e.expr; return e; };
const isLit = (e: A.Expr | undefined): boolean => {
  if (!e) return false; const u = unparen(e);
  if (u.type === 'NumberLit' || u.type === 'StringLit' || u.type === 'TrueLit' || u.type === 'FalseLit' || u.type === 'NilLit') return true;
  return u.type === 'UnExpr' && u.op === '-' && unparen(u.expr).type === 'NumberLit';
};

  interface Guard { proto: string; stmt: A.IfStat; rec: string; stores: Store[]; }

  const observed = new Set<string>();
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const storeOf = new Map<A.Stat, Store>();
  for (const p of protos) {
    const sc = analyzeScopes(p.chunk);
    const recOf = (e: A.Expr | undefined): string | null => {
      const u = e && unparen(e);
      if (!u || u.type !== 'NameExpr') return null;
      const b = sc.refOf.get(u);
      if (b && b.kind !== 'global') return null;
      return recordId(u.name);

    const asStore = (s: A.Stat): string | null => {
      if (s.type !== 'AssignStat' || s.op || s.targets.length !== 1 || s.values.length !== 1) return null;
      const t = unparen(s.targets[0]);
      if (t.type !== 'IndexExpr' || !isLit(t.index) || !isLit(s.values[0])) return null;
      return recOf(t.obj);

    const guardRec = (c: A.Expr): string | null => {
      let u = unparen(c);
      if (u.type === 'UnExpr' && u.op === 'not') u = unparen(u.expr);
      if (u.type !== 'BinExpr' || (u.op !== '==' && u.op !== '~=')) return null;
      const side = (a: A.Expr, b: A.Expr) => { const ua = unparen(a); return ua.type === 'IndexExpr' && isLit(ua.index) && isLit(b) ? recOf(ua.obj) : null; };
      return side(u.left, u.right) ?? side(u.right, u.left);
    };
    const counted = new Set<A.NameExpr>();
    const visitStmts = (list: A.Stat[]) => {
      for (const s of list) {
        const r = asStore(s);
        if (r !== null) { const st = { proto: p.id, stmt: s as A.AssignStat, rec: r }; stores.push(st); storeOf.set(s, st); seen.add(r); counted.add(unparen((unparen((s as A.AssignStat).targets[0]) as A.IndexExpr).obj) as A.NameExpr); continue; }
        if (s.type === 'IfStat' && s.clauses.length === 1) {
          const g = guardRec(s.clauses[0].cond);
          const branches = [s.clauses[0].body, s.elseBody ?? []];
          if (g !== null && branches.every(b => b.every(x => asStore(x) !== null))) {
            const gs: Store[] = [];
            for (const b of branches) for (const x of b) { const st = { proto: p.id, stmt: x as A.AssignStat, rec: asStore(x)! }; gs.push(st); counted.add(unparen((unparen((x as A.AssignStat).targets[0]) as A.IndexExpr).obj) as A.NameExpr); seen.add(st.rec); }
            guards.push({ proto: p.id, stmt: s, rec: g, stores: gs }); seen.add(g);
            // the record name inside the condition
            const visitC = (n: any) => { if (!n || typeof n !== 'object') return; if (n.type === 'NameExpr') { counted.add(n); return; } for (const k of Object.keys(n)) if (k !== 'loc') visitC(n[k]); };
            visitC(s.clauses[0].cond);
            continue;
          }
        }
        // nested statement lists
        switch (s.type) {
          case 'DoStat': case 'WhileStat': case 'RepeatStat': case 'NumericForStat': case 'GenericForStat': visitStmts(s.body); break;
          case 'IfStat': for (const c of s.clauses) visitStmts(c.body); if (s.elseBody) visitStmts(s.elseBody); break;
        }
      }
    };
    // every statement list, nested functions included
    const lists: A.Stat[][] = [];
    const findFns = (n: any) => { if (!n || typeof n !== 'object') return; if (Array.isArray(n)) { n.forEach(findFns); return; } if (n.type === 'FunctionExpr') lists.push(n.body); for (const k of Object.keys(n)) if (k !== 'loc') { const x = n[k]; if (x && typeof x === 'object') findFns(x); } };
    lists.push(p.chunk.body); findFns(p.chunk.body);
    for (const l of lists) visitStmts(l);
    // any other reference observes the record
    for (const b of sc.bindings) {
      if (b.kind !== 'global') continue;
      const r = recordId(b.name); if (r === null) continue;
      for (const ref of b.refs) if (!counted.has(ref)) { observed.add(r); break; }
    }
  }
  // records written under a guard on an observed record are observed too (the guard decides them) — and a guard
  // that writes an observed record observes its own condition
  let grow = true;
  while (grow) {
    grow = false;
    for (const g of guards) {
      if (observed.has(g.rec)) continue;
      if (g.stores.some(s => observed.has(s.rec))) { observed.add(g.rec); grow = true; }
    }
  }
  const dead = new Set([...seen].filter(r => !observed.has(r)));
  if (!dead.size) return res;
  const drop = new Set<A.Stat>();
  for (const s of stores) if (dead.has(s.rec)) drop.add(s.stmt);
  for (const g of guards) if (dead.has(g.rec) && g.stores.every(s => dead.has(s.rec))) { drop.add(g.stmt); res.guards++; }
  for (const p of protos) {
    let n = 0;
    const filter = (list: A.Stat[]) => {
      for (let i = list.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        const s = list[i];
        if (drop.has(s)) { list.splice(i, 1); n++; continue; }
        switch (s.type) {
          case 'DoStat': case 'WhileStat': case 'RepeatStat': case 'NumericForStat': case 'GenericForStat': filter(s.body); break;
          case 'IfStat': for (const c of s.clauses) filter(c.body); if (s.elseBody) filter(s.elseBody); break;
        }
      }
    };
    const findFns = (x: any) => { if (!x || typeof x !== 'object') return; if (Array.isArray(x)) { x.forEach(findFns); return; } if (x.type === 'FunctionExpr') filter(x.body); for (const k of Object.keys(x)) if (k !== 'loc') { const y = x[k]; if (y && typeof y === 'object') findFns(y); } };
    filter(p.chunk.body); findFns(p.chunk.body);
    if (n) res.changed.add(p.id);
  }
  res.stores = stores.filter(s => dead.has(s.rec)).length;
  res.records = dead.size;
  res.notes.push(`${res.stores} store(s) into ${dead.size} dump record(s) and ${res.guards} one-time patch guard(s) removed: the residual program never reads these records otherwise (self-modifying bytecode leftovers)` + (observed.size ? `; ${observed.size} record(s) still read at run time keep their stores` : ''));
  return res;
}
EOF

/** most locals in scope at once in a function body (the Luau limit is on active locals, not on declarations) */
function maxActiveLocals(list: A.Stat[], base: number): number {
  let cur = base, best = base;
  for (const s of list) {

      case 'LocalStat': cur += s.names.length; if (cur > best) best = cur; break;

      case 'GenericForStat': best = Math.max(best, maxActiveLocals(s.body, cur + s.names.length)); break;
      case 'IfStat': for (const c of s.clauses) best = Math.max(best, maxActiveLocals(c.body, cur)); if (s.elseBody) best = Math.max(best, maxActiveLocals(s.elseBody, cur)); break;

  }

}
