-- prism: vm
-- VM-residual style: varargs-pack helper, register table, multiple results through a top marker
local PACK = function(...)
  local n = select("#", ...)
  if n == 0 then return 0, {} end
  return n, { ... }
end
local function f3(a, b, c) return a, b, c end
local function many(...) return ... end
local function F(...)
  local R = table.create(20)
  local N, ARGS = PACK(...)
  local n, t, j
  R[1] = ARGS[1]
  -- call with all results of another call
  R[2] = print
  R[3] = "x"
  R[4] = many
  R[5] = 1
  R[6] = nil
  R[7] = 3
  n, t = PACK(R[4](table.unpack(R, 5, 7)))
  n = n + 4 - 1
  j = 0
  for i = 4, n do j = j + 1; R[i] = t[j] end
  R[2](table.unpack(R, 3, n))
  -- chained: print(many(many("p", "q")))
  R[2] = print
  R[3] = many
  R[4] = many
  R[5] = "p"
  R[6] = "q"
  n, t = PACK(R[4](table.unpack(R, 5, 6)))
  n = n + 4 - 1
  j = 0
  for i = 4, n do j = j + 1; R[i] = t[j] end
  n, t = PACK(R[3](table.unpack(R, 4, n)))
  n = n + 3 - 1
  j = 0
  for i = 3, n do j = j + 1; R[i] = t[j] end
  R[2](table.unpack(R, 3, n))
  -- list store into a fresh table
  R[2] = {}
  R[3] = "a"
  R[4] = many
  R[5] = "b"
  R[6] = "c"
  n, t = PACK(R[4](table.unpack(R, 5, 6)))
  n = n + 4 - 1
  j = 0
  for i = 4, n do j = j + 1; R[i] = t[j] end
  local T = R[2]
  table.move(R, 3, n, 1, T)
  print(#R[2], R[2][1], R[2][2], R[2][3])
  -- list store into an existing table at an offset
  R[8] = { "k1", "k2", "k3" }
  R[9] = many
  R[10] = "m"
  n, t = PACK(R[9](R[10], nil, "z"))
  n = n + 9 - 1
  j = 0
  for i = 9, n do j = j + 1; R[i] = t[j] end
  table.move(R, 9, n, 2, R[8])
  print(R[8][1], R[8][2], R[8][3], R[8][4])
  -- varargs after the first parameter
  R[2] = print
  R[3] = R[1]
  local c = N - 1 - 1
  if not (c < 0) then else c = -1 end
  j = 0
  for i = 4, 4 + c do R[i] = ARGS[2 + j]; j = j + 1 end
  R[2](table.unpack(R, 3, 4 + c))
  -- fixed number of results
  n, t = PACK(f3(7, 8, 9))
  R[5] = t[1]
  R[6] = t[2]
  print(R[5], R[6])
  -- results nobody takes
  n, t = PACK(print("side effect"))
  -- return all results
  R[2] = many
  R[3] = "r1"
  R[4] = "r2"
  n, t = PACK(R[2](table.unpack(R, 3, 4)))
  n = n + 2 - 1
  j = 0
  for i = 2, n do j = j + 1; R[i] = t[j] end
  do return table.unpack(R, 2, n) end
end

  // table that is not resolved to a record withdraws the implication. No fixpoint: no implication used.

  });

  while true do

    if k > n then break end
    if k == 6 then acc[#acc + 1] = "six" else acc[#acc + 1] = k end
  end

## 1886. ИИ · шаг

Переписываю фазы импликаций в patches.ts
bash
cd /data/prism && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='packages/core/src/vm/patches.ts'
s=open(p).read()
a=s.index('export interface ResolveOptions {')
b=s.index('  run(true, implied);\n')+len('  run(true, implied);\n')
new='''export interface ResolveOptions {
  /** residual record name -> dump table id (K_n / PROTO_n) */
  recordId: (name: string) => string | null;
  /** closure creation site -> created proto id */
  createdProto?: (call: A.CallExpr) => string | null;
  /** the dump value of a record slot before the program runs (`ok` false: not a literal / unknown);
   *  without it no one-time patch flag implies anything (a flag already holding its value says nothing) */
  initial?: (tid: string, key: Lit) => { ok: boolean; v: Lit };
}
const skParts = (sk: string): { tid: string; key: Lit; keyLit: string } => {
  const i = sk.indexOf('|'); const kp = sk.slice(i + 1);
  const key: Lit = kp.startsWith('n:') ? Number(kp.slice(2)) : kp.slice(2);
  return { tid: sk.slice(0, i), key, keyLit: JSON.stringify(key) };
};
/** structured code of all protos: resolve remaining patched reads, then drop stores into records no longer read */
export function resolvePatchedReads(protos: Array<{ id: string; chunk: A.Chunk }>, patches: PatchSpec[], o: ResolveOptions): ResolveReport {
  const rep: ResolveReport = { resolved: 0, remaining: 0, dropped: 0, notes: [] };
  const model = new PatchModel(patches);
  const remainingBy = new Map<string, number>();
  const escaped = new Set<string>();
  // creation order (parents first)
  const created = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  const scanCalls = (node: any, fn: (c: A.CallExpr) => void) => { const st: any[] = [node]; while (st.length) { const x = st.pop(); if (!x || typeof x !== 'object') continue; if (Array.isArray(x)) { for (const y of x) st.push(y); continue; } if (x.type === 'CallExpr') fn(x); for (const k of Object.keys(x)) if (k !== 'loc') st.push(x[k]); } };
  for (const p of protos) { const s = new Set<string>(); if (o.createdProto) scanCalls(p.chunk, (c) => { const id = o.createdProto!(c); if (id !== null) s.add(id); }); created.set(p.id, s); }
  const order = creationOrder(protos.map(p => p.id), created);
  const byId = new Map(protos.map(p => [p.id, p]));
  const capturedBy = new Map(protos.map(p => [p.id, capturedNames(p.chunk)]));
  /** what a (non-mutating) analysis of the whole program under some implications observed */
  interface Seen { runs: Map<string, Known>; escaped: Set<string>; copied: Map<string, Set<string>>; unknown: Map<string, Set<string>>; }
  const run = (mutate: boolean, implied: Map<string, Known>, seen?: Seen) => {
    const entry = new Map<string, Known>();
    for (const { id, cyclic } of order) {
      const p = byId.get(id)!;
      const an = makeAnalyzer({ model, recordId: o.recordId, createdProto: o.createdProto, mutate, captured: capturedBy.get(id),
        onRead: mutate ? (t, ok) => { if (ok) rep.resolved++; else { rep.remaining++; remainingBy.set(t, (remainingBy.get(t) ?? 0) + 1); } } : undefined,
        onEscape: mutate ? (t) => escaped.add(t) : seen ? (t) => seen.escaped.add(t) : undefined,
        onCopy: seen ? (t) => { let c = seen.copied.get(id); if (!c) seen.copied.set(id, c = new Set()); c.add(t); } : undefined,
        implied: implied.size ? (tid, key, lit) => implied.get(slotKey(tid, key) + '=' + JSON.stringify(lit)) ?? null : undefined,
        onRunStore: seen ? (sk, lit, after) => { const kk = sk + '=' + JSON.stringify(lit); const prev = seen.runs.get(kk); seen.runs.set(kk, prev ? intersect(prev, after) : new Map(after)); } : undefined,
        onUnknownStore: seen ? (key, value) => { let u = seen.unknown.get(id); if (!u) seen.unknown.set(id, u = new Set()); u.add((key.ok ? JSON.stringify(key.v) : '*') + '=' + (value.ok ? JSON.stringify(value.v) : '*')); } : undefined,
        onCreate: (pid, k) => { const prev = entry.get(pid); entry.set(pid, prev ? intersect(prev, k) : k); } });
      an.list(p.chunk.body, an.fresh(cyclic ? new Map() : (entry.get(id) ?? new Map())));
    }
  };
  // guard implications: a true guard `slot == v` (a one-time patch flag) implies the single-valued slots
  // known at the end of the straight-line run of every store writing v (the patch chain the flag closes).
  // F(I): the implications observed under the implications I — from the stores reachable under I, for flags
  // whose dump value is known and differs from v, in records that never escape, and with no store into an
  // unknown table (key / value matching) in a proto holding a copy of the record. An implication set with
  // I ⊆ F(I) justifies itself: the first read at run time contradicting it would follow a store that was
  // reachable under it. Growth (I := F(I)) proposes, a descending verification (I := I ∩ F(I)) disposes.
  const observe = (implied: Map<string, Known>): Map<string, Known> => {
    const seen: Seen = { runs: new Map(), escaped: new Set(), copied: new Map(), unknown: new Map() };
    run(false, implied, seen);
    const out = new Map<string, Known>();
    const trace = devEnv('PRISM_IMPL_TRACE');
    const why = new Map<string, number>();
    const drop = (r: string) => why.set(r, (why.get(r) ?? 0) + 1);
    for (const [kk, m] of seen.runs) {
      const sk = kk.slice(0, kk.indexOf('=')); const litS = kk.slice(kk.indexOf('=') + 1); const lit = JSON.parse(litS) as Lit;
      if (!model.single(sk)) { drop('multi-valued'); continue; }
      const { tid, key, keyLit } = skParts(sk);
      if (seen.escaped.has(tid)) { drop('escaped'); continue; }
      const iv = o.initial?.(tid, key);
      if (!iv || !iv.ok || iv.v === lit) { drop(iv && iv.ok ? 'initially set' : 'initial unknown'); continue; }
      let bad = false;
      for (const [pid, ts] of seen.copied) {
        if (!ts.has(tid)) continue;
        const u = seen.unknown.get(pid); if (!u) continue;
        if (u.has(keyLit + '=' + litS) || u.has(keyLit + '=*') || u.has('*=' + litS) || u.has('*=*')) { bad = true; break; }
      }
      if (bad) { drop('aliased store'); continue; }
      const mm = new Map(m); mm.delete(sk);
      if (mm.size) out.set(kk, mm);
    }
    if (trace !== undefined) { console.error(`[impl] observed ${out.size} implication(s); dropped: ${[...why].map(([r, n]) => r + ' ' + n).join(', ')}; escaped ${seen.escaped.size}, copied in ${seen.copied.size} proto(s)`); for (const [kk, mm] of out) if (trace && kk.startsWith(trace)) console.error('  ', kk, [...mm].slice(0, 12).map(([x, y]) => x + '=' + y).join(' ')); }
    return out;
  };
  const sameK = (a: Map<string, Known>, b: Map<string, Known>) => a.size === b.size && [...a].every(([k, v]) => { const w = b.get(k); return !!w && w.size === v.size && [...v].every(([x, y]) => w.get(x) === y); });
  let implied = new Map<string, Known>();
  let phases = 0;
  if (model.slots.size && o.initial) {
    // growth: until stable (bounded)
    for (let g = 0; g < 8; g++) { phases++; const next = observe(implied); if (sameK(next, implied)) break; implied = next; }
    // verification: strictly descending until self-justified (always terminates)
    for (let d = 0; d < 64; d++) {
      phases++;
      const f = observe(implied);
      const next = new Map<string, Known>();
      for (const [kk, m] of implied) { const w = f.get(kk); if (!w) continue; const x = intersect(m, w); if (x.size) next.set(kk, x); }
      if (sameK(next, implied)) break;
      implied = next;
      if (d === 63) implied = new Map();   // (unreachable in practice) not verified: use nothing
    }
  }
  run(true, implied);

import { readFileSync } from 'fs';
import { parse } from '../packages/core/src/parser.js';
import { printExpr } from '../packages/core/src/vm/specialize.js';
import { recordFlow } from '../packages/core/src/vm/patches.js';
const st = JSON.parse(readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8'));
const only = process.argv[3] ? new Set(process.argv[3].split(',')) : null;
const names = new Set<string>(st.records);
const tables = new Set<string>(st.patches.map((p: any) => String(p.table)));
const recordId = (nm: string): string | null => { if (!names.has(nm)) return null; const m = /^(?:K|PROTO)_(.+)$/.exec(nm); return m ? m[1] : null; };
for (const p of st.protos) {
  if (only && !only.has(p.id)) continue;
  const chunk = parse(p.code).chunk;
  const reasons = new Map<string, string>();
  const f = recordFlow(chunk, recordId, (t) => tables.has(t), (t, r, e) => { if (!reasons.has(t)) reasons.set(t, r + ' :: ' + printExpr(e).slice(0, 80)); });
  if (f.escaped.size) console.log('proto', p.id, 'escaped', [...f.escaped].join(','), '\n   ', [...reasons].map(([t, r]) => 'K_' + t + ': ' + r).join('\n    '));
}
EOF

## 2017. ИИ · шаг

Пишу свёртку идемпотентных гардов
bash
cd /data/prism/packages/core/src && cat >> vm/records.ts <<'EOF'

/** One-time guards whose branches agree once the flag is written:
 *
 *    if R[k] == v then A else R[k] = v; A end      ->  do R[k] = v; A end
 *    if R[k] ~= v then R[k] = v; A else A end      ->  do R[k] = v; A end
 *
 *  (R a dump record — a plain table without metatables; several tested slots joined by `and`, with stores
 *  writing tested slots with their tested values). When the guard holds, the stores write the values the
 *  slots already have; otherwise the branch with the stores runs as it is. A is compared textually. */
export function foldIdempotentGuards(chunk: A.Chunk, recordId: (name: string) => string | null, print: (n: A.Chunk) => string): number {
  let n = 0;
  const sc = analyzeScopes(chunk);
  const recName = (e: A.Expr): string | null => {
    const u = unparen(e); if (u.type !== 'NameExpr') return null;
    const b = sc.refOf.get(u); if (b && b.kind !== 'global') return null;
    return recordId(u.name) !== null ? u.name : null;
  };
  const litKey = (e: A.Expr | undefined): string | null => {
    if (!e || !isLit(e)) return null; const u = unparen(e);
    switch (u.type) {
      case 'NumberLit': return 'n' + String(u.value);
      case 'StringLit': return 's' + JSON.stringify(u.value);
      case 'TrueLit': return 'b1'; case 'FalseLit': return 'b0'; case 'NilLit': return 'nil';
      case 'UnExpr': { const v = unparen(u.expr) as A.NumberLit; return 'n' + String(-v.value); }
    }
    return null;
  };
  /** `R[k] op v` -> "R|k" -> "v" */
  const tests = (cond: A.Expr, op: '==' | '~='): Map<string, string> | null => {
    const out = new Map<string, string>();
    const flat = (e: A.Expr): boolean => {
      const u = unparen(e);
      if (op === '==' && u.type === 'BinExpr' && u.op === 'and') return flat(u.left) && flat(u.right);
      if (u.type !== 'BinExpr' || u.op !== op) return false;
      let ix = unparen(u.left), lv = u.right;
      if (ix.type !== 'IndexExpr') { ix = unparen(u.right); lv = u.left; }
      if (ix.type !== 'IndexExpr') return false;
      const r = recName(ix.obj), k = litKey(ix.index), v = litKey(lv);
      if (r === null || k === null || v === null || v === 'nil') return false;
      const sk = r + '|' + k; if (out.has(sk) && out.get(sk) !== v) return false;
      out.set(sk, v); return true;
    };
    return flat(cond) && out.size ? out : null;
  };
  const storeOf = (s: A.Stat): [string, string] | null => {
    if (s.type !== 'AssignStat' || s.op || s.targets.length !== 1 || s.values.length !== 1) return null;
    const t = unparen(s.targets[0]); if (t.type !== 'IndexExpr') return null;
    const r = recName(t.obj), k = litKey(t.index), v = litKey(s.values[0]);
    return r !== null && k !== null && v !== null ? [r + '|' + k, v] : null;
  };
  const text = (l: A.Stat[]) => print({ type: 'Chunk', body: l } as A.Chunk);
  /** body = stores of tested slots with their tested values, then `rest` equal to other */
  const split = (body: A.Stat[], other: A.Stat[], ts: Map<string, string>): A.Stat[] | null => {
    let i = 0;
    while (i < body.length) { const st = storeOf(body[i]); if (!st || ts.get(st[0]) !== st[1]) break; i++; }
    if (i === 0 || body.length - i !== other.length) return null;
    return text(body.slice(i)) === text(other) ? body.slice(0, i) : null;
  };
  const visit = (l: A.Stat[]) => {
    for (let i = 0; i < l.length; i++) {
      const s = l[i];
      for (const k of ['body', 'elseBody'] as const) { const b = (s as any)[k]; if (Array.isArray(b)) visit(b); }
      if (s.type === 'IfStat') for (const c of s.clauses) visit(c.body);
      if (s.type !== 'IfStat' || s.clauses.length !== 1) continue;
      const c = s.clauses[0], els = s.elseBody ?? [];
      let pre: A.Stat[] | null = null, rest: A.Stat[] = [];
      const pos = tests(c.cond, '==');
      if (pos) { pre = split(els, c.body, pos); rest = c.body; }
      if (!pre) { const neg = tests(c.cond, '~='); if (neg && neg.size === 1) { pre = split(c.body, els, neg); rest = els; } }
      if (!pre) continue;
      l[i] = { type: 'DoStat', body: [...pre, ...rest] } as A.Stat;
      n++;
    }
  };
  visit(chunk.body);
  walk(chunk, (m: any) => { if (m.type === 'FunctionExpr') visit(m.body); });
  return n;
}
EOF

## 2042. ИИ

Пока удалось достать **структуру и часть содержимого**, но не всю прикладную логику скрипта.

### Что уже видно в TEST-PRISM3

- Восстановлено дерево из **35 прототипов функций**. Главная цепочка начинается с `proto 1 → proto 10`; внутри `proto 10` создаются 24 вложенные функции.
- `proto 1` собирает таблицу из **167 полей** и передаёт её дальше. В ней есть строки, числа, ссылки на глобальные функции и созданное замыкание.
- В `proto 10` видна подготовка окружения: он собирает функции `string`, `table`, `coroutine`, `task`, использует `Instance`, `Vector2`, `Vector3`, `Random`, `loadstring`, а также проверяет наличие библиотеки `debug`. Текст проверки: **“The debug library is required on Luau platforms. Please open a support ticket.”**
- Среди извлечённых строк есть `HttpService`, `GetAsync`, `PostAsync`, `RequestAsync`, `RunService`, `IsClient`, `IsServer`, `ScreenGui`, `Frame`, `Folder`, `getupvalue`, `setupvalue`, `getconstants`. **Это пока только найденные имена:** по ним одним нельзя утверждать, что скрипт действительно отправляет запросы или выполняет конкретные действия.
- Механизм upvalues и связей между замыканиями распознан, но ещё не собран обратно в обычные локальные переменные. Остались и обращения к изменяемым на лету данным.

То есть сейчас я могу показать внутреннее устройство и отдельные элементы, но **честно описать полное поведение скрипта или воспроизвести его логику пока нельзя**.

### Насчёт универсальности

Да, я делал проходы как **общие инструменты анализа**, а не под конкретные значения этого файла. Проверил исходники основных пакетов: упоминаний `TEST-PRISM3` и конкретных тестовых `proto`/`K` там не нашёл. При этом отдельные *scratch*-скрипты для диагностики и запуска теста привязаны к этому таргету — это вспомогательные эксперименты, не универсальное ядро.

Универсальность не означает, что инструмент уже справится с **любой** обфускацией: распознавание зависит от структуры кода и поддерживаемых конструкций. Последние изменения ещё не прошли полный набор тестов.

**Останавливаюсь и жду, пока скажешь продолжать.**
